raw_text:
27 AAWARA PHIRNA [To Wander]
Synonyms: TAHA(TEH),HAMA(HYM)
27.1 TAHA():  To walk astounded and worried, to lost in state of
misguidance from here to there. and as per Ibn ul faris this is JINSUN
MIN ALHAYRAH(جِنسٌ مِّنَ الحَيرَة) meaning this a type of astoundness,
and ALTEH(التيه) is such a plain field in which the one walking get lost
Surat Al-Mā'idah (The Table Spread) - سورة المائدة
5:26
قَالَ فَإِنَّهَا مُحَرَّمَةٌ عَلَيْهِمْ ۛ أَرْبَعِينَ سَنَةً ۛ يَتِيهُونَ فِي الْأَرْضِ  ۚ فَلَا تَأْسَ عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْفَاسِقِينَ
[ Allah ] said, "Then indeed, it is forbidden to them for forty years [in which] they will wander throughout the land.  So do not grieve over the defiantly disobedient people."
27.2 HAMA(هَامَ):
meaning to wander in state of madness. wandering of lover type person.
sahib munjad writes its meaning as to love and to wander. In the Quran
Surat Ash-Shu`arā' (The Poets) - سورة الشعراء
26:224
وَالشُّعَرَاءُ يَتَّبِعُهُمُ الْغَاوُونَ
And the poets - [only] the deviators follow them;
Surat Ash-Shu`arā' (The Poets) - سورة الشعراء
26:225
أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّهُمْ فِي كُلِّ وَادٍ يَهِيمُونَ
Do you not see that in every valley they roam
Summary:
27.1 TAH : In astounded and worried wandering misguided on paths
27.2 HAM: Wandering in Fervent Love or Affair of Love

title: content/A/A28.html
raw_text:
28 AAWAZ AUR US KI IQSAAM [SOUND AND ITS TYPES]
28.1 SAUT(صَوْت): In arabic SAUT is used for every type of sound.
whether it occurs due to speech or due to things colliding. one
definition of SAUT is "If the thing that comes out of mouth is not
formed of Words and Letters then it's SAUT" <- this is not a
dependable definition.
In the Quran
Surat Al-Ĥujurāt (The Rooms) - سورة الحجرات
49:2
يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لَا تَرْفَعُوا أَصْوَاتَكُمْ فَوْقَ صَوْتِ النَّبِيِّ  وَلَا تَجْهَرُوا لَهُ بِالْقَوْلِ كَجَهْرِ بَعْضِكُمْ لِبَعْضٍ أَن تَحْبَطَ أَعْمَالُكُمْ وَأَنتُمْ لَا تَشْعُرُونَ
O you who have believed, do not raise your voices above the voice of the Prophet
or be loud to him in speech like the loudness of some of you to others,
lest your deeds become worthless while you perceive not.
It is obvious that companions (RA) of Prophet Muhammad (PBUH ) had
meaningful speech, and not meaningless voices. Yet Ibn Faris made a
comprehensive definition of SAUT that is KULLU MA WAQARA FI UZUNI SAM3IN
(كُلٌّ مَا وَقَرَ فِي اُذُنِ سَامعٍ) Everything that collides with the
Ear of the listener is sound.
In the Holy Quran there are mentioned some sound of Living things and
some of Non Living things . We will describe them in the same order
SOUNDS OF LIVING THINGS
SADD,SARKH,HMS,HASEES,MAKA-( MKW),TASDYAH,DBH,KHWAR,ZAFER, SHAHEQ,LAHC
28.2 SADDA (صَدَّ):  YASIDDU SADEEDAN(يَصِدّ،صَدِيداً) the sound of
cry and wailing and sighing as the time of a person falling. but this
word is used in the Quran in the meaning of screaming and shouting only.
Surat Az-Zukhruf (The Ornaments of Gold) - سورة الزخرف
43:57
وَلَمَّا ضُرِبَ ابْنُ مَرْيَمَ مَثَلًا إِذَا قَوْمُكَ مِنْهُ يَصِدُّونَ
And when the son of Mary was presented as an example, immediately your people laughed aloud.
28.3 SARKH( صرخ) : Sound in times of distress and anxiety,cry for help. ALLAH said
Surat Fāţir (Originator) - سورة فاطر
35:37
وَهُمْ يَصْطَرِخُونَ فِيهَا رَبَّنَا أَخْرِجْنَا نَعْمَلْ صَالِحًا غَيْرَ الَّذِي كُنَّا نَعْمَلُ ۚ
أَوَلَمْ نُعَمِّرْكُم مَّا يَتَذَكَّرُ فِيهِ مَن تَذَكَّرَ وَجَاءَكُمُ
النَّذِيرُ ۖ فَذُوقُوا فَمَا لِلظَّالِمِينَ مِن نَّصِيرٍ
And they will cry out therein, "Our Lord, remove us ;  we will do righteousness - other than what we were doing!"
But did We not grant you life enough for whoever would remember therein
to remember, and the warner had come to you? So taste [the punishment],
for there is not for the wrongdoers any helper.
28.4 HMS(هَمْس):
sound of any human movement. sound of whispers, ASSAUT AL KHAFY WA
AHASS(الصوت الخفّيِ وَ اَحَسَّ) so it means any soft and listenable
sound of human. ALLAH said
Surat Ţāhā (Ta-Ha) - سورة طه
20:108

Surat Al-Ĥijr (The Rocky Tract) - سورة الحجر
15:26
وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا الْإِنسَانَ مِن صَلْصَالٍ مِّنْ حَمَإٍ مَّسْنُونٍ
And We did certainly create man out of clay from an altered black mud.


28.20 QARY3AH(قَارعة): QR3 (قرع) means to smash one thing with another thing. QR3 ALBAAB(قَرَعَ اْلَبابَ) meaning to knock on the door , meaning sound result when one leaf of the door is collided with the other or by hitting with hand or with any other thing. Judgement day is called QARY3AH by ALLAH.as at that time things will be colliding with each other producing sounds. ALLAH said

Surat Al-Qāri`ah (The Calamity) - سورة القارعة
101:1
الْقَارِعَةُ
The Striking Calamity -
Surat Al-Qāri`ah (The Calamity) - سورة القارعة
101:2
مَا الْقَارِعَةُ
What is the Striking Calamity?

29 AAHISTA AAHISTA [SLOWLY SLOWLY]
Synonyms: RUWYD(R-W-D),RUKHA-(R-K-W), 3URF,YUSR,ISTADRAJ,DALLA
29.1 RUWYD( رُوَيدَا) : derived from ALRUWD(الرّود) and gerund of
ARWADU(اَرْوَدُ) is MASAGGR(مصغّر). It is said IMSH 3LA ALRUWD(إِمش علي
الرود) meaning walk slowly . SARU SAYRAN RUWAYDAN(سَارُوْا سَيْراً
رُوَيْداً). they walked softly and slowly slowly. and ARWADU meaning to
be slow in one's work. also it is said ALDAHR AUWRADU ZU GHAYRIN
(الدَهْرُ اَوْرَدُ ذُوُ غِيرٍ) meaning Time keeps on doing it's work
quietly quietly. it doesn't let it be known. also it is said RUWAYDA
ZAYDAN(رُوَيْداً زَيْداً) give Zayd extension (more time for deadline
). so RUWAYD(رُوَيدَ) means slowly slowly and quietly quietly delaying
and give respite.
ALLAH said:
Surat Aţ-Ţāriq (The Nightcommer) - سورة الطارق
86:17
فَمَهِّلِ الْكَافِرِينَ أَمْهِلْهُمْ رُوَيْدًا
So allow time for the disbelievers. Leave them awhile
29.2 RUKHAAN(رُخَاءً): such a soft and slowly blowing wind that doesn't
move anything (Breeze).Gentle and soft flowing of wind. ALLAH said
Surat Şād (The Letter "Saad") - سورة ص
38:36
فَسَخَّرْنَا لَهُ الرِّيحَ تَجْرِي بِأَمْرِهِ رُخَاءً حَيْثُ أَصَابَ
So We subjected to him the wind blowing by his command, gently, wherever he directed,
29.3 3RFAN(عُرفاً) :
gently flowing pleasant breeze. AL3RF العرف meaning (smell). it is
mostly used for fragrance. and normally such winds paced slowly. like
early morning wind. In the Quran
Surat Al-Mursalāt (The Emissaries) - سورة المرسلات
77:1
وَالْمُرْسَلَاتِ عُرْفًا
By those [winds] sent forth in gusts
29.4 YUSR(يُسْر)
: meaning ease and comfort and it's antonym is 3SR(عسر) meaning
difficulty. and YUSRAN يُسْراً refers to such a condition when some
thing can be done easily and comfortably without any formality.and it
doesn't contain any shortcomings. ALLAH said
Surat Adh-Dhāriyāt (The Winnowing Winds) - سورة الذاريات
51:3
فَالْجَارِيَاتِ يُسْرًا
And those [ships] sailing with ease
here YUSR doesn't mean that speed is slow but it means that there is no
rocking or shortcoming or inclination or noise even though it's pacing
swiftly and owing to this it seems that its a slow and smooth ride
29.5 ISTADRAJ(إستدراج) :DARJAH(درجة)
is step of a ladder when ascending upstairs and ISTADRJ(إستدرج) meaning
to slowly slowly and gradually bring one thing close to another thing
so that it doesn't become aware (imperceptible) . so ISTADRAJ has to
include two elements of being gradual and slowlness
ALLAH Said
Surat Al-'A`rāf (The Heights) - سورة الأعراف
7:182
وَالَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا بِآيَاتِنَا سَنَسْتَدْرِجُهُم مِّنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
But those who deny Our signs - We will progressively lead them [to destruction] from where they do not know.
29.6 DALLA(دلَّي) :
DALWUN(دَلْوٌ) is such a bucket which is empty of water and
ADLA(ادْلَي) means to place an empty bucket in the wall for it to be
filled up ,which slowly slowly reaches to the water and DALLA meaning
to slowly slowly and gradually accomplish a task or achieve the
objective. ALLAH said
Surat Al-'A`rāf (The Heights) - سورة الأعراف
7:22
فَدَلَّاهُمَا بِغُرُورٍ  ۚ فَلَمَّا ذَاقَا الشَّجَرَةَ
بَدَتْ لَهُمَا سَوْآتُهُمَا وَطَفِقَا يَخْصِفَانِ عَلَيْهِمَا مِن
وَرَقِ الْجَنَّةِ ۖ وَنَادَاهُمَا رَبُّهُمَا أَلَمْ أَنْهَكُمَا عَن
تِلْكُمَا الشَّجَرَةِ وَأَقُل لَّكُمَا إِنَّ الشَّيْطَانَ لَكُمَا
عَدُوٌّ مُّبِينٌ
So he made them fall, through deception .
And when they tasted of the tree, their private parts became apparent
to them, and they began to fasten together over themselves from the
leaves of Paradise. And their Lord called to them, "Did I not forbid
you from that tree and tell you that Satan is to you a clear enemy?"
Summary:
29.1 RUWYD to let loose someone's rope slowly slowly so that someone can reach its end
29.2 RUKHA- Wind breeezing slowly and softly without any resistance
29.3 3URFAN Wind gently blowing and also include being pleasant
29.4 YUSRAN To finish a task informally and comfortably without any resistance
29.5 ISTADRAJ gradually and slowly approach some other thing
29.6 DALLA gradually and slowly achieve one's objective

raw_text:
3 AKHIRAT [HEREAFTER]
Synonyms: AKHIRAH, DAR UL AKHIRAH, YAUM UL AKHIR, DAR ALQARAR,ALYAUM ALBA3S  these words put to light different aspect of the hereafter
for yaum ul taghabun, yaum ul tanad,yaum addeen,yaum alfasl,yaum aljamaa,yaum al nashoor
please refer to topic "Judgement Day"
3.1 AKHIRAH(أَخِرَة) :meaning
DAR UL BAQA(دَار البَقَا) abode of survival, it refers to the eternal
life in the next world that humans will obtain and in that life soul and
body will be completely combined and righteous & wicked people will
be admitted to either heaven or hell in return for their deeds
ALLAH says:
Surat Al-Baqarah (The Cow) - سورة البقرة
2:4
وَالَّذِينَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِمَا أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكَ وَمَا أُنزِلَ مِن قَبْلِكَ  وَبِالْآخِرَةِ هُمْ يُوقِنُونَ
And who believe in what has been revealed to you, [O Muhammad], and what was revealed before you,  and of the Hereafter they are certain [in faith] .
3.2 DAR UL AKHIRAH(دَار الأَخِرَة) :
DAR meaning residence. and DAR (plural DIYAR دِيَارDOOR دُور) applies
to a very wide meaning. DAR meaning house,estate,region,province, country
even this entire world as per humans residence is DAR ADUNIYA(دَار
الدُنِيَا) and it's anotnym is DAR UL AKHIRAH. but in that next life
every person will be given a DAR as per person's deeds. in the Holy
Quran
Surat An-Naĥl (The Bee) - سورة النحل
16:30
وَقِيلَ لِلَّذِينَ اتَّقَوْا مَاذَا أَنزَلَ رَبُّكُمْ ۚ قَالُوا خَيْرًا ۗ
لِّلَّذِينَ أَحْسَنُوا فِي هَٰذِهِ الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةٌ ۚ وَلَدَارُ
الْآخِرَةِ خَيْرٌ ۚ  وَلَنِعْمَ دَارُ الْمُتَّقِينَ
And it will be said to those who feared Allah , "What did your Lord send
down?" They will say, "[That which is] good." For those who do good in
this world is good; and the home of the Hereafter is better.  And how excellent is the home of the righteous  -
and for disbelievers their abode will be SU- ADDAR(سُوءُ الدَّارِ)
Surat Ghāfir (The Forgiver) - سورة غافر
40:52
يَوْمَ لَا يَنفَعُ الظَّالِمِينَ مَعْذِرَتُهُمْ ۖ وَلَهُمُ اللَّعْنَةُ وَلَهُمْ  سُوءُ الدَّارِ
The Day their excuse will not benefit the wrongdoers, and they will have the curse, and they will have the  worst home .
and DAR UL BAWAR(دَارَ الْبَوَارِ)
Surat 'Ibrāhīm (Abrahim) - سورة ابراهيم
14:28
أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَى الَّذِينَ بَدَّلُوا نِعْمَتَ اللَّهِ كُفْرًا وَأَحَلُّوا قَوْمَهُمْ  دَارَ الْبَوَارِ
Have you not considered those who exchanged the favor of Allah for disbelief and settled their people [in]  the home of ruin ?
both refers to hell
3.3 DAR UL QARAR(دَار القَرَار) :
QARAR meaning to stay firmly in a place,as that life is forever eternal
that's why it's refer to as DAR UL QARAR.yet DAR UL QARAR is used in
good meaning and DAR UL QARAR refers to the abode of righteous people
i.e. Heaven.
likewise for disbeliever similar period of time and abode is B-S
ALQARAR(ئْسَ الْقَرَارُ) meaning Hell is used in the Holy Quran
Surat 'Ibrāhīm (Abrahim) - سورة ابراهيم
14:29
جَهَنَّمَ يَصْلَوْنَهَا ۖ وَ بِئْسَ الْقَرَارُ
[It is] Hell, which they will [enter to] burn, and  wretched is the settlement .
3.4 AL YAUM AL AKHIR(اليُوم الاخِر) :
YAUM doesn't refer to the known world day of 24 hours or the one that
is used in comparison with night. but it refers to the long period of
the life of hereafter. as ALLAH said
Surat Al-'A`rāf (The Heights) - سورة الأعراف
7:54
إِنَّ رَبَّكُمُ اللَّهُ الَّذِي خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ فِي سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ
ثُمَّ اسْتَوَىٰ عَلَى الْعَرْشِ يُغْشِي اللَّيْلَ النَّهَارَ يَطْلُبُهُ
حَثِيثًا وَالشَّمْسَ وَالْقَمَرَ وَالنُّجُومَ مُسَخَّرَاتٍ بِأَمْرِهِ ۗ
أَلَا لَهُ الْخَلْقُ وَالْأَمْرُ ۗ تَبَارَكَ اللَّهُ رَبُّ
الْعَالَمِينَ
Indeed, your Lord is Allah , who created the heavens and earth in six days
and then established Himself above the Throne. He covers the night with
the day, [another night] chasing it rapidly; and [He created] the sun,
the moon, and the stars, subjected by His command. Unquestionably, His
is the creation and the command; blessed is Allah , Lord of the worlds.
and this is obvious as the day that exist before the creation of Earth
and Skies ,can not be imagined to be that day which results from sun's
existence
3.5 YAUM AL B3S(يَُوم البعث) : B3S meaning to
stand up for a particular objective by resurrection from graves,bacause
the start of the long period of hereafter will be marked by this B3S
thus it is also called YAUM AL B3S . ALLAH said
Surat Ar-Rūm (The Romans) - سورة الروم
30:56
وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ أُوتُوا الْعِلْمَ وَالْإِيمَانَ  لَقَدْ لَبِثْتُمْ فِي كِتَابِ اللَّهِ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ الْبَعْثِ  ۖ فَهَٰذَا يَوْمُ الْبَعْثِ وَلَٰكِنَّكُمْ كُنتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
But those who were given knowledge and faith will say, " You remained the extent of Allah 's decree until the Day of Resurrection , and this is the Day of Resurrection, but you did not used to know."

3.3 DAR UL QARAR(دَار القَرَار): QARAR meaning to stay firmly in a place,as that life is forever eternal that's why it's refer to as DAR UL QARAR.yet DAR UL QARAR is used in good meaning and DAR UL QARAR refers to the abode of righteous people i.e. Heaven.
likewise for disbeliever similar period of time and abode is B-S ALQARAR(ئْسَ الْقَرَارُ) meaning Hell is used in the Holy Quran

Surat 'Ibrāhīm (Abrahim) - سورة ابراهيم
14:29
جَهَنَّمَ يَصْلَوْنَهَا ۖ وَبِئْسَ الْقَرَارُ
[It is] Hell, which they will [enter to] burn, and wretched is the settlement.

3.4 AL YAUM AL AKHIR(اليُوم الاخِر): YAUM doesn't refer to the known world day of 24 hours or the one that is used in comparison with night. but it refers to the long period of the life of hereafter. as ALLAH said

Surat Al-'A`rāf (The Heights) - سورة الأعراف
7:54
إِنَّ رَبَّكُمُ اللَّهُ الَّذِي خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ فِي سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ ثُمَّ اسْتَوَىٰ عَلَى الْعَرْشِ يُغْشِي اللَّيْلَ النَّهَارَ يَطْلُبُهُ حَثِيثًا وَالشَّمْسَ وَالْقَمَرَ وَالنُّجُومَ مُسَخَّرَاتٍ بِأَمْرِهِ ۗ أَلَا لَهُ الْخَلْقُ وَالْأَمْرُ ۗ تَبَارَكَ اللَّهُ رَبُّ الْعَالَمِينَ
Indeed, your Lord is Allah , who created the heavens and earth in six days and then established Himself above the Throne. He covers the night with the day, [another night] chasing it rapidly; and [He created] the sun, the moon, and the stars, subjected by His command. Unquestionably, His is the creation and the command; blessed is Allah , Lord of the worlds.

and this is obvious as the day that exist before the creation of Earth and Skies ,can not be imagined to be that day which results from sun's existence

3.5 YAUM AL B3S(يَُوم البعث): B3S meaning to stand up for a particular objective by resurrection from graves,bacause the start of the long period of hereafter will be marked by this B3S thus it is also called YAUM AL B3S . ALLAH said

Surat Ar-Rūm (The Romans) - سورة الروم
30:56
وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ أُوتُوا الْعِلْمَ وَالْإِيمَانَ لَقَدْ لَبِثْتُمْ فِي كِتَابِ اللَّهِ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ الْبَعْثِ ۖ فَهَٰذَا يَوْمُ الْبَعْثِ وَلَٰكِنَّكُمْ كُنتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
But those who were given knowledge and faith will say, "You remained the extent of Allah 's decree until the Day of Resurrection, and this is the Day of Resurrection, but you did not used to know."

4 AADMI (INSAAN) [MAN,HUMAN]
[ side
note:putting summary first because discourse is a bit more elaborate and
drill down deep in to subtleties and nuancies which will be better
understood once summary is in mind]
Summary:
1 INS: when the discussion includes the social aspect of human then INS and its derived forms are used
2 ADAM: when historical aspect is under discussion then ADAM and BANI ADAM children of ADAM is used
3 BASHAR: when natural,physical aspects are discussed than BASHAR is used
Details are as follows
Synonyms: INS,ANSIYAAN,ADAM,BASHAR
INS(انس) and its derivatives like INSAAN(انسان) INSIYYAN(انسيّا) etc and
also ADAM(ادم) and BASHAR(بشر) are used for human and man in the Quran,
4.0.1  In
ghareeb ul Quran many a meaning of INS are mentioned.Ibne Qatiba wrote
that human are called INS because he is visible and can be perceived
with eyes and the proof he gave is from this ayah
Surat Al-Qaşaş (The Stories) - سورة القصص
28:29
فَلَمَّا قَضَىٰ مُوسَى الْأَجَلَ وَسَارَ بِأَهْلِهِ آنَسَ مِن جَانِبِ الطُّورِ نَارًا قَالَ لِأَهْلِهِ امْكُثُوا  إِنِّي آنَسْتُ نَارًا  لَّعَلِّي آتِيكُم مِّنْهَا بِخَبَرٍ أَوْ جَذْوَةٍ مِّنَ النَّارِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَصْطَلُونَ
And when Moses had completed the term and was traveling with his family,
he perceived from the direction of the mount a fire. He said to his
family, "Stay here; indeed,  I have perceived a fire . Perhaps I will bring you from there [some] information or burning wood from the fire that you may warm yourselves."
and from this aspect opp of INS is JIN(جّن) which means invisible or
concealed and cannot be perceive by eyes.and this seems to be the case
as these two creation are said as SAQALAN (ثقلان) by ALLAH and they are
used in contrast with each other
Surat Adh-Dhāriyāt (The Winnowing Winds) - سورة الذاريات
51:56
وَمَا خَلَقْتُ الْجِنَّ وَالْإِنسَ إِلَّا لِيَعْبُدُونِ
And I did not create the jinn and mankind except to worship Me.
4.0.2
ibne abbas reported that human is called INSAAN or INSIYYA as LI INNA
HU UHDE ELAYHE FA NASIYA (لانّه عهد إليه فنسي) meaning a covenant was
taken from him which he forgets. so from this point of view INSAAN or
INSIYYA is made of root NaSiYa(نسي)
4.0.3  imam raghib
describe it to be derived from UNS(اُنس).meaning a creation which is
created to live together in social life and harmony. To cherish and in
connection/relation with each other. from this aspect the opp is WAHUSH(
وحش)
4.0.4   and Ibn ul Faris has put together both definition
1) being visible 2) anything which is different from wild and beastly ways and behaviour
INS is ISM UL JINS( إسم إلجنس) this means that INS can refer to a single
person as well as the whole of mankind.same is the case with word
INSAAN but generally it means mankind.its singular is INSIYYUN(اِنسيُُ)
Surat Maryam (Mary) - سورة مريم
19:26
فَكُلِي وَاشْرَبِي وَقَرِّي عَيْنًا ۖ  فَإِمَّا تَرَيِنَّ مِنَ الْبَشَرِ أَحَدًا فَقُولِي إِنِّي نَذَرْتُ لِلرَّحْمَٰنِ صَوْمًا فَلَنْ أُكَلِّمَ الْيَوْمَ إِنسِيًّا
So eat and drink and be contented.  And if you see from among humanity
anyone, say, 'Indeed, I have vowed to the Most Merciful abstention, so I
will not speak today to [any] man.'  "
and its plural is NAAS(ناس),UNAS(اناس),UNASI( اناسي)
NAAS refers to generality.if said YA AYUH ANAAS(ياّيهاِالناس)refers to all present and future mankind
ALLAH said
Surat Al-Baqarah (The Cow)[2:21]
يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ اعْبُدُوا رَبَّكُمُ الَّذِي خَلَقَكُمْ
O mankind, worship your Lord, who created you
4.1 UNAS( اُناس): used for such a group of humans which is different from others owing to tribe,classification or anyother reason
Surat Al-Baqarah (The Cow) - سورة البقرة
2:60
وَإِذِ اسْتَسْقَىٰ مُوسَىٰ لِقَوْمِهِ فَقُلْنَا اضْرِب بِّعَصَاكَ الْحَجَرَ ۖ فَانفَجَرَتْ مِنْهُ اثْنَتَا عَشْرَةَ عَيْنًا ۖ  قَدْ عَلِمَ كُلُّ أُنَاسٍ مَّشْرَبَهُمْ ۖ  كُلُوا وَاشْرَبُوا مِن رِّزْقِ اللَّهِ وَلَا تَعْثَوْا فِي الْأَرْضِ مُفْسِدِينَ
And [recall] when Moses prayed for water for his people, so We said,
"Strike with your staff the stone." And there gushed forth from it
twelve springs,  and every people knew its watering place . "Eat and drink from the provision of Allah , and do not commit abuse on the earth, spreading corruption."
and ANASIYYA(اناسيُُ) : a big group of people
Surat Al-Furqān (The Criterian) - سورة الفرقان
25:49
لِّنُحْيِيَ بِهِ بَلْدَةً مَّيْتًا وَنُسْقِيَهُ مِمَّا  خَلَقْنَا أَنْعَامًا وَأَنَاسِيَّ كَثِيرًا
That We may bring to life thereby a dead land and give it as drink to those  We created of numerous livestock and men.
4.2 ADAM :is
from root Aa-Da-M basic meaning is favourable and tenderness. and
ADAAM() meaning every favourable and tender thing.this meaning is from
Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) saying which he told to mughira bin sheba (may
ALLAH be please with him)
لو نَظَرْتَ اِلَيهافانّه احري ان يّؤدم بينَكما
(Tirmidhi,Nisai)
"If you see you fiancee once then it there will be more chance of love and happiness between you"
there are other reference but this is strong as it confirms with hadith.
ADAM( ادم)  :
name of father of all man.yet it also refers to human as individual or
BANI ADAM children of adam refering to the all of mankind
and ADAM or BANI ADAM(بَني ادم) in Quran refers to History of humans e.g
Adam's birth from clay,taking covenant from all mankind,prostration of
Angels,to be superior among creation,saytan's leading Adam and his
children astray and his dialogue with ALLAH
4.3 BASHAR(بشر) :basic
meaning is exhibiting something with beauty and elegance.whereas
UNS(انس) mean only exhibit ALBASHARAH(البشرة) means the topmost layer of
human skin (side note: which contains pain receptors)
Surat Al-Muddaththir (The Cloaked One) - سورة المدثر
74:29
لَوَّاحَةٌ لِّلْبَشَرِ
Blackening the skins.
it's plural is BASHARUN( بَشَرُُ) and ABSHARUN(ابشارُُ) and human is
also said BASHR because his skin is clean and pure of hairs n wool as
compared to other animals and is visible BASHAR is used for
singular,plural,masculin, feminine but it's dual is BASHARAIN(بَشَرَين)
Surat Al-Mu'minūn (The Believers) - سورة المؤمنون
23:47
فَقَالُوا  أَنُؤْمِنُ لِبَشَرَيْنِ مِثْلِنَا  وَقَوْمُهُمَا لَنَا عَابِدُونَ
They said, " Should we believe two men like ourselves  while their people are for us in servitude?"
and BASHAR is used when human's physical and material aspect,his
built,natural traits and weakness are discussed as evident from the
aforementioned ayah. and BASHAR in contrast with MALK( مَلك) meaning
angel who is devoid of all those traits mentioned above
the disbelievers always raise objections that how can a BASHAR lie us
who born and die,eat and drink,walk in markets,and fullfills his needs
like us. So what is his superiority over us that we should believe him,
well if there is to be an angel who would be devoid of these traits then
it can be conidered
ALLAH has answered to this objection is this ayah
Surat Al-'Isrā' (The Night Journey) - سورة الإسراء
17:94
وَمَا مَنَعَ النَّاسَ أَن يُؤْمِنُوا إِذْ جَاءَهُمُ الْهُدَىٰ إِلَّا أَن قَالُوا أَبَعَثَ اللَّهُ بَشَرًا رَّسُولًا
And what prevented the people from believing when guidance came to them
except that they said, "Has Allah sent a human messenger?"
Surat Al-'Isrā' (The Night Journey) - سورة الإسراء
17:95
قُل لَّوْ كَانَ فِي الْأَرْضِ مَلَائِكَةٌ يَمْشُونَ مُطْمَئِنِّينَ لَنَزَّلْنَا عَلَيْهِم مِّنَ السَّمَاءِ مَلَكًا رَّسُولًا
Say, "If there were upon the earth angels walking securely, We would
have sent down to them from the heaven an angel [as a] messenger."

5 AARAM KARNA[ To Take Rest]
Synonyms: SAKANA,SABATA,IRTAFAQA(RAFQ)
5.1 SAKANA(سَكَنَ) : to rest after movement and turmoil.and this
word SAKOON(سَكُون) is used for both physical and conceptual meaning. to
rest after physical exhaustion
Surat Al-Qaşaş (The Stories) - سورة القصص
28:72
قُلْ أَرَأَيْتُمْ إِن جَعَلَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْكُمُ النَّهَارَ سَرْمَدًا إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ  مَنْ إِلَٰهٌ غَيْرُ اللَّهِ يَأْتِيكُم بِلَيْلٍ تَسْكُنُونَ فِيهِ ۖ  أَفَلَا تُبْصِرُونَ
Say, "Have you considered: if Allah should make for you the day continuous until the Day of Resurrection,  what deity other than Allah could bring you a night in which you may rest?  Then will you not see?"
and to rest after mental fatigue
Surat At-Tawbah (The Repentance) - سورة التوبة
9:103
خُذْ مِنْ أَمْوَالِهِمْ صَدَقَةً تُطَهِّرُهُمْ وَتُزَكِّيهِم بِهَا  وَصَلِّ عَلَيْهِمْ ۖ إِنَّ صَلَاتَكَ سَكَنٌ لَّهُمْ ۗ  وَاللَّهُ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ
Take, [O, Muhammad], from their wealth a charity by which you purify them and cause them increase,  and invoke [ Allah 's blessings] upon them. Indeed, your invocations are reassurance for them.  And Allah is Hearing and Knowing.
5.2 SABATA(سَبَتَ) : its basic meaning is peace and tranquility meaning such a rest after which relief or comfort is achieved
Surat An-Naba' (The Tidings) - سورة النبإ
78:9
وَجَعَلْنَا نَوْمَكُمْ سُبَاتًا
And made your sleep [a means for] rest
and as per medical research it is found that those cells of the body
which are used up because of work in the day ,gets replenished in the
state of sleep.that's the reason when a person wakes up after sound
sleep then person is refreshed and tranquil. and this is the meaning of
SABAT
5.3 IRTAFAQA(إِرتَفَقَ) : Its root is RAFQ(رَفق)
meaning favourable and close mutual company free from harshness and
severity. afterwards whatever thing results in comfort and favourability
is called RAFQ.from this regard MIRFAQ(مِرفق) is elbow,as it used to
get support and human feels comfort and MIRFAQA(مِرفقه) is a small
pillow and IRTAFAQ(إِرتَفَاق) is such a companionship which results in
comfort and favourability . and MARTAFAQ(مَرتفق) is such a place where
there is comfort and no disturbance as ALLAH said
Surat Al-Kahf (The Cave) - سورة الكهف
18:31
أُولَٰئِكَ لَهُمْ جَنَّاتُ عَدْنٍ تَجْرِي مِن تَحْتِهِمُ الْأَنْهَارُ
يُحَلَّوْنَ فِيهَا مِنْ أَسَاوِرَ مِن ذَهَبٍ وَيَلْبَسُونَ ثِيَابًا
خُضْرًا مِّن سُندُسٍ وَإِسْتَبْرَقٍ مُّتَّكِئِينَ فِيهَا عَلَى
الْأَرَائِكِ ۚ  نِعْمَ الثَّوَابُ وَحَسُنَتْ مُرْتَفَقًا
Those will have gardens of perpetual residence; beneath them rivers will
flow. They will be adorned therein with bracelets of gold and will wear
green garments of fine silk and brocade, reclining therein on adorned
couches.  Excellent is the reward, and good is the resting place.
Summary:
5.1 SAKANA: physical and mental rest
5.2 SABATA: rest and relief after it (rejuvenate)
5.3 IRTAFAQ: such a rest in which there is no disturbance or interference

title: content/A/A6.html
raw_text:
6 ARZOO ARZOO KARNA [WISH ,TO MAKE A WISH]
Synonyms: AMALA,UMNIYAH(MNY) and WADDA
6.1 AMALA(أَمَلَ) : (plural AMAL أَمَال ) such a wish and
expectation which though is expected and awaited yet difficult and
beyond for fullfilment.thus Ibn faris had described its meaning as AS
SABBAT Wa ALINTIZAR (التَثَبَّت وَ الإِنتِظَار) meaning to hope for a
wish and to wait for its to come true,to be hopeful of long life.
ALLAH said:
Surat Al-Ĥijr (The Rocky Tract) - سورة الحجر
15:3
ذَرْهُمْ يَأْكُلُوا وَيَتَمَتَّعُوا وَيُلْهِهِمُ الْأَمَلُ ۖ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ
Let them eat and enjoy themselves and be diverted by [false] hope, for they are going to know.
6.2 UMNIYAH(أُمنِيَة) :
(plural AMANI أَمَانِي ) such a wish which there is no strong
foundation/basis. To think of some good expectation and estimation. and
then to wish for it .so this word is used for false and unreal ,desires
and expectations . In the Holy Quran
Surat Al-Baqarah (The Cow) - سورة البقرة
2:111
وَقَالُوا لَن يَدْخُلَ الْجَنَّةَ إِلَّا مَن كَانَ هُودًا
أَوْ نَصَارَىٰ ۗ تِلْكَ أَمَانِيُّهُمْ ۗ قُلْ هَاتُوا بُرْهَانَكُمْ إِن
كُنتُمْ صَادِقِينَ
And they say, "None will enter Paradise except one who is a Jew or a
Christian." That is [merely] their wishful thinking, Say, "Produce your
proof, if you should be truthful."
and some scholars had in ayah mentioned below
Surat Al-Baqarah (The Cow) - سورة البقرة
2:78
وَمِنْهُمْ أُمِّيُّونَ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ الْكِتَابَ إِلَّا أَمَانِيَّ وَإِنْ هُمْ إِلَّا يَظُنُّونَ
And among them are unlettered ones who do not know the Scripture except in wishful thinking, but they are only assuming.
took AMANI as those narrations which they have made up in to the religion or forged them. and mujahid implies ILLA AMANIA       إِلَّا أَمَانِيَّ   as ILLA KAZIBA إِلاَّ كَاذِبَا meaning 'lie  '  and
some say AMANI refers to recite without understanding/comprehension. as
this is further affirmed by other Ayahs and TAMANNA(تَمَّنَى) meaning
to tell a lie ,TAMANNA ALRAJL(تَمَنَّى الرَجل) meaning he told a lie
in the Holy Quran:
Surat An-Najm (The Star) - سورة النجم
53:24
أَمْ لِلْإِنسَانِ مَا تَمَنَّىٰ
Or is there for man whatever he wishes?
6.3 WADDA(وَدَّ) :it
contains two basic meaning a) to love something b) to wish for it. then
sometime this word is used in both connotation and sometimes in one
only for e.g.
Surat Al-Ĥijr (The Rocky Tract) - سورة الحجر
15:2
رُّبَمَا يَوَدُّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا لَوْ كَانُوا مُسْلِمِينَ
Perhaps those who disbelieve will wish that they had been Muslims.
it contains both the connotation where as in the Ayah below
Surat Maryam (Mary) - سورة مريم
19:96
إِنَّ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ سَيَجْعَلُ لَهُمُ الرَّحْمَٰنُ وُدًّا
Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds - the Most Merciful will appoint for them affection.
only the first meaning is found.
Summary:
6.1 AMALA: apparently unexpected and delayed fullfilment of wish
6.2 UMNIYAH: false and baseless wish (N.B and that wish which has a foundation RIJA please see UMEED LAGANA )
6.3 WADDA: love and wish of anything (N.B. see also KHWAHISH)

title: content/A/A7.html
raw_text:
7 AAR [Barrier]
Synonyms: BARZAKH,HAJR,HAJZ,HADD
7.1 BARZAKH(بَرزَخ) : a barrier between two things where these
things are quite far apart then this barrier is called BARZAKH. like
between this world and hereafter or time interval between death till
judgment day is called BARZAKH. But the condition of being 'quite far
apart' that ibn faris imposes is not correct as the Holy Quran doesn't
confirms it. ALLAH said
Surat Ar-Raĥmān (The Beneficent) - سورة الرحمن
55:19
مَرَجَ الْبَحْرَيْنِ يَلْتَقِيَانِ
He released the two seas, meeting [side by side];
Surat Ar-Raĥmān (The Beneficent) - سورة الرحمن
55:20
بَيْنَهُمَا بَرْزَخٌ لَّا يَبْغِيَانِ
Between them is a barrier [so] neither of them transgresses .
but if instead of 'quite far apart' ,just enough difference (of attribute) would be more suitable
BARZAKH is actually a third thing in between two things which also
functions as barrier,but this third thing i.e BARZAKH contains
attributes of both the things whether of one of them dominant or equal
of both of them. World of BARZAKH is like this that for Momin(Believer)
it's comfort/relief and for disbeliever it's the begining of punishment,
but this relief/punishment is of lesser magnitude than that of the
Hereafter
and middle BARZAKH between two rivers is like that in one ocean there is
warm tidal current and on the other there is cold tidal current then
water of that BARZAKH will be moderate. likewise if one side is
freshwater and the other saline and bitter then BARZAKH of this water
will be of intermediate state and more examples of this BARZAKH can be
given which contains moderate/intermediate types of attributes for e.g
between Heaven and Earth (AARAF اعرََاف
) where there will be neither Punishment nor Pleasure. Between Human and
Animals is chimpanzee, between Human and Fish is mermaid, between
animals and plants is coral, between solid and liquid is mercury etc etc
7.2 HIJR(حِجر) :
HIJARAH(حِجَارَة) commonly means stone which is hard and solid. then
HIJR is also said to be every thing that is hard and can function as a
barrier or hurdle which can separate one thing from another thing. as
per Ibn e Faris it's meaning is ALMANA WALAHATAH ALA SHAYEE (المَنَع وَ
الأَحَاطَه علَى الشَيِ).To build protective wall around the village for
the protection of village, to encircle with stones,to encircle with
courtyard or mansion, all of this is included in the meaning of HIJR .
ALLAH said
Surat Al-Furqān (The Criterian) - سورة الفرقان
25:22
يَوْمَ يَرَوْنَ الْمَلَائِكَةَ لَا بُشْرَىٰ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُجْرِمِينَ وَيَقُولُونَ حِجْرًا مَّحْجُورًا
The day they see the angels - no good tidings will there be that day for
the criminals, and [the angels] will say, "Prevented and inaccessible."
HIJRAN MAHJORAN(حِجْرًا مَّحْجُورًا) is a word that is used as proverb
by the arabs at the time of descending of an enemy or calamity. like we
say "I seek refuge of ALLAH from him/it"(not used in english ,just urdu
translation) then the one listening would do no harm to the speaker
then HIJR is used for such an intellect which deny the acceptance of
false ,wrong theories and futile talk. so such a cautious intelligence
which can think of it's own defense is HIJR.
ALLAH said
Surat Al-Fajr (The Dawn) - سورة الفجر
89:5
هَلْ فِي ذَٰلِكَ قَسَمٌ لِّذِي حِجْرٍ
Is there [not] in [all] that an oath [sufficient] for one of perception?
then HIJR is also used for forbidden,illegal and haram things
Surat Al-'An`ām (The Cattle) - سورة الأنعام
6:138
وَقَالُوا هَٰذِهِ أَنْعَامٌ وَحَرْثٌ حِجْرٌ لَّا يَطْعَمُهَا إِلَّا مَن نَّشَاءُ بِزَعْمِهِمْ
وَأَنْعَامٌ حُرِّمَتْ ظُهُورُهَا وَأَنْعَامٌ لَّا يَذْكُرُونَ اسْمَ
اللَّهِ عَلَيْهَا افْتِرَاءً عَلَيْهِ ۚ سَيَجْزِيهِم بِمَا كَانُوا
يَفْتَرُونَ
And they say, "These animals and crops are forbidden; no one may eat from them except whom we will," by their claim .
And there are those [camels] whose backs are forbidden [by them] and
those upon which the name of Allah is not mentioned - [all of this] an
invention of untruth about Him. He will punish them for what they were
inventing.
7.3 HJZ (حجز):  is something in
between two things which is obstructing them AL HAWL BAYN AL
SHAYEEN(الحول بين الشَيِين) and HAJIZ (حَاجِز) meaning barrier or
curtain. ALLAH said
Surat An-Naml (The Ant) - سورة النمل
27:61
أَمَّن جَعَلَ الْأَرْضَ قَرَارًا وَجَعَلَ خِلَالَهَا أَنْهَارًا وَجَعَلَ لَهَا رَوَاسِيَ  وَجَعَلَ بَيْنَ الْبَحْرَيْنِ حَاجِزًا  ۗ أَإِلَٰهٌ مَّعَ اللَّهِ ۚ بَلْ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
Is He [not best] who made the earth a stable ground and placed within it rivers and made for it firmly set mountains and  placed between the two seas a barrier ? Is there a deity with Allah ? [No], but most of them do not know.
then HAJIZ is also used to sheild in between, stopping one thing or protecting other thing
Surat Al-Ĥāqqah (The Reality) - سورة الحاقة
69:47
فَمَا مِنكُم مِّنْ أَحَدٍ عَنْهُ حَاجِزِينَ
And there is no one of you who could prevent [Us] from him.
7.4 HADD(حدّ) :
The limit of any thing ,and it's last edge which separates it from
other things. so it's basic meaning includes a) Limit b) Edge. so HADD
is not any third thing ,it's the last edge of a thing which doesn't let
it meet/mix with other things. HUDDO O ARBA3 is commonly used in urdu to
explain this meaning .ALLAH said
Surat An-Nisā' (The Women) - سورة النساء
4:14
وَمَن يَعْصِ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ وَيَتَعَدَّ حُدُودَهُ يُدْخِلْهُ نَارًا خَالِدًا فِيهَا  وَلَهُ عَذَابٌ مُّهِينٌ
And
whoever disobeys Allah and His Messenger and transgresses His limits -
He will put him into the Fire to abide eternally therein,  and he will have a humiliating punishment.
Summary:

7 AAR [Barrier]

Synonyms: BARZAKH,HAJR,HAJZ,HADD

7.1 BARZAKH(بَرزَخ): a barrier between two things where these things are quite far apart then this barrier is called BARZAKH. like between this world and hereafter or time interval between death till judgment day is called BARZAKH. But the condition of being 'quite far apart' that ibn faris imposes is not correct as the Holy Quran doesn't confirms it. ALLAH said

Surat Ar-Raĥmān (The Beneficent) - سورة الرحمن
55:19
مَرَجَ الْبَحْرَيْنِ يَلْتَقِيَانِ
He released the two seas, meeting [side by side];


Surat Ar-Raĥmān (The Beneficent) - سورة الرحمن
55:20
بَيْنَهُمَا بَرْزَخٌ لَّا يَبْغِيَانِ
Between them is a barrier [so] neither of them transgresses.

but if instead of 'quite far apart' ,just enough difference (of attribute) would be more suitable
BARZAKH is actually a third thing in between two things which also functions as barrier,but this third thing i.e BARZAKH contains attributes of both the things whether of one of them dominant or equal of both of them. World of BARZAKH is like this that for Momin(Believer) it's comfort/relief and for disbeliever it's the begining of punishment, but this relief/punishment is of lesser magnitude than that of the Hereafter
and middle BARZAKH between two rivers is like that in one ocean there is warm tidal current and on the other there is cold tidal current then water of that BARZAKH will be moderate. likewise if one side is freshwater and the other saline and bitter then BARZAKH of this water will be of intermediate state and more examples of this BARZAKH can be given which contains moderate/intermediate types of attributes for e.g between Heaven and Earth (AARAF اعرََاف
) where there will be neither Punishment nor Pleasure. Between Human and Animals is chimpanzee, between Human and Fish is mermaid, between animals and plants is coral, between solid and liquid is mercury etc etc



7.2 HIJR(حِجر): HIJARAH(حِجَارَة) commonly means stone which is hard and solid. then HIJR is also said to be every thing that is hard and can function as a barrier or hurdle which can separate one thing from another thing. as per Ibn e Faris it's meaning is ALMANA WALAHATAH ALA SHAYEE (المَنَع وَ الأَحَاطَه علَى الشَيِ).To build protective wall around the village for the protection of village, to encircle with stones,to encircle with courtyard or mansion, all of this is included in the meaning of HIJR . ALLAH said

Surat Al-Furqān (The Criterian) - سورة الفرقان
25:22
يَوْمَ يَرَوْنَ الْمَلَائِكَةَ لَا بُشْرَىٰ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُجْرِمِينَ وَيَقُولُونَ حِجْرًا مَّحْجُورًا
The day they see the angels - no good tidings will there be that day for the criminals, and [the angels] will say, "Prevented and inaccessible."

HIJRAN MAHJORAN(حِجْرًا مَّحْجُورًا) is a word that is used as proverb by the arabs at the time of descending of an enemy or calamity. like we say "I seek refuge of ALLAH from him/it"(not used in english ,just urdu translation) then the one listening would do no harm to the speaker

then HIJR is used for such an intellect which deny the acceptance of false ,wrong theories and futile talk. so such a cautious intelligence which can think of it's own defense is HIJR.
ALLAH said

Surat Al-Fajr (The Dawn) - سورة الفجر
89:5
هَلْ فِي ذَٰلِكَ قَسَمٌ لِّذِي حِجْرٍ
Is there [not] in [all] that an oath [sufficient] for one of perception?

then HIJR is also used for forbidden,illegal and haram things

Surat Al-'An`ām (The Cattle) - سورة الأنعام
6:138
وَقَالُوا هَٰذِهِ أَنْعَامٌ وَحَرْثٌ حِجْرٌ لَّا يَطْعَمُهَا إِلَّا مَن نَّشَاءُ بِزَعْمِهِمْ وَأَنْعَامٌ حُرِّمَتْ ظُهُورُهَا وَأَنْعَامٌ لَّا يَذْكُرُونَ اسْمَ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهَا افْتِرَاءً عَلَيْهِ ۚ سَيَجْزِيهِم بِمَا كَانُوا يَفْتَرُونَ
And they say, "These animals and crops are forbidden; no one may eat from them except whom we will," by their claim. And there are those [camels] whose backs are forbidden [by them] and those upon which the name of Allah is not mentioned - [all of this] an invention of untruth about Him. He will punish them for what they were inventing.


7.3 HJZ (حجز): is something in between two things which is obstructing them AL HAWL BAYN AL SHAYEEN(الحول بين الشَيِين) and HAJIZ (حَاجِز) meaning barrier or curtain. ALLAH said
Surat An-Naml (The Ant) - سورة النمل
27:61
أَمَّن جَعَلَ الْأَرْضَ قَرَارًا وَجَعَلَ خِلَالَهَا أَنْهَارًا وَجَعَلَ لَهَا رَوَاسِيَ وَجَعَلَ بَيْنَ الْبَحْرَيْنِ حَاجِزًا ۗ أَإِلَٰهٌ مَّعَ اللَّهِ ۚ بَلْ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
Is He [not best] who made the earth a stable ground and placed within it rivers and made for it firmly set mountains and placed between the two seas a barrier? Is there a deity with Allah ? [No], but most of them do not know.

then HAJIZ is also used to sheild in between, stopping one thing or protecting other thing

Surat Al-Ĥāqqah (The Reality) - سورة الحاقة

فَمَا مِنكُم مِّنْ أَحَدٍ عَنْهُ حَاجِزِينَ
And there is no one of you who could prevent [Us] from him.


7.4 HADD(حدّ): The limit of any thing ,and it's last edge which separates it from other things. so it's basic meaning includes a) Limit b) Edge. so HADD is not any third thing ,it's the last edge of a thing which doesn't let it meet/mix with other things. HUDDO O ARBA3 is commonly used in urdu to explain this meaning .ALLAH said

Surat An-Nisā' (The Women) - سورة النساء

وَمَن يَعْصِ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ وَيَتَعَدَّ حُدُودَهُ يُدْخِلْهُ نَارًا خَالِدًا فِيهَا وَلَهُ عَذَابٌ مُّهِينٌ
And whoever disobeys Allah and His Messenger and transgresses His limits - He will put him into the Fire to abide eternally therein, and he will have a humiliating punishment.

8 AZAD[FREE]
Synonyms: HURR,MUHSIN,SUDE
8.1 HURR(حرّ) : meaning free (antonym ABD عبد meaning slave) meaning a person who is no one's slave. in the Holy Quran.
Surat Al-Baqarah (The Cow) - سورة البقرة
2:178
يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا كُتِبَ عَلَيْكُمُ الْقِصَاصُ فِي الْقَتْلَى ۖ  الْحُرُّ بِالْحُرِّ وَالْعَبْدُ بِالْعَبْدِ وَالْأُنثَىٰ بِالْأُنثَىٰ ۚ
فَمَنْ عُفِيَ لَهُ مِنْ أَخِيهِ شَيْءٌ فَاتِّبَاعٌ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ
وَأَدَاءٌ إِلَيْهِ بِإِحْسَانٍ ۗ ذَٰلِكَ تَخْفِيفٌ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ
وَرَحْمَةٌ ۗ فَمَنِ اعْتَدَىٰ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ فَلَهُ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
O you who have believed, prescribed for you is legal retribution for those murdered -  the free for the free, the slave for the slave, and the female for the female.
But whoever overlooks from his brother anything, then there should be a
suitable follow-up and payment to him with good conduct. This is an
alleviation from your Lord and a mercy. But whoever transgresses after
that will have a painful punishment.
8.2 MUHSIN( مُحصِن) :
HASANA(حَصَنَ) meaning castle or shelter. and as per ibn al faris it
comprise of three things a) protection b) encircled c) refuge and in
AHSAN(أَحصَان) also these basic connotations are found. AHSAN is of two
types 1) Freedom and it's prestige is like a castle itself compared with
salvery, 2) It also serves as a castle in Nikah (marriage) to prevent
shamelessness. and protect the chastity and dignity. in the Holy Quran
this word is used in both the context. MUSHIN or MUHSINAT if comes in
the meaning of 3AFIFI (عَفِيف) [chastity]]or 3AFIFAH(عَفِيفَه) then (ص)
can be read with either Fathah or Kusrah. and if it comes after the word
of HURRIMAT(حُرِّمَت) then (ص) can be read with Fathah whihc means only
'married'. Free man and woman are quite free to protect their dignity
as compared to slave man and woman. 1) because slaves have to out to
sort out chores and being of low status in the society they commit or
prone to shamelessness. 2) because at that time it was common for a
master to prostitue his slaves woman out of greed. Thus ALLAH has
strongly forbid from this heinous business. ALLAH said
Surat An-Nūr (The Light) - سورة النور
24:33
وَلْيَسْتَعْفِفِ الَّذِينَ لَا يَجِدُونَ نِكَاحًا حَتَّىٰ يُغْنِيَهُمُ
اللَّهُ مِن فَضْلِهِ ۗ وَالَّذِينَ يَبْتَغُونَ الْكِتَابَ مِمَّا
مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَانُكُمْ فَكَاتِبُوهُمْ إِنْ عَلِمْتُمْ فِيهِمْ خَيْرًا ۖ
وَآتُوهُم مِّن مَّالِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي آتَاكُمْ ۚ  وَلَا تُكْرِهُوا فَتَيَاتِكُمْ عَلَى الْبِغَاءِ إِنْ أَرَدْنَ تَحَصُّنًا لِّتَبْتَغُوا عَرَضَ الْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا ۚ  وَمَن يُكْرِههُّنَّ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ مِن بَعْدِ إِكْرَاهِهِنَّ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
But let them who find not [the means for] marriage abstain [from sexual
relations] until Allah enriches them from His bounty. And those who seek
a contract [for eventual emancipation] from among whom your right hands
possess - then make a contract with them if you know there is within
them goodness and give them from the wealth of Allah which He has given
you.  And do not compel your slave girls to prostitution, if they
desire chastity, to seek [thereby] the temporary interests of worldly
life.  And if someone should compel them, then indeed, Allah is [to them], after their compulsion, Forgiving and Merciful.
also further said
Surat An-Nisā' (The Women) - سورة النساء
4:25
وَمَن لَّمْ يَسْتَطِعْ مِنكُمْ طَوْلًا أَن يَنكِحَ
الْمُحْصَنَاتِ الْمُؤْمِنَاتِ فَمِن مَّا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَانُكُم مِّن
فَتَيَاتِكُمُ الْمُؤْمِنَاتِ ۚ  وَاللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِإِيمَانِكُم ۚ
بَعْضُكُم مِّن بَعْضٍ ۚ فَانكِحُوهُنَّ بِإِذْنِ أَهْلِهِنَّ وَآتُوهُنَّ
أُجُورَهُنَّ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ مُحْصَنَاتٍ غَيْرَ مُسَافِحَاتٍ وَلَا
مُتَّخِذَاتِ أَخْدَانٍ ۚ فَإِذَا أُحْصِنَّ فَإِنْ أَتَيْنَ بِفَاحِشَةٍ
فَعَلَيْهِنَّ نِصْفُ مَا عَلَى الْمُحْصَنَاتِ مِنَ الْعَذَابِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ
لِمَنْ خَشِيَ الْعَنَتَ مِنكُمْ ۚ وَأَن تَصْبِرُوا خَيْرٌ لَّكُمْ ۗ
وَاللَّهُ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
And whoever among you cannot [find]
the means to marry free, believing women, then [he may marry] from those
whom your right hands possess of believing slave girls . And Allah
is most knowing about your faith. You [believers] are of one another. So
marry them with the permission of their people and give them their due
compensation according to what is acceptable. [They should be] chaste,
neither [of] those who commit unlawful intercourse randomly nor those
who take [secret] lovers. But once they are sheltered in marriage, if
they should commit adultery, then for them is half the punishment for
free [unmarried] women. This [allowance] is for him among you who fears
sin, but to be patient is better for you. And Allah is Forgiving and
Merciful.
In this Ayah , word MUHSANAT(مُحصِنَت) is used for free and virgin
woman. as married women have more opportunity of protecting their
chastity .After marriage the fulfillment of sexual desire and Man's
honour is like a strong castle defending woman against shamelessness. In
the Ayah mentioned below word MUHSANAT only clarifies the meaning of
'married woman'.
Surat An-Nisā' (The Women) - سورة النساء
4:24
وَالْمُحْصَنَاتُ مِنَ النِّسَاءِ إِلَّا مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَانُكُمْ
ۖ كِتَابَ اللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ ۚ وَأُحِلَّ لَكُم مَّا وَرَاءَ ذَٰلِكُمْ
أَن تَبْتَغُوا بِأَمْوَالِكُم مُّحْصِنِينَ غَيْرَ مُسَافِحِينَ ۚ فَمَا
اسْتَمْتَعْتُم بِهِ مِنْهُنَّ فَآتُوهُنَّ أُجُورَهُنَّ فَرِيضَةً ۚ وَلَا
جُنَاحَ عَلَيْكُمْ فِيمَا تَرَاضَيْتُم بِهِ مِن بَعْدِ الْفَرِيضَةِ ۚ
إِنَّ اللَّهَ كَانَ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمًا
And [also prohibited to you are all] married women except those your right hands possess .
[This is] the decree of Allah upon you. And lawful to you are [all
others] beyond these, [provided] that you seek them [in marriage] with
[gifts from] your property, desiring chastity, not unlawful sexual
intercourse. So for whatever you enjoy [of marriage] from them, give
them their due compensation as an obligation. And there is no blame upon
you for what you mutually agree to beyond the obligation. Indeed, Allah
is ever Knowing and Wise.
so word AHSAN is exhibiting the meaning of being free in protecting one's dignity and chastity
8.3 SUDA(سُدَى) : SUDA AL NAQAH(سُدَى النَاقَة) meaning she-camel
stride and SADY(سَادي) is that she-camel which stride in pace and SUDA
meaning unrestrained ,some one without any restriction. ALLAH said
Surat Al-Qiyāmah (The Resurrection) - سورة القيامة
75:36
أَيَحْسَبُ الْإِنسَانُ أَن يُتْرَكَ سُدًى
Does man think that he will be left neglected?
Summary:
8.1 HURR:free compared to slave
8.2 MUHSIN:free to defend one's chastity
8.3 SUDA:unrestrained

وَمَن لَّمْ يَسْتَطِعْ مِنكُمْ طَوْلًا أَن يَنكِحَ الْمُحْصَنَاتِ الْمُؤْمِنَاتِ فَمِن مَّا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَانُكُم مِّن فَتَيَاتِكُمُ الْمُؤْمِنَاتِ ۚ وَاللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِإِيمَانِكُم ۚ بَعْضُكُم مِّن بَعْضٍ ۚ فَانكِحُوهُنَّ بِإِذْنِ أَهْلِهِنَّ وَآتُوهُنَّ أُجُورَهُنَّ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ مُحْصَنَاتٍ غَيْرَ مُسَافِحَاتٍ وَلَا مُتَّخِذَاتِ أَخْدَانٍ ۚ فَإِذَا أُحْصِنَّ فَإِنْ أَتَيْنَ بِفَاحِشَةٍ فَعَلَيْهِنَّ نِصْفُ مَا عَلَى الْمُحْصَنَاتِ مِنَ الْعَذَابِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ لِمَنْ خَشِيَ الْعَنَتَ مِنكُمْ ۚ وَأَن تَصْبِرُوا خَيْرٌ لَّكُمْ ۗ وَاللَّهُ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
And whoever among you cannot [find] the means to marry free, believing women, then [he may marry] from those whom your right hands possess of believing slave girls. And Allah is most knowing about your faith. You [believers] are of one another. So marry them with the permission of their people and give them their due compensation according to what is acceptable. [They should be] chaste, neither [of] those who commit unlawful intercourse randomly nor those who take [secret] lovers. But once they are sheltered in marriage, if they should commit adultery, then for them is half the punishment for free [unmarried] women. This [allowance] is for him among you who fears sin, but to be patient is better for you. And Allah is Forgiving and Merciful.

In this Ayah , word MUHSANAT(مُحصِنَت) is used for free and virgin woman. as married women have more opportunity of protecting their chastity .After marriage the fulfillment of sexual desire and Man's honour is like a strong castle defending woman against shamelessness. In the Ayah mentioned below word MUHSANAT only clarifies the meaning of 'married woman'.

Surat An-Nisā' (The Women) - سورة النساء
4:24
وَالْمُحْصَنَاتُ مِنَ النِّسَاءِ إِلَّا مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَانُكُمْ ۖ كِتَابَ اللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ ۚ وَأُحِلَّ لَكُم مَّا وَرَاءَ ذَٰلِكُمْ أَن تَبْتَغُوا بِأَمْوَالِكُم مُّحْصِنِينَ غَيْرَ مُسَافِحِينَ ۚ فَمَا اسْتَمْتَعْتُم بِهِ مِنْهُنَّ فَآتُوهُنَّ أُجُورَهُنَّ فَرِيضَةً ۚ وَلَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيْكُمْ فِيمَا تَرَاضَيْتُم بِهِ مِن بَعْدِ الْفَرِيضَةِ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ كَانَ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمًا
And [also prohibited to you are all] married women except those your right hands possess. [This is] the decree of Allah upon you. And lawful to you are [all others] beyond these, [provided] that you seek them [in marriage] with [gifts from] your property, desiring chastity, not unlawful sexual intercourse. So for whatever you enjoy [of marriage] from them, give them their due compensation as an obligation. And there is no blame upon you for what you mutually agree to beyond the obligation. Indeed, Allah is ever Knowing and Wise.

so word AHSAN is exhibiting the meaning of being free in protecting one's dignity and chastity

8.3 SUDA(سُدَى): SUDA AL NAQAH(سُدَى النَاقَة) meaning she-camel stride and SADY(سَادي) is that she-camel which stride in pace and SUDA meaning unrestrained ,some one without any restriction. ALLAH said

Surat Al-Qiyāmah (The Resurrection) - سورة القيامة
75:36
أَيَحْسَبُ الْإِنسَانُ أَن يُتْرَكَ سُدًى
Does man think that he will be left neglected?

Summary:
8.1 HURR:free compared to slave
8.2 MUHSIN:free to defend one's chastity
8.3 SUDA:unrestrained

9 AZAD KARNA [TO FREE]
Synonyms: TEHREER,TALAQ,TASREEH
9.1 TEHREER(تِحرير) :it's origin is HURR(حُرّ) and its root contains
two connotations a) to be free b) to be pure from defect and flaw.
Antonym of HURR is ABD meaning slave. and HARRARA(حَرَّرَ)
TEHREERAN(تِحرِيراً) meaning to free a slave. so this word is specific
for 'to free a slave'. ALLAH said
Surat An-Nisā' (The Women) - سورة النساء
4:92
وَمَا كَانَ لِمُؤْمِنٍ أَن يَقْتُلَ مُؤْمِنًا إِلَّا خَطَأً ۚ  وَمَن قَتَلَ مُؤْمِنًا خَطَأً فَتَحْرِيرُ رَقَبَةٍ مُّؤْمِنَةٍ وَدِيَةٌ مُّسَلَّمَةٌ إِلَىٰ أَهْلِهِ  إِلَّا
أَن يَصَّدَّقُوا ۚ فَإِن كَانَ مِن قَوْمٍ عَدُوٍّ لَّكُمْ وَهُوَ
مُؤْمِنٌ فَتَحْرِيرُ رَقَبَةٍ مُّؤْمِنَةٍ ۖ وَإِن كَانَ مِن قَوْمٍ
بَيْنَكُمْ وَبَيْنَهُم مِّيثَاقٌ فَدِيَةٌ مُّسَلَّمَةٌ إِلَىٰ أَهْلِهِ
وَتَحْرِيرُ رَقَبَةٍ مُّؤْمِنَةٍ ۖ فَمَن لَّمْ يَجِدْ فَصِيَامُ
شَهْرَيْنِ مُتَتَابِعَيْنِ تَوْبَةً مِّنَ اللَّهِ ۗ وَكَانَ اللَّهُ
عَلِيمًا حَكِيمًا
And never is it for a believer to kill a believer except by mistake.  And
whoever kills a believer by mistake - then the freeing of a believing
slave and a compensation payment presented to the deceased's family [is
required]  unless they give [up their right as] charity. But if the
deceased was from a people at war with you and he was a believer - then
[only] the freeing of a believing slave; and if he was from a people
with whom you have a treaty - then a compensation payment presented to
his family and the freeing of a believing slave. And whoever does not
find [one or cannot afford to buy one] - then [instead], a fast for two
months consecutively, [seeking] acceptance of repentance from Allah .
And Allah is ever Knowing and Wise.
9.2 TALAQ (طَلاَق) :
it's root is TA-LA-QA(طلق) refers to two connotation a) seclusion b)
dispatch. so some living being who is in one control and care, to give
up control of that being and to dispatch. this word is commonly used to
free wife from the contract of marriage and parting.but it is not
necessary that both the connotation exist at the same time . ALLAH said
Surat Al-Baqarah (The Cow) - سورة البقرة
2:229
الطَّلَاقُ مَرَّتَانِ ۖ  فَإِمْسَاكٌ بِمَعْرُوفٍ أَوْ
تَسْرِيحٌ بِإِحْسَانٍ ۗ وَلَا يَحِلُّ لَكُمْ أَن تَأْخُذُوا مِمَّا
آتَيْتُمُوهُنَّ شَيْئًا إِلَّا أَن يَخَافَا أَلَّا يُقِيمَا حُدُودَ
اللَّهِ ۖ فَإِنْ خِفْتُمْ أَلَّا يُقِيمَا حُدُودَ اللَّهِ فَلَا جُنَاحَ
عَلَيْهِمَا فِيمَا افْتَدَتْ بِهِ ۗ تِلْكَ حُدُودُ اللَّهِ فَلَا
تَعْتَدُوهَا ۚ وَمَن يَتَعَدَّ حُدُودَ اللَّهِ فَأُولَٰئِكَ هُمُ
الظَّالِمُونَ
Divorce is twice . Then, either keep [her] in
an acceptable manner or release [her] with good treatment. And it is not
lawful for you to take anything of what you have given them unless both
fear that they will not be able to keep [within] the limits of Allah .
But if you fear that they will not keep [within] the limits of Allah ,
then there is no blame upon either of them concerning that by which she
ransoms herself. These are the limits of Allah , so do not transgress
them. And whoever transgresses the limits of Allah - it is those who are
the wrongdoers.
Now this is clear that in once or twice divorce there exist seclusion
but not parting. likewise TALAQ is used to free a slave (but it's
example is not in Quran) .so here is also present the condition of
seclusion or giving up one's right but neither the despatch is needed
nor conditioned. which means that in TALAQ the real condition is
Seclusion. and condition of Dispatch is sometimes existent ,like in the
third divorce this condition becomes mandatory , and sometimes non
existent like in first and second divorce
9.3 TASREEH(تَسرِيح) :
derived from SRH(سرح) which means "to take out cattle for grazing" and
ISRAH(اسرح) meaning to send out camel or cattle to graze. later on it is
meant for leaving cattle free for grazing in the pasture. as in the
Holy Quran
Surat An-Naĥl (The Bee) - سورة النحل
16:6
وَلَكُمْ فِيهَا جَمَالٌ حِينَ تُرِيحُونَ وَحِينَ تَسْرَحُونَ
And for you in them is [the enjoyment of] beauty when you bring them in
[for the evening] and when you send them out [to pasture].
so TASREEH basic meaning is to regard ease in dispatch and in that
enforcement of contract is not that strong as in the meaning of TALAQ.
also TASREEH is of common usage whereas TALAQ is now nearly limited to
woman. but TASREEH if relates to woman TASREEH ALMIRAH(تَسرِيح المِرَاة)
then it means to divorce the woman and dispatch her in a polite manner.
ALLAH said
Surat Al-Baqarah (The Cow) - سورة البقرة
2:229
الطَّلَاقُ مَرَّتَانِ ۖ فَإِمْسَاكٌ بِمَعْرُوفٍ أَوْ تَسْرِيحٌ بِإِحْسَانٍ
ۗ وَلَا يَحِلُّ لَكُمْ أَن تَأْخُذُوا مِمَّا آتَيْتُمُوهُنَّ شَيْئًا
إِلَّا أَن يَخَافَا أَلَّا يُقِيمَا حُدُودَ اللَّهِ ۖ فَإِنْ خِفْتُمْ
أَلَّا يُقِيمَا حُدُودَ اللَّهِ فَلَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيْهِمَا فِيمَا
افْتَدَتْ بِهِ ۗ تِلْكَ حُدُودُ اللَّهِ فَلَا تَعْتَدُوهَا ۚ وَمَن
يَتَعَدَّ حُدُودَ اللَّهِ فَأُولَٰئِكَ هُمُ الظَّالِمُونَ
Divorce is twice. Then, either keep [her] in an acceptable manner or release [her] with good treatment.
And it is not lawful for you to take anything of what you have given
them unless both fear that they will not be able to keep [within] the
limits of Allah . But if you fear that they will not keep [within] the
limits of Allah , then there is no blame upon either of them concerning
that by which she ransoms herself. These are the limits of Allah , so do
not transgress them. And whoever transgresses the limits of Allah - it
is those who are the wrongdoers.
at another place said:
Surat Al-'Aĥzāb (The Combined Forces) - سورة الأحزاب
33:28
يَا أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ قُل لِّأَزْوَاجِكَ إِن كُنتُنَّ تُرِدْنَ
الْحَيَاةَ الدُّنْيَا وَزِينَتَهَا فَتَعَالَيْنَ أُمَتِّعْكُنَّ
وَأُسَرِّحْكُنَّ سَرَاحًا جَمِيلًا
O Prophet, say to your wives, "If you should desire the worldly life and
its adornment, then come, I will provide for you and give you a
gracious release.
Summary:
9.1 TEHREER:word specific to free a slave
ALTALAQ and TASREEH both words are used for parting with woman or in common usage for divorce
9.2 ALTALAQ:  seclusion  is mandatory and  dispatch  is partially conditioned
9.3 TASREEH: dispatch  is mandatory and keeping in view ease and comfort

1 UBALNA JOSH MARNA [Boiling, To Overflow]
Synonyms: GHAL,NADAKHA,FARA(FA-WA-RA)
1.1 GHAL(غَلْي) : GHALA (غلا) basic meaning is to go beyond one's
limit and to arise. from this is GHALA ALQIDR(غَلاَ القِدر) meaning
overflowing pot , and GHALA ALSS3R(غلاَ السّعر) meaning rising prices.
ALLAH said:
Surat Ad-Dukhān (The Smoke) - سورة الدخان
44:45
كَالْمُهْلِ يَغْلِي فِي الْبُطُونِ
Like murky oil, it boils within bellies
Surat Ad-Dukhān (The Smoke) - سورة الدخان
44:46
كَغَلْيِ الْحَمِيمِ

1.2 NADAKHA(نَضَخَ) :
bursting out of spring of water ,but in NADAKHA the reason of bursting

10 UJAD[ Yahoo]
Synonyms: 3UTULL,FZZ,A3RAB

Surat Ad-Dukhān (The Smoke) - سورة الدخان
44:47
خُذُوهُ فَاعْتِلُوهُ إِلَىٰ سَوَاءِ الْجَحِيمِ

Cruel, moreover, and an illegitimate pretender.
10.2 FAZZ(فظّ)
: meaning rude and immoral. and FAZZ meaning talk harshly and blunt.
bitter of tongue.Antonym is LYN(لين) meaning soft tongue and kind
manners
Surat 'Āli `Imrān (Family of Imran) - سورة آل عمران
3:159
فَبِمَا رَحْمَةٍ مِّنَ اللَّهِ لِنتَ لَهُمْ ۖ وَلَوْ كُنتَ فَظًّا غَلِيظَ الْقَلْبِ لَانفَضُّوا مِنْ حَوْلِكَ
ۖ فَاعْفُ عَنْهُمْ وَاسْتَغْفِرْ لَهُمْ وَشَاوِرْهُمْ فِي الْأَمْرِ ۖ
فَإِذَا عَزَمْتَ فَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى اللَّهِ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ
الْمُتَوَكِّلِينَ
So by mercy from Allah , [O Muhammad], you
were lenient with them. And if you had been rude [in speech] and harsh
in heart, they would have disbanded from about you . So pardon them
and ask forgiveness for them and consult them in the matter. And when
you have decided, then rely upon Allah . Indeed, Allah loves those who
rely [upon Him].
10.3 A3RAB(اعراب)  : yokel- desert dwellers, wild ,jungle people,
uncivilized, those who doesn't possess any mannerism and unable to
converse in civilized way. ALLAH said
Surat At-Tawbah (The Repentance) - سورة التوبة
9:97
الْأَعْرَابُ أَشَدُّ كُفْرًا وَنِفَاقًا وَأَجْدَرُ أَلَّا يَعْلَمُوا حُدُودَ مَا أَنزَلَ اللَّهُ عَلَىٰ رَسُولِهِ ۗ  وَاللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌ
The
bedouins are stronger in disbelief and hypocrisy and more likely not to
know the limits of what [laws] Allah has revealed to His Messenger . And Allah is Knowing and Wise.
Summary:
10.1 3TL rude and violent
10.2 FZ immoral and using derogatory speech
10.3 A3RAB hick ,those who don't even know the mannerism of speech

11 ACHANAK (NA GHAN) [Sudden Bolt From Blue]
Synonyms: IZ,IZA, BAGTATAN
11.1 IZ(اِذْ) and IZA(اِذَا) : both of them are adverb meaning
"when" . IZ is generally used for past. and IZA is for
MUDARAH(present/future) . both these HARF comes for catastrophe or some
breaking news. yet what is happening now has some relationship with what
occured before. like KHARAJATU FAIZA ASADUN BI ILBABI(خَرَجَتُ فَاِذا
اَسَدٌ بِالْبَابِ) meaning when I emerge then suddenly on the door was a
lion. In the Quran
Surat Al-'A`rāf (The Heights) - سورة الأعراف
7:107
فَأَلْقَىٰ عَصَاهُ فَإِذَا هِيَ ثُعْبَانٌ مُّبِينٌ
So Moses threw his staff, and suddenly it was a serpent, manifest.
11.2 BAGHTATAN(بَغْتَةً) :
meaning something to manifest in such a way that it was unperceiveable.
difference BAGHTATAN and IZ or IZA is that in IZA there is some
relation between what happen afterwards and before. whereas in BAGHTATAN
only a catastrophe is narrated. ALLAH said
Surat Al-'A`rāf (The Heights) - سورة الأعراف
7:95
ثُمَّ بَدَّلْنَا مَكَانَ السَّيِّئَةِ الْحَسَنَةَ حَتَّىٰ عَفَوا وَّقَالُوا قَدْ مَسَّ آبَاءَنَا الضَّرَّاءُ وَالسَّرَّاءُ  فَأَخَذْنَاهُم بَغْتَةً وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ
Then We exchanged in place of the bad [condition], good, until they
increased [and prospered] and said, "Our fathers [also] were touched
with hardship and ease."  So We seized them suddenly while they did not perceive.
and on a second place
Surat Al-'An`ām (The Cattle) - سورة الأنعام
6:31
قَدْ خَسِرَ الَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا بِلِقَاءِ اللَّهِ ۖ  حَتَّىٰ إِذَا جَاءَتْهُمُ السَّاعَةُ بَغْتَةً قَالُوا يَا حَسْرَتَنَا عَلَىٰ مَا فَرَّطْنَا فِيهَا  وَهُمْ يَحْمِلُونَ أَوْزَارَهُمْ عَلَىٰ ظُهُورِهِمْ ۚ أَلَا سَاءَ مَا يَزِرُونَ
Those will have lost who deny the meeting with Allah ,  until when the
Hour [of resurrection] comes upon them unexpectedly, they will say,
"Oh, [how great is] our regret over what we neglected concerning it ," while they bear their burdens on their backs. Unquestionably, evil is that which they bear.

raw_text:
12 ACCHA,KHWB,BEHTER [GOOD,NICE,BETTER]
Synonyms: NI3MA,KHAIR,HASUNA,MUSLA, JAMEYL
12.1 NI3MA(نِعمَ) : word of admiration which is used for all types
of applause which means Bravo, Excellent. It's said on something when
pleased. as per Ibn e Faris its real is Join and Inclination. meaning
something when seen caused inclination towards it and to be favorable
then NI3MA is said . its antonym is BI-SA() which word of protest and
used for agitation.In the Quran
Surat An-Naĥl (The Bee) - سورة النحل
16:30
وَقِيلَ لِلَّذِينَ اتَّقَوْا مَاذَا أَنزَلَ رَبُّكُمْ ۚ قَالُوا خَيْرًا ۗ
لِّلَّذِينَ أَحْسَنُوا فِي هَٰذِهِ الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةٌ ۚ وَلَدَارُ
الْآخِرَةِ خَيْرٌ ۚ  وَلَنِعْمَ دَارُ الْمُتَّقِينَ
And it will be said to those who feared Allah , "What did your Lord send
down?" They will say, "[That which is] good." For those who do good in
this world is good; and the home of the Hereafter is better.  And how excellent is the home of the righteous -
12.2 KHAYR(خَيْر) : Every thing that is everyone's favourite for e.g justic,blessing,wisdom,and wealth. It's antonym is SHAR(شر). In the Quran
Surat Al-`Ādiyāt (The Courser) - سورة العاديات
100:8
وَإِنَّهُ لِحُبِّ الْخَيْرِ لَشَدِيدٌ
And indeed he is, in love of wealth, intense.
meaning KHAYR is every good discourse or deed and its plurl is KHAYRAT(خيرات) .ALLAH said
Surat 'Āli `Imrān (Family of Imran) - سورة آل عمران
3:114
يُؤْمِنُونَ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ وَيَأْمُرُونَ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ
وَيَنْهَوْنَ عَنِ الْمُنكَرِ وَيُسَارِعُونَ فِي الْخَيْرَاتِ  وَأُولَٰئِكَ مِنَ الصَّالِحِينَ
They believe in Allah and the Last Day, and they enjoin what is right and forbid what is wrong and hasten to good deeds.  And those are among the righteous.
KHAYR is not only used for good discourse or good deed but also for good
person and things as well. and for Faith ias well . Its plural in that
case is AKHYAR(اخيار). for e.g.
Surat Şād (The Letter "Saad") - سورة ص
38:47
وَإِنَّهُمْ عِندَنَا لَمِنَ الْمُصْطَفَيْنَ الْأَخْيَارِ
And indeed they are, to Us, among the chosen and outstanding.
So KHAYR is used for good discourse or deed or person and NI3MA when
happy by looking at some good thing .the ayah mentioned below clarify
this
Surat An-Naĥl (The Bee) - سورة النحل
16:30
وَقِيلَ لِلَّذِينَ اتَّقَوْا مَاذَا أَنزَلَ رَبُّكُمْ ۚ قَالُوا خَيْرًا ۗ
لِّلَّذِينَ أَحْسَنُوا فِي هَٰذِهِ الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةٌ ۚ  وَلَدَارُ الْآخِرَةِ خَيْرٌ ۚ وَلَنِعْمَ دَارُ الْمُتَّقِينَ
And it will be said to those who feared Allah , "What did your Lord send
down?" They will say, "[That which is] good." For those who do good in
this world is good;  and the home of the Hereafter is better. And how excellent is the home of the righteous -
12.3 HASUNA(حَسُنَ): meaning relishing and pleasing thing. and its
antonym is SA-A(سَاءَ). Then this word is used for visible beauty and
for the improved facial beauty. as said
Surat Ar-Raĥmān (The Beneficent) - سورة الرحمن
55:70
فِيهِنَّ خَيْرَاتٌ حِسَانٌ
In them are good and beautiful women -
and in that case its antonym is QABUHA( قَبُحَ) . also this word is used to exhibit the fine morality in literal sense as said
Surat An-Nisā' (The Women) - سورة النساء
4:69
وَمَن يُطِعِ اللَّهَ وَالرَّسُولَ فَأُولَٰئِكَ مَعَ الَّذِينَ أَنْعَمَ
اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِم مِّنَ النَّبِيِّينَ وَالصِّدِّيقِينَ وَالشُّهَدَاءِ
وَالصَّالِحِينَ ۚ  وَحَسُنَ أُولَٰئِكَ رَفِيقًا
And whoever obeys Allah and the Messenger - those will be with the ones
upon whom Allah has bestowed favor of the prophets, the steadfast
affirmers of truth, the martyrs and the righteous.  And excellent are those as companions .
12.4 AMCAL اَمْثَل and MUCLA مُثْلََي  : MACALAمَثَلَ means having a picture in front of eyes. and AMCAL meaning exemplary,ideal ,the best . as in the Quran.
Surat Ţāhā (Ta-Ha) - سورة طه
20:104
نَّحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ  إِذْ يَقُولُ أَمْثَلُهُمْ طَرِيقَةً  إِن لَّبِثْتُمْ إِلَّا يَوْمًا
We are most knowing of what they say  when the best of them in manner will say , "You remained not but one day."
and MUCLA is feminine from AMCALU. In the Quran

13 ACHANBHA AJNABI HONA [Wonder, To be Stranger]
Synonyms: NAKERA,3AJABA,JUNUB
13.1 NAKERA(نَكِرَ) : meaning to be unaware of something (antonym is
MA3RFAH مَعْرفة) and ANKAR(انكر) means to deny. to be unfamiliar with
some one. and TANAKAR(تَنَاكر) meaning to deliberately show
unfamiliarity between each other and to treat like strangers and
NUKR(نُكر) meaning bad deed, hard work and MUNKAR( مُنكر) meaning worst
deed ,worst discourse,unpleasing thing so NAKR includes 'Strangeness and
Unpleasant'. ALLAH said
Surat Hūd (Hud) - سورة هود
11:70
فَلَمَّا رَأَىٰ أَيْدِيَهُمْ لَا تَصِلُ إِلَيْهِ نَكِرَهُمْ وَأَوْجَسَ مِنْهُمْ خِيفَةً ۚ  قَالُوا لَا تَخَفْ إِنَّا أُرْسِلْنَا إِلَىٰ قَوْمِ لُوطٍ
But when he saw their hands not reaching for it, he distrusted them and felt from them apprehension.  They said, "Fear not. We have been sent to the people of Lot."
13.2 3AJABA(عَجَبَ)  :This word 3AJABUN(عَجَبٌ) is said to such an
amazement whose reason is unknown. also 3AJABA means to like and A3JABA
meaning to feel something pleasing which is unexpected and its reason is
unknown. sometimes this word is only used in the meaning of pleasant.
so in 3JB there are also two things Strangeness, and Pleasant. ALLAH
said
Surat Hūd (Hud) - سورة هود
11:73
قَالُوا أَتَعْجَبِينَ مِنْ أَمْرِ اللَّهِ ۖ رَحْمَتُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ عَلَيْكُمْ أَهْلَ الْبَيْتِ  ۚ إِنَّهُ حَمِيدٌ مَّجِيدٌ
They said, "Are you amazed at the decree of Allah ? May the mercy of Allah and His blessings be upon you, people of the house . Indeed, He is Praiseworthy and Honorable."
13.3 JUNUB( جُنُب) :
JANB جَنْب meaning side,lay on side, and JUNUB meaning strange and
impure. and JUNUB is the word used for all of
singular,dual,plural,male, feminine. This word is used in the Quran in
both the meaning. When this word is used in the sense of strangenss then
it doesn;t relate to unpleasing or pleasing. ALLAH said
Surat An-Nisā' (The Women) - سورة النساء
4:36
وَاعْبُدُوا اللَّهَ وَلَا تُشْرِكُوا بِهِ شَيْئًا ۖ وَبِالْوَالِدَيْنِ
إِحْسَانًا وَبِذِي الْقُرْبَىٰ وَالْيَتَامَىٰ وَالْمَسَاكِينِ  وَالْجَارِ ذِي الْقُرْبَىٰ وَالْجَارِ الْجُنُبِ وَالصَّاحِبِ بِالْجَنبِ  وَابْنِ السَّبِيلِ وَمَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَانُكُمْ ۗ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يُحِبُّ مَن كَانَ مُخْتَالًا فَخُورًا
Worship Allah and associate nothing with Him, and to parents do good,  and to relatives, orphans, the needy, the near neighbor, the neighbor farther away, the companion at your side , the traveler, and those whom your right hands possess. Indeed, Allah does not like those who are
and JANABA(جَنَبَ) meaning to be on one side and to stay away and as
JANABY person is commanded to stay on side or away from Prayer and
Mosque .that's why he is called JUNBY or JUNUB. In the Quran
Surat An-Nisā' (The Women) - سورة النساء
4:43
يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لَا تَقْرَبُوا الصَّلَاةَ وَأَنتُمْ سُكَارَىٰ حَتَّىٰ تَعْلَمُوا مَا تَقُولُونَ  وَلَا جُنُبًا إِلَّا عَابِرِي سَبِيلٍ حَتَّىٰ تَغْتَسِلُوا ۚ
وَإِن كُنتُم مَّرْضَىٰ أَوْ عَلَىٰ سَفَرٍ أَوْ جَاءَ أَحَدٌ مِّنكُم
مِّنَ الْغَائِطِ أَوْ لَامَسْتُمُ النِّسَاءَ فَلَمْ تَجِدُوا مَاءً
فَتَيَمَّمُوا صَعِيدًا طَيِّبًا فَامْسَحُوا بِوُجُوهِكُمْ وَأَيْدِيكُمْ ۗ
إِنَّ اللَّهَ كَانَ عَفُوًّا غَفُورًا
O you who have believed, do not approach prayer while you are intoxicated until you know what you are saying  or in a state of janabah, except those passing through [a place of prayer], until you have washed [your whole body].
And if you are ill or on a journey or one of you comes from the place
of relieving himself or you have contacted women and find no water, then
seek clean earth and wipe over your faces and your hands [with it].
Indeed, Allah is ever Pardoning and Forgiving.
Summary:
If strangeness include unpleasant then NAKIRA and if includes Pleasant then 3JB and when there is neither of two then it's JUNB

14 AHSAN KARNA [To Give Favour]
Synonyms: FADDALA,MANNA,AN3AMA,AHSANA
14.1 FADL(فَضْل) : meaning something is more than the economy or
moderate level. and FUDUL(فُضُوْل) meaning more than need. also all war
spoils thare left after distribution. and FADUL(فَضُوْل) the one doing
FADL alot and FADL meaning Favour,excess and FADDL(فَضَّل) meaning to
give some one preference or respect. ALLAH said
Surat Al-Baqarah (The Cow) - سورة البقرة
2:237
وَإِن طَلَّقْتُمُوهُنَّ مِن قَبْلِ أَن تَمَسُّوهُنَّ وَقَدْ فَرَضْتُمْ
لَهُنَّ فَرِيضَةً فَنِصْفُ مَا فَرَضْتُمْ إِلَّا أَن يَعْفُونَ أَوْ
يَعْفُوَ الَّذِي بِيَدِهِ عُقْدَةُ النِّكَاحِ ۚ وَأَن تَعْفُوا أَقْرَبُ
لِلتَّقْوَىٰ ۚ  وَلَا تَنسَوُا الْفَضْلَ بَيْنَكُمْ  ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ
And if you divorce them before you have touched them and you have
already specified for them an obligation, then [give] half of what you
specified - unless they forego the right or the one in whose hand is the
marriage contract foregoes it. And to forego it is nearer to
righteousness.  And do not forget graciousness between you . Indeed Allah , of whatever you do, is Seeing.
and FADDALA(فَضَّلَ) meaning to give some more than one's right out of courtesy. ALLAH said
Surat Al-Baqarah (The Cow) - سورة البقرة
2:253
تِلْكَ الرُّسُلُ فَضَّلْنَا بَعْضَهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ ۘ
مِّنْهُم مَّن كَلَّمَ اللَّهُ ۖ وَرَفَعَ بَعْضَهُمْ دَرَجَاتٍ ۚ
وَآتَيْنَا عِيسَى ابْنَ مَرْيَمَ الْبَيِّنَاتِ وَأَيَّدْنَاهُ بِرُوحِ
الْقُدُسِ ۗ وَلَوْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ مَا اقْتَتَلَ الَّذِينَ مِن بَعْدِهِم
مِّن بَعْدِ مَا جَاءَتْهُمُ الْبَيِّنَاتُ وَلَٰكِنِ اخْتَلَفُوا
فَمِنْهُم مَّنْ آمَنَ وَمِنْهُم مَّن كَفَرَ ۚ وَلَوْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ مَا
اقْتَتَلُوا وَلَٰكِنَّ اللَّهَ يَفْعَلُ مَا يُرِيدُ
Those messengers - some of them We caused to exceed others .
Among them were those to whom Allah spoke, and He raised some of them
in degree. And We gave Jesus, the Son of Mary, clear proofs, and We
supported him with the Pure Spirit. If Allah had willed, those
[generations] succeeding them would not have fought each other after the
clear proofs had come to them. But they differed, and some of them
believed and some of them disbelieved. And if Allah had willed, they
would not have fought each other, but Allah does what He intends.
14.2 MANN(مَنّ) : meaning Favour ,goodness,and MANNA(مَنَّ) meaning
to do favour. to remind of favour and name of a heavy weight. plural are
AMNAN(اَمْنَان) and AMNA-(اَمْنَاء) . and MANNA meaning heavy favour or
huge favour ALLAH said
Surat 'Āli `Imrān (Family of Imran) - سورة آل عمران
3:164
لَقَدْ مَنَّ اللَّهُ عَلَى الْمُؤْمِنِينَ إِذْ بَعَثَ فِيهِمْ رَسُولًا مِّنْ أَنفُسِهِمْ
يَتْلُو عَلَيْهِمْ آيَاتِهِ وَيُزَكِّيهِمْ وَيُعَلِّمُهُمُ الْكِتَابَ
وَالْحِكْمَةَ وَإِن كَانُوا مِن قَبْلُ لَفِي ضَلَالٍ مُّبِينٍ
Certainly did Allah confer [great] favor upon the believers when He sent among them a Messenger from themselves ,
reciting to them His verses and purifying them and teaching them the
Book and wisdom, although they had been before in manifest error.
14.3 AN3AMA(اَنْعَمَ) :
ANNA3MAH(اَلنَّعْمة) said to good state of a person. and N3MAH نعمة is
every thing that fullfills any need of a human and to make him prosper.
This word is for group. whether N3MAT is less or more. and N3MAT and
IN3AM are specific to human.AN3AMA اَنْعَمَ means to do favour,good,or
welfare. but AN3M 3LA FARSAH انعم علَي فرسه will never come. also this
word is never used for oneself.
Surat Al-'Aĥzāb (The Combined Forces) - سورة الأحزاب
33:37
وَإِذْ تَقُولُ لِلَّذِي أَنْعَمَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَأَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِ أَمْسِكْ عَلَيْكَ زَوْجَكَ
وَاتَّقِ اللَّهَ وَتُخْفِي فِي نَفْسِكَ مَا اللَّهُ مُبْدِيهِ وَتَخْشَى
النَّاسَ وَاللَّهُ أَحَقُّ أَن تَخْشَاهُ ۖ فَلَمَّا قَضَىٰ زَيْدٌ
مِّنْهَا وَطَرًا زَوَّجْنَاكَهَا لِكَيْ لَا يَكُونَ عَلَى الْمُؤْمِنِينَ
حَرَجٌ فِي أَزْوَاجِ أَدْعِيَائِهِمْ إِذَا قَضَوْا مِنْهُنَّ وَطَرًا ۚ
وَكَانَ أَمْرُ اللَّهِ مَفْعُولًا
And [remember, O Muhammad], when you said to the one on whom Allah bestowed favor and you bestowed favor, "Keep your wife  and
fear Allah ," while you concealed within yourself that which Allah is
to disclose. And you feared the people, while Allah has more right that
you fear Him. So when Zayd had no longer any need for her, We married
her to you in order that there not be upon the believers any discomfort
concerning the wives of their adopted sons when they no longer have need
of them. And ever is the command of Allah accomplished.
14.4 AHSAN(اَحْسَنَ):  AHSAAN means all matters of goodness and piety
whether it relates to oneself or others. in Hadith of Jibreel(AS),He
asked Muhammad(PBUH)what is AHSAAN so he replied "AHSAAN is that you
worship ALLAH like that you are watching HIM and if that's not
attainable then to atleast think that ALLAH is watching you". AHSAAN is
used for smaller of the smallest an larger of the largest of goodness.
like when Joseph(AS) thanked ALLAH by saying
Surat Yūsuf (Joseph) - سورة يوسف
12:100
وَرَفَعَ أَبَوَيْهِ عَلَى الْعَرْشِ وَخَرُّوا لَهُ سُجَّدًا ۖ وَقَالَ
يَا أَبَتِ هَٰذَا تَأْوِيلُ رُؤْيَايَ مِن قَبْلُ قَدْ جَعَلَهَا رَبِّي
حَقًّا ۖ  وَقَدْ أَحْسَنَ بِي إِذْ أَخْرَجَنِي مِنَ السِّجْنِ وَجَاءَ بِكُم مِّنَ الْبَدْوِ  مِن
بَعْدِ أَن نَّزَغَ الشَّيْطَانُ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَ إِخْوَتِي ۚ إِنَّ
رَبِّي لَطِيفٌ لِّمَا يَشَاءُ ۚ إِنَّهُ هُوَ الْعَلِيمُ الْحَكِيمُ
And he raised his parents upon the throne, and they bowed to him in
prostration. And he said, "O my father, this is the explanation of my
vision of before. My Lord has made it reality.  And He was certainly good to me when He took me out of prison and brought you [here] from bedouin life
after Satan had induced [estrangement] between me and my brothers.
Indeed, my Lord is Subtle in what He wills. Indeed, it is He who is the
Knowing, the Wise.
Summary:
14.1 FADDAL to give someone more than one's right out of courtesy
14.2 MANNA for huge favour
14.3 AN3AMA to give favour to any human except for one self
14.4 AHSANA very common and it can relate to others as well as one self

15 IKHTIAR (RAKHNA) [(To Have)Authority ]
Synonyms: KHAYARAH,MALK,WALAYAH,AMKANA
15.1 KHAYARAH(خِيَرَة) : KHAYR(خير) meaning good, and best and
KHAYARAH and IKHTAAR(اختار) meaning to choose or employ or like some
good thing from two or more than two things. ALLAH said
Surat Al-'Aĥzāb (The Combined Forces) - سورة الأحزاب
33:36
وَمَا كَانَ لِمُؤْمِنٍ وَلَا مُؤْمِنَةٍ إِذَا قَضَى اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ أَمْرًا أَن يَكُونَ  لَهُمُ الْخِيَرَةُ مِنْ أَمْرِهِمْ ۗ وَمَن يَعْصِ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ فَقَدْ ضَلَّ ضَلَالًا مُّبِينًا
It
is not for a believing man or a believing woman, when Allah and His
Messenger have decided a matter, that they should [thereafter] have any
choice about their affair.  And whoever disobeys Allah and His Messenger has certainly strayed into clear error.
15.2 MALK(مَلْك): MILK(مِلك) is all that is in someone's hold and no
other have any hold or authority over it .MALK and MILK both are
similar in meaning relative to that in MALK authority in such a thing
which is one's ownership and hold. and MALIK مَلِك is a king as public
is in his hold and control and he is their manager. In the Quran.
Surat Ţāhā (Ta-Ha) - سورة طه
20:87
قَالُوا مَا أَخْلَفْنَا مَوْعِدَكَ بِمَلْكِنَا  وَلَٰكِنَّا حُمِّلْنَا أَوْزَارًا مِّن زِينَةِ الْقَوْمِ فَقَذَفْنَاهَا فَكَذَٰلِكَ أَلْقَى السَّامِرِيُّ
They said, "We did not break our promise to you by our will ,
but we were made to carry burdens from the ornaments of the people [of
Pharaoh], so we threw them [into the fire], and thus did the Samiri
throw."
meaning samiri overpowered us by taking jewellery from us with deception
and made a calf out of it.such that we lost authority and control over
our own will and wish.
15.3 WALAYAH(وَلَاية) : If WAW
is Maftooh . and if WAW is maksoor that is WILAYAH(وِلايَة) then it
means country ,kingdom, or kingship. and WALAYAH meaning to be trustee
of some thing
and ALWALA-(الولاء) meaning that inheritance which is obtained of one's
free slave. and WALAYAH is used in the Quran in the meaning of
Inheritance. When First of the immigrants and Ansar establsihed
brotherhood then they were also inheritors to each other but later on
these commandments were revoked. and only real inheritors were delcared
actual inheritors. (See Surah ANFAAL 72-75). Also Quran used MAWLA مولي
(plural MAWALY موالي) in meaning of inheritor. ALLAH said
Surat An-Nisā' (The Women) - سورة النساء
4:33
وَلِكُلٍّ جَعَلْنَا مَوَالِيَ مِمَّا تَرَكَ الْوَالِدَانِ وَالْأَقْرَبُونَ  ۚ وَالَّذِينَ عَقَدَتْ أَيْمَانُكُمْ فَآتُوهُمْ نَصِيبَهُمْ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ كَانَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ شَهِيدًا
And for all, We have made heirs to what is left by parents and relatives . And to those whom your oaths have bound [to you] - give them their share. Indeed Allah is ever, over all things, a Witness.
so WALAYAH is more wide in meaning than MALK. ALLAH said
Surat Al-Kahf (The Cave) - سورة الكهف
18:44
هُنَالِكَ الْوَلَايَةُ لِلَّهِ الْحَقِّ ۚ  هُوَ خَيْرٌ ثَوَابًا وَخَيْرٌ عُقْبًا
There the authority is [completely] for Allah , the Truth . He is best in reward and best in outcome.
15.4 AMKANA(اَمْكَنَ) :
MAKAN(مكان) meaning place,situation,level and AMKANA and MAKKANA both
means to give someone authority over some place. To give authority,and
power. and AMKAN ALAMR(اَمْكَنَ الامر) meaning to make some work

16 IKHTYAR KARNA [To Follow]
Synonyms: ISTAHABBA,TAHARRA
16.1 ISTAHABBA(اِسْتَحَبَّ) : HUBBA(حُبّ) meaning love and ISTAHABBA meaning to follow something which is also wanted by the person following. ALLAH said
Surat At-Tawbah (The Repentance) - سورة التوبة
9:23
يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لَا تَتَّخِذُوا آبَاءَكُمْ
وَإِخْوَانَكُمْ أَوْلِيَاءَ إِنِ اسْتَحَبُّوا الْكُفْرَ عَلَى
الْإِيمَانِ  ۚ وَمَن يَتَوَلَّهُم مِّنكُمْ فَأُولَٰئِكَ هُمُ الظَّالِمُونَ
O you who have believed, do not take your fathers or your brothers as allies if they have preferred disbelief over belief.  And whoever does so among you - then it is those who are the wrongdoers.
16.2 TAHARRA (تَحَرّي) :
HRW(حرو) AHRA (اَحْري) meaning more capable and TAHARRA meaning 'to ask
for more suitable and capable for usage'. to summon the one better of
the two. In the Quran
Surat Al-Jinn (The Jinn) - سورة الجن
72:14
وَأَنَّا مِنَّا الْمُسْلِمُونَ وَمِنَّا الْقَاسِطُونَ ۖ  فَمَنْ أَسْلَمَ فَأُولَٰئِكَ تَحَرَّوْا رَشَدًا
And among us are Muslims [in submission to Allah ], and among us are the unjust.  And whoever has become Muslim - those have sought out the right course.
Summary:
To follow one of two or more than two things then if that selection is
also liked by the one following then it is ISTAHABBA . and to follow the
selection which is more apt and prudent then it is TAHARRA. [see also
PASAND KARNA and CHUN LEYNA]
