23:8
وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ لِأَمَانَاتِهِمْ وَعَهْدِهِمْ رَاعُونَ
And they who are to their trusts and their promises attentive
9.3 AHSANA  :HSN(حصن) meaning fort or secure place and it's plural is HUSUWN(حُصُوْن)
there are two basic things in HASAN, ALHIFZH WA ALHYATAH(الحفظ والحياطة) meaning protection and surrounded/covered. and as per author of MANJAD it means to protect in a protected place.also a woman guarding her chastity.In the QURAN
Surat At-Taĥrīm (The Prohibtiion) - سورة التحريم
66:12
وَمَرْيَمَ ابْنَتَ عِمْرَانَ الَّتِي أَحْصَنَتْ فَرْجَهَا فَنَفَخْنَا فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِنَا وَصَدَّقَتْ بِكَلِمَاتِ رَبِّهَا وَكُتُبِهِ وَكَانَتْ مِنَ الْقَانِتِينَ
And [the example of] Mary, the daughter of 'Imran, who guarded her chastity, so We blew into [her garment] through Our angel, and she believed in the words of her Lord and His scriptures and was of the devoutly obedient.
and also to commit marriage contract.because marriage serves as a fort againt shamelessness. as said
Surat An-Nisā' (The Women) - سورة النساء
4:24
وَالْمُحْصَنَاتُ مِنَ النِّسَاءِ إِلَّا مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَانُكُمْ ۖ كِتَابَ اللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ ۚ وَأُحِلَّ لَكُم مَّا وَرَاءَ ذَٰلِكُمْ أَن تَبْتَغُوا بِأَمْوَالِكُم مُّحْصِنِينَ غَيْرَ مُسَافِحِينَ ۚ فَمَا اسْتَمْتَعْتُم بِهِ مِنْهُنَّ فَآتُوهُنَّ أُجُورَهُنَّ فَرِيضَةً ۚ وَلَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيْكُمْ فِيمَا تَرَاضَيْتُم بِهِ مِن بَعْدِ الْفَرِيضَةِ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ كَانَ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمًا
And [also prohibited to you are all] married women except those your right hands possess. [This is] the decree of Allah upon you. And lawful to you are [all others] beyond these, [provided] that you seek them [in marriage] with [gifts from] your property, desiring chastity, not unlawful sexual intercourse. So for whatever you enjoy [of marriage] from them, give them their due compensation as an obligation. And there is no blame upon you for what you mutually agree to beyond the obligation. Indeed, Allah is ever Knowing and Wise.
9.4 KALA-A  :to keep something under visual surveillance and to keep it sustained.so it also includes two things a)contemplation b)stability and meaning to prevent something from getting inclined from peace to disaster. as said
Surat Al-'Anbyā' (The Prophets) - سورة الأنبياء
21:42
قُلْ مَن يَكْلَؤُكُم بِاللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ مِنَ الرَّحْمَٰنِ ۗ بَلْ هُمْ عَن ذِكْرِ رَبِّهِم مُّعْرِضُونَ
Say, "Who can protect you at night or by day from the Most Merciful?" But they are, from the remembrance of their Lord, turning away.
SUMMARY  :
9.1 HAFIZA:to prevent something from being wasted
9.2 RA3A:safety and removing causes of external dangers
9.3 AHSANA:safety by means of enclosure.
9.4 KALA-A:to keep valid and intact.
in addition please see   NIGHEHBAN [Guardian]

SAAD
1: Saaf Karna (To clean)
Synonyms: Mahhsa,Tahra,saffa,masah
1.1      Massaha:   To clean such thing in which synthesis is absorbed. It is used to separate the compounds in Madi things. Like (Mahasa dhab).To remove away the mixture and Alaish of other compounds from the gold after putting into cruset. Literally it means to clean and purify it after someone makes to suffer from grief and sorrows. Allah (swt) said:
Surat 'Āli `Imrān (Family of Imran)
3:141
وَلِيُمَحِّصَ اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَيَمْحَقَ الْكَافِرِينَ
And that Allâh may test (or purify) the believers (from sins) and destroy the disbelievers
1.2      Tahar: (its opposite is Nasa means uncleanliness) means to wash away the uncleanliness Tuhur means pure from uncleanliness and impurities. Clean-Translucent-Distilled .Allah (swt) said:
Surat-Al-Furqan:
25:48
وَأَنْزَلْنَا مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً طَهُورًا
and We send down pure water from the sky.
1.3      Saffa: To clean such things from mixture Alaish     which is possible without chemical way means mixture, like to distill the honey from the hive and Moom and to separate the salt and water after boiling the salty water. Allah (swt) said:
Surat Muhammad:
47:15
وَأَنْهَارٌ مِنْ عَسَلٍ مُصَفًّى
And rivers of clarified honey (clear and pure)
1.4      Masaha: means to remove the dust with hand, to dust , to wipe away, as it is said:
Surat-Saad:
38:33
فَطَفِقَ مَسْحًا بِالسُّوقِ وَالْأَعْنَاقِ
Then he (Prophet Suleman (a) ) began to pass his hand over their legs and their necks (till the end of the display).
And in Juristic meaning masah means to rub or put pure clay or water then remove it by dusting.Allah (swt) said:
Surat-al-Maidah:
5:6
فَتَيَمَّمُوا صَعِيدًا طَيِّبًا فَامْسَحُوا بِوُجُوهِكُمْ وَأَيْدِيكُمْ مِنْهُ
Summary:
1: Mahhsa:   to remove the mixture from the compounds and clean it
2:Tahhara:   to clean the external impurities with water, etc
3: Saffa:   To remove the mixture from Ameza
4:Masha:   to wipe away the dust or Alaish with hand-to dust-to clean

3. Subuh kerna (To do morning)
Synonyms:   Asbaha & Ghada
3.1: Asbaha & sabbaha:  sabiha, (sabhaan) means shine and to be bright and Misbah means   charaag   and a lot of light due to rise of day in the morning.   Asbaha  : means to enter in morning and   Sabbaha   means to come in the morning.to say morning greetings.Asbaha  and sabbaha to happen of some work in the morning or it is used to --------?Allah (swt) said:
Soorah-Al-Qalam: 68: 20-21
فَأَصْبَحَتْ كَالصَّرِيم فَتَنَادَوْا مُصْبِحِينَِ
So the (garden) became, by the morning, like a dark and desolate spot, (whose fruit had been gathered). As the morning broke, they called out one to another.
In an Other place said:
Soorah Al- Qamar: 54:30
وَلَقَدْ صَبَّحَهُمْ بُكْرَةً عَذَابٌ مُسْتَقِرٌّ
Early on the morrow an abiding Punishment seized them:
Then due to the abundance use of it the word Asbaha being used in the meaning of “to be” as said:
Surah-Al Imran: 03:103
فَأَصْبَحْتُمْ بِنِعْمَتِهِ إِخْوَانًا
by His Grace, you became brethren
3.2: Ghada: means coming day, tomorrow and Gadwa after rising the day Ishraq and third part after Bukrah and Gada means to do some one next day in the morning hours the this word was also used for someday or for the morning work. Allah (SWT) said:
Surah-Al Imran: 03:121
وَإِذْ غَدَوْتَ مِنْ أَهْلِكَ تُبَوِّئُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ مَقَاعِدَ لِلْقِتَالِ
Remember that morning thou didst leave thy household (early) to post the Faithful at their stations for battle:

3.2: Ghada: means coming day, tomorrow and Gadwa after rising the day Ishraq and third part after Bukrah and Gada means to do some one next day in the morning hours the this word was also used for someday or for the morning work. Allah (SWT) said:

Surah-Al Imran: 03:121

 

وَإِذْ غَدَوْتَ مِنْ أَهْلِكَ تُبَوِّئُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ مَقَاعِدَ لِلْقِتَالِ

Remember that morning thou didst leave thy household (early) to post the Faithful at their stations for battle:

raw_text:
4 - Sabar Kerna ( Be Patient)
Synonyms:   Sabara,Qana’ah:

Surah-Al-A’naam: 6:34

With patience and constancy they bore their rejection and their wrongs until Our aid did reach them

When they are down on their sides (after slaughter), eat ye thereof, and feed such as (beg not but) live in contentment,

2:Qanat: Be patient & thankful with little needs of life.

title: content/SA/SA5.html
raw_text:
5 Sullah (Reconciliation)
Synonyms  : Suluh,Salama
5.1 : Suluh ( pl. islah) its opposite is Fassad means demolition and Islah means to correct the demolition.& suluh is mutual co-operation in  between those two groups who had demolition , & dispute earlier. Allah (SWT) Said:
Soorat-An-Nisa :4:128
وَإِنِ امْرَأَةٌ خَافَتْ مِنْ بَعْلِهَا نُشُوزًا أَوْ إِعْرَاضًا فَلَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيْهِمَا أَنْ يُصْلِحَا بَيْنَهُمَا صُلْحًا ۚ وَالصُّلْحُ خَيْرٌ
If a wife fears cruelty or desertion on her husband's part, there is no blame on them if they arrange an amicable settlement between themselves; and such settlement is best;
5.2:Salam: Assalaam, means peace ,obediently and salaam means to get rid off ,be saved, the reconciler is also called Salaam, and also that reconciliation and co-operation which is aroused before the dispute and demolition. Be obedient, Allah (swt) said:
Soorat-An-Nisa :4:90
فَإِنِ اعْتَزَلُوكُمْ فَلَمْ يُقَاتِلُوكُمْ وَأَلْقَوْا إِلَيْكُمُ السَّلَمَ فَمَا جَعَلَ اللَّهُ لَكُمْ عَلَيْهِمْ سَبِيلًا
therefore if they withdraw from you but fight you, not and (instead) send you (guarantees of) peace, then Allah hath opened no way for you (to war against them).
Summary:   the co-operation before the demolition and dispute is called Salam and the word sulah is used for the mutual co-operation after the demolition.

title: content/TA/TA1.html
raw_text:
1-Taaqat (Strength)
Synonyms in the Quran: Taaqata (tauq), Quwwa (Quww), Mirrah(Marr), Rukn, Mahul
1.1-Taaqata(طاقة): It is a well recognized word and its usage is common. Literally, the strength and power required for a certain action.
Allah(swt) says in the Quran:
Surah Al-Baqarah-The Cow(2:286)
رَبَّنَا وَلَا تُحَمِّلْنَا مَا لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِ ۖ
Our Lord, and burden us not with that which we have no ability to bear.
1.2-Quwwah(قُوَّة):Force. The potential and ability that is found in a thing. Antonym: weak
Mentioned in the Quran:
Surah Qasas-The Stories (28:76)
إِنَّ مَفَاتِحَهُ لَتَنُوءُ بِالْعُصْبَةِ أُولِي الْقُوَّةِ
We gave him of treasures whose keys would burden a band of strong men;
1.3-Mirrah(مِرَّة)(Marra): Meaning i)Passing by ii)To be acrimonious or iii)To divide firmly. And mirrah meaning with intensity. The perennial condition of a thing. Strength. Steadfastness.Intensity and resolve. And Zumarrah(ذومرة) is an idiom meaning strong and powerful. Energetic. Very forceful. And Mareer meaning a braided rope. Allah (swt) says:
Surah An-Najm-The Star (53:5-6)
عَلَّمَهُ شَدِيدُ الْقُوَىٰ
ذُو مِرَّةٍ فَاسْتَوَىٰ
Taught to him by one intense in strength -
One of soundness. And he rose to [his] true form
1.4-Rukn(رُكن): Something's Rukn is it's strongest direction. And meaning pillar. Fortress and foundation are also used.
Allah (swt) says:
Surah Hud (11:80)
قَالَ لَوْ أَنَّ لِي بِكُمْ قُوَّةً أَوْ آوِي إِلَىٰ رُكْنٍ شَدِيدٍ
He said, "If only I had against you some power or could take refuge in a strong support."
1.5-Mahula(مَحُلَ): Meaning to scheme against someone with power and strictness. Therefore, the meaning of Mahl may encompass Quwwah and Heelah. That is, to tighten one's grip upon a person via scheming. And Mahl meaning betrayal. Duplicity. Enmity. Intensity. Drought. Extreme hunger. Allah(swt) says:
Surah Ar-Ra'd-The Thunder(13:13)
وَهُمْ يُجَادِلُونَ فِي اللَّهِ وَهُوَ شَدِيدُ الْمِحَالِ
...they dispute about Allah ; and He is severe in assault.
Summary:
1) Taaqat: Common word. The amount of strength required for an act.
2) Quwwah: The capacity and ability present in something.
3) Marrah: Power, intensity and resolve.
4) Rukn: The strongest direction of something
5) Mahl: Power and excuses

title: content/TA/TA2.html
raw_text:
2-Taaqat rakhna (to have strength)
The words ataq and istita'a have been used in the Quran for this.
2.1-Ataq(اطاق):Meaning to have the courage and power for a certain act. Its a commonly used word.
Allah (swt) says in the Quran:
Surah Baqarah-The Cow (2:184)
أَيَّامًا مَّعْدُودَاتٍ ۚ فَمَن كَانَ مِنكُم مَّرِيضًا أَوْ عَلَىٰ سَفَرٍ فَعِدَّةٌ مِّنْ أَيَّامٍ أُخَرَ ۚ وَعَلَى الَّذِينَ يُطِيقُونَهُ فِدْيَةٌ طَعَامُ مِسْكِينٍ ۖ فَمَن تَطَوَّعَ خَيْرًا فَهُوَ خَيْرٌ لَّهُ ۚ وَأَن تَصُومُوا خَيْرٌ لَّكُمْ ۖ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
[Fasting for] a limited number of days. So whoever among you is ill or on a journey [during them] - then an equal number of days [are to be made up]. And upon those who are able [to fast, but with hardship] - a ransom [as substitute] of feeding a poor person [each day]. And whoever volunteers excess - it is better for him. But to fast is best for you, if you only knew.
2.2:Istita'a (اِستِطاعَ)- meaning to have the strength for a certain act. To be able. And meaning the presence of all the means required for the implementation of a certain act.The word taaqat is limited to an individual whereas the word istita'at encompasses other means and methods, in addition to individual strength. For example, the expenditure, transport, presence of peace in the way, money for the household et cetera for Hajj.
Surah 'Ali Imran (Family of Imran)[3:97]
وَلِلَّهِ عَلَى النَّاسِ حِجُّ الْبَيْتِ مَنِ اسْتَطَاعَ إِلَيْهِ سَبِيلًا ۚ
And [due] to Allah from the people is a pilgrimage to the House - for whoever is able to find thereto a way.
Therefore Istita'a is taken to mean to have the ways, to have the means, or the ability to perform a certain act. It is mentioned in the Quran:
Surah Al-Kahf (The Cave) [18:97]
فَمَا اسْطَاعُوا أَن يَظْهَرُوهُ وَمَا اسْتَطَاعُوا لَهُ نَقْبًا
So Gog and Magog were unable to pass over it, nor were they able [to effect] in it any penetration.
And in another place:
Surah Al-Ma'idah-The Table Spread(5:112)
إِذْ قَالَ الْحَوَارِيُّونَ يَا عِيسَى ابْنَ مَرْيَمَ هَلْ يَسْتَطِيعُ رَبُّكَ أَن يُنَزِّلَ عَلَيْنَا مَائِدَةً مِّنَ السَّمَاءِ
[And remember] when the disciples said, "O Jesus, Son of Mary, can your Lord send down to us a table [spread with food] from the heaven?

title: content/TA/TA3.html
raw_text:
3-Tareeqa(way)-Dastoor(norms)
Synonyms: Tareeqa, Sunnah, Ummah, Shari'ah, Minhaj, Mansak, Shakilah, Ma'aroof and Khuluq
3.1:Tareeqa(طَرِيقَة)-Meaning habit, condition, religion. Therefore all the sects and religions that humans adopt to do some work.
It is mentioned in the Quran:
Surah Taha (20:63):
قَالُوا إِنْ هَٰذَانِ لَسَاحِرَانِ يُرِيدَانِ أَن يُخْرِجَاكُم مِّنْ أَرْضِكُم بِسِحْرِهِمَا وَيَذْهَبَا بِطَرِيقَتِكُمُ الْمُثْلَىٰ
They said, "Indeed, these are two magicians who want to drive you out of your land with their magic and do away with your most exemplary way.
And in another place:
Surah Taha (20:104):
نَّحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ إِذْ يَقُولُ أَمْثَلُهُمْ طَرِيقَةً إِن لَّبِثْتُمْ إِلَّا يَوْمًا
We are most knowing of what they say when the best of them in manner will say, "You remained not but one day."
Therefore in sharaee context, tareeqa refers to those rituals and habits that people have raised to the level of religion.
3.2:Sunnah(سُنَّة): Sanna(سَنَّ) meaning the advent of something and its continuation in a correct manner. Used for both things that are being done because they are an order and those that are being done because of inclination. For example 'mun sanna sunnah'(مَن سَنَّ سُنَّة) someone established something (way, ritual, norm). When used in reference to Allah Ta'ala then it will mean God's Law (which is usually referred to as nature's law).
Allah(swt) says in the Quran:
Surah Fatir-Originator(35:43):
فَهَلْ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا سُنَّتَ الْأَوَّلِينَ ۚ فَلَن تَجِدَ لِسُنَّتِ اللَّهِ تَبْدِيلًا
... Then do they await except the way of the former peoples? But you will never find in the way of Allah any change,
And when only the word Sunnat is used, it usually means the way of the Prophet (saw)
3.3:Ummah(اُمَّة): A group of people having a shared set of beliefs and opinions/outlooks. It also includes any belief and outlook that people are agreed upon, whether it is wrong or right.
Allah(swt) says in the Quran:
Surah Az-Zukhruf-The Ornaments of Gold(43:23):
إِنَّا وَجَدْنَا آبَاءَنَا عَلَىٰ أُمَّةٍ وَإِنَّا عَلَىٰ آثَارِهِم مُّقْتَدُونَ
"Indeed, we found our fathers upon a religion, and we are, in their footsteps, following."
3.4-Sharia'ah(شَرِيعَة): Shara'a(شرع)meaning for something to be brought or raised into being apparent. Shara'-al-ba'aeeroo o'onuqahoo(شَرَعَ البَعِيرُ عُنُقَهُ)- the camel raised his neck in such a way that it became more noticeable. And shara'a-al-qaum(شرع اللقوم) meaning to make the law for a nation. And sharia'a(شَرِيعَة) meaning Islamic law. God's orders. Order and shari'at-e-Islamia are used for Islamic laws. And Shari'ah meaning the clear and designated path. But this applies only to God's orders.
We think that Imam Raghib's explanation or meaning is the more correct view that is the word Shari'at means God's orders rather than Islamic law because the Prophet(saw) said that the Deen of all messengers and Prophets was one but the Shari'at kept changing (according to the requirements of that time). Deen is similar to a father whereas shari'at is like a mother. The Prophet(saw) said all the Messengers have a common father but different mothers. Therefore, the Deen is based on certain constant dictates of God that have been the same since the beginning of Creation such as belief in the unseen, belief in Allah, His angels and His books and laws of reward and punishment etc. Prayers, fasting, and Zakat's rulings and laws of punishments and orders of Shari'at is exemplified by the number of prayers, their rakaat and way of offering them. The shari'at for all messengers and prophets was different but the Deen was one.
Allah (swt) says:
Surah al-Jathiya-The Crouching(45:18)
ثُمَّ جَعَلْنَاكَ عَلَىٰ شَرِيعَةٍ مِّنَ الْأَمْرِ
Then We put you, [O Muhammad], on an ordained way
This Ayat makes it clear that Prophet(saw) was given a separate shari'at.
3.5-Minhaj(مِنهَاج): Nahj al amr waltareeq(نهج الامروالطريق) meaning for a work or way to be apparent. And minhaj meaning clear way of acts that is the way of enacting shara'ee orders. And this way is told to the messengers by Allah Himself as is made obvious by Sahih Hadith that Jibrael (as) came to the Prophet(saw) for two days and instructed him in the 5 prayers. The first day during optimum times and the second day during the late hours. And told him that prayers can also be offered between these two extremes of times. This is minhaj. Therefore, minhaj is a treatise and explanation of shari'at.
Allah(swt) says:
Surah Al-Maidah-The Table Spread (5:48)
كُلٍّ جَعَلْنَا مِنكُمْ شِرْعَةً وَمِنْهَاجًا ۚ
To each of you We prescribed a law and a method.
3.6-Munsaka(مَنسَكَ): Nasaka(نَسَكَ) meaning to become an ascetic. To become a dervish. And nasaka lillahi(نَسَكَ لِلَّهِ) meaning to sacrifice for Allah. Munsaka has been derived from minhaj and it only refers to those ways that are related to worship. As mentioned in the Quran:
Surah Al-Haj (22:67)
لِّكُلِّ أُمَّةٍ جَعَلْنَا مَنسَكًا هُمْ نَاسِكُوهُ ۖ
For every religion We have appointed rites which they perform.
The word Manasak is usually limited to the rulings and performance of Hajj. Manasik-e-Hajj meaning the locations, methods and manners for the acts of Hajj. And nasak(نسك) refers to the sacrifice offered during Hajj. (For details, refer to 'Qurbani')
In the Quran:
Surah Al-Baqrah-The Cow (2:196)
فَمَن كَانَ مِنكُم مَّرِيضًا أَوْ بِهِ أَذًى مِّن رَّأْسِهِ فَفِدْيَةٌ مِّن صِيَامٍ أَوْ صَدَقَةٍ أَوْ نُسُكٍ ۚ
And whoever among you is ill or has an ailment of the head [making shaving necessary must offer] a ransom of fasting [three days] or charity or sacrifice.
3.7-Shaakilah(شَاكِلَه): Shakala(شَكَلَ) meaning to be ambiguous. And Shakul-ad-daayah(شَكُلَ الدَّايَة) meaning sheltering an animal and an-nas-u ashkal-u-wa-ullaafun (اَلنَّاسُ اَشكَالٌ وَّالَّافٌ) meaning people being similar to each other with fondness in the sense that there are two aspects in the meaning of shakal. One being similar in apparence while shaakilah refers to a specific way of dealing with others to inspire and encourage them in doing the same. As the Holy Prophet (SAW) said: Kullum-muyassarul-limaa-khuliqa-lah(كُلٌّ مُّيَسَّرٌ لِّمَا خُلِقَ لَهُ) . You can understand this with the example of a man who takes care of the needy be giving sadaqah or charity while giving it in a way that it encourages others not to show off but without having any ill intent. Now, both these methods are correct and allowed although the act is similar or exactly the same but the way of performing them is unique in their own respect depending on their preference and execution. This is shakilah.
Allah (swt) says in the Quran:
Surah Al-Isra-The Night Journey (17:84)
قُلْ كُلٌّ يَعْمَلُ عَلَىٰ شَاكِلَتِهِ فَرَبُّكُمْ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنْ هُوَ أَهْدَىٰ سَبِيلًا
Say, "Each works according to his manner, but your Lord is most knowing of who is best guided in way."
3.8-Ma'aroof(مَعرُوف): Urf(عُرف) meaning recognizable and ma'aroof refers to a way that easily blends in with the norms of the society, customs and traditions in the sense that it is perceived to be good, independent of whether it is supported or backed by the shari'ah or not. Like treating elders with respect and calling them 'sir' or using 'jee' even though there is no such obligation by the shari'ah but such acts are good, meaning ma'aroof.
Allah (swt) says in the Quran:
Surah Al-Baqarah-The Cow (2:241)
وَلِلْمُطَلَّقَاتِ مَتَاعٌ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ ۖ
And for divorced women is a provision according to what is acceptable -
3.9-Khuluq(خُلُق): Khalq khilqat(خَلق خِلقَت) refers to the outer appearance that can be perceived by the human eye while khulq(خُلق) refers to the personality or hidden traits of a person like habits and weaknesses. Khulq or Khuluq meaning preference, weakness or an act or way that has become a habit.
Allah (swt) says in the Quran:
Surah Ash-Shu'ara-The Poets (26:137)
إِنْ هَٰذَا إِلَّا خُلُقُ الْأَوَّلِينَ
This is not but the custom of the former peoples,
Summary:
1) Tareeqah: Those traditions and rituals that people start believing to be part of religion
2) Sunnah: The laws of God that are established in the universe.
3) Ummah: The similar views or beliefs of a group of people.
4) Shari'ah: Those laws of God that kept changing due to different requirements and times.
5) Minhaj: The way to enact God's laws. Details and explanation.
6) Mansak: The rules of worship especially Hajj.
7) Shakilatih: The actions of an individual due to his personal inclinations
8) Ma'aroof: Such rituals and customs that are liked in a society and they are not contrary to Islamic law.
9) Khuluq: Those habits or ways that have become a part of an individual.

3-Tareeqa(way)-Dastoor(norms)


Synonyms: Tareeqa, Sunnah, Ummah, Shari'ah, Minhaj, Mansak, Shakilah, Ma'aroof and Khuluq

3.1:Tareeqa(طَرِيقَة)-Meaning habit, condition, religion. Therefore all the sects and religions that humans adopt to do some work.
It is mentioned in the Quran:

Surah Taha (20:63):
قَالُوا إِنْ هَٰذَانِ لَسَاحِرَانِ يُرِيدَانِ أَن يُخْرِجَاكُم مِّنْ أَرْضِكُم بِسِحْرِهِمَا وَيَذْهَبَا بِطَرِيقَتِكُمُ الْمُثْلَىٰ
They said, "Indeed, these are two magicians who want to drive you out of your land with their magic and do away with your most exemplary way.

And in another place:

Surah Taha (20:104):
نَّحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ إِذْ يَقُولُ أَمْثَلُهُمْ طَرِيقَةً إِن لَّبِثْتُمْ إِلَّا يَوْمًا
We are most knowing of what they say when the best of them in manner will say, "You remained not but one day."

Therefore in sharaee context, tareeqa refers to those rituals and habits that people have raised to the level of religion.


3.2:Sunnah(سُنَّة): Sanna(سَنَّ) meaning the advent of something and its continuation in a correct manner. Used for both things that are being done because they are an order and those that are being done because of inclination. For example 'mun sanna sunnah'(مَن سَنَّ سُنَّة) someone established something (way, ritual, norm). When used in reference to Allah Ta'ala then it will mean God's Law (which is usually referred to as nature's law).
Allah(swt) says in the Quran:

Surah Fatir-Originator(35:43):
فَهَلْ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا سُنَّتَ الْأَوَّلِينَ ۚ فَلَن تَجِدَ لِسُنَّتِ اللَّهِ تَبْدِيلًا
... Then do they await except the way of the former peoples? But you will never find in the way of Allah any change,

And when only the word Sunnat is used, it usually means the way of the Prophet (saw)

3.3:Ummah(اُمَّة): A group of people having a shared set of beliefs and opinions/outlooks. It also includes any belief and outlook that people are agreed upon, whether it is wrong or right.
Allah(swt) says in the Quran:

Surah Az-Zukhruf-The Ornaments of Gold(43:23):
إِنَّا وَجَدْنَا آبَاءَنَا عَلَىٰ أُمَّةٍ وَإِنَّا عَلَىٰ آثَارِهِم مُّقْتَدُونَ
"Indeed, we found our fathers upon a religion, and we are, in their footsteps, following."



3.4-Sharia'ah(شَرِيعَة): Shara'a(شرع)meaning for something to be brought or raised into being apparent. Shara'-al-ba'aeeroo o'onuqahoo(شَرَعَ البَعِيرُ عُنُقَهُ)- the camel raised his neck in such a way that it became more noticeable. And shara'a-al-qaum(شرع اللقوم) meaning to make the law for a nation. And sharia'a(شَرِيعَة) meaning Islamic law. God's orders. Order and shari'at-e-Islamia are used for Islamic laws. And Shari'ah meaning the clear and designated path. But this applies only to God's orders.
We think that Imam Raghib's explanation or meaning is the more correct view that is the word Shari'at means God's orders rather than Islamic law because the Prophet(saw) said that the Deen of all messengers and Prophets was one but the Shari'at kept changing (according to the requirements of that time). Deen is similar to a father whereas shari'at is like a mother. The Prophet(saw) said all the Messengers have a common father but different mothers. Therefore, the Deen is based on certain constant dictates of God that have been the same since the beginning of Creation such as belief in the unseen, belief in Allah, His angels and His books and laws of reward and punishment etc. Prayers, fasting, and Zakat's rulings and laws of punishments and orders of Shari'at is exemplified by the number of prayers, their rakaat and way of offering them. The shari'at for all messengers and prophets was different but the Deen was one.
Allah (swt) says:

Surah al-Jathiya-The Crouching(45:18)
ثُمَّ جَعَلْنَاكَ عَلَىٰ شَرِيعَةٍ مِّنَ الْأَمْرِ
Then We put you, [O Muhammad], on an ordained way

This Ayat makes it clear that Prophet(saw) was given a separate shari'at.



3.5-Minhaj(مِنهَاج): Nahj al amr waltareeq(نهج الامروالطريق) meaning for a work or way to be apparent. And minhaj meaning clear way of acts that is the way of enacting shara'ee orders. And this way is told to the messengers by Allah Himself as is made obvious by Sahih Hadith that Jibrael (as) came to the Prophet(saw) for two days and instructed him in the 5 prayers. The first day during optimum times and the second day during the late hours. And told him that prayers can also be offered between these two extremes of times. This is minhaj. Therefore, minhaj is a treatise and explanation of shari'at.
Allah(swt) says:

Surah Al-Maidah-The Table Spread (5:48)
كُلٍّ جَعَلْنَا مِنكُمْ شِرْعَةً وَمِنْهَاجًا ۚ
To each of you We prescribed a law and a method.



3.6-Munsaka(مَنسَكَ): Nasaka(نَسَكَ) meaning to become an ascetic. To become a dervish. And nasaka lillahi(نَسَكَ لِلَّهِ) meaning to sacrifice for Allah. Munsaka has been derived from minhaj and it only refers to those ways that are related to worship. As mentioned in the Quran:

Surah Al-Haj (22:67)
لِّكُلِّ أُمَّةٍ جَعَلْنَا مَنسَكًا هُمْ نَاسِكُوهُ ۖ
For every religion We have appointed rites which they perform.

The word Manasak is usually limited to the rulings and performance of Hajj. Manasik-e-Hajj meaning the locations, methods and manners for the acts of Hajj. And nasak(نسك) refers to the sacrifice offered during Hajj. (For details, refer to 'Qurbani')
In the Quran:

Surah Al-Baqrah-The Cow (2:196)
فَمَن كَانَ مِنكُم مَّرِيضًا أَوْ بِهِ أَذًى مِّن رَّأْسِهِ فَفِدْيَةٌ مِّن صِيَامٍ أَوْ صَدَقَةٍ أَوْ نُسُكٍ ۚ
And whoever among you is ill or has an ailment of the head [making shaving necessary must offer] a ransom of fasting [three days] or charity or sacrifice.



3.7-Shaakilah(شَاكِلَه): Shakala(شَكَلَ) meaning to be ambiguous. And Shakul-ad-daayah(شَكُلَ الدَّايَة) meaning sheltering an animal and an-nas-u ashkal-u-wa-ullaafun (اَلنَّاسُ اَشكَالٌ وَّالَّافٌ) meaning people being similar to each other with fondness in the sense that there are two aspects in the meaning of shakal. One being similar in apparence while shaakilah refers to a specific way of dealing with others to inspire and encourage them in doing the same. As the Holy Prophet (SAW) said: Kullum-muyassarul-limaa-khuliqa-lah(كُلٌّ مُّيَسَّرٌ لِّمَا خُلِقَ لَهُ) . You can understand this with the example of a man who takes care of the needy be giving sadaqah or charity while giving it in a way that it encourages others not to show off but without having any ill intent. Now, both these methods are correct and allowed although the act is similar or exactly the same but the way of performing them is unique in their own respect depending on their preference and execution. This is shakilah.
Allah (swt) says in the Quran:

Surah Al-Isra-The Night Journey (17:84)
قُلْ كُلٌّ يَعْمَلُ عَلَىٰ شَاكِلَتِهِ فَرَبُّكُمْ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنْ هُوَ أَهْدَىٰ سَبِيلًا
Say, "Each works according to his manner, but your Lord is most knowing of who is best guided in way."



3.8-Ma'aroof(مَعرُوف): Urf(عُرف) meaning recognizable and ma'aroof refers to a way that easily blends in with the norms of the society, customs and traditions in the sense that it is perceived to be good, independent of whether it is supported or backed by the shari'ah or not. And for divorced women is a provision according to what is acceptable -



3.9-Khuluq(خُلُق): Khalq khilqat(خَلق خِلقَت) refers to the outer appearance that can be perceived by the human eye while khulq(خُلق) refers to the personality or hidden traits of a person like habits and weaknesses. Khulq or Khuluq meaning preference, weakness or an act or way that has become a habit.
Allah (swt) says in the Quran:

Surah Ash-Shu'ara-The Poets (26:137)
إِنْ هَٰذَا إِلَّا خُلُقُ الْأَوَّلِينَ
This is not but the custom of the former peoples,



Summary:
1) Tareeqah: Those traditions and rituals that people start believing to be part of religion
2) Sunnah: The laws of God that are established in the universe.
3) Ummah: The similar views or beliefs of a group of people.
4) Shari'ah: Those laws of God that kept changing due to different requirements and times.
5) Minhaj: The way to enact God's laws. Details and explanation.

4-Taa'ana daina (to taunt)
Synonyms: Ta'ana, lamaza, hamaza
4.1-Taa'ana(طَعَنَ): Meaning spear. To inflict a wound with horns or some other sharp object. Metaphorically speaking, to say something about a person or to a person that pierces him like a spear, meaning highlighting his shortcomings in such a way that is unpleasant.
Allah (swt) says in the Quran:
Surah At-Tawbah-The Repentance(9:12)
وَإِن نَّكَثُوا أَيْمَانَهُم مِّن بَعْدِ عَهْدِهِمْ وَطَعَنُوا فِي دِينِكُمْ فَقَاتِلُوا أَئِمَّةَ الْكُفْرِ
And if they break their oaths after their treaty and defame your religion, then fight the leaders of disbelief,
4.2-Lamaza(لَمَزَ): To find flaws in others. To keep finding flaws in someone and to backbite about the person for that purpose in order to get hold of their weaknesses. And to follow that with making them the target of taunts and jibes. And meaning to unfairly accuse someone.
Allah(swt) says in the Quran:
Surah At-Tawbah-The Repentance(9:79)
الَّذِينَ يَلْمِزُونَ الْمُطَّوِّعِينَ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ فِي الصَّدَقَاتِ
Those who criticize the contributors among the believers concerning [their] charities
4.3-Hamaza(هَمَزَ): Meaning to pinch, prod or backbite. And Haamaz(هامز) meaning a person who finds faults in others. And Hammaz(هَمَّاز) meaning a person who finds faults and taunts others. And Hamazaatish shayateen(هَمَزَاتِ الشَّياطِين) meaning the stirring up and whispers of shaytan. Haamiz(هَامِز) meaning someone who mocks while backbiting about someone and hamaza(هَمَزَ) meaning to indicate with one's eyes. To cut. To beat up and backbite. And hamz-al-fars meaning to spur on a horse.
Surah Al-Qalam [68:11]
هَمَّازٍ مَّشَّاءٍ بِنَمِيمٍ
[And] scorner, going about with malicious gossip -
Summary:
1)Ta'ana: To present the weakness or flaw of a person in such a way that it hurts him like a pointy object.
2)Lamaza: To unjustly mock someone's action
3)Hamaza: To mock someone through gestures

title: content/TA/TA5.html
raw_text:
5-Tawq daalna (to put a shackle)
Synonyms:Tawwaqa, Ghalla
5.1-Tawwaqa(طَوَّقَ): Tawq(طوق) refers to all those things that have a circular appearance. And tawq meaning a necklet. Anything that encircles. Atwaaq(اطوَاق) (plural) Thus tawq is a necklace, jewellery of the neck, noose around the neck. A band of iron around the neck. And ittawwaq-al-hayyah(اِطَّوَّقَ الحَيَّه) meaning the way a snake sits attentively. And tawwaqa meaning to make someone wear a tawq.
Allah (swt) says:
Surah 'Ali 'Imran-Family of Imran (3:180)
سَيُطَوَّقُونَ مَا بَخِلُوا بِهِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ۗ
Their necks will be encircled by what they withheld on the Day of Resurrection.
5.2-Ghulla(غُلّ): (plural aghlaal) This word is more common than tawq.
Ghull refers to all those things with which a person's body parts are shackled and bound in the middle. And it refers to handcuffs, anklecuffs(shackles) and tawq (neck shackle). Ghalla meaning to put on handcuffs or iron collar.
Allah (swt) says:
Surah Al-Haqqah-The Reality(69:30-31)
خُذُوهُ فَغُلُّوهُ
ثُمَّ الْجَحِيمَ صَلُّوهُ
[ Allah will say], "Seize him and shackle him.
Then into Hellfire drive him.

title: content/TA/TA6.html
raw_text:
6- Tamaa'a rakhna (to have greed)
Synonyms: Tamaa'a, Harasa, Shuhha
6.1-Tamaa'a(طَمَعَ): To have a powerful anticipation/desire in one's heart for something. Have a strong expectation.
Allah (swt) says:
Surah Al-Muddaththir-The Cloaked One (74:14-15)
وَمَهَّدتُّ لَهُ تَمْهِيدًا
ثُمَّ يَطْمَعُ أَنْ أَزِيدَ
And spread [everything] before him, easing [his life].
Then he desires that I should add more.
6.2-Hirs(حِرص): When the expectation or affinity for a thing reaches great heights, it is known as hirs. Whether it is for one's own good or someone else's. Greed.
It is mentioned in the Quran:
Surah An-Nahl-The Bee(16:37)
إِن تَحْرِصْ عَلَىٰ هُدَاهُمْ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِي مَن يُضِلُّ ۖ
[Even] if you should strive for their guidance, [O Muhammad], indeed, Allah does not guide those He sends astray
6.4-Shuhh(شُحّ): Shahha(شَحَّ) meaning stinginess and greediness. And Ash-sheeh(اَلشِّيح) and Ash-shihaah(اَلشِّحَاح) meaning miser. Coveter that is Shahha has two simultaneous qualities:
i)Greed for acquisition of wealth
ii)Reluctance in spending that wealth
Stinginess and covetousness are two of the worst qualities.
It is said in the Quran:
Surah Al-Ahzab-The Combined Forces (33:19)
بِأَلْسِنَةٍ حِدَادٍ أَشِحَّةً عَلَى الْخَيْرِ ۚ
But when fear departs, they lash you with sharp tongues, indisposed toward [any] good.
In another place, Allah (swt) says:Surah Al-Hashr(59:9)
وَمَن يُوقَ شُحَّ نَفْسِهِ فَأُولَٰئِكَ هُمُ الْمُفْلِحُونَ
And whoever is protected from the stinginess of his soul - it is those who will be the successful.
Summary  :
1)Tamaa'a: To have a powerful desire in one's heart for something.
2)Hirs: When the desire becomes extreme, then it is called hirs.
3)When stinginess is added to the desire for wealth, it is known as shuhha.

It is said in the Quran:

Surah Al-Ahzab-The Combined Forces (33:19)
بِأَلْسِنَةٍ حِدَادٍ أَشِحَّةً عَلَى الْخَيْرِ ۚ
But when fear departs, they lash you with sharp tongues, indisposed toward [any] good.

In another place, Allah (swt) says:Surah Al-Hashr(59:9)
وَمَن يُوقَ شُحَّ نَفْسِهِ فَأُولَٰئِكَ هُمُ الْمُفْلِحُونَ
And whoever is protected from the stinginess of his soul - it is those who will be the successful.



Summary:
1)Tamaa'a: To have a powerful desire in one's heart for something.
2)Hirs: When the desire becomes extreme, then it is called hirs.
3)When stinginess is added to the desire for wealth, it is known as shuhha.

title: content/TA/TA7.html
raw_text:
7- Tay kerna (To go a certain distance)
Synonyms: 'Abara, Qataa'a
7.1-'Abara(عَبَرَ): The basic meaning is to cross a body of water. Whether it is by swimming, some means of transport or by a bridge and 'Abrunnahr(عَبرُ النَّهر) refers to that corner of a stream from where you can cross it. And 'Abar-al-'aeyn(عَبَرَ العَين) meaning the flow of tears. And al-'abaraat(العَبَرَات) means tears. Then it started being used to refer to going the distance of all kinds of paths, whether the way had water or not.
Allah (swt) says:
Surah An-Nisa' (4:43)
وَلَا جُنُبًا إِلَّا عَابِرِي سَبِيلٍ حَتَّىٰ تَغْتَسِلُوا ۚ وَإِن كُنتُم مَّرْضَىٰ أَوْ عَلَىٰ سَفَرٍ أَوْ جَاءَ أَحَدٌ مِّنكُم مِّنَ الْغَائِطِ أَوْ لَامَسْتُمُ النِّسَاءَ فَلَمْ تَجِدُوا مَاءً فَتَيَمَّمُوا صَعِيدًا طَيِّبًا فَامْسَحُوا بِوُجُوهِكُمْ وَأَيْدِيكُمْ
...do not approach prayer while you are intoxicated until you know what you are saying or in a state of janabah, except those passing through [a place of prayer], until you have washed [your whole body]. And if you are ill or on a journey or one of you comes from the place of relieving himself or you have contacted women and find no water, then seek clean earth and wipe over your faces and your hands [with it].
7.2-Qataa'a(قَطَعَ): Basically means to cut and separate. And qataa'-an-nahr(قَطَعَ النَّهر) means to cross a stream. Qata'a-as-sabeel(قَطَعَ السَّبِيل) means mugging (on the way). And qata'a-al-waadi(قطع الوادى) meaning to cross a field or ground. And qata'a-al-amr(قطع العمر) means to decide a schedule for completing a task. Thus this word is more common that 'abara in reference to crossing a distance.
Allah (swt) says:
Surah At-Taubah-The Repentance (9:121)
-وَلَا يَقْطَعُونَ وَادِيًا إِلَّا كُتِبَ لَهُمْ
... or cross a valley but that it is registered for them...
And in another place:
Surah An-Naml-The Ant (27:32)
مَا كُنتُ قَاطِعَةً أَمْرًا حَتَّىٰ تَشْهَدُونِ
"...I would not decide a matter until you witness [for] me."
Summary:
The word 'abara is used to mean to cross a way or especially a body of water and qataa'a is used to refer to decide matters and to cross boundaries of land.

raw_text:
To become evident (Zahir hona) ظ – ظاہر ہونا   [  p631-633]
Synonyms:
ظَهَر, جَهْرً, بَدَا, عُثِرَ, تَّبَيَّن,حَصْحَصَ, تَجَلَّى, شُرَّعًا
1. ظَهَرَ : back, rear, external, outward, apparent.   Opposite of بطن which means stomach, internal.
Example: ظَهَرَ الْفَسَادُ فِي الْبَرِّ وَالْبَحْرِ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ أَيْدِي النَّاسِ
Corruption has appeared throughout the land and sea by [reason of] what the hands of people have earned. [Ar-Rum 30:41]
ظَهَر is also used in literal meanings. Example: قُلْ إِنَّمَا حَرَّمَ رَبِّيَ الْفَوَاحِشَ مَا ظَهَرَ مِنْهَا وَمَا بَطَنَ
Say, "My Lord has only forbidden immoralities - what is apparent of them and what is concealed. [Al-Araf 7:33]
2. جَهْرً : openly, visibly  . Example: وَإِذْ قُلْتُمْ يَا مُوسَىٰ لَن نُّؤْمِنَ لَكَ حَتَّىٰ نَرَى اللَّهَ جَهْرَةً
And [recall] when you said, "O Moses, we will never believe you until we see Allah outright" [Al-Baqarah 2:55]
جَهْرً is usually used to express a loud voice. جَهْری salah is when the imam recites in a loud voice, in Fajr, Maghrib and Isha. It’s opposite is سرّی, where the imam recites in a low voice.
Example: لَّا يُحِبُّ اللَّهُ الْجَهْرَ بِالسُّوءِ مِنَ الْقَوْلِ إِلَّا مَن ظُلِمَ
Allah does not like the public mention of evil except by one who has been wronged. [An-Nisa 4:148]
3. بَدَا : To become apparent without the consent of anyone.
Example: بَلْ بَدَا لَهُم مَّا كَانُوا يُخْفُونَ مِن قَبْلُ
But what they concealed before has [now] appeared to them. [Al-An’am: 6:28]
Example 2: بَدَتْ لَهُمَا سَوْآتُهُمَا وَطَفِقَا يَخْصِفَانِ عَلَيْهِمَا مِن وَرَقِ الْجَنَّةِ
“…their private parts became apparent to them, and they began to fasten together over themselves from the leaves of Paradise.” [Al-Ar’af 7:22]
بَدَا is also used in literal meanings. Example: ثُمَّ بَدَا لَهُم مِّن بَعْدِ مَا رَأَوُا الْآيَاتِ لَيَسْجُنُنَّهُ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ
Then it appeared to them after they had seen the signs that al-'Azeez should surely imprison him for a time. [Yusuf 12:35]
4. عُثِرَ: To slip and fall.   عُثِرَ shall mean “to become visible” when someone is lying and tells the truth by mistake, and therefore the truth becomes ‘visible’.
Example: فَإِنْ عُثِرَ عَلَىٰ أَنَّهُمَا اسْتَحَقَّا إِثْمًا
But if it is found that those two were guilty of perjury… [Al-Maidah 5:107]
5. تَّبَيَّن and استبان : بان means to become visible in comparison to another thing  . تَّبَيَّن is used in the same meaning.
Example: قَد تَّبَيَّنَ الرُّشْدُ مِنَ الْغَيِّ
The right course has become clear from the wrong. [Al-Baqarah 2:256]
Example 2: وَلِتَسْتَبِينَ سَبِيلُ الْمُجْرِمِينَ
and [thus] the way of the criminals will become evident. [Al-An’am 6:56]
6. حَصْحَصَ : to become clear, when the truth gets out.
Example: قَالَتِ امْرَأَتُ الْعَزِيزِ الْآنَ حَصْحَصَ الْحَقُّ أَنَا رَاوَدتُّهُ عَن نَّفْسِهِ
The wife of al-'Azeez said, "Now the truth has become evident. It was I who sought to seduce him [Yusuf 12:51]
7. تَجَلَّىٰ : A bright and beautiful thing becoming evident.
Example: فَلَمَّا تَجَلَّىٰ رَبُّهُ لِلْجَبَلِ جَعَلَهُ دَكًّا
But when his Lord appeared to the mountain, He rendered it level [Al-Ar’af 7:143]
8. شُرَّعًا : شرع means to become visible openly  . It is phrased شرع البعیر عنقھ, which means that the camel raised his neck visibly.
Example: إِذْ تَأْتِيهِمْ حِيتَانُهُمْ يَوْمَ سَبْتِهِمْ شُرَّعًا
…when their fish came to them openly on their sabbath day.. [Al-Ar’af 7:163]
Summary:   ظَهَر, جَهْرً, بَدَا, عُثِرَ, تَّبَيَّن,حَصْحَصَ, تَجَلَّى, شُرَّعًا
1. ظَهَر : to become visibly apparent.
2. جَهْرً : To speak loudly or announce. Usually used to express sound.
3. بَدَا : To become apparent without the consent of anyone.
4. عُثِرَ: truth coming out mistakenly.
5. تَّبَيَّن : When separation, distance and clearness are present.
6. حَصْحَصَ : truth becoming evident after not being compelled to hide the truth anymore.
7. تَجَلَّى : Something bright and beautiful becoming evident.
8. شُرَّعًا : to become visible openly.

title: content/ZA/ZA2.html
raw_text:
To reveal  ظاہر کرنا – ۲
Synonyms:
اظھر from ظھر, ابدا from بدا, اعثر from عثر, جھر and اعلن
The first four synonyms have already been defined above (in previous entry). Examples are as follows:
1.اظھر :
فَلَا يُظْهِرُ عَلَىٰ غَيْبِهِ أَحَدًا
He does not disclose His [knowledge of the] unseen to anyone. [Al-Jinn 72:26]
2. ابدا :
وَأَعْلَمُ مَا تُبْدُونَ وَمَا كُنتُمْ تَكْتُمُونَ
And I know what you reveal and what you have concealed. [Al-Baqarah 2:33]
3. اعثر :
وَكَذَٰلِكَ أَعْثَرْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ لِيَعْلَمُوا أَنَّ وَعْدَ اللَّهِ حَقٌّ
We caused them to be found that they [who found them] would know that the promise of Allah is truth.. [Al-Kahf 18:21]
4. جھر :
وَأَسِرُّوا قَوْلَكُمْ أَوِ اجْهَرُوا بِهِ ۖ إِنَّهُ عَلِيمٌ بِذَاتِ الصُّدُورِ
And conceal your speech or publicize it; indeed, He is Knowing of that within the breasts. [Al-Mulk 67:13]
5. اعلن : (opposite of اسر  ) To express something.   Rarely used for body language. Verbal expression is not compulsory either.
Example: وَاللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ مَا تُسِرُّونَ وَمَا تُعْلِنُونَ
And Allah knows what you conceal and what you declare. [An-Nahl 16:19]
علانیۃ ,ظاہر، شُرَّعًا are used for “zaahir” (to reveal). All have been explained above.
ظلم کرنا - to do injustice (see بے انصافی کرنا)

title: Mutaradifatul Qur'aan - about
raw_text:
Mutaradifatul Qur'aan - about      How to use QuranSynonyms
QuranSynonyms.com is the first effort in the English language in getting the synonyms of the Quran and compiling their meanings onto one site, so we can see why Allah (  azza wa jal  ) spoke to us one word over another in the Qur’an, and what subtlety was being implied in the Quranic word which was chosen.
QuranSynonyms relation to Picturesque Arabic:
Arabic is an extremely visual language, so every word and sentence should be imagined as a picture. This is how you will understand the Quran the best. Every word will show you an image in your mind, and we hope to bring these images to life in your imagination   inshaa Allah   to inspire your relationship with Allah’s book in new and awesome ways.
Your job will be to visually look at the meanings of words and the examples we have given with them to imagine the image which Allah is portraying in your mind. We will now tell you how you can do this.
QuranSynonyms is layed out in the following structure  :
1 – Quran   Ayah   (Arabic).
2 – A   simple translation   of the meaning of that ayah.
3 – The   Meanings   of the words in that ayah in-depth.
4 –   Antonyms   – the opposite meaning of the word (of  step 3)
5 –   Synonyms   – words which are similar to the words (of  step 3).
3 -   The indepth Meanings  : of the words in the Quran has not been focused in the English language before, when this is infact the most miraculous aspect of the Quranic language! QuranSynonyms  wants to show you the word meaning in every ayah, and the picture associated with it so the image comes to life in your mind.
4 –   Antonyms  : To enhance your understanding of the meaning of the word, Antonyms have been added because   ‘words are known by their opposites.’   You can only know the color white because you have seen the colour black, the same goes for Arabic words. We want you to see the black and the white, so you can get a clear overview of why Allah chose one word especially.
(Example:  Fasaad generally means Corruption, so what is its antonym? It is SulH which generally means ‘to make Peace.’ But we go beyond this, the root meaning of SulH is actually ‘to Connect two broken separated things/people together.’ With knowledge of the Antonym, we’ve figured that Fasaad (Corruption) is mainly to break people and things apart.)
5 –   Synonyms  :  Words in Arabic are different shades of meaning. Since every word is a visual graphic picture, you wonder why one word is chosen especially compared to other words similar to it.
Example: Flowing water - there are different types of flowing of water, some being violent while others being light and dribbling, Arabic has a word for each of these concepts. We show you the comparison between all these Synonym words so you can see why Allah described and chose this word specifically.
More & more examples:
We hope to provide you examples as ‘QuranGems’ to help you visualise so the vision becomes even more empowered in your mind, and your experience with the Quran is enriched.
For more details on the project, or to contact us    click here   .
You can    download all content    for offline use!
All the translations are stored alphabatically in Content folder.
Thanks to Allah swt & Jazakallah khair to all the countless volunteers without whose efforts this project wouldn't have taken off the ground.
Special tip of the hat to    http://www.linguisticmiracle.com/   .
Please pray that Allah swt accept these humble efforts from everyone involved. Salaam! :-D

4 – Antonyms – the opposite meaning of the word (of  step 3)

5 – Synonyms – words which are similar to the words (of  step 3).

3 - The indepth Meanings: of the words in the Quran has not been focused in the English language before, when this is infact the most miraculous aspect of the Quranic language! QuranSynonyms  wants to show you the word meaning in every ayah, and the picture associated with it so the image comes to life in your mind.

4 – Antonyms: To enhance your understanding of the meaning of the word, Antonyms have been added because ‘words are known by their opposites.’ You can only know the color white because you have seen the colour black, the same goes for Arabic words. We want you to see the black and the white, so you can get a clear overview of why Allah chose one word especially.

(Example:  Fasaad generally means Corruption, so what is its antonym? It is SulH which generally means ‘to make Peace.’ But we go beyond this, the root meaning of SulH is actually ‘to Connect two broken separated things/people together.’ With knowledge of the Antonym, we’ve figured that Fasaad (Corruption) is mainly to break people and things apart.)

5 – Synonyms:  Words in Arabic are different shades of meaning. Since every word is a visual graphic picture, you wonder why one word is chosen especially compared to other words similar to it.

Example: Flowing water - there are different types of flowing of water, some being violent while others being light and dribbling, Arabic has a word for each of these concepts. We show you the comparison between all these Synonym words so you can see why Allah described and chose this word specifically.

More & more examples:

We hope to provide you examples as ‘QuranGems’ to help you visualise so the vision becomes even more empowered in your mind, and your experience with the Quran is enriched.

For more details on the project, or to contact us click here.

You can download all content for offline use!

All the translations are stored alphabatically in Content folder.

Thanks to Allah swt & Jazakallah khair to all the countless volunteers without whose efforts this project wouldn't have taken off the ground.

Special tip of the hat to http://www.linguisticmiracle.com/.

Please pray that Allah swt accept these humble efforts from everyone involved. Salaam! :-D

title: Mutaradifatul Qur'aan - appendices

Mutaradifatul Qur'aan - appendices      Summary of the Appendices in the book  . These span from page 905 - 1008
The subappendices mentioned are not a complete list but a sample of what  is covered. A few of these appendices I believe will be of special interest to people studying the balaghah "eloquence" of the arabic language. Translating these can be a secondary task - or a separate project altogether.
Appendices
1- Appendix 1
All proper nouns appearing in the Quran
Sub Appendices
a- Prophetsd and Messageners
b- Angels
c- Places
d- Mountains
2- Appendix 2
All common nouns appearing in the Quran without synonyms
Sub Appendices
a- Animals
b- Body Parts
etc.
3- Appendix 3
Antonyms
Subappendices
a- Words which carry a meaning and its antonyms meaning according to the context
b- Words in which the change of a single letter causes the meaning to be changed to its antonym
c- Common words and their antonyms (the one we translated)
4- Appendix 4
Verbs that have a different meaning by changing the "Ain Kalima" (i.e. central letter of the root) or a letter in the "masdar"
5- Appendix 5
Miscellaneous
Subappendices
a- Some Proverbs
b- Words which have a different meaning by changing the "harkat/tashkeel/fatha damma, kasra" of the "fa Kalima" of a word

Sects or Religions which are mentioned in the Quran are as follows

Surat Al-Ĥaj (The Pilgrimage) - سورة الحج
22:78
وَجَاهِدُوا فِي اللَّهِ حَقَّ جِهَادِهِ ۚ هُوَ اجْتَبَاكُمْ وَمَا جَعَلَ عَلَيْكُمْ فِي الدِّينِ مِنْ حَرَجٍ ۚ مِّلَّةَ أَبِيكُمْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ۚ   هُوَ سَمَّاكُمُ الْمُسْلِمِينَ مِن قَبْلُ وَفِي هَٰذَا   لِيَكُونَ الرَّسُولُ شَهِيدًا عَلَيْكُمْ وَتَكُونُوا شُهَدَاءَ عَلَى النَّاسِ ۚ فَأَقِيمُوا الصَّلَاةَ وَآتُوا الزَّكَاةَ وَاعْتَصِمُوا بِاللَّهِ هُوَ مَوْلَاكُمْ ۖ فَنِعْمَ الْمَوْلَىٰ وَنِعْمَ النَّصِيرُ
And strive for Allah with the striving due to Him. He has chosen you and has not placed upon you in the religion any difficulty. [It is] the religion of your father, Abraham.   Allah named you "Muslims" before [in former scriptures] and in this [revelation]   that the Messenger may be a witness over you and you may be witnesses over the people. So establish prayer and give zakah and hold fast to Allah . He is your protector; and excellent is the protector, and excellent is the helper.
2 MU-MINIYN(مُؤمِنِيْن)  :when Islam becomes fixed/hold strong roots in the heart then it is called IYMAN(ايمان)faith and one having faith is called MWMN(مومن). This difference is mentioned by the Quran as:
Surat Al-Ĥujurāt (The Rooms) - سورة الحجرات
49:14
قَالَتِ الْأَعْرَابُ آمَنَّا ۖ قُل لَّمْ تُؤْمِنُوا وَلَٰكِن قُولُوا أَسْلَمْنَا وَلَمَّا يَدْخُلِ الْإِيمَانُ فِي قُلُوبِكُمْ   ۖ وَإِن تُطِيعُوا اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ لَا يَلِتْكُم مِّنْ أَعْمَالِكُمْ شَيْئًا ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
The bedouins say, "We have believed." Say, "You have not [yet] believed; but say [instead], 'We have submitted,' for faith has not yet entered your hearts  . And if you obey Allah and His Messenger, He will not deprive you from your deeds of anything. Indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful."
so ,actually IYMAN is the next grade/level of ISLAM and Muslims then becomes MU-MIN
3 KUFFAR(كُفّار)  :Every such person which discard the call of any prophet or messenger and denies it is a KAFIR(كافر) and KFR(كفر) meaning to deny whether one belongs to any religion. In the Quran:
Surat Al-Baqarah (The Cow) - سورة البقرة
2:6
إِنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا سَوَاءٌ عَلَيْهِمْ أَأَنذَرْتَهُمْ أَمْ لَمْ تُنذِرْهُمْ   لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
Indeed, those who disbelieve - it is all the same for them whether you warn them or do not warn them   - they will not believe.
4 MUNAFIQIYN( مُنافِقِيْن)  : such people that apparently accepts Islam yet in their heart remain KFR and their sympathies are with the Disbelievers. are called MUNAFIQIYN. Such a group comes in to existence to reap some social and economical benefits. and It formed when some Movement is progressing and nurturing. thus in Makkan life there doesn't exist MUNAFIQIYN.
When Islam established in Medina life then this group also came in to existence. This group utilize guile and deception thus is worst than disbelievers. ALLAH said
Surat An-Nisā' (The Women) - سورة النساء
4:145
إِنَّ الْمُنَافِقِينَ فِي الدَّرْكِ الْأَسْفَلِ مِنَ النَّارِ   وَلَن تَجِدَ لَهُمْ نَصِيرًا
Indeed, the hypocrites will be in the lowest depths of the Fire   - and never will you find for them a helper -
5 MUSHRIKIYN(مُشْرِكِيْن)  :Those people who thinks that apart from one GOD ALLAH, there are other entities that can cause benefit or loss . and in worship whether physical or by wealth or by tongue ,they share other(to be worshipped) as well. whether these others are living for e.g prophets,pious,elders ,angels or jinn etc or non living for e.g idols,moon,sun,false god and false goddesses. are called MUSHRIKIYN. and those people can be in any sect even Muslims and Mu-min can also be MUSHRIK. ALLAH said
Surat Yūsuf (Joseph) - سورة يوسف
12:106
وَمَا يُؤْمِنُ أَكْثَرُهُم بِاللَّهِ إِلَّا وَهُم مُّشْرِكُونَ
And most of them believe not in Allah except while they associate others with Him.
6 YAHUWDIY(يَهُوْدِي)  : HADA(هَادَ) means to return softly,slowly slowly and also to be a jew.
and HAWWADA(هَوَّدَ) meaning to make someone jew. YAHUD(يهود) means followers of Moses (AS). When reciting Torah slowly slowly and sway is what caused them to be called YAHUDI(يهودي). and as per some people's opinion it relates to the son of Israel (AS) named YAHUDA(يهودا). This nation was initially extremely coward but then when they start consuming usury then they also become hard hearted. The more ALLAH showered HIS favours upon them the more they denied those favour. till they are declared MUGHDOOB 3LAYHIM(مغضوب عليهم) in front of ALLAH. They were arch nemesis in the early stage of Islam and till today they are on this promenade.
7 NASARA(نصارَي)  :Followers of Jesus(PBUH) and the book which was revealed to him i.e Bible.There are two reason for this name. one that Jesus(PBUH) was born in NASRAH(ناصره) so he was called MESSIAH NASIRI(مسيح ناصري). so his followers are called NASARA. second that the followers of Jesus(PBUH) declare themselves as
Surat 'Āli `Imrān (Family of Imran) - سورة آل عمران
3:52
فَلَمَّا أَحَسَّ عِيسَىٰ مِنْهُمُ الْكُفْرَ قَالَ مَنْ أَنصَارِي إِلَى اللَّهِ ۖ قَالَ الْحَوَارِيُّونَ   نَحْنُ أَنصَارُ اللَّهِ   آمَنَّا بِاللَّهِ وَاشْهَدْ بِأَنَّا مُسْلِمُونَ
But when Jesus felt [persistence in] disbelief from them, he said, "Who are my supporters for [the cause of] Allah ?" The disciples said,"   We are supporters for Allah   . We have believed in Allah and testify that we are Muslims [submitting to Him].
so these people are called NASARA. Now a days they are called Christians. Their attributes and behaviour are better in comparison with jews. In the prophetic era their sympathies are with Muslims.and they were less harmful compared to jews. ALLAH said
Surat Al-Mā'idah (The Table Spread) - سورة المائدة
5:82
لَتَجِدَنَّ أَشَدَّ النَّاسِ عَدَاوَةً لِّلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا الْيَهُودَ وَالَّذِينَ أَشْرَكُوا ۖ وَلَتَجِدَنَّ أَقْرَبَهُم مَّوَدَّةً لِّلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا الَّذِينَ قَالُوا إِنَّا نَصَارَىٰ   ۚ ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ مِنْهُمْ قِسِّيسِينَ وَرُهْبَانًا وَأَنَّهُمْ لَا يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ
You will surely find the most intense of the people in animosity toward the believers [to be] the Jews and those who associate others with Allah ; and you will find the nearest of them in affection to the believers those who say, "We are Christians."   That is because among them are priests and monks and because they are not arrogant.

Fire worshippers and Sun worshippers who claime them to be the followers of Noah(PBUH) and are enemy of all other prophets. Their concept is that god of good and god of evil are separate. meaning there are two gods. god of good or creator is YAZDAN( يزدان) and god of evil or its creator is AHERMAN(اهرمن). these people give names of their revealed books as CAND and AVESTA
9 SABIEIN(صَابِئِيْن)  :SABA-(صَبَأَ) star worshippers sect which put ABRAHAM(PBUH) in fire. they also self proclaimed followers of Noah (PBUH). and also deniers of all other prophets. Later on SABA- was used for changing religion or to reject forefathers's religion. and it becomes a bad name. like that person become a SABY(صابي) meaning he become without religion or apostate. ALLAH said
Surat Al-Ĥaj (The Pilgrimage) - سورة الحج
22:17
إِنَّ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَالَّذِينَ هَادُوا وَالصَّابِئِينَ وَالنَّصَارَىٰ وَالْمَجُوسَ وَالَّذِينَ أَشْرَكُوا إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَفْصِلُ بَيْنَهُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ۚ   إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ شَهِيدٌ
Indeed, those who have believed and those who were Jews and the Sabeans and the Christians and the Magians and those who associated with Allah - Allah will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection.   Indeed Allah is, over all things, Witness.

8 MAJUWS( مجوس)[ Zoroastrian]: MJS(مجس) (singular MAJUSI مجوسي) and MAJJS(مجّس) meaning to make some one MAJUSI. and TAMAJJAS(تمجّس) meaning to become MAJUSI. Fire worshippers and Sun worshippers who claime them to be the followers of Noah(PBUH) and are enemy of all other prophets. Their concept is that god of good and god of evil are separate. meaning there are two gods. god of good or creator is YAZDAN( يزدان) and god of evil or its creator is AHERMAN(اهرمن). these people give names of their revealed books as CAND and AVESTA

9 SABIEIN(صَابِئِيْن):SABA-(صَبَأَ) star worshippers sect which put ABRAHAM(PBUH) in fire. they also self proclaimed followers of Noah (PBUH). and also deniers of all other prophets. Later on SABA- was used for changing religion or to reject forefathers's religion. and it becomes a bad name. like that person become a SABY(صابي) meaning he become without religion or apostate. ALLAH said

Surat Al-Ĥaj (The Pilgrimage) - سورة الحج

22:17

إِنَّ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَالَّذِينَ هَادُوا وَالصَّابِئِينَ وَالنَّصَارَىٰ وَالْمَجُوسَ وَالَّذِينَ أَشْرَكُوا إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَفْصِلُ بَيْنَهُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ شَهِيدٌ

Indeed, those who have believed and those who were Jews and the Sabeans and the Christians and the Magians and those who associated with Allah - Allah will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection. Indeed Allah is, over all things, Witness.

--------------------------------------------End of 10 Sect or Religion ----------------page 931------------------------

11 3BADAAT AUR SHAR3Y ISTALAHAT
[ Acts of Devotion and Religious Terminology ]
There are five pillars of Islam. among them the first is shahadah by which a person enters Islam. the remaining four pillars are comprised of acts of devotion.All of them and their brief descriptions are mentioned in the Holy Quran. and they are SALAH( صَلوة), ZAKAH(زَكوة),SAUWM(صَوْم) and HAJJ(حجّ). and these words are used in the Quran as Religious Terminology. Which means that complete meaning and understanding of these words can only be obtained from the Sunnah(sayings and teachings,actions ) of Prophet Muhammad (PBUH). Lexicon will be unable to solve this knot.
1 SALAH: people of lexicon gives its meaning as to pray for someone and to applause and bless. and SALLA(صَلّي) meaning to offer prayer. In the Holy Quran , its command came nearly 700 times yet it neither mentions the count of daily prayers nor the units of prayers and nor the method of prayer and nor the details of the timing of prayers. From Quran ,one knows of only 3 prayers and their times. at forenoon, in the evening and at the time of dawn. Also mentioned the middle prayer was mentioned but it is not explained as which one is it. though mention of congregational prayer is in abundance. for this the term AQAMAT ASSALAH(اقامت الصّلوة) is used. before the mention of offering prayer was mentioned the mandatory acts of Purification and Ablution. and of pillars of Prayer i.e Bowing,Standing, Prostration.
RAKA3(ركع) literally means to bow, but in terminology it means to bow the back in a peculiar and known form in prayer which also includes the element of humbless and humility. from RAKA3 is derived the word RAKA3AT(ركعت) the unit of prayer. which means that this is the most important of pillar of prayer. furthermore this word is used in the Quran for complete prayer. ALLAH said
Surat Al-Baqarah (The Cow) - سورة البقرة
2:43
وَأَقِيمُوا الصَّلَاةَ وَآتُوا الزَّكَاةَ وَارْكَعُوا مَعَ الرَّاكِعِينَ
And establish prayer and give zakah and bow with those who bow [in worship and obedience].
SAJADA(سَجَدَ): literally means to show humility and humbleness.and in that meaning every thing of this universe prostrate in front of ALLAH. but in Religious terminology it means a peculiar and known form of sitting and placing forehead and nose on the ground. like bowing ,prostration is also an important part of prayer . ALLAH said
Surat Al-Fatĥ (The Victory) - سورة الفتح
48:29
مُّحَمَّدٌ رَّسُولُ اللَّهِ ۚ وَالَّذِينَ مَعَهُ أَشِدَّاءُ عَلَى الْكُفَّارِ رُحَمَاءُ بَيْنَهُمْ ۖ   تَرَاهُمْ رُكَّعًا سُجَّدًا يَبْتَغُونَ فَضْلًا مِّنَ اللَّهِ وَرِضْوَانًا ۖ   سِيمَاهُمْ فِي وُجُوهِهِم مِّنْ أَثَرِ السُّجُودِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ مَثَلُهُمْ فِي التَّوْرَاةِ ۚ وَمَثَلُهُمْ فِي الْإِنجِيلِ كَزَرْعٍ أَخْرَجَ شَطْأَهُ فَآزَرَهُ فَاسْتَغْلَظَ فَاسْتَوَىٰ عَلَىٰ سُوقِهِ يُعْجِبُ الزُّرَّاعَ لِيَغِيظَ بِهِمُ الْكُفَّارَ ۗ وَعَدَ اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ مِنْهُم مَّغْفِرَةً وَأَجْرًا عَظِيمًا
Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah ; and those with him are forceful against the disbelievers, merciful among themselves.   You see them bowing and prostrating [in prayer], seeking bounty from Allah and [His] pleasure.   Their mark is on their faces from the trace of prostration. That is their description in the Torah. And their description in the Gospel is as a plant which produces its offshoots and strengthens them so they grow firm and stand upon their stalks, delighting the sowers - so that Allah may enrage by them the disbelievers. Allah has promised those who believe and do righteous deeds among them forgiveness and a great reward.
in addition to appointed known prayers.in the Quran also mentioned Prayer of Traveller(SALAT UL QASR صلوة قصر) and Prayer of Fear SALAT ALKHAWF(صلوة الخوف) during war. and Prayer for Deceased and Night Prayer. and SALAH is used in the QURAN in four meanings 1) for the appointed prayers 2) for the prayer of the deceased in which there is no bowing and prostration only standing. ALLAH said:
Surat At-Tawbah (The Repentance) - سورة التوبة
9:84
وَلَا تُصَلِّ عَلَىٰ أَحَدٍ مِّنْهُم مَّاتَ أَبَدًا   وَلَا تَقُمْ عَلَىٰ قَبْرِهِ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَفَرُوا بِاللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ وَمَاتُوا وَهُمْ فَاسِقُونَ
And do not pray [the funeral prayer, O Muhammad], over any of them who has died - ever   - or stand at his grave. Indeed, they disbelieved in Allah and His Messenger and died while they were defiantly disobedient.
3) only in the meaning of supplication as said
Surat At-Tawbah (The Repentance) - سورة التوبة
9:103
خُذْ مِنْ أَمْوَالِهِمْ صَدَقَةً تُطَهِّرُهُمْ وَتُزَكِّيهِم بِهَا   وَصَلِّ عَلَيْهِمْ ۖ إِنَّ صَلَاتَكَ سَكَنٌ لَّهُمْ ۗ   وَاللَّهُ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ
Take, [O, Muhammad], from their wealth a charity by which you purify them and cause them increase,   and invoke [ Allah 's blessings] upon them. Indeed, your invocations are reassurance for them. And Allah is Hearing and Knowing  .
4) if SALAH relates to ALLAH then it means to bestow blessings .ALLAH said
Surat Al-'Aĥzāb (The Combined Forces) - سورة الأحزاب
33:56
إِنَّ اللَّهَ وَمَلَائِكَتَهُ يُصَلُّونَ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ ۚ   يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا صَلُّوا عَلَيْهِ وَسَلِّمُوا تَسْلِيمًا
Indeed, Allah confers blessing upon the Prophet, and His angels [ask Him to do so]  . O you who have believed, ask [ Allah to confer] blessing upon him and ask [ Allah to grant him] peace.
2 ZAKAH  :(alms giving)literally means to grow, to increase, to nurture. and in religious terminology it means that part of one's excess of wealth that is made mandatory by religion to give charity in the way of ALLAH . ZAKAH was mentioned nearly 70 times in the Quran but details of Wealth on which Zakah is applicable,Measure/Qualification of Zakah and Explaination of Zakah is not mentioned. this is only found in the Sunnah of Prophet (PBUH). Zakah is also called SADQAH(صدقة) in the Quran. and its the responsibility of an Islamic state that it receives Zakah from the qualifying people to where it must be spend in the permissble usage of Zakah.
ALLAH said
Surat At-Tawbah (The Repentance) - سورة التوبة
9:103
خُذْ مِنْ أَمْوَالِهِمْ صَدَقَةً   تُطَهِّرُهُمْ وَتُزَكِّيهِم بِهَا وَصَلِّ عَلَيْهِمْ ۖ إِنَّ صَلَاتَكَ سَكَنٌ لَّهُمْ ۗ وَاللَّهُ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ
Take, [O, Muhammad], from their wealth a charity   by which you purify them and cause them increase, and invoke [ Allah 's blessings] upon them. Indeed, your invocations are reassurance for them. And Allah is Hearing and Knowing.
SAQDAH can be voluntarily or mandatory. Zakah is the other name of mandatory charity. In this ayah   خُذْ   implies this charity to be mandatory i.e Zakah. also proven from this word is that receiving Zakah and establishing a system of Zakah is responsibility of Isamic Government.
Zakah is an act of devotion by wealth and is the third most important pillar of Islam after prayer. yet in act of devotion by wealth, also includes voluntary charity,and penalty for some sins, sacrifice and votive offering. votive offering is that SADQAH which a person conditioned on oneself to be mandatory(Vow) then it becomes mandatory to fullfill it. and sacrifice (especially on the occassion of Eid Ul Azha) is mandatory on all who are capable.
3 SAUWM  : literally means to stop from doing something and to abstain. for e.g a horse who doesn't eat feed or abstain from movement is also called SAIM(صائم) but in religious terminology SAMA(صَامَ) means to fast whose complete rules are mentioned in the Prophetic Sunnah. In Quran only this much is mentioned that
Surat Al-Baqarah (The Cow) - سورة البقرة
2:187
أُحِلَّ لَكُمْ لَيْلَةَ الصِّيَامِ الرَّفَثُ إِلَىٰ نِسَائِكُمْ ۚ هُنَّ لِبَاسٌ لَّكُمْ وَأَنتُمْ لِبَاسٌ لَّهُنَّ ۗ عَلِمَ اللَّهُ أَنَّكُمْ كُنتُمْ تَخْتَانُونَ أَنفُسَكُمْ فَتَابَ عَلَيْكُمْ وَعَفَا عَنكُمْ ۖ فَالْآنَ بَاشِرُوهُنَّ وَابْتَغُوا مَا كَتَبَ اللَّهُ لَكُمْ ۚ   وَكُلُوا وَاشْرَبُوا حَتَّىٰ يَتَبَيَّنَ لَكُمُ الْخَيْطُ الْأَبْيَضُ مِنَ الْخَيْطِ الْأَسْوَدِ مِنَ الْفَجْرِ ۖ ثُمَّ أَتِمُّوا الصِّيَامَ إِلَى اللَّيْلِ   ۚ وَلَا تُبَاشِرُوهُنَّ وَأَنتُمْ عَاكِفُونَ فِي الْمَسَاجِدِ ۗ تِلْكَ حُدُودُ اللَّهِ فَلَا تَقْرَبُوهَا ۗ كَذَٰلِكَ يُبَيِّنُ اللَّهُ آيَاتِهِ لِلنَّاسِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَّقُونَ
It has been made permissible for you the night preceding fasting to go to your wives [for sexual relations]. They are clothing for you and you are clothing for them. Allah knows that you used to deceive yourselves, so He accepted your repentance and forgave you. So now, have relations with them and seek that which Allah has decreed for you.   And eat and drink until the white thread of dawn becomes distinct to you from the black thread [of night]. Then complete the fast until the sunset.   And do not have relations with them as long as you are staying for worship in the mosques. These are the limits [set by] Allah , so do not approach them. Thus does Allah make clear His ordinances to the people that they may become righteous.
A3TAKAF(اعتكاف): AKF(عكف) literally means to stop and in that meaning it is used in the Quran
Surat Al-Fatĥ (The Victory) - سورة الفتح
48:25
هُمُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا وَصَدُّوكُمْ عَنِ الْمَسْجِدِ الْحَرَامِ   وَالْهَدْيَ مَعْكُوفًا أَن يَبْلُغَ مَحِلَّهُ   ۚ وَلَوْلَا رِجَالٌ مُّؤْمِنُونَ وَنِسَاءٌ مُّؤْمِنَاتٌ لَّمْ تَعْلَمُوهُمْ أَن تَطَئُوهُمْ فَتُصِيبَكُم مِّنْهُم مَّعَرَّةٌ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ ۖ لِّيُدْخِلَ اللَّهُ فِي رَحْمَتِهِ مَن يَشَاءُ ۚ لَوْ تَزَيَّلُوا لَعَذَّبْنَا الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا مِنْهُمْ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًا
They are the ones who disbelieved and obstructed you from al-Masjid al-Haram   while the offering was prevented from reaching its place of sacrifice  . And if not for believing men and believing women whom you did not know - that you might trample them and there would befall you because of them dishonor without [your] knowledge - [you would have been permitted to enter Makkah]. [This was so] that Allah might admit to His mercy whom He willed. If they had been apart [from them], We would have punished those who disbelieved among them with painful punishment
and in religious terminology AL3KWF(العكوف) means to concentrate on something out of respect and to associate with it and A3TAKAF means to stay in the mosque with the intention of worship and not to go out.
There is a deep relation between fasting and A3TAKAF. A3TAKAF is FARD KIFAYA(الفرض الكفاية) by Shariah in every mosque in the month of fasting's last 10 days. and ALLAH has also mentioned A3TAKAF along with Fasting in the aforementioned ayah. yet fasting and A3TAKAF are not complementary to each other. A3TAKAF can be done without fasting and also in other times apart from the month of fasting. and like from point of view of purification of soul , A3TAKAF has a special relation with fasting. likewise from point of view of mosque , A3TAKAF has a special relation with the House of ALLAH (كعبه), ALLAH said
Surat Al-Baqarah (The Cow) - سورة البقرة
2:125
وَإِذْ جَعَلْنَا الْبَيْتَ مَثَابَةً لِّلنَّاسِ وَأَمْنًا وَاتَّخِذُوا مِن مَّقَامِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ مُصَلًّى ۖ   وَعَهِدْنَا إِلَىٰ إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَإِسْمَاعِيلَ أَن طَهِّرَا بَيْتِيَ لِلطَّائِفِينَ وَالْعَاكِفِينَ وَالرُّكَّعِ السُّجُودِ
And [mention] when We made the House a place of return for the people and [a place of] security. And take, [O believers], from the standing place of Abraham a place of prayer.   And We charged Abraham and Ishmael, [saying], "Purify My House for those who perform Tawaf and those who are staying [there] for worship and those who bow and prostrate [in prayer]."
as A3TAKAF is also a worship, thus MUSHRIKIN used to share their worship by directing it to idols. Quran mentioned
Surat Al-'A`rāf (The Heights) - سورة الأعراف
7:138
وَجَاوَزْنَا بِبَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ الْبَحْرَ فَأَتَوْا عَلَىٰ قَوْمٍ يَعْكُفُونَ عَلَىٰ أَصْنَامٍ لَّهُمْ   ۚ قَالُوا يَا مُوسَى اجْعَل لَّنَا إِلَٰهًا كَمَا لَهُمْ آلِهَةٌ ۚ قَالَ إِنَّكُمْ قَوْمٌ تَجْهَلُونَ
And We took the Children of Israel across the sea; then they came upon a people intent in devotion to [some] idols of theirs  . They said, "O Moses, make for us a god just as they have gods." He said, "Indeed, you are a people behaving ignorantly.
4 HAJJ: meaning to make intention or aim for pilgrimage. and HAJJ BANU FALANIN FALANAN(حجّ بنو فلانٍ فلاناً) meaning 'tribe A has travelled to and from B alot'. HAJAJTU FALANAN(حَجَجْتُ فلاناً) meaning ' I went to A many a times repeatedly' . ans as HAJJ comes once a year so from HAJJ is ISM MARA (إسم مره)[Noun of Once] HAJJATUN(حَجَّةٌ) meaning Year, (plural is HIJAJ حِجَجَ ) . and in religious terminology intention of AQAMAT NASAK(اقامت نسك) [Establishing sacrifice ]by aiming for Baitullah is HAJJ. The Month of the year in which Hajj is performed is ZUL HAJJA( ذو الحجّة). HAJJ is also a pillar of Islam. and Its mandatory once in a life time for capable person. ALLAH said
Surat 'Āli `Imrān (Family of Imran) - سورة آل عمران
3:97
فِيهِ آيَاتٌ بَيِّنَاتٌ مَّقَامُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ۖ وَمَن دَخَلَهُ كَانَ آمِنًا ۗ   وَلِلَّهِ عَلَى النَّاسِ حِجُّ الْبَيْتِ مَنِ اسْتَطَاعَ إِلَيْهِ سَبِيلًا ۚ   وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ غَنِيٌّ عَنِ الْعَالَمِينَ
In it are clear signs [such as] the standing place of Abraham. And whoever enters it shall be safe.   And [due] to Allah from the people is a pilgrimage to the House - for whoever is able to find thereto a way  . But whoever disbelieves - then indeed, Allah is free from need of the worlds.
3UMRAH(عُمرة) as per one of the narration is called HAJJ ASGHAR(حج اصغر) [Small Hajj]
in it there exist circumambulation and the rapidly walking seven times back and forth between the hills of Safa and Marwah. It doesn't include sacrifice, overnight stay in Mina, Stay in 3RAFAH. then also 3UMRAH can be done in every season and at all times. In its comparison is HAJJ AKBAR(حج اكبر). and YUM ALHAJJ ALAKBAR(يوم إلحج إلاكبر) means YUM NAHR(
يوم نحر) or YUM 3RFAH(يوم عرفة) and I3TAMARA( اِعْتَمَرَ) means to do 3UMRAH. ALLAH said
Surat Al-Baqarah (The Cow) - سورة البقرة
2:158
إِنَّ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةَ مِن شَعَائِرِ اللَّهِ ۖ   فَمَنْ حَجَّ الْبَيْتَ أَوِ اعْتَمَرَ فَلَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيْهِ أَن يَطَّوَّفَ بِهِمَا   ۚ وَمَن تَطَوَّعَ خَيْرًا فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ شَاكِرٌ عَلِيمٌ
Indeed, as-Safa and al-Marwah are among the symbols of Allah .   So whoever makes Hajj to the House or performs 'umrah - there is no blame upon him for walking between them.   And whoever volunteers good - then indeed, Allah is appreciative and Knowing.
TAWAF(طَوَاف):meaning to circle around something and go round.and TA-IF(طائف) is that watchman which circles at night for security. and in religious terminology TAWAF is those circumambulation which are performed during Hajj or 3umrah and even apart from them of House of ALLAH. This type of worship is specific to only House of ALLAH but mushrikin have included in this worship for some graves and shrine. ALLAH said
Surat Al-Ĥaj (The Pilgrimage) - سورة الحج
22:29
ثُمَّ لْيَقْضُوا تَفَثَهُمْ وَلْيُوفُوا نُذُورَهُمْ وَلْيَطَّوَّفُوا بِالْبَيْتِ الْعَتِيقِ
Then let them end their untidiness and fulfill their vows and perform Tawaf around the ancient House."
For QURBANI[Sacrifice] see QURBANI KA JANWAR [Sacrificial Animal]
