1 SALAH: people of lexicon gives its meaning as to pray for someone and to applause and bless. and SALLA(صَلّي) meaning to offer prayer. In the Holy Quran , its command came nearly 700 times yet it neither mentions the count of daily prayers nor the units of prayers and nor the method of prayer and nor the details of the timing of prayers. From Quran ,one knows of only 3 prayers and their times. at forenoon, in the evening and at the time of dawn. Also mentioned the middle prayer was mentioned but it is not explained as which one is it. though mention of congregational prayer is in abundance. for this the term AQAMAT ASSALAH(اقامت الصّلوة) is used. before the mention of offering prayer was mentioned the mandatory acts of Purification and Ablution. and of pillars of Prayer i.e Bowing,Standing, Prostration.

RAKA3(ركع) literally means to bow, but in terminology it means to bow the back in a peculiar and known form in prayer which also includes the element of humbless and humility. from RAKA3 is derived the word RAKA3AT(ركعت) the unit of prayer. which means that this is the most important of pillar of prayer. furthermore this word is used in the Quran for complete prayer. ALLAH said

Surat Al-Baqarah (The Cow) - سورة البقرة

2:43

وَأَقِيمُوا الصَّلَاةَ وَآتُوا الزَّكَاةَ وَارْكَعُوا مَعَ الرَّاكِعِينَ

And establish prayer and give zakah and bow with those who bow [in worship and obedience].

SAJADA(سَجَدَ): literally means to show humility and humbleness.and in that meaning every thing of this universe prostrate in front of ALLAH. but in Religious terminology it means a peculiar and known form of sitting and placing forehead and nose on the ground. like bowing ,prostration is also an important part of prayer . ALLAH said

Surat Al-Fatĥ (The Victory) - سورة الفتح

48:29

مُّحَمَّدٌ رَّسُولُ اللَّهِ ۚ وَالَّذِينَ مَعَهُ أَشِدَّاءُ عَلَى الْكُفَّارِ رُحَمَاءُ بَيْنَهُمْ ۖ تَرَاهُمْ رُكَّعًا سُجَّدًا يَبْتَغُونَ فَضْلًا مِّنَ اللَّهِ وَرِضْوَانًا ۖ سِيمَاهُمْ فِي وُجُوهِهِم مِّنْ أَثَرِ السُّجُودِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ مَثَلُهُمْ فِي التَّوْرَاةِ ۚ وَمَثَلُهُمْ فِي الْإِنجِيلِ كَزَرْعٍ أَخْرَجَ شَطْأَهُ فَآزَرَهُ فَاسْتَغْلَظَ فَاسْتَوَىٰ عَلَىٰ سُوقِهِ يُعْجِبُ الزُّرَّاعَ لِيَغِيظَ بِهِمُ الْكُفَّارَ ۗ وَعَدَ اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ مِنْهُم مَّغْفِرَةً وَأَجْرًا عَظِيمًا

Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah ; and those with him are forceful against the disbelievers, merciful among themselves. You see them bowing and prostrating [in prayer], seeking bounty from Allah and [His] pleasure. Their mark is on their faces from the trace of prostration. That is their description in the Torah. And their description in the Gospel is as a plant which produces its offshoots and strengthens them so they grow firm and stand upon their stalks, delighting the sowers - so that Allah may enrage by them the disbelievers. Allah has promised those who believe and do righteous deeds among them forgiveness and a great reward.

in addition to appointed known prayers.in the Quran also mentioned Prayer of Traveller(SALAT UL QASR صلوة قصر) and Prayer of Fear SALAT ALKHAWF(صلوة الخوف) during war. and Prayer for Deceased and Night Prayer. and SALAH is used in the QURAN in four meanings 1) for the appointed prayers 2) for the prayer of the deceased in which there is no bowing and prostration only standing. ALLAH said:

Surat At-Tawbah (The Repentance) - سورة التوبة

9:84

وَلَا تُصَلِّ عَلَىٰ أَحَدٍ مِّنْهُم مَّاتَ أَبَدًا وَلَا تَقُمْ عَلَىٰ قَبْرِهِ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَفَرُوا بِاللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ وَمَاتُوا وَهُمْ فَاسِقُونَ

And do not pray [the funeral prayer, O Muhammad], over any of them who has died - ever - or stand at his grave. Indeed, they disbelieved in Allah and His Messenger and died while they were defiantly disobedient.

3) only in the meaning of supplication as said

Surat At-Tawbah (The Repentance) - سورة التوبة

9:103

خُذْ مِنْ أَمْوَالِهِمْ صَدَقَةً تُطَهِّرُهُمْ وَتُزَكِّيهِم بِهَا وَصَلِّ عَلَيْهِمْ ۖ إِنَّ صَلَاتَكَ سَكَنٌ لَّهُمْ ۗ وَاللَّهُ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ

Take, [O, Muhammad], from their wealth a charity by which you purify them and cause them increase, and invoke [ Allah 's blessings] upon them. Indeed, your invocations are reassurance for them. And Allah is Hearing and Knowing.

4) if SALAH relates to ALLAH then it means to bestow blessings .ALLAH said

Surat Al-'Aĥzāb (The Combined Forces) - سورة الأحزاب

33:56

إِنَّ اللَّهَ وَمَلَائِكَتَهُ يُصَلُّونَ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ ۚ يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا صَلُّوا عَلَيْهِ وَسَلِّمُوا تَسْلِيمًا

Indeed, Allah confers blessing upon the Prophet, and His angels [ask Him to do so]. O you who have believed, ask [ Allah to confer] blessing upon him and ask [ Allah to grant him] peace.

2 ZAKAH:(alms giving)literally means to grow, to increase, to nurture. and in religious terminology it means that part of one's excess of wealth that is made mandatory by religion to give charity in the way of ALLAH . ZAKAH was mentioned nearly 70 times in the Quran but details of Wealth on which Zakah is applicable,Measure/Qualification of Zakah and Explaination of Zakah is not mentioned. this is only found in the Sunnah of Prophet (PBUH). Zakah is also called SADQAH(صدقة) in the Quran. and its the responsibility of an Islamic state that it receives Zakah from the qualifying people to where it must be spend in the permissble usage of Zakah.

ALLAH said

Surat At-Tawbah (The Repentance) - سورة التوبة

9:103

خُذْ مِنْ أَمْوَالِهِمْ صَدَقَةً تُطَهِّرُهُمْ وَتُزَكِّيهِم بِهَا وَصَلِّ عَلَيْهِمْ ۖ إِنَّ صَلَاتَكَ سَكَنٌ لَّهُمْ ۗ وَاللَّهُ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ

Take, [O, Muhammad], from their wealth a charity by which you purify them and cause them increase, and invoke [ Allah 's blessings] upon them. Indeed, your invocations are reassurance for them. And Allah is Hearing and Knowing.

SAQDAH can be voluntarily or mandatory. Zakah is the other name of mandatory charity. In this ayah خُذْ implies this charity to be mandatory i.e Zakah. also proven from this word is that receiving Zakah and establishing a system of Zakah is responsibility of Isamic Government.

Zakah is an act of devotion by wealth and is the third most important pillar of Islam after prayer. yet in act of devotion by wealth, also includes voluntary charity,and penalty for some sins, sacrifice and votive offering. votive offering is that SADQAH which a person conditioned on oneself to be mandatory(Vow) then it becomes mandatory to fullfill it. and sacrifice (especially on the occassion of Eid Ul Azha) is mandatory on all who are capable.

3 SAUWM: literally means to stop from doing something and to abstain. for e.g a horse who doesn't eat feed or abstain from movement is also called SAIM(صائم) but in religious terminology SAMA(صَامَ) means to fast whose complete rules are mentioned in the Prophetic Sunnah. In Quran only this much is mentioned that

Surat Al-Baqarah (The Cow) - سورة البقرة

2:187

أُحِلَّ لَكُمْ لَيْلَةَ الصِّيَامِ الرَّفَثُ إِلَىٰ نِسَائِكُمْ ۚ هُنَّ لِبَاسٌ لَّكُمْ وَأَنتُمْ لِبَاسٌ لَّهُنَّ ۗ عَلِمَ اللَّهُ أَنَّكُمْ كُنتُمْ تَخْتَانُونَ أَنفُسَكُمْ فَتَابَ عَلَيْكُمْ وَعَفَا عَنكُمْ ۖ فَالْآنَ بَاشِرُوهُنَّ وَابْتَغُوا مَا كَتَبَ اللَّهُ لَكُمْ ۚ وَكُلُوا وَاشْرَبُوا حَتَّىٰ يَتَبَيَّنَ لَكُمُ الْخَيْطُ الْأَبْيَضُ مِنَ الْخَيْطِ الْأَسْوَدِ مِنَ الْفَجْرِ ۖ ثُمَّ أَتِمُّوا الصِّيَامَ إِلَى اللَّيْلِ ۚ وَلَا تُبَاشِرُوهُنَّ وَأَنتُمْ عَاكِفُونَ فِي الْمَسَاجِدِ ۗ تِلْكَ حُدُودُ اللَّهِ فَلَا تَقْرَبُوهَا ۗ كَذَٰلِكَ يُبَيِّنُ اللَّهُ آيَاتِهِ لِلنَّاسِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَّقُونَ

It has been made permissible for you the night preceding fasting to go to your wives [for sexual relations]. They are clothing for you and you are clothing for them. Allah knows that you used to deceive yourselves, so He accepted your repentance and forgave you. So now, have relations with them and seek that which Allah has decreed for you. And eat and drink until the white thread of dawn becomes distinct to you from the black thread [of night]. Then complete the fast until the sunset. And do not have relations with them as long as you are staying for worship in the mosques. These are the limits [set by] Allah , so do not approach them. Thus does Allah make clear His ordinances to the people that they may become righteous.

A3TAKAF(اعتكاف): AKF(عكف) literally means to stop and in that meaning it is used in the Quran

Surat Al-Fatĥ (The Victory) - سورة الفتح

48:25

هُمُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا وَصَدُّوكُمْ عَنِ الْمَسْجِدِ الْحَرَامِ وَالْهَدْيَ مَعْكُوفًا أَن يَبْلُغَ مَحِلَّهُ ۚ وَلَوْلَا رِجَالٌ مُّؤْمِنُونَ وَنِسَاءٌ مُّؤْمِنَاتٌ لَّمْ تَعْلَمُوهُمْ أَن تَطَئُوهُمْ فَتُصِيبَكُم مِّنْهُم مَّعَرَّةٌ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ ۖ لِّيُدْخِلَ اللَّهُ فِي رَحْمَتِهِ مَن يَشَاءُ ۚ لَوْ تَزَيَّلُوا لَعَذَّبْنَا الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا مِنْهُمْ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًا

They are the ones who disbelieved and obstructed you from al-Masjid al-Haram while the offering was prevented from reaching its place of sacrifice. And if not for believing men and believing women whom you did not know - that you might trample them and there would befall you because of them dishonor without [your] knowledge - [you would have been permitted to enter Makkah]. [This was so] that Allah might admit to His mercy whom He willed. If they had been apart [from them], We would have punished those who disbelieved among them with painful punishment

and in religious terminology AL3KWF(العكوف) means to concentrate on something out of respect and to associate with it and A3TAKAF means to stay in the mosque with the intention of worship and not to go out.

There is a deep relation between fasting and A3TAKAF. A3TAKAF is FARD KIFAYA(الفرض الكفاية) by Shariah in every mosque in the month of fasting's last 10 days. and ALLAH has also mentioned A3TAKAF along with Fasting in the aforementioned ayah. yet fasting and A3TAKAF are not complementary to each other. A3TAKAF can be done without fasting and also in other times apart from the month of fasting. and like from point of view of purification of soul , A3TAKAF has a special relation with fasting. likewise from point of view of mosque , A3TAKAF has a special relation with the House of ALLAH (كعبه), ALLAH said

Surat Al-Baqarah (The Cow) - سورة البقرة

2:125

وَإِذْ جَعَلْنَا الْبَيْتَ مَثَابَةً لِّلنَّاسِ وَأَمْنًا وَاتَّخِذُوا مِن مَّقَامِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ مُصَلًّى ۖ وَعَهِدْنَا إِلَىٰ إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَإِسْمَاعِيلَ أَن طَهِّرَا بَيْتِيَ لِلطَّائِفِينَ وَالْعَاكِفِينَ وَالرُّكَّعِ السُّجُودِ

And [mention] when We made the House a place of return for the people and [a place of] security. And take, [O believers], from the standing place of Abraham a place of prayer. And We charged Abraham and Ishmael, [saying], "Purify My House for those who perform Tawaf and those who are staying [there] for worship and those who bow and prostrate [in prayer]."

as A3TAKAF is also a worship, thus MUSHRIKIN used to share their worship by directing it to idols. Quran mentioned

Surat Al-'A`rāf (The Heights) - سورة الأعراف

7:138

وَجَاوَزْنَا بِبَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ الْبَحْرَ فَأَتَوْا عَلَىٰ قَوْمٍ يَعْكُفُونَ عَلَىٰ أَصْنَامٍ لَّهُمْ ۚ قَالُوا يَا مُوسَى اجْعَل لَّنَا إِلَٰهًا كَمَا لَهُمْ آلِهَةٌ ۚ قَالَ إِنَّكُمْ قَوْمٌ تَجْهَلُونَ

And We took the Children of Israel across the sea; then they came upon a people intent in devotion to [some] idols of theirs. They said, "O Moses, make for us a god just as they have gods." He said, "Indeed, you are a people behaving ignorantly.

4 HAJJ: meaning to make intention or aim for pilgrimage. and HAJJ BANU FALANIN FALANAN(حجّ بنو فلانٍ فلاناً) meaning 'tribe A has travelled to and from B alot'. HAJAJTU FALANAN(حَجَجْتُ فلاناً) meaning ' I went to A many a times repeatedly' . ans as HAJJ comes once a year so from HAJJ is ISM MARA (إسم مره)[Noun of Once] HAJJATUN(حَجَّةٌ) meaning Year, (plural is HIJAJ حِجَجَ ) . and in religious terminology intention of AQAMAT NASAK(اقامت نسك) [Establishing sacrifice ]by aiming for Baitullah is HAJJ. The Month of the year in which Hajj is performed is ZUL HAJJA( ذو الحجّة). HAJJ is also a pillar of Islam. and Its mandatory once in a life time for capable person. ALLAH said

Surat 'Āli `Imrān (Family of Imran) - سورة آل عمران

3:97

فِيهِ آيَاتٌ بَيِّنَاتٌ مَّقَامُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ۖ وَمَن دَخَلَهُ كَانَ آمِنًا ۗ وَلِلَّهِ عَلَى النَّاسِ حِجُّ الْبَيْتِ مَنِ اسْتَطَاعَ إِلَيْهِ سَبِيلًا ۚ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ غَنِيٌّ عَنِ الْعَالَمِينَ

In it are clear signs [such as] the standing place of Abraham. And whoever enters it shall be safe. And [due] to Allah from the people is a pilgrimage to the House - for whoever is able to find thereto a way. But whoever disbelieves - then indeed, Allah is free from need of the worlds.

3UMRAH(عُمرة) as per one of the narration is called HAJJ ASGHAR(حج اصغر) [Small Hajj]

in it there exist circumambulation and the rapidly walking seven times back and forth between the hills of Safa and Marwah. It doesn't include sacrifice, overnight stay in Mina, Stay in 3RAFAH. then also 3UMRAH can be done in every season and at all times. In its comparison is HAJJ AKBAR(حج اكبر). and YUM ALHAJJ ALAKBAR(يوم إلحج إلاكبر) means YUM NAHR(

يوم نحر) or YUM 3RFAH(يوم عرفة) and I3TAMARA( اِعْتَمَرَ) means to do 3UMRAH. ALLAH said

Surat Al-Baqarah (The Cow) - سورة البقرة

2:158

إِنَّ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةَ مِن شَعَائِرِ اللَّهِ ۖ فَمَنْ حَجَّ الْبَيْتَ أَوِ اعْتَمَرَ فَلَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيْهِ أَن يَطَّوَّفَ بِهِمَا ۚ وَمَن تَطَوَّعَ خَيْرًا فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ شَاكِرٌ عَلِيمٌ

Indeed, as-Safa and al-Marwah are among the symbols of Allah . So whoever makes Hajj to the House or performs 'umrah - there is no blame upon him for walking between them. And whoever volunteers good - then indeed, Allah is appreciative and Knowing.

TAWAF(طَوَاف):meaning to circle around something and go round.and TA-IF(طائف) is that watchman which circles at night for security. and in religious terminology TAWAF is those circumambulation which are performed during Hajj or 3umrah and even apart from them of House of ALLAH. This type of worship is specific to only House of ALLAH but mushrikin have included in this worship for some graves and shrine. ALLAH said

Surat Al-Ĥaj (The Pilgrimage) - سورة الحج

22:29

ثُمَّ لْيَقْضُوا تَفَثَهُمْ وَلْيُوفُوا نُذُورَهُمْ وَلْيَطَّوَّفُوا بِالْبَيْتِ الْعَتِيقِ

Then let them end their untidiness and fulfill their vows and perform Tawaf around the ancient House."

12 ISM 3ADAD [Noun of Numbers]
Noun of Numbers are also a type of Proper Noun. Following are the Numbers and their derivatives mentioned in the Holy Quran. First see some example then their rules will be mentioned.
One
Surat Al-'Ikhlāş (The Sincerity) - سورة الإخلاص
112:1
قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ
Say, "He is Allah , [who is] One,
Surat Yūsuf (Joseph) - سورة يوسف
12:36
وَدَخَلَ مَعَهُ السِّجْنَ فَتَيَانِ ۖ  قَالَ أَحَدُهُمَا  إِنِّي أَرَانِي أَعْصِرُ خَمْرًا ۖ وَقَالَ الْآخَرُ إِنِّي أَرَانِي أَحْمِلُ فَوْقَ رَأْسِي خُبْزًا تَأْكُلُ الطَّيْرُ مِنْهُ ۖ نَبِّئْنَا بِتَأْوِيلِهِ ۖ إِنَّا نَرَاكَ مِنَ الْمُحْسِنِينَ
And there entered the prison with him two young men.  One of them said , "Indeed, I have seen myself [in a dream] pressing wine." The other said, "Indeed, I have seen myself carrying upon my head [some] bread, from which the birds were eating. Inform us of its interpretation; indeed, we see you to be of those who do good."
Surat Al-Baqarah (The Cow) - سورة البقرة
2:133
أَمْ كُنتُمْ شُهَدَاءَ إِذْ حَضَرَ يَعْقُوبَ الْمَوْتُ إِذْ قَالَ لِبَنِيهِ مَا تَعْبُدُونَ مِن بَعْدِي قَالُوا نَعْبُدُ إِلَٰهَكَ وَإِلَٰهَ آبَائِكَ إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَإِسْمَاعِيلَ وَإِسْحَاقَ  إِلَٰهًا وَاحِدًا  وَنَحْنُ لَهُ مُسْلِمُونَ
Or were you witnesses when death approached Jacob, when he said to his sons, "What will you worship after me?" They said, "We will worship your God and the God of your fathers, Abraham and Ishmael and Isaac -  one God . And we are Muslims [in submission] to Him."
Surat Ghāfir (The Forgiver) - سورة غافر
40:84
فَلَمَّا رَأَوْا بَأْسَنَا قَالُو ا آمَنَّا بِاللَّهِ وَحْدَهُ  وَكَفَرْنَا بِمَا كُنَّا بِهِ مُشْرِكِينَ
And when they saw Our punishment, they said,"  We believe in Allah alone  and disbelieve in that which we used to associate with Him."
Surat Al-Baqarah (The Cow) - سورة البقرة
2:213

Allah makes clear to you [His law], lest you go astray. And Allah is Knowing of all things.

And do not shave your heads until the sacrificial animal has reached its place of slaughter. And when you are secure, then whoever performs 'umrah [during the Hajj months] followed by Hajj [offers] what can be obtained with ease of sacrificial animals. Allah instructs you concerning your children: for the male, what is equal to the share of two females. But if there are [only] daughters, two or more, for them is two thirds of one's estate. And if there is only one, for her is half. And for one's parents, to each one of them is a sixth of his estate if he left children. But if he had no children and the parents [alone] inherit from him, then  for his mother is one third . And if he had brothers [or sisters], for his mother is a sixth, after any bequest he [may have] made or debt. Your parents or your children - you know not which of them are nearest to you in benefit. [These shares are] an obligation [imposed] by Allah . Indeed, Allah is ever Knowing and Wise.

They request from you a [legal] ruling. Say, " Allah gives you a ruling concerning one having neither descendants nor ascendants [as heirs]." If a man dies, leaving no child but [only] a sister, she will have half of what he left. And he inherits from her if she [dies and] has no child. But if there are two sisters [or more],  they will have two-thirds  of what he left. If there are both brothers and sisters, the male will have the share of two females. Allah makes clear to you [His law], lest you go astray. And Allah is Knowing of all things.

And for you is half of what your wives leave if they have no child. But if they have a child,  for you is one fourth  of what they leave, after any bequest they [may have] made or debt. 13 ISM ZAMEER [Pronouns]
Pronouns are also a type of proper noun.It represents assumed name and normally after it.Pronouns are of two types
MUSTATAR(مستتر)[hidden] and BAREZ(بارز)[visible] .
a) Mustatar   is that which are understood from verb and its different SIYGHA,صيغه
Side Note:[Corresponding Form of Verb for Particular Person(1st/ 2nd/3rd),Singularity/Plurality,Gender masculine/feminine,Tense Maadi/Mudaari] .
for e.g QALA(قَالَ) the pronoun is Singular,maculine,3rd person
and QULNA(قُلْنَ) the pronoun is plural,feminine,3rd person are MUSTATAR pronoun.
b)BAREZ   is that which is apparent from words and its further sub categorized as MUTTASIL(متصل)[attached] and MUNFASIL(منفصل)[detached].MUTTASIL is that which is attached to the word like KITABAKA LAHUMA BIHIM (كِتَابَكَ،لَهُمَا،بِهِمْ) etc . and MUNFASIL is that which exist as a separate word like HUWA HUMA HUM -- ANA NAHNU (هُوَ هُمَا هُم اَنَا نَحْنُ).Detached pronouns are used in the nominative state and attached pronouns are used in accusative and genitive state. In accusative state IYYA(اِيَّا) is prefixed to these pronouns to produce exclusivity in the speech. like IYYAHU(اِيَّاهُ) meaning 'only to that one man'. as in the Quran
Surat Al-Fātiĥah (The Opener) - سورة الفاتحة
1:5
إِيَّاكَ نَعْبُدُ وَإِيَّاكَ نَسْتَعِينُ
It is You we worship and You we ask for help.
for further details please refer to a grammar book.

14 ISM ISHARA [Demonstrative Noun/Pointing Noun]
In reality demonstrative nouns are ZA(ذَا) and ZANI( ذَانِ) etc.
these words are prefixed with HA(ها) and suffixed with K(ك) or LK(لك) transformed in the ISM ISHARA QAREEB(اسم اشاره قريب)[NEAR POINTING NOUNS] and ISM ISHARA BA3YD(اسم اشاره بعيد)[FAR POINTING NOUNS].for near pointing HAZA(هَذَا) is used. for Dual HAZAAN(هَذَانِ)and HAZYN(هَذَين) and for plural HAUWLAA-(هَؤُلَََاءِ) .see the examples
1- ISHARA QAREEB:
Singular Masculine
Surat Al-'Isrā' (The Night Journey) - سورة الإسراء
17:62
قَالَ   أَرَأَيْتَكَ هَٰذَا الَّذِي كَرَّمْتَ عَلَيَّ   لَئِنْ أَخَّرْتَنِ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ لَأَحْتَنِكَنَّ ذُرِّيَّتَهُ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا
[Iblees] said, "  Do You see this one whom You have honored above me?   If You delay me until the Day of Resurrection, I will surely destroy his descendants, except for a few."
Dual Masculine
Surat Ţāhā (Ta-Ha) - سورة طه
20:63
قَالُوا   إِنْ هَٰذَانِ لَسَاحِرَانِ   يُرِيدَانِ أَن يُخْرِجَاكُم مِّنْ أَرْضِكُم بِسِحْرِهِمَا وَيَذْهَبَا بِطَرِيقَتِكُمُ الْمُثْلَىٰ
They said, "  Indeed, these are two magicians   who want to drive you out of your land with their magic and do away with your most exemplary way.
Plural Masculine
Surat Al-'Anbyā' (The Prophets) - سورة الأنبياء
21:65
ثُمَّ نُكِسُوا عَلَىٰ رُءُوسِهِمْ   لَقَدْ عَلِمْتَ مَا هَٰؤُلَاءِ يَنطِقُونَ
Then they reversed themselves, [saying], "  You have already known that these do not speak  !"
and from HAZA ,feminine are HAZIHI(هَذِهِ),and from HAZAANIand HAZYN are HATAN(هاتان) and HATYN(هاتين). and in plural whether masculine or feminine in all cases HAUWLAA- is used for e.g
ISHARA QARYB :Singular Feminine
Surat Aţ-Ţūr (The Mount) - سورة الطور
52:14
هَٰذِهِ النَّارُ الَّتِي كُنتُم بِهَا تُكَذِّبُونَ
"This is the Fire which you used to deny.
2- ISHARA BA3YD  : for masculine singular ZAK(ذَاك) and ZALIKA(ذَلِكَ) for dual ZANIKA(ذَنِكَ) and ZAYNIKA(ذَيْنِكَ) and for plural masucline UWLAA-IKA(اُولئِكَ) are used. then if something is of high with respect to status and if that is near as well still ZALIKA is used for it for example.
Surat Al-Baqarah (The Cow) - سورة البقرة
2:2
ذَٰلِكَ الْكِتَابُ لَا رَيْبَ ۛ فِيهِ ۛ   هُدًى لِّلْمُتَّقِينَ
This is the Book about which there is no doubt  , a guidance for those conscious of Allah -
Surat Al-Qaşaş (The Stories) - سورة القصص
28:32
اسْلُكْ يَدَكَ فِي جَيْبِكَ تَخْرُجْ بَيْضَاءَ مِنْ غَيْرِ سُوءٍ وَاضْمُمْ إِلَيْكَ جَنَاحَكَ مِنَ الرَّهْبِ ۖ   فَذَانِكَ بُرْهَانَانِ مِن رَّبِّكَ   إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَئِهِ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا قَوْمًا فَاسِقِينَ
Insert your hand into the opening of your garment; it will come out white, without disease. And draw in your arm close to you [as prevention] from fear,   for those are two proofs from your Lord   to Pharaoh and his establishment. Indeed, they have been a people defiantly disobedient."
Surat Al-Baqarah (The Cow) - سورة البقرة
2:5
أُولَٰئِكَ عَلَىٰ هُدًى مِّن رَّبِّهِمْ   ۖ وَأُولَٰئِكَ هُمُ الْمُفْلِحُونَ
Those are upon [right] guidance from their Lord  , and it is those who are the successful.
for singular feminine TAKA(تَاكَ) or TILKA(تِلْكَ) , for dual TANIKA(تَانِكَ) or TAUNIKA(تَيْنِكَ) and for plural masculine/feminine both UWLAA-IKA is used for e.g
ISHARA BA3YD singular feminine
Surat Al-Baqarah (The Cow) - سورة البقرة
2:134
تِلْكَ أُمَّةٌ قَدْ خَلَتْ   ۖ لَهَا مَا كَسَبَتْ وَلَكُم مَّا كَسَبْتُمْ ۖ وَلَا تُسْأَلُونَ عَمَّا كَانُوا يَعْمَلُونَ
That was a nation which has passed on  . It will have [the consequence of] what it earned, and you will have what you have earned. And you will not be asked about what they used to do.
3 the real words of ISM ISHARA BA3YD i.e ZALIKA(ذَلِكَ) and TILKA(تِلْكَ)changed as per the 2nd person pronoun. but there is no change in the meaning for e.g.

2:2
ذَٰلِكَ الْكِتَابُ   لَا رَيْبَ ۛ فِيهِ ۛ هُدًى لِّلْمُتَّقِينَ
This is the Book   about which there is no doubt, a guidance for those conscious of Allah -
ZALIKUMA RABBIKUMA(ذَلِكُما رَبِّكُمَا) He is Lord of both of you
Surat Az-Zumar (The Troops) - سورة الزمر
39:6
خَلَقَكُم مِّن نَّفْسٍ وَاحِدَةٍ ثُمَّ جَعَلَ مِنْهَا زَوْجَهَا وَأَنزَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ الْأَنْعَامِ ثَمَانِيَةَ أَزْوَاجٍ ۚ يَخْلُقُكُمْ فِي بُطُونِ أُمَّهَاتِكُمْ خَلْقًا مِّن بَعْدِ خَلْقٍ فِي ظُلُمَاتٍ ثَلَاثٍ ۚ   ذَٰلِكُمُ اللَّهُ رَبُّكُمْ   لَهُ الْمُلْكُ ۖ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ فَأَنَّىٰ تُصْرَفُونَ
He created you from one soul. Then He made from it its mate, and He produced for you from the grazing livestock eight mates. He creates you in the wombs of your mothers, creation after creation, within three darknesses.   That is Allah , your Lord;   to Him belongs dominion. There is no deity except Him, so how are you averted?
Surat Yūsuf (Joseph) - سورة يوسف
12:32
قَالَتْ   فَذَٰلِكُنَّ الَّذِي لُمْتُنَّنِي فِيهِ   ۖ وَلَقَدْ رَاوَدتُّهُ عَن نَّفْسِهِ فَاسْتَعْصَمَ ۖ وَلَئِن لَّمْ يَفْعَلْ مَا آمُرُهُ لَيُسْجَنَنَّ وَلَيَكُونًا مِّنَ الصَّاغِرِينَ
She said, "  That is the one about whom you blamed me  . And I certainly sought to seduce him, but he firmly refused; and if he will not do what I order him, he will surely be imprisoned and will be of those debased."
Surat Al-'A`rāf (The Heights) - سورة الأعراف
7:22
فَدَلَّاهُمَا بِغُرُورٍ ۚ فَلَمَّا ذَاقَا الشَّجَرَةَ بَدَتْ لَهُمَا سَوْآتُهُمَا وَطَفِقَا يَخْصِفَانِ عَلَيْهِمَا مِن وَرَقِ الْجَنَّةِ ۖ وَنَادَاهُمَا رَبُّهُمَا   أَلَمْ أَنْهَكُمَا عَن تِلْكُمَا الشَّجَرَةِ   وَأَقُل لَّكُمَا إِنَّ الشَّيْطَانَ لَكُمَا عَدُوٌّ مُّبِينٌ
So he made them fall, through deception. And when they tasted of the tree, their private parts became apparent to them, and they began to fasten together over themselves from the leaves of Paradise. And their Lord called to them, "  Did I not forbid you from that tree   and tell you that Satan is to you a clear enemy?"

HAZA ZALIKA HAZIHI TILKA HAUWLAA- all got translated as "this". and KAZALIKA as "like this" or "as this".
5 HUNA(هُنا)   :(meaning here)used to point the time and place.yet mostly used for pointing place. and like ZA ZAKA and ZALIKA is HUNA HUNAKA(هُنَاكَ) and HUNALIKA(هُنَالِكَ) are used .ALLAH said

There, [on that Day], every soul will be put to trial for what it did previously,   and they will be returned to Allah , their master, the Truth, and lost from them is whatever they used to invent.

these words are prefixed with HA(ها) and suffixed with K(ك) or LK(لك) transformed in the ISM ISHARA QAREEB(اسم اشاره قريب)[NEAR POINTING NOUNS] and ISM ISHARA BA3YD(اسم اشاره بعيد)[FAR POINTING NOUNS].for near pointing HAZA(هَذَا) is used. for Dual HAZAAN(هَذَانِ)and HAZYN(هَذَين) and for plural HAUWLAA-(هَؤُلَََاءِ) .see the examples

1- ISHARA QAREEB:

Singular Masculine

Surat Al-'Isrā' (The Night Journey) - سورة الإسراء

17:62

قَالَ أَرَأَيْتَكَ هَٰذَا الَّذِي كَرَّمْتَ عَلَيَّ لَئِنْ أَخَّرْتَنِ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ لَأَحْتَنِكَنَّ ذُرِّيَّتَهُ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا

[Iblees] said, "Do You see this one whom You have honored above me? If You delay me until the Day of Resurrection, I will surely destroy his descendants, except for a few."

Dual Masculine

Surat Ţāhā (Ta-Ha) - سورة طه

20:63

قَالُوا إِنْ هَٰذَانِ لَسَاحِرَانِ يُرِيدَانِ أَن يُخْرِجَاكُم مِّنْ أَرْضِكُم بِسِحْرِهِمَا وَيَذْهَبَا بِطَرِيقَتِكُمُ الْمُثْلَىٰ

They said, "Indeed, these are two magicians who want to drive you out of your land with their magic and do away with your most exemplary way.

Plural Masculine

Surat Al-'Anbyā' (The Prophets) - سورة الأنبياء

21:65

ثُمَّ نُكِسُوا عَلَىٰ رُءُوسِهِمْ لَقَدْ عَلِمْتَ مَا هَٰؤُلَاءِ يَنطِقُونَ

Then they reversed themselves, [saying], "You have already known that these do not speak!"

and from HAZA ,feminine are HAZIHI(هَذِهِ),and from HAZAANIand HAZYN are HATAN(هاتان) and HATYN(هاتين). and in plural whether masculine or feminine in all cases HAUWLAA- is used for e.g

ISHARA QARYB :Singular Feminine

Surat Aţ-Ţūr (The Mount) - سورة الطور

52:14

هَٰذِهِ النَّارُ الَّتِي كُنتُم بِهَا تُكَذِّبُونَ

"This is the Fire which you used to deny.

2- ISHARA BA3YD: for masculine singular ZAK(ذَاك) and ZALIKA(ذَلِكَ) for dual ZANIKA(ذَنِكَ) and ZAYNIKA(ذَيْنِكَ) and for plural masucline UWLAA-IKA(اُولئِكَ) are used. then if something is of high with respect to status and if that is near as well still ZALIKA is used for it for example.

Surat Al-Baqarah (The Cow) - سورة البقرة

2:2

ذَٰلِكَ الْكِتَابُ لَا رَيْبَ ۛ فِيهِ ۛ هُدًى لِّلْمُتَّقِينَ

This is the Book about which there is no doubt, a guidance for those conscious of Allah -

Surat Al-Qaşaş (The Stories) - سورة القصص

28:32

اسْلُكْ يَدَكَ فِي جَيْبِكَ تَخْرُجْ بَيْضَاءَ مِنْ غَيْرِ سُوءٍ وَاضْمُمْ إِلَيْكَ جَنَاحَكَ مِنَ الرَّهْبِ ۖ فَذَانِكَ بُرْهَانَانِ مِن رَّبِّكَ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَئِهِ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا قَوْمًا فَاسِقِينَ

Insert your hand into the opening of your garment; it will come out white, without disease. And draw in your arm close to you [as prevention] from fear, for those are two proofs from your Lord to Pharaoh and his establishment. Indeed, they have been a people defiantly disobedient."

Surat Al-Baqarah (The Cow) - سورة البقرة

2:5

أُولَٰئِكَ عَلَىٰ هُدًى مِّن رَّبِّهِمْ ۖ وَأُولَٰئِكَ هُمُ الْمُفْلِحُونَ

Those are upon [right] guidance from their Lord, and it is those who are the successful.

for singular feminine TAKA(تَاكَ) or TILKA(تِلْكَ) , for dual TANIKA(تَانِكَ) or TAUNIKA(تَيْنِكَ) and for plural masculine/feminine both UWLAA-IKA is used for e.g

ISHARA BA3YD singular feminine

Surat Al-Baqarah (The Cow) - سورة البقرة

تِلْكَ أُمَّةٌ قَدْ خَلَتْ ۖ لَهَا مَا كَسَبَتْ وَلَكُم مَّا كَسَبْتُمْ ۖ وَلَا تُسْأَلُونَ عَمَّا كَانُوا يَعْمَلُونَ

That was a nation which has passed on. It will have [the consequence of] what it earned, and you will have what you have earned. And you will not be asked about what they used to do.

3 the real words of ISM ISHARA BA3YD i.e ZALIKA(ذَلِكَ) and TILKA(تِلْكَ)changed as per the 2nd person pronoun. but there is no change in the meaning for e.g.

Surat Al-Baqarah (The Cow) - سورة البقرة

2:2

ذَٰلِكَ الْكِتَابُ لَا رَيْبَ ۛ فِيهِ ۛ هُدًى لِّلْمُتَّقِينَ

This is the Book about which there is no doubt, a guidance for those conscious of Allah -

ZALIKUMA RABBIKUMA(ذَلِكُما رَبِّكُمَا) He is Lord of both of you

Surat Az-Zumar (The Troops) - سورة الزمر

39:6

خَلَقَكُم مِّن نَّفْسٍ وَاحِدَةٍ ثُمَّ جَعَلَ مِنْهَا زَوْجَهَا وَأَنزَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ الْأَنْعَامِ ثَمَانِيَةَ أَزْوَاجٍ ۚ يَخْلُقُكُمْ فِي بُطُونِ أُمَّهَاتِكُمْ خَلْقًا مِّن بَعْدِ خَلْقٍ فِي ظُلُمَاتٍ ثَلَاثٍ ۚ ذَٰلِكُمُ اللَّهُ رَبُّكُمْ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ ۖ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ فَأَنَّىٰ تُصْرَفُونَ

He created you from one soul. Then He made from it its mate, and He produced for you from the grazing livestock eight mates. He creates you in the wombs of your mothers, creation after creation, within three darknesses. That is Allah , your Lord; to Him belongs dominion. There is no deity except Him, so how are you averted?

Surat Yūsuf (Joseph) - سورة يوسف

12:32

قَالَتْ فَذَٰلِكُنَّ الَّذِي لُمْتُنَّنِي فِيهِ ۖ وَلَقَدْ رَاوَدتُّهُ عَن نَّفْسِهِ فَاسْتَعْصَمَ ۖ وَلَئِن لَّمْ يَفْعَلْ مَا آمُرُهُ لَيُسْجَنَنَّ وَلَيَكُونًا مِّنَ الصَّاغِرِينَ

She said, "That is the one about whom you blamed me. And I certainly sought to seduce him, but he firmly refused; and if he will not do what I order him, he will surely be imprisoned and will be of those debased."

Surat Al-'A`rāf (The Heights) - سورة الأعراف

7:22

فَدَلَّاهُمَا بِغُرُورٍ ۚ فَلَمَّا ذَاقَا الشَّجَرَةَ بَدَتْ لَهُمَا سَوْآتُهُمَا وَطَفِقَا يَخْصِفَانِ عَلَيْهِمَا مِن وَرَقِ الْجَنَّةِ ۖ وَنَادَاهُمَا رَبُّهُمَا أَلَمْ أَنْهَكُمَا عَن تِلْكُمَا الشَّجَرَةِ وَأَقُل لَّكُمَا إِنَّ الشَّيْطَانَ لَكُمَا عَدُوٌّ مُّبِينٌ

So he made them fall, through deception. And when they tasted of the tree, their private parts became apparent to them, and they began to fasten together over themselves from the leaves of Paradise. And their Lord called to them, "Did I not forbid you from that tree and tell you that Satan is to you a clear enemy?"

4 HAZA and ZALIKA are also used with the addition of K(ك) of like, for e.g HAKAZA(هَكَذَا) meaning 'like this' and KAZALIKA(كَذَالِكَ) meaning 'like that'but in urdu translation all these demonstrative nouns are translated as ISHARA QAREEB because in urdu in pointing there is no difference relative to dual,plural,masculine,feminine. HAZA ZALIKA HAZIHI TILKA HAUWLAA- all got translated as "this". and KAZALIKA as "like this" or "as this".

5 HUNA(هُنا) :(meaning here)used to point the time and place.yet mostly used for pointing place. and like ZA ZAKA and ZALIKA is HUNA HUNAKA(هُنَاكَ) and HUNALIKA(هُنَالِكَ) are used .ALLAH said

هُنَالِكَ تَبْلُو كُلُّ نَفْسٍ مَّا أَسْلَفَتْ ۚ وَرُدُّوا إِلَى اللَّهِ مَوْلَاهُمُ الْحَقِّ ۖ وَضَلَّ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا يَفْتَرُونَ

There, [on that Day], every soul will be put to trial for what it did previously, and they will be returned to Allah , their master, the Truth, and lost from them is whatever they used to invent.

on other place

فَغُلِبُوا هُنَالِكَ وَانقَلَبُوا صَاغِرِينَ

And Pharaoh and his people were overcome right there and became debased.

HUNA is prefixed with HA(ها) to limit it to place only meaning "this place" or "at this place". In the Quran

قَالُوا يَا مُوسَىٰ إِنَّا لَن نَّدْخُلَهَا أَبَدًا مَّا دَامُوا فِيهَا ۖ فَاذْهَبْ أَنتَ وَرَبُّكَ فَقَاتِلَا إِنَّا هَاهُنَا قَاعِدُونَ

They said, "O Moses, indeed we will not enter it, ever, as long as they are within it; so go, you and your Lord, and fight. Indeed, we are remaining right here."

8 PAHAAR,WADIYAAN AUR AMAKAN [Mountain,Valleys and Sites]
those mountains and fields or valleys whose name occur in the Holy Quran are as follows
1-2 SAFA(صفا ) and MARWAH(مروة)  : near House of ALLAH are two famous mountains.between those HAGAR to and fro 7 times in search of water. Nowadays those mountains are cutdown to get rid of the middle valley.only the signs of the mountains remain.Every pilgrim had to walk swiftly in between them as essential part of HAJJ and UMRAH
ALLAH said:
Surat Al-Baqarah (The Cow) - سورة البقرة
2:158
إِنَّ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةَ مِن شَعَائِرِ اللَّهِ ۖ   فَمَنْ حَجَّ الْبَيْتَ أَوِ اعْتَمَرَ فَلَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيْهِ أَن يَطَّوَّفَ بِهِمَا ۚ وَمَن تَطَوَّعَ خَيْرًا فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ شَاكِرٌ عَلِيمٌ
Indeed, as-Safa and al-Marwah are among the symbols of Allah   . So whoever makes Hajj to the House or performs 'umrah - there is no blame upon him for walking between them. And whoever volunteers good - then indeed, Allah is appreciative and Knowing.
2.JUDIYY( جُوْدِيّ)  :Noah's Storm continues,consecutively for 40 days. meaning it keeps raining and also earth keeps releasing water from beneath it. in the mean time Noah's Ark keep on gaining height continuously. and that time this storm came on all visible earth where there was population of mankind. later on when water start receding then it took 150 days for this process to complete. and when water start receding then Ark rest at Mount Judiyy. Judiyy is (   Mount Judi - Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia   ) one of the mountain of mountains of Ararat.and is famous with the same name. ALLAH said:
Surat Hūd (Hud) - سورة هود
11:44
وَقِيلَ يَا أَرْضُ ابْلَعِي مَاءَكِ وَيَا سَمَاءُ أَقْلِعِي وَغِيضَ الْمَاءُ وَقُضِيَ الْأَمْرُ وَاسْتَوَتْ عَلَى الْجُودِيِّ   ۖ وَقِيلَ بُعْدًا لِّلْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ
And it was said, "O earth, swallow your water, and O sky, withhold [your rain]." And the water subsided, and the matter was accomplished, and the ship came to rest on the [mountain of] Judiyy  . And it was said, "Away with the wrongdoing people."
4-6 SINA( سينا),SINAIN(سينين),TWR(طور) and TWY(طوي):   SINA and SINAIN are two names of one thing. SINA is a high mountain whose height is 7359 foot which is in the path between MADIAN and EGYPT in the country of SYRIA . At this place Moses(PBUH) was bestowed twice the opportunity to talk with ALLAH.One of the peak of this mountain is called TWR. and in the base of this mountain is a valley named TWY which is also called Holy Valley and Blessed place. When Moses (PBUH) took Children of Israel out of EGYPT then he went past this path. from this relation TWR Mountain is also called TWRI SINAIN(). ALLAH said
Surat At-Tīn (The Fig) - سورة التين
95:1
وَالتِّينِ وَالزَّيْتُونِ
By the fig and the olive
Surat At-Tīn (The Fig) - سورة التين
95:2
وَطُورِ سِينِينَ
And [by] Mount Sinai
7 3RFAT(عرفات)  :is a mountain ,25 Kilometer away from MAKKAH which is called JABLI 3RFAT(جبل عرفات). and the base or valley of this mountain is also called 3RFAT.after the forenoon on 9th of ZILHAJJ ,pilgrims supplicate here till evening .Staying at 3RFAT is major pillar of Hajj.and day of 3RFAH is 9th of ZILHAJJ which is the day of preparation to reach 3RFAT. and 3ARRAFA ALHUJJAJ(عَرَّفَ الحُجّاج) meaning pilgrims stayed in 3RFAT
8 MASH3R ALHARAM(مشعر الحرام)  : MASH3R(مشعر) plural MSHA3R(مشاعر) comes in the meaning of SH3AIR(شعائر). meaning reminder of religion(something which make conscious of religion).and MASH3R ALHARAM is the name of a mountain near MUZDALFA(مزدلفه). on 9th of ZILHAJJ,whne pilgrims return from 3RFAT stays overnight and supplicate here. and from here pick up stones for RAMI(رَمي) with them. ALLAH said
Surat Al-Baqarah (The Cow) - سورة البقرة
2:198
لَيْسَ عَلَيْكُمْ جُنَاحٌ أَن تَبْتَغُوا فَضْلًا مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ ۚ   فَإِذَا أَفَضْتُم مِّنْ عَرَفَاتٍ فَاذْكُرُوا اللَّهَ عِندَ الْمَشْعَرِ الْحَرَامِ ۖ   وَاذْكُرُوهُ كَمَا هَدَاكُمْ وَإِن كُنتُم مِّن قَبْلِهِ لَمِنَ الضَّالِّينَ
There is no blame upon you for seeking bounty from your Lord [during Hajj].   But when you depart from 'Arafat, remember Allah at al- Mash'ar al-Haram  . And remember Him, as He has guided you, for indeed, you were before that among those astray.
9 BADR(بدر)  :a field 80 miles away from medina . which came on one side of the path from Medina to Makkah . at this place occurred the famous campaign of BADR in 2 Hijri . ALLAH said
Surat 'Āli `Imrān (Family of Imran) - سورة آل عمران
3:123
وَلَقَدْ نَصَرَكُمُ اللَّهُ بِبَدْرٍ وَأَنتُمْ أَذِلَّةٌ   ۖ فَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ
And already had Allah given you victory at [the battle of] Badr while you were few in number  . Then fear Allah ; perhaps you will be grateful.
10 HUNAYN(حُنَيْن)  : name of a vally between Makkah and Taif where afte the Conquest of Makkah in month of Shawwal 8th Hijri occurred the battel of HUNAYN with People of HAWAZIN. HAWAZIN were master archers. Muslims strength was 12,000 and a bit more than
disbelievers. partly due to effect of Conquest of Makkah ,and partly pride of majority in numbers. the result was that Muslim got defeated in the begining. then when army was reinforced again then by ALLAH's favoured them and turn this defeat in to Victory. ALLAH said
Surat At-Tawbah (The Repentance) - سورة التوبة
9:25
لَقَدْ نَصَرَكُمُ اللَّهُ فِي مَوَاطِنَ كَثِيرَةٍ ۙ وَيَوْمَ حُنَيْنٍ ۙ إِذْ أَعْجَبَتْكُمْ كَثْرَتُكُمْ   فَلَمْ تُغْنِ عَنكُمْ شَيْئًا وَضَاقَتْ عَلَيْكُمُ الْأَرْضُ بِمَا رَحُبَتْ ثُمَّ وَلَّيْتُم مُّدْبِرِينَ
Allah has already given you victory in many regions and [even] on the day of Hunayn, when your great number pleased you  , but it did not avail you at all, and the earth was confining for you with its vastness; then you turned back, fleeing.
11 MASJID ALAQSA(مسجِد الاقصَي)  :lexical meaning , a mosque far away. and it means BAIT UL MUQADDAS (بيت المقدس) which was the first QIBLA(قبله) of muslim(direction of prayer).on earth after KA3BAH or House of ALLAH was this mosque built. and it is called MASJID AQSA because it is situated far awa from MASJID ALHARAM(KA3BAH). later on this name became known in usage. ALLAH said
Surat Al-'Isrā' (The Night Journey) - سورة الإسراء
17:1
سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي أَسْرَىٰ بِعَبْدِهِ لَيْلًا مِّنَ الْمَسْجِدِ الْحَرَامِ إِلَى الْمَسْجِدِ الْأَقْصَى   الَّذِي بَارَكْنَا حَوْلَهُ لِنُرِيَهُ مِنْ آيَاتِنَا ۚ إِنَّهُ هُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْبَصِيرُ
Exalted is He who took His Servant by night from al-Masjid al-Haram to al-Masjid al- Aqsa  , whose surroundings We have blessed, to show him of Our signs. Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Seeing.
12 SIDRATUL MUNTAHA(سِدْرَةُ الْمُنْتَهَي)  : SIDRAH means berry tree and MUNTAHA meaning at the very limit of situated a berry tree.This is a place in the Heavens where Information of Lower World ends and elaborations of Upper world descends down from here. at this place Holy Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) saw Angel Gabriel(AS) in his original form the second time. and also means a berry tree on the right side of the throne of ALLAH, which is the last limit of the reach of Angels etc. The place where Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) was especially bestowed with ALLAH's Blessings and Hefty Prizes. and all these discourses are proven from SURAH NAJM(53) ayah 5-18. 14 SALSABEEL(سلسبيل)  : people of lexicon write it as sweet and pleasant water which is easily drinkable down the mouth. and SALSABEEL is define by ALLAH HIMSELF as this is a spring in the paradise in drink of which contains mixture of dry ginger. ALLAH said

8 PAHAAR,WADIYAAN AUR AMAKAN [Mountain,Valleys and Sites]

those mountains and fields or valleys whose name occur in the Holy Quran are as follows

1-2 SAFA(صفا ) and MARWAH(مروة): near House of ALLAH are two famous mountains.between those HAGAR to and fro 7 times in search of water. Nowadays those mountains are cutdown to get rid of the middle valley.only the signs of the mountains remain.Every pilgrim had to walk swiftly in between them as essential part of HAJJ and UMRAH

ALLAH said:

2:158

إِنَّ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةَ مِن شَعَائِرِ اللَّهِ ۖ فَمَنْ حَجَّ الْبَيْتَ أَوِ اعْتَمَرَ فَلَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيْهِ أَن يَطَّوَّفَ بِهِمَا ۚ وَمَن تَطَوَّعَ خَيْرًا فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ شَاكِرٌ عَلِيمٌ

Indeed, as-Safa and al-Marwah are among the symbols of Allah . So whoever makes Hajj to the House or performs 'umrah - there is no blame upon him for walking between them. And whoever volunteers good - then indeed, Allah is appreciative and Knowing.

2.JUDIYY( جُوْدِيّ):Noah's Storm continues,consecutively for 40 days. meaning it keeps raining and also earth keeps releasing water from beneath it. in the mean time Noah's Ark keep on gaining height continuously. and that time this storm came on all visible earth where there was population of mankind. later on when water start receding then it took 150 days for this process to complete. and when water start receding then Ark rest at Mount Judiyy. Judiyy is (Mount Judi - Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia) one of the mountain of mountains of Ararat.and is famous with the same name. ALLAH said:

Surat Hūd (Hud) - سورة هود

11:44

وَقِيلَ يَا أَرْضُ ابْلَعِي مَاءَكِ وَيَا سَمَاءُ أَقْلِعِي وَغِيضَ الْمَاءُ وَقُضِيَ الْأَمْرُ وَاسْتَوَتْ عَلَى الْجُودِيِّ ۖ وَقِيلَ بُعْدًا لِّلْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ

And it was said, "O earth, swallow your water, and O sky, withhold [your rain]." And the water subsided, and the matter was accomplished, and the ship came to rest on the [mountain of] Judiyy. And it was said, "Away with the wrongdoing people."

4-6 SINA( سينا),SINAIN(سينين),TWR(طور) and TWY(طوي): SINA and SINAIN are two names of one thing. SINA is a high mountain whose height is 7359 foot which is in the path between MADIAN and EGYPT in the country of SYRIA . At this place Moses(PBUH) was bestowed twice the opportunity to talk with ALLAH.One of the peak of this mountain is called TWR. and in the base of this mountain is a valley named TWY which is also called Holy Valley and Blessed place. When Moses (PBUH) took Children of Israel out of EGYPT then he went past this path. from this relation TWR Mountain is also called TWRI SINAIN(). ALLAH said

Surat At-Tīn (The Fig) - سورة التين

95:1

وَالتِّينِ وَالزَّيْتُونِ

By the fig and the olive

Surat At-Tīn (The Fig) - سورة التين

95:2

And [by] Mount Sinai

7 3RFAT(عرفات):is a mountain ,25 Kilometer away from MAKKAH which is called JABLI 3RFAT(جبل عرفات). and the base or valley of this mountain is also called 3RFAT.after the forenoon on 9th of ZILHAJJ ,pilgrims supplicate here till evening .Staying at 3RFAT is major pillar of Hajj.and day of 3RFAH is 9th of ZILHAJJ which is the day of preparation to reach 3RFAT. and 3ARRAFA ALHUJJAJ(عَرَّفَ الحُجّاج) meaning pilgrims stayed in 3RFAT

8 MASH3R ALHARAM(مشعر الحرام): MASH3R(مشعر) plural MSHA3R(مشاعر) comes in the meaning of SH3AIR(شعائر). meaning reminder of religion(something which make conscious of religion).and MASH3R ALHARAM is the name of a mountain near MUZDALFA(مزدلفه). on 9th of ZILHAJJ,whne pilgrims return from 3RFAT stays overnight and supplicate here. and from here pick up stones for RAMI(رَمي) with them. Those nations which are mentioned in the Quran. From those,
1 Nation of Noah,
2 Ād,
3 Thamud,
4 Lot,
5 Moses,
6 Pharaoh,
are already described in the section of Prophets. Apart from there are some other Nations that are mentioned which are
7 QWM IRAM(قوم اِرَم)  : is the other attribute name or title of Nation of Ād. IRAM literally means sign made of stones and it refers to those high and decorated pillars which Nation of Ād or Thamud (Ād successor) made in the capacity of master stone sculpturer. also IRAM is the first person of Nation of Ād or the royal family of nation of Ād. Those people are dwellers in the area of YEMEN. ALLAH said
Surat Al-Fajr (The Dawn) - سورة الفجر
89:6
أَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِعَادٍ
Have you not considered how your Lord dealt with 'Aad -
Surat Al-Fajr (The Dawn) - سورة الفجر
89:7
إِرَمَ ذَاتِ الْعِمَادِ
[With] Iram - who had lofty pillars,
8 QWM TUBBA3(قوم تُبَّع)  : TUBBA3 was the title of the kings of HAMYR tribe. TUBBA3's nation was actually a branch of Nation of SABA which in 115 B.C in the are of SABA (situated in YEMEN). and remain in power till 300 A.D . ALLAH said
Surat Ad-Dukhān (The Smoke) - سورة الدخان
44:37
أَهُمْ خَيْرٌ أَمْ قَوْمُ تُبَّعٍ وَالَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ أَهْلَكْنَاهُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا مُجْرِمِينَ
Are they better or the people of Tubba' and those before them? We destroyed them, [for] indeed, they were criminals.
9 QRYSH(قريش)  : Messenger of ALLAH (PBUH) ,11th generation predecessor was FHR(فهر) who became famous with the title of QRYSH. QRYSH is actually saod to Whale which is the biggest and most powerful of all the marine animals. In time of FHR, one ruler of YEMEN named HASSAN had attacked Makkah with the intention of taking away KABAH ' stone from there to YEMEN to built a House of ALLAH there. FHR fights him and arrested him. due to this reason he became famous with the title of QRYSH. FHR's offspring is also called QRYSH, QRYSH is also Messenger of ALLAH (PBUH)'s own nation, which was highly reputed in the entire Arabia but this nation oppose the Messenger of ALLAH (PBUH) most. The stength of this opposition subsides on the day of conquest of Makkah and this nation accepted faith. then most Caliphs of Islam were also from this nation. ALLAH said
Surat Quraysh (Quraysh) - سورة قريش
106:1
لِإِيلَافِ قُرَيْشٍ
For the accustomed security of the Quraysh -
Surat Quraysh (Quraysh) - سورة قريش
106:2
إِيلَافِهِمْ رِحْلَةَ الشِّتَاءِ وَالصَّيْفِ
Their accustomed security [in] the caravan of winter and summer -
10 YAJUJ(ياجوج) and MAJUJ(ماجوج) aka Gog Magog  :Those warrior and wild nations of Northern and Eastern Asia which used to attack,decimate civilized countries. They are classified from the offspring of Noah(PBUH)'s son YAFC(يافث). Their areas are Russia, Moscow etc. King ZULQARNAIN(ذوالقرنين) which was mentioned before , had built a hurdle/wall in order to get rid of their attacks. This wall was built in between the trough area or valley of two mountain ranges from where this wild nation used to emerge for attack. ALLAH said
Surat Al-Kahf (The Cave) - سورة الكهف
18:94
قَالُوا يَا ذَا الْقَرْنَيْنِ إِنَّ يَأْجُوجَ وَمَأْجُوجَ مُفْسِدُونَ فِي الْأَرْضِ فَهَلْ نَجْعَلُ لَكَ خَرْجًا عَلَىٰ أَن تَجْعَلَ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَهُمْ سَدًّا
They said, "O Dhul-Qarnayn, indeed Gog and Magog are [great] corrupters in the land. So may we assign for you an expenditure that you might make between us and them a barrier?"
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Surat An-Naml (The Ant) - سورة النمل

And [recall] when you said, "O Moses, we can never endure one [kind of] food. And [recall] when you said, "O Moses, we can never endure one [kind of] food. So call upon your Lord to bring forth for us from the earth its green herbs and its cucumbers and its garlic and its lentils and its onions." [Moses] said, "Would you exchange what is better for what is less? People of arab has a tradition that by saying most prominent part they meant the whole. and this word RA-S applies to cattle as well.like ARB3UNA RA-SAN MIN AL GHANAMI(اَرْبَعُوْنَ رَأْساً مِنَ الْغَنَمِ) meaning 40 goats.as head is the topmost part of the body therefore every top part is also called RA-S. like RA-S ALJABL(راس الجبل) meaning mountains peak/summit/pinnacle. like wise from literal aspect RA-S ALQWM(رأس القوم) meaning chief of the nation.RA-YS(رئيس) meaning chief-ruler. plural RU-UWSA-(رُءُوْسَاء) and MAR-WS(مرءوس) meaning those who are being ruled, assistant. and RA-S meaning real quantity of something as RA-SUL MAL(رَاسُ الْمَال) . as ALLAH said

وَوَصَّيْنَا الْإِنسَانَ بِوَالِدَيْهِ إِحْسَانًا ۖ حَمَلَتْهُ أُمُّهُ كُرْهًا وَوَضَعَتْهُ كُرْهًا ۖ وَحَمْلُهُ وَفِصَالُهُ ثَلَاثُونَ شَهْرًا ۚ حَتَّىٰ إِذَا بَلَغَ أَشُدَّهُ وَبَلَغَ أَرْبَعِينَ سَنَةً قَالَ رَبِّ أَوْزِعْنِي أَنْ أَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ الَّتِي أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيَّ وَعَلَىٰ وَالِدَيَّ وَأَنْ أَعْمَلَ صَالِحًا تَرْضَاهُ وَأَصْلِحْ لِي فِي ذُرِّيَّتِي ۖ إِنِّي تُبْتُ إِلَيْكَ وَإِنِّي مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ

And We have enjoined upon man, to his parents, good treatment. His mother carried him with hardship and gave birth to him with hardship, and his gestation and weaning [period] is thirty months. [He grows] until, when he reaches maturity and reaches [the age of] forty years, he says, "My Lord, enable me to be grateful for Your favor which You have bestowed upon me and upon my parents and to work righteousness of which You will approve and make righteous for me my offspring. Indeed, I have repented to You, and indeed, I am of the Muslims."

3.4.5 WADA3Aوَضَعَ: meaning mother breast-feeding milk to baby. and RADA3ATرَضَاعَت meaning the period of feeding which can be atmost 2 Years. and MURDI3AH مُرْضِعَة meaning the one who breast-feeds,wet nurse. plural MARADI3مَرَاضِع ,and ISTARDA3اِسْتَرْضَعَ meaning to get some other women(wet nurse) to breast-feed the baby. ALLAH said.

Surat Al-Baqarah (The Cow) - سورة البقرة

2:233

وَالْوَالِدَاتُ يُرْضِعْنَ أَوْلَادَهُنَّ حَوْلَيْنِ كَامِلَيْنِ ۖ لِمَنْ أَرَادَ أَن يُتِمَّ الرَّضَاعَةَ ۚ وَعَلَى الْمَوْلُودِ لَهُ رِزْقُهُنَّ وَكِسْوَتُهُنَّ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ ۚ لَا تُكَلَّفُ نَفْسٌ إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا ۚ لَا تُضَارَّ وَالِدَةٌ بِوَلَدِهَا وَلَا مَوْلُودٌ لَّهُ بِوَلَدِهِ ۚ وَعَلَى الْوَارِثِ مِثْلُ ذَٰلِكَ ۗ فَإِنْ أَرَادَا فِصَالًا عَن تَرَاضٍ مِّنْهُمَا وَتَشَاوُرٍ فَلَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيْهِمَا ۗ وَإِنْ أَرَدتُّمْ أَن تَسْتَرْضِعُوا أَوْلَادَكُمْ فَلَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيْكُمْ إِذَا سَلَّمْتُم مَّا آتَيْتُم بِالْمَعْرُوفِ ۗ وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَاعْلَمُوا أَنَّ اللَّهَ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ

Mothers may breastfeed their children two complete years for whoever wishes to complete the nursing [period]. Upon the father is the mothers' provision and their clothing according to what is acceptable. No person is charged with more than his capacity. No mother should be harmed through her child, and no father through his child. And upon the [father's] heir is [a duty] like that [of the father]. And if they both desire weaning through mutual consent from both of them and consultation, there is no blame upon either of them. And if you wish to have your children nursed by a substitute, there is no blame upon you as long as you give payment according to what is acceptable. And fear Allah and know that Allah is Seeing of what you do.

and the importance of breast-feeding in the Shariah is that those relations which are HARAM by blood relation are also HARAM by suckling. ALLAH said

Surat An-Nisā' (The Women) - سورة النساء

4:23

حُرِّمَتْ عَلَيْكُمْ أُمَّهَاتُكُمْ وَبَنَاتُكُمْ وَأَخَوَاتُكُمْ وَعَمَّاتُكُمْ وَخَالَاتُكُمْ وَبَنَاتُ الْأَخِ وَبَنَاتُ الْأُخْتِ وَأُمَّهَاتُكُمُ اللَّاتِي أَرْضَعْنَكُمْ وَأَخَوَاتُكُم مِّنَ الرَّضَاعَةِ وَأُمَّهَاتُ نِسَائِكُمْ وَرَبَائِبُكُمُ اللَّاتِي فِي حُجُورِكُم مِّن نِّسَائِكُمُ اللَّاتِي دَخَلْتُم بِهِنَّ فَإِن لَّمْ تَكُونُوا دَخَلْتُم بِهِنَّ فَلَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيْكُمْ وَحَلَائِلُ أَبْنَائِكُمُ الَّذِينَ مِنْ أَصْلَابِكُمْ وَأَن تَجْمَعُوا بَيْنَ الْأُخْتَيْنِ إِلَّا مَا قَدْ سَلَفَ ۗ إِنَّ اللَّهَ كَانَ غَفُورًا رَّحِيمًا

Prohibited to you [for marriage] are your mothers, your daughters, your sisters, your father's sisters, your mother's sisters, your brother's daughters, your sister's daughters, your [milk] mothers who nursed you, your sisters through nursing, your wives' mothers, and your step-daughters under your guardianship [born] of your wives unto whom you have gone in. But if you have not gone in unto them, there is no sin upon you. And [also prohibited are] the wives of your sons who are from your [own] loins, and that you take [in marriage] two sisters simultaneously, except for what has already occurred. Indeed, Allah is ever Forgiving and Merciful.

3.4.6 FISAL(فِصَال): meaning to weaning babies off milk. any female stopping feeding milk to her baby. ALLAH said

Appendix2: 4.1 GHAR AUR GHARYLW ASYA-[House and Household Items]
4.1.1-2 for DAR and BAYT(دَار بَيْت)   please see GHAR[Home]

4.1.7 3AMADAعَمَدَ  :Pillars (singular 3IMADعِمَاد) and meaning leaning against,support,trust and 3AMAD means such pillars which helps roof to be established.some times weakness of walls(JUDURجُدُر) is cured with pillars. and sometimes entire roof is supported only on pillars and UMWDعمود is that wood which supports the tent.ALLAH said
Surat Ar-Ra`d (The Thunder) - سورة الرعد
13:2
اللَّهُ الَّذِي رَفَعَ السَّمَاوَاتِ بِغَيْرِ عَمَدٍ تَرَوْنَهَا   ۖ ثُمَّ اسْتَوَىٰ عَلَى الْعَرْشِ ۖ وَسَخَّرَ الشَّمْسَ وَالْقَمَرَ ۖ كُلٌّ يَجْرِي لِأَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى ۚ يُدَبِّرُ الْأَمْرَ يُفَصِّلُ الْآيَاتِ لَعَلَّكُم بِلِقَاءِ رَبِّكُمْ تُوقِنُونَ
It is Allah who erected the heavens without pillars that you [can] see  ; then He established Himself above the Throne and made subject the sun and the moon, each running [its course] for a specified term. He arranges [each] matter; He details the signs that you may, of the meeting with your Lord, be certain.
4.1.8 BAAB باب  : door (plural ABWABابواب) and BAWWABبوّاب meaning door/gate keeper. and BABAبَابَ meaning to be door keeper. and BAWWABAHبَوَّابَة meaning profession of doorkeeping and its wages as well. then like every house has several doors which opens in different directions. like this different aspect of a every thing is called ABWABاَبْوَاب. BAWWABA ALKITABبَوَّبَ الْكِتَاب meaning to divide books in to chapters. In the Quran
Surat Al-'An`ām (The Cattle) - سورة الأنعام
6:44
فَلَمَّا نَسُوا مَا ذُكِّرُوا بِهِ فَتَحْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ أَبْوَابَ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ   حَتَّىٰ إِذَا فَرِحُوا بِمَا أُوتُوا أَخَذْنَاهُم بَغْتَةً فَإِذَا هُم مُّبْلِسُونَ
So when they forgot that by which they had been reminded, We opened to them the doors of every [good] thing   until, when they rejoiced in that which they were given, We seized them suddenly, and they were [then] in despair.
4.1.9 WASIYD(وَصِيْد)  : meaning that enclosure which is built for the protection for cattle in the mountain. and meaning door's lintel on which door closed and AWSADAT ULBABاَوْصَدَتُ البَاب meaning I closed door . In the Quran
Surat Al-Kahf (The Cave) - سورة الكهف
18:18
وَتَحْسَبُهُمْ أَيْقَاظًا وَهُمْ رُقُودٌ ۚ وَنُقَلِّبُهُمْ ذَاتَ الْيَمِينِ وَذَاتَ الشِّمَالِ ۖ   وَكَلْبُهُم بَاسِطٌ ذِرَاعَيْهِ بِالْوَصِيدِ ۚ   لَوِ اطَّلَعْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ لَوَلَّيْتَ مِنْهُمْ فِرَارًا وَلَمُلِئْتَ مِنْهُمْ رُعْبًا
And you would think them awake, while they were asleep. And We turned them to the right and to the left,   while their dog stretched his forelegs at the entrance  . If you had looked at them, you would have turned from them in flight and been filled by them with terror.
4.1.10 MISHKAT(مِشكَوة)  : meaning arch in the wall,small almirah which doesn't goes across. In the Quran
Surat An-Nūr (The Light) - سورة النور
24:35
اللَّهُ نُورُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ ۚ مَثَلُ نُورِهِ   كَمِشْكَاةٍ فِيهَا مِصْبَاحٌ   ۖ الْمِصْبَاحُ فِي زُجَاجَةٍ ۖ الزُّجَاجَةُ كَأَنَّهَا كَوْكَبٌ دُرِّيٌّ يُوقَدُ مِن شَجَرَةٍ مُّبَارَكَةٍ زَيْتُونَةٍ لَّا شَرْقِيَّةٍ وَلَا غَرْبِيَّةٍ يَكَادُ زَيْتُهَا يُضِيءُ وَلَوْ لَمْ تَمْسَسْهُ نَارٌ ۚ نُّورٌ عَلَىٰ نُورٍ ۗ يَهْدِي اللَّهُ لِنُورِهِ مَن يَشَاءُ ۚ وَيَضْرِبُ اللَّهُ الْأَمْثَالَ لِلنَّاسِ ۗ وَاللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِيمٌ
Allah is the Light of the heavens and the earth. The example of His light is   like a niche within which is a lamp  , the lamp is within glass, the glass as if it were a pearly [white] star lit from [the oil of] a blessed olive tree, neither of the east nor of the west, whose oil would almost glow even if untouched by fire. Light upon light. Allah guides to His light whom He wills. And Allah presents examples for the people, and Allah is Knowing of all things  .
4.1.11 QUFL(قُفْل)  : meaning Lock (plural AQFALاقفال ) and AQFAL ALBAB(اقفل الباب) meaning to lock door. then everything was hinted as QFL which hinders or stops from some work. In the Quran
Surat Muĥammad (Muhammad) - سورة محمد
47:24
أَفَلَا يَتَدَبَّرُونَ الْقُرْآنَ أَمْ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبٍ أَقْفَالُهَا
Then do they not reflect upon the Qur'an, or are there locks upon [their] hearts?
4.1.12 KURSIY(كُرْسِي)  :known thing on which one leans against and put step on ground to sit with comfort. and KURSI ALMULK(كرسي الملك) ,comes in the meaning of Royal Throne. ALLAH said
Surat Al-Baqarah (The Cow) - سورة البقرة
2:255
اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ ۚ لَا تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ ۚ لَّهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ ۗ مَن ذَا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِندَهُ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِ ۚ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ ۖ وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيْءٍ مِّنْ عِلْمِهِ إِلَّا بِمَا شَاءَ ۚ   وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ   ۖ وَلَا يَئُودُهُ حِفْظُهُمَا ۚ وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ
Allah - there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of [all] existence. Neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who is it that can intercede with Him except by His permission? He knows what is [presently] before them and what will be after them, and they encompass not a thing of His knowledge except for what He wills.   His Kursi extends over the heavens and the earth  , and their preservation tires Him not. And He is the Most High, the Most Great.
and how is this KURSI of ALLAH the ALMIGHTY ?. Human can neither understand nor charged with its understanding.KURSI also means rule and also authority
4.1.13 for ARIYKAH and SARIYR(اَرِيْكَة سَرِيْر  ) also see TAKHT[Throne]
4.1.14 MASAD(مَسَدَ)  :rope made of palm or date leaves from which bedding is woven and MASAD ALHABLمَسَدَ الْحَبْل meaning rope making.In the Quran
Surat Al-Masad (The Palm Fiber, Flame) - سورة المسد
111:5
فِي جِيدِهَا حَبْلٌ مِّن مَّسَدٍ
Around her neck is a rope of [twisted] fiber.
4.1.15 TABUWT(تَابُوْت)  : meaning chest of wood. and TABUWT ALMAYYITتَابُوْت الميِّت is the elongated wooden coffin in which corpse is palced.
Surat Ţāhā (Ta-Ha) - سورة طه
20:39
أَنِ اقْذِفِيهِ فِي التَّابُوتِ فَاقْذِفِيهِ فِي الْيَمِّ   فَلْيُلْقِهِ الْيَمُّ بِالسَّاحِلِ يَأْخُذْهُ عَدُوٌّ لِّي وَعَدُوٌّ لَّهُ ۚ وَأَلْقَيْتُ عَلَيْكَ مَحَبَّةً مِّنِّي وَلِتُصْنَعَ عَلَىٰ عَيْنِي
[Saying], 'Cast him into the chest and cast it into the river,   and the river will throw it onto the bank; there will take him an enemy to Me and an enemy to him.' And I bestowed upon you love from Me that you would be brought up under My eye.
4.1.16 QALAM(قلَمَ)  : known and famous tool (plural AQLAMاقلام) QALAM meaning to Trim. QALM ALZAFRقلم الظفر to trim nails, MIQLAMمِقْلام meaning short knife and also inkstand. and QALAMAHقلامه meaning trims. before trimming QALM is called QASBAHقَصْبَة and BRA3AHبراعه. ALLAH said
Surat Al-`Alaq (The Clot) - سورة العلق
96:4
الَّذِي عَلَّمَ بِالْقَلَمِ
Who taught by the pen -
Surat Al-`Alaq (The Clot) - سورة العلق
96:5
عَلَّمَ الْإِنسَانَ مَا لَمْ يَعْلَمْ

And tell the believing women to reduce [some] of their vision and guard their private parts and not expose their adornment except that which [necessarily] appears thereof and to wrap [a portion of] their headcovers over their chests and not expose their adornment except to their husbands, their fathers, their husbands' fathers, their sons, their husbands' sons, their brothers, their brothers' sons, their sisters' sons, their women, that which their right hands possess, or those male attendants having no physical desire, or children who are not yet aware of the private aspects of women. And let them not stamp their feet to make known what they conceal of their adornment. And turn to Allah in repentance, all of you, O believers, that you might succeed.

4.4.11-12 KHAYTخَيْط and KHIYATخِيَاط meaning thread,string- KHAYT UL ABYAD(خَيطُ الابْيَضْ) meaning daylight and KHAYT UL ASWADخَيطُ الاَسْوَد meaning darkness of night. In the QURAN

Surat Al-Baqarah (The Cow) - سورة البقرة

2:187

أُحِلَّ لَكُمْ لَيْلَةَ الصِّيَامِ الرَّفَثُ إِلَىٰ نِسَائِكُمْ ۚ هُنَّ لِبَاسٌ لَّكُمْ وَأَنتُمْ لِبَاسٌ لَّهُنَّ ۗ عَلِمَ اللَّهُ أَنَّكُمْ كُنتُمْ تَخْتَانُونَ أَنفُسَكُمْ فَتَابَ عَلَيْكُمْ وَعَفَا عَنكُمْ ۖ فَالْآنَ بَاشِرُوهُنَّ وَابْتَغُوا مَا كَتَبَ اللَّهُ لَكُمْ ۚ وَكُلُوا وَاشْرَبُوا حَتَّىٰ يَتَبَيَّنَ لَكُمُ الْخَيْطُ الْأَبْيَضُ مِنَ الْخَيْطِ الْأَسْوَدِ مِنَ الْفَجْرِ ۖ ثُمَّ أَتِمُّوا الصِّيَامَ إِلَى اللَّيْلِ ۚ وَلَا تُبَاشِرُوهُنَّ وَأَنتُمْ عَاكِفُونَ فِي الْمَسَاجِدِ ۗ تِلْكَ حُدُودُ اللَّهِ فَلَا تَقْرَبُوهَا ۗ كَذَٰلِكَ يُبَيِّنُ اللَّهُ آيَاتِهِ لِلنَّاسِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَّقُونَ

It has been made permissible for you the night preceding fasting to go to your wives [for sexual relations]. They are clothing for you and you are clothing for them. Allah knows that you used to deceive yourselves, so He accepted your repentance and forgave you. So now, have relations with them and seek that which Allah has decreed for you. And eat and drink until the white thread of dawn becomes distinct to you from the black thread [of night]. Then complete the fast until the sunset. And do not have relations with them as long as you are staying for worship in the mosques. These are the limits [set by] Allah , so do not approach them. Thus does Allah make clear His ordinances to the people that they may become righteous.

and KHIYATخِيَاط meaning needle and also MUKHIYTمُخِيْط is needle. and KHAYYATخيّاط meaning tailor and KHAYATAHخياطة meaning profession of tailoring. In the QURAN.

Surat Al-'A`rāf (The Heights) - سورة الأعراف

7:40

إِنَّ الَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا بِآيَاتِنَا وَاسْتَكْبَرُوا عَنْهَا لَا تُفَتَّحُ لَهُمْ أَبْوَابُ السَّمَاءِ وَلَا يَدْخُلُونَ الْجَنَّةَ حَتَّىٰ يَلِجَ الْجَمَلُ فِي سَمِّ الْخِيَاطِ ۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِي الْمُجْرِمِينَ

Indeed, those who deny Our verses and are arrogant toward them - the gates of Heaven will not be opened for them, nor will they enter Paradise until a camel enters into the eye of a needle. And thus do We recompense the criminals.

Surat An-Naĥl (The Bee) - سورة النحل

16:92

وَلَا تَكُونُوا كَالَّتِي نَقَضَتْ غَزْلَهَا مِن بَعْدِ قُوَّةٍ أَنكَاثًا تَتَّخِذُونَ أَيْمَانَكُمْ دَخَلًا بَيْنَكُمْ أَن تَكُونَ أُمَّةٌ هِيَ أَرْبَىٰ مِنْ أُمَّةٍ ۚ إِنَّمَا يَبْلُوكُمُ اللَّهُ بِهِ ۚ وَلَيُبَيِّنَنَّ لَكُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ مَا كُنتُمْ فِيهِ تَخْتَلِفُونَ

And do not be like she who untwisted her spun thread after it was strong [by] taking your oaths as [means of] deceit between you because one community is more plentiful [in number or wealth] than another community. Allah only tries you thereby. And He will surely make clear to you on the Day of Resurrection that over which you used to differ.

4.4.13 HILYAH(حِلْيَة):HALIY ALMIR-AHحَلِي الْمِرْءَة meaning to make jewellery for woman. to decorate woman, to groom.and HALIYAT ILMIR-AHحَلِيَتِ الْمِرْءَة meaning Women wearing jewellery.HALLAحَلَّي meaning to wear jewellery and HILYAH meaning jewellery (plural HULLIYحُلِّي)and HILYAT UL INSANحِلْيَةُالانْسَان meaning human's colour and beauty and apparent form and face.

4.4.14 ASWIRAH(اسْوَرَة):SAWWARA ALMIR-AHسَوَّرَالْمِرْءَة meaning to make woman wear hand bangle. and SAWARسَوَار and ASWARاَسْوَار meaning bangle(plural SWR ASWIRAH and ASAWIRسور اَسْوِرَة اَسَاوِر).ALLAH said

أُولَٰئِكَ لَهُمْ جَنَّاتُ عَدْنٍ تَجْرِي مِن تَحْتِهِمُ الْأَنْهَارُ يُحَلَّوْنَ فِيهَا مِنْ أَسَاوِرَ مِن ذَهَبٍ وَيَلْبَسُونَ ثِيَابًا خُضْرًا مِّن سُندُسٍ وَإِسْتَبْرَقٍ مُّتَّكِئِينَ فِيهَا عَلَى الْأَرَائِكِ ۚ نِعْمَ الثَّوَابُ وَحَسُنَتْ مُرْتَفَقًا

Those will have gardens of perpetual residence; beneath them rivers will flow. They will be adorned therein with bracelets of gold and will wear green garments of fine silk and brocade, reclining therein on adorned couches. Excellent is the reward, and good is the resting place.

عَسَىٰ رَبُّكُمْ أَن يَرْحَمَكُمْ ۚ وَإِنْ عُدتُّمْ عُدْنَا ۘ وَجَعَلْنَا جَهَنَّمَ لِلْكَافِرِينَ حَصِيرًا

[Then Allah said], "It is expected, [if you repent], that your Lord will have mercy upon you. But if you return [to sin], We will return [to punishment]. And We have made Hell, for the disbelievers, a prison-bed."

4.5 NAQDY [Cash]

4.5.1 WARIQ(وَرِق): meaning coin of silver. which would have been in use in any government. and nowadays currency paper note is also called WARQAHوَرْقَة by people of Arab. WARQAT RIYALAYNورقة ريالَين meaning note of 2 riyal.In Quran, mentioned in the description of Companion of Cave.

Surat Al-Kahf (The Cave) - سورة الكهف

18:19

وَكَذَٰلِكَ بَعَثْنَاهُمْ لِيَتَسَاءَلُوا بَيْنَهُمْ ۚ قَالَ قَائِلٌ مِّنْهُمْ كَمْ لَبِثْتُمْ ۖ قَالُوا لَبِثْنَا يَوْمًا أَوْ بَعْضَ يَوْمٍ ۚ قَالُوا رَبُّكُمْ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا لَبِثْتُمْ فَابْعَثُوا أَحَدَكُم بِوَرِقِكُمْ هَٰذِهِ إِلَى الْمَدِينَةِ فَلْيَنظُرْ أَيُّهَا أَزْكَىٰ طَعَامًا فَلْيَأْتِكُم بِرِزْقٍ مِّنْهُ وَلْيَتَلَطَّفْ وَلَا يُشْعِرَنَّ بِكُمْ أَحَدًا

And similarly, We awakened them that they might question one another. Said a speaker from among them, "How long have you remained [here]?" They said, "We have remained a day or part of a day." They said, "Your Lord is most knowing of how long you remained. So send one of you with this silver coin of yours to the city and let him look to which is the best of food and bring you provision from it and let him be cautious. And let no one be aware of you.

4.5.2 DIRHAM(دِرهَم):Silver coin of 3 1/2 measure of MASHA, which was used in the prophetic era in Arab. actually DIRHAM and DINAR are greek coins which were used in Romen and Hijaz. In the Quran

Surat Yūsuf (Joseph) - سورة يوسف

12:20

وَشَرَوْهُ بِثَمَنٍ بَخْسٍ دَرَاهِمَ مَعْدُودَةٍ وَكَانُوا فِيهِ مِنَ الزَّاهِدِينَ

And they sold him for a reduced price - a few dirhams - and they were, concerning him, of those content with little.

4.5.3 DIYNAR( دِيْنَار): Gold Coin of 4 1/2 measure of masha [for more details http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Indian_..._and_measures]

. plural DANANAYRدنانير, the relation between DIRHAM and DIYNAR is that one DIYNAR is equal to Twenty DIRHAM. In the Quran.

Surat 'Āli `Imrān (Family of Imran) - سورة آل عمران

3:75

وَمِنْ أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ مَنْ إِن تَأْمَنْهُ بِقِنطَارٍ يُؤَدِّهِ إِلَيْكَ وَمِنْهُم مَّنْ إِن تَأْمَنْهُ بِدِينَارٍ لَّا يُؤَدِّهِ إِلَيْكَ إِلَّا مَا دُمْتَ عَلَيْهِ قَائِمًا ۗ ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ قَالُوا لَيْسَ عَلَيْنَا فِي الْأُمِّيِّينَ سَبِيلٌ وَيَقُولُونَ عَلَى اللَّهِ الْكَذِبَ وَهُمْ يَعْلَمُونَ

And among the People of the Scripture is he who, if you entrust him with a great amount [of wealth], he will return it to you. And among them is he who, if you entrust him with a [single] silver coin, he will not return it to you unless you are constantly standing over him [demanding it]. That is because they say, "There is no blame upon us concerning the unlearned." And they speak untruth about Allah while they know [it].

Beautified for people is the love of that which they desire - of women and sons,   heaped-up sums of gold and silver  , fine branded horses, and cattle and tilled land. That is the enjoyment of worldly life, but Allah has with Him the best return.

أَوْ يَكُونَ لَكَ بَيْتٌ مِّن زُخْرُفٍ   أَوْ تَرْقَىٰ فِي السَّمَاءِ وَلَن نُّؤْمِنَ لِرُقِيِّكَ حَتَّىٰ تُنَزِّلَ عَلَيْنَا كِتَابًا نَّقْرَؤُهُ ۗ قُلْ سُبْحَانَ رَبِّي هَلْ كُنتُ إِلَّا بَشَرًا رَّسُولًا

5.10 QITRAAN(قَطِرَان)  : a oily flowing matter matter which is obtained from the tree like that of pine.coaltar and QATIRANقَطِرَان meaning melted resin or sulphur and QITRANقِطْرَان meaning melted copper and QATAR ALBA3IYRقَطَرَ البَعِيْر meaning camel covered with brim-stone/sulphur . flammable matter which fire up at once. Their garments of liquid pitch   and their faces covered by the Fire.

5.10 QITRAAN(قَطِرَان): a oily flowing matter matter which is obtained from the tree like that of pine.coaltar and QATIRANقَطِرَان meaning melted resin or sulphur and QITRANقِطْرَان meaning melted copper and QATAR ALBA3IYRقَطَرَ البَعِيْر meaning camel covered with brim-stone/sulphur . flammable matter which fire up at once. In the QURAN

Surat 'Ibrāhīm (Abrahim) - سورة ابراهيم

14:50

سَرَابِيلُهُم مِّن قَطِرَانٍ وَتَغْشَىٰ وُجُوهَهُمُ النَّارُ

Their garments of liquid pitch and their faces covered by the Fire.

Appendix 3: Lexicon of ذوي الاضداد
Appendix 3
LUGHUT ZAWIY ALAZDAD لغت ذوي الاضداد [Lexicon Intrinsic Antonym]
ZIDDضِدّ ,lexicon meaning is opposition or to be against.but this word is more specific than KHILAFخلاف. As per Imam RAGHIB, ZIDDYNضِدّين is defined as two things which are in competition with each other and is of same gender and cannot be gathered or comibined ever. like blackness or whiteness as both are from the gender of colour or are colour. and as per Ibn Alfaris ZIDDAYN is defined as such two competing things which cannot be gathered at the same time.like day and night and ZIDD is peculiar than KHILAF.that every ZIDD is KHILAF for sure but every KHILAF is not necessarily ZIDD.
To know ZIDD of something benefits in that sense that If one word's meaning is in the mind then meaning of other automatically comes in mind.due to this people of lexicon on most places also write down antonyms of word. We have also write down in this book lots of antonyms wherever deemed necessary. also in addition this appendix is also prescribed for this benefit.we divide words of antonym in three types
1 such words are themselves Intrinsic Antonyms.meaning in one word also contains the meaning of its antonym. like 3ADL(عَدْل) meaning also to do justic and also injustice as well. like this FARTفَرْط also means to decrease and also to increase.
2 Such words or trilateral roots in which change of one letter causes the meaning of antonym like TARIBAتَرِبَ meaning hand to mouth, and being poor. and TARIFتَرِفَ meaning to have DOLCE VITA or propserous life. or then in create a subtle difference
3 General list of Lexicon of Antonym like Antonym of ABYADاَبْيَض is ASWADاَسْوَد or Antonym of NAHARنَهَار is LAYLلَيْل
so with this arrangement we are presenting lexicon in alphabetical order
3.1 ALFAZ ZAWIY ALAZDAD [Words Intrinsic Antonym ]
3.1.1 AZR(ازر):IZARاِزَار meaning a)sarang b)cloth sheet c)everything that can cover up shame. and AAZARAاَزَرَ meaning to empower and to help out and also weakness and fraility. to strengthen or empower ABWABابواب of AAZRاَزر and AZZARاَزَّر are used. In the QURAN

So let him write and let the one who has the obligation dictate. And let him fear Allah , his Lord, and not leave anything out of it. But if the one who has the obligation is of limited understanding or weak or unable to dictate himself, then let his guardian dictate in justice. And bring to witness two witnesses from among your men. And if there are not two men [available], then a man and two women from those whom you accept as witnesses - so that if one of the women errs, then the other can remind her. And let not the witnesses refuse when they are called upon. And do not be [too] weary to write it, whether it is small or large, for its [specified] term. That is more just in the sight of Allah and stronger as evidence and more likely to prevent doubt between you, except when it is an immediate transaction which you conduct among yourselves. For [then] there is no blame upon you if you do not write it. And take witnesses when you conclude a contract. Let no scribe be harmed or any witness. For if you do so, indeed, it is [grave] disobedience in you. And fear Allah . And Allah teaches you. And Allah is Knowing of all things.

O you who have believed, when you contract a debt for a specified term, write it down. And let a scribe write [it] between you in justice. Let no scribe refuse to write as Allah has taught him. So let him write and let the one who has the obligation dictate. And let him fear Allah , his Lord, and not leave anything out of it. But if the one who has the obligation is of limited understanding or weak or unable to dictate himself, then let his guardian dictate in justice. And bring to witness two witnesses from among your men. And if there are not two men [available], then a man and two women from those whom you accept as witnesses - so that if one of the women errs, then the other can remind her. And let not the witnesses refuse when they are called upon. And do not be [too] weary to write it, whether it is small or large, for its [specified] term. That is more just in the sight of Allah and stronger as evidence and more likely to prevent doubt between you, except when it is an immediate transaction which you conduct among yourselves. For [then] there is no blame upon you if you do not write it. And take witnesses when you conclude a contract. Let no scribe be harmed or any witness. For if you do so, indeed, it is [grave] disobedience in you. And fear Allah . And Allah teaches you. And Allah is Knowing of all things.
