Page 991
Appendix 5 Miscellanious
1 Some Comprehensive Names
1.1 AYAMA(اَيَامَي)  :is plural of AYYAM اَيّم meaning widow or widower used for both gender.meaning women without husband,or husband without wife,AMA YAIYMU AYMAN AYUMAN AIMATAN(اَمَ يَئِيْمُ اَيْماً اَيُوْماً اَئِمَّةً)meaning man or woman become widow,and TAAYYUM(تَاَيُّم) meaning to remain unmarried for a long time,to be single. ALLAH said
Surat An-Nūr (The Light) - سورة النور
24:32
وَأَنكِحُوا الْأَيَامَىٰ مِنكُمْ وَالصَّالِحِينَ مِنْ عِبَادِكُمْ وَإِمَائِكُمْ ۚ   إِن يَكُونُوا فُقَرَاءَ يُغْنِهِمُ اللَّهُ مِن فَضْلِهِ ۗ وَاللَّهُ وَاسِعٌ عَلِيمٌ
And marry the unmarried among you and the righteous among your male slaves and female slaves  . If they should be poor, Allah will enrich them from His bounty, and Allah is all-Encompassing and Knowing.
2 B3YR( بعير):  Actually IBL(ابل)is used as ISM JINS(اسم جنس) for camel and B3YR is such a camel whis is 4 year old young,able for transportation and powerful.with this condition B3YR can be used as ISM JINS and comes for both gender. even though in the lexicon for she-camel there is word for NAQAH(ناقة). so B3YR means young,transport,powerful whether camel or she-camel. In the Quran
Surat Yūsuf (Joseph) - سورة يوسف
12:72
قَالُوا نَفْقِدُ صُوَاعَ الْمَلِكِ   وَلِمَن جَاءَ بِهِ حِمْلُ بَعِيرٍ وَأَنَا بِهِ زَعِيمٌ
They said, "We are missing the measure of the king.   And for he who produces it is [the reward of] a camel's load, and I am responsible for it."
3 BAQR(بقر)  : is ISM JINS.which applies to Cow,Ox,whether of any age on all of them and BAQR ALWHSH( بقر الوحش) meaning swamp deer,ibex,wild ox,blue bull and BAQRAH(بقرة)used as singular. and from lexical point of view used for both gender. but for ox as there is separate entry in lexicon of CWR(ثور). so BAQRAH generally means cow. and plural of BAQRAH is BAQRATبقرات,BUQURبُقُر,ABQURاَبْقُ ر,ABQARابقار,ABAQIRاَبَاقِر and ABAQIYR(اَبَاقِيْر). cow's owner and shepherd is called BAQQAR(بقّار). and herd of cows BAQR(باقر),BAQUR(باقور),BAYQWR(بيقور ). In the Quran
Surat Yūsuf (Joseph) - سورة يوسف
12:43
وَقَالَ الْمَلِكُ إِنِّي أَرَىٰ سَبْعَ بَقَرَاتٍ سِمَانٍ يَأْكُلُهُنَّ سَبْعٌ عِجَافٌ   وَسَبْعَ سُنبُلَاتٍ خُضْرٍ وَأُخَرَ يَابِسَاتٍ ۖ يَا أَيُّهَا الْمَلَأُ أَفْتُونِي فِي رُؤْيَايَ إِن كُنتُمْ لِلرُّؤْيَا تَعْبُرُونَ
And [subsequently] the king said, "Indeed, I have seen [in a dream] seven fat cows being eaten by seven [that were] lean  , and seven green spikes [of grain] and others [that were] dry. O eminent ones, explain to me my vision, if you should interpret visions."
4 BIKR(بِكْر):   meaning virgin male or female,used for both. even for animals and its both genders. In the Quran
Surat Al-Baqarah (The Cow) - سورة البقرة
2:68
قَالُوا ادْعُ لَنَا رَبَّكَ يُبَيِّن لَّنَا مَا هِيَ ۚ   قَالَ إِنَّهُ يَقُولُ إِنَّهَا بَقَرَةٌ لَّا فَارِضٌ وَلَا بِكْرٌ   عَوَانٌ بَيْنَ ذَٰلِكَ ۖ فَافْعَلُوا مَا تُؤْمَرُونَ
They said, "Call upon your Lord to make clear to us what it is."   [Moses] said, "[ Allah ] says, 'It is a cow which is neither old nor virgin,   but median between that,' so do what you are commanded."
5 CAYYIB(ثَيِّب):   (antonym BIKR)that which is not virgin whether male or female.CAYYIB is used in wide meanings and come for both male and female.married man and woman are also CAYYIB,divorced woman is also CAYYIB,and widow and widower is also CAYYIB. so any male or female who has copulated is now CAYYIB. RAJL CAYYIB( رجل ثَيِّب) meaning married man,husband.meaning woman separated from husband whether due to husband's death or from divorce. ALLAH said
Surat At-Taĥrīm (The Prohibtiion) - سورة التحريم
66:5
عَسَىٰ رَبُّهُ إِن طَلَّقَكُنَّ أَن يُبْدِلَهُ أَزْوَاجًا خَيْرًا مِّنكُنَّ مُسْلِمَاتٍ مُّؤْمِنَاتٍ قَانِتَاتٍ تَائِبَاتٍ عَابِدَاتٍ سَائِحَاتٍ ثَيِّبَاتٍ وَأَبْكَارًا
Perhaps his Lord, if he divorced you [all], would substitute for him wives better than you - submitting [to Allah ], believing, devoutly obedient, repentant, worshipping, and traveling - [ones] previously married and virgins.
In this Ayah CAYYIB's meaning is limited to only 'without husband' and from SAHIH MUSLIM ,BOOK OF LIMITS as per 3BADA BIN SAMAT's narration it is obvious that any man or women who is not BIKR is CAYYIB
6 KHDN(خدن)  :(Plural AKHDAN اخدان) meaning secret friends,chums,those man or women who commit adultery in secret. and in QURAN this word is used for both adulterous man and woman. ALLAH said
Surat Al-Mā'idah (The Table Spread) - سورة المائدة
5:5
الْيَوْمَ أُحِلَّ لَكُمُ الطَّيِّبَاتُ ۖ وَطَعَامُ الَّذِينَ أُوتُوا الْكِتَابَ حِلٌّ لَّكُمْ وَطَعَامُكُمْ حِلٌّ لَّهُمْ ۖ وَالْمُحْصَنَاتُ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنَاتِ وَالْمُحْصَنَاتُ مِنَ الَّذِينَ أُوتُوا الْكِتَابَ مِن قَبْلِكُمْ إِذَا آتَيْتُمُوهُنَّ أُجُورَهُنَّ   مُحْصِنِينَ غَيْرَ مُسَافِحِينَ وَلَا مُتَّخِذِي أَخْدَانٍ ۗ   وَمَن يَكْفُرْ بِالْإِيمَانِ فَقَدْ حَبِطَ عَمَلُهُ وَهُوَ فِي الْآخِرَةِ مِنَ الْخَاسِرِينَ
This day [all] good foods have been made lawful, and the food of those who were given the Scripture is lawful for you and your food is lawful for them. And [lawful in marriage are] chaste women from among the believers and chaste women from among those who were given the Scripture before you, when you have given them their due compensation,   desiring chastity, not unlawful sexual intercourse or taking [secret] lovers  . And whoever denies the faith - his work has become worthless, and he, in the Hereafter, will be among the losers.
and on a second place.
Surat An-Nisā' (The Women) - سورة النساء
4:25
وَمَن لَّمْ يَسْتَطِعْ مِنكُمْ طَوْلًا أَن يَنكِحَ الْمُحْصَنَاتِ الْمُؤْمِنَاتِ فَمِن مَّا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَانُكُم مِّن فَتَيَاتِكُمُ الْمُؤْمِنَاتِ ۚ وَاللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِإِيمَانِكُم ۚ بَعْضُكُم مِّن بَعْضٍ ۚ فَانكِحُوهُنَّ بِإِذْنِ أَهْلِهِنَّ وَآتُوهُنَّ أُجُورَهُنَّ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ   مُحْصَنَاتٍ غَيْرَ مُسَافِحَاتٍ وَلَا مُتَّخِذَاتِ أَخْدَانٍ ۚ   فَإِذَا أُحْصِنَّ فَإِنْ أَتَيْنَ بِفَاحِشَةٍ فَعَلَيْهِنَّ نِصْفُ مَا عَلَى الْمُحْصَنَاتِ مِنَ الْعَذَابِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ لِمَنْ خَشِيَ الْعَنَتَ مِنكُمْ ۚ وَأَن تَصْبِرُوا خَيْرٌ لَّكُمْ ۗ وَاللَّهُ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
And whoever among you cannot [find] the means to marry free, believing women, then [he may marry] from those whom your right hands possess of believing slave girls. And Allah is most knowing about your faith. You [believers] are of one another. So marry them with the permission of their people and give them their due compensation according to what is acceptable.   [They should be] chaste, neither [of] those who commit unlawful intercourse randomly nor those who take [secret] lovers  . But once they are sheltered in marriage, if they should commit adultery, then for them is half the punishment for free [unmarried] women. This [allowance] is for him among you who fears sin, but to be patient is better for you. And Allah is Forgiving and Merciful.
7 DAAAABAH(دَآبَّة)  :is used in very wide meanings. DABBA(دَبَّ) literally eans HARKAH 3LY ALARD AKHFF MIN ALMASHY(حركة علي الارض اخفّ من المشي) meaning to walk slower than the normal pace on the earth and meaning crawling.to wallk like snake or toddler that learns to walk on hands and feets all are included in DABBA. from this point of view any living thing that walks on the surface of the earth is encompassed by the word DABBAH. ALLAH said
Surat Hūd (Hud) - سورة هود

2 Commonly misunderstood
1 TAQRYR(تقرير)  : in urdu, this word is used for orating,to give speech, or public advice which is incorrect from lexical point of view.
QARRA(قَرَّ) in the Quran and from lexicon point of views is used in two meaning a)cool off and QARRAH 3YN(قرّة عين) meaning coolness of eye. Muhammad(PBUH)said QARRATAH 3YNY FI ALSALAH(قرّة عيني في الصّلَوة) meaning coolness of my eyes in Prayer. ALLAH said
Surat Maryam (Mary) - سورة مريم
19:26
فَكُلِي وَاشْرَبِي وَقَرِّي عَيْنًا ۖ   فَإِمَّا تَرَيِنَّ مِنَ الْبَشَرِ أَحَدًا فَقُولِي إِنِّي نَذَرْتُ لِلرَّحْمَٰنِ صَوْمًا فَلَنْ أُكَلِّمَ الْيَوْمَ إِنسِيًّا
So eat and drink and be contented.   And if you see from among humanity anyone, say, 'Indeed, I have vowed to the Most Merciful abstention, so I will not speak today to [any] man.' "
and QARR ALYWM(قرَّ اليوم) meaning today has been a cold day,and its second meaning is to settle, to stay calm. ALLAH said
Surat Al-'Aĥzāb (The Combined Forces) - سورة الأحزاب
33:33
وَقَرْنَ فِي بُيُوتِكُنَّ   وَلَا تَبَرَّجْنَ تَبَرُّجَ الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ الْأُولَىٰ ۖ وَأَقِمْنَ الصَّلَاةَ وَآتِينَ الزَّكَاةَ وَأَطِعْنَ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ ۚ إِنَّمَا يُرِيدُ اللَّهُ لِيُذْهِبَ عَنكُمُ الرِّجْسَ أَهْلَ الْبَيْتِ وَيُطَهِّرَكُمْ تَطْهِيرًا
And abide in your houses   and do not display yourselves as [was] the display of the former times of ignorance. And establish prayer and give zakah and obey Allah and His Messenger. Allah intends only to remove from you the impurity [of sin], O people of the [Prophet's] household, and to purify you with [extensive] purification.
and AQARR(اَقَرَّ) meaning to acknowledge, to hold, and QAWWARA(TAQREERA)(قَوَّرَ(تقريرا) meaning to acknowledge in some matter and also to admit the truth and also to prove truth on someone. and TAQRYRI HADYC تقريري حديث is that ,when some even happend in front of MUHAMMAD(PBUH)and he stayed silent and didn't forbid it. then its reason is proved. so that matter or discourse is left at its place. from these clear evidence its obvious that TAQREER when used in the meaning of SPEECH is wrong as per QURAN and Lexicon' aspect.
2 ZLYL( ذليل)  : in urdu it implies a wicked,destitute person.even though ZLYL could mean humble,incapable,weak but not wicked or evil. Antonym of ZLYL is 3ZYZعزيز. and 3ZYZ meaning dominant(in the most widest possible meaning), Excellent(Impressive).thus ZLYL meaning under dominance, and weak. ALLAH said
Surat 'Āli `Imrān (Family of Imran) - سورة آل عمران
3:123
وَلَقَدْ نَصَرَكُمُ اللَّهُ بِبَدْرٍ وَأَنتُمْ أَذِلَّةٌ ۖ   فَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ
And already had Allah given you victory at [the battle of] Badr while you were few in number  . Then fear Allah ; perhaps you will be grateful.
and on a second place said:
Surat Al-Munāfiqūn (The Hypocrites) - سورة المنافقون
63:8
يَقُولُونَ لَئِن رَّجَعْنَا إِلَى الْمَدِينَةِ لَيُخْرِجَنَّ الْأَعَزُّ مِنْهَا الْأَذَلَّ   ۚ وَلِلَّهِ الْعِزَّةُ وَلِرَسُولِهِ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَلَٰكِنَّ الْمُنَافِقِينَ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
They say, "If we return to al-Madinah, the more honored [for power] will surely expel therefrom the more humble."   And to Allah belongs [all] honor, and to His Messenger, and to the believers, but the hypocrites do not know.
and from ZLL ذلّ also is ISM FA3L(اسم فاعل) ZLYL and ZALUWL(ذَلُول).ZLYL meaning incapable,weak,lethargy. and ZALUWL meaning ,one that follow eaily,that becomes obedient easily. obedient to command. ALLAH said
Surat Al-Mulk (The Sovereignty) - سورة الملك
67:15
هُوَ الَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الْأَرْضَ ذَلُولًا   فَامْشُوا فِي مَنَاكِبِهَا وَكُلُوا مِن رِّزْقِهِ ۖ وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ
It is He who made the earth tame for you   - so walk among its slopes and eat of His provision - and to Him is the resurrection.
on a second place said:
Surat Al-Baqarah (The Cow) - سورة البقرة
2:71
قَالَ إِنَّهُ يَقُولُ إِنَّهَا بَقَرَةٌ لَّا ذَلُولٌ تُثِيرُ الْأَرْضَ وَلَا تَسْقِي الْحَرْثَ   مُسَلَّمَةٌ لَّا شِيَةَ فِيهَا ۚ قَالُوا الْآنَ جِئْتَ بِالْحَقِّ ۚ فَذَبَحُوهَا وَمَا كَادُوا يَفْعَلُونَ
He said, "He says, 'It is a cow neither trained to plow the earth nor to irrigate the field,   one free from fault with no spot upon her.' " They said, "Now you have come with the truth." So they slaughtered her, but they could hardly do it.
3 RAQBAH(رقبة)  :in urdu it means area= length x width of something. this meaning is found neither in QURAN nor in lexicon.RAQBAH is said to the back side of neck or nape . because saying part of a thing implies whole thus RAQBAH means slave.and RAQBرقب means to hit on someone nape and also to keep one under strict surveillance.This word can be used for surveillance,wait,taking care,looking after, and protection as used in the QURAN but it's usage as AREA is not found anywhere in the lexicon. ALLAH said:
Surat Al-Balad (The City) - سورة البلد
90:12
وَمَا أَدْرَاكَ مَا الْعَقَبَةُ
And what can make you know what is [breaking through] the difficult pass?
Surat Al-Balad (The City) - سورة البلد
90:13
فَكُّ رَقَبَةٍ
It is the freeing of a slave
4 DLL( ضَلّ)  : means to be lost and also to lost the way.In urdu its translation as GUMRAH HWNA(گمراه هونا) is correct but this word's meaning is taken incorrectly i.e. to be punishable in hell owing to taking wrong path, that's why most translator had weird translations for
Surat Ađ-Đuĥaá (The Morning Hours) - سورة الضحى
93:7
وَوَجَدَكَ   ضَالًّا   فَهَدَىٰ
And He found you   lost   and guided [you],
even though its straight forward translation is "you could not get the way (of guidance).ALLAH guided you to that path.
In the Quran
Surat As-Sajdah (The Prostration) - سورة السجدة
32:10
وَقَالُوا أَإِذَا ضَلَلْنَا فِي الْأَرْضِ   أَإِنَّا لَفِي خَلْقٍ جَدِيدٍ ۚ بَلْ هُم بِلِقَاءِ رَبِّهِمْ كَافِرُونَ
And they say, "When we are lost within the earth  , will we indeed be [recreated] in a new creation?" Rather, they are, in [the matter of] the meeting with their Lord, disbelievers.
and second place:
Surat Al-Baqarah (The Cow) - سورة البقرة
2:282
يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا إِذَا تَدَايَنتُم بِدَيْنٍ إِلَىٰ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى فَاكْتُبُوهُ ۚ وَلْيَكْتُب بَّيْنَكُمْ كَاتِبٌ بِالْعَدْلِ ۚ وَلَا يَأْبَ كَاتِبٌ أَن يَكْتُبَ كَمَا عَلَّمَهُ اللَّهُ ۚ فَلْيَكْتُبْ وَلْيُمْلِلِ الَّذِي عَلَيْهِ الْحَقُّ وَلْيَتَّقِ اللَّهَ رَبَّهُ وَلَا يَبْخَسْ مِنْهُ شَيْئًا ۚ فَإِن كَانَ الَّذِي عَلَيْهِ الْحَقُّ سَفِيهًا أَوْ ضَعِيفًا أَوْ لَا يَسْتَطِيعُ أَن يُمِلَّ هُوَ فَلْيُمْلِلْ وَلِيُّهُ بِالْعَدْلِ ۚ وَاسْتَشْهِدُوا شَهِيدَيْنِ مِن رِّجَالِكُمْ ۖ فَإِن لَّمْ يَكُونَا رَجُلَيْنِ فَرَجُلٌ وَامْرَأَتَانِ مِمَّن تَرْضَوْنَ مِنَ الشُّهَدَاءِ   أَن تَضِلَّ إِحْدَاهُمَا   فَتُذَكِّرَ إِحْدَاهُمَا الْأُخْرَىٰ ۚ وَلَا يَأْبَ الشُّهَدَاءُ إِذَا مَا دُعُوا ۚ وَلَا تَسْأَمُوا أَن تَكْتُبُوهُ صَغِيرًا أَوْ كَبِيرًا إِلَىٰ أَجَلِهِ ۚ ذَٰلِكُمْ أَقْسَطُ عِندَ اللَّهِ وَأَقْوَمُ لِلشَّهَادَةِ وَأَدْنَىٰ أَلَّا تَرْتَابُوا ۖ إِلَّا أَن تَكُونَ تِجَارَةً حَاضِرَةً تُدِيرُونَهَا بَيْنَكُمْ فَلَيْسَ عَلَيْكُمْ جُنَاحٌ أَلَّا تَكْتُبُوهَا ۗ وَأَشْهِدُوا إِذَا تَبَايَعْتُمْ ۚ وَلَا يُضَارَّ كَاتِبٌ وَلَا شَهِيدٌ ۚ وَإِن تَفْعَلُوا فَإِنَّهُ فُسُوقٌ بِكُمْ ۗ وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ ۖ وَيُعَلِّمُكُمُ اللَّهُ ۗ وَاللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِيمٌ
O you who have believed, when you contract a debt for a specified term, write it down. And let a scribe write [it] between you in justice. Let no scribe refuse to write as Allah has taught him. So let him write and let the one who has the obligation dictate. And let him fear Allah , his Lord, and not leave anything out of it. But if the one who has the obligation is of limited understanding or weak or unable to dictate himself, then let his guardian dictate in justice. And bring to witness two witnesses from among your men. And if there are not two men [available], then a man and two women from those whom you accept as witnesses -   so that if one of the women errs  , then the other can remind her. And let not the witnesses refuse when they are called upon. And do not be [too] weary to write it, whether it is small or large, for its [specified] term. That is more just in the sight of Allah and stronger as evidence and more likely to prevent doubt between you, except when it is an immediate transaction which you conduct among yourselves. For [then] there is no blame upon you if you do not write it. And take witnesses when you conclude a contract. Let no scribe be harmed or any witness. For if you do so, indeed, it is [grave] disobedience in you. And fear Allah . And Allah teaches you. And Allah is Knowing of all things.
and third place:
Surat Al-'A`rāf (The Heights) - سورة الأعراف
7:37
فَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّنِ افْتَرَىٰ عَلَى اللَّهِ كَذِبًا أَوْ كَذَّبَ بِآيَاتِهِ ۚ أُولَٰئِكَ يَنَالُهُمْ نَصِيبُهُم مِّنَ الْكِتَابِ ۖ حَتَّىٰ إِذَا جَاءَتْهُمْ رُسُلُنَا يَتَوَفَّوْنَهُمْ قَالُوا أَيْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ ۖ   قَالُوا ضَلُّوا عَنَّا   وَشَهِدُوا عَلَىٰ أَنفُسِهِمْ أَنَّهُمْ كَانُوا كَافِرِينَ
And who is more unjust than one who invents about Allah a lie or denies His verses? Those will attain their portion of the decree until when Our messengers come to them to take them in death, they will say, "Where are those you used to invoke besides Allah ?"   They will say, "They have departed from us  ," and will bear witness against themselves that they were disbelievers.
thus DALLA means only unable to find way,to be diverted. and the meaning that we took for this QURAN has used words like GHWA(غوَي) JARA(جَارَ) and ALHADA(اَلْحَدَ) etc.
5 3ZYZ(عزيز)  : we took its meaning as relatives or near relatives especially one who are younger in age as well. this meaning is wrong as per QURAN and LEXICON. antonym of 3ZYZ is ZLYL(ذليل)meaning weak, under dominance. and 3ZYZ meaning dominant,having upper hand,powerful as it's been explained aforementioned in ZLYL

O you who have believed, when you contract a debt for a specified term, write it down. And let a scribe write [it] between you in justice. Let no scribe refuse to write as Allah has taught him. So let him write and let the one who has the obligation dictate. And let him fear Allah , his Lord, and not leave anything out of it. But if the one who has the obligation is of limited understanding or weak or unable to dictate himself, then let his guardian dictate in justice. And bring to witness two witnesses from among your men. And if there are not two men [available], then a man and two women from those whom you accept as witnesses - so that if one of the women errs, then the other can remind her. And let not the witnesses refuse when they are called upon. And do not be [too] weary to write it, whether it is small or large, for its [specified] term. That is more just in the sight of Allah and stronger as evidence and more likely to prevent doubt between you, except when it is an immediate transaction which you conduct among yourselves. For [then] there is no blame upon you if you do not write it. And take witnesses when you conclude a contract. Let no scribe be harmed or any witness. For if you do so, indeed, it is [grave] disobedience in you. And fear Allah . And Allah teaches you. And Allah is Knowing of all things.

4 Difference between Lexical meaning and Shariah meaning
Words mentioned below are those which when used in the Quran implies a specific meaning but Lexicon doesn't confirm it
1 AZZAN(اذََي)  : In the Quran
Surat Al-Baqarah (The Cow) - سورة البقرة
2:222
وَ  يَسْأَلُونَكَ عَنِ الْمَحِيضِ ۖ قُلْ هُوَ أَذًى   فَاعْتَزِلُوا النِّسَاءَ فِي الْمَحِيضِ ۖ وَلَا تَقْرَبُوهُنَّ حَتَّىٰ يَطْهُرْنَ ۖ فَإِذَا تَطَهَّرْنَ فَأْتُوهُنَّ مِنْ حَيْثُ أَمَرَكُمُ اللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ التَّوَّابِينَ وَيُحِبُّ الْمُتَطَهِّرِينَ
And   they ask you about menstruation. Say, "It is harm  , so keep away from wives during menstruation. And do not approach them until they are pure. And when they have purified themselves, then come to them from where Allah has ordained for you. Indeed, Allah loves those who are constantly repentant and loves those who purify themselves."
now see, AZZAN literaly means pain, and is used in this meaning many a times in the QURAN but at this place it means impurity,filth,unclean or QIDR( قِدْر). this meaning is not confirmed by lexicon
2 JARAMA(جَرَمَ)  : in Quran IJRAM اجرام is used for sin or guilt or crime, that is to some extent confirmed by lexicon but Quran has used JARAMA (Trilateral isolaed )as to provoke for sin, to involve one to sin is not confirmed by the lexicon. JARAMA meaning to cut, to earn,to sin in lexicon but to provoke to sin is not.
whereas in the QURAN
Surat Hūd (Hud) - سورة هود
11:89
وَيَا قَوْمِ   لَا يَجْرِمَنَّكُمْ شِقَاقِي   أَن يُصِيبَكُم مِّثْلُ مَا أَصَابَ قَوْمَ نُوحٍ أَوْ قَوْمَ هُودٍ أَوْ قَوْمَ صَالِحٍ ۚ وَمَا قَوْمُ لُوطٍ مِّنكُم بِبَعِيدٍ
And O my people,   let not [your] dissension from me cause   you to be struck by that similar to what struck the people of Noah or the people of Hud or the people of Salih. And the people of Lot are not from you far away.
Surat Al-Mā'idah (The Table Spread) - سورة المائدة
5:2
يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لَا تُحِلُّوا شَعَائِرَ اللَّهِ وَلَا الشَّهْرَ الْحَرَامَ وَلَا الْهَدْيَ وَلَا الْقَلَائِدَ وَلَا آمِّينَ الْبَيْتَ الْحَرَامَ يَبْتَغُونَ فَضْلًا مِّن رَّبِّهِمْ وَرِضْوَانًا ۚ وَإِذَا حَلَلْتُمْ فَاصْطَادُوا ۚ وَ  لَا يَجْرِمَنَّكُمْ شَنَآنُ قَوْمٍ   أَن صَدُّوكُمْ عَنِ الْمَسْجِدِ الْحَرَامِ أَن تَعْتَدُوا ۘ وَتَعَاوَنُوا عَلَى الْبِرِّ وَالتَّقْوَىٰ ۖ وَلَا تَعَاوَنُوا عَلَى الْإِثْمِ وَالْعُدْوَانِ ۚ وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ ۖ إِنَّ اللَّهَ شَدِيدُ الْعِقَابِ
O you who have believed, do not violate the rites of Allah or [the sanctity of] the sacred month or [neglect the marking of] the sacrificial animals and garlanding [them] or [violate the safety of] those coming to the Sacred House seeking bounty from their Lord and [His] approval. But when you come out of ihram, then [you may] hunt. And   do not let the hatred of a people for having obstructed you from al-Masjid al-Haram lead you to transgress  . And cooperate in righteousness and piety, but do not cooperate in sin and aggression. And fear Allah ; indeed, Allah is severe in penalty.
3 JANA(جَنَي):   literal meaning is to pick ripe fruits or collect them .and JANA meaning one selected whether its a fruit or honey. and it is bovious that a fruit can only be selected when it had already been picked off the tree. but In Quran this word is used for hanging ripe fruit on the tree. as said
Surat Ar-Raĥmān (The Beneficent) - سورة الرحمن
55:54
مُتَّكِئِينَ عَلَىٰ فُرُشٍ بَطَائِنُهَا مِنْ إِسْتَبْرَقٍ ۚ   وَجَنَى الْجَنَّتَيْنِ دَانٍ
[They are] reclining on beds whose linings are of silk brocade,   and the fruit of the two gardens is hanging low.
4 HABASA(حَبَسَ)  :literally means to stop, to close, to imprison but not to make stand. In the Quran
Surat Al-Mā'idah (The Table Spread) - سورة المائدة
5:106
يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا شَهَادَةُ بَيْنِكُمْ إِذَا حَضَرَ أَحَدَكُمُ الْمَوْتُ حِينَ الْوَصِيَّةِ اثْنَانِ ذَوَا عَدْلٍ مِّنكُمْ أَوْ آخَرَانِ مِنْ غَيْرِكُمْ إِنْ أَنتُمْ ضَرَبْتُمْ فِي الْأَرْضِ فَأَصَابَتْكُم مُّصِيبَةُ الْمَوْتِ ۚ   تَحْبِسُونَهُمَا مِن بَعْدِ الصَّلَاةِ   فَيُقْسِمَانِ بِاللَّهِ إِنِ ارْتَبْتُمْ لَا نَشْتَرِي بِهِ ثَمَنًا وَلَوْ كَانَ ذَا قُرْبَىٰ ۙ وَلَا نَكْتُمُ شَهَادَةَ اللَّهِ إِنَّا إِذًا لَّمِنَ الْآثِمِينَ
O you who have believed, testimony [should be taken] among you when death approaches one of you at the time of bequest - [that of] two just men from among you or two others from outside if you are traveling through the land and the disaster of death should strike you.   Detain them after the prayer   and let them both swear by Allah if you doubt [their testimony, saying], "We will not exchange our oath for a price, even if he should be a near relative, and we will not withhold the testimony of Allah . Indeed, we would then be of the sinful."
but in TAFHEEM UL QURAN.it means "to stop" which confirms with lexicon
5 SA-AH(سَوْءَةَ):  SUW-(سُوْء) meaning bad,SAYYIAH(سَيِّئَة) meaning bad deed, SAA-A(سَاءَ) meaning to be bad and ASA-(اساء) meaning to make bad,to corrupt and SU-AH()meaning bad that looks bad.it hints to privates of man and woman as if it's naked then it looks bad.and SA-AH meaning "dead body" is not even its hinted meaning. and neither any lexicon confirm it. but in SURAH MAIDA AYAH 31 this word is used in the meaning of "dead body" and the problem is that none other meaning fits here
Surat Al-Mā'idah (The Table Spread) - سورة المائدة
5:31
فَبَعَثَ اللَّهُ غُرَابًا يَبْحَثُ فِي الْأَرْضِ لِيُرِيَهُ كَيْفَ يُوَارِي سَوْءَةَ أَخِيهِ ۚ قَالَ يَا وَيْلَتَا أَعَجَزْتُ أَنْ أَكُونَ مِثْلَ هَٰذَا الْغُرَابِ فَأُوَارِيَ   سَوْءَةَ   أَخِي ۖ فَأَصْبَحَ مِنَ النَّادِمِينَ
Then Allah sent a crow searching in the ground to show him how to hide the disgrace of his brother. He said, "O woe to me! Have I failed to be like this crow and hide the   body   of my brother?" And he became of the regretful.
6 QUTUF( قُطُوْف):  like JANA(جَنَي),QUTUF is used for selected fruit and especially bunch of grapes when it's being selected. and its plural is QITAFقِطَاف and QUTUF but QURAN has used this word for such bunches or ears which are riped but still hanging on the tree. ALLAH said
Surat Al-Ĥāqqah (The Reality) - سورة الحاقة
69:22
فِي جَنَّةٍ عَالِيَةٍ
In an elevated garden,
Surat Al-Ĥāqqah (The Reality) - سورة الحاقة
69:23
قُطُوفُهَا دَانِيَةٌ
Its [fruit] to be picked hanging near.
and another place
Surat Al-'Insān (The Man) - سورة الانسان
76:14
وَدَانِيَةً عَلَيْهِمْ ظِلَالُهَا   وَذُلِّلَتْ قُطُوفُهَا تَذْلِيلًا
And near above them are its shades,   and its [fruit] to be picked will be lowered in compliance  .
7 MISBAH and SIRAJ   ,for discussion see in CHARAGH
8 NIHLATAN(نِحْلَةً)  :NAHALA(نَحَلَ) meaning to be feeble, to give something to someone and NAHL(نَحْل) meaning donation,charity,feeble and thin adn NIHLATAN meaning to claim (wrong matter), to call names (to someone),(disease causing someone)to make thin. now see in the QURAN
Surat An-Nisā' (The Women) - سورة النساء
4:4
وَآتُوا النِّسَاءَ صَدُقَاتِهِنَّ نِحْلَةً ۚ   فَإِن طِبْنَ لَكُمْ عَن شَيْءٍ مِّنْهُ نَفْسًا فَكُلُوهُ هَنِيئًا مَّرِيئًا
And give the women [upon marriage] their [bridal] gifts graciously  . But if they give up willingly to you anything of it, then take it in satisfaction and ease.
and in arabic exegesis ,NAHLAH نحلة is translated as 3N TYB NFS(عن طيب نفس) meaning joy of heart. now in lexicon it means to give or to donate but for it ATUHUNNA اَتُوْهُنَّ and SADUQAT صَدُقَات already exist.NAHLAH meaning joy of heart is not found in the lexicon

O you who have believed, testimony [should be taken] among you when death approaches one of you at the time of bequest - [that of] two just men from among you or two others from outside if you are traveling through the land and the disaster of death should strike you. Detain them after the prayer and let them both swear by Allah if you doubt [their testimony, saying], "We will not exchange our oath for a price, even if he should be a near relative, and we will not withhold the testimony of Allah . Indeed, we would then be of the sinful."

but in TAFHEEM UL QURAN.it means "to stop" which confirms with lexicon

5 SA-AH(سَوْءَةَ):SUW-(سُوْء) meaning bad,SAYYIAH(سَيِّئَة) meaning bad deed, SAA-A(سَاءَ) meaning to be bad and ASA-(اساء) meaning to make bad,to corrupt and SU-AH()meaning bad that looks bad.it hints to privates of man and woman as if it's naked then it looks bad.and SA-AH meaning "dead body" is not even its hinted meaning. and neither any lexicon confirm it. but in SURAH MAIDA AYAH 31 this word is used in the meaning of "dead body" and the problem is that none other meaning fits here

Then Allah sent a crow searching in the ground to show him how to hide the disgrace of his brother. He said, "O woe to me! Have I failed to be like this crow and hide the body of my brother?" And he became of the regretful.

6 QUTUF( قُطُوْف):like JANA(جَنَي),QUTUF is used for selected fruit and especially bunch of grapes when it's being selected. and its plural is QITAFقِطَاف and QUTUF but QURAN has used this word for such bunches or ears which are riped but still hanging on the tree. ALLAH said

In an elevated garden,

and another place

وَدَانِيَةً عَلَيْهِمْ ظِلَالُهَا وَذُلِّلَتْ قُطُوفُهَا تَذْلِيلًا

And near above them are its shades, and its [fruit] to be picked will be lowered in compliance.

7 MISBAH and SIRAJ ,for discussion see in CHARAGH

8 NIHLATAN(نِحْلَةً):NAHALA(نَحَلَ) meaning to be feeble, to give something to someone and NAHL(نَحْل) meaning donation,charity,feeble and thin adn NIHLATAN meaning to claim (wrong matter), to call names (to someone),(disease causing someone)to make thin. now see in the QURAN

وَآتُوا النِّسَاءَ صَدُقَاتِهِنَّ نِحْلَةً ۚ فَإِن طِبْنَ لَكُمْ عَن شَيْءٍ مِّنْهُ نَفْسًا فَكُلُوهُ هَنِيئًا مَّرِيئًا

And give the women [upon marriage] their [bridal] gifts graciously. But if they give up willingly to you anything of it, then take it in satisfaction and ease.

and in arabic exegesis ,NAHLAH نحلة is translated as 3N TYB NFS(عن طيب نفس) meaning joy of heart. now in lexicon it means to give or to donate but for it ATUHUNNA اَتُوْهُنَّ and SADUQAT صَدُقَات already exist.NAHLAH meaning joy of heart is not found in the lexicon

And the Day those who disbelieved are exposed to the Fire [it will be said], "You exhausted your pleasures during your worldly life and enjoyed them,   so this Day you will be awarded the punishment of [extreme] humiliation   because you were arrogant upon the earth without right and because you were defiantly disobedient."

5 Amazing Difference by Changing Vowel marking of FA(ف) Letter

1 AMR( اَمْر) and IMR(اِمْر):AMR meaning some matter or deed(plural AMWR امور)but IMR means highly dislike matter or deed which is against both SHARIAH and Intellect.In the Quran

Surat Al-Kahf (The Cave) - سورة الكهف

18:71

فَانطَلَقَا حَتَّىٰ إِذَا رَكِبَا فِي السَّفِينَةِ خَرَقَهَا ۖ قَالَ أَخَرَقْتَهَا لِتُغْرِقَ أَهْلَهَا لَقَدْ جِئْتَ شَيْئًا إِمْرًا

So they set out, until when they had embarked on the ship, al-Khidh r tore it open. [Moses] said, "Have you torn it open to drown its people? You have certainly done a grave thing."

2 BAYD(بَيْض) and BIYD(بِيْض): BAYD is plural of BYDAH بيضة meaning eggs,BADA( بَاضَ) meaning laying egg by hen and BYAD بياض meaning white milk, ALLAH said

Surat Aş-Şāffāt (Those who set the Ranks) - سورة الصافات

37:49

كَأَنَّهُنَّ بَيْضٌ مَّكْنُونٌ

As if they were [delicate] eggs, well-protected.

and BIYD is plural of ABYAD اَبْيَض meaning one of white color, and its feminie is BAYDA- بَيْضَاءَ and plural of both ABYAD and BAYDA- is BAYDبِيْض. In the Quran

Surat Fāţir (Originator) - سورة فاطر

35:27

أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ اللَّهَ أَنزَلَ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً فَأَخْرَجْنَا بِهِ ثَمَرَاتٍ مُّخْتَلِفًا أَلْوَانُهَا ۚ وَمِنَ الْجِبَالِ جُدَدٌ بِيضٌ وَحُمْرٌ مُّخْتَلِفٌ أَلْوَانُهَا وَغَرَابِيبُ سُودٌ

Do you not see that Allah sends down rain from the sky, and We produce thereby fruits of varying colors? And in the mountains are tracts, white and red of varying shades and [some] extremely black.

3 HAML( حَمْل) and HIML(حِمْل): HAML meaning that load which one burdens over whether on one's head or back or female in her body.but HIML specified that quantity of load which is the most that some one can take. In the Quran

12:72

قَالُوا نَفْقِدُ صُوَاعَ الْمَلِكِ وَلِمَن جَاءَ بِهِ حِمْلُ بَعِيرٍ وَأَنَا بِهِ زَعِيمٌ

They said, "We are missing the measure of the king. And for he who produces it is [the reward of] a camel's load, and I am responsible for it."

4 KHABR(خَبْر ) and KHUBR(خُبْر): KHABR is a well known word and KHUBR is such a KHABR which is proved true by experimenting and observation. and KHUBR meaning knowledge,experiment,test.It is said SADDAQA ALKHABRU ALKHUBR( صَدَّقَ الْخَبْرُ الْخُبْر) meaning experiment and observation verified the news(that one listens,unverified)in the QURAN

Surat Al-Kahf (The Cave) - سورة الكهف

18:68

وَكَيْفَ تَصْبِرُ عَلَىٰ مَا لَمْ تُحِطْ بِهِ خُبْرًا

And how can you have patience for what you do not encompass in knowledge?"

5 KHALQ( خَلْق ) and KHULQ(خُلْق) or KHULUQ(خُلُقُ ): KHALQ meaning birth- KHILQAT( خِلْقَت)-KHALQATAخَلْقَتَ and it relates to the apparent shape and face of something. and it applies to all living or nonliving. as said

Surat Al-'A`rāf (The Heights) - سورة الأعراف

7:69

أَوَعَجِبْتُمْ أَن جَاءَكُمْ ذِكْرٌ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ عَلَىٰ رَجُلٍ مِّنكُمْ لِيُنذِرَكُمْ ۚ وَاذْكُرُوا إِذْ جَعَلَكُمْ خُلَفَاءَ مِن بَعْدِ قَوْمِ نُوحٍ وَزَادَكُمْ فِي الْخَلْقِ بَسْطَةً ۖ فَاذْكُرُوا آلَاءَ اللَّهِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ

Then do you wonder that there has come to you a reminder from your Lord through a man from among you, that he may warn you? And remember when He made you successors after the people of Noah and increased you in stature extensively. So remember the favors of Allah that you might succeed.

and KHULQ or KHULUQ(plural AKHLAQاخلاق) meaning Human's natural attributes-behaviour,interaction,habits. so this word applies to only on the apparent attributes of those having intellect. and KHLAQخلاق meaning that part or fate which someone get owing to his AKHLAQ. ALLAH said

Surat Al-Qalam (The Pen) - سورة القلم

68:4

وَإِنَّكَ لَعَلَىٰ خُلُقٍ عَظِيمٍ

And indeed, you are of a great moral character.

6 SHAFA(شَفَا) and SHIFA(شِفَا): SHAFA meaning edge of destruction. In the Quran

Surat At-Tawbah (The Repentance) - سورة التوبة

9:109

أَفَمَنْ أَسَّسَ بُنْيَانَهُ عَلَىٰ تَقْوَىٰ مِنَ اللَّهِ وَرِضْوَانٍ خَيْرٌ أَم مَّنْ أَسَّسَ بُنْيَانَهُ عَلَىٰ شَفَا جُرُفٍ هَارٍ فَانْهَارَ بِهِ فِي نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ ۗ وَاللَّهُ لَا يَهْدِي الْقَوْمَ الظَّالِمِينَ

Then is one who laid the foundation of his building on righteousness [with fear] from Allah and [seeking] His approval better or one who laid the foundation of his building on the edge of a bank about to collapse, so it collapsed with him into the fire of Hell? And Allah does not guide the wrongdoing people.

and SHIFA meaning health, to be cured from disease. In the Quran

Surat An-Naĥl (The Bee) - سورة النحل

16:69

ثُمَّ كُلِي مِن كُلِّ الثَّمَرَاتِ فَاسْلُكِي سُبُلَ رَبِّكِ ذُلُلًا ۚ يَخْرُجُ مِن بُطُونِهَا شَرَابٌ مُّخْتَلِفٌ أَلْوَانُهُ فِيهِ شِفَاءٌ لِّلنَّاسِ ۗ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَةً لِّقَوْمٍ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ

Then eat from all the fruits and follow the ways of your Lord laid down [for you]." There emerges from their bellies a drink, varying in colors, in which there is healing for people. Indeed in that is a sign for a people who give thought.

7 SHURB(شُرْب) and SHIRB( شِرْب): SHARIB شَرِبَ meaning 'to drink' from it came three gerunds SHARBشَرْب,SHURB and SHIRB. SHARB is common.SHURB express the condition of drinking and of drinking too much water. In the Quran

Surat Al-Wāqi`ah (The Inevitable) - سورة الواقعة

56:55

فَشَارِبُونَ شُرْبَ الْهِيمِ

And will drink as the drinking of thirsty camels.

and SHIRB part of water, drinking water,turn of drinking. meaning to drink as much water as one get in one's part(allowed). ALLAH said

26:155

قَالَ هَٰذِهِ نَاقَةٌ لَّهَا شِرْبٌ وَلَكُمْ شِرْبُ يَوْمٍ مَّعْلُومٍ

Surat Al-Mā'idah (The Table Spread) - سورة المائدة

5:76

قُلْ أَتَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ مَا لَا يَمْلِكُ لَكُمْ ضَرًّا وَلَا نَفْعًا ۚ وَاللَّهُ هُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ

and DURR commonly used for bodily harm/pain. as said

وَإِذَا مَسَّ الْإِنسَانَ الضُّرُّ دَعَانَا لِجَنبِهِ أَوْ قَاعِدًا أَوْ قَائِمًا فَلَمَّا كَشَفْنَا عَنْهُ ضُرَّهُ مَرَّ كَأَن لَّمْ يَدْعُنَا إِلَىٰ ضُرٍّ مَّسَّهُ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ زُيِّنَ لِلْمُسْرِفِينَ مَا كَانُوا يَعْمَلُونَ

9 MALK(مَلْك ),MILK(مِلْك) and MULK(مُلْك): MALK and MILK are both having similar meaning.MILK is not used in the QURAN and MALK means to have authority over something,control. In the Quran

10 MALAK(مَلَكَ) and MALIK(مَلِك): MALAK meaning angel(plural MALAIK مَلائِك and MALAIKAH مَلَائِكه )

وَلَا أَقُولُ لَكُمْ عِندِي خَزَائِنُ اللَّهِ وَلَا أَعْلَمُ الْغَيْبَ وَلَا أَقُولُ إِنِّي مَلَكٌ وَلَا أَقُولُ لِلَّذِينَ تَزْدَرِي أَعْيُنُكُمْ لَن يُؤْتِيَهُمُ اللَّهُ خَيْرًا ۖ اللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا فِي أَنفُسِهِمْ ۖ إِنِّي إِذًا لَّمِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ

And those [clouds] carrying a load [of water]

Page 1001
6 Some Idioms
1 HIJRAN MAHJURAN(حِجْراً مَّحْجُوْراً)  :HIJARAH حِجَارَة meaning stone. and HIJR حِجْر is said to all those things which are hard like stone and can also serves as shield or protection. people of arab had this habit that when they saw such an enemy from which they feel the danger of having trouble or some other calamity . like we said GOD save use from this. so normally the one listening wouldnot harm the one saying it. QURAN has also used this idiom.
Surat Al-Furqān (The Criterian) - سورة الفرقان
25:22
يَوْمَ يَرَوْنَ الْمَلَائِكَةَ   لَا بُشْرَىٰ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُجْرِمِينَ وَيَقُولُونَ حِجْرًا مَّحْجُورًا
The day they see the angels -   no good tidings will there be that day for the criminals, and [the angels] will say, "Prevented and inaccessible."
2 ADLA(DLW)ALA FULAN اَدْلَي (دلو) الَي فلان  : DALWدَلْو meaning empty well bucket. and ADLAادْلَي means to hang down empty well bucket in the well to fill it up. and DLWT BFULAN(دلوت بفلان) meaning I made FULAN(Mr X)my recommender.and ADLA BIQARABATIH(اَدْلَي بِقَرَبَتِهِ) meaning to get intercession of some relative.to make him a recommender. and ADLA ILA FULAN اَدْلَي الَي فلان meaning to take one's dispute to someone. and it is used when using false means ,one intend to usurp someone else's right. ALLAH said
Surat Al-Baqarah (The Cow) - سورة البقرة
2:188
وَلَا تَأْكُلُوا أَمْوَالَكُم بَيْنَكُم بِالْبَاطِلِ وَتُدْلُوا بِهَا إِلَى الْحُكَّامِ لِتَأْكُلُوا فَرِيقًا مِّنْ أَمْوَالِ النَّاسِ بِالْإِثْمِ   وَأَنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
And do not consume one another's wealth unjustly or send it [in bribery] to the rulers in order that [they might aid] you [to] consume a portion of the wealth of the people in sin  , while you know [it is unlawful].
3 RABATA 3LA ALQALB(رَبَطَ عَلَي القَلْب)  :RABATرَبَطَ meaning strongly tied knot and RABT ALLAH 3LA ALQALBربط الّله علي القلب meaning ALLAH tying knot on unsettling and anxiety of some one's heart.and to grant him success/support of patience. ALLAH said
Surat Al-Qaşaş (The Stories) - سورة القصص
28:10
وَأَصْبَحَ فُؤَادُ أُمِّ مُوسَىٰ فَارِغًا ۖ   إِن كَادَتْ لَتُبْدِي بِهِ لَوْلَا أَن رَّبَطْنَا عَلَىٰ قَلْبِهَا   لِتَكُونَ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ
And the heart of Moses' mother became empty [of all else].   She was about to disclose [the matter concerning] him had We not bound fast her heart   that she would be of the believers.
4 RADD ILA ALHAFIRAH(رَدّ اِلَي الْحَافِرَة)  : HAFARA(حَفَرَ) meaning to dig a hole and HUFRAH(حُفْرَة) meaning hole and grave as well. and HAFIRAHحَافِرَة is feminine of HAFIR(حافر) meaning dugged up earth and inital state/condition as well. and RADD FI ALHAFIRAH رَدّ في الْحَافِرَة meaning from where started ,going back there.[urdu poetry roughly translates as "dust return to settle where it belongs" refers to grave of a person]. In the Quran
Surat An-Nāzi`āt (Those who drag forth) - سورة النازعات
79:10
يَقُولُونَ أَإِنَّا لَمَرْدُودُونَ فِي الْحَافِرَةِ
They are [presently] saying, "Will we indeed be returned to [our] former state [of life]?
5 RYBA ALMNUN(ريبَ المنُون)  :RYBريب is such a doubt which includes anxiety and restlessness.and MANIYYAHمَنِيَّة meaning death,divine predestined(plural is MANAYAمَنَايَا and MANUENمَنُوْن) and RYBA ALMNUN's idiom is said when some person desires on someone other to be cursed with calamities and tribulation and want him dead. and to await for his bad end or time going against him. ALLAH said
Surat Aţ-Ţūr (The Mount) - سورة الطور
52:30
أَمْ يَقُولُونَ شَاعِرٌ نَّتَرَبَّصُ بِهِ رَيْبَ الْمَنُونِ
Or do they say [of you], "A poet for whom we await a misfortune of time?"

إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَعْلَمُ أَنَّكَ تَقُومُ أَدْنَىٰ مِن ثُلُثَيِ اللَّيْلِ وَنِصْفَهُ وَثُلُثَهُ وَطَائِفَةٌ مِّنَ الَّذِينَ مَعَكَ ۚ وَاللَّهُ يُقَدِّرُ اللَّيْلَ وَالنَّهَارَ ۚ عَلِمَ أَن لَّن تُحْصُوهُ فَتَابَ عَلَيْكُمْ ۖ فَاقْرَءُوا مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنَ الْقُرْآنِ ۚ عَلِمَ أَن سَيَكُونُ مِنكُم مَّرْضَىٰ ۙ وَآخَرُونَ يَضْرِبُونَ فِي الْأَرْضِ يَبْتَغُونَ مِن فَضْلِ اللَّهِ ۙ وَآخَرُونَ يُقَاتِلُونَ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ ۖ فَاقْرَءُوا مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنْهُ ۚ وَأَقِيمُوا الصَّلَاةَ وَآتُوا الزَّكَاةَ وَأَقْرِضُوا اللَّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًا ۚ وَمَا تُقَدِّمُوا لِأَنفُسِكُم مِّنْ خَيْرٍ تَجِدُوهُ عِندَ اللَّهِ هُوَ خَيْرًا وَأَعْظَمَ أَجْرًا ۚ وَاسْتَغْفِرُوا اللَّهَ ۖ إِنَّ اللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ

Indeed, your Lord knows, [O Muhammad], that you stand [in prayer] almost two thirds of the night or half of it or a third of it, and [so do] a group of those with you. And Allah determines [the extent of] the night and the day. He has known that you [Muslims] will not be able to do it and has turned to you in forgiveness, so recite what is easy [for you] of the Qur'an. He has known that there will be among you those who are ill and others traveling throughout the land seeking [something] of the bounty of Allah and others fighting for the cause of Allah . So recite what is easy from it and establish prayer and give zakah and loan Allah a goodly loan. And whatever good you put forward for yourselves - you will find it with Allah . It is better and greater in reward. And seek forgiveness of Allah . Indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful.

12 MAGHLUL ALYAD(مَغْلُوْلُ الْيَد): meaning to be miser"detail in BUKHUL KARNA" see under topic GHALLA

13 JAA-A MIN ALGHAIT(جَآءَ مِنَ الغَآئِط):meaning to return after relieving nature's call "see detail in GARHA"

14 QAAB QWSYN(قاب قومين): meaning to be very near, extremely closeness "see detail in NAZDEEK HON under topic QABA"

15 NABAZA 3ALA SAWAAI(نَبَذَ عَلَي سَوَآءٍ): NABZ(نبذ) meaning to throw away something considering it uselessand NABZ AL3HD(نبذ العهد) meaning to break or dishonour some agreement's conditions and NABAZA 3ALA SAWAAI meaning to throw away the agreement on the level of equality meaning both the party to the agreement return back to the condition and level and state of preagreement. and thus terms and conditions of agreement being void. ALLAH said

Surat Al-'Anfāl (The Spoils of War) - سورة الأنفال

8:58

وَإِمَّا تَخَافَنَّ مِن قَوْمٍ خِيَانَةً فَانبِذْ إِلَيْهِمْ عَلَىٰ سَوَاءٍ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يُحِبُّ الْخَائِنِينَ

If you [have reason to] fear from a people betrayal, throw [their treaty] back to them, [putting you] on equal terms. Indeed, Allah does not like traitors.

16 NAKASA 3ALA RASIN(نكَسَ عَلَي رَاسٍ): NKS(نكسَ) meaning to turn upside down and NAKASA RASAHU( نَكَسَ رَاسَهُ) meaning to lower head,to give up, and NAKASA 3ALA RASIN meaning to lower one head in embarrasment and to think. In the Quran

Surat Al-'Anbyā' (The Prophets) - سورة الأنبياء

21:65

ثُمَّ نُكِسُوا عَلَىٰ رُءُوسِهِمْ لَقَدْ عَلِمْتَ مَا هَٰؤُلَاءِ يَنطِقُونَ

Then they reversed themselves, [saying], "You have already known that these do not speak!"

17 WALAJ FI SAMMI ALKHIYAT(وَلَج فِيْ سَمِّ الْخِيَاط):WALAJA وَلَج meaning to enter a narrow place and HATTA YLIJA ALJAMALU FI SAMMI ALKHIYAT(حَتَّي يَلِجَ الْجَمَلُ فِيْ سَمِّ الْخِيَاط) literally means 'till camel enter needle hole' and this idiom is spoken at that time when something is absolutely impossible. ALLAH said

Surat Al-'A`rāf (The Heights) - سورة الأعراف

7:40

إِنَّ الَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا بِآيَاتِنَا وَاسْتَكْبَرُوا عَنْهَا لَا تُفَتَّحُ لَهُمْ أَبْوَابُ السَّمَاءِ وَلَا يَدْخُلُونَ الْجَنَّةَ حَتَّىٰ يَلِجَ الْجَمَلُ فِي سَمِّ الْخِيَاطِ ۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِي الْمُجْرِمِينَ

Indeed, those who deny Our verses and are arrogant toward them - the gates of Heaven will not be opened for them, nor will they enter Paradise until a camel enters into the eye of a needle. And thus do We recompense the criminals.

pg 1007-1008 [End of the Book]
Appendix 5 Miscellaneous
8. HUROOF KA F3L KAY ZAMANAY PAR ASAR
[Effect of Particles on the Tense of Verb]
1 QAD(قد)  :Its a particle of research(Proven) . When it enters on past tense .it converts it in to near past. and itself gves the meaning of Indeed, Certainly. In the Quran
Surat Al-Mujādila (The Pleading Woman) - سورة المجادلة
58:1
قَدْ سَمِعَ اللَّهُ قَوْلَ الَّتِي تُجَادِلُكَ فِي زَوْجِهَا   وَتَشْتَكِي إِلَى اللَّهِ وَاللَّهُ يَسْمَعُ تَحَاوُرَكُمَا ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ سَمِيعٌ بَصِيرٌ
Certainly has Allah heard the speech of the one who argues with you, [O Muhammad], concerning her husband   and directs her complaint to Allah . And Allah hears your dialogue; indeed, Allah is Hearing and Seeing.
and when it enters on MUDARI مضارع (Present-Future)then in it gives the meaning in verb of TAQLEEL(تقليل)[reduction].meaning sometimes that verb occurs and sometimes not. as said
Surat An-Nūr (The Light) - سورة النور
24:63
لَّا تَجْعَلُوا دُعَاءَ الرَّسُولِ بَيْنَكُمْ كَدُعَاءِ بَعْضِكُم بَعْضًا ۚ   قَدْ يَعْلَمُ اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ يَتَسَلَّلُونَ مِنكُمْ لِوَاذًا   ۚ فَلْيَحْذَرِ الَّذِينَ يُخَالِفُونَ عَنْ أَمْرِهِ أَن تُصِيبَهُمْ فِتْنَةٌ أَوْ يُصِيبَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
Do not make [your] calling of the Messenger among yourselves as the call of one of you to another.   Already Allah knows those of you who slip away, concealed by others.   So let those beware who dissent from the Prophet's order, lest fitnah strike them or a painful punishment.
meaning if someone slips away then ALLAH certainly has its knowledge.
2 KANA(كَانَ)  :It comes as perfect verb and as imperfect verb as well. as imperfect if it enters on other past verb then it makes it far past. like KANA ZAHABA(كاَنَ ذَهَبَ) He had gone. and if it enter MUDARI then it converts it to MADI ISTIMRAR (Past Conitnuous)[something that was habitualy done in the past]. as in the Quran
Surat Al-Baqarah (The Cow) - سورة البقرة
2:59
فَبَدَّلَ الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا قَوْلًا غَيْرَ الَّذِي قِيلَ لَهُمْ   فَأَنزَلْنَا عَلَى الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا رِجْزًا مِّنَ السَّمَاءِ بِمَا كَانُوا يَفْسُقُونَ
But those who wronged changed [those words] to a statement other than that which had been said to them,   so We sent down upon those who wronged a punishment from the sky because they were defiantly disobeying  .
3 LAM(لَمْ)  :enters on MUDARI to convert it into negative past. In the Quran
Surat Al-Ĥujurāt (The Rooms) - سورة الحجرات
49:14
قَالَتِ الْأَعْرَابُ آمَنَّا ۖ قُل لَّمْ تُؤْمِنُوا   وَلَٰكِن قُولُوا أَسْلَمْنَا وَلَمَّا يَدْخُلِ الْإِيمَانُ فِي قُلُوبِكُمْ ۖ وَإِن تُطِيعُوا اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ لَا يَلِتْكُم مِّنْ أَعْمَالِكُمْ شَيْئًا ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
The bedouins say, "We have believed." Say, "You have not [yet] believed  ; but say [instead], 'We have submitted,' for faith has not yet entered your hearts. And if you obey Allah and His Messenger, He will not deprive you from your deeds of anything. Indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful."
adding MA(ما) after LAM gives the meaning of "not yet" as in the ayah above
like LAM , LAMMA(لمّا) also make MUDARI ,negative past and it contains the meaning of ISTAGHRAQ( استغراق)[Immersion/Encompass] which is not found in LAM. To make negative past ,interrogative HUMZA(أ) will come before LAM. ALLAH said
Surat Ađ-Đuĥaá (The Morning Hours) - سورة الضحى
93:6
أَلَمْ يَجِدْكَ يَتِيمًا فَآوَىٰ
Did He not find you an orphan and give [you] refuge?
4 LAN(لَنْ)  :enters on MUDARI to make it negative future with emphasis. meaning it gives three changes. a)limits MUDARI to future b)negate it c)this negation is emphatic. like LAYYADRIBA (لَنْ يَّضْرِبَ) meaning He will never going to strike.
In the Quran
Surat Al-Baqarah (The Cow) - سورة البقرة
2:55
وَإِذْ قُلْتُمْ يَا مُوسَىٰ لَن نُّؤْمِنَ لَكَ حَتَّىٰ نَرَى اللَّهَ جَهْرَةً   فَأَخَذَتْكُمُ الصَّاعِقَةُ وَأَنتُمْ تَنظُرُونَ
And [recall] when you said, "O Moses, we will never believe you until we see Allah outright"  ; so the thunderbolt took you while you were looking on.
5 LAW(لَوْ)  :(meaning if)enter on MADI makes it past conditional, and on it's answer ('then' part of the condition) starts with LA( لَ) LAM MAFTUHA(Letter Lam with Fatha ) meaning 'then'.In the Quran
Surat Al-Baqarah (The Cow) - سورة البقرة
2:103
وَلَوْ أَنَّهُمْ آمَنُوا وَاتَّقَوْا لَمَثُوبَةٌ مِّنْ عِندِ اللَّهِ خَيْرٌ ۖ   لَّوْ كَانُوا يَعْلَمُونَ
And if they had believed and feared Allah , then the reward from Allah would have been [far] better,   if they only knew.
6 IN(اِنْ)  :(meaning if)enters on MUDARI to make it conditional and limit it to future.and on its 'then' part also LA (LAM MAFTUHA) enters as in the Quran
Surat Yā-Sīn (Ya Sin) - سورة يس
36:18
قَالُوا إِنَّا تَطَيَّرْنَا بِكُمْ ۖ لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهُوا لَنَرْجُمَنَّكُمْ   وَلَيَمَسَّنَّكُم مِّنَّا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
They said, "Indeed, we consider you a bad omen. If you do not desist, we will surely stone you,   and there will surely touch you, from us, a painful punishment."
7 LAYTA(لَيْتَ)  :(meaning "I wish")enters on past to make it wishful past. and it applies to such a matter which is impossible or atleast difficult. In the Quran
Surat An-Naba' (The Tidings) - سورة النبإ
78:40
إِنَّا أَنذَرْنَاكُمْ عَذَابًا قَرِيبًا يَوْمَ يَنظُرُ الْمَرْءُ مَا قَدَّمَتْ يَدَاهُ   وَيَقُولُ الْكَافِرُ يَا لَيْتَنِي كُنتُ تُرَابًا
Indeed, We have warned you of a near punishment on the Day when a man will observe what his hands have put forth   and the disbeliever will say, "Oh, I wish that I were dust!"
like (optative sentence )wishful past , LAYTA also converts MUDARI to wishful past. the difference between LAYTA and LAW is that LAYTA comes normally for impossible matters whereas LAW for something that is possible. as said
Surat Al-Baqarah (The Cow) - سورة البقرة
2:103
وَلَوْ أَنَّهُمْ آمَنُوا وَاتَّقَوْا لَمَثُوبَةٌ مِّنْ عِندِ اللَّهِ خَيْرٌ ۖ   لَّوْ كَانُوا يَعْلَمُونَ
And if they had believed and feared Allah , then the reward from Allah would have been [far] better,   if they only knew  .
8 IZA(اِذَا)  :meaning when- its (adverb of time)noun of time for future. when it enters on past tense it makes it MUDARI.in the Quran
Surat Al-Baqarah (The Cow) - سورة البقرة
2:13
وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ آمِنُوا   كَمَا آمَنَ النَّاسُ قَالُوا أَنُؤْمِنُ كَمَا آمَنَ السُّفَهَاءُ ۗ أَلَا إِنَّهُمْ هُمُ السُّفَهَاءُ وَلَٰكِن لَّا يَعْلَمُونَ

Appendix 5 Miscellaneous

8. HUROOF KA F3L KAY ZAMANAY PAR ASAR

[Effect of Particles on the Tense of Verb]

1 QAD(قد):Its a particle of research(Proven) . When it enters on past tense .it converts it in to near past. and itself gves the meaning of Indeed, Certainly. In the Quran

Surat Al-Mujādila (The Pleading Woman) - سورة المجادلة

58:1

قَدْ سَمِعَ اللَّهُ قَوْلَ الَّتِي تُجَادِلُكَ فِي زَوْجِهَا وَتَشْتَكِي إِلَى اللَّهِ وَاللَّهُ يَسْمَعُ تَحَاوُرَكُمَا ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ سَمِيعٌ بَصِيرٌ

Certainly has Allah heard the speech of the one who argues with you, [O Muhammad], concerning her husband and directs her complaint to Allah . And Allah hears your dialogue; indeed, Allah is Hearing and Seeing.

and when it enters on MUDARI مضارع (Present-Future)then in it gives the meaning in verb of TAQLEEL(تقليل)[reduction].meaning sometimes that verb occurs and sometimes not. as said

Surat An-Nūr (The Light) - سورة النور

24:63

لَّا تَجْعَلُوا دُعَاءَ الرَّسُولِ بَيْنَكُمْ كَدُعَاءِ بَعْضِكُم بَعْضًا ۚ قَدْ يَعْلَمُ اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ يَتَسَلَّلُونَ مِنكُمْ لِوَاذًا ۚ فَلْيَحْذَرِ الَّذِينَ يُخَالِفُونَ عَنْ أَمْرِهِ أَن تُصِيبَهُمْ فِتْنَةٌ أَوْ يُصِيبَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ

Do not make [your] calling of the Messenger among yourselves as the call of one of you to another. Already Allah knows those of you who slip away, concealed by others. So let those beware who dissent from the Prophet's order, lest fitnah strike them or a painful punishment.

meaning if someone slips away then ALLAH certainly has its knowledge.

2 KANA(كَانَ):It comes as perfect verb and as imperfect verb as well. as imperfect if it enters on other past verb then it makes it far past. like KANA ZAHABA(كاَنَ ذَهَبَ) He had gone. and if it enter MUDARI then it converts it to MADI ISTIMRAR (Past Conitnuous)[something that was habitualy done in the past]. as in the Quran

Surat Al-Baqarah (The Cow) - سورة البقرة

2:59

فَبَدَّلَ الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا قَوْلًا غَيْرَ الَّذِي قِيلَ لَهُمْ فَأَنزَلْنَا عَلَى الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا رِجْزًا مِّنَ السَّمَاءِ بِمَا كَانُوا يَفْسُقُونَ

But those who wronged changed [those words] to a statement other than that which had been said to them, so We sent down upon those who wronged a punishment from the sky because they were defiantly disobeying.

3 LAM(لَمْ):enters on MUDARI to convert it into negative past. In the Quran

Surat Al-Ĥujurāt (The Rooms) - سورة الحجرات

49:14

قَالَتِ الْأَعْرَابُ آمَنَّا ۖ قُل لَّمْ تُؤْمِنُوا وَلَٰكِن قُولُوا أَسْلَمْنَا وَلَمَّا يَدْخُلِ الْإِيمَانُ فِي قُلُوبِكُمْ ۖ وَإِن تُطِيعُوا اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ لَا يَلِتْكُم مِّنْ أَعْمَالِكُمْ شَيْئًا ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ

The bedouins say, "We have believed." Say, "You have not [yet] believed; but say [instead], 'We have submitted,' for faith has not yet entered your hearts. And if you obey Allah and His Messenger, He will not deprive you from your deeds of anything. Indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful."

adding MA(ما) after LAM gives the meaning of "not yet" as in the ayah above

like LAM , LAMMA(لمّا) also make MUDARI ,negative past and it contains the meaning of ISTAGHRAQ( استغراق)[Immersion/Encompass] which is not found in LAM. To make negative past ,interrogative HUMZA(أ) will come before LAM. ALLAH said

Surat Ađ-Đuĥaá (The Morning Hours) - سورة الضحى

93:6

أَلَمْ يَجِدْكَ يَتِيمًا فَآوَىٰ

Did He not find you an orphan and give [you] refuge?

4 LAN(لَنْ):enters on MUDARI to make it negative future with emphasis. meaning it gives three changes. a)limits MUDARI to future b)negate it c)this negation is emphatic. like LAYYADRIBA (لَنْ يَّضْرِبَ) meaning He will never going to strike.

In the Quran

Surat Al-Baqarah (The Cow) - سورة البقرة

2:55

وَإِذْ قُلْتُمْ يَا مُوسَىٰ لَن نُّؤْمِنَ لَكَ حَتَّىٰ نَرَى اللَّهَ جَهْرَةً فَأَخَذَتْكُمُ الصَّاعِقَةُ وَأَنتُمْ تَنظُرُونَ

And [recall] when you said, "O Moses, we will never believe you until we see Allah outright"; so the thunderbolt took you while you were looking on.

5 LAW(لَوْ):(meaning if)enter on MADI makes it past conditional, and on it's answer ('then' part of the condition) starts with LA( لَ) LAM MAFTUHA(Letter Lam with Fatha ) meaning 'then'.In the Quran

Surat Al-Baqarah (The Cow) - سورة البقرة

2:103

وَلَوْ أَنَّهُمْ آمَنُوا وَاتَّقَوْا لَمَثُوبَةٌ مِّنْ عِندِ اللَّهِ خَيْرٌ ۖ لَّوْ كَانُوا يَعْلَمُونَ

And if they had believed and feared Allah , then the reward from Allah would have been [far] better, if they only knew.

6 IN(اِنْ):(meaning if)enters on MUDARI to make it conditional and limit it to future.and on its 'then' part also LA (LAM MAFTUHA) enters as in the Quran

Surat Yā-Sīn (Ya Sin) - سورة يس

36:18

قَالُوا إِنَّا تَطَيَّرْنَا بِكُمْ ۖ لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهُوا لَنَرْجُمَنَّكُمْ وَلَيَمَسَّنَّكُم مِّنَّا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ

They said, "Indeed, we consider you a bad omen. If you do not desist, we will surely stone you, and there will surely touch you, from us, a painful punishment."

7 LAYTA(لَيْتَ):(meaning "I wish")enters on past to make it wishful past. and it applies to such a matter which is impossible or atleast difficult. In the Quran

Surat An-Naba' (The Tidings) - سورة النبإ

78:40

إِنَّا أَنذَرْنَاكُمْ عَذَابًا قَرِيبًا يَوْمَ يَنظُرُ الْمَرْءُ مَا قَدَّمَتْ يَدَاهُ وَيَقُولُ الْكَافِرُ يَا لَيْتَنِي كُنتُ تُرَابًا

Indeed, We have warned you of a near punishment on the Day when a man will observe what his hands have put forth and the disbeliever will say, "Oh, I wish that I were dust!"

like (optative sentence )wishful past , LAYTA also converts MUDARI to wishful past. the difference between LAYTA and LAW is that LAYTA comes normally for impossible matters whereas LAW for something that is possible. as said

Surat Al-Baqarah (The Cow) - سورة البقرة

And if they had believed and feared Allah , then the reward from Allah would have been [far] better, if they only knew.

8 IZA(اِذَا):meaning when- its (adverb of time)noun of time for future. when it enters on past tense it makes it MUDARI.in the Quran

1 BAAP [Father]
Synonyms: WALID,AB
1.1 WALID(وَالِد) : this word is used only for father . meaning only
that person which was in relation to his natural child . similarly for
mother WALIDAH(وَالِده) is used only for natural mother the one that
gives birth . ALLAH said
Surat Luqmān (Luqman) - سورة لقمان
31:33
يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ اتَّقُوا رَبَّكُمْ وَاخْشَوْا يَوْمًا  لَّا يَجْزِي وَالِدٌ عَن وَلَدِهِ وَلَا مَوْلُودٌ هُوَ جَازٍ عَن وَالِدِهِ شَيْئًا  ۚ إِنَّ وَعْدَ اللَّهِ حَقٌّ ۖ فَلَا تَغُرَّنَّكُمُ الْحَيَاةُ الدُّنْيَا وَلَا يَغُرَّنَّكُم بِاللَّهِ الْغَرُورُ
O mankind, fear your Lord and fear a Day  when no father will avail his son, nor will a son avail his father at all .
Indeed, the promise of Allah is truth, so let not the worldly life
delude you and be not deceived about Allah by the Deceiver.
and for both natural mother and father WALIDAEN(وَالِدَيْن) is used as
Surat Luqmān (Luqman) - سورة لقمان
31:14
وَوَصَّيْنَا الْإِنسَانَ بِوَالِدَيْهِ حَمَلَتْهُ أُمُّهُ وَهْنًا عَلَىٰ وَهْنٍ وَفِصَالُهُ فِي عَامَيْنِ  أَنِ اشْكُرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيْكَ  إِلَيَّ الْمَصِيرُ
And We have enjoined upon man [care] for his parents. His mother carried
him, [increasing her] in weakness upon weakness, and his weaning is in
two years.  Be grateful to Me and to your parents ; to Me is the [final] destination.
1.2 AB(اَبْ):
but AB is used in a very wide context . This word is used for father,
grand father, grand grand father and even beyond that for all previous
generations. and for mother father as per the occassion came ABWYN إبوين
or ABWAN إبوِان is used now see it's examples
a) for mother father only
Surat Al-Kahf (The Cave) - سورة الكهف
18:80
وَأَمَّا الْغُلَامُ فَكَانَ أَبَوَاهُ مُؤْمِنَيْنِ  فَخَشِينَا أَن يُرْهِقَهُمَا طُغْيَانًا وَكُفْرًا
And as for the boy, his parents were believers , and we feared that he would overburden them by transgression and disbelief.
b) for several generations
Surat Al-Mu'minūn (The Believers) - سورة المؤمنون
23:24
فَقَالَ الْمَلَأُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا مِن قَوْمِهِ مَا هَٰذَا إِلَّا
بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُكُمْ يُرِيدُ أَن يَتَفَضَّلَ عَلَيْكُمْ وَلَوْ شَاءَ
اللَّهُ لَأَنزَلَ مَلَائِكَةً  مَّا سَمِعْنَا بِهَٰذَا فِي آبَائِنَا الْأَوَّلِينَ
But the eminent among those who disbelieved from his people said, "This
is not but a man like yourselves who wishes to take precedence over you;
and if Allah had willed [to send a messenger], He would have sent down
angels.  We have not heard of this among our forefathers.
c) and these geerations can be alot more as well as in
Surat Al-Ĥaj (The Pilgrimage) - سورة الحج
22:78
وَجَاهِدُوا فِي اللَّهِ حَقَّ جِهَادِهِ ۚ هُوَ اجْتَبَاكُمْ وَمَا جَعَلَ عَلَيْكُمْ فِي الدِّينِ مِنْ حَرَجٍ ۚ  مِّلَّةَ أَبِيكُمْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ۚ هُوَ سَمَّاكُمُ الْمُسْلِمِينَ
مِن قَبْلُ وَفِي هَٰذَا لِيَكُونَ الرَّسُولُ شَهِيدًا عَلَيْكُمْ
وَتَكُونُوا شُهَدَاءَ عَلَى النَّاسِ ۚ فَأَقِيمُوا الصَّلَاةَ وَآتُوا
الزَّكَاةَ وَاعْتَصِمُوا بِاللَّهِ هُوَ مَوْلَاكُمْ ۖ فَنِعْمَ
الْمَوْلَىٰ وَنِعْمَ النَّصِيرُ
And strive for Allah with the striving due to Him. He has chosen you and has not placed upon you in the religion any difficulty.  [It is] the religion of your father, Abraham. Allah named you "Muslims"
before [in former scriptures] and in this [revelation] that the
Messenger may be a witness over you and you may be witnesses over the
people. So establish prayer and give zakah and hold fast to Allah . He
is your protector; and excellent is the protector, and excellent is the
helper.
It must be kept in mind that there are nearly 26 generations between Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) and Prophet Ibrahim (AS) .  Even for Adam(AS)   who is the oldest father of mankind   (first human)  , AB is used as
Surat Al-'A`rāf (The Heights) - سورة الأعراف
7:27
يَا بَنِي آدَمَ لَا يَفْتِنَنَّكُمُ الشَّيْطَانُ كَمَا أَخْرَجَ أَبَوَيْكُم مِّنَ الْجَنَّةِ
يَنزِعُ عَنْهُمَا لِبَاسَهُمَا لِيُرِيَهُمَا سَوْآتِهِمَا ۗ إِنَّهُ
يَرَاكُمْ هُوَ وَقَبِيلُهُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا تَرَوْنَهُمْ ۗ إِنَّا
جَعَلْنَا الشَّيَاطِينَ أَوْلِيَاءَ لِلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
O children of Adam, let not Satan tempt you as he removed your parents from Paradise ,
stripping them of their clothing to show them their private parts.
Indeed, he sees you, he and his tribe, from where you do not see them.
Indeed, We have made the devils allies to those who do not believe.
AB is in actually ABW(إبو) and it refers to providing education and food
of some one. that's why if son spoke to father then generally AB will
be used as
Surat Yūsuf (Joseph) - سورة يوسف
12:100
وَرَفَعَ أَبَوَيْهِ عَلَى الْعَرْشِ وَخَرُّوا لَهُ سُجَّدًا ۖ وَقَالَ  يَا أَبَتِ هَٰذَا تَأْوِيلُ رُؤْيَايَ مِن قَبْلُ
قَدْ جَعَلَهَا رَبِّي حَقًّا ۖ وَقَدْ أَحْسَنَ بِي إِذْ أَخْرَجَنِي
مِنَ السِّجْنِ وَجَاءَ بِكُم مِّنَ الْبَدْوِ مِن بَعْدِ أَن نَّزَغَ
الشَّيْطَانُ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَ إِخْوَتِي ۚ إِنَّ رَبِّي لَطِيفٌ لِّمَا
يَشَاءُ ۚ إِنَّهُ هُوَ الْعَلِيمُ الْحَكِيمُ
And he raised his parents upon the throne, and they bowed to him in prostration. And he said, " O my father, this is the explanation of my vision of before .
My Lord has made it reality. And He was certainly good to me when He
took me out of prison and brought you [here] from bedouin life after
Satan had induced [estrangement] between me and my brothers. Indeed, my
Lord is Subtle in what He wills. Indeed, it is He who is the Knowing,
the Wise.
Then now this word is also used some time because of some special
attribute like host is called ABW ALADYAF(ابو الاضياف) and warrior as
ABW ALHARB ابو الحرب. In Quran ABW LHB (إبو لهب) is also used because of
this attribute of his that his colour was glittering like ember.
likewise nickname are taken because of love or relation with something
like ابو حريره ,ابو تراب etc. (note also see difference between
NASB(origin) and KUNYAT(nickname) in "BETA BAITE"[son, daughter])

10 BAZW [Arms]
Synonyms:JANAHA 3ADUD and ZIRA3 (جَنَاحَ عَضُد ذِرَاع)are used in the Holy QURAN
10.1 JANAHA(جَنَاحَ)  :meaning bird's feathers or arms. dual is JANAHAYN(جَنَاحَيْن)then it can be hinted for two sides of something.JANAHA AL3ASKAR(جَنَاحَا الْعَسْكَر) meaning both arms or side of army.like wise it also applied to both arms of the human. so JANAHA is used for left or right direction or side or arms ,used in all places. and arms refers to part between shoulders till the end of finger. ALLAH said
Surat Al-Qaşaş (The Stories) - سورة القصص
28:32
اسْلُكْ يَدَكَ فِي جَيْبِكَ تَخْرُجْ بَيْضَاءَ مِنْ غَيْرِ سُوءٍ   وَاضْمُمْ إِلَيْكَ جَنَاحَكَ مِنَ الرَّهْبِ   ۖ فَذَانِكَ بُرْهَانَانِ مِن رَّبِّكَ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَئِهِ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا قَوْمًا فَاسِقِينَ
Insert your hand into the opening of your garment; it will come out white, without disease.   And draw in your arm close to you [as prevention] from fear  , for those are two proofs from your Lord to Pharaoh and his establishment. Indeed, they have been a people defiantly disobedient."
10.2 3ADUD(عَضُد)  :means part between elbow till  shoulder.and 3ADADTUHU(عَضَدْتُهُ) meaning I hit him on arm.also It means I hold his arm and give him support.so this word is also used like YAD(يد)as hinting for helper. ALLAH said
Surat Al-Kahf (The Cave) - سورة الكهف
18:51
مَّا أَشْهَدتُّهُمْ خَلْقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَلَا خَلْقَ أَنفُسِهِمْ   وَمَا كُنتُ مُتَّخِذَ الْمُضِلِّينَ عَضُدًا
I did not make them witness to the creation of the heavens and the earth or to the creation of themselves,   and I would not have taken the misguiders as assistants.
10.3 ZIRA3(ذِرَاع)  :meaning from elbow till the end of middle finger.and it's usually translated as 'hand'. ALLAH said
Surat Al-Kahf (The Cave) - سورة الكهف
18:18
وَتَحْسَبُهُمْ أَيْقَاظًا وَهُمْ رُقُودٌ ۚ وَنُقَلِّبُهُمْ ذَاتَ الْيَمِينِ وَذَاتَ الشِّمَالِ ۖ   وَكَلْبُهُم بَاسِطٌ ذِرَاعَيْهِ بِالْوَصِيدِ   ۚ لَوِ اطَّلَعْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ لَوَلَّيْتَ مِنْهُمْ فِرَارًا وَلَمُلِئْتَ مِنْهُمْ رُعْبًا
And you would think them awake, while they were asleep. And We turned them to the right and to the left,   while their dog stretched his forelegs at the entrance  . If you had looked at them, you would have turned from them in flight and been filled by them with terror.
then ZIRA3  also refers to in measurement such a length which is between elbow and the end of middle finger.this length is also calledc'Hand' . as humans are of different size and length in different eras thus the value of this measurement also varies. Author of MANJAD mentions it to be 50-70 cm meaning approx 20 inch to 28 inch. Some translator ,translates it as 'feet'. ALLAH said
Surat Al-Ĥāqqah (The Reality) - سورة الحاقة
69:32
ثُمَّ فِي سِلْسِلَةٍ ذَرْعُهَا سَبْعُونَ ذِرَاعًا فَاسْلُكُوهُ
Then into a chain whose length is seventy cubits insert him."
Summary
Shoulder till elbow is 3ADUD, Elbow till end of middle finger is ZIRA3 and sum of both meaning from shoulder till end of fingers is JANAH

11 BAGH [Orchard]
Synonyms: JANNAH(جَنَّة),HADAI-Q(حَدَائِق) and RAWDAH(رَوْضَة)
11.1 JANNAH(جَنَّة)  :derived from JANNA(جَنَّ).which means to hide or to conceal something from the senses and JANNAH is such an orchard whose ground cannot be seen owing to dense vegetation and   trees. As   per Author of Munjad, JANNAH is a lush green garden of trees.whether it is earthly or Heavenly. In the Quran.
Surat Al-Baqarah (The Cow) - سورة البقرة
2:265
وَمَثَلُ الَّذِينَ يُنفِقُونَ أَمْوَالَهُمُ ابْتِغَاءَ مَرْضَاتِ اللَّهِ وَتَثْبِيتًا مِّنْ أَنفُسِهِمْ   كَمَثَلِ جَنَّةٍ بِرَبْوَةٍ أَصَابَهَا وَابِلٌ فَآتَتْ أُكُلَهَا ضِعْفَيْنِ   فَإِن لَّمْ يُصِبْهَا وَابِلٌ فَطَلٌّ ۗ وَاللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ
And the example of those who spend their wealth seeking means to the approval of Allah and assuring [reward for] themselves is   like a garden on high ground which is hit by a downpour - so it yields its fruits in double  . And [even] if it is not hit by a downpour, then a drizzle [is sufficient]. And Allah , of what you do, is Seeing.
11.2 HADAI-Q(حَدَائِق)  : is plural of HADIYQAH(حَدِيْقَة),which is derived from HADAQ(حَدَقَ). and HADAQ means to surround something from all sides. so HADIYQA is such an orchard or garden which is fortified with surrounding walls for protection. ALLAH said
Surat An-Naml (The Ant) - سورة النمل
27:60
أَمَّنْ خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ وَأَنزَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً   فَأَنبَتْنَا بِهِ حَدَائِقَ ذَاتَ بَهْجَةٍ   مَّا كَانَ لَكُمْ أَن تُنبِتُوا شَجَرَهَا ۗ أَإِلَٰهٌ مَّعَ اللَّهِ ۚ بَلْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ يَعْدِلُونَ
[More precisely], is He [not best] who created the heavens and the earth and sent down for you rain from the sky,   causing to grow thereby gardens of joyful beauty   which you could not [otherwise] have grown the trees thereof? Is there a deity with Allah ? [No], but they are a people who ascribe equals [to Him].
11.3 RAWDAH(رَوْضَة)  :(plural RWDAATروضات)RWD() refers to vastness and space. and RAWWADA ALMATUR ALARD(رَوَّضَ الْمَطْرُ الاَرْضَ) means rain causing earth to bloom and spring,and RAWDATU(رَوْضَة) is blooming parterre . so RAWDAH is that part or place inside of the orchard which is pleasantly blooming.and on such places is normally built pergola and terrrace etc.
Surat Ar-Rūm (The Romans) - سورة الروم
30:15
فَأَمَّا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ فَهُمْ فِي رَوْضَةٍ يُحْبَرُونَ
And as for those who had believed and done righteous deeds, they will be in a garden [of Paradise], delighted.
Summary
11.1 JANNAH:any orchard where are lots of trees
11.2 HADIYQAH:walled orchard
11.3 RAWDAH:any pleasant part inside orchard

12 BAQY RAKHNA-CHORNA[To Keep Remain,To Left]
Synonyms ABQA(ابْقَي ),ACBAT(اَثْبَت ),GHAADAR(غَادَر)
12.1 ABQA(ابْقَي)  :BQY(بقي)means something to remain and remain for ever.It's antonym is FNY(فني) and HLK(هلك) meaning something destroyed,nonexistant,finished and ABQA means to maintain and establish something.ALLAH said
Surat An-Najm (The Star) - سورة النجم
53:50
وَأَنَّهُ أَهْلَكَ عَادًا الْأُولَىٰ
And that He destroyed the first [people of] 'Aad
Surat An-Najm (The Star) - سورة النجم
53:51
وَثَمُودَ فَمَا أَبْقَىٰ
And Thamud - and He did not spare [them] -
12.2 ACBAT(اَثْبَت)  :CABATA(ثَبَتَ) means to maintain something at it's state and it's antonym is ZALA(زَالَ) meaning something displaced of its place to here of there. and ACBATA mean to maintain and establish something at it's original state. ALLAH said
Surat Ar-Ra`d (The Thunder) - سورة الرعد
13:39

raw_text:
14 BANJH [Infertile]
Synonyms 3AQIR(عَاقِر), and 3AQIYM(عَقِيْم)
14.1 3AQIR(عَاقِر)  :root 3QR(عقر)contains the meaning of inflicting injury or wound.ALKALBU AL3AQUWR(الْكَلْبُ الْعَقُوْر ) is a dog that bites.and 3AQAR ANNAKHLAH(عَقَرَ النَّخْلَة) means to cut palm tree from root.In the Quran
Surat Ash-Shams (The Sun) - سورة الشمس
91:14
فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَعَقَرُوهَا   فَدَمْدَمَ عَلَيْهِمْ رَبُّهُم بِذَنبِهِمْ فَسَوَّاهَا
But they denied him and hamstrung her.   So their Lord brought down upon them destruction for their sin and made it equal [upon all of them].
and AL3AQR(اَلْعَقْر)is also said to someone's last child after which there is no child.so 3AQIR is used for such a woman who was giving birth before but after wound in womb or menopause or some other disease,is unable to give birth now.also this word is used for both man and woman.In the Quran
Surat Maryam (Mary) - سورة مريم
19:5
وَإِنِّي خِفْتُ الْمَوَالِيَ مِن وَرَائِي وَكَانَتِ امْرَأَتِي عَاقِرًا فَهَبْ لِي مِن لَّدُنكَ وَلِيًّا
And indeed, I fear the successors after me, and my wife has been barren, so give me from Yourself an heir
14.2 3AQIYM(عَقِيْم)  :like word 3AQIR is also used for both male and female. 3AQIYM is also said to that sandy part or patch of earth which is infertile. and RIYHUN 3AQIYM(   الرِّيحَ الْعَقِيمَ  ) is such a wind which is devoid of good. In that meaning this word is used in the Holy QURAN:
Surat Adh-Dhāriyāt (The Winnowing Winds) - سورة الذاريات
51:41
وَفِي عَادٍ إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمُ الرِّيحَ الْعَقِيمَ
And in 'Aad [was a sign], when We sent against them the barren wind.
and 3AQIYM is that man who doesn't have sperm or his sperm cells are dead.likewise 3AQIYM is such a women who doesn't accept man's sperm at all.so 3AQIYM is that man or woman who doesn't have any children at all. ALLAH said
Surat Ash-Shūraá (The Consultation) - سورة الشورى
42:50
أَوْ يُزَوِّجُهُمْ ذُكْرَانًا وَإِنَاثًا ۖ وَيَجْعَلُ مَن يَشَاءُ عَقِيمًا   ۚ إِنَّهُ عَلِيمٌ قَدِيرٌ
Or He makes them [both] males and females, and He renders whom He wills barren  . Indeed, He is Knowing and Competent.
Summary
3AQIR who used to have children but stop having them later on.and 3QIYM is that who absolutley had no child born

15 BANDHNA [To Tie]
Synonyms: RABATA(رَبَطَ),SHADDA(شَدَّ),GHULLA(غُلَّ)
15.1 RABATA(رَبَطَ)  :to tie strongly, and MARBAT(مربط) and MARBATAH( مربطة) is that rope with which animal is tied and RABBAT( رَبَّاط) meaning 'tier of catgut' and RABYTAH( ربيطه) meaning tie up animal, and RABATA ALLAHU 3ALA QALBIHI( رَبَطَ اللّهُ عَلَي قَلْبِهِ) is a proverb. ALLAH tied his heart meaning strengthen his heart and granted patience.ALLAH said
Surat Al-Qaşaş (The Stories) - سورة القصص
28:10
وَأَصْبَحَ فُؤَادُ أُمِّ مُوسَىٰ فَارِغًا ۖ   إِن كَادَتْ لَتُبْدِي بِهِ لَوْلَا أَن رَّبَطْنَا عَلَىٰ قَلْبِهَا   لِتَكُونَ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ
And the heart of Moses' mother became empty [of all else].   She was about to disclose [the matter concerning] him had We not bound fast her heart   that she would be of the believers.
15.2 SHADDA(شَدَّ)  :SHADD ALSHAY-(شَدَّ الشَّئ) meaning to tie something, to strenghtne it, to tie strongly. In the QURAN
Surat Muĥammad (Muhammad) - سورة محمد
47:4
فَإِذَا لَقِيتُمُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا فَضَرْبَ الرِّقَابِ   حَتَّىٰ إِذَا أَثْخَنتُمُوهُمْ فَشُدُّوا الْوَثَاقَ   فَإِمَّا مَنًّا بَعْدُ وَإِمَّا فِدَاءً حَتَّىٰ تَضَعَ الْحَرْبُ أَوْزَارَهَا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ وَلَوْ يَشَاءُ اللَّهُ لَانتَصَرَ مِنْهُمْ وَلَٰكِن لِّيَبْلُوَ بَعْضَكُم بِبَعْضٍ ۗ وَالَّذِينَ قُتِلُوا فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ فَلَن يُضِلَّ أَعْمَالَهُمْ
So when you meet those who disbelieve [in battle], strike [their] necks   until, when you have inflicted slaughter upon them, then secure their bonds  , and either [confer] favor afterwards or ransom [them] until the war lays down its burdens. That [is the command]. And if Allah had willed, He could have taken vengeance upon them [Himself], but [He ordered armed struggle] to test some of you by means of others. And those who are killed in the cause of Allah - never will He waste their deeds.
15.3 GHULLA(غُلَّ)  :is anything with which any organ can be hold and tied to its centre and meaning shackle (plural AGHLAL اغلال)and hinted MUGHLUL ALYAD(مغلول اليد) is said to a miser person, meaning that person hands are tied of spending.ALLAH said
Surat Al-Mā'idah (The Table Spread) - سورة المائدة
5:64
وَقَالَتِ الْيَهُودُ يَدُ اللَّهِ مَغْلُولَةٌ ۚ غُلَّتْ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَلُعِنُوا بِمَا قَالُوا ۘ بَلْ يَدَاهُ مَبْسُوطَتَانِ يُنفِقُ كَيْفَ يَشَاءُ   ۚ وَلَيَزِيدَنَّ كَثِيرًا مِّنْهُم مَّا أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكَ مِن رَّبِّكَ طُغْيَانًا وَكُفْرًا ۚ وَأَلْقَيْنَا بَيْنَهُمُ الْعَدَاوَةَ وَالْبَغْضَاءَ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ ۚ كُلَّمَا أَوْقَدُوا نَارًا لِّلْحَرْبِ أَطْفَأَهَا اللَّهُ ۚ وَيَسْعَوْنَ فِي الْأَرْضِ فَسَادًا ۚ وَاللَّهُ لَا يُحِبُّ الْمُفْسِدِينَ
And the Jews say, "The hand of Allah is chained." Chained are their hands, and cursed are they for what they say. Rather, both His hands are extended; He spends however He wills.   And that which has been revealed to you from your Lord will surely increase many of them in transgression and disbelief. And We have cast among them animosity and hatred until the Day of Resurrection. Every time they kindled the fire of war [against you], Allah extinguished it. And they strive throughout the land [causing] corruption, and Allah does not like corrupters.
Summary
15.1 RABAT:To tie something with a rope, and  رَبَطَ اللّهُ عَلَي قَلْبِهِ-ALLAH strengthening someone's heart and grant one patience
15.2 SHADD:strenghtening by tying up.more eloquent than RABAT
15.3 GHULL:hand being tied of spending and مغلول اليد is a miser.

raw_text:
16 BUT [Idol]
Synonyms SANAM(صَنَمَ),NUSUB(نُصُب)AWCAN(اَوْثَان)JIBT(جِبْت)TAGHUWT(طَاغُوْت)
16.1 SANAM(صَنَمَ)  :(Plural ASNAM اَصْنَام)Silver,Brass or wooden self sculpted idols and statues etc which are transferable and get traded.SANNA3ATU ALASNAM(صَنَّاعَةُ الاَصْنَام)-said to the profession and art of Idol Trade. Prophet Abraham father AAZAR used to do this business.Prophet Abraham prays to his lord
Surat 'Ibrāhīm (Abrahim) - سورة ابراهيم
14:35
وَإِذْ قَالَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ رَبِّ اجْعَلْ هَٰذَا الْبَلَدَ آمِنً  ا وَاجْنُبْنِي وَبَنِيَّ أَن نَّعْبُدَ الْأَصْنَامَ
And [mention, O Muhammad], when Abraham said, "My Lord, make this city [Makkah] secure   and keep me and my sons away from worshipping idols.
16.2 NUSUB(نُصُب)  :NASAB ASSHAYEE(نَصَبَ الشَّئ)means to make some one stand upright and install on earth and NASIYBUN(نَصِيْبٌ) is that stone which is installed as the signpost.and NASIYB is also said to that stone or iron etc that statue which is installed at a place for purpose of worship.This statue is normally of Prophets,Saints and Pious Individuals or Kings.Such places where those statues are installled is called C-HAN(تهان) in urdu.It's plural is NUSUB and ANSAB(اَنْصَاب) . In the QURAN
Surat Al-Mā'idah (The Table Spread) - سورة المائدة
5:3
حُرِّمَتْ عَلَيْكُمُ الْمَيْتَةُ وَالدَّمُ وَلَحْمُ الْخِنزِيرِ وَمَا أُهِلَّ لِغَيْرِ اللَّهِ بِهِ وَالْمُنْخَنِقَةُ وَالْمَوْقُوذَةُ وَالْمُتَرَدِّيَةُ وَالنَّطِيحَةُ وَمَا أَكَلَ السَّبُعُ إِلَّا مَا ذَكَّيْتُمْ   وَمَا ذُبِحَ عَلَى النُّصُبِ وَأَن تَسْتَقْسِمُوا بِالْأَزْلَامِ   ۚ ذَٰلِكُمْ فِسْقٌ ۗ الْيَوْمَ يَئِسَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا مِن دِينِكُمْ فَلَا تَخْشَوْهُمْ وَاخْشَوْنِ ۚ الْيَوْمَ أَكْمَلْتُ لَكُمْ دِينَكُمْ وَأَتْمَمْتُ عَلَيْكُمْ نِعْمَتِي وَرَضِيتُ لَكُمُ الْإِسْلَامَ دِينًا ۚ فَمَنِ اضْطُرَّ فِي مَخْمَصَةٍ غَيْرَ مُتَجَانِفٍ لِّإِثْمٍ ۙ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
Prohibited to you are dead animals, blood, the flesh of swine, and that which has been dedicated to other than Allah , and [those animals] killed by strangling or by a violent blow or by a head-long fall or by the goring of horns, and those from which a wild animal has eaten, except what you [are able to] slaughter [before its death],   and those which are sacrificed on stone altars, and [prohibited is] that you seek decision through divining arrows  . That is grave disobedience. This day those who disbelieve have despaired of [defeating] your religion; so fear them not, but fear Me. This day I have perfected for you your religion and completed My favor upon you and have approved for you Islam as religion. But whoever is forced by severe hunger with no inclination to sin - then indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful.

17 BIJLY [Lightning]
Synonyms:BARQ(بَرْق),RA3D(رَعْد) and SA3IQAH(صَاعِقَة)
17.1 BARQ(بَرْق)  :lightning that flashes,bolts and that blinds eyes(of lightning glare) and BARIQ ALBASARU(بَرِقَ الْبَصَرُ) meaning eyes blinded(of lightning glare). In the QURAN
Surat Al-Baqarah (The Cow) - سورة البقرة
2:20
يَكَادُ الْبَرْقُ يَخْطَفُ أَبْصَارَهُمْ   ۖ كُلَّمَا أَضَاءَ لَهُم مَّشَوْا فِيهِ وَإِذَا أَظْلَمَ عَلَيْهِمْ قَامُوا ۚ وَلَوْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ لَذَهَبَ بِسَمْعِهِمْ وَأَبْصَارِهِمْ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
The lightning almost snatches away their sight  . Every time it lights [the way] for them, they walk therein; but when darkness comes over them, they stand [still]. And if Allah had willed, He could have taken away their hearing and their sight. Indeed, Allah is over all things competent.
17.2 RA3D(رَعْد)  :Thundery and loud lightning.also for such a cloud which has thundercrack and thunderclap. ALLAH said
Surat Ar-Ra`d (The Thunder) - سورة الرعد
13:13
وَيُسَبِّحُ الرَّعْدُ بِحَمْدِهِ وَالْمَلَائِكَةُ مِنْ خِيفَتِهِ   وَيُرْسِلُ الصَّوَاعِقَ فَيُصِيبُ بِهَا مَن يَشَاءُ وَهُمْ يُجَادِلُونَ فِي اللَّهِ وَهُوَ شَدِيدُ الْمِحَالِ
And the thunder exalts [ Allah ] with praise of Him - and the angels [as well] from fear of Him   - and He sends thunderbolts and strikes therewith whom He wills while they dispute about Allah ; and He is severe in assault.
17.3 SA3IQAH(صَاعِقَة)  :lightning that falls and fall to annihilate.so it also means Divine Punishment or also death as well. and Imam Raghib said that it referes to such a dangerous explosion which relates to cosmic/heavenly bodies and in it's comparison is SAQA3A(صَقَعَ) which is peculiar to earthly bodies and meaning of both are same.and as per author of Muntaha Aladab it means Fire thrown from sky with intense thunderclap or such a hard sound by hearing which one get knock unconscious.In this case SA3IQAH is an extreme form of RA3D. plural of SA3IQAH is SAWA3IQ(صَوَاعِق). ALLAH said
Surat Ar-Ra`d (The Thunder) - سورة الرعد
13:13
وَيُسَبِّحُ الرَّعْدُ بِحَمْدِهِ وَالْمَلَائِكَةُ مِنْ خِيفَتِهِ   وَيُرْسِلُ الصَّوَاعِقَ فَيُصِيبُ بِهَا مَن يَشَاءُ   وَهُمْ يُجَادِلُونَ فِي اللَّهِ وَهُوَ شَدِيدُ الْمِحَالِ
And the thunder exalts [ Allah ] with praise of Him - and the angels [as well] from fear of Him -   and He sends thunderbolts and strikes therewith whom He wills   while they dispute about Allah ; and He is severe in assault.
Summary
BARQ the one that flashes RA3D the one that thunderclap and SA3IQAH intense thunderclap with thunderbolt .
for BUJHANA AWR BUJHNA[To Put out and Being Put out] please see AAG AWR US KAY AF3AL [Fire and It's Function]
