raw_text:
8 BARISH [Rain]
Synonyms MATAR MAA-- TALLA WADAQ GHAYC MIDRARA GADAQA WABIL(مَطَر مََآء طَلّ وَدْق غَيْث مِدْرَار غَدَقَ وَابِل صَيِّب) SAYYIB are used
8.1 MATAR(مَطَر)  :common word for rain.whether beneficial or destructive. whether water rains or some thing else for all MATAR can be used and AMTAR(اَمْطَرَ) meaning to cause rain. ALLAH said
Surat Ash-Shu`arā' (The Poets) - سورة الشعراء
26:173
وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهِم مَّطَرًا ۖ فَسَاءَ مَطَرُ الْمُنذَرِينَ
And We rained upon them a rain [of stones], and evil was the rain of those who were warned.
8.2 MAA--(مََآء)  :lexical meaning is water (plural MYAH مياه) and literally/virtually used for rain . for e.g
Surat Al-Baqarah (The Cow) - سورة البقرة
2:22
الَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الْأَرْضَ فِرَاشًا وَالسَّمَاءَ بِنَاءً   وَأَنزَلَ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً فَأَخْرَجَ بِهِ مِنَ الثَّمَرَاتِ رِزْقًا لَّكُمْ   ۖ فَلَا تَجْعَلُوا لِلَّهِ أَندَادًا وَأَنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
[He] who made for you the earth a bed [spread out] and the sky a ceiling   and sent down from the sky, rain and brought forth thereby fruits as provision for you.   So do not attribute to Allah equals while you know [that there is nothing similar to Him].
8.3 TALLA(طَلّ)  :just light and weak rain.dew and drizzle for both TALLA is used. In the Quran
Surat Al-Baqarah (The Cow) - سورة البقرة
2:265
وَمَثَلُ الَّذِينَ يُنفِقُونَ أَمْوَالَهُمُ ابْتِغَاءَ مَرْضَاتِ اللَّهِ وَتَثْبِيتًا مِّنْ أَنفُسِهِمْ كَمَثَلِ جَنَّةٍ بِرَبْوَةٍ أَصَابَهَا وَابِلٌ فَآتَتْ أُكُلَهَا ضِعْفَيْنِ   فَإِن لَّمْ يُصِبْهَا وَابِلٌ فَطَلٌّ   ۗ وَاللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ
And the example of those who spend their wealth seeking means to the approval of Allah and assuring [reward for] themselves is like a garden on high ground which is hit by a downpour - so it yields its fruits in double. And [even]   if it is not hit by a downpour, then a drizzle [is sufficient].   And Allah , of what you do, is Seeing.
8.4 WADQ(وَدْق)  :that rain which continues on is WADQ.such a rain normally rains slowly slowly and continues for a long time. In the Quran
Surat An-Nūr (The Light) - سورة النور
24:43
أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ اللَّهَ يُزْجِي سَحَابًا ثُمَّ يُؤَلِّفُ بَيْنَهُ   ثُمَّ يَجْعَلُهُ رُكَامًا فَتَرَى الْوَدْقَ يَخْرُجُ مِنْ خِلَالِهِ   وَيُنَزِّلُ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مِن جِبَالٍ فِيهَا مِن بَرَدٍ فَيُصِيبُ بِهِ مَن يَشَاءُ وَيَصْرِفُهُ عَن مَّن يَشَاءُ ۖ يَكَادُ سَنَا بَرْقِهِ يَذْهَبُ بِالْأَبْصَارِ
Do you not see that Allah drives clouds? Then He brings them together,   then He makes them into a mass, and you see the rain emerge from within it  . And He sends down from the sky, mountains [of clouds] within which is hail, and He strikes with it whom He wills and averts it from whom He wills. The flash of its lightening almost takes away the eyesight.
8.5 GHAYC(غَيْث)  :that rain which rains when needed and as per the need is GHAYC. In the Quran
Surat Al-Ĥadīd (The Iron) - سورة الحديد
57:20
اعْلَمُوا أَنَّمَا الْحَيَاةُ الدُّنْيَا لَعِبٌ وَلَهْوٌ وَزِينَةٌ وَتَفَاخُرٌ بَيْنَكُمْ وَتَكَاثُرٌ فِي الْأَمْوَالِ وَالْأَوْلَادِ ۖ   كَمَثَلِ غَيْثٍ أَعْجَبَ الْكُفَّارَ نَبَاتُهُ   ثُمَّ يَهِيجُ فَتَرَاهُ مُصْفَرًّا ثُمَّ يَكُونُ حُطَامًا ۖ وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ عَذَابٌ شَدِيدٌ وَمَغْفِرَةٌ مِّنَ اللَّهِ وَرِضْوَانٌ ۚ وَمَا الْحَيَاةُ الدُّنْيَا إِلَّا مَتَاعُ الْغُرُورِ
Know that the life of this world is but amusement and diversion and adornment and boasting to one another and competition in increase of wealth and children -   like the example of a rain whose [resulting] plant growth pleases the tillers  ; then it dries and you see it turned yellow; then it becomes [scattered] debris. And in the Hereafter is severe punishment and forgiveness from Allah and approval. And what is the worldly life except the enjoyment of delusion.
8.6 MIDRARA(مِدْرَار)  :ADDARR(الدَّرّ) said to milk and it's excess. and DRWD(درود) is such a she camel which give lots of milk and from it is derived MIDRARA . 3AYNUN MIDRARA( عَيْنٌ مِدْرَارٌ) meaning eye which sheds lots of tears. and MIDRARA means rain that rains a lot meaning MIDRARA is that rain in which there is excessive water (Heavy Downpour)
Surat Hūd (Hud) - سورة هود
11:52
وَيَا قَوْمِ اسْتَغْفِرُوا رَبَّكُمْ ثُمَّ تُوبُوا إِلَيْهِ يُرْسِلِ السَّمَاءَ عَلَيْكُم مِّدْرَارًا   وَيَزِدْكُمْ قُوَّةً إِلَىٰ قُوَّتِكُمْ وَلَا تَتَوَلَّوْا مُجْرِمِينَ
And O my people, ask forgiveness of your Lord and then repent to Him. He will send [rain from] the sky upon you in showers   and increase you in strength [added] to your strength. And do not turn away, [being] criminals."
8.7 GADAQA(غَدَقَ)  :as per Ibn Faris it is that rain in which there is excessive water and also beneficial . GHADAQATUN(غَدَقَةٌ) meaning sweet spring and GHADAQ ALMAKAN(غدق المكان) means a place getting wet with water, to become green and GHADIQ(غَدِقَ) meaning green place. so GHADAQA is such a rain which causes greenery. ALLAH said
Surat Al-Jinn (The Jinn) - سورة الجن
72:16
وَأَن لَّوِ اسْتَقَامُوا عَلَى الطَّرِيقَةِ لَأَسْقَيْنَاهُم مَّاءً غَدَقًا
And [ Allah revealed] that if they had remained straight on the way, We would have given them abundant provision
8.8 SAYYIB(صَيِّب)  :such an powerful rain in which clouds are thundering alot and lightning as well and as per ibn al faris such a rain which pour properly. ALLAH said
Surat Al-Baqarah (The Cow) - سورة البقرة
2:19
أَوْ كَصَيِّبٍ مِّنَ السَّمَاءِ فِيهِ ظُلُمَاتٌ وَرَعْدٌ وَبَرْقٌ   يَجْعَلُونَ أَصَابِعَهُمْ فِي آذَانِهِم مِّنَ الصَّوَاعِقِ حَذَرَ الْمَوْتِ ۚ وَاللَّهُ مُحِيطٌ بِالْكَافِرِينَ
Or [it is] like a rainstorm from the sky within which is darkness, thunder and lightning  . They put their fingers in their ears against the thunderclaps in dread of death. But Allah is encompassing of the disbelievers.
8.9 WABIL(وَابِل)  :WABAL(وَبَلَ) means to hit with staff (cattle etc)   repeatedly.in    its meaning is intensity and weight.Ibn Faris said that WABAL gives the meaning of intensity and excessiveness and WABIL refers to intense type of rain. so WABIL is that rain which owing to it's excessive water and intensity and swiftness would flood away even the hay and stack. and this is the last level of rain. ALLAH said
Surat Al-Baqarah (The Cow) - سورة البقرة
2:264
يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لَا تُبْطِلُوا صَدَقَاتِكُم بِالْمَنِّ وَالْأَذَىٰ كَالَّذِي يُنفِقُ مَالَهُ رِئَاءَ النَّاسِ وَلَا يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ ۖ   فَمَثَلُهُ كَمَثَلِ صَفْوَانٍ عَلَيْهِ تُرَابٌ فَأَصَابَهُ وَابِلٌ فَتَرَكَهُ صَلْدًا   ۖ لَّا يَقْدِرُونَ عَلَىٰ شَيْءٍ مِّمَّا كَسَبُوا ۗ وَاللَّهُ لَا يَهْدِي الْقَوْمَ الْكَافِرِينَ
O you who have believed, do not invalidate your charities with reminders or injury as does one who spends his wealth [only] to be seen by the people and does not believe in Allah and the Last Day.   His example is like that of a [large] smooth stone upon which is dust and is hit by a downpour that leaves it bare  . They are unable [to keep] anything of what they have earned. And Allah does not guide the disbelieving people.
Summary
8.1 MATAR: for any type of rain,Noun of Kind(اسم جنس)
8.2 MAA--:meaning water ,used as virtually
8.3 TALL:Dew or Drizzle
8.4 WADQ: slow and continous rain
8.5 GHAYC:Rain as per need on appropriate time
8.6 MIDRARA:refers to excessive water
8.7 GHADAQ:such a rain in which there is excessive water and also beneficial meaning cause vegetation to grow
8.8 SAYYIB:powerful rain ,with large droplets,Heavy downpour
8.9 WABIL:such an intense rain that flood away hay and stack

title: Allah says in the Quran: 7:143: Surat Al-'A`rāf (The Heights) -   سورة الأعراف
raw_text:
80: Faint/collapse/to be unconscious:
Saiqa   صَعِقَ  ,sakara   سَكَرَ   ,ghamara   غَمَرَ  ,sara’a     صَرَع  , & ghashee    غَشى   are the words used.
1.            Saiqa   صَعِقَ   : to faint because one is frightened or anxious. Saaiqa,    صاعقه   refers to the lightening, or that very loud blast that is associated with ajsaam e alvi.   اجسام علوى   (look for the details under section ‘light’)
Allah says in the Quran: 7:143: Surat Al-'A`rāf (The Heights) -   سورة الأعراف
وَلَمَّا جَاءَ مُوسَىٰ لِمِيقَاتِنَا وَكَلَّمَهُ رَبُّهُ قَالَ رَبِّ أَرِنِي أَنظُرْ إِلَيْكَ   ۚ   قَالَ لَن تَرَانِي وَلَٰكِنِ انظُرْ إِلَى الْجَبَلِ فَإِنِ اسْتَقَرَّ مَكَانَهُ فَسَوْفَ تَرَانِي   ۚ   فَلَمَّا تَجَلَّىٰ رَبُّهُ لِلْجَبَلِ جَعَلَهُ دَكًّا وَخَرَّ مُوسَىٰ صَعِقًا   ۚ   فَلَمَّا أَفَاقَ قَالَ سُبْحَانَكَ تُبْتُ إِلَيْكَ وَأَنَا أَوَّلُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ
And when Moses arrived at Our appointed time and his Lord spoke to him, he said, "My Lord, show me [Yourself] that I may look at You." [ Allah ] said, "You will not see Me, but look at the mountain; if it should remain in place, then you will see Me." But when his Lord appeared to the mountain, He rendered it level, and Moses fell unconscious. And when he awoke, he said, "Exalted are You! I have repented to You, and I am the first of the believers."
2.            Sakara    سَكَرَ  : sukr    سُكر   refers to such a state where the person loses his senses.
Quran says: 50:19: Surat Qāf (The Letter "Qaf") -   سورة ق
وَجَاءَتْ سَكْرَةُ الْمَوْتِ بِالْحَقِّ ۖ ذَٰلِكَ مَا كُنتَ مِنْهُ تَحِيدُ
And the intoxication of death will bring the truth; that is what you were trying to avoid.
But this word is generally used for losing senses after using some intoxicated stuff (liquor etc). Because sakar   سَكَر refers  to alcohol & all other intoxicants.
Allah says in the Quran: 16:67 Surat An-Naĥl (The Bee) -   سورة النحل
وَمِن ثَمَرَاتِ النَّخِيلِ وَالْأَعْنَابِ تَتَّخِذُونَ مِنْهُ سَكَرًا وَرِزْقًا حَسَنًا   ۗ   إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَةً لِّقَوْمٍ يَعْقِلُونَ
And from the fruits of the palm trees and grapevines you take intoxicant and good provision. Indeed in that is a sign for a people who reason.
Sakir   سَكِر means losing senses after drinking alcohol. (sakran  سكران) .feminine sacra  سكرى & its plural sukaaraa   سُكرى.
3.            Ghamira  غَمَرَ: start to lose senses ( start of being unconscious) ghamratul maut   غمرات الموتmeans the hardships & difficulties of death that makes one lose his senses. Ghamra kaseer  غمرة كثير means water, the depth of which cannot be measured. According to ibn e faaris,ghamar غَمَرَ means the state of losing senses because one faces lots of difficulties & hardships.
Allah says in the Quran: 6:93: Surat Al-'An`ām (The Cattle) - سورة الأنعام
وَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّنِ افْتَرَىٰ عَلَى اللَّهِ كَذِبًا أَوْ قَالَ أُوحِيَ إِلَيَّ وَلَمْ يُوحَ إِلَيْهِ شَيْءٌ وَمَن قَالَ سَأُنزِلُ مِثْلَ مَا أَنزَلَ اللَّهُ   ۗ   وَلَوْ تَرَىٰ إِذِ الظَّالِمُونَ فِي غَمَرَاتِ الْمَوْتِ وَالْمَلَائِكَةُ بَاسِطُو أَيْدِيهِمْ أَخْرِجُوا أَنفُسَكُمُ   ۖ   الْيَوْمَ تُجْزَوْنَ عَذَابَ الْهُونِ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَقُولُونَ عَلَى اللَّهِ غَيْرَ الْحَقِّ وَكُنتُمْ عَنْ آيَاتِهِ تَسْتَكْبِرُونَ
And who is more unjust than one who invents a lie about Allah or says, "It has been inspired to me," while nothing has been inspired to him, and one who says, "I will reveal [something] like what Allah revealed." And if you could but see when the wrongdoers are in the overwhelming pangs of death while the angels extend their hands, [saying], "Discharge your souls! Today you will be awarded the punishment of [extreme] humiliation for what you used to say against Allah other than the truth and [that] you were, toward His verses, being arrogant."
In another verse, Allah says:23:63: Surat Al-Mu'minūn (The Believers) - سورة المؤمنون
بَلْ قُلُوبُهُمْ فِي غَمْرَةٍ مِّنْ هَٰذَا وَلَهُمْ أَعْمَالٌ مِّن دُونِ ذَٰلِكَ هُمْ لَهَا عَامِلُونَ
But their hearts are covered with confusion over this, and they have [evil] deeds besides disbelief which they are doing,
4.            Sara’a    صَرَع   : means epilepsy or    اُمُّ الصبيان   ummus subyaan (renowned disease) in which a person suddenly collapses & drops on floor (after fainting) as if someone has thrown him down. Sara’a     صَرَع   means drop on the floor  because one is anxious or worried.
Allah says in the Quran: 69:7: Surat Al-Ĥāqqah (The Reality) -   سورة الحاقة
سَخَّرَهَا عَلَيْهِمْ سَبْعَ لَيَالٍ وَثَمَانِيَةَ أَيَّامٍ حُسُومًا فَتَرَى الْقَوْمَ فِيهَا صَرْعَىٰ كَأَنَّهُمْ أَعْجَازُ نَخْلٍ خَاوِيَةٍ
Which Allah imposed upon them for seven nights and eight days in succession, so you would see the people therein fallen as if they were hollow trunks of palm trees.
5.Ghashee    غَشى  : ghasha    غشا   means to cover something . when a persons wisdom/mind stops working as if its covered by something, then this condition is called ghasha    غَشى  . The reasons could be anything ,(he is frightened,scared or anything) maghshee   مغشى   is the one who is unconscious.
Quran says: 33:19: Surat Al-'Aĥzāb (The Combined Forces) -   سورة الأحزاب
أَشِحَّةً عَلَيْكُمْ ۖ فَإِذَا جَاءَ الْخَوْفُ رَأَيْتَهُمْ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَيْكَ تَدُورُ أَعْيُنُهُمْ كَالَّذِي يُغْشَىٰ عَلَيْهِ مِنَ الْمَوْتِ ۖ فَإِذَا ذَهَبَ الْخَوْفُ سَلَقُوكُم بِأَلْسِنَةٍ حِدَادٍ أَشِحَّةً عَلَى الْخَيْرِ ۚ أُولَٰئِكَ لَمْ يُؤْمِنُوا فَأَحْبَطَ اللَّهُ أَعْمَالَهُمْ ۚ وَكَانَ ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى اللَّهِ يَسِيرًا
Indisposed toward you. And when fear comes, you see them looking at you, their eyes revolving like one being overcome by death. But when fear departs, they lash you with sharp tongues, indisposed toward [any] good. Those have not believed, so Allah has rendered their deeds worthless, and ever is that, for Allah , easy.
Summary:
1.            Saiqa    صَعِقَ  : to faint after being struck by some calamity from the sky(lightening)
2.            Sakara    سَكَرَ   : Fainting/losing senses after having alcohol or some other intoxicant.
3.            Ghamara    غَمَرَ   : to lose senses after facing hardships & difficulties
4.            Sara’a    صَرَع   : to suddenly collapse/fall on ground  after fainting (some disease)
5.            Ghashee   غَشى   : common word used for unconsciousness .the reasons could be fear, disease, or any other reason)

1.        Saiqa صَعِقَ : to faint because one is frightened or anxious. Saaiqa,  صاعقه refers to the lightening, or that very loud blast that is associated with ajsaam e alvi. اجسام علوى (look for the details under section ‘light’)

 

Allah says in the Quran: 7:143: Surat Al-'A`rāf (The Heights) - سورة الأعراف

 

 

وَلَمَّا جَاءَ مُوسَىٰ لِمِيقَاتِنَا وَكَلَّمَهُ رَبُّهُ قَالَ رَبِّ أَرِنِي أَنظُرْ إِلَيْكَ ۚ قَالَ لَن تَرَانِي وَلَٰكِنِ انظُرْ إِلَى الْجَبَلِ فَإِنِ اسْتَقَرَّ مَكَانَهُ فَسَوْفَ تَرَانِي ۚ فَلَمَّا تَجَلَّىٰ رَبُّهُ لِلْجَبَلِ جَعَلَهُ دَكًّا وَخَرَّ مُوسَىٰ صَعِقًا ۚ فَلَمَّا أَفَاقَ قَالَ سُبْحَانَكَ تُبْتُ إِلَيْكَ وَأَنَا أَوَّلُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ

 

And when Moses arrived at Our appointed time and his Lord spoke to him, he said, "My Lord, show me [Yourself] that I may look at You." [ Allah ] said, "You will not see Me, but look at the mountain; if it should remain in place, then you will see Me." But when his Lord appeared to the mountain, He rendered it level, and Moses fell unconscious. And when he awoke, he said, "Exalted are You! I have repented to You, and I am the first of the believers."

 

2.        Sakara  سَكَرَ: sukr  سُكر refers to such a state where the person loses his senses.

Quran says: 50:19: Surat Qāf (The Letter "Qaf") - سورة ق

 

وَجَاءَتْ سَكْرَةُ الْمَوْتِ بِالْحَقِّ ۖ ذَٰلِكَ مَا كُنتَ مِنْهُ تَحِيدُ

And the intoxication of death will bring the truth; that is what you were trying to avoid.

But this word is generally used for losing senses after using some intoxicated stuff (liquor etc). Because sakar   سَكَر refers  to alcohol & all other intoxicants.

Allah says in the Quran: 16:67 Surat An-Naĥl (The Bee) - سورة النحل

 

وَمِن ثَمَرَاتِ النَّخِيلِ وَالْأَعْنَابِ تَتَّخِذُونَ مِنْهُ سَكَرًا وَرِزْقًا حَسَنًا ۗ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَةً لِّقَوْمٍ يَعْقِلُونَ

And from the fruits of the palm trees and grapevines you take intoxicant and good provision. Indeed in that is a sign for a people who reason.

Sakir   سَكِر means losing senses after drinking alcohol. (sakran  سكران) .feminine sacra  سكرى & its plural sukaaraa   سُكرى.

 

3.        Ghamira  غَمَرَ: start to lose senses ( start of being unconscious) ghamratul maut   غمرات الموتmeans the hardships & difficulties of death that makes one lose his senses. Ghamra kaseer  غمرة كثير means water, the depth of which cannot be measured. According to ibn e faaris,ghamar غَمَرَ means the state of losing senses because one faces lots of difficulties & hardships.

Allah says in the Quran: 6:93: Surat Al-'An`ām (The Cattle) - سورة الأنعام

وَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّنِ افْتَرَىٰ عَلَى اللَّهِ كَذِبًا أَوْ قَالَ أُوحِيَ إِلَيَّ وَلَمْ يُوحَ إِلَيْهِ شَيْءٌ وَمَن قَالَ سَأُنزِلُ مِثْلَ مَا أَنزَلَ اللَّهُ ۗ وَلَوْ تَرَىٰ إِذِ الظَّالِمُونَ فِي غَمَرَاتِ الْمَوْتِ وَالْمَلَائِكَةُ بَاسِطُو أَيْدِيهِمْ أَخْرِجُوا أَنفُسَكُمُ ۖ الْيَوْمَ تُجْزَوْنَ عَذَابَ الْهُونِ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَقُولُونَ عَلَى اللَّهِ غَيْرَ الْحَقِّ وَكُنتُمْ عَنْ آيَاتِهِ تَسْتَكْبِرُونَ

And who is more unjust than one who invents a lie about Allah or says, "It has been inspired to me," while nothing has been inspired to him, and one who says, "I will reveal [something] like what Allah revealed." And if you could but see when the wrongdoers are in the overwhelming pangs of death while the angels extend their hands, [saying], "Discharge your souls! Today you will be awarded the punishment of [extreme] humiliation for what you used to say against Allah other than the truth and [that] you were, toward His verses, being arrogant."

 

In another verse, Allah says:23:63: Surat Al-Mu'minūn (The Believers) - سورة المؤمنون

بَلْ قُلُوبُهُمْ فِي غَمْرَةٍ مِّنْ هَٰذَا وَلَهُمْ أَعْمَالٌ مِّن دُونِ ذَٰلِكَ هُمْ لَهَا عَامِلُونَ

But their hearts are covered with confusion over this, and they have [evil] deeds besides disbelief which they are doing,

 

4.        Sara’a  صَرَع : means epilepsy or  اُمُّ الصبيان ummus subyaan (renowned disease) in which a person suddenly collapses & drops on floor (after fainting) as if someone has thrown him down. Sara’a   صَرَع means drop on the floor  because one is anxious or worried.

 

Allah says in the Quran: 69:7: Surat Al-Ĥāqqah (The Reality) - سورة الحاقة

 

سَخَّرَهَا عَلَيْهِمْ سَبْعَ لَيَالٍ وَثَمَانِيَةَ أَيَّامٍ حُسُومًا فَتَرَى الْقَوْمَ فِيهَا صَرْعَىٰ كَأَنَّهُمْ أَعْجَازُ نَخْلٍ خَاوِيَةٍ

 

Which Allah imposed upon them for seven nights and eight days in succession, so you would see the people therein fallen as if they were hollow trunks of palm trees.

 

 

5.Ghashee  غَشى: ghasha  غشا means to cover something . when a persons wisdom/mind stops working as if its covered by something, then this condition is called ghasha  غَشى. The reasons could be anything ,(he is frightened,scared or anything) maghshee مغشى is the one who is unconscious.

 

Quran says: 33:19: Surat Al-'Aĥzāb (The Combined Forces) - سورة الأحزاب

 

أَشِحَّةً عَلَيْكُمْ ۖ فَإِذَا جَاءَ الْخَوْفُ رَأَيْتَهُمْ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَيْكَ تَدُورُ أَعْيُنُهُمْ كَالَّذِي يُغْشَىٰ عَلَيْهِ مِنَ الْمَوْتِ ۖ فَإِذَا ذَهَبَ الْخَوْفُ سَلَقُوكُم بِأَلْسِنَةٍ حِدَادٍ أَشِحَّةً عَلَى الْخَيْرِ ۚ أُولَٰئِكَ لَمْ يُؤْمِنُوا فَأَحْبَطَ اللَّهُ أَعْمَالَهُمْ ۚ وَكَانَ ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى اللَّهِ يَسِيرًا

 

Indisposed toward you. And when fear comes, you see them looking at you, their eyes revolving like one being overcome by death. But when fear departs, they lash you with sharp tongues, indisposed toward [any] good. Those have not believed, so Allah has rendered their deeds worthless, and ever is that, for Allah , easy.

 

 Summary:

 

1.        Saiqa  صَعِقَ: to faint after being struck by some calamity from the sky(lightening)

2.        Sakara  سَكَرَ : Fainting/losing senses after having alcohol or some other intoxicant.

3.        Ghamara  غَمَرَ : to lose senses after facing hardships & difficulties

4.        Sara’a  صَرَع : to suddenly collapse/fall on ground  after fainting (some disease)

5.        Ghashee غَشى : common word used for unconsciousness .the reasons could be fear, disease, or any other reason)

9 BAAZ ANA[To Limit/To give up]
Synonyms INTAHA(NHY)and INNAFAKA(FKK)[(اِنْتَهَي (نهي) ،اِنَّفَكَ (فكّ)]
9.1 INTAHA(اِنْتَهَي)  :ANNAHA(اَلنّهْي) means to stop and INTAHA comes in the meaning of to stop or to give up.and ANNIHAU WANNIHAYATU(النِّهَاءُ وَالنِّهَايَةُ) is said to something's objective and last limit(the outcome). ALLAH said
Surat At-Tawbah (The Repentance) - سورة التوبة
9:12
وَإِن نَّكَثُوا أَيْمَانَهُم مِّن بَعْدِ عَهْدِهِمْ وَطَعَنُوا فِي دِينِكُمْ   فَقَاتِلُوا أَئِمَّةَ الْكُفْرِ ۙ إِنَّهُمْ لَا أَيْمَانَ لَهُمْ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَنتَهُونَ
And if they break their oaths after their treaty and defame your religion,   then fight the leaders of disbelief, for indeed, there are no oaths [sacred] to them; [fight them that] they might cease.
9.2 INNAFAKA اِنَّفَكَ   :FAKK((فكّ)means to free from some contract.FAKKU ALASIYR(فَكُّ الاَسِيْر) meaning to free a prisoner. FAKK URRIHN(فَكُّ الرِّهْن)to get back loaned item. and FAKKU RAQABAH(فَكَّ رَقَبَةٍ) to free a slave.and INFAKAK(انفكاك) means to detach by oneself , to open.and INFAKAKUL3ABD (اِنْفِكاَكُ الْعُبْد) means slave freeing up.also INFAKKA AL3AZMU(اِنْفَكَّ الْعَظْمُ) means dislocation of shoulders due to weakness.which means that INFAKAK the connotation of limiting is involuntarily.meaning the place where they cling, to detach and stay away from it involuntarily.ALLAH said
Surat Al-Bayyinah (The Clear Proof) - سورة البينة
98:1
لَمْ يَكُنِ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا مِنْ أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ وَالْمُشْرِكِينَ مُنفَكِّينَ حَتَّىٰ تَأْتِيَهُمُ الْبَيِّنَةُ
Those who disbelieved among the People of the Scripture and the polytheists were not to be parted [from misbelief] until there came to them clear evidence -
and this clear proof/reference is the prophethood of Muhammad (PBUH) and the dominance of Islam.which force them to stay away from Disbelief and Shirk (making partners with One God)
Summary
In INTAHA ,the process of limiting is to some extent voluntarily whereas in INFAKKA this process is in involuntarily form

1 CHABIY(KUNJI) [Key]
SYNONYMS: MAQALIYD(مَقالِيد),MAFATIH(مَفاتِح)
1.1 MAQALIYD  :QALADA(قَلَدَ) meaning to thin iron and to turn it or turn it to make bunch. and QALADقلاد or AQLIYDاقليد is that wire of copper or brass which is used in necklace.and QALADAHقلادة is also necklace.MIQLADمِقلَد is that iron key which is turned in to the lock to unlock    it.it   's plural is MAQALIDمَقالِد and Plural of plural is MAQALIYD. ALLAH said
Surat Ash-Shūraá (The Consultation) - سورة الشورى
42:12
لَهُ مَقَالِيدُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ ۖ يَبْسُطُ الرِّزْقَ لِمَن يَشَاءُ وَيَقْدِرُ ۚ إِنَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِيمٌ
To Him belong the keys of the heavens and the earth. He extends provision for whom He wills and restricts [it]. Indeed He is, of all things, Knowing.
1.2 MAFATIH  :FATAH(فَتَحَ) meaning to open or to get rid of constraint and complexity of something.and this word is used in all the context of opening door,unlocking lock,opening water way,to decree in some dispute,and to conquer some country.MIFTAHUNمِفْتَحٌ(plural MAFATIHمَفَاتِح) also means key and also water stream.and MIFTAHمِفْتَاح plural is MAFATIH then its plural is MAFATIYHمفاتيح. and this word is not used in the QURAN.so MAFATIH is more eloquent than MAQALIYD which is used in the meaning of, to get rid of any type of contraint or hurdle and opening.
ALLAH said
Surat Al-'An`ām (The Cattle) - سورة الأنعام
6:59
وَعِندَهُ مَفَاتِحُ الْغَيْبِ لَا يَعْلَمُهَا إِلَّا هُوَ ۚ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا فِي الْبَرِّ وَالْبَحْرِ ۚ وَمَا تَسْقُطُ مِن وَرَقَةٍ إِلَّا يَعْلَمُهَا وَلَا حَبَّةٍ فِي ظُلُمَاتِ الْأَرْضِ وَلَا رَطْبٍ وَلَا يَابِسٍ إِلَّا فِي كِتَابٍ مُّبِينٍ
And with Him are the keys of the unseen; none knows them except Him. And He knows what is on the land and in the sea. Not a leaf falls but that He knows it. And no grain is there within the darknesses of the earth and no moist or dry [thing] but that it is [written] in a clear record.

10-Spring (  چشمہ  )
Words used are ‘a’aen’(  عین  ), ‘yanbo’o’(  ینبوع   ) and ‘sariyyun’(  سری  ).
1)-a’aen: means eye and its plural in Quran is a’ayun(  اعین  ) because water flows from eye ,mouth of water skin is also called as a’aynun, and  Similarly spring which produces water too. A’aynun (  عین  ) is used for bursting spring and its plural is u’yoon(  عیون  ). For example:
And caused the earth to burst with springs, and the waters met for a matter already predestined.  قُدِرَ     قَدْ     أَمْرٍ     عَلَىٰ     الْمَاءُ     فَالْتَقَى     عُيُونًا     الْأَرْضَ     وَفَجَّرْنَا  [54:12]
2)-   ‘yanbo’o’(  ینبوع   ) naba’a(  نبع  ) means water bursting out from spring. And manba’a (  منبع  ) is that location from where it is bursted out. And yanbo’o(  ینبوع   ) is that spring with boiling or bursting water out. And yanab’aya(  ینابیع  ) is its plural. For example:
And they say, "We will not believe you until you break open for us from the ground a spring.  يَنبُوعًا     الْأَرْضِ     مِنَ     لَنَا     تَفْجُرَ     حَتَّىٰ     لَكَ     نُّؤْمِنَ     لَن     وَقَالُوا   [17:90]
3)-   ‘sariyy’(  سری  ) means small canal, running canal. Its plurals are asriyatun(  اسریہ   ) and suryan(  سریان  )
And sariyaatun(  ہ  سری  ) is known as battalion and military way as well, whose plural is saraya(  سرایا  ). And saryah(  ہ  ساری  ) means small army going at night, having the concept of small size or no. for example:
your Lord has provided beneath you a stream.      سَرِيًّاتَحْتَكِ     رَبُّكِ     جَعَلَ     قَدْ  [19:24].
Conclusion: with respect to eye it(spring) is known as   a’aen , ‘yanbo’o’(  ینبوع   ) for water bursting out from earth, and running spring in the form of small canal is called as      ‘sariyy’(  سری  ).

2)- ‘yanbo’o’(ینبوع ) naba’a(نبع) means water bursting out from spring. And manba’a (منبع) is that location from where it is bursted out. And yanbo’o(ینبوع ) is that spring with boiling or bursting water out. And yanab’aya(ینابیع) is its plural. For example:

And they say, "We will not believe you until you break open for us from the ground a spring.يَنبُوعًا الْأَرْضِ مِنَ لَنَا تَفْجُرَ حَتَّىٰ لَكَ نُّؤْمِنَ لَن وَقَالُوا [17:90]

3)- ‘sariyy’(سری) means small canal, running canal. Its plurals are asriyatun(اسریہ ) and suryan(سریان)

And sariyaatun(ہسری) is known as battalion and military way as well, whose plural is saraya(سرایا). And saryah(ہساری) means small army going at night, having the concept of small size or no. for example:

 your Lord has provided beneath you a stream.  سَرِيًّاتَحْتَكِ رَبُّكِ جَعَلَ قَدْ[19:24].

Conclusion: with respect to eye it(spring) is known as a’aen , ‘yanbo’o’(ینبوع ) for water bursting out from earth, and running spring in the form of small canal is called as  ‘sariyy’(سری).

11-Gush out and flow of stream(  بہنا     اور     پھوٹنا     کا     چشمے  )
Word used are ‘faara’(  فار  ), ‘inbajasa’(  انبجس  ), ‘infajarao’(  انفجراو  ), ‘fajjara’(  فجر  ), ‘nazakha’(  نضج  ), ‘saala’(sail)(   سال   (  سیل  )), ‘jaraa’(  جری  ) and ‘faaza’(faiz)(   فاض   (  فیض  )).
1)- ‘faara’(  فار  ), means showing enthusiasm and boiling. And fawar (  فور  ) means excitement and ebullition. Faaral-qidr(  فارالقدر  ) means boiling pot, faaral-ma’a(  فارالماء  ) means boiling water, faaral-irq(  فارالعرق  ) means nervousness of nerve. It is mainly concerned with boiling out of water rather than flowing of water. Especially with high pressure inside or from a narrow hole. The famous word (fawwarah)fountain is derived from it.
[So it was], until when Our command came and the oven overflowed   التَّنُّورُ     وَفَارَ     أَمْرُنَا     جَاءَ     إِذَا     حَتَّىٰ   [11:40]
2)-‘nazakha’(  نضج  ) means bursting out of water strongly, and ‘inzakha’ means bursting down of water. ‘nazzakha’(  نضاخ  ) is called as heavy rain and ‘manzakhah’(  منضخہ  ) is called as device used for spraying water. This word has more emphasised on overflowing and spouting of water rather than lifting up of water with pressure. For example:
In both of them are two springs, spouting.  نَضَّاخَتَانِ     عَيْنَانِ     فِيهِمَا  [55:66]
3)-   ‘inbajasa’(  انبجس  ) means anything open due to water ,it may be earth, rocks or mountain. And according to sahib Illalaghta(  اللغتہ     فقہ  ) this word is especially meant for rocks and mountains. For example:
And We inspired to Moses when his people implored him for water, "Strike with your staff the stone," and there gushed forth from it twelve springs.
ۖ     عَيْنًا     عَشْرَةَ     اثْنَتَا     مِنْهُ     فَانبَجَسَتْ     ۖ      الْحَجَرَ     بِّعَصَاكَ     اضْرِب     أَنِ     قَوْمُهُ     اسْتَسْقَاهُ     إِذِ     مُوسَىٰ     إِلَىٰ     وَأَوْحَيْنَا  [7:160]
4)-   ‘infajara’(  انفجراو  )and ‘inbajasa’(  انبجس  ) both has approximately same meaning. And they are used in the glorious Quran for the similar incident. For example verse related to  ‘infajara’(  انفجراو  ) is as follow:
And [recall] when Moses prayed for water for his people, so We said, "Strike with your staff the stone." And there gushed forth from it twelve springs      ۖ     عَيْنًا     عَشْرَةَ     اثْنَتَا     مِنْهُ     فَانفَجَرَتْ     ۖ     الْحَجَرَ     بِّعَصَاكَ     اضْرِب     فَقُلْنَا     لِقَوْمِهِ     مُوسَىٰ     اسْتَسْقَىٰ     وَإِذِ   [2:60]
Both the words slightly differs in two ways, first is that when the spring is not completely opened mouth and water is lifted up to some level then word used is ‘inbajasa’, and when it is completely opened mouth and water flows out from its port , then the word used is ‘infajara’. Second difference is that ‘inbajasa’ is used in the context of springs bursting out from rocky earth and mountain whereas the word ‘infajara’ is general. It can be used for earth as well as mountains. At the time of  Nooh(peace be upon him) water was burst out from normal level of earth while storm. Almighty Allah says:
And caused the earth to burst with springs, and the waters met for a matter already predestined.       قُدِرَ      قَدْ     أَمْرٍ     عَلَىٰ     الْمَاءُ     فَالْتَقَى     عُيُونًا     الْأَرْضَ     وَفَجَّرْنَا   [54:12]
5)-   ‘saala’(   سال  ) only has the concept of flowing of water , whether the water is rain water or flowing from spring.for example:
1) He sends down from the sky, rain, and valleys flow according to their capacity      بِقَدَرِهَا     أَوْدِيَةٌ     فَسَالَتْ     مَاءً     السَّمَاءِ     مِنَ     أَنزَلَ   [13:17]
2)     We made flow for him (Solomon) a spring of [liquid] copper.       ۖ     لْقِطْرِ     عَيْنَ     لَهُ     وَأَسَلْنَا  [34:12]
The word ‘sayyal’ (  سیال  )is also derived from it, it includes everything having the feature of flowing like water. And ‘sail’   (  سیل  )   is used in the context of strongly flowing downward.
<<end of page 417>>
And is ‘sail’ is known as flood (sailab) in general term. For example:
But they turned away [refusing], so We sent upon them the flood of the dam      الْعَرِمِ     سَيْلَ     عَلَيْهِمْ     فَأَرْسَلْنَا     فَأَعْرَضُوا   [34:16]
6)-   ‘jaraa’(  جری  ) starting of water or motion of water. It should not be so precipitous and not has high pressure. Flow or motion of water with normal speed whether from stream or from spring. For example:
1) In both of them [gardens] are two springs, flowing.      تَجْرِيَانِ     عَيْنَانِ     فِيهِمَا  [55:50]
2)     They will have gardens [in Paradise] beneath which rivers flow.      ۖ  الْأَنْهَارُ     تَحْتِهَا     مِن     تَجْرِي     جَنَّاتٍ     لَهُمْ   [2:25]
It is a general term used in holy Quran for the motion of winds, sun and the moon etc along with fluid things. Sometimes it is not used for its original meaning rather used virtually.for example, ‘sunnat-e-jaar’ is a famous word but the Quran does not define it’s any example predominantly, it is used in context of time and motion which means to flow for a long time or a long distance.
7-‘faaz’(  فاض  ) ,     فیض  : ‘faiz’ is been used in two context, 1)often occurrence of something, 2) something get uncontrollable due to its often occurrence or repetition. ‘faazassailu’(  السیل     فیض  ) means flow of water over the banks of the river. And   الاناء     افاض   means he filled the vessel to such n extent that it started overflowing from the edges. Quran says:      you see their eyes overflowing with tears because of what they have recognized of the truth.        ۖ  الْحَقِّ     مِنَ     عَرَفُوا     مِمَّا     الدَّمْع     مِنَ     تَفِيضُ     أَعْيُنَهُمْ     تَرَىٰ   [5:83],
Means eyes are filled with water such that tears starts flowing. At another place,
Then depart from the place from where [all] the people depart.     النَّاسُ     أَفَاضَ     حَيْثُ     مِنْ     أَفِيضُوا     ثُمَّ   [2:199],
Here people refers to a group or a crowd or a mass, who but obvious tends to be with them and it is been interpreted by the word ‘faaz’ , along with coming back with the crowd too. Similarly it is used at third place for extreme things,
Conclusion:
1)                ‘faara’  : bursting out of water forcefully.
2)                 ‘nazakha’: bouncing down of water.
3)                ‘inbajasa’: bursting out of water from spring from a narrow hole.
4)                ‘infajara’: bursting out of water from spring but with a wide hole.
5)                ‘saala’: used in the context of flow(only) of water and any liquid.
6)                ‘jaraa’: motion or flow of water or any other liquid for a long time or to a long distance with normal speed.
7)                ‘faaz’: flowing of water or some other thing just because of regularity(repetition, or often occurence)(overflow).

12-Walk
Words used are ‘masaa’(  مثی  ), ‘dabba’(   دب  ), ‘intalaqa’(   انطلق  ), ‘salaka’(   سلک  ), ‘saraba’(   سرب  ), ‘saraa’(   سری  ), ‘da’ab’(   داب  ), ‘mazaa’(   مظی  ), ‘naqqab’(   نقب  ) ‘saara’(   سار  , ‘sair’(   سیر  )), ‘qassa’(   قص  ), ‘rajila’(   رجل  , ‘rijalan’(   رجالا  )).
1)     ‘masaa’(  مثی  ) :walking from one place to another intentionally, step by step, moving and walking with normal speed. Generally , this word is used for walking. Quran says:   And they say, "What is this messenger that eats food and walks in the markets?      الْأَسْوَاقِ     فِي     وَيَمْشِي     الطَّعَامَ     يَأْكُلُ     الرَّسُولِ     هَـٰذَا      مَالِ     وَقَالُوا   [25:7]
2)     ‘dabba’(   دب  ) : It includes walking with slow and normal speed, creeping, crawling like snake, or children walking with the support of hands and legs. And everything walking and moving on earth. Quran says:     And there is no creature on earth but that upon Allah is its provision, and He knows .     رِزْقُهَا     اللَّهِ     عَلَى     إِلَّا     الْأَرْضِ     فِي     دَابَّةٍ     مِن     وَمَا  [11:6]
3)     ‘intalaqa’(   انطلق  ) ‘talaqa’ means releasing from any boundation. And ‘intalaqa’ means walking after pause. Standing up, to leave, to leave after getting release from prison, starting talk after being quiet. For example: 1)  So they set out, until when they had embarked on the ship.     السَّفِينَةِ     فِي     رَكِبَا     إِذَا     حَتَّىٰ     فَانطَلَقَا   [18:71]
2)(Moses said)And   my tongue will not be fluent, so send for Aaron.     هَارُونَ     إِلَىٰ     فَأَرْسِلْ     لِسَانِي     يَنطَلِقُ     وَلَا   [26:13]
4) ‘salaka’(   سلک  ) : used for two meanings, 1)following a path without deviating ,following and leading a path. Quran says:
[o bee]   Then eat from all the fruits and follow the ways of your Lord laid down [for you]."      ذُلُلًا     رَبِّكِ     سُبُلَ     فَاسْلُكِي     الثَّمَرَاتِ     كُلِّ     مِن     كُلِي     ثُمَّ   [16:69]
2)   الشئ     فی      نفوذالشئ   means influencing one thing into another, to enter, to make enter. Quran says:
Insert your hand into the opening of your garment; it will come out white, without disease.     رِ     سُوءٍ     غَيْ     مِنْ     بَيْضَاءَ     تَخْرُجْ     جَيْبِكَ     فِي     يَدَكَ     اسْلُكْ   [28:32]
5)- ‘saraba’(   سرب  ):means entering towards low ground or precipitousnes, and sarab means whole of wild animals. A pit, bottom sash, prison. It is said that , “snake entered into its hole”. Quran says:   and it took its course into the sea, slipping away.      فَاتَّخَذَ     سَبِيلَهُ     فِي     الْبَحْرِ     سَرَبًا   [18:61]
6)- ‘saraa’(   سری  ) (  یسری  ) means walking at night, travelling at night, and   الساریتہ   means a small group or crowd travelling at night. In Quran this word is meant for moving of night itself rather than travelling at night. For example:   And [by] the night when it passes .     وَاللَّيْلِ     إِذَا     يَسْرِ  [89:4]
7)- ‘da’ab’(   داب  ) trying to accomplish any task with hard work continuously in a regular manner, without any break or pause. Quran says:
And He subjected for you the sun and the moon, continuous [in orbit]        ۖ      وَسَخَّرَ     لَكُمُ     الشَّمْسَ     وَالْقَمَرَ     دَائِبَيْنِ  [14:33], at another place,
[Joseph] said, "You will plant for seven years consecutively.     تَزْرَعُونَ     سَبْعَ     سِنِينَ     دَأَبًا  [12:47]
8)- ‘mazaa’(   مظی  ) means to pass, to go, being free. It is used in the context of passing of time and era. And maazi is meant for passed era or provide the meaning for something which is passing or passed by. ‘mazaa ma mazaa’(  مضی     ما     مظی  ) means bygones be bygones or what happened has happened. Quran says:   فَ
1-And We destroyed greater than them in [striking] power, and the example of the former peoples has preceded.
فَأَهْلَكْنَا     أَشَدَّ     مِنْهُم     بَطْشًا     وَمَضَىٰ     مَثَلُ     الْأَوَّلِينَ  [43:8]
2-           "I will not cease [traveling] until I reach the junction of the two seas or continue for a long period."       حَتَّىٰ أَبْلُغَ مَجْمَعَ الْبَحْرَيْنِ أَوْ أَمْضِيَ حُقُبًا  [18:60]
Here ‘mazaaa’ is used in the context of era, he will not cease until periods passes away.
9)- ‘naqqab’(   نقب  ) : ‘naqaba’ means 1)making hole in wall or leather, 2) researching news. And  ‘naqqaba’ means navigating or to patrol. Entering a country, researching and investigating the situation. Quran says:
They  had explored throughout the lands. Is there any place of escape?     مَّحِيصٍ     مِن      هَلْ     الْبِلَادِ     فِي     فَنَقَّبُوا   [50:36]
10) ‘saara’(   سار  , ‘sair’(   سیر  )) means walking, roaming,  can be for any purpose. A person who is walking is termed as ‘saayur’ and a crowd walking in group is termed as ‘sayyarah’. Quran says:
And when Moses had completed the term and was traveling with his family.     بِأَهْلِهِ     وَسَارَ     الْأَجَلَ     مُوسَى     قَضَىٰ     فَلَمَّا   [28:29]

1) ‘masaa’(مثی) :walking from one place to another intentionally, step by step, moving and walking with normal speed. Generally , this word is used for walking. Quran says: And they say, "What is this messenger that eats food and walks in the markets?  الْأَسْوَاقِ فِي وَيَمْشِي الطَّعَامَ يَأْكُلُ الرَّسُولِ هَـٰذَا  مَالِ وَقَالُوا [25:7]

2) ‘dabba’( دب) : It includes walking with slow and normal speed, creeping, crawling like snake, or children walking with the support of hands and legs. And everything walking and moving on earth. Quran says: And there is no creature on earth but that upon Allah is its provision, and He knows . رِزْقُهَا اللَّهِ عَلَى إِلَّا الْأَرْضِ فِي دَابَّةٍ مِن وَمَا[11:6]

3) ‘intalaqa’( انطلق) ‘talaqa’ means releasing from any boundation. And ‘intalaqa’ means walking after pause. Standing up, to leave, to leave after getting release from prison, starting talk after being quiet. For example: 1)So they set out, until when they had embarked on the ship. السَّفِينَةِ فِي رَكِبَا إِذَا حَتَّىٰ فَانطَلَقَا [18:71]

                                            2)(Moses said)And my tongue will not be fluent, so send for Aaron. هَارُونَ إِلَىٰ فَأَرْسِلْ لِسَانِي يَنطَلِقُ وَلَا [26:13]

4) ‘salaka’( سلک) : used for two meanings, 1)following a path without deviating ,following and leading a path. Quran says:

[o bee] Then eat from all the fruits and follow the ways of your Lord laid down [for you]."  ذُلُلًا رَبِّكِ سُبُلَ فَاسْلُكِي الثَّمَرَاتِ كُلِّ مِن كُلِي ثُمَّ [16:69]

   2) الشئ فی  نفوذالشئ means influencing one thing into another, to enter, to make enter. Quran says:

 Insert your hand into the opening of your garment; it will come out white, without disease. رِ سُوءٍ غَيْ مِنْ بَيْضَاءَ تَخْرُجْ جَيْبِكَ فِي يَدَكَ اسْلُكْ [28:32]

 

5)- ‘saraba’( سرب):means entering towards low ground or precipitousnes, and sarab means whole of wild animals. A pit, bottom sash, prison. It is said that , “snake entered into its hole”. 13-to make move
Words used are ‘saaqa’(  ساق  (   سوق  )), ‘harraka’(   حرک  ), ‘azjaa’(  ازجی   (  زجو  )), ‘salaka’(   سلک  ), ‘sayyar’(   سیر  ) and ‘asra’(   اسری  ).
1)- ‘saaqa’(  ساق  (   سوق  )): means to drive, driving through tapping on back like shepherds drive their animals or driver who drives vehicle. Driver is termed as ‘sawwaq’. Quran says:   And will drive the criminals to Hell in thirst.        وِرْدًا     جَهَنَّمَ     إِلَىٰ     الْمُجْرِمِينَ     وَنَسُوقُ  [19:86]
2)   ‘harraka’(   حرک  ): ‘haraka’ means to move, to make any activity and ‘harraka’ means to move something, to make something moving forward.
For example:   Move not your tongue with it, [O Muhammad], to hasten with recitation of the Qur'an.     بِهِ     لِتَعْجَلَ     لِسَانَكَ     بِهِ     تُحَرِّكْ     لَا   [75:16]
3)   ‘azjaa’(  ازجی   (  زجو  )) :means to drive slowly or softly. ‘mazajja’ means weak. For example:   Do you not see that Allah drives clouds? Then He brings them together.     بَيْنَهُ     يُؤَلِّفُ     ثُمَّ     سَحَابًا     يُزْجِي     اللَّهَ     أَنَّ     تَرَ     أَلَمْ   [24:43]
4) ‘salaka’(   سلک  ) means 1-)walking on path.
2-)interpenetrating one thing into another or coming across, increasing.
This word is especially related to the path. Quran says:   [It is He] who has made for you the earth as a bed [spread out] and inserted therein for you roadways      سُبُلًا     فِيهَا     لَكُمْ     وَسَلَكَ     مَهْدًا     الْأَرْضَ     لَكُمُ     جَعَلَ     الَّذِي   [20:53]
5)   ‘sayyar’(   سیر  ): ‘saara’ means roaming, walking and travelling. ‘sayyar’(   سیر  ) means to make something move, travel. To see off. For example:     It is He who enables you to travel on land and sea.     وَالْبَحْرِ     الْبَرِّ     فِي     يُسَيِّرُكُمْ     الَّذِي     هُوَ  [10:22]
6)   ‘asra’(   اسری  ): ‘sara’ means moving on night. ‘asra’(   اسری  ) means to make move on night, to make travel /walk. Quran says:
"[O Lot] So set out with your family during a portion of the night.     اللَّيْلِ     مِّنَ     بِقِطْعٍ     بِأَهْلِكَ     فَأَسْرِ   [11:81]
At another place,   Exalted is He who took His Servant by night from .     لَيْلًا     بِعَبْدِهِ     أَسْرَىٰ     الَّذِي     سُبْحَانَ   [17:1]
Conclusion:
1)                ‘saaqa’(  ساق  (   سوق  )): to drive(to make move from back).
2)                ‘harraka’(   حرک  ): drive through an activity.
3)                ‘azjaa’(  ازجی   (  زجو  )): to make move slowly.
4)                ‘salaka’(   سلک  ): to follow a path.
5)                ‘sayyar’(   سیر  ): to make walk/roam.
6)                ‘asra’(   اسری  ): to make move/walk at night,

14-shout/scream
Words used are ‘na’aqa’ (  نعق  ), ‘sadda’(   صد  ), ‘ja’ara’(   جر  ), ‘istasrakha;(   استصرخ  (   صرخ  )), ‘sarra’(   صر  ).
1)       ‘na’aqa’ (  نعق  ) means calling someone loudly, shepherd calling his flock.
Quran says:     The example of those who disbelieve is like that of one who shouts at what hears nothing but calls and cries cattle or sheep - deaf, dumb and blind       ۚ     وَنِدَاءً     دُعَاءً     إِلَّا      يَسْمَعُ     لَا     بِمَا     يَنْعِقُ     الَّذِي     كَمَثَلِ     كَفَرُوا     الَّذِينَ     وَمَثَلُ   [2:171]
2)       ‘sadda’(   صد  ): ‘yasiddu’ means making noise without any reason,  saddad means to clap.
For example:   And when the son of Mary was presented as an example, immediately your people laughed aloud.
يَصِدُّونَ     مِنْهُ     قَوْمُكَ     إِذَا     مَثَلًا     مَرْيَمَ     ابْنُ     ضُرِبَ     وَلَمَّا  [43:57]
3)       ‘ja’ara’(   جر  ): means rumbling in loud voice, high pitch noise producing or groaning by wild animals due to nervousness like deer etc. For example:
Until when We seize their affluent ones with punishment, at once they are crying [to Allah ] for help.  يَجْأَرُونَ     هُمْ     إِذَا     بِالْعَذَابِ     مُتْرَفِيهِم     نَا     أَخَذْ     إِذَا     حَتَّىٰ  [23:64]
4)       ‘istasrakha’(   استصرخ  (   صرخ  )): ‘sarakha’ means crying out or screaming for help. to request. ‘asrakha’         means to reach someone to help him/her who asks for help. ‘istasrakha’(   استصرخ  (   صرخ  )) means to beg for help before people.
For example:   when suddenly the one who sought his help the previous day cried out to him [once again].     يَسْتَصْرِخُهُ     بِالْأَمْسِ     اسْتَنصَرَهُ     الَّذِي     فَإِذَا   [28:18]
5)       ‘sarra’(   صر  ): ‘sarra’(   صر  ) and   صرالرجل     صر   means someone shouting loudly. ‘sarrah’ means a high scream. For example:   And his wife approached with a cry [of alarm] and struck her face and said, "[I am] a barren old woman!"
عَقِيمٌ     عَجُوزٌ     وَقَالَتْ     وَجْهَهَا     فَصَكَّتْ     صَرَّةٍ     فِي     امْرَأَتُهُ     فَأَقْبَلَتِ  [51:29]
Conclusion:
1-     ‘na’aqa’ (  نعق  ): means calling someone loudly.
2-     ‘sadda’(   صد  ):making noise unnecessarily.
3-     ‘ja’ara’(   جر  ): groaning due to tension or nervousness.
4-     ‘istasrakha’(   استصرخ  (   صرخ  )): shouting or begging for help.
5-     ‘sarra’(   صر  ): screaming or shouting.

15- Clasp/Cling/Embrace
Words used in the glorious Quran are ‘Alhafa’(  الحف  ), ‘lazaba’(   لزب  ), and ‘lazima’(   لزم  ).
1)       ‘Alhafa’(  الحف  ) means blanket. It is a saying, ‘Al-haftuhu fal-tahafa’ i covered him with a blanket therefore he is embedded in it. And ‘Alhafa’(  الحف  ) means ‘ilhah’ that is begging persistently.
For example:
but you will know them by their [characteristic] sign. They do not ask people persistently [or at all].   .  إِلْحَافً     النَّاسَ     يَسْأَلُونَ     لَا     بِسِيمَاهُمْ     تَعْرِفُهُم  [2:273]
2)       ‘lazaba’(   لزب  ): the thing which sticks somewhere strongly is known as ‘lazib’. According to sahib                    Illalaghta it means sticky and gelatinous clay. In Quran this word is only meant for clay, hence used for both the context. For example:   We created men from sticky clay.      لَّازِبٍ     طِينٍ     مِّن     خَلَقْنَاهُم     إِنَّا   [37:11]
3)       ‘lazima’(   لزم  ) : used in two contexts. Means something get stick at a particular place for a long period.
This word is used at different place for different meanings in urdu language for this concept.   And if not for a word that preceded from your Lord, punishment would have been an obligation [due immediately], and [if not for] a specified term [decreed].   For example:
وَلَوْلَا كَلِمَةٌ سَبَقَتْ مِن رَّبِّكَ لَكَانَ لِزَامًا وَأَجَلٌ مُّسَمًّى  [20:129]
Conclusion:
1)                 ‘Alhafa’(  الحف  ): force someone for any work by begging persistently.
2)                 ‘lazaba’(   لزب  ): something get stick due to gelatinousness and sticky.
3)                 ‘lazima’(   لزم  ): two things get stick to each other for a long time.

title: content/ch/ch16.html
raw_text:
16- To Shine/ Brightness
Words used are ‘Bazag’a’(  بزغ  ), ‘Ashraqa’(  اشرق(     شرق)), ‘saqaba’(     ثقب), ‘sana’(     سنا(سنو)), ‘duriyyun’(     دری).
1)                 ‘Bazag’a’(  بزغ  ): means rising of sun when its light is scattering. Used for the sun, moon, stars and other bodies while they are rising. And ‘nujoomun bavazig’un’ is meant for rising stars.
Quran says:     And when he saw the sun rising, he said, "This is my lord.   رَبِّي  هَـٰذَا قَالَ بَازِغَةً الشَّمْسَ رَأَى     فَلَمَّا[6:78]
2)                 ‘Ashraqa’(  اشرق(     شرق)): ‘sharaq’ means scattering or spreading of light completely. And ‘ashraqa’ means to make something shine. Throwing light on it such that it shines out completely.
For example:   And the earth will shine with the light of its Lord.     رَبِّهَا بِنُورِ الْأَرْضُ     وَأَشْرَقَتِ [39:69]
3)                 ‘saqaba’(     ثقب): means lighting of fire or burning of flame, shimmering of star. ‘saqub’ means being reddish like that of fire, penetrating of light completely and being through something. ‘saqab’ means to make hole in something. And ‘saaqib’ means shiny to such an extent that can penetrate through anything on which it falls. Hence ‘saqab’ is means for intensity and reddishness like that of flame. Quran says:   Except one who snatches [some words] by theft, but they are pursued by a burning flame, piercing [in brightness].   ثَاقِبٌ شِهَابٌ فَأَتْبَعَهُ الْخَطْفَةَ     خَطِفَ     مَنْ     إِلَّا[37:10]
4)                 ‘sana’(     سنا(سنو)): means flashing of lightening. Light that can take away the eyesight.
Quran says:    The flash of its[of clouds] lightening almost takes away the eyesight.   بِالْأَبْصَارِ هَبُ يَذْ     بَرْقِهِ     سَنَا     يَكَادُ[24:43]
5)               ‘duriyyun’(     دری): ‘darra’ is meant for brightness and excess. ‘saifun duriyyun’ means shining or glowing sword.
‘darrun’ and ‘adwari’ means camel producing huge milk. The word ‘midraran’ has the same concept and ‘dur’ means shining pearl. Sometimes both the contexts are found together. For example, a very shining star that is intense as well as glowing. Quran says:   as if it were a pearly [white] star lit.     دُرِّيٌّ     كَوْكَبٌ كَأَنَّهَا[24:35]
Conclusion:
1)                 ‘Bazag’a’(  بزغ  ): means scattering of light while rising of heavenly bodies.
2)               ‘Ashraqa’(  اشرق(     شرق)): means falling of light on something and make it glow.
3)               ‘saqaba’(     ثقب): penetration of high intense light.
4)               ‘sana’(     سنا(سنو)): light which effect eyesight.
5)               ‘duriyyun’(     دری): high glowing.

17- Few
Words used are ‘ma’adudah’(  معدودہ  ), ‘biza’a’(   بضع  ), ‘nafar’(  نفر  ).
1)                 ‘ma’adudah’(  معدودہ  ): is meant for counting. Single or few, many in comparison of less. For example hundred is less than thousand. For example:   And they sold him for a reduced price - a few dirhams.     مَعْدُودَةٍ     دَرَاهِمَ     بَخْسٍ     بِثَمَنٍ     وَشَرَوْهُ  [12:20]
2)                 ‘biza’a’(   بضع  ): include countings from three to ten. It includes only odd numbers from 3 to 9. For example:
But they, after their defeat, will overcome. Within three to nine years.     سِنِينَ     بِضْعِ     فِي     سَيَغْلِبُونَ     غَلَبِهِمْ     بَعْدِ     مِّن     وَهُم  [30:4]
3) ‘nafar’(  نفر  ): ‘An-nafaru’ means all people as well as a group of from 3 to 10 peaple. ‘salaasatu nafarun aw anfaazin’ means 3 men. For example:          Say, [O Muhammad], "It has been revealed to me that a group of the jinn listened and said, 'Indeed, we have heard an amazing Qur'an.      عَجَبًقُرْآنًا     سَمِعْنَاإِنَّا     فَقَالُوا     الْجِنِّ     مِّنَ     نَفَرٌ     اسْتَمَعَ     أَنَّهُ     إِلَيَّ     أُوحِيَ     قُلْ   [72:1]
Conclusion:
1)                ‘ma’adudah’(  معدودہ  ): few in numbers. Less as compared to many.
2)                ‘biza’a’(   بضع  ): 3 to 10, for general things.
3)                ‘nafar’(  نفر  ):group of 3 to 10.
18- To Select
Words used are ‘ikhtaar’(  اختار   (  خیر  )), ‘istafaa’(   اصطفی  (  صفو  ), ‘ijtabaa’(  اجتبی  (  جبو  )), ‘istakhlasa’(   استخلص   (  خلص  )), ‘istana’a’(   اصطنع  (  صنع  ).
1)            ‘ikhtaar’(  اختار   (  خیر  )): ‘khair’ means something desired by everyone and ‘ikhtaar’ means to select the best one among the items of same type.
For example:   And Moses chose from his people seventy men for Our appointment.     لِّمِيقَاتِنَا     رَجُلًا     سَبْعِينَ     قَوْمَه     مُوسَىٰ     وَاخْتَارَ  [7:155]
2)            ‘istafaa’(   اصطفی  (  صفو  ): ‘as-safa’ and ‘safaw’ means to be neat and pure. ‘as-safiyyu’ and ‘as-safwah’ means a loyal friend. ‘istafaa’ to select something on the basis of its purification.
Quran says:   Indeed, Allah chose Adam and Noah and the family of Abraham and the family of 'Imran over the worlds
إِنَّ اللَّهَ اصْطَفَىٰ آدَمَ وَنُوحًا وَآلَ إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَآلَ عِمْرَانَ عَلَى الْعَالَمِينَ
3)               ‘ijtabaa’(  اجتبی  (  جبو  )): ‘jabaw’ means 1)to collect something and then 2)to take it somewhere. According to Ibn faris it means the collection of taxex and revenues including to carry it to treasure. ‘mujbaa’ means tax. Quran says:
Have we not established for them a safe sanctuary to which are brought the fruits of all things as provision from Us?     شَيْءٍ     كُلِّ     ثَمَرَاتُ     إِلَيْهِ     يُجْبَىٰ   [28:57]
And ‘ijtabaa’ means to select a good thing and make it closer, to choose it. Quran says:   And thus will your      Lord  choose you and teach you the interpretation of narratives.     الْأَحَادِيثِ      تَأْوِيلِ     مِن     وَيُعَلِّمُكَ     رَبُّكَ     يَجْتَبِيكَ     لِكَ     كَذَ  ‌  ٰوَ   [12:6]
4)            ‘istakhlasa’(   استخلص   (  خلص  )): ‘khalasa’(derive from ‘khalata’) means to be clear and exclusive from the cast of other things. And ‘khallasa’ means to make exclusive, safi is different from it as it may be already the exclusive one. Hence ‘istakhlasa’ means to select someone and make it reserve for own.
Quran says:   And the king said, "Bring him to me; I will appoint him exclusively for myself.".        ۖ  يلِنَفْسِ     أَسْتَخْلِصْهُ     بِهِ     ائْتُونِي     الْمَلِكُ     وَقَالَ   [12:54]
5)            ‘istana’a’(   اصطنع  (  صنع  ): ‘sana’a’ means to create something with artistic skills. ‘istana’a’ means selecting someone special and appoint him for an important purpose.
Allah says for Moses:   And I produced you for Myself.     يلِنَفْسِ     وَاصْطَنَعْتُكَ  [20:41]
Conclusion:
1)                ‘ikhtaar’(  اختار   (  خیر  )): to select the best one from different things.
2)                ‘istafaa’(   اصطفی  (  صفو  ): to select someone on the basis of its purification.
3)                ‘ijtabaa’(  اجتبی  (  جبو  )):selecting someone and make it own.
4)                ‘istakhlasa’(   استخلص   (  خلص  )):selecting someone special for a special purpose.
5)                 ‘istana’a’(   اصطنع  (  صنع  ): selecting and appointing someone special for a special purpose.

18 CHUN LAYNA [To Choose]
Synonyms: IKHTAR (KH-YA-RA)(اِخْتار (خير) ISTAFA(SA-FA-WA)(اِصْطَفَي (صفو) ,IJTABA(JA-BA-WA)(اِجْتَبَي (جبو),
ISTAKHLASA(KH-LA-SA)( اِسْتَخْلَصَ (خلص),ISTANA3A(SA-NA-3A)(اِصطَنَعَ(صنع)
18.1 IKHTAR  :KHAYR خير is every such thing and discourse which is desirable to all.and IKHTAR refers to selection of the better thing from lots of things of the same kind.In the QURAN
Surat Al-'A`rāf (The Heights) - سورة الأعراف
7:155
وَاخْتَارَ مُوسَىٰ قَوْمَهُ سَبْعِينَ رَجُلًا لِّمِيقَاتِنَا ۖ فَلَمَّا أَخَذَتْهُمُ الرَّجْفَةُ قَالَ رَبِّ لَوْ شِئْتَ أَهْلَكْتَهُم مِّن قَبْلُ وَإِيَّايَ ۖ أَتُهْلِكُنَا بِمَا فَعَلَ السُّفَهَاءُ مِنَّا ۖ إِنْ هِيَ إِلَّا فِتْنَتُكَ تُضِلُّ بِهَا مَن تَشَاءُ وَتَهْدِي مَن تَشَاءُ ۖ أَنتَ وَلِيُّنَا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَارْحَمْنَا ۖ وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ الْغَافِرِينَ
And Moses chose from his people seventy men for Our appointment. And when the earthquake seized them, he said, "My Lord, if You had willed, You could have destroyed them before and me [as well]. Would You destroy us for what the foolish among us have done? This is not but Your trial by which You send astray whom You will and guide whom You will. You are our Protector, so forgive us and have mercy upon us; and You are the best of forgivers.
18.2 ISTAFA  :ASSAFA الصّفا and SAFW صفو means pure and clean.ASSAFIYU اَلصَّفِيُّ and ASSAFWAH اَلصَّفْوَة is a sincere friend. and ISTAFA mean to select something on the basis of purity and cleanliness of self(NAFS نفس).In the QURAN
Surat 'Āli `Imrān (Family of Imran) - سورة آل عمران
3:33
إِنَّ اللَّهَ اصْطَفَىٰ آدَمَ وَنُوحًا وَآلَ إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَآلَ عِمْرَانَ عَلَى الْعَالَمِينَ
Indeed, Allah chose Adam and Noah and the family of Abraham and the family of 'Imran over the worlds -
18.3 IJTABA  :JABUW(جبو) means a) to collect something.b)then take it some where .YUJMA3U WA YUHMALU(يُجْمَعُ وَ يُحْمَلُ).in words of ibn faris JAMA3 ASSHAYEE WA ALTAJMM3(جمع الشئ والتجمّع). in addition word JABUW is used commonly for collecting tax or toll which also includes transfering it to the treasury.and MUJBA مُجبَي meaning tax. In the QURAN
Surat Al-Qaşaş (The Stories) - سورة القصص
28:57
وَقَالُوا إِن نَّتَّبِعِ الْهُدَىٰ مَعَكَ نُتَخَطَّفْ مِنْ أَرْضِنَا ۚ أَوَلَمْ نُمَكِّن لَّهُمْ حَرَمًا آمِنًا يُجْبَىٰ إِلَيْهِ ثَمَرَاتُ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ رِّزْقًا مِّن لَّدُنَّا وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
And they say, "If we were to follow the guidance with you, we would be swept from our land." Have we not established for them a safe sanctuary to which are brought the fruits of all things as provision from Us? But most of them do not know.
and IJTABA means to bring near/closer ,by selecting some fine/excellent   thing.to   make closer and choosen.In the QURAN
Surat Yūsuf (Joseph) - سورة يوسف
12:6
وَكَذَٰلِكَ يَجْتَبِيكَ رَبُّكَ وَيُعَلِّمُكَ مِن تَأْوِيلِ الْأَحَادِيثِ وَيُتِمُّ نِعْمَتَهُ عَلَيْكَ وَعَلَىٰ آلِ يَعْقُوبَ كَمَا أَتَمَّهَا عَلَىٰ أَبَوَيْكَ مِن قَبْلُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَإِسْحَاقَ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌ
And thus will your Lord choose you and teach you the interpretation of narratives and complete His favor upon you and upon the family of Jacob, as He completed it upon your fathers before, Abraham and Isaac. Indeed, your Lord is Knowing and Wise."
18.4 ISTAKHLASA  :KHALASA(خَلَصَ) (antonym KHALATA خَلَطَ)meaning to be free from mixture(impurities) and filth of other   things.to  be purified.and KHALLAS(خَلَّص) meaning to make pure.KHALAS is more eloquent than SAFA because SAFA could be clean before hand.thus ISTAKHLASA means to choose someone and to be specify for one's self. In the QURAN
Surat Yūsuf (Joseph) - سورة يوسف
12:54
وَقَالَ الْمَلِكُ ائْتُونِي بِهِ أَسْتَخْلِصْهُ لِنَفْسِي ۖ فَلَمَّا كَلَّمَهُ قَالَ إِنَّكَ الْيَوْمَ لَدَيْنَا مَكِينٌ أَمِينٌ
And the king said, "Bring him to me; I will appoint him exclusively for myself." And when he spoke to him, he said, "Indeed, you are today established [in position] and trusted."
18.5 ISTANA3A:  SANA3 صنع means to make something with technical skill/mastery.and ISTANA3A means for some special objective, to select some appropriate person and then trained him specially.ALLAH said regarding Moses (PBUH).
Surat Ţāhā (Ta-Ha) - سورة طه
20:41
وَاصْطَنَعْتُكَ لِنَفْسِي
And I produced you for Myself.
Summary:
18.1 IKHTAR:To select something better from lots of things
18.2 ISTAFA:To select something on the basis of purity
18.3 IJTABA:To select something then keep it close to oneself
18.4 ISTAKHLASA:To select some person for some special objective
18.5 ISTANA3A:to select some one for some special objective and then train in an appropriate manner

title: content/ch/ch19.html
raw_text:
19 CHAWPA-AY [Four Legged]
Synonyms: WUHUSH وُحُوش BAHA-IM بَهَائِم AN3AM اَنْعَام DAWWAB دَوَّاب
19.1 WUHUSH  :is plural of WAHASH(وحش). and WAHASH is antonym of INS(انس).meaning such living beings who doesn't get familiar with humans.wild animals and beast etc.In the QURAN
Surat At-Takwīr (The Overthrowing) - سورة التكوير
81:5
وَإِذَا الْوُحُوشُ حُشِرَتْ
And when the wild beasts are gathered
19.2 BAHA-IM  :is plural of BAHIYMAH بَهِيْمة. and it applies to all four legged except of wild four legged.whether of land or water(aquatic).yet it mostly applies to goat,sheep and cow etc.BHM بهم is lamb or kid/billy.and one definition of BAHIYMAH is that such four legged(except beast)who don't possess hearing.and BUHM بُهم is difficult task, and ABHAM اَبْهَمْ is dumb.
19.3 AN3AM  :is plural of NA3M نَعْم. so this word also applies to all animals except on beasts. yet this word is mostly used for camel.because for arabs there is no blessing greater than camel.In Quran , the word AN3AM even comes on it's own as well. as
Surat `Abasa (He Frowned) - سورة عبس
80:32
مَّتَاعًا لَّكُمْ وَلِأَنْعَامِكُمْ
[As] enjoyment for you and your grazing livestock.
Surat Ţāhā (Ta-Ha) - سورة طه
20:54
كُلُوا وَارْعَوْا أَنْعَامَكُمْ ۗ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَاتٍ لِّأُولِي النُّهَىٰ
Eat [therefrom] and pasture your livestock. Indeed, in that are signs for those of intelligence.
yet word BAHIMAH (in singular form) mostly comes with AN3AM.as
Surat Al-Ĥaj (The Pilgrimage) - سورة الحج
22:28
لِّيَشْهَدُوا مَنَافِعَ لَهُمْ وَيَذْكُرُوا اسْمَ اللَّهِ فِي أَيَّامٍ مَّعْلُومَاتٍ عَلَىٰ مَا رَزَقَهُم مِّن بَهِيمَةِ الْأَنْعَامِ ۖ فَكُلُوا مِنْهَا وَأَطْعِمُوا الْبَائِسَ الْفَقِيرَ
That they may witness benefits for themselves and mention the name of Allah on known days over what He has provided for them of [sacrificial] animals. So eat of them and feed the miserable and poor.
or as said
Surat Al-Mā'idah (The Table Spread) - سورة المائدة
5:1
يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا أَوْفُوا بِالْعُقُودِ ۚ أُحِلَّتْ لَكُم بَهِيمَةُ الْأَنْعَامِ إِلَّا مَا يُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْكُمْ غَيْرَ مُحِلِّي الصَّيْدِ وَأَنتُمْ حُرُمٌ ۗ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَحْكُمُ مَا يُرِيدُ
O you who have believed, fulfill [all] contracts. Lawful for you are the animals of grazing livestock except for that which is recited to you [in this Qur'an] - hunting not being permitted while you are in the state of ihram. Indeed, Allah ordains what He intends.
19.4 ADDAWWAB(الدوّاب)  :is plural of DAABAH(دآبة).and every animal that walks on the earth's surface whether by crawling on stomach as snake etc or on two feets as human.and some types of monkeys or having four legs like wild animals or four legged whether for riding or for loading (transport).male of female for all DAABAH is a common word.but its specifically used for horses,mule and donkey. In Quran Specifying/pecularity is not possible but it is used at all (as general)[Side note:It means the word was used in QURAN in general context].ALLAH said
Surat Hūd (Hud) - سورة هود
11:6
وَمَا مِن دَابَّةٍ فِي الْأَرْضِ إِلَّا عَلَى اللَّهِ رِزْقُهَا وَيَعْلَمُ مُسْتَقَرَّهَا وَمُسْتَوْدَعَهَا ۚ كُلٌّ فِي كِتَابٍ مُّبِينٍ
And there is no creature on earth but that upon Allah is its provision, and He knows its place of dwelling and place of storage. All is in a clear register.
though FI(في) before ARD( ارض) refers to this matter that it includes aquatic animals and birds as well
Surat Al-'Anfāl (The Spoils of War) - سورة الأنفال
8:55
إِنَّ شَرَّ الدَّوَابِّ عِندَ اللَّهِ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا فَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
Indeed, the worst of living creatures in the sight of Allah are those who have disbelieved, and they will not [ever] believe -
Summary:
19.1 WUHUSH:wild animals-beasts
19.2 BAHA-IM:all four legged except beasts.for grazing animals generally goat,sheep and cow etc
19.3 AN3AM:all four legged except beasts.for camels generally
19.4 DAWWAB:every 'walking' living being in the earth.

title: content/ch/ch2.html
raw_text:
2 CHADAAR [Cloth Sheet]
SYNONYMS:KHUMUR( خُمُر), JALABIYB(جَلاَبِيْب)
2.1 KHUMUR  :singular KHIMAR(خِمَار) meaning shawl,scarf,veil.KHIMAR is that small cloth sheet or scard with which face could be veiled and sides in addition to covering chest.ALLAH said
Surat An-Nūr (The Light) - سورة النور
24:31
وَقُل لِّلْمُؤْمِنَاتِ يَغْضُضْنَ مِنْ أَبْصَارِهِنَّ وَيَحْفَظْنَ فُرُوجَهُنَّ وَلَا يُبْدِينَ زِينَتَهُنَّ إِلَّا مَا ظَهَرَ مِنْهَا ۖ وَلْيَضْرِبْنَ بِخُمُرِهِنَّ عَلَىٰ جُيُوبِهِنَّ ۖ وَلَا يُبْدِينَ زِينَتَهُنَّ إِلَّا لِبُعُولَتِهِنَّ أَوْ آبَائِهِنَّ أَوْ آبَاءِ بُعُولَتِهِنَّ أَوْ أَبْنَائِهِنَّ أَوْ أَبْنَاءِ بُعُولَتِهِنَّ أَوْ إِخْوَانِهِنَّ أَوْ بَنِي إِخْوَانِهِنَّ أَوْ بَنِي أَخَوَاتِهِنَّ أَوْ نِسَائِهِنَّ أَوْ مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَانُهُنَّ أَوِ التَّابِعِينَ غَيْرِ أُولِي الْإِرْبَةِ مِنَ الرِّجَالِ أَوِ الطِّفْلِ الَّذِينَ لَمْ يَظْهَرُوا عَلَىٰ عَوْرَاتِ النِّسَاءِ ۖ وَلَا يَضْرِبْنَ بِأَرْجُلِهِنَّ لِيُعْلَمَ مَا يُخْفِينَ مِن زِينَتِهِنَّ ۚ وَتُوبُوا إِلَى اللَّهِ جَمِيعًا أَيُّهَ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ
And tell the believing women to reduce [some] of their vision and guard their private parts and not expose their adornment except that which [necessarily] appears thereof and to wrap [a portion of] their headcovers over their chests and not expose their adornment except to their husbands, their fathers, their husbands' fathers, their sons, their husbands' sons, their brothers, their brothers' sons, their sisters' sons, their women, that which their right hands possess, or those male attendants having no physical desire, or children who are not yet aware of the private aspects of women. And let them not stamp their feet to make known what they conceal of their adornment. And turn to Allah in repentance, all of you, O believers, that you might succeed.
2.2 JALABIYB  :singular JILBAB(جِلْبَاب)meaning cloth sheet or shirt and JALYABA(جَلْيَبَ) meaning to wear shawl or shirt.JILBAB is actually that big cloth sheet which can conver entire body from heat to toe.ALLAH said
Surat Al-'Aĥzāb (The Combined Forces) - سورة الأحزاب
33:59
يَا أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ قُل لِّأَزْوَاجِكَ وَبَنَاتِكَ وَنِسَاءِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ يُدْنِينَ عَلَيْهِنَّ مِن جَلَابِيبِهِنَّ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ أَدْنَىٰ أَن يُعْرَفْنَ فَلَا يُؤْذَيْنَ ۗ وَكَانَ اللَّهُ غَفُورًا رَّحِيمًا
O Prophet, tell your wives and your daughters and the women of the believers to bring down over themselves [part] of their outer garments. That is more suitable that they will be known and not be abused. And ever is Allah Forgiving and Merciful.

title: content/ch/ch20.html
raw_text:
20 CHURA CHURA YA REYZA REYZA [Bits and Pieces]
Synonyms: HASHIYM هَشِيْم HUTAM حُطَام GHUCAA-A(GH-CA-WA)(غُثآء (غثو) HABAA-A(HA-BA-WA)(هَبَاء(هبو) RUFAT رُفَات BASSA بَسَّ DAKKA- دَكَّاء
20.1 HASHIYM  :HASHAMA( هَشَمَ) meaning to beat.and HASHIYM is beaten dry grass.and it refers to powder of hay,straw,bran of every type of plant.In the QURAN
Surat Al-Qamar (The Moon) - سورة القمر
54:31
إِنَّا أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ صَيْحَةً وَاحِدَةً فَكَانُوا كَهَشِيمِ الْمُحْتَظِرِ
Indeed, We sent upon them one blast from the sky, and they became like the dry twig fragments of an [animal] pen.
20.2 HUTAM  :HATAMA(حَطَمَ)meaning to break,to twist and HATUWM حَطُوم is such an intense wind that will break and twist every thing.and HUTAM is broken,twisted or bits/particles of a thing.this word is also said for running over some thing or to reduce it to   particles.to   crush.ALLAH said
Surat Az-Zumar (The Troops) - سورة الزمر
39:21
أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ اللَّهَ أَنزَلَ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً فَسَلَكَهُ يَنَابِيعَ فِي الْأَرْضِ ثُمَّ يُخْرِجُ بِهِ زَرْعًا مُّخْتَلِفًا أَلْوَانُهُ ثُمَّ يَهِيجُ فَتَرَاهُ مُصْفَرًّا ثُمَّ يَجْعَلُهُ حُطَامًا ۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَذِكْرَىٰ لِأُولِي الْأَلْبَابِ
Do you not see that Allah sends down rain from the sky and makes it flow as springs [and rivers] in the earth; then He produces thereby crops of varying colors; then they dry and you see them turned yellow; then He makes them [scattered] debris. Indeed in that is a reminder for those of understanding.
20.3 GHUCAA-A  :meaning litter stuck in surf of flood water.decomposed leaves of trees which are mixed in surf.and GHASHIY ALKALAM(غَشِيَ اَلْكَلاَم) meaning to mix lie and truth in discourse.
and GHUCAA-A is also powder of grass n hay and also said for litter. In the QURAN
Surat Al-'A`lá (The Most High) - سورة الأعلى
87:4
وَالَّذِي أَخْرَجَ الْمَرْعَىٰ
And who brings out the pasture
Surat Al-'A`lá (The Most High) - سورة الأعلى
87:5
فَجَعَلَهُ غُثَاءً أَحْوَىٰ
And [then] makes it black stubble.
20.4 HABAA-A  :dust wind blows away .flying dust.fine particls of dust that are spread out in the air.and ALHABWATUN(اَلْهَبْوَةٌ) is a dust tornado. In the QURAN
Surat Al-Furqān (The Criterian) - سورة الفرقان
25:23
وَقَدِمْنَا إِلَىٰ مَا عَمِلُوا مِنْ عَمَلٍ فَجَعَلْنَاهُ هَبَاءً مَّنثُورًا
And We will regard what they have done of deeds and make them as dust dispersed.
20.5 RUFAT  :RAFATA( رَفَتَ) means to break and to beat. and RUFAT meaning beaten up ,crumble. a this word is used for reduced to powder owing to disintegration.In the QURAN
Surat Al-'Isrā' (The Night Journey) - سورة الإسراء
17:49
وَقَالُوا أَإِذَا كُنَّا عِظَامًا وَرُفَاتًا أَإِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ خَلْقًا جَدِيدًا
And they say, "When we are bones and crumbled particles, will we [truly] be resurrected as a new creation?"
20.6 BASSA  :meaning stones reduced to powder.and as per author of MAQA-IS ALLUGHA its basic meaning are two a) to reduced something to particles b)to mix it in to some other thing.from Holy QURAN both these meanings are affirmed.ALLAH said
Surat Al-Wāqi`ah (The Inevitable) - سورة الواقعة
56:5
وَبُسَّتِ الْجِبَالُ بَسًّا
And the mountains are broken down, crumbling
Surat Al-Wāqi`ah (The Inevitable) - سورة الواقعة
56:6
فَكَانَتْ هَبَاءً مُّنبَثًّا
And become dust dispersing.
20.7 DAKKA-  :DAKKA دَكَّ has two basic meanings a) to beat up b) then to level it. meaning to beat up something to reduce to powder and then to level it to ground.In the QURAN
Surat Al-'A`rāf (The Heights) - سورة الأعراف
7:143
وَلَمَّا جَاءَ مُوسَىٰ لِمِيقَاتِنَا وَكَلَّمَهُ رَبُّهُ قَالَ رَبِّ أَرِنِي أَنظُرْ إِلَيْكَ ۚ قَالَ لَن تَرَانِي وَلَٰكِنِ انظُرْ إِلَى الْجَبَلِ فَإِنِ اسْتَقَرَّ مَكَانَهُ فَسَوْفَ تَرَانِي ۚ فَلَمَّا تَجَلَّىٰ رَبُّهُ لِلْجَبَلِ جَعَلَهُ دَكًّا وَخَرَّ مُوسَىٰ صَعِقًا ۚ فَلَمَّا أَفَاقَ قَالَ سُبْحَانَكَ تُبْتُ إِلَيْكَ وَأَنَا أَوَّلُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ
And when Moses arrived at Our appointed time and his Lord spoke to him, he said, "My Lord, show me [Yourself] that I may look at You." [ Allah ] said, "You will not see Me, but look at the mountain; if it should remain in place, then you will see Me." But when his Lord appeared to the mountain, He rendered it level, and Moses fell unconscious. And when he awoke, he said, "Exalted are You! I have repented to You, and I am the first of the believers."
at another place
Surat Al-Kahf (The Cave) - سورة الكهف
18:98
قَالَ هَٰذَا رَحْمَةٌ مِّن رَّبِّي ۖ فَإِذَا جَاءَ وَعْدُ رَبِّي جَعَلَهُ دَكَّاءَ ۖ وَكَانَ وَعْدُ رَبِّي حَقًّا
[Dhul-Qarnayn] said, "This is a mercy from my Lord; but when the promise of my Lord comes, He will make it level, and ever is the promise of my Lord true."
Summary:
20.1 HASHIYM:dry powder-straw of every type of plant.
20.2 HUTAM:dry plants-that powder which formed of running over and crushing over.
20.3 GHUCAA-A:Weed-litter
20.4 HABAA-A:Dust and Dirt-Air bourne particles of every thing.
20.5 RUFAT:Something powdered owing to disintegration.
20.6 BASSA:stone or some hard thing being powdered
20.7 DAKKA-:some thing powdered to the ground
<<Alternate: page 430>>
Page 430
1.       دَكَّآءَ- dakka   has basically 2 meanings: (1) To crush something and (2) lay it even with the ground.
(7:143)   فَلَمَّا تَجَلَّىٰ رَبُّهُ لِلْجَبَلِ جَعَلَهُ   دَكًّ  ا
-but when his Lord manifested His glory to the mountain He made it crumble.
-At another place its stated:
(18:98)    فَإِذَا جَاءَ وَعْدُ رَبِّي جَعَلَهُ   دَكَّاءَ
-but when the promise of my Lord comes, He will make it level
Summary:
1.       haxiim- dry twig fragments
2.       HuTaam- what is broken in pieces of a thing that is dry
3.       gucaae- the rubbish of dead leaves, scum
4.       hbae- dust particles
5.       rafaat- a thing that has become old and worn out, and crumbled or broken out into small pieces
6.       bassa- breaking a hard thing or stone into pieces
7.       dakkaae- To crush something and lay it even with the ground

title: content/ch/ch21.html
raw_text:
21- TO STEAL
1-      saraqa  : To steal- To take secretly a thing from somebody else’s  property in a secure place.
Allah SWT says:
(5:38)   وَالسَّارِقَةُ فَاقْطَعُوا أَيْدِيَهُمَا     وَالسَّارِقُ
-And (as for) the man who steals and the woman who steals, cut off their hands
-  istaraqa   means ‘to try to steal’
-    ِإستَرَقُ ٱلسَمَع    -To listen or hear by stealth
Allah SWT says:
(15:18)   إِلَّا مَنِ اسْتَرَقَ السَّمْعَ فَأَتْبَعَهُ شِهَابٌ مُبِينٌ
-But he who steals a hearing, so there follows him a visible flame.
2-      غَلَّ:  to steal something and keep in one’s own luggage. Used for stealing and defalcation. For example to take something from booty which does not classify as stealing.
Allah SWT says:
(3:161)      وَمَنْ يَغْلُلْ يَأْتِ بِمَا غَلَّ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ
And whoever betrays, [taking unlawfully], will come with what he took on the Day of Resurrection.
Summary:
1-saraqa: To steal
2-galla- a combined form of stealing and  defalcation.

22. CHOWKIDAAR
[ watchman ]
Synonyms: HARASA, RASAD, MU3AQIBAAT
25.1 HARASA (حَرَسَ) :   means to take under protection, to take in custody, to guard over. To watch over a criminal. According to Ibn Alfaaris, two things are found in   حرس   . 1) protection 2) to watch over for a certain period of time.   الملك حرس   means royal protector, body guard.
___________________________________
Surah Al-Jinn (The Jinn)
72:8
وَأَنَّا لَمَسْنَا السَّمَاء فَوَجَدْنَاهَا مُلِئَتْ   حَرَسًا   شَدِيدًا وَشُهُبًا
And we have sought to reach the heaven; but found it filled with stern   guards   and flaming fires.
___________________________________
25.2 RASAD (رَصَد) :   means to sit and watch over. To lay in wait. And   مرصاد   means the place where you lay in wait. And   رَاصِد   refers to   the one who   lies in wait.
___________________________________
Surah Al-Jinn (The Jinn)
72:27
إِلَّا مَنِ ارْتَضَى مِن رَّسُولٍ فَإِنَّهُ يَسْلُكُ مِن بَيْنِ يَدَيْهِ وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِ   رَصَدًا
Except to a Messenger whom He has chosen, and then He makes a band of   watching guards   to march before him and behind him.
___________________________________
25.3 MU3AQIB   (مُعَقِّبْ)   :   عَقَّب   means to come behind, to walk behind. And   مُعَقِّبَات   means the one who walks behind. The one in charge, the one who protects, guard, watchman.
___________________________________
Surah Ar-Ra'd (The Thunder)
13:11
لَهُ   مُعَقِّبَاتٌ   مِّن بَيْنِ يَدَيْهِ وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِ يَحْفَظُونَهُ مِنْ أَمْرِ اللّهِ
For him, there are   guards   in succession, before and behind him. They guard him by the Command of Allâh.
___________________________________
SUMMARY
HARASA  : the guard who protects and watches over someone for a certain period of time.
RASADA  : the guard who sits and watches for when his prey will come and he will catch it.
MU3AQIBAAT  : the guard or protector who stays with and protects and saves from problems.

23. CHUPNA    [ to hide yourself ]
Synonyms: GHABA, AFALA, GHARABA, 3AZABA, WAQABA, BATANA, TAWAARAA, KHAFIYA, KANNA.
23.1  GHABA   (غَابَ)   :   this word is common.   غَيْب   is used for a thing that has vanished. The use of this word is common for a thing which disappears from sight because of some reason or at sometime. Its opposite is   حَضَرَ   . Although according to Saahib Faka Allaghta, everything that is hidden from the knowledge and awareness of humans, is GHAIB. But it can be imagined by the heart.
____________________________________
Surah An-Naml (The Ants)
27:75
وَمَا مِنْ   غَائِبَةٍ   فِي السَّمَاء وَالْأَرْضِ إِلَّا فِي كِتَابٍ مُّبِينٍ
And there is nothing   hidden   in the heaven and the earth, but is in a Clear Book.
_____________________________________
23.2  AFALA     (اَفَلَ)  : this word is used for the disappearing or the setting of heavenly bodies (such as the sun, moon and stars).
_____________________________________
Surah Al-An'am (The Cattle)
6:77
فَلَمَّا رَأَى الْقَمَرَ بَازِغًا قَالَ هَذَا رَبِّي فَلَمَّا   أَفَلَ
When he saw the moon rising up, he said: "This is my lord." But when it   set  .
_____________________________________
23.3  GHARABA   (غَرَبَ)   :   this word is used for the disappearing or the setting of the sun. (like   شرق   for its coming out, and in   طَلَعَ   the sun and all planets are included).
_____________________________________
Surah Al-Kahf (The Cave)
18:16
وَتَرَى الشَّمْسَ إِذَا طَلَعَت تَّزَاوَرُ عَن كَهْفِهِمْ ذَاتَ الْيَمِينِ وَإِذَا   غَرَبَت   تَّقْرِضُهُمْ ذَاتَ الشِّمَالِ
And you might have seen the sun, when it rose, declining to the right from their Cave, and when it   set  , turning away from them to the left.
_____________________________________
23.4  3AZABA   (عَزَبَ)   :   to vanish from the sight because of going far away. And   عازب   refers to that man who goes away from his people in search of grass.   عَزَّب   means to disappear for a long time.
_____________________________________
Surah Yunus (Jonah)
10:61
وَمَا   يَعْزُبُ   عَن رَّبِّكَ مِن مِّثْقَالِ ذَرَّةٍ
And nothing is   hidden   from your Lord (so much as) the weight of an atom.
_____________________________________
23.5  WAQABA   (وَقَبَ)   :   means to go into a hole and disappear. For the setting of the sun ا  لشَّمْس وَقَبَت   is used.   الظلام وقب   refers to the spreading of darkness.   اَلْوَقْب   means a hole made of stone in which water has collected. And   وَقَبَ   means to enter a hole.
_____________________________________
Surah Al-Falaq (The Daybreak)
113:3
وَمِن شَرِّغَاسِقٍ إِذَا   وَقَبَ
And from the evil of the darkening (night) as it   comes with its     darkness  .
_____________________________________
23.6  BATANA     (بَطَنَ)   :   بطن   means the stomach, or the internal part of something. As internal parts are completely hidden,   بَطَنَ    is used for something that is completely hidden and its opposite is   ظَهَرَ  .
_____________________________________
Surah Al-A'raf (The Heights)
7:33
قُلْ إِنَّمَا حَرَّمَ رَبِّيَ الْفَوَاحِشَ مَا ظَهَرَ مِنْهَا وَمَا   بَطَنَ
Say : the things that my Lord has indeed forbidden are Al-Fawâhish whether committed openly or   secretly  .
______________________________________
23.7  TAWAARAA   (تَوَارى)   :   ورى     means to hide the truth.   يتوارى   means to hide from people after************* by the truth.
_______________________________________
Surah An-Nahl (The Bees)
16:59
يَتَوَارَى   مِنَ الْقَوْمِ مِن سُوءِ مَا بُشِّرَ بِهِ
He   hides   himself from the people because of the evil of that whereof he has been informed.
_______________________________________
23.8  KHAFIYA   (خَفِىَ)   :   (opposite is   بَدَا   and   عَلَنَ  ) the hiding of a thing. This word is even more common than   غاب  . It refers to the hiding of a thing which cannot even be imagined.
_______________________________________
Surah Ale-Imran (The Family of Imran)
3:5
إِنَّ اللّهَ لاَ   يَخْفَىَ   عَلَيْهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الأَرْضِ وَلاَ فِي السَّمَاء
Truly, nothing is   hidden   from Allâh, in the earth or in the heaven.
________________________________________
23.9  KANNA   (كَنَّ)   :    كِنّ     means a safe place or a cave in a mountain where a human can seek refuge. Its plural words are   اَكِنَّة   and   اَكْنَان  . And    كَنَّ   means a thing which is hidden in a safe place which is inaccessible to ordinary people.
________________________________________
Surah As-Saffaat (Those Arranged in Ranks)
37:49
كَأَنَّهُنَّ   بَيْضٌ مَّكْنُونٌ
As if they were eggs which were   kept in a safe place  .
________________________________________
SUMMARY
GHABA:   something which is out of the awareness of the human senses.
AFALA:   the setting of the heavenly bodies.
GHARABA:   the setting of the sun
3AZABA:   to disappear due to going far away
WAQABA:   to disappear due to climbing into a hole
BATANA:   to be completely hidden.
YATWAARAA:   to hide from others due to ******* from a truth
KHAFIYA:   this word is more common than GHABA
KANNA:   to hide in a safe place.
