12 HUMWAAR KERNA
[To level]
Synonyms: SATAH(  سطح  ), DAKKA(  دك  ), MARRAD(  مرد  )
12.1 satah(  سطح  )  : two things are included in the meaning of satah(  سطح  ): (i)to spread, to stretch (ii) then to level it. Satah-ul-bait(  سطح البيت  ) meaning to level the roof of a house and mistah(  مسطح  ) means the instrument used to level something and satah(  سطح  ) means the upper portion of the roof of a house. In the words of Imam Raghib:   اعلى البيت جعل سويا   Allah states that:
________________
Surat Al-Ghashiya (The Overwhelming) -   سُوۡرَةُ الغَاشِیَة
88:20
وَإِلَى ٱلۡأَرۡضِ كَيۡفَ سُطِحَتۡ
And the earth, how it is spread?
________________
12.2 dakka (  دك  )  : basic meanings: (i)to crush (ii)then to level it i.e. to crush something and level it to the ground. Allah states that:
________________
Surat Al-Kahf (The Cave) -   سُوۡرَةُ الکهف
18:98
فَإِذَا جَآءَ وَعۡدُ رَبِّى جَعَلَهُ ۥ دَكَّآءَ‌ۖ
He said: This is a mercy from my Lord; but when the promise of my Lord cometh to pass, He will lay it low, for the promise of my Lord is true.
________________
12.3 marrada (  مرد  )  : marid-al-ghulam(  مرد الغلام  ) meaning man gone astray and marrad-al-fusn(  مرد ألفصن  ) meaning cleaning the leaves of the branch and marrad-al-bana’a(  مرد البناء  ) meaning to smooth a building and to dampen it. Allah states that:
________________
Surat Al-Naml (The Ant) -   سُوۡرَةُ النَّمل
27:44
الَ إِنَّهُ ۥ صَرۡحٌ۬ مُّمَرَّدٌ۬ مِّن قَوَارِيرَ‌ۗ
It was said unto her: Enter the hall. And when she saw it she deemed it a pool and bared her legs. (Solomon) said: Lo! it is a hall, made smooth, of glass. She said: My Lord! Lo! I have wronged myself, and I surrender with Solomon unto Allah, the Lord of the Worlds.
________________
Summary:
1. SATAH(  سطح  ): to spread and level it.
2. DAKKA(  دك  ): to level something by crushing it.
3. MARRADA(  مرد  ): to level and dampen.

13 HAMESHA
[always]
Synonyms: SARMAD(  سرمد  ), ABD(  ابد  )
13.1 sarmad(  سرمد  )  : means eternity, always. Sarmadi(  سرمدي  ) meaning something which has no start or end, something to be in the same state at all times and not having any kind of change in it. Allah states that:
________________
Surat Al-Qasas (The STory) -   سُوۡرَةُ القَصَص
28:71

وَلَا يَتَمَنَّوۡنَهُ ۥۤ أَبَدَۢا بِمَا قَدَّمَتۡ أَيۡدِيهِمۡ‌ۚ

14 HAMESHA HONA, REHNA
[forever]
Synonyms: KHALADA(  خلد  ), WASABA(  وصب  ), ZALLA(  ظل  ), ISTAMAR(  استمر  ), DAAM(  دام  ), ZAAL(  زال  ), ABRAH(  أبرح  ), FATAA(  فتا  )
14.1 khalada(  خلد  )  : the word khalada(  خلد  ) is not used for everlasting but for something to not show any transformation or destruction from its beginning till a long time because this word is used to put stress with abada(  ابد  ) and when only a long time period is to be mentioned then only this word will be used, the word abada(  ابد  ) will not come with it. Allah states that:
________________
Surat Al-Bayyina (The Proof)  -   سُوۡرَةُ البَیّنَة
98:6
نَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ مِنۡ أَهۡلِ ٱلۡكِتَـٰبِ وَٱلۡمُشۡرِكِينَ فِى نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيہَآ‌ۚ
Lo! those who disbelieve, among the People of the Scripture and the idolaters, will abide in fire of hell. They are the worst of created beings.
________________
and n the same surah, when the reward of good muslims is mentioned, it is stated:
________________
Surat Al-Bayyina (The Proof)  -   سُوۡرَةُ البَیّنَة
98:8
جَزَآؤُهُمۡ عِندَ رَبِّہِمۡ جَنَّـٰتُ عَدۡنٍ۬ تَجۡرِى مِن تَحۡتِہَا ٱلۡأَنۡہَـٰرُ خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيہَآ أَبَدً۬ا‌ۖ
Their reward is with their Lord: Gardens of Eden underneath which rivers flow, wherein they dwell for ever. Allah hath pleasure in them and they have pleasure in Him. This is (in store) for him who feareth his Lord.
________________
and akhlada(  اخلد  ) and khallada(  خلد  ) are used to show some thing’s steadfastness on some situation for a long time or to be in the same conditions as is stated:
________________
Surat Al-Humaza (The Slanderer)  -   سُوۡرَةُ الهُمَزة
104:3
يَحۡسَبُ أَنَّ مَالَهُ ۥۤ أَخۡلَدَهُ ۥ
He thinketh that his wealth will render him immortal.
________________
at another point, it is stated:
________________
Surat Al-Waqia (The Event)  -   سُوۡرَةُ الواقِعَة
56:17
يَطُوفُ عَلَيۡہِمۡ وِلۡدَٲنٌ۬ مُّخَلَّدُونَ
There wait on them immortal youths
________________
14.2 wasaba (  وصب  )  : according to Ibn-al-Faris, its meaning is the continuity of something on a particular state and according to the people of lexical jurisprudence, it is the severity of something like severity of pain and alwasib(  الواصب  ) means land spread till a long distance and wasaba(  وصب  ) means to be perpetual, to be determined and be eternal. Allah states that:
________________
Surat As-Saffaat (The Rangers) -   سُوۡرَةُ الصَّافات
37:9
وَلَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ۬ وَاصِبٌ
Outcast, and theirs is a perpetual torment;
________________
here, the word wasib(  واصب  ) includes all three meanings of continuity, severity and spread. But then this word stated being used only for severity, strength and vastness. Allah states that:
________________
Surat An-Nahl (The Bee)  -   سُوۡرَةُ النّحل
16:52
وَلَهُ ۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٲتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَلَهُ ٱلدِّينُ وَاصِبًا‌ۚ
Unto Him belongeth whatsoever is in the heavens and the earth, and religion is His for ever. Will ye then fear any other than Allah?
________________
14.3 zalla (  ظل  )  : meaning to last forever. Zallal yom(  ظل اليوم  ) meaning the day to be shady, to be in shade all day. Zallal(  ظلل  ) means that water that is always in the shade of trees and zaleel(  ظليل  ) meaning shady, forever providing shade. Zaliltu(  ظللت  ) and zaltu(  ظلت  ) are actually used for those works which are done in the day but sometimes it gives the meaning of sirtu(  صرت  ) i.e. to be completed or a little left. Zalla(  ظل  ) means to do some work the complete day or be in the same situation the complete day. Thus zalla(  ظل  )  includes continuity for the complete day or for some time period. Allah states that:
________________
Surat Ash-Shura (The Council) -   سُوۡرَةُ الشّوریٰ
42:33
إِن يَشَأۡ يُسۡكِنِ ٱلرِّيحَ فَيَظۡلَلۡنَ رَوَاكِدَ عَلَىٰ ظَهۡرِهِۦۤ‌ۚ
If He will He calmeth the wind so that they keep still upon its surface - Lo! herein verily are signs for every steadfast grateful (heart).
________________
14.4 istamar (  استمر  )  : marra(  مر  ) meaning to pass, to go, to go past something and istamar(  استمر  ) means to be steadfast on some habit or condition, everlasting. Allah states that:
________________
Surat Al-Qamar (The Moon) -   سُوۡرَةُ القَمَر
54:2
وَإِن يَرَوۡاْ ءَايَةً۬ يُعۡرِضُواْ وَيَقُولُواْ سِحۡرٌ۬ مُّسۡتَمِرٌّ۬
And if they behold a portent they turn away and say: Prolonged illusion.
________________
Summary:
1. KHALADA(  خلد  ): to be in same condition without change for a long time period.
2. WASABA(  وصب  ): includes vastness and strength along with continuity.
3. ZALLA(  ظل  ): to do some work the complete day, or to be in same condition the complete day.
4. ISTAMAR(  استمر  ): to be in the same state from the beginning till the current time.
________________
14.5 daama (  دام  )  : dawaam(  دوام  ) meaning calmness and maa-ad-daim(  ماء الدائم  ) meaning stagnant water which has no movement  and daam-ash-shaye(  دام الشي  ) meaning something to be in one state without change and dawaam(  دوام  ) meaning forever. Sometimes, this word is associated with some other state i.e. this state will continue to be for the time the other state remains. When used with the word   ما  , it will become madaam(  مادام  ) which means until. Allah states that:
________________
Surat Al-Maeda (The Table) -   سُوۡرَةُ المَائدة
5:23
قَالُواْ يَـٰمُوسَىٰٓ إِنَّا لَن نَّدۡخُلَهَآ أَبَدً۬ا مَّا دَامُواْ فِيهَا‌ۖ
They said: O Moses! We will never enter (the land) while they are in it. So go thou and thy Lord and fight! We will sit here.
________________
14.6 zaala (  زال  )  : means to dispel, waver off and zawaal(  زوال  ) means to adapt. When this word is used with   لا   or   ما   it will give the meaning of everlasting and in these meanings, it is always used with   لا   or   ما   and used for time durations. Allah states that:
________________
Surat Al-Maeda (The Table) -   سُوۡرَةُ المَائدة
5:13
وَلَا تَزَالُ تَطَّلِعُ عَلَىٰ خَآٮِٕنَةٍ۬ مِّنۡہُمۡ إِلَّا قَلِيلاً۬ مِّنۡہُمۡ‌ۖ
And because of their breaking their covenant, We have cursed them and made hard their hearts. They change words from their context and forget a part of that whereof they were admonished. Thou wilt not cease to discover treachery from all save a few of them. But bear with them and pardon them. Lo! Allah loveth the kindly. ________________
at another point it is stated:
________________
Surat Al-Anbiya (The Prophets) -   سُوۡرَةُ الاٴنبیَاء
21:15
فَمَا زَالَت تِّلۡكَ دَعۡوَٮٰهُمۡ حَتَّىٰ جَعَلۡنَـٰهُمۡ حَصِيدًا خَـٰمِدِينَ
And this their crying ceased not till We made them as reaped corn, extinct.
________________
14.7 abraha (  أبرح  )  : the antonym of baraha(  برح  ) is baraza(  برز  ) and baraza(  برز  ) means to come forward in a vast land and baraha(  برح  ) means to go back from an open land. When the negation word   لا   or   ما   is used with this word, it will give the meaning of distance and always comes with hatta(  حتى  ). Allah states that:
________________
Surat Al-Kahf (The Cave) -   سُوۡرَةُ الکهف
18:60
وَإِذۡ قَالَ مُوسَىٰ لِفَتَٮٰهُ لَآ أَبۡرَحُ حَتَّىٰٓ أَبۡلُغَ مَجۡمَعَ ٱلۡبَحۡرَيۡنِ
And when Moses said unto his servant: I will not give up until I reach the point where the two rivers meet, though I march on for ages.
________________
at another point, it is stated:
________________
Surat Ta-Ha  -   سُوۡرَةُ طٰه
20:91
قَالُواْ لَن نَّبۡرَحَ عَلَيۡهِ عَـٰكِفِينَ حَتَّىٰ يَرۡجِعَ إِلَيۡنَا مُوسَىٰ
They said: We shall by no means cease to be its votaries till Moses return unto us.
________________
14.8 fataa (  فتا  )  : meaning to stop someone from doing something. When it comes with   لا   or   ما   it gives the meaning of continuity in some work. It is said   ما فتا يفعل ذالك   which means he continued doing that, usually associated with hatta(  حتى  ), only used for past and past perfect, used for time durations. This word has been used in the Quran just once along with   لا.   Allah states that:
________________
Surat Yusuf -   سُوۡرَةُ یُوسُف
12:85
قَالُواْ تَٱللَّهِ تَفۡتَؤُاْ تَذۡڪُرُ يُوسُفَ حَتَّىٰ تَكُونَ حَرَضًا أَوۡ تَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلۡهَـٰلِكِينَ
They said: By Allah, thou wilt never cease remembering Joseph till thy health is ruined or thou art of those who perish!
________________
Summary:
5. DAAMA(  دام  ): only associated with the past tense, showing change in state, used for time and distance.
6. ABRAHA(  أبرح  ): only perfect tense, used with   لا   and   ما   for negation and comes with hatta(  حتى  ), used for distance.
7. ZAALA(  زال  ): for past and perfect tense, used with   لا   and   ما  , used for time.
8. FATAA(  فتا  ):for past and perfect tense, used with   لا   and   ما  , comes with hatta(  حتى  ), used for time.

فَمَا زَالَت تِّلۡكَ دَعۡوَٮٰهُمۡ حَتَّىٰ جَعَلۡنَـٰهُمۡ حَصِيدًا خَـٰمِدِينَ

And this their crying ceased not till We made them as reaped corn, extinct.

 ________________

14.7 abraha (أبرح): the antonym of baraha(برح) is baraza(برز) and baraza(برز) means to come forward in a vast land and baraha(برح) means to go back from an open land. When the negation word لا or ما is used with this word, it will give the meaning of distance and always comes with hatta(حتى). Allah states that:

________________

Surat Al-Kahf (The Cave) - سُوۡرَةُ الکهف

18:60

وَإِذۡ قَالَ مُوسَىٰ لِفَتَٮٰهُ لَآ أَبۡرَحُ حَتَّىٰٓ أَبۡلُغَ مَجۡمَعَ ٱلۡبَحۡرَيۡنِ

And when Moses said unto his servant: I will not give up until I reach the point where the two rivers meet, though I march on for ages.

 ________________

at another point, it is stated:

________________

Surat Ta-Ha  - سُوۡرَةُ طٰه

20:91

قَالُواْ لَن نَّبۡرَحَ عَلَيۡهِ عَـٰكِفِينَ حَتَّىٰ يَرۡجِعَ إِلَيۡنَا مُوسَىٰ

They said: We shall by no means cease to be its votaries till Moses return unto us.

________________

14.8 fataa (فتا): meaning to stop someone from doing something. When it comes with لا or ما it gives the meaning of continuity in some work. It is said ما فتا يفعل ذالك which means he continued doing that, usually associated with hatta(حتى), only used for past and past perfect, used for time durations. This word has been used in the Quran just once along with لا. Allah states that:

________________

Surat Yusuf - سُوۡرَةُ یُوسُف

12:85

قَالُواْ تَٱللَّهِ تَفۡتَؤُاْ تَذۡڪُرُ يُوسُفَ حَتَّىٰ تَكُونَ حَرَضًا أَوۡ تَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلۡهَـٰلِكِينَ

They said: By Allah, thou wilt never cease remembering Joseph till thy health is ruined or thou art of those who perish!

 ________________

Summary:

5. DAAMA(دام): only associated with the past tense, showing change in state, used for time and distance.

6. ABRAHA(أبرح): only perfect tense, used with لا and ما for negation and comes with hatta(حتى), used for distance.

7. ZAALA(زال): for past and perfect tense, used with لا and ما, used for time.

8. FATAA(فتا):for past and perfect tense, used with لا and ما, comes with hatta(حتى), used for time.

raw_text:
15 HANSNA
[to laugh]
Synonyms: DAHIKA(  ضحك  ), TABASSAMA(  تبسم  )
15.1 dahika(  ضحك  )  : to laugh with an open mouth so that the teeth are visible. Allah states that:
________________
Surat Hud -   سُوۡرَةُ هُود
11:71
وَٱمۡرَأَتُهُ ۥ قَآٮِٕمَةٌ۬ فَضَحِكَتۡ فَبَشَّرۡنَـٰهَا بِإِسۡحَـٰقَ
And his wife, standing by laughed when We gave her good tidings (of the birth) of Isaac, and, after Isaac, of Jacob.
________________
15.2 tabassama (  تبسم  )  : basama(  بسم  ) and tabassama(  تبسم  ) meaning to smile, to laugh lightly without any voice which shows signs of pleasure. It is stated in the Quran:
________________
Surat Al-Naml (The Ants) -   سُوۡرَةُ النَّمل
27:19
فَتَبَسَّمَ ضَاحِكً۬ا مِّن قَوۡلِهَا
And (Solomon) smiled, laughing at her speech, and said: My Lord, arouse me to be thankful for Thy favour wherewith Thou hast favoured me and my parents, and to do good that shall be pleasing unto Thee, and include me in (the number of) Thy righteous slaves.
________________

raw_text:
16 HAWA AUR US KI IQSAAM
[air and its types]
Synonyms: REEH(  ريح  ) ROOH(  روح  )
16.1 reeh(  ريح  )  : according to Ibn-al-Faris, it means air and its movement. But it is used in wider meanings in the Quran for example:
(1) meaning air, used in common meaning as that which moves. Allah states that:
________________
Surat Ash-Shura (The Council)  -   سُوۡرَةُ الشّوریٰ
42:33
إِن يَشَأۡ يُسۡكِنِ ٱلرِّيحَ
If He will He calmeth the wind so that they keep still upon its surface - Lo! herein verily are signs for every steadfast grateful (heart).
________________
(2) meaning smell. It is stated in the Quran:
________________
Surat Yusuf  -   سُوۡرَةُ یُوسُف
12:94
إِنِّى لَأَجِدُ رِيحَ يُوسُفَ‌ۖ
When the caravan departed their father had said: Truly I am conscious of the breath of Joseph, though ye call me dotard.
________________
(3) meaning command and control as is stated:
________________
Surat Al-Anfal (The Spoils of War) -   سُوۡرَةُ الاٴنفَال
8:46
وَلَا تَنَـٰزَعُواْ فَتَفۡشَلُواْ وَتَذۡهَبَ رِيحُكُمۡ‌ۖ
And obey Allah and His messenger, and dispute not one with another lest ye falter and your strength depart from you; but be steadfast! Lo! Allah is with the steadfast.
________________
and the plural of reeh(  ريح  ) is riyah(  رياح  ). When the word arsaal-ar-riyaah(  ارسال الرياح  ) is used, it means winds of blessings. If arsaal-ar-reeh(  ارسال الريح  ) is used, i.e. only the singular word is used, then it means the wind of torment. This is the way both of these are classified now.
________________
KHUSHGAWAAR HAWAEIN
[pleasant winds]
Synonyms: RAUH(  روح  ), RAIHAN(  ريحان  ), MUBASSHIRAAT(  مبشرات  ), LAWAQIHAH(  لواقح  )
1 rauh(  روح  )  : meaning pleasant wind, blessing, happiness, and yom rauhun(  يوم روح  ) meaning pleasant day and according to Imam Raghib, rooh(  روح  ) and rauh(  روح  ) are the same things. And rooh(  روح  ) is associated with breath and araah-al-insaan(  أراح الانسان  ) means someone breathing and also having a calm time. When you think about the various meanings of rooh(  روح  ), you find out that it means the continuous blessings and rewards from Allah which are a source of soothing and pleasure for the persons.  Allah states that:
________________
Surat Yusuf  -   سُوۡرَةُ یُوسُف
12:87
لَا تَاْيۡـَٔسُواْ مِن رَّوۡحِ ٱللَّهِ‌ۖ إِنَّهُ ۥ لَا يَاْيۡـَٔسُ مِن رَّوۡحِ ٱللَّهِ إِلَّا ٱلۡقَوۡمُ ٱلۡكَـٰفِرُونَ
Go, O my sons, and ascertain concerning Joseph and his brother, and despair not of the Spirit of Allah. Lo! none despaireth of the Spirit of Allah save disbelieving folk.
________________
2 raihan(  ريحان  )  : meaning every kind of good smelling plant, sustenance, economics and raaihah(  رائحة  ) meaning an aromatic smell. Raihana(  ريحانة  ) means a bouquet of flowers. When you ponder over the meanings of these words, you find out that if raihan(  ريحان  ) means sustenance and things acquired from plantation, then it will mean those things which have a good aroma and smell. Allah states that:
________________
Surat Al-Waqia (The Event)  -   سُوۡرَةُ الواقِعَة
56:89
فَرَوۡحٌ۬ وَرَيۡحَانٌ۬ وَجَنَّتُ نَعِيمٍ۬
Then breath of life, and plenty, and a Garden of delight.
________________
At another point, it is stated:
________________
Surat Ar-Rahman (The Beneficient) -   سُوۡرَةُ الرَّحمٰن
55:12
وَٱلۡحَبُّ ذُو ٱلۡعَصۡفِ وَٱلرَّيۡحَانُ
Husked grain and scented herb.
________________
3 mubashirat(  مبشرات  )  : meaning winds giving glad timings or of rain, the pleasant breeze before a rainfall. Allah states that:
________________
Surat Al-Room (the Romans)  -   سُوۡرَةُ الرُّوم
30:46
وَمِنۡ ءَايَـٰتِهِۦۤ أَن يُرۡسِلَ ٱلرِّيَاحَ مُبَشِّرَٲتٍ۬ وَلِيُذِيقَكُم مِّن رَّحۡمَتِهِۦ
And of His signs is this: He sendeth herald winds to make you taste His mercy, and that the ships may sail at His command, and that ye may seek his favour, and that haply ye may be thankful.
________________
4 lawaqih(  لواقح  )  : (sg: laqihah(  لاقحه  )) laqh(  لقح  ) meaning winds carrying some load and this load can be of two types: (i) the load of water which the wind carries before a rainfall  (ii) the load of a male seed which the wind carries to the female plant. This word has only been used in the first meaning in the Quran. Allah states that:
________________
Surat Al-Hijr (The Rock)  -   سُوۡرَةُ الحِجر
15:23
وَأَرۡسَلۡنَا ٱلرِّيَـٰحَ لَوَٲقِحَ فَأَنزَلۡنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً۬
And We send the winds fertilising, and cause water to descend from the sky, and give it you to drink. It is not ye who are the holders of the store thereof.
________________
NAGAWAR HAWAEIN
[unpleasant winds]
Synonyms: A’SIFUN(  عاصف  ), QASIFUN(  قاصف  ), HASIBUN(  حاصب  ), SAMOOMUN(  سموم  ), I’SARUN(  اعصار  ), HUSBAAN(  حسبان  ), NAFHAH(  نفحة  ), SARSAR(  صرصر  ), REEHUN AQEEMUN(  ريح عقيم  )
5 a’sifun(  عاصف  )  : a’sf(  عصف  ) meaning husk, dry plants which get crushed easily and a’sifa(  عاصفة  ) means that wind or breeze which makes the husk and similar small things fly in the air. Allah states that:
________________
Surat Yunus  -   سُوۡرَةُ یُونس
10:22
حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا كُنتُمۡ فِى ٱلۡفُلۡكِ وَجَرَيۡنَ بِہِم بِرِيحٍ۬ طَيِّبَةٍ۬ وَفَرِحُواْ بِہَا جَآءَتۡہَا رِيحٌ عَاصِفٌ۬ وَجَآءَهُمُ ٱلۡمَوۡجُ مِن كُلِّ مَكَانٍ۬ وَظَنُّوٓاْ أَنَّہُمۡ أُحِيطَ بِهِمۡ‌ۙ
He it is Who maketh you to go on the land and the sea till, when ye are in the ships and they sail with them with a fair breeze and they are glad therein, a storm-wind reacheth them and the wave cometh unto them from every side and they deem that they are overwhelmed therein; (then) they cry unto Allah, making their faith pure for Him only: If Thou deliver us from this, we truly will be of the thankful.
________________
6 hasibun(  حاصب  )  : hasb(  حصب  ) meaning stones, rocks and hasibah(  حاصبة  ) is used for such a high speed wind which makes the stones and pebbles fly. Ahsab-al-fars(  احصب الفرس  ) means a horse running with such a high speed that small pebbles fly with its feet. Allah states that:
________________
Surat Al-Isra(Children of Israel)  -   سُوۡرَةُ بنیٓ اسرآئیل / الإسرَاء
17:68
أَفَأَمِنتُمۡ أَن يَخۡسِفَ بِكُمۡ جَانِبَ ٱلۡبَرِّ أَوۡ يُرۡسِلَ عَلَيۡڪُمۡ حَاصِبً۬ا
Feel ye then secure that He will not cause a slope of the land to engulf you, or send a sand-storm upon you, and then ye will find that ye have no protector?
________________
7 qasifun(  قاصف  )  : qasf(  قصف  ) meaning break, to break and qasifun(  قاصف  ) is that high speed wind which breaks off trees, wind storm, thunderstorm. Allah states that:
________________
Surat Al-Isra(Children of Israel)  -   سُوۡرَةُ بنیٓ اسرآئیل / الإسرَاء
17:69
فَيُرۡسِلَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ قَاصِفً۬ا مِّنَ ٱلرِّيحِ فَيُغۡرِقَكُم بِمَا كَفَرۡتُمۡ‌ۙ
Or feel ye secure that He will not return you to that (plight) a second time, and send against you a hurricane of wind and drown you for your thanklessness, and then ye will not find therein that ye have any avenger against Us?
________________
8 samoomun(  سموم  )  : very hot wind, heatstroke, which burns the things. Allah states that:
________________
Surat At-Tur (The Mountain)  -   سُوۡرَةُ الطُّور
52:27
فَمَنَّ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيۡنَا وَوَقَٮٰنَا عَذَابَ ٱلسَّمُومِ
But Allah hath been gracious unto us and hath preserved us from the torment of the breath of Fire.
________________
9 I’saar(  اعصار  )  : meaning that wind which circulates in the atmosphere and dust storm which travels towards the sky, cyclone, tycoon. It is stated in the Quran:
________________
Surat Al-Baqara (The Cow)  -   سُوۡرَةُ البَقَرَة
2:266
فَأَصَابَهَآ إِعۡصَارٌ۬ فِيهِ نَارٌ۬ فَٱحۡتَرَقَتۡ‌ۗ
Would any of you like to have a garden of palm-trees and vines, with rivers flowing underneath it, with all kinds of fruit for him therein; and old age hath stricken him and he hath feeble offspring; and a fiery whirlwind striketh it and it is (all) consumed by fire. Thus Allah maketh plain His revelations unto you, in order that ye may give thought.
________________
10 husbaan(  حسبان  )  : hasaba(  حسب  ) meaning to calculate, count, and husbaan(  حسبان  ) means that torment which is enough to be calculated. People of different schools of thoughts have given the meaning of husbaan(  حسبان  ) in different ways. However, this torment is associated with the torment of wind. Allah states that:
________________
Surat Al-Kahf (The Cave)  -   سُوۡرَةُ الکهف
18:40
وَيُرۡسِلَ عَلَيۡہَا حُسۡبَانً۬ا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَتُصۡبِحَ صَعِيدً۬ا زَلَقًا
Yet it may be that my Lord will give me better than thy garden, and will send on it a bolt from heaven, and some morning it will be a smooth hillside,
________________
11 nafhah(  نفحة  )  : means cold wind, like the wind which escapes through an aerator. Extremely cold wind, and its antonym is lafhah(  لفحة  ). It is stated in the Quran:
________________
Surat Al-Anbiya (The Prophets)  -   سُوۡرَةُ الاٴنبیَاء
21:46
وَلَٮِٕن مَّسَّتۡهُمۡ نَفۡحَةٌ۬ مِّنۡ عَذَابِ رَبِّكَ
And if a breath of thy Lord's punishment were to touch them, they assuredly would say: Alas for us! Lo! we were wrong-doers.
________________

Surat Yunus  - سُوۡرَةُ یُونس

10:22

حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا كُنتُمۡ فِى ٱلۡفُلۡكِ وَجَرَيۡنَ بِہِم بِرِيحٍ۬ طَيِّبَةٍ۬ وَفَرِحُواْ بِہَا جَآءَتۡہَا رِيحٌ عَاصِفٌ۬ وَجَآءَهُمُ ٱلۡمَوۡجُ مِن كُلِّ مَكَانٍ۬ وَظَنُّوٓاْ أَنَّہُمۡ أُحِيطَ بِهِمۡ‌ۙ

He it is Who maketh you to go on the land and the sea till, when ye are in the ships and they sail with them with a fair breeze and they are glad therein, a storm-wind reacheth them and the wave cometh unto them from every side and they deem that they are overwhelmed therein; (then) they cry unto Allah, making their faith pure for Him only: If Thou deliver us from this, we truly will be of the thankful.

________________

6 hasibun(حاصب): hasb(حصب) meaning stones, rocks and hasibah(حاصبة) is used for such a high speed wind which makes the stones and pebbles fly. Ahsab-al-fars(احصب الفرس) means a horse running with such a high speed that small pebbles fly with its feet. Allah states that:

________________

Surat Al-Isra(Children of Israel)  - سُوۡرَةُ بنیٓ اسرآئیل / الإسرَاء

17:68

أَفَأَمِنتُمۡ أَن يَخۡسِفَ بِكُمۡ جَانِبَ ٱلۡبَرِّ أَوۡ يُرۡسِلَ عَلَيۡڪُمۡ حَاصِبً۬ا

Feel ye then secure that He will not cause a slope of the land to engulf you, or send a sand-storm upon you, and then ye will find that ye have no protector?

________________

7 qasifun(قاصف): qasf(قصف) meaning break, to break and qasifun(قاصف) is that high speed wind which breaks off trees, wind storm, thunderstorm. Allah states that:

________________

Surat Al-Isra(Children of Israel)  - سُوۡرَةُ بنیٓ اسرآئیل / الإسرَاء

17:69

فَيُرۡسِلَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ قَاصِفً۬ا مِّنَ ٱلرِّيحِ فَيُغۡرِقَكُم بِمَا كَفَرۡتُمۡ‌ۙ

Or feel ye secure that He will not return you to that (plight) a second time, and send against you a hurricane of wind and drown you for your thanklessness, and then ye will not find therein that ye have any avenger against Us?

________________

8 samoomun(سموم): very hot wind, heatstroke, which burns the things. Allah states that:

________________

Surat At-Tur (The Mountain)  - سُوۡرَةُ الطُّور

52:27

فَمَنَّ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيۡنَا وَوَقَٮٰنَا عَذَابَ ٱلسَّمُومِ

But Allah hath been gracious unto us and hath preserved us from the torment of the breath of Fire.

________________

9 I’saar(اعصار): meaning that wind which circulates in the atmosphere and dust storm which travels towards the sky, cyclone, tycoon. It is stated in the Quran:

________________

Surat Al-Baqara (The Cow)  - سُوۡرَةُ البَقَرَة

2:266

فَأَصَابَهَآ إِعۡصَارٌ۬ فِيهِ نَارٌ۬ فَٱحۡتَرَقَتۡ‌ۗ

Would any of you like to have a garden of palm-trees and vines, with rivers flowing underneath it, with all kinds of fruit for him therein; and old age hath stricken him and he hath feeble offspring; and a fiery whirlwind striketh it and it is (all) consumed by fire. Thus Allah maketh plain His revelations unto you, in order that ye may give thought.

________________

10 husbaan(حسبان): hasaba(حسب) meaning to calculate, count, and husbaan(حسبان) means that torment which is enough to be calculated. People of different schools of thoughts have given the meaning of husbaan(حسبان) in different ways. However, this torment is associated with the torment of wind. Allah states that:

________________

Surat Al-Kahf (The Cave)  - سُوۡرَةُ الکهف

18:40

وَيُرۡسِلَ عَلَيۡہَا حُسۡبَانً۬ا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَتُصۡبِحَ صَعِيدً۬ا زَلَقًا

Yet it may be that my Lord will give me better than thy garden, and will send on it a bolt from heaven, and some morning it will be a smooth hillside,

________________

11 nafhah(نفحة): means cold wind, like the wind which escapes through an aerator. Extremely cold wind, and its antonym is lafhah(لفحة). It is stated in the Quran:

________________

Surat Al-Anbiya (The Prophets)  - سُوۡرَةُ الاٴنبیَاء

21:46

وَلَٮِٕن مَّسَّتۡهُمۡ نَفۡحَةٌ۬ مِّنۡ عَذَابِ رَبِّكَ

And if a breath of thy Lord's punishment were to touch them, they assuredly would say: Alas for us! Lo! we were wrong-doers.

________________

Kaana, “hona” P.900
{
Synonyms: KANA,ASBAHA,SADARA,ASDARA,WAQAA
1 KANA(كَانَ): meaning is,was KANA gives meaning of past and present. and its MUDHARI(مضارع) form is YAKUN(يكون) both for present and future. as per ibn al faris KANA means AKHBAR 3N HADOOS ALSHAYEE(اخبار عن حدوث الشي) that is to give news of some new matter happening
Surat Al-Baqarah [2:34] - The Noble Qur'an
إِلَّا إِبْلِيسَ أَبَىٰ وَاسْتَكْبَرَ وَ  كَانَ   مِنَ الْكَافِرِينَ
except for Iblees. He refused and was arrogant and   became   of the disbelievers
Surat Al-'Insan [76:7] - The Noble Qur'an
وَيَخَافُونَ يَوْمًا   كَانَ   شَرُّهُ مُسْتَطِيرًا
and fear a Day whose evil   will be   widespread  .
also KANA can come as defective verb. when it enters on past changes it to far past.KANA ZAHABA(كان ذَهَبَ) meaning he went. and when it enters on MUDHARI it becomes MAZI ISTIMRAARI
Surat Al-Baqarah [2:59] - The Noble Qur'an
فَأَنزَلْنَا عَلَى الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا رِجْزًا مِّنَ السَّمَاءِ بِمَا   كَانُوا   يَفْسُقُونَ
so We sent down upon those who wronged a punishment from the sky because they   were   defiantly disobeying
2 ASBAHA(اَصْبَحَ): meaning happened.change from one state to another or one attribute to another.ASBAH UL HAQQ(اَصْبَحَ الحقّ) meaning Truth became evident.
Surat Al-Qasas [28:10] - The Noble Qur'an
وَ  أَصْبَحَ   فُؤَادُ أُمِّ مُوسَىٰ فَارِغًا ۖ
And the heart of Moses' mother   became   empty [of all else].
3 SADARA(صَدَرَ): [antonym WARADA(وَرَدَ)] to return after completion of something
Surat Al-Qasas [28:23] - The Noble Qur'an
قَالَتَا لَا نَسْقِي حَتَّىٰ   يُصْدِرَ   الرِّعَاءُ
They said, "We do not water until the shepherds   dispatch   [their flocks]
4 WAQAA(وَقَعَ):has basically two meanings a)to prove something b)to fall. and WAQIA(واقعة) is normally said to an intense and strong accident.In Quran this word is used for tribulation,distress}
Surat Al-Ma`arij [70:1] - The Noble Qur'an
سَأَلَ سَائِلٌ بِعَذَابٍ   وَاقِعٍ
A supplicant asked for a punishment   bound to happen
Surat An-Naml [27:85] - The Noble Qur'anوَ  وَقَعَ   الْقَوْلُ عَلَيْهِم بِمَا ظَلَمُواAnd the decree will   befall   them for the wrong they did
Summary:
1 KANA:To give news of Happening
2 ASBAHA: for change of state or attribute
3 SUDUR:to be properly relieved after completion of something
4 WAQAA:for some tragedy befalling
}

2 HAAN [yes]
Synonyms: NA’AM, AYEE, BALAA
2.1 NA3AM (نَعَمْ)  : Means yes. A word for affirmation. An answer to a question where both the question and answer is positive. In the Quran
Surah Al-Araf (The heights): سورۃ الأعرَاف 7:113
وَجَاءَ السَّحَرَةُ فِرْعَوْنَ قَالُوا إِنَّ لَنَا لَأَجْرًا إِن كُنَّا نَحْنُ الْغَالِبِينَ قَالَ نَعَمْ وَإِنَّكُمْ لَمِنَ الْمُقَرَّبِينَ
They said: "Indeed there will be a (good) reward for us if we are the victors." He said: "Yes, and moreover you will (in that case) be of the nearest (to me)."
2.2 IY(اِی)  : Means ‘yes yes’; certainly. Word for affirmation. Used to give a positive answer with confirmation and emphasis in case of a question, so that there is no room left for doubt or suspicion. Usually is followed by swearing or vow. Allah says in the Quran
Surat Yunus (Jonah) - سورة يونس 10:53
وَيَسْتَنبِئُونَكَ أَحَقٌّ هُوَ ۖ قُلْ إِي وَرَبِّي إِنَّهُ لَحَقٌّ
And they ask information of you, [O Muhammad], "Is it true?" Say, "Yes, by my Lord. Indeed, it is truth; and you will not cause failure [to Allah ]."
2.3 BALA (بَلَىٰ )  : Is also a word for affirmation, but is used when the question is giving a negative gesture. And in case of answer one has to change this negativity to positivity. And it means ‘why not - certainly’.
Surah Al-Araf (The heights): سورۃ الأعرَاف 7:172
بِرَبِّكُمْ ۖ قَالُوا بَلَىٰ
"Am I not your Lord?" They said, "Yes indeed,
Summary:
NA3AM:positive answer of positive question.IY:emphatic positive reply of positive question. and BALA is negation  of negative question and answer in affirmation.

3.HAANPNA [To Pant]    page 881
Synonyms: DABHA ضَبْح,LAHACA لَهَثَ
3.1 DABHA  : (ALFARS الفرس),the sound that horse made out of its belly/middle while running swiftly at their full strength.In the QURAN.
Surat Al-`Ādiyāt (The Courser) - سورة العاديات
100:1
وَالْعَادِيَاتِ ضَبْحًا
By the racers, panting,
3.2 LAHACA  :to stick out tongue out of exteme/intense thirst.and to to make sound out of middle/stomach.dog sticking out tongue by panting owing to thirst or fatigue.In the QURAN.
Surat Al-'A`rāf (The Heights) - سورة الأعراف
7:176
وَلَوْ شِئْنَا لَرَفَعْنَاهُ بِهَا وَلَٰكِنَّهُ أَخْلَدَ إِلَى الْأَرْضِ وَاتَّبَعَ هَوَاهُ ۚ فَمَثَلُهُ كَمَثَلِ الْكَلْبِ إِن تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْهِ يَلْهَثْ أَوْ تَتْرُكْهُ يَلْهَث ۚ ذَّٰلِكَ مَثَلُ الْقَوْمِ الَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا بِآيَاتِنَا ۚ فَاقْصُصِ الْقَصَصَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ
And if We had willed, we could have elevated him thereby, but he adhered [instead] to the earth and followed his own desire. So his example is like that of the dog: if you chase him, he pants, or if you leave him, he [still] pants. That is the example of the people who denied Our signs. So relate the stories that perhaps they will give thought.
Summary  :panting owing to running swiftly is DABHA and owing to thirst or fatigue is LAHACA.

raw_text:
Yadu’u, Hatana (to repel)
Pg. 881
Pdf pg. 899
1.   Dafa’aa:   To protect from external danger or to repel an attack.
Daf’aae:   To protect something.
Muda’fat:   To attack in defense.
Allah SWT said (22:40): “And if Allah SWT hadn’t stopped people from attacking each other.”
If this word ends with “ilaa”, it means to give somebody their trust/possession back.
In Quran (4:6): “So, return their possessions.”
2.   Janaba/Janna’ba:   To repel, to save someone/something by pulling them on the side. To tap on the side of the body.
Janib:   Side of a body
Allah SWT said: Wasayujanabuha al’ataqa al’adhi yuti malahu yatazakah “The one who abstains from sins will be pulled aside—the one who gives in charity.”
3.   Zahzaha  : To repel someone away from some place, resign
Al-zahzaha:   Far
Zahzaha-An:   To repel someone away from harm
Allah SWT said (3:185): “And the one, who is pulled away/repelled away from (hell) and was entered into paradise, is saved.”
4.   Da’raa:   to yank away someone with extreme force and to save him/her from pain or injury.
Allah SWT says (24:8): “and if this woman takes oath by Allah SWT four times then this will save her from punishment.”
Idraa’:   To blame someone else for one’s own misdeeds to protect oneself from punishment.
Allah SWT says (2:72):“And you start blaming one another for murdering that person.”
5.   Da’aa:   To shove away, jostle away, elbow roughly and rudely.
Allah SWT says (107:2): “A man like this repulses/kicks away/jostles away an orphan!”
6.   Dahra:   1) Repel someone with disgust, 2) To push away in loathing, abhor someone
Allah SWT said (7:18): “Allah SWT told (Ibless/Satan) to get out of the paradise.”
7.   Khasaa/Khasaa   nazar: weak eyesight
Khasa   alqalub: to repulse a dog
Khaseeye   minalqab wakhanazeer: Disgustingly repulse a panting dog or pig that is not allowed to wander among people.
Allah SWT says (2:65): “And we told them to become disgraced monkeys.”
Summary:
1.   Dafa’aa: To repel away the danger/attack to protect oneself
2.   Janaba: To pull someone aside (common usage)
3.   Zahzaha: To pull away someone from a place and to save them from injury
4.   Da’raa: To keep away the harm/injury with full might and extreme force
5.   Da’aa: To jostle someone around or to kick someone out insultingly
6.   Dahra: To kick someone out by humiliating them. No matter whatever the reason
7.   Khasaa: To assume someone, something is disgusting/ filthy and to abhor them

6. Dahra: 1) Repel someone with disgust, 2) To push away in loathing, abhor someone

Allah SWT said (7:18): “Allah SWT told (Ibless/Satan) to get out of the paradise.”

7. Khasaa/Khasaa nazar: weak eyesight

Khasa alqalub: to repulse a dog

Khaseeye minalqab wakhanazeer: Disgustingly repulse a panting dog or pig that is not allowed to wander among people.

Allah SWT says (2:65): “And we told them to become disgraced monkeys.”

Summary:

1. Dafa’aa: To repel away the danger/attack to protect oneself

2. Janaba: To pull someone aside (common usage)

3. Zahzaha: To pull away someone from a place and to save them from injury

4. Da’raa: To keep away the harm/injury with full might and extreme force

5. Da’aa: To jostle someone around or to kick someone out insultingly

6. Dahra: To kick someone out by humiliating them. No matter whatever the reason

7. Khasaa: To assume someone, something is disgusting/ filthy and to abhor them

raw_text:
5 HIDAYAT DEYNA -PANA [To give Guidance-To get Guidance]     page 883
Synonyms: HADA هَدَي IHTADA اِهْتَدَي RASHADA رَشَدَ
5.1 IHTADA  : HA-DA-YA هدي meaning to guide someone with subtleity and   gentleness.to   show path of goodness and it's antonym is DALLA ضَلَّ and ADALLA اَضَلَّ.meaning to make someone forget the path-or to misguide   it.to   make the path of goodness lost or to hide it.(HIDAYAT هدايت antonym DALALAT ضلالت).word HIDAYAT comes in three meanings.
a) natural guidance which ALLAH has intrinsically bestowed on every thing.like a new born baby moving to mother's breast to feed off. said in the QURAN.
Surat Ţāhā (Ta-Ha) - سورة طه
20:50
قَالَ رَبُّنَا الَّذِي أَعْطَىٰ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ خَلْقَهُ ثُمَّ هَدَىٰ
He said, "Our Lord is He who gave each thing its form and then guided [it]."
b) to turn a person's mind from misguidance towards guidanc or from disbelief to belief in Islam or from disobedience to the obedience of ALLAH. this task is done by means of prophets and messengers but the actual act of turning is only by ALLAH's authority/will.ALLAH said
Surat Al-Qaşaş (The Stories) - سورة القصص
28:56
إِنَّكَ لَا تَهْدِي مَنْ أَحْبَبْتَ وَلَٰكِنَّ اللَّهَ يَهْدِي مَن يَشَاءُ ۚ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِالْمُهْتَدِينَ
Indeed, [O Muhammad], you do not guide whom you like, but Allah guides whom He wills. And He is most knowing of the [rightly] guided.
c)those people who comes to ALLAH's obedience or towards Islam,to keep on showing them the 'straight path' or to keep them following right path.this actual responsibility is of prophets and messengers. then other muslims also share this.yet this task also happens as per the will of ALLAH. as said
Surat Yūnus (Jonah) - سورة يونس
10:43
وَمِنْهُم مَّن يَنظُرُ إِلَيْكَ ۚ أَفَأَنتَ تَهْدِي الْعُمْيَ وَلَوْ كَانُوا لَا يُبْصِرُونَ
And among them are those who look at you. But can you guide the blind although they will not [attempt to] see?
at another place said
Surat Ash-Shūraá (The Consultation) - سورة الشورى
42:52
وَكَذَٰلِكَ أَوْحَيْنَا إِلَيْكَ رُوحًا مِّنْ أَمْرِنَا ۚ مَا كُنتَ تَدْرِي مَا الْكِتَابُ وَلَا الْإِيمَانُ وَلَٰكِن جَعَلْنَاهُ نُورًا نَّهْدِي بِهِ مَن نَّشَاءُ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ۚ وَإِنَّكَ لَتَهْدِي إِلَىٰ صِرَاطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ
And thus We have revealed to you an inspiration of Our command. You did not know what is the Book or [what is] faith, but We have made it a light by which We guide whom We will of Our servants. And indeed, [O Muhammad], you guide to a straight path -
And IHTADA meaing to find guidance,to follow the right path.ALLAH said
Surat Yūnus (Jonah) - سورة يونس
10:108
قُلْ يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ قَدْ جَاءَكُمُ الْحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّكُمْ ۖ فَمَنِ اهْتَدَىٰ فَإِنَّمَا يَهْتَدِي لِنَفْسِهِ ۖ وَمَن ضَلَّ فَإِنَّمَا يَضِلُّ عَلَيْهَا ۖ وَمَا أَنَا عَلَيْكُم بِوَكِيلٍ
Say, "O mankind, the truth has come to you from your Lord, so whoever is guided is only guided for [the benefit of] his soul, and whoever goes astray only goes astray [in violation] against it. And I am not over you a manager."
5.2 RASHADA  :(antonym GHAWA غوَي) meaning that person who comes to the right path and also adheres to good character.and RUSHD رُشُد (antonym GHIYY غيّ) meaning have determination on true path-adherence to it.In the QURAN
Surat Hūd (Hud) - سورة هود
11:78
وَجَاءَهُ قَوْمُهُ يُهْرَعُونَ إِلَيْهِ وَمِن قَبْلُ كَانُوا يَعْمَلُونَ السَّيِّئَاتِ ۚ قَالَ يَا قَوْمِ هَٰؤُلَاءِ بَنَاتِي هُنَّ أَطْهَرُ لَكُمْ ۖ فَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَلَا تُخْزُونِ فِي ضَيْفِي ۖ أَلَيْسَ مِنكُمْ رَجُلٌ رَّشِيدٌ
And his people came hastening to him, and before [this] they had been doing evil deeds. He said, "O my people, these are my daughters; they are purer for you. So fear Allah and do not disgrace me concerning my guests. Is there not among you a man of reason?"
Summary  :IHTADA: to be/come/join on the right path.and RASHADA after accepting/following the right path,adhering to good habits and ethics and stay firm on it.

6 HALAKAT
[Destruction, Death]
Synonyms: TABBA(  تب  ), TA’SA(  تعس  ), QUTIL(  قتل  ), SABARA(  ثبر  ), AULA(  أولى  ), WAILUN(  ويل  ) (  These words are used in a state of anger and annoyance  )
6.1 tabba(  تب  )  : meaning to die, break, cut, to cut; used in all these senses. It is stated in the Quran:
________________
Surat Lahab -   سُوۡرَةُ لهب
111:1
تَبَّتۡ يَدَآ أَبِى لَهَبٍ۬ وَتَبَّ
The power of Abu Lahab will perish, and he will perish.
________________
6.2 ta’sa (  تعس  )  : meaning to fall after stumbling and not able to stand up again, to die after falling in a pit. It is stated in the Quran:
________________
Surat Muhammad -   سُوۡرَةُ محَمَّد
47:8
وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ فَتَعۡسً۬ا لَّهُمۡ
And those who disbelieve, perdition is for them, and He will make their actions vain.
________________
6.3 qutila (  قتل  )  : qatala(  قتل  ) meaning to kill someone, to separate the soul from the body and qutila(  قتل  ) means to be killed, to die. It is stated in the Quran:
________________
Surat Al-Mudathir (The Cloaked One) -   سُوۡرَةُ المدَّثِّر
74:19-20
ثُمَّ قُتِلَ كَيۡفَ قَدَّرَ فَقُتِلَ كَيۡفَ قَدَّرَ
(Self-)destroyed is he, how he planned! (19) Again (self-)destroyed is he, how he planned!
________________
6.4 sabara (  ثبر  )  : meaning to be killed or aggravating of a wound and suboor(  ثبور  ) meaning death. It is stated in the Quran:
________________
Surat Al-Furqan (The Standard) -   سُوۡرَةُ الفُرقان
25:14
لَّا تَدۡعُواْ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ ثُبُورً۬ا وَٲحِدً۬ا وَٱدۡعُواْ ثُبُورً۬ا ڪَثِيرً۬ا
Pray not that day for one destruction, but pray for many destructions!
________________
6.5 aula (  أولى  )  : if it ends in   ب  , it means worthy, appropriate, most deserving. And if it ends in   ل  , it means death, destruction and damage, sadness. This phrase is used for such one who has reached his death so that he may be warned. Also, this word is used for disagreement, so that the person may try to avoid it by pondering over the end result. It is stated in the Quran:
________________
Surat Al-Qiyama (Resurrection) -   سُوۡرَةُ القِیَامَة
75:31-34
أَوۡلَىٰ لَكَ فَأَوۡلَىٰ  ثُمَّ ذَهَبَ إِلَىٰٓ أَهۡلِهِۦ يَتَمَطَّىٰٓ وَلَـٰكِن كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ فَلَا صَدَّقَ وَلَا صَلَّىٰ
For he neither trusted, nor prayed. (31) But he denied and flouted. (32) Then went he to his folk with glee. (33) Nearer unto thee and nearer
________________
6.6 wailun (  ويل  )  : damage, destruction, grief, death; this word is usually used for an occasion of desire. It is stated in the Quran:
________________
Surat Al-Jathiya (Crouching) -   سُوۡرَةُ الجَاثیَة
45:7
وَيۡلٌ۬ لِّكُلِّ أَفَّاكٍ أَثِيمٍ۬
Woe unto each sinful liar
________________

raw_text:
7 HALAAK HONA, KERNA
[To be killed, to kill]
Synonyms: HALAKA(  هلك  ), AHLAKA(  اهلك  ), BAADA(  باد  )BAID(  بيد  ), RADDA(  ردى  ), TARADDA(  تردى  ), BAKHA’A(  بخع  ), DAMMARA(  دمر  ), DAMDAMA(  دمدم  ), TABBABA(  تبب  ), TABBARA(  تبر  ), BAARA(  بار  )BOOR(  بور  ), AS-HATA(  اسحت  ), AUBAQA(  أوبق  ), QASAMA(  قصم  ), FANA(  فنى  )
7.1 halaka(  هلك  )  : meaning to perish, used for living and non-living things. In case of living things, its meaning is to die helplessly, to die a bad death. Allah states that:
________________
Surat Al-Qasas(The Story)  -   سُوۡرَةُ القَصَص
28:88
كُلُّ شَىۡءٍ هَالِكٌ إِلَّا وَجۡهَهُ
And cry not unto any other god along with Allah. There is no God save Him. Everything will perish save His countenance. His is the command, and unto Him ye will be brought back
________________
At another point, it is stated:
________________
Surat An-Nisa (Women) -   سُوۡرَةُ النِّسَاء
4:175
إِنِ ٱمۡرُؤٌاْ هَلَكَ لَيۡسَ لَهُ ۥ وَلَدٌ۬
They ask thee for a pronouncement. Say: Allah hath pronounced for you concerning distant kindred. If a man die childless and he have a sister, hers is half the heritage, and he would have inherited from her had she died childless. And if there be two sisters, then theirs are two-thirds of the heritage, and if they be brethren, men and women, unto the male is the equivalent of the share of two females. Allah expoundeth unto you, so that ye err not. Allah is Knower of all things.
________________
And ahlaka(  اهلك  ) means to damage something else and destroy it. Allah states that:
________________
Surat Al-Anaam (Cattle) -   سُوۡرَةُ الاٴنعَام
6:6
أَلَمۡ يَرَوۡاْ كَمۡ أَهۡلَكۡنَا مِن قَبۡلِهِم مِّن قَرۡنٍ۬
See they not how many a generation We destroyed before them, whom We had established in the earth more firmly than We have established you, and We shed on them abundant showers from the sky, and made the rivers flow beneath them. Yet we destroyed them for their sins, and created after them another generation.
________________
7.2 baada (  باد  )  : albaidaa(  البيداء  ) means a vast desert and its plural is beed(  بيد  ). And baada(  باد  ) means the destruction of a crop, complete destruction, devastation. Allah states that:
________________
Surat Al-Kahf (The Cave)  -   سُوۡرَةُ الکهف
18:35
قَالَ مَآ أَظُنُّ أَن تَبِيدَ هَـٰذِهِۦۤ أَبَدً۬ا
And he went into his garden, while he (thus) wronged himself. He said: I think not that all this will ever perish.
________________
7.3 taradda(  تردى  )  : rada(  ردى  ) means to throw something on the ground from a height or to throw from the ground into a pit so that it reached destruction. Allah states that:
________________
Surat Ta-Ha  -   سُوۡرَةُ طٰه
20:16
وَٱتَّبَعَ هَوَٮٰهُ فَتَرۡدَىٰ
Therefor, let not him turn thee aside from (the thought of) it who believeth not therein but followeth his own desire, lest thou perish.
________________
And arda(  اردى  ) means contagious that is, to kill someone like this. It is stated in the Quran:
________________
Surat As-Saaffaat (The Rangers) -   سُوۡرَةُ الصَّافات
37:56
قَالَ تَٱللَّهِ إِن كِدتَّ لَتُرۡدِينِ
He saith: By Allah, thou verily didst all but cause my ruin
________________
And taradda(  تردى  ) means to fall in a well or pit yourself and die. Allah states that:
________________
Surat Al-Lail (The Night) -   سُوۡرَةُ اللیْل
92:11
وَمَا يُغۡنِى عَنۡهُ مَالُهُ ۥۤ إِذَا تَرَدَّىٰٓ
His riches will not save him when he perisheth.
________________
7.4 bakha’a(  بخع  )  : to kill yourself by grief or anger, to be exhausted gradually. Allah states that:
________________
Surat Al-Kahf (The Cave) -   سُوۡرَةُ الکهف
18:6
فَلَعَلَّكَ بَـٰخِعٌ۬ نَّفۡسَكَ عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَـٰرِهِمۡ إِن لَّمۡ يُؤۡمِنُواْ بِهَـٰذَا ٱلۡحَدِيثِ أَسَفًا
Yet it may be, if they believe not in this statement, that thou (Muhammad) wilt torment thy soul with grief over their footsteps.
________________
7.5 dammara(  دمر  )  : damara(  دمر  ) means to enter someone’s home without permission with a bad intention and dammara(  دمر  ) means to inflict destruction upon something.
________________
Surat Al-Isra (Children of Israel) -   سُوۡرَةُ بنیٓ اسرآئیل
17:16
فَفَسَقُواْ فِيہَا فَحَقَّ عَلَيۡہَا ٱلۡقَوۡلُ فَدَمَّرۡنَـٰهَا تَدۡمِيرً۬ا
And when We would destroy a township We send commandment to its folk who live at ease, and afterward they commit abomination therein, and so the Word (of doom) hath effect for it, and we annihilate it with complete annihilation.
________________
7.6 damdama(  دمدم  )  : damdam ash-shaye(  دمدم الشيئ  ) means to stick something on the ground and damdam Allah alaihim(  دمدم الله عليهم  ) means that God killed them, destroyed them completely. Allah states that:
________________
Surat Ash-Shams (The Sun) -   سُوۡرَةُ الشّمس
91: 14
فَدَمۡدَمَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ رَبُّهُم بِذَنۢبِهِمۡ فَسَوَّٮٰهَا
But they denied him, and they hamstrung her, so Allah doomed them for their sin and razed (their dwellings).
________________
7.7 tabbaba(  تبب  )  : tabba(  تب  ) is a prayer statement. Tabban laka(  تبالك  ) means that may you die and its literal meaning is to break, cut or die. And tabbaba(  تبب  ) means to step towards continuous destruction. Allah states that:
________________
Surat Hud  -   سُوۡرَةُ هُود
11: 101
وَمَا زَادُوهُمۡ غَيۡرَ تَتۡبِيبٍ۬
We wronged them not, but they did wrong themselves; and their gods on whom they call beside Allah availed them naught when came thy Lord's command; they added to them naught save ruin.
________________
7.8 tabbara(  تبر  )  : to ravage, to wreck havoc on, to eradicate. Tabaar(  تبار  ) means death, destruction. Allah states that:
________________
Surat Al-Furqan (The Standard) -   سُوۡرَةُ الفُرقان
25: 39
وَڪُلاًّ۬ ضَرَبۡنَا لَهُ ٱلۡأَمۡثَـٰلَ‌ۖ وَڪُلاًّ۬ تَبَّرۡنَا تَتۡبِيرً۬ا
Each (of them) We warned by examples, and each (of them) We brought to utter ruin.
________________
7.9 baara(  بار  )  : derived from boor(  بور  ) and buwar(  بوار  ) which means extreme devaluation of some sale merchandise and reach destruction. Kasada haatta fasada(  كسد حتى فسد  ) means to move gradually towards destruction, destruction of merchandise by slowly decreasing it. It is stated in the Quran:
________________
Surat Fatir (The Angels) -   سُوۡرَةُ فَاطِر
35: 29
وَأَنفَقُواْ مِمَّا رَزَقۡنَـٰهُمۡ سِرًّ۬ا وَعَلَانِيَةً۬ يَرۡجُونَ تِجَـٰرَةً۬ لَّن تَبُورَ
Lo! those who read the Scripture of Allah, and establish worship, and spend of that which We have bestowed on them secretly and openly, they look forward to imperishable gain
________________
7.10 as-hata(  اسحت  )  : suht(  سحت  ) meaning illegitimate earning and bribery. Sahata(  سحت  ) means that he earned bad money and as-hatit tijara(  اسحت التجارة  ) means forging and mixing of fake goods and us-hita(  اسحت  ) means in need of goods, destruction of goods. As-hata(  اسحت  ) to destroy completely from roots thus as-hata(  اسحت  ) is used to depict destruction because of poverty. Allah states that:
________________
Surat Ta-Ha  -   سُوۡرَةُ طٰه
20: 61
لَا تَفۡتَرُواْ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ڪَذِبً۬ا فَيُسۡحِتَكُم بِعَذَابٍ۬‌ۖ
Moses said unto them: Woe unto you! Invent not a lie against Allah, lest He extirpate you by some punishment. He who lieth faileth miserably.
________________
7.11 aubaqa(  أوبق  )  : wabaqa(  وبق  ) meaning to die and maubiqa(  موبق  ) means place of death, prison, something coming in between two things, between fire and pit. Awabaqa(  أوبق  ) means reaching such a point where you only see death in all ways and aubaqa(  أوبق  ) means to kill someone at such a place. Allah states that:

8 HALKA HONA, KERNA
[light, to lighten]
Synonyms: KHAFFA(  خف  ), KHAFFAFA (  خفف  ), ISTAKHAFA(  استخف  ), FATTARA(  فتر  ), QASADA(  قصد  )
8.1 khaffafa(  خفف  )  : khaffa(  خف  ) meaning to be light, (ant:saqula(  ثقل  ) meaning to be heavy). Used both in literal and semantic senses. Khafeef(  خفيف  ) means to be light in terms of weight as well as being energetic and positive. Saqeel(  ثقيل  ) means heavy in terms of weight as well as heavy on the heart. Qaulan saqeelan(  قولا ثقيلا  )(73:5) means heavy on health, heavy responsibility. Allah states that:
________________
Surat Al-Araaf (The Heights) -   سُوۡرَةُ الاٴعرَاف
7:9
وَمَنۡ خَفَّتۡ مَوَٲزِينُهُ ۥ فَأُوْلَـٰٓٮِٕكَ ٱلَّذِينَ خَسِرُوٓاْ أَنفُسَہُم
And as for those whose scale is light: those are they who lose their souls because they disbelived Our revelations.
________________
And khaffafa(  خفف  ) means to decrease, to lighten the load or responsibility, to lighten. This is also used in all ways. Allah states that:
________________
Surat Al-Baqarah (The Cow) -   سُوۡرَةُ البَقَرَة
2:86
فَلَا يُخَفَّفُ عَنۡہُمُ ٱلۡعَذَابُ وَلَا هُمۡ يُنصَرُونَ
Such are those who buy the life of the world at the price of the Hereafter. Their punishment will not be lightened, neither will they have support.
________________
And istakhaffa(  استخف  ) means to try to decrease the value and worth of something considerably. Allah states that:
________________
Surat Az-Zukhruf (Ornaments of Gold) -   سُوۡرَةُ الزّخرُف
43:54
فَٱسۡتَخَفَّ قَوۡمَهُ ۥ فَأَطَاعُوهُ‌ۚ
Thus he persuaded his people to make light (of Moses), and they obeyed him. Lo! they were a wanton folk.
________________
8.2 fattara(  فتر  )  : fatara(  فتر  ) means considerable decrease in something’s force or speed, weakness after strength, slow speed gradually after fast speed, and fatoor(  فتور  ) means slowness or stationary after high speed, softness after hardness and weakness after strength. Fattara(  فتر  ) means to considerably decrease the load or speed. Allah states that:
________________
Surat Az-Zukhruf (Ornaments of Gold) -   سُوۡرَةُ الزّخرُف
43:74-75
لَا يُفَتَّرُ عَنۡهُمۡ وَهُمۡ فِيهِ مُبۡلِسُونَ فِى عَذَابِ جَهَنَّمَ خَـٰلِدُونَ
Lo! the guilty are immortal in hell's torment. (74) It is not relaxed for them, and they despair therein.
________________
8.3 qasada(  قصد  )  : one of its meanings is to adopt a middle way saving from extravagance and deflation. Iqtisaad(  اقتصاد  ) means to adopt a middle way in the spending of money and other things. Allah states that:
________________
Surat Luqman -   سُوۡرَةُ لقمَان
31:19
وَٱقۡصِدۡ فِى مَشۡيِكَ
Be modest in thy bearing and subdue thy voice. Lo! the harshest of all voices is the voice of the ass.
________________
At another point, it is stated:
________________
Surat Al-Tawba (Repentance) -   سُوۡرَةُ التّوبَة
9:42
لَوۡ كَانَ عَرَضً۬ا قَرِيبً۬ا وَسَفَرً۬ا قَاصِدً۬ا
Had it been a near adventure and an easy journey they had followed thee, but the distance seemed too far for them. Yet will they swear by Allah (saying): If we had been able we would surely have set out with you. They destroy their souls, and Allah knoweth that they verily are liars.
________________
here also, qaasidan(  قاصدا  ) means very less or moderate distance, meaning not too far or near but it is used in the meaning of being lighter to avoid comparison and details.
Summary:
1. KHAFFAFA(  خفف  ): meaning to lighten something by decreasing the weight or responsibility.
2. FATTARA(  فتر  ): to decrease something’s strength.
3. QASADA(  قصد  ): means middle way, moderate, easy as compared to difficult.

9 HILNA, HILANA
[move, to move]
Synonyms: HARRAKA(  حرك  ), HAZZA(  هز  ), HASHA(  هش  ), LAWWA(  لوى  )  , NAFADA(  نفض  )
9.1 harraka(  حرك  )  : meaning to move, its use is common however what kind of movement it may be. Allah states that:
________________
Surat Al- Qiyama (Resurrection) -   سُوۡرَةُ القِیَامَة
75:16
لَا تُحَرِّكۡ بِهِۦ لِسَانَكَ لِتَعۡجَلَ بِهِۦۤ

________________
And ihtazza(  اهتز  ) means the movement of something in such a way as if someone has bumped it or is shaking it. Allah states that:
________________
Surat Al-Qasas (The Story) -   سُوۡرَةُ القَصَص
28:31

Throw down thy staff. And when he saw it writhing as it had been a demon, he turned to flee headlong, (and it was said unto him): O Moses! Draw nigh and fear not. Lo! thou art of those who are secure.
________________
9.3 hasha (  هش  )  : hasha(  هش  ) and hazza(  هز  ) both have the same meaning. The only difference is that hasha(  هش  ) is used only to show movement of light or small things such as hashal warq(  هش الورق  ) meaning move the leaves and hasheesh(  حشيش  ) means all soft things, soft natured man. Hasha(  هش  ) means to smile and hashaash(  حشاش  ) means such a person whose face lightens up at even the smallest things and he becomes happy. Allah states that:
________________
Surat Ta-Ha  -   سُوۡرَةُ طٰه
20:18
قَالَ هِىَ عَصَاىَ أَتَوَڪَّؤُاْ عَلَيۡہَا وَأَهُشُّ بِہَا عَلَىٰ غَنَمِى
He said: This is my staff whereon I lean, and wherewith I beat down branches for my sheep, and wherein I find other uses.
________________
9.4 lawwa (  لوى  )  : lawal habl(  لوى الحبل  ) meaning tying a knot, lawaitul hayyah(  لويت الحية  ) meaning convolution of a snake and lawwa lisanah(  لوى لسانة  ) means to roll one’s tongue during talking in such a way that the meaning of the sentence changes. Lawwa(  لوى  ) means to roll or spin something, to turn, all these meanings are used. Lawwa ra’sahu(  لوى رأسه  ) means to shake the head in such a way so as to show that you don’t agree with what is being said, shaking of the head. Allah states that:

63:5
وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمۡ تَعَالَوۡاْ يَسۡتَغۡفِرۡ لَكُمۡ رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ لَوَّوۡاْ رُءُوسَهُمۡ
And when it is said unto them: Come! The messenger of Allah will ask forgiveness for you! they avert their faces and thou seest them turning away, disdainful.
________________
9.5 nafada (  نفض  )  : meaning shivering, moving, to be restless. Nafada ra’sahu(  نفض رأسه  ) meaning to shake one’s head in amazement, humor or cold, to jerk. Nafada(  نفض  ) means to shiver while walking, someone who moves his head, and alanfaad(  الانفاض  ) means to move your head. Allah states that:
________________
Surat Al-Isra (Children of Israel) -   سُوۡرَةُ بنیٓ اسرآئیل / الإسرَاء
17:51
فَسَيُنۡغِضُونَ إِلَيۡكَ رُءُوسَہُمۡ وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هُوَ‌ۖ قُلۡ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَكُونَ قَرِيبً۬ا
Or some created thing that is yet greater in your thoughts! Then they will say: Who shall bring us back (to life). Say: He Who created you at the first. Then will they shake their heads at thee, and say: When will it be? Say: It will perhaps be soon;
________________
Summary:
1. HARRAKA(  حرك  ): to move, it is common.
2. HAZZA(  هز  ): to move a big or heavy thing by yanking it.
3. HASHA(  هش  ): to move a small or light thing by yanking it.
4. LAWWA(  لوى  ): to twist something.
5. NAFADA(  نفض  ): to shake head in amazement, humor or cold, this word is specific for movement of the head.

1 JASUWSIY KARNA [To Spy]
SYNONYMS:TAJASSASA(تَجَسَّسَ),SAMMA3(سَمَّاع)
1.1 TAJASSASA(تَجَسَّسَ)  :JASSA(جَسّ)meaning to touch by hand to find out and JASSA BI3AYNIHI(جَسَّ بِعَيْنِهِ) meaning to see with sharp sight,to stare and JASSASA(جَسَّسَ) and TAJASSASA meaning to investigate. to find someone's flaw. to be interested in someone's affairs.commonly used in bad meaning(negative context). and JASIYS(جسيس) meaning spy. ALLAH said
Surat Al-Ĥujurāt (The Rooms) - سورة الحجرات
49:12
يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اجْتَنِبُوا كَثِيرًا مِّنَ الظَّنِّ إِنَّ بَعْضَ الظَّنِّ إِثْمٌ ۖ   وَلَا تَجَسَّسُوا وَلَا يَغْتَب بَّعْضُكُم بَعْضًا ۚ   أَيُحِبُّ أَحَدُكُمْ أَن يَأْكُلَ لَحْمَ أَخِيهِ مَيْتًا فَكَرِهْتُمُوهُ ۚ وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ تَوَّابٌ رَّحِيمٌ
O you who have believed, avoid much [negative] assumption. Indeed, some assumption is sin.   And do not spy or backbite each other  . Would one of you like to eat the flesh of his brother when dead? You would detest it. And fear Allah ; indeed, Allah is Accepting of repentance and Merciful.
1.2 SAMMA3(سَمَّاع)  :SAMI3A(سَمِعَ) meaning to listen and SAAMA3(سامع) meaning listener. and SAMMA3(سَمَّاع) meaning the one who spy to listen any conversation covertly-the spy. ALLAH said
Surat Al-Mā'idah (The Table Spread) - سورة المائدة
5:41
يَا أَيُّهَا الرَّسُولُ لَا يَحْزُنكَ الَّذِينَ يُسَارِعُونَ فِي الْكُفْرِ مِنَ الَّذِينَ قَالُوا آمَنَّا بِأَفْوَاهِهِمْ وَلَمْ تُؤْمِن قُلُوبُهُمْ ۛ وَمِنَ الَّذِينَ هَادُوا ۛ   سَمَّاعُونَ لِلْكَذِبِ سَمَّاعُونَ لِقَوْمٍ آخَرِينَ لَمْ يَأْتُوكَ ۖ   يُحَرِّفُونَ الْكَلِمَ مِن بَعْدِ مَوَاضِعِهِ ۖ يَقُولُونَ إِنْ أُوتِيتُمْ هَٰذَا فَخُذُوهُ وَإِن لَّمْ تُؤْتَوْهُ فَاحْذَرُوا ۚ وَمَن يُرِدِ اللَّهُ فِتْنَتَهُ فَلَن تَمْلِكَ لَهُ مِنَ اللَّهِ شَيْئًا ۚ أُولَٰئِكَ الَّذِينَ لَمْ يُرِدِ اللَّهُ أَن يُطَهِّرَ قُلُوبَهُمْ ۚ لَهُمْ فِي الدُّنْيَا خِزْيٌ ۖ وَلَهُمْ فِي الْآخِرَةِ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ
O Messenger, let them not grieve you who hasten into disbelief of those who say, "We believe" with their mouths, but their hearts believe not, and from among the Jews.   [They are] avid listeners to falsehood, listening to another people who have not come to you.   They distort words beyond their [proper] usages, saying "If you are given this, take it; but if you are not given it, then beware." But he for whom Allah intends fitnah - never will you possess [power to do] for him a thing against Allah . Those are the ones for whom Allah does not intend to purify their hearts. For them in this world is disgrace, and for them in the Hereafter is a great punishment.
SUMMARY:
1.1 TAJASSASA:generally in negative context, to pick someone's flaw and to be in quest of one's affairs by any means.
1.2 SAMMA3: that person who listens to some matter for the sake of spying and to inform others of it.
JANCHNA [To Evaluate] please see AZMAISH KARNA[To Put to Trial]

10 JALDI KARNA [To Hurry Up]
SYNONYMS:SARI3A(سَرِعَ),i,3AJILA(عَجِل� �) ISTA3JALA(اِسْتَعْجَلَ) BADARA(بَدَرَ) FAWR(فَوْر) SA and SAWFA(سَ سَوْفَ)
10.1 SARI3A  :To not delay what needs to be done.To not leave till tomorrow what needs to be done   today.to   not   procastinate.to   finish work on time or slightly before due time.This is a commendable attribute. and It's antonym BATA-A(بَطَأ) meaning to delay(owing to laziness etc). To hurry where it is better and appropriate.ALLAH said
Surat Al-Baqarah (The Cow) - سورة البقرة
2:202
أُولَٰئِكَ لَهُمْ نَصِيبٌ مِّمَّا كَسَبُوا ۚ وَاللَّهُ سَرِيعُ الْحِسَابِ
Those will have a share of what they have earned, and Allah is swift in account.
10.2 3AJILA  :To try to obtain something before its   time.to   hurry and this a deplorable   attribute.to   hurry where it shouldn't be. ALLAH said
Surat Al-'Isrā' (The Night Journey) - سورة الإسراء
17:11
وَيَدْعُ الْإِنسَانُ بِالشَّرِّ دُعَاءَهُ بِالْخَيْرِ ۖ وَكَانَ الْإِنسَانُ عَجُولًا
And man supplicates for evil as he supplicates for good, and man is ever hasty.
and ISTA3JALA meaning to ask for something quickly or before time.ALLAH said
Surat Ar-Ra`d (The Thunder) - سورة الرعد
13:6
وَيَسْتَعْجِلُونَكَ بِالسَّيِّئَةِ قَبْلَ الْحَسَنَةِ وَقَدْ خَلَتْ مِن قَبْلِهِمُ الْمَثُلَاتُ ۗ وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَذُو مَغْفِرَةٍ لِّلنَّاسِ عَلَىٰ ظُلْمِهِمْ ۖ وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَشَدِيدُ الْعِقَابِ
They impatiently urge you to bring about evil before good, while there has already occurred before them similar punishments [to what they demand]. And indeed, your Lord is full of forgiveness for the people despite their wrongdoing, and indeed, your Lord is severe in penalty.
10.3 BADARA  :The time that is required for a task,to complete that task by reducing the time required(expedite).In the HADYC (Prophetic Narration)
LA TUBADIRUNIY BARRUKUW3I WASSUJUWDI(لَا تُبَادِ رُوْنِيْ بِالرُّكُوْعِ وَالسُّجُوْدِ) Don't Hurry for the bowing and prostration before me. Ref:[Ahmed,Abu Dawood,Ibn Maja]
and in the Quran
Surat An-Nisā' (The Women) - سورة النساء
4:6
وَابْتَلُوا الْيَتَامَىٰ حَتَّىٰ إِذَا بَلَغُوا النِّكَاحَ فَإِنْ آنَسْتُم مِّنْهُمْ رُشْدًا فَادْفَعُوا إِلَيْهِمْ أَمْوَالَهُمْ ۖ وَلَا تَأْكُلُوهَا إِسْرَافًا وَبِدَارًا أَن يَكْبَرُوا ۚ وَمَن كَانَ غَنِيًّا فَلْيَسْتَعْفِفْ ۖ وَمَن كَانَ فَقِيرًا فَلْيَأْكُلْ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ ۚ فَإِذَا دَفَعْتُمْ إِلَيْهِمْ أَمْوَالَهُمْ فَأَشْهِدُوا عَلَيْهِمْ ۚ وَكَفَىٰ بِاللَّهِ حَسِيبًا
And test the orphans [in their abilities] until they reach marriageable age. Then if you perceive in them sound judgement, release their property to them. And do not consume it excessively and quickly, [anticipating] that they will grow up. And whoever, [when acting as guardian], is self-sufficient should refrain [from taking a fee]; and whoever is poor - let him take according to what is acceptable. Then when you release their property to them, bring witnesses upon them. And sufficient is Allah as Accountant.
10.4 FAWR  :FARA(فَارَ) meaning to boil to be emotional.and FAWR meaning 'hurry alot'.it is said RAJA3A MIN FAWRIHI(رَجَعَ مِنْ فَوْرِهِ) he returned very quickly without break. meaning instantly do something with passion.ALLAH said
Surat 'Āli `Imrān (Family of Imran) - سورة آل عمران
3:125
بَلَىٰ ۚ إِن تَصْبِرُوا وَتَتَّقُوا وَيَأْتُوكُم مِّن فَوْرِهِمْ هَٰذَا يُمْدِدْكُمْ رَبُّكُم بِخَمْسَةِ آلَافٍ مِّنَ الْمَلَائِكَةِ مُسَوِّمِينَ
Yes, if you remain patient and conscious of Allah and the enemy come upon you [attacking] in rage, your Lord will reinforce you with five thousand angels having marks [of distinction]
10.5 SA and SAWFA  :apart from it SA and SAWFA enters on MUDARI3(مضارع) to give the meaning of Soon.and limits MUDARI3 to future.The difference in between them is only that SA is for near future and it is meant to be "NOW" as said
Surat Al-Baqarah (The Cow) - سورة البقرة
2:142
سَيَقُولُ السُّفَهَاءُ مِنَ النَّاسِ مَا وَلَّاهُمْ عَن قِبْلَتِهِمُ الَّتِي كَانُوا عَلَيْهَا ۚ قُل لِّلَّهِ الْمَشْرِقُ وَالْمَغْرِبُ ۚ يَهْدِي مَن يَشَاءُ إِلَىٰ صِرَاطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ
The foolish among the people will say, "What has turned them away from their qiblah, which they used to face?" Say, "To Allah belongs the east and the west. He guides whom He wills to a straight path."
and SAWFA is far in time than SA as said
Surat At-Takāthur (The Rivalry in world increase) - سورة التكاثر
102:3
كَلَّا سَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ
No! You are going to know.
SUMMARY:
10.1 SARI3A:To finish something a bit before time
10.2 3AJILA:To Hurry.To try to get something before its due time-so that it won't be done properly
10.3 BADARA:to cut deadline of work owing to hurry
10.4 FAWR:to work in the heat/passion of the moment
10.5 SA and SAWFA:both enters on MUDARI to create meaning of soon
for   JALNA[To Burn]   please see   AAG[Fire]

وَيَسْتَعْجِلُونَكَ بِالسَّيِّئَةِ قَبْلَ الْحَسَنَةِ وَقَدْ خَلَتْ مِن قَبْلِهِمُ الْمَثُلَاتُ ۗ وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَذُو مَغْفِرَةٍ لِّلنَّاسِ عَلَىٰ ظُلْمِهِمْ ۖ وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَشَدِيدُ الْعِقَابِ

They impatiently urge you to bring about evil before good, while there has already occurred before them similar punishments [to what they demand]. And indeed, your Lord is full of forgiveness for the people despite their wrongdoing, and indeed, your Lord is severe in penalty.

10.3 BADARA:The time that is required for a task,to complete that task by reducing the time required(expedite).In the HADYC (Prophetic Narration)

LA TUBADIRUNIY BARRUKUW3I WASSUJUWDI(لَا تُبَادِ رُوْنِيْ بِالرُّكُوْعِ وَالسُّجُوْدِ) Don't Hurry for the bowing and prostration before me. Ref:[Ahmed,Abu Dawood,Ibn Maja]

and in the Quran

Surat An-Nisā' (The Women) - سورة النساء

4:6

وَابْتَلُوا الْيَتَامَىٰ حَتَّىٰ إِذَا بَلَغُوا النِّكَاحَ فَإِنْ آنَسْتُم مِّنْهُمْ رُشْدًا فَادْفَعُوا إِلَيْهِمْ أَمْوَالَهُمْ ۖ وَلَا تَأْكُلُوهَا إِسْرَافًا وَبِدَارًا أَن يَكْبَرُوا ۚ وَمَن كَانَ غَنِيًّا فَلْيَسْتَعْفِفْ ۖ وَمَن كَانَ فَقِيرًا فَلْيَأْكُلْ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ ۚ فَإِذَا دَفَعْتُمْ إِلَيْهِمْ أَمْوَالَهُمْ فَأَشْهِدُوا عَلَيْهِمْ ۚ وَكَفَىٰ بِاللَّهِ حَسِيبًا

And test the orphans [in their abilities] until they reach marriageable age. Then if you perceive in them sound judgement, release their property to them. And do not consume it excessively and quickly, [anticipating] that they will grow up. And whoever, [when acting as guardian], is self-sufficient should refrain [from taking a fee]; and whoever is poor - let him take according to what is acceptable. Then when you release their property to them, bring witnesses upon them. And sufficient is Allah as Accountant.

10.4 FAWR:FARA(فَارَ) meaning to boil to be emotional.and FAWR meaning 'hurry alot'.it is said RAJA3A MIN FAWRIHI(رَجَعَ مِنْ فَوْرِهِ) he returned very quickly without break. meaning instantly do something with passion.ALLAH said

Surat 'Āli `Imrān (Family of Imran) - سورة آل عمران

3:125

بَلَىٰ ۚ إِن تَصْبِرُوا وَتَتَّقُوا وَيَأْتُوكُم مِّن فَوْرِهِمْ هَٰذَا يُمْدِدْكُمْ رَبُّكُم بِخَمْسَةِ آلَافٍ مِّنَ الْمَلَائِكَةِ مُسَوِّمِينَ

Yes, if you remain patient and conscious of Allah and the enemy come upon you [attacking] in rage, your Lord will reinforce you with five thousand angels having marks [of distinction]

10.5 SA and SAWFA:apart from it SA and SAWFA enters on MUDARI3(مضارع) to give the meaning of Soon.and limits MUDARI3 to future.The difference in between them is only that SA is for near future and it is meant to be "NOW" as said

Surat Al-Baqarah (The Cow) - سورة البقرة

2:142

سَيَقُولُ السُّفَهَاءُ مِنَ النَّاسِ مَا وَلَّاهُمْ عَن قِبْلَتِهِمُ الَّتِي كَانُوا عَلَيْهَا ۚ قُل لِّلَّهِ الْمَشْرِقُ وَالْمَغْرِبُ ۚ يَهْدِي مَن يَشَاءُ إِلَىٰ صِرَاطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ

The foolish among the people will say, "What has turned them away from their qiblah, which they used to face?" Say, "To Allah belongs the east and the west. He guides whom He wills to a straight path."

and SAWFA is far in time than SA as said

Surat At-Takāthur (The Rivalry in world increase) - سورة التكاثر

102:3

كَلَّا سَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ

No! You are going to know.

SUMMARY:

10.1 SARI3A:To finish something a bit before time

10.2 3AJILA:To Hurry.To try to get something before its due time-so that it won't be done properly

10.3 BADARA:to cut deadline of work owing to hurry

10.4 FAWR:to work in the heat/passion of the moment

10.5 SA and SAWFA:both enters on MUDARI to create meaning of soon

for JALNA[To Burn] please see AAG[Fire]
