title: content/k/k43.html
raw_text:
43. KYA (What)
Synonyms: A’, HAL(letter),  MA( As a Noun), MAZA.
43.1 A’(ءَ):   In the meaning of “What”, the use of this letter is common. It is used in all; noun, verb and alphabet. In the Quran:
1.   Surat 'Āli `Imrān (Family of Imran) - سورة آل عمران 3:144
أَفإِنْ مّاتَ أَوْ قُتِلَ
So if he was to die or be killed.
2.   Surat Al-'Anbyā' (The Prophets) - سورة الأنبياء 21:62
أَنتَ فَعَلْتَ هَٰذَا
(O Ibrahim A.S) Have you done this?
43.2 HAL(هَل):   Interrogative pronoun. Is inserted in noun and verb. Does not apply on alphabets. In the Quran:
“Surat Ar-Ra`d (The Thunder) - سورة الرعد 13:16
هَلْ يَسْتَوِي الْأَعْمَىٰ وَالْبَصِيرُ
Is the blind equivalent to the seeing?
43.3 MA(مَا):   (As a noun, an Interrogative). Only comes for irrational creatures. In the Quran:
Surat Al-'Anbyā' (The Prophets) - سورة الأنبياء 21:52
مَا هَٰذِهِ التَّمَاثِيلُ الَّتِي أَنتُمْ لَهَا عَاكِفُونَ
What are these statues to which you are devoted?
43.4 MAZA(مَاذَا):   ZA(ذَا) when added with     MA(مَا )(interrogative pronoun), creates expansion in it’s meaning. It gives meaning of both “what and which”. It can be used for rational creatures as well. In the Quran:
1.   Surat Al-Baqarah (The Cow) - سورة البقرة 2:219
يَسْأَلُونَكَ مَاذَا يُنفِقُونَ
They ask you what they should spend.
2.   Surat Al-Qaşaş (The Stories) - سورة القصص 28:65
مَاذَا أَجَبْتُمُ الْمُرْسَلِينَ
What did you answer the messengers?

title: content/k/k44.html

44. KESE (How?)
Synonyms: KAIFA, ANNA.
44.1. KAIFA   (کیف): Is used to ask about the stance and condition of something. In the Quran:
Page 725--
Surat Al-Ghāshiyah (The Overwhelming) - سورة الغاشية 18:17
أَفَلَا يَنظُرُونَ إِلَى الْإِبِلِ كَيْفَ خُلِقَتْ
Then do they not look at the camels - how they are created?
44.2. ANNA  (اَنَّى):  Is used to ask the reason regarding a task. “How”. In the Quran:
Surat Al-Baqarah (The Cow) - سورة البقرة 2:247
أَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ عَلَيْنَا
How can he have kingship over us?

Surat Al-Baqarah (The Cow) - سورة البقرة 2:247

أَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ عَلَيْنَا

How can he have kingship over us?

title: content/k/k45.html
raw_text:
45. KYUN-KYUN NA (Why – Why not)
Synonyms: LIMA, LAULA, LAUMA.
45.1 LIMA  (لِمَ): Means why, for what. In the Quran:
Surat Ţāhā (Ta-Ha) - سورة طه 20:125
رَبِّ لِمَ حَشَرْتَنِي أَعْمَىٰ
My Lord, why have you raised me blind
45.2 LAULA  (لولا): Means why not. HALLA(هَلاَّ) means rebuke and particularization. And a “Verb” should follow it.
In terms of particularization, it is exclusive with the     Verb aorist. In the Quran:
Surat An-Naml (The Ant) - سورة النمل 27:46
لَوْلَا تَسْتَغْفِرُونَ اللَّهَ
Why do you not seek forgiveness of Allah
And in terms of rebuke, past tense makes it particular. In the Quran:
Surat An-Nūr (The Light) - سورة النور 24:13
لَّوْلَا جَاءُوا عَلَيْهِ بِأَرْبَعَةِ شُهَدَاءَ ۚ
Why did they [who slandered] not produce for it four witnesses?
45.2 LAUMA  (لوما): it is a word for particularization. And after using it with aorist, it means the same as “لولا”. In the Quran:
Surat Al-Ĥijr (The Rocky Tract) - سورة الحجر 15:7
لَّوْ مَا تَأْتِينَا بِالْمَلَائِكَةِ
Why do you not bring us the angels?

raw_text:
5- KAAM ANA [to be useful, to be helpful]
Synonyms: JAZA, AGHNAA
5.1 JAZA (جَزَا) YAJZEE (یَجْزِیْ) JAZA’AN (جَزَاءً):   1. To repay back equally and then set free or save it. 2. To be a substitute, to be helpful. For instance
Surah Al-Baqarah (The cow): سورۃ البَقَرَۃ  2:48
يَوۡمً۬ا لَّا تَجۡزِى نَفۡسٌ عَن نَّفۡسٍ۬ شَيۡـًٔ۬ا
a Day when no soul will avail another in the least
And for requiting and saving:
Surah Al-Mumenoon (The believers): سُوۡرَةُ المؤمنون 23:111
إِنِّى جَزَيۡتُهُمُ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ بِمَا صَبَرُوٓاْ أَنَّهُمۡ هُمُ ٱلۡفَآٮِٕزُونَ
Today, I have rewarded them for their endurance. They are the ones who are the triumphant.
5.2 AGHNAA (اغنٰی):   Something being ample and helpful, and removes the need for anything else
Surah Al-Haqqah (The reality): سورۃ الحَاقَّۃ 69:28
مَآ أَغۡنَىٰ عَنِّى مَالِيَهۡۜ  هَلَكَ عَنِّى سُلۡطَـٰنِيَهۡ
My money cannot avail me. My power has vanished from me.”
Summary:
5.1 JAZA: To be helpful and save from difficulty
5.2 AGHNAA: Helpful and beneficial.

title: content/k/k6.html
raw_text:
6 KAAM KERNA [to do something]
Synonyms: FA’A’LA, A’MILA, SANAA’, SADAA’, JARAHA, IJTARAH’, TAM’MAD, AMR, SHA’N
6.1 FA’A’LA (فَعَلَ):   FA’EL (فَعْل) is something which comes as an effect by the doer, despite the one who does have or haven’t planned it or may or may not have material nature, and all is applied on him (doer) (plural AFA’AL (افعال) ). And FA’LAH (فَعْلَۃً) to do a something once. In the Quran
Surah Ash-Shura’ (The Poets): صورۃ الشُّعْراء 26:19
وَفَعَلۡتَ فَعۡلَتَكَ ٱلَّتِى فَعَلۡتَ وَأَنتَ مِنَ ٱلۡكَـٰفِرِينَ
And you committed that deed you committed, and you were ungrateful.”
This Ayah relates the murder that was done by Moses (Hazrat Musa (A.S)) unintentionally. The example for something done intentionally is following
Surah Al-Baqarah (The cow): سورۃ البَقَرَۃ  2:68
فَٱفۡعَلُواْ مَا تُؤۡمَرُونَ
So do what you are commanded.
6.2 A’MILA (عَمِلَ):    A’ML (عَمْل) means anything done by a living being intentionally which may be good or bad (plural A’MAAL(اعمال)). AMAL (عَمِل) refers to hard work and labor. In the Quran
Surah Al-Kahf (The Cave): سورۃ الکھف 18:79
أَمَّا ٱلسَّفِينَةُ فَكَانَتۡ لِمَسَـٰكِينَ يَعۡمَلُونَ فِى ٱلۡبَحۡرِ
As for the boat, it belonged to paupers working at sea.
6.3 SANAA’ (صَنَعَ):   To perform a task with perfection. This word is from AMALA (عَمَلَ) and not used when referring animals. SANNA’ (صَنَعَ) means a craftsman or an expert in his domain. Allah says in the Quran
Surah Hud (Hud): سورۃ ھود 11:37
وَٱصۡنَعِ ٱلۡفُلۡكَ بِأَعۡيُنِنَا وَوَحۡيِنَا
And build the Ark, under Our eyes, and with Our inspiration
Page 694
6.4 SADAA’ (صَدَعَ):   Means to finish a work   (dictionary Al   Manjad  ) despite of any difficulties, completing the task. SADA’-BIL- HAQQ   (صَدَعَ بِالْحَقّ)   means to speak truth openly. SADA’-ASH-SHAI   (صَدَعَ الشَّئ)   means to tear something without separating it (dictionary Al   Manjad  ). Allah says in the Holy Quran
Surah Al-Hijr (The Rock): سورۃ الحِجر 15:94
فَٱصۡدَعۡ بِمَا تُؤۡمَرُ وَأَعۡرِضۡ عَنِ ٱلۡمُشۡرِكِينَ
So proclaim openly what you are commanded, and turn away from the polytheists.
6.5 JARAHA (جَرَحَ):   JRAH (جرح) means a wound (plural wound) JARAHA (جَرَحَ) means to inflict a wound, JARAH-BIL-LISAAN (جَرَحَ بِاللِّسَان) to hurt someone with words, or torture verbally. To narrate someone’s imperfections. JARAH-ASH-SHAHADAH (جَرَحَ الشَھَادَۃ) means to falsify a testimony   (dictionary Al   Manjad  ). When this word is used to refer to doing something then usually it is taken in a negative manner. Allah says in the Quran
Surah Al-Ana’am (The cattle): سورۃ الانعام 6:60
وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى يَتَوَفَّٮٰڪُم بِٱلَّيۡلِ وَيَعۡلَمُ مَا جَرَحۡتُم بِٱلنَّہَارِ
It is He Who takes you by night, and He knows what you earn by day
And   IJTARAH’ (اِجْتَرَح) means to commit something   (dictionary Al   Manjad  )  . IJTARAH-AL-ISM (اِجْتَرَح الِاثْم) means he committed a sin. Allah says in the Quran
Surah Al-Jathiya (Crouching): سُوۡرَةُ الجَاثیَة 45:21
أَمۡ حَسِبَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱجۡتَرَحُواْ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ أَن نَّجۡعَلَهُمۡ كَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ
Do those who perpetrate the evil deeds assume that We will regard them as equal to those who believe and do righteous deeds
6.6 TA’AM’MAD (تَعَمَّدَ):   AMADA (عَمَدَ) means to aim to do something, or vow to do something. AMAD (عَمَد) means a pillar (plural I’MAAD (عِمَاد)). And AMOOD (عَمُوْد) is that wooden pillar that supports the tent. TA’AM’MAD (تَعَمَّدَ) means to do something deliberately, to do something despite of knowing it is bad (opposite SAHW). In the Quran
Surah An-Nisa (The women): سورۃ النِّسا 4:93
وَمَن يَقۡتُلۡ مُؤۡمِنً۬ا مُّتَعَمِّدً۬ا فَجَزَآؤُهُ ۥ جَهَنَّمُ خَـٰلِدً۬ا فِيہَا
Whoever kills a believer deliberately, the penalty for him is Hell, where he will remain forever
6.7 AMR (اَمْر):   Refers to an action, state, matter that may be verbal or in act. (Plural AMOOR (امور)) This word is more popular than FA’EL (فَعْل) because it not only refers to actions but also to words. Moreover it is also used for words or acts related to will of Allah. In the Quran
Surah An-Naml (The ant): سورۃ النَّمل 27:32
مَا ڪُنتُ قَاطِعَةً أَمۡرًا حَتَّىٰ تَشۡہَدُونِ
I never make a decision unless you are present.”
Page 695
In this ayah the word AMR (اَمْر) is giving the meaning of act, matter and words. And the work is referring to neither act nor words. AMR (اَمْر) also means an order. In that case its plural will be AWAAMIR (اَوَامِْر)  (opposite NAWAHI(نواھی)). When denotes an action then it won’t mean to do something, rather to abide by an order.
6.8 SHA’N (شاْن):   (plural SHU’OON(شؤون)) means huge affairs, matters or conditions. MIN-SHANIHI-KAZA ( مِنْ شَانِہِ کَذَا) means to do this thing is in his nature   (dictionary Al   Manjad  )  . Thus SHA’N (شاْن) means to do something befitting for someone. Allah says in Quran
Surah Ar-Rahman (The Beneficent): سُوۡرَةُ الرَّحمٰن 55:29
كُلَّ يَوۡمٍ هُوَ فِى شَأۡنٍ۬
Every day He is managing
In another reference
Surah Al-Noor (The light): سورۃ النور 24:62
ۦ‌ۚ فَإِذَا ٱسۡتَـٔۡذَنُوكَ لِبَعۡضِ شَأۡنِهِمۡ فَأۡذَن لِّمَن شِئۡتَ مِنۡهُمۡ
So when they ask your permission to attend to some affair of theirs, give permission to any of them you wish,
Summary
6.1 FA’A’LA:  Something done with or without intention
6.2 A’ML: Action performed intentionally due to some interest
6.3 SANAA’: To do something skillfully
6.4 SADAA’: To complete a task despite of tribulations
6.5 JARAHA: Usually refers to ill actions
6.6, TAM’MAD: To perform an ill action intentionally
6.7 AMR: Related to actions, words or matters
6.9 SHA’N: To do a befitting work.

title: content/k/k7.html
raw_text:
7. KAMYAAB HONA, MURAD PAANA [To be successful, to obtain one’s wish]
Synonyms:   AFLAHA, FAAZ
7.1. AFLAHA (افلح):   There are three meanings in   FALAHA (  فلح  )  : a) to rip or tear apart b) success c) imperishability  . FALLAH (فلاح)   means a farmer who tears open the land to sow seeds, achieves success when his crops are ready to be harvested and obtains his wish when he benefits from it.   AFLAHA (افلح)   means to be successful, fulfilment of one’s wish by working hard for it.
Allah (swt) said:
Surah al-Muminun 23:1-2
Certainly will the believers have succeeded: they who are humbly submissive during their prayer.
7.2.   FAAZ (فاز):   It means to be saved from some trouble and achieve something which is dear. It also means to receive security as well as blessing.
Allah (swt) said:
Surah Al-e-Imran 3:185
فَازَ فَقَدْ الْجَنَّةَ وَأُدْخِلَ النَّارِ عَنِ زُحْزِحَ فَمَن
So he who is drawn away from the Fire and admitted to Paradise has attained [his desire].
The word   FAAZ (فاز)   is from the dictionary of opposites. It means to be successful and obtain emancipation and it also means to perish or die.   FAWWAZ ARAJUL (الرجل فوز)   means a man died.   MAFAAZATUN (مفازۃ, 3:188)   means the cause or place of success. It also means the cause or place of annihilation as it is used in this meaning in the aforementioned verse. However, this word usually means to be saved from some trouble and to achieve success or fulfil one’s wish by attaining something desirable.
It is mentioned in the Quran:
Surah an-Nisa 4:73
عَظِيمًافَوْزًا فَأَفُوزَ مَعَهُمْ كُنتُ لَيتَنِي يَا
(Hypocrite will say :) "Oh, I wish I had been with them so I could have attained a great attainment."
CONCLUSION:
1) AFLAHA is used for achieving success by gaining the rightful fruit of hard work and 2) FAAZ refers to an act which, if it has shortcomings, would lead to destruction, but if it is completed successfully , then it would result in the attainment of a lot of rewards.

raw_text:
8. KANMPNA [to shake, to tremble]
Synonyms: ZALZAL, MARA, RAJJA, RAJAFA
8.1 ZALZAL (زَلْزَلَ):   ZALL (زَلَّ) mean slipping of feet, ZALZAL (زَلْزَل) has recurrence in it, which also relates to the meaning, so ZALZAL (زَلْزَل) means to slip around repeatedly. ZALZALA (زَلْزَلَة) means an earthquake or earth tremor. This word ZALZALA (زَلْزَلة) is specific for an earthquake. Allah says in the Quran
Surah Al-Zalzala (The earthquake): سُوۡرَةُ الزّلزَلة 99:1
إِذَا زُلۡزِلَتِ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ زِلۡزَالَهَا
When the earth is shaken with its quake.
8.2 RAJJ (رَجّ):   To shake something, to jerk. This is the initial state of an earthquake. Allah says in the Quran
Surah Al-Waqiah (The Inevitable): سُوۡرَةُ الواقِعَة 56:4
إِذَا رُجَّتِ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ رَجًّ۬ا
When the earth is shaken with a shock.
8.3 RAJAFA (رَجَفَ):   Basically means extreme agitation. BAHRUN-RAJJAFUN (بَحْرٌرَجَّافٌ) means a violent sea. WAL-MURJFUUN-FIL-MADINAH  وَٱلۡمُرۡجِفُونَ فِى ٱلۡمَدِينَةِ      33:60 means something causing wave of excitement or unrest. When the word is used in relation with earth, then it means strong tremors or a strong earthquake. In the Quran
Surah Al-Muzammil (The enshrouded one): سورۃ المُزمّل 73:14
يَوۡمَ تَرۡجُفُ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ وَٱلۡجِبَالُ وَكَانَتِ ٱلۡجِبَالُ كَثِيبً۬ا مَّهِيلاً
On the Day when the earth and the mountains tremble, and the mountains become heaps of sand.
Page 697
8.4 MAAR (مَارَ):   basically refers to movement or speed. AN-NAQATU-TAMOORU-FI-SEERIHA (الناقة تَمُوْرُفْیِ سَیْرِھَا) means when a camel runs speedily raising dust. MAUR means to turn to dust and blown with winds. MAR-ASH-SHAI (مَارالشئ) means trembling and shaking of something due to speed. To lose balance (  dictionary Al   Manjad  ). Allah says in the Quran
Surah At-Tur (The Mount): سورۃ الطُّور 52:9
يَوۡمَ تَمُورُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ مَوۡرً۬ا
On the Day when the heaven sways in agitation.
Summary:
ZALZALA, RAJJ and RAJAF are related to earthquake
8.1 ZALZALA: Common word for earthquake
8.2 RAJJ: Initial state of earthquake
8.3 RAJAF: A violent earthquake
8.4 MARA: Shaking and trembling due to high speed

raw_text:
9 KAB? [When?]
Synonyms: AYYAANA, MATAA
9.1 AYYAANA (اَیَّان):   Used when inquiring for time for an event or task. Allah says in the Quran
Surah An-Nazi'at (Those who drag forth): سورۃ النَّازعَات 79:42
يَسۡـَٔلُونَكَ عَنِ ٱلسَّاعَةِ أَيَّانَ مُرۡسَٮٰهَا
They ask you about the Hour, “When will it take place?”
9.2 MATAA (متٰی):   Besides inquiry is also used for challenging.  In the Quran
Surah As-Sajda (The prostration ): سُوۡرَةُ السَّجدَة 32:28
مَتَىٰ هَـٰذَا ٱلۡفَتۡحُ إِن ڪُنتُمۡ صَـٰدِقِينَ
“When is this victory, if you are truthful?”
Surah Yaseen (Yaseen): سورۃ ٰیٰس 36:48
مَتَىٰ هَـٰذَا ٱلۡوَعۡدُ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَـٰدِقِينَ
“When will this promise be, if you are truthful?”

10 KHUSHK HUWNA [To Be DRY]
SYNONYMS: YABASA يَبَسَ HAJA(HA-YA-JA)(هَاجَ(هيج)HAMADA هَمَدَ JAFA-A (JA-FA-WA)(جَفَأَ (جفو)and GHADA (GHA-YA-DA)(غَاضَ (غيض)
10.1 YABASA  :(anotnym is RATABA رَطَبَ)is a common word.something or someplace being devoid of water of moisture.something dryed up.In the QURAN
Surat Ţāhā (Ta-Ha) - سورة طه
20:77
وَلَقَدْ أَوْحَيْنَا إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰ أَنْ أَسْرِ بِعِبَادِي فَاضْرِبْ لَهُمْ طَرِيقًا فِي الْبَحْرِ يَبَسًا لَّا تَخَافُ دَرَكًا وَلَا تَخْشَىٰ
And We had inspired to Moses, "Travel by night with My servants and strike for them a dry path through the sea; you will not fear being overtaken [by Pharaoh] nor be afraid [of drowning]."
10.2 HAJA  :planation being yellowish from green and dryed up owing to natural disposition or lack of water.plantation being bloom to the full and then fall to decay when it is ripe to yellow and able to be harvested/sickled.and HAJA ANNABATU(هَاجَ النَّبَتُ) meaning grass dryed up.and HAJAT ALARD(هاجت الارض) meaning drying up of earth grass.In the QURAN
Surat Az-Zumar (The Troops) - سورة الزمر
39:21
أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ اللَّهَ أَنزَلَ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً فَسَلَكَهُ يَنَابِيعَ فِي الْأَرْضِ ثُمَّ يُخْرِجُ بِهِ زَرْعًا مُّخْتَلِفًا أَلْوَانُهُ ثُمَّ يَهِيجُ فَتَرَاهُ مُصْفَرًّا ثُمَّ يَجْعَلُهُ حُطَامًا ۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَذِكْرَىٰ لِأُولِي الْأَلْبَابِ
Do you not see that Allah sends down rain from the sky and makes it flow as springs [and rivers] in the earth; then He produces thereby crops of varying colors; then they dry and you see them turned yellow; then He makes them [scattered] debris. Indeed in that is a reminder for those of understanding.
10.3 HAMADA  :earth becoming dry and uncultivable/barren or plantation being dryed off of drying-owing to unavailability of water.NABATUN HAMIDATUN(نَبَاتٌ هَامِدَةٌ) meaning dryed off grass.and ARDA HAMIDATUN(اَرْضٌ هَامِدَةٌ) meaning dry and barren land.ALLAH said
Surat Al-Ĥaj (The Pilgrimage) - سورة الحج
22:5
يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ إِن كُنتُمْ فِي رَيْبٍ مِّنَ الْبَعْثِ فَإِنَّا خَلَقْنَاكُم مِّن تُرَابٍ ثُمَّ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ ثُمَّ مِنْ عَلَقَةٍ ثُمَّ مِن مُّضْغَةٍ مُّخَلَّقَةٍ وَغَيْرِ مُخَلَّقَةٍ لِّنُبَيِّنَ لَكُمْ ۚ وَنُقِرُّ فِي الْأَرْحَامِ مَا نَشَاءُ إِلَىٰ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى ثُمَّ نُخْرِجُكُمْ طِفْلًا ثُمَّ لِتَبْلُغُوا أَشُدَّكُمْ ۖ وَمِنكُم مَّن يُتَوَفَّىٰ وَمِنكُم مَّن يُرَدُّ إِلَىٰ أَرْذَلِ الْعُمُرِ لِكَيْلَا يَعْلَمَ مِن بَعْدِ عِلْمٍ شَيْئًا ۚ وَتَرَى الْأَرْضَ هَامِدَةً فَإِذَا أَنزَلْنَا عَلَيْهَا الْمَاءَ اهْتَزَّتْ وَرَبَتْ وَأَنبَتَتْ مِن كُلِّ زَوْجٍ بَهِيجٍ
O People, if you should be in doubt about the Resurrection, then [consider that] indeed, We created you from dust, then from a sperm-drop, then from a clinging clot, and then from a lump of flesh, formed and unformed - that We may show you. And We settle in the wombs whom We will for a specified term, then We bring you out as a child, and then [We develop you] that you may reach your [time of] maturity. And among you is he who is taken in [early] death, and among you is he who is returned to the most decrepit [old] age so that he knows, after [once having] knowledge, nothing. And you see the earth barren, but when We send down upon it rain, it quivers and swells and grows [something] of every beautiful kind.
10.4 JAFA-A  :JAFA YAJFU-(جَفَا يَجْفُوْا) river dumping it surf or trash at it's bank or vessel spilling its bubbles/boil etc by boiling to its edges.and JAFA- is that useless and non beneficial hay and straw which drys off at the bank of   river.in   the QURAN
Surat Ar-Ra`d (The Thunder) - سورة الرعد
13:17
أَنزَلَ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً فَسَالَتْ أَوْدِيَةٌ بِقَدَرِهَا فَاحْتَمَلَ السَّيْلُ زَبَدًا رَّابِيًا ۚ وَمِمَّا يُوقِدُونَ عَلَيْهِ فِي النَّارِ ابْتِغَاءَ حِلْيَةٍ أَوْ مَتَاعٍ زَبَدٌ مِّثْلُهُ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يَضْرِبُ اللَّهُ الْحَقَّ وَالْبَاطِلَ ۚ فَأَمَّا الزَّبَدُ فَيَذْهَبُ جُفَاءً ۖ وَأَمَّا مَا يَنفَعُ النَّاسَ فَيَمْكُثُ فِي الْأَرْضِ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يَضْرِبُ اللَّهُ الْأَمْثَالَ
He sends down from the sky, rain, and valleys flow according to their capacity, and the torrent carries a rising foam. And from that [ore] which they heat in the fire, desiring adornments and utensils, is a foam like it. Thus Allah presents [the example of] truth and falsehood. As for the foam, it vanishes, [being] cast off; but as for that which benefits the people, it remains on the earth. Thus does Allah present examples.
10.5 GHADA  :meaning to decrease something and something itself automatically   decreasing.to   shrink something or itself being shrinked.used both in transitive and intransitive   context.in   the QURAN.
Surat Ar-Ra`d (The Thunder) - سورة الرعد
13:8
اللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ مَا تَحْمِلُ كُلُّ أُنثَىٰ وَمَا تَغِيضُ الْأَرْحَامُ وَمَا تَزْدَادُ ۖ وَكُلُّ شَيْءٍ عِندَهُ بِمِقْدَارٍ
Allah knows what every female carries and what the wombs lose [prematurely] or exceed. And everything with Him is by due measure.
and GHADA when it refers to water then it means water drying up.and lowering of water surface by being absorbed by earth.ALLAH said
Surat Hūd (Hud) - سورة هود
11:44
وَقِيلَ يَا أَرْضُ ابْلَعِي مَاءَكِ وَيَا سَمَاءُ أَقْلِعِي وَغِيضَ الْمَاءُ وَقُضِيَ الْأَمْرُ وَاسْتَوَتْ عَلَى الْجُودِيِّ ۖ وَقِيلَ بُعْدًا لِّلْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ
And it was said, "O earth, swallow your water, and O sky, withhold [your rain]." And the water subsided, and the matter was accomplished, and the ship came to rest on the [mountain of] Judiyy. And it was said, "Away with the wrongdoing people."
SUMMARY  :
10.1 YABASA:common word for dryness.
10.2 HAJA:natural yellowness and dryness of plantation owing to deacy after their blooming.
10.3 HAMADA:drying up or drying off plantation owing to lack of water or barren earth.
10.4 JAFA-A:drying up of trash or surf by river bank
10.5 GHADA:to decrease by drying   up.to   shrink.water(level) descending down

11 KHALASY PANA-DYNA-CHUTKARA-RIHA-IY [Absolution-To give absolution-Acceptilation-Discharge ]
SYNONYMS: NIJAT(NA-JA-WA)(نجات (نجو)MANAS(NA-WA-SA)مناص (نوص) ANQAZA اَنْقَذَ
11.1 NIJAT  :NAJA نجا meaning to be saved from some trouble,difficult task,trial or punishment.and ANJA اَنْجَي meaning to free some other .this is a common word.In the QURAN.
Surat Al-'A`rāf (The Heights) - سورة الأعراف
7:141
وَإِذْ أَنجَيْنَاكُم مِّنْ آلِ فِرْعَوْنَ يَسُومُونَكُمْ سُوءَ الْعَذَابِ ۖ يُقَتِّلُونَ أَبْنَاءَكُمْ وَيَسْتَحْيُونَ نِسَاءَكُمْ ۚ وَفِي ذَٰلِكُم بَلَاءٌ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ عَظِيمٌ
And [recall, O Children of Israel], when We saved you from the people of Pharaoh, [who were] afflicting you with the worst torment - killing your sons and keeping your women alive. And in that was a great trial from your Lord.
and NIJAT meaning to absolve,acceptilation and discharge.ALLAH said
Surat Ghāfir (The Forgiver) - سورة غافر
40:41
وَيَا قَوْمِ مَا لِي أَدْعُوكُمْ إِلَى النَّجَاةِ وَتَدْعُونَنِي إِلَى النَّارِ
And O my people, how is it that I invite you to salvation while you invite me to the Fire?
11.2 MANAS  :NAWS includes the meaning of hesitation and to get freedom by getting some where.NASA FULANAN(نَاصَ فُلاَناً ) to slip away from someone's hand. NASA 3AN QARNIHI(نَاصَ عَنْ قَرْنِهِ) to run away from one's opponent.and MANAS is adverb and used as both as adverb of time and adverb of place.meaning time of absolution and place of absolution.ALLAH said
Surat Şād (The Letter "Saad") - سورة ص
38:3
كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّن قَرْنٍ فَنَادَوا وَّلَاتَ حِينَ مَنَاصٍ
How many a generation have We destroyed before them, and they [then] called out; but it was not a time for escape.
11.3 ANQAZA  :to absolve,to acceptilate,to save someone from some danger or   destruction.as   ALLAH said
Surat Az-Zumar (The Troops) - سورة الزمر
39:19
أَفَمَنْ حَقَّ عَلَيْهِ كَلِمَةُ الْعَذَابِ أَفَأَنتَ تُنقِذُ مَن فِي النَّارِ
Then, is one who has deserved the decree of punishment [to be guided]? Then, can you save one who is in the Fire?
SUMMARY  :
11.1 NIJAT:is a common   word.to   absolve from some difficulty,trial,trouble,wrath. etc
11.2 MANAS:to get absolution by one ,going some where else
11.3 ANQAZA:peculiar than NIJAT ,to give absolution from danger,destruction or wrath.
also please see   NIJAT PANA [To get absolution]

12 KHALQAT-MAKHLUWQ [Creature-Creation]
SYNONYMS:BARIYYAH (BA-RA-AA)(بَرِيَّة (برئ)ANAM اَنَام JIBILLAN(JA-BA-LA)(جِبِلّاً (جبل)
12.1 BARIYYAH  : is derived from BARA-A بَرَءَ.meaning to bring in to existence something from nothing.thus every such thing which exist is included in BARIYYAH.All Creation.All Universe Earth and Skies,other planets/celestial bodies are also included in it.In the QURAN
Surat Al-Bayyinah (The Clear Proof) - سورة البينة
98:7
إِنَّ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ أُولَٰئِكَ هُمْ خَيْرُ الْبَرِيَّةِ
Indeed, they who have believed and done righteous deeds - those are the best of creatures.
12.2 ANAM  :is used for every type of creationg present on earth.whether living or non living.ALLAH said
Surat Ar-Raĥmān (The Beneficent) - سورة الرحمن
55:10
وَالْأَرْضَ وَضَعَهَا لِلْأَنَامِ
And the earth He laid [out] for the creatures.
and ALWARAاَلْوَرَي meaning that creation which was present on earth at one   time.it   doesn't include past and future generation.but this word is not used in the HOLY QURAN.and its plural is WARAYAوَرَايَا.
12.3 JIBILLAN  :plural of JIBLAHجبلّة -its meaning is as per JBL or hugeness of mountain.meaning very big group.ALLAH said
Surat Yā-Sīn (Ya Sin) - سورة يس
36:62
وَلَقَدْ أَضَلَّ مِنكُمْ جِبِلًّا كَثِيرًا ۖ أَفَلَمْ تَكُونُوا تَعْقِلُونَ
And he had already led astray from among you much of creation, so did you not use reason?
SUMMARY  :
12.1 BARIYYAH:for all creation
12.2 ANAM:for creation present on earth
12.3 JIBILLAN:for a big part of creation that is subject to shariah

13 KHAWAB [Dream]
SYNONYMS:MANAM (NAWM)(مَنَام(نَوْم),RU-YA(RA-AA-YA)رُءْيَا (راي) AHLAM اَحْلام
13.1 MANAM  :meaning state of sleep.and whatever human see in sleep is also MANAM whether it's real or not.ALLAH said
Surat Al-'Anfāl (The Spoils of War) - سورة الأنفال
8:43
إِذْ يُرِيكَهُمُ اللَّهُ فِي مَنَامِكَ قَلِيلًا ۖ وَلَوْ أَرَاكَهُمْ كَثِيرًا لَّفَشِلْتُمْ وَلَتَنَازَعْتُمْ فِي الْأَمْرِ وَلَٰكِنَّ اللَّهَ سَلَّمَ ۗ إِنَّهُ عَلِيمٌ بِذَاتِ الصُّدُورِ
[Remember, O Muhammad], when Allah showed them to you in your dream as few; and if He had shown them to you as many, you [believers] would have lost courage and would have disputed in the matter [of whether to fight], but Allah saved [you from that]. Indeed, He is Knowing of that within the breasts.
13.2 RU-YA  :RA-AA-YA meaning to see.this word also applies to watching some even in sleep for e.g
Surat Yūsuf (Joseph) - سورة يوسف
12:5
قَالَ يَا بُنَيَّ لَا تَقْصُصْ رُؤْيَاكَ عَلَىٰ إِخْوَتِكَ فَيَكِيدُوا لَكَ كَيْدًا ۖ إِنَّ الشَّيْطَانَ لِلْإِنسَانِ عَدُوٌّ مُّبِينٌ
He said, "O my son, do not relate your vision to your brothers or they will contrive against you a plan. Indeed Satan, to man, is a manifest enemy.
and also in awakening state. the even of ascension on which there is a consensus of scholar that it occurred in the awakening state. regarding it ALLAH said
Surat Al-'Isrā' (The Night Journey) - سورة الإسراء
17:60
وَإِذْ قُلْنَا لَكَ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ أَحَاطَ بِالنَّاسِ ۚ وَمَا جَعَلْنَا الرُّؤْيَا الَّتِي أَرَيْنَاكَ إِلَّا فِتْنَةً لِّلنَّاسِ وَالشَّجَرَةَ الْمَلْعُونَةَ فِي الْقُرْآنِ ۚ وَنُخَوِّفُهُمْ فَمَا يَزِيدُهُمْ إِلَّا طُغْيَانًا كَبِيرًا
And [remember, O Muhammad], when We told you, "Indeed, your Lord has encompassed the people." And We did not make the sight which We showed you except as a trial for the people, as was the accursed tree [mentioned] in the Qur'an. And We threaten them, but it increases them not except in great transgression.
here words of FITNATUN LINNAS( فِتْنَةٌ لِلنَّاسِ) also clarifies this fact that this even occurs in the awakening state.
13.3 AHLAM  :plural of HULUM(حُلُم) HALAMAحَلَمَ meaning young and adult.and HULMحُلْم meaning wet dreams.vulgar and nightmare dreams. In the QURAN
Surat Yūsuf (Joseph) - سورة يوسف
12:44
قَالُوا أَضْغَاثُ أَحْلَامٍ ۖ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِتَأْوِيلِ الْأَحْلَامِ بِعَالِمِينَ
They said, "[It is but] a mixture of false dreams, and we are not learned in the interpretation of dreams."
SUMMARY  :
13.1 MANAM:common word for dream
13.2 RU-YA:to see some event whether dreaming or awaken
13.3 AHLAM:disconnected ,vulgar and nightmarish dream

14 KHWAHISH [Desire]
SYNONYMS:AMLامْل UMNIYAHاُمْنِيَة HAWAهَوَي SHAHWAHشَهْوَة WATARوَطَرَ
for 14.1 AML-14.2 UMNIYAH  :please see   AARZOO AWR UMIYD LAGANA [To wish and have hope]

Surat An-Nāzi`āt (Those who drag forth) - سورة النازعات
79:40
وَأَمَّا مَنْ خَافَ مَقَامَ رَبِّهِ وَنَهَى النَّفْسَ عَنِ الْهَوَىٰ
But as for he who feared the position of his Lord and prevented the soul from [unlawful] inclination,

Beautified for people is the love of that which they desire - of women and sons, heaped-up sums of gold and silver, fine branded horses, and cattle and tilled land. That is the enjoyment of worldly life, but Allah has with Him the best return.
SHAW YASHAWشهو يشهو meaning meal being tasty.and ISHTAHAاشتها word is peculiarly used for the demand of eatable and drinkable things or hunger.In the QURAN
Surat Fuşşilat (Explained in Detail) - سورة فصلت
41:31
نَحْنُ أَوْلِيَاؤُكُمْ فِي الْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ ۖ وَلَكُمْ فِيهَا مَا تَشْتَهِي أَنفُسُكُمْ وَلَكُمْ فِيهَا مَا تَدَّعُونَ
We [angels] were your allies in worldly life and [are so] in the Hereafter. And you will have therein whatever your souls desire, and you will have therein whatever you request [or wish]
14.5 WATAR  :intense desire of something and important/indispensable need.intercourse,lust.In QURAN this word is used for sexual desire. It is said
Surat Al-'Aĥzāb (The Combined Forces) - سورة الأحزاب
33:37
وَإِذْ تَقُولُ لِلَّذِي أَنْعَمَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَأَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِ أَمْسِكْ عَلَيْكَ زَوْجَكَ وَاتَّقِ اللَّهَ وَتُخْفِي فِي نَفْسِكَ مَا اللَّهُ مُبْدِيهِ وَتَخْشَى النَّاسَ وَاللَّهُ أَحَقُّ أَن تَخْشَاهُ ۖ فَلَمَّا قَضَىٰ زَيْدٌ مِّنْهَا وَطَرًا زَوَّجْنَاكَهَا لِكَيْ لَا يَكُونَ عَلَى الْمُؤْمِنِينَ حَرَجٌ فِي أَزْوَاجِ أَدْعِيَائِهِمْ إِذَا قَضَوْا مِنْهُنَّ وَطَرًا ۚ وَكَانَ أَمْرُ اللَّهِ مَفْعُولًا
And [remember, O Muhammad], when you said to the one on whom Allah bestowed favor and you bestowed favor, "Keep your wife and fear Allah ," while you concealed within yourself that which Allah is to disclose. And you feared the people, while Allah has more right that you fear Him. So when Zayd had no longer any need for her, We married her to you in order that there not be upon the believers any discomfort concerning the wives of their adopted sons when they no longer have need of them. And ever is the command of Allah accomplished.
SUMMARY  :
14.1 AML:such a desire which would require long period
14.2 UMNIYAH:baseless and false desire
14.3 HAWA:bad/evil desires or bad use of natural desires
14.4 SHAHWAH:intense desire and indispensable need. particularly intercourse
14.5 WATAR:natural human desires

15 KHAWBSUWRAT [BEAUTY]
SYNONYMS: BAHIYJبَهِيْج NADIRAHنَاضِرَة HISANحِسَان
15.1 BAHIYJ  :meaning to be beautiful. and ABHAJ ALMAKANابهج المكان meaning something being lush green and BAHJAH بَهْجَة meaning beauty-greenery-joy-happiness or expression of happiness.so BAHJAH word commonly used for beauty of plantation.such a beauty which cheers heart.and BAHIYJ meaning beauty,booming,blooming.ALLAH said
Surat Qāf (The Letter "Qaf") - سورة ق
50:7
وَالْأَرْضَ مَدَدْنَاهَا وَأَلْقَيْنَا فِيهَا رَوَاسِيَ وَأَنبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ زَوْجٍ بَهِيجٍ
And the earth - We spread it out and cast therein firmly set mountains and made grow therein [something] of every beautiful kind,
15.2 NADIRAH  :NADARA نَضَرَ meaning to be refreshed.and NADARA ALWAJH نَضَرَ الْوَجْه meaning face being soft,fresh and beautiful.and NADRAH نَضْرَةmeaning beauty-boom-bliss and NADIR نَاضِر meaning beautiful-soft and delicate.this word is also used for the beauty of refreshing plantation yet it also applies to the beauty of human face which is owing to refereshness and softness.ALLAH said
Surat Al-Qiyāmah (The Resurrection) - سورة القيامة
75:22
وُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ نَّاضِرَةٌ
[Some] faces, that Day, will be radiant,
Surat Al-Qiyāmah (The Resurrection) - سورة القيامة
75:23
إِلَىٰ رَبِّهَا نَاظِرَةٌ
Looking at their Lord.
15.3 HISAN  :HASUNA حَسُنَ meaning to be beautiful.and HASIYNحَسِيْن meaning beautiful-prettiness.feminine HASANAHحَسَنَة and HASANA-حَسَنَاء(plural HISAN) and HUSNحُسْن meaning beauty-grace. and MAHASINمَحَاسِن meaning beautiful places of body.ALLAH said
Surat Ar-Raĥmān (The Beneficent) - سورة الرحمن
55:70
فِيهِنَّ خَيْرَاتٌ حِسَانٌ
In them are good and beautiful women -
SUMMARY  :
15.1 BAHIYJ:commonly applies to beauty of plantation
15.2 NADIRAH:for beauty of face owing to softness and refreshness
15.3 HISAN:used for being favourite and good looking

raw_text:
16 KHWRAK- KHWRK LANA [FOOD-To Bring Food]
SYNONYMS:QUWT قُوْتRIZQرِزْق MARA(MA-YA-RA)(مَارَ(مير)
16.1 QUWT  :meaning food-nutrition-such an amount of food which is just enough for any living being to stay alive.plural AQWAT اقوات and QATA YAQUWTU قَاتَ يَقُوْتُ meaning to feed nutrition.and AQAT اَقَات meaning such a thing with which one can obtain    strength.it    is said MALAHU QUWTU LAYLATIN(مَالَهُ قُوْتُ لَيْلَةٍ) meaning he does't have food even for night.ALLAH said
Surat Fuşşilat (Explained in Detail) - سورة فصلت
41:10
وَجَعَلَ فِيهَا رَوَاسِيَ مِن فَوْقِهَا وَبَارَكَ فِيهَا وَقَدَّرَ فِيهَا أَقْوَاتَهَا فِي أَرْبَعَةِ أَيَّامٍ سَوَاءً لِّلسَّائِلِينَ
And He placed on the earth firmly set mountains over its surface, and He blessed it and determined therein its [creatures'] sustenance in four days without distinction - for [the information] of those who ask.
16.2 RIZQ  :meaning provision,RAZAQA رَزَقَ means to give provision.and RUZIQ رُزِق - to get provision, to be lucky.and MURZURQ مُرْزُرْق meaning lucky.this word is used both in material and literal aspect.and RIZQ meaning also predestined.RUZIQTU 3ILMAN رُزِقْتُ عِلماً meaning I was bestowed upon knowledge.and from material point of view RIZQ is every thing that digests in stomach to become nutrition.and RIZQ means also    rain.as    ALLAH said
Surat Adh-Dhāriyāt (The Winnowing Winds) - سورة الذاريات
51:22
وَفِي السَّمَاءِ رِزْقُكُمْ وَمَا تُوعَدُونَ
And in the heaven is your provision and whatever you are promised.
so every thing that implicity or explicitly, causes spiritual or physical nutrition or training is RIZQ.ALLAH said
Surat Yūsuf (Joseph) - سورة يوسف
12:37
قَالَ لَا يَأْتِيكُمَا طَعَامٌ تُرْزَقَانِهِ إِلَّا نَبَّأْتُكُمَا بِتَأْوِيلِهِ قَبْلَ أَن يَأْتِيَكُمَا ۚ ذَٰلِكُمَا مِمَّا عَلَّمَنِي رَبِّي ۚ إِنِّي تَرَكْتُ مِلَّةَ قَوْمٍ لَّا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِاللَّهِ وَهُم بِالْآخِرَةِ هُمْ كَافِرُونَ
He said, "You will not receive food that is provided to you except that I will inform you of its interpretation before it comes to you. That is from what my Lord has taught me. Indeed, I have left the religion of a people who do not believe in Allah , and they, in the Hereafter, are disbelievers.
16.3 MARA(MA-YA-RA)  :MAYR مَيْر meaing food-diet and MIYARAHمِيَرَة meaning stored food. plural MIYR and MARA and AMAARA 3AYALUHU اَمَارَ عَيَالُهُ meaning to bring food for familiy.and MA-IR مَائِر and MAYYAR مَيَّار meaning the one who brings food.so MAYR is that edible stuff which is kept as stored.In the QURAN
Surat Yūsuf (Joseph) - سورة يوسف
12:65
وَلَمَّا فَتَحُوا مَتَاعَهُمْ وَجَدُوا بِضَاعَتَهُمْ رُدَّتْ إِلَيْهِمْ ۖ قَالُوا يَا أَبَانَا مَا نَبْغِي ۖ هَٰذِهِ بِضَاعَتُنَا رُدَّتْ إِلَيْنَا ۖ وَنَمِيرُ أَهْلَنَا وَنَحْفَظُ أَخَانَا وَنَزْدَادُ كَيْلَ بَعِيرٍ ۖ ذَٰلِكَ كَيْلٌ يَسِيرٌ
And when they opened their baggage, they found their merchandise returned to them. They said, "O our father, what [more] could we desire? This is our merchandise returned to us. And we will obtain supplies for our family and protect our brother and obtain an increase of a camel's load; that is an easy measurement."
SUMMARY  :
16.1 QUWT:just enough quantity of food ,for living being to live off.
16.2 RIZQ:every thing that implicitly or explicitly causes spiritual or physical training.
16.3 MARA(MA-YA-RA):grains or edible stu that is for storage.and MARA meaning to bring food.

Surat Yūsuf (Joseph) - سورة يوسف

12:65

وَلَمَّا فَتَحُوا مَتَاعَهُمْ وَجَدُوا بِضَاعَتَهُمْ رُدَّتْ إِلَيْهِمْ ۖ قَالُوا يَا أَبَانَا مَا نَبْغِي ۖ هَٰذِهِ بِضَاعَتُنَا رُدَّتْ إِلَيْنَا ۖ وَنَمِيرُ أَهْلَنَا وَنَحْفَظُ أَخَانَا وَنَزْدَادُ كَيْلَ بَعِيرٍ ۖ ذَٰلِكَ كَيْلٌ يَسِيرٌ

And when they opened their baggage, they found their merchandise returned to them. They said, "O our father, what [more] could we desire? This is our merchandise returned to us. 18 KHWSH HALIY [Prosperity]
SYNONYMS:SARRA- سَرَّاء NA3MA- نَعْمَاءTUBA طُوبَي
18.1 SARRA-  : antonym is DARRA- ضَرَّاء which means poverty and period of suffering.and SARRAAA-I means that time which passes with peace and comfort.and also absence of financial constraint. meaning such an era of convenience and peace and prosperity in which delight/joy is obtained.ALLAH said
Surat 'Āli `Imrān (Family of Imran) - سورة آل عمران
3:134
الَّذِينَ يُنفِقُونَ فِي السَّرَّاءِ وَالضَّرَّاءِ وَالْكَاظِمِينَ الْغَيْظَ وَالْعَافِينَ عَنِ النَّاسِ ۗ وَاللَّهُ يُحِبُّ الْمُحْسِنِينَ
Who spend [in the cause of Allah ] during ease and hardship and who restrain anger and who pardon the people - and Allah loves the doers of good;
18.2 NA3MAAA-نَعْمآء-  :NI3MATنِعْمَت meaning good state,good and NA3MATنََعْمَت meaning comfort and luxury and NI3MAT meaning benefit ,grace-AN3AM and NA3MAT meaning betterment-convenience-wealth-cattle and NU3MAH نُعْمَةmeaning happiness,and NU3MAAA- is such a period of prosperity in which there is excess of divine blssings.and those blessings would be seen by others as well.its antonym is DARRAA-. ALLAH said
Surat Hūd (Hud) - سورة هود
11:10
وَلَئِنْ أَذَقْنَاهُ نَعْمَاءَ بَعْدَ ضَرَّاءَ مَسَّتْهُ لَيَقُولَنَّ ذَهَبَ السَّيِّئَاتُ عَنِّي ۚ إِنَّهُ لَفَرِحٌ فَخُورٌ
But if We give him a taste of favor after hardship has touched him, he will surely say, "Bad times have left me." Indeed, he is exultant and boastful -
18.3 TUBA  :TABA طَابَ meaning to obtain such a joy which is enjoyed by heart as well as the other senses of the human as well. and TAYYIB طَيِّب meaning purt and TIYB طِيْب meaning fragrance. and TUBA طُوبَي meaning such a prosperity in which heart is satisfied and joyful as well.ALLAH said
Surat Ar-Ra`d (The Thunder) - سورة الرعد
13:29
الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ طُوبَىٰ لَهُمْ وَحُسْنُ مَآبٍ
Those who have believed and done righteous deeds - a good state is theirs and a good return.
SUMMARY  :
18.1 SARRA-:peace and bliss and normal living
18.2 NA3MA-:excess of blessing and comfort and luxury
18.3 TUBA:when along with prosperity, heart is also satisfied

raw_text:
19- Bunches
For bunches, 1. (talaa'), 2. (qutoof) and 3. (qinwaan) are used in the Quran.
1. Talaa':
The literal meaning of talaa' is to appear, to show, to be seen.
This word is frequently used for stars. It is also used for a cluster which begins to appear from the spathe (a
large sheathing bract enclosing the flower cluster)
of a date palm. (Munjad). Allah says in the Quran:
وَالنَّخْلَ بَاسِقَاتٍ لَهَا طَلْعٌ نَضِيدٌ
And tall date-palms, with ranged clusters; (50:10)
2. Qutoof:
This is the plural of qitaf, and refers to the ripe fruit ready for picking. Words of the Quran give an evidence of this, whereas fellows of Munjad translate this as 'picked fruit or cluster of grapes that is picked.' Allah says in the Quran:
فَهُوَ فِي عِيشَةٍ رَاضِيَةٍ فِي جَنَّةٍ عَالِيَةٍ قُطُوفُهَا دَانِيَةٌ
So he shall be in a life, well-pleasing.In a lofty Paradise, the fruits in bunches whereof will be low and near at hand. (69:21-23)
which makes it clear that the fruit is ripe, ready to be picked from the trees, as Allah used the word 'qutoof' in the ayah above.
3. Qinwaan:
This is the plural of 'qinu' and this word is associated only with the bunches of grapes and dates which is unripe yet. Allah says in the Quran:
وَمِنَ النَّخْلِ مِنْ طَلْعِهَا قِنْوَانٌ دَانِيَةٌ
And out of the date-palm and its spathe come forth clusters of dates hanging low and near (6:99)
Conclusion: The word talaa' is used for the fruit that appears from the spathe, the word qitaf is used for the ripe fruit ready to be picked from the tree and the stage in between refers to qinu. However, qinu is only used for the clusters of dates and grapes.
For bloodshed, see "to kill".

raw_text:
2 KHABR [News]
SYNONYMS:KHABARA خَبَرَ KHUBR خُبْر NABA-نَبَاْ
2.1 KHABAR  :(plural AKHBAR اخبار) is a famous word.such an even which a human doesn't know of .and he gets informed from some other source is KHABR. the knowledge of condition/affair/news of surrounding.In the QURAN
Surat Al-Qaşaş (The Stories) - سورة القصص
Flash movie
28:29
فَلَمَّا قَضَىٰ مُوسَى الْأَجَلَ وَسَارَ بِأَهْلِهِ آنَسَ مِن جَانِبِ الطُّورِ نَارًا قَالَ لِأَهْلِهِ امْكُثُوا إِنِّي آنَسْتُ نَارًا لَّعَلِّي آتِيكُم مِّنْهَا بِخَبَرٍ أَوْ جَذْوَةٍ مِّنَ النَّارِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَصْطَلُونَ
And when Moses had completed the term and was traveling with his family, he perceived from the direction of the mount a fire. He said to his family, "Stay here; indeed, I have perceived a fire. Perhaps I will bring you from there [some] information or burning wood from the fire that you may warm yourselves."
another place
Surat At-Tawbah (The Repentance) - سورة التوبة
9:94
يَعْتَذِرُونَ إِلَيْكُمْ إِذَا رَجَعْتُمْ إِلَيْهِمْ ۚ قُل لَّا تَعْتَذِرُوا لَن نُّؤْمِنَ لَكُمْ قَدْ نَبَّأَنَا اللَّهُ مِنْ أَخْبَارِكُمْ ۚ وَسَيَرَى اللَّهُ عَمَلَكُمْ وَرَسُولُهُ ثُمَّ تُرَدُّونَ إِلَىٰ عَالِمِ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ فَيُنَبِّئُكُم بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
They will make excuses to you when you have returned to them. Say, "Make no excuse - never will we believe you. Allah has already informed us of your news. And Allah will observe your deeds, and [so will] His Messenger; then you will be taken back to the Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, and He will inform you of what you used to do."
2.2 KHUBR  :the knowledge of reality of some event.experiment,insight.It is said SADDAQA ALKHABRA ALKHUBR(صَدَّقَ الْخَبْرَ الْخُبْرَ)-experiment and observation verified the news heard.In the QURAN.
Surat Al-Kahf (The Cave) - سورة الكهف
18:68
وَكَيْفَ تَصْبِرُ عَلَىٰ مَا لَمْ تُحِطْ بِهِ خُبْرًا
And how can you have patience for what you do not encompass in knowledge?"
2.3 NABA-  :relevant news about some important matter.specially such news which is relevant also to the one listening news.and whether this news relates to past events or from future event.In the QURAN
Surat Al-Ĥujurāt (The Rooms) - سورة الحجرات
49:6
يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا إِن جَاءَكُمْ فَاسِقٌ بِنَبَإٍ فَتَبَيَّنُوا أَن تُصِيبُوا قَوْمًا بِجَهَالَةٍ فَتُصْبِحُوا عَلَىٰ مَا فَعَلْتُمْ نَادِمِينَ
O you who have believed, if there comes to you a disobedient one with information, investigate, lest you harm a people out of ignorance and become, over what you have done, regretful.
SUMMARY:
following are the differences between KHABR and NABA
a) KHABR is common,NABA is particular.-NABA is that KHABR which is pertinent to the listener and it can effect him.

20- Breech of trust
For breech of trust, the words kha-na and ghalla have been used
1. Kha-na:
It means breech of trust and its antonym is to deposit. Breech of trust can be of promises as well as in embezzlement of deposited money, if all or some of it is stolen by fraud or confiscation. Similarly,it is used for breaking promises. To deceive.
These can be clarified from the following ayah:
يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لَا تَخُونُوا اللَّـهَ وَالرَّسُولَ وَتَخُونُوا أَمَانَاتِكُمْ
O you who believe! Betray not Allah and His Messenger, nor betray knowingly your   Amanat   (things entrusted to you, and all the duties which Allah has ordained for you). (8:27)
also see "to cheat"
2. Ghalla:
This means to hide a stolen property among your things or to pack it in a manner that it can not be seen (Munjad, M.L.)
Page 472-474
..continuation from page 471..
and غلول is used in the context of breaking trust, closing, and miserliness. Therefore, there is an element of burglary along with breech of trust in   غَلَّ   or the means of breech of trust were burglary.
وَمَا كَانَ لِنَبِيٍّ أَنْ يَغُلَّ   ۚ   وَمَنْ يَغْلُلْ يَأْتِ بِمَا غَلَّ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ
It is not for any Prophet to take illegally a part of booty (  Ghulul  ), and whosoever deceives his companions as regards the booty, he shall bring forth on the Day of Resurrection that which he took (illegally). (3:161)
Conclusion:
خََان is used in the breaking of promises or embezzlement of money by deception or fraud whereas غَلَّ has an element of burglary in the breech of trust.

21. Shelter
For shelter, (i) خيَام, (ii) ظُلَّة and (iii) سُرَادِق
(i) خيَام
It is the plural of   خیمہ. It refers to a tent that is made out of thick cloth or mat to keep shelter from rain or sun. These have a slope instead of a proper rooftop. Followers of Munjid refer it to as any tent which is not made up of bricks, stones or clay. خیمہ is also a camel's seat or saddle. Allah says in the Quran:
حُورٌ مَقْصُورَاتٌ فِي الْخِيَامِ
Houris   (beautiful, fair females) restrained in pavilions (55:72)
(ii) ظُلَّة
This is a shelter which has a rooftop but no walls. This word is also used for an umbrella.   ظلِيل is a tree with big canopy (Munjid). ظِلّ means shadow and ظِلّاً ظلِيلَاً refers to as long and thick shadows.   Allah says in the Quran:
وَإِذْ نَتَقْنَا الْجَبَلَ فَوْقَهُمْ كَأَنَّهُ ظُلَّةٌ
And (remember) when We raised the mountain over them as if it had been a canopy, (7:171)
(iii) سُرَادِق
This is a plural of   سردق and this word is derived from Persian. It is a tent, normally used at weddings, which has only walls, but no roof.   Allah says in the Quran:
إِنَّا أَعْتَدْنَا لِلظَّالِمِينَ نَارًا أَحَاطَ بِهِمْ سُرَادِقُهَا
Verily, We have prepared for the   Zalimun   (polytheists and wrong-doers, etc.), a Fire whose walls will be surrounding them (disbelievers in the Oneness of Allah). (18:29)
22. To enter:
The words used for entering are (i)   دَخَلَ and اَدخَلَ, (ii) وَلَجَ and اَولَجَ, (iii) صَلى and صَلّى, and (iv) سَلَكَ.
(i) دَخَلَ
This is a commonly used word, meaning to enter. Its opposite is خَرَجَ, meaning to go out. Allah says in the Quran:
وَدَخَلَ مَعَهُ السِّجْنَ فَتَيَانِ
And there entered with him two young men in the prison. (12:36)
Another word used for entering (passive) is   اَدخَلَ. Allah says in the Quran:
يُّدْخِلُ مَنْ يَّشَاءُ فِيْ رَحْمَتِه
He will admit to His Mercy whom He will (76:31)
(ii) وَلَجَ
الولولج is the word used when you enter a narrow or confined space (M.F.) or to enter with difficulty. Allah says in the Quran:
وَلَا يَدْخُلُوْنَ الْجَنَّةَ حَتّٰي يَلِجَ الْجَمَلُ فِيْ سَمِّ الْخِيَاطِ
and they will not enter Paradise until the camel goes through the eye of the needle (which is impossible) (7:41)
اَولَجَ is used to make someone enter with difficulty (used passively) Allah says in the Quran:
يُولِجُ اللَّيْلَ فِي النَّهَارِ وَيُولِجُ النَّهَارَ فِي اللَّيْلِ
That is because Allah merges the night into the day, and He merges the day into the night. And verily, Allah is All-Hearer, All-Seer. (22:61)
(iii) صَلى
This word is used specifically for fire, to fall into fire and burn (M.F.). Allah says in the Quran:
جَهَنَّمَ يَصْلَوْنَهَا   ۖ   وَبِئْسَ الْقَرَارُ
Hell, in which they will burn, - and what an evil place to settle in! (14:29)
Similarly, صَلّى is used for throwing into fire.
Allah says in the Quran:
خُذُوهُ فَغُلُّوهُثُمَّ الْجَحِيمَ صَلُّوهُ
(It will be said): "Seize him and fetter him, then throw him in the blazing Fire. (69:30-31)
(iv) سَلَكَ
This word has multiple meanings, both in imperative and optional meanings, all of which mean'to enter'.
1. It means to insert, like inserting thread into a bead. Allah says in the Quran:
كَذَٰلِكَ سَلَكْنَاهُ فِي قُلُوبِ الْمُجْرِمِينَ
Thus have We caused it (the denial of the Qur'an) to enter the hearts of the   Mujrimun   (criminals, polytheists, sinners, etc.). (26:200)
2. To enter as in the famous urdu idiomگریبان میں ہاتھ ڈالنا (putting one's hand in one's bosom). Allah says in the Quran:
اسْلُكْ يَدَكَ فِي جَيْبِكَ تَخْرُجْ بَيْضَاءَ مِنْ غَيْرِ سُوءٍ
Put your hand in your bosom, it will come forth white without a disease (28:32)
A similar ayah is used with the word وَأَدْخِلْ at another place:
وَأَدْخِلْ يَدَكَ فِي جَيْبِكَ تَخْرُجْ بَيْضَاءَ مِنْ غَيْرِ سُوءٍ
And put your hand into your bosom, it will come forth white without hurt. (27:12)
3. To go along with the way. Allah addresses honey bee in the Quran:
فَاسْلُكِي سُبُلَ رَبِّكِ ذُلُلًا   ۚ
follow the ways of your Lord made easy (for you). (16:69)
Allah also says in the Quran:
مَا سَلَكَكُمْ فِي سَقَرَ
"What has caused you to enter Hell?" (74:42)
Followers of Muntahi Al-arb translate   سَلَكَ as pulling one thing from between the second. Followers of Munjid translate it as keeping one thing between the other. Followers of   Maqaayeesul-lughat give the following two meanings: 1) to go along the way and 2) to insert.
Conclusion:
(i)   دَخَلَ is commonly used for entering
(ii) وَلَجَ is to enter into a confined space
(iii) صَلى to enter the fire
(iv) سَلَكَ to make one thing enter through the second.

3 KHATAM HUWNA [To be finished]
SYNONYMS:NAFAD نفد KHATAM ختم
3.1 NAFADA  :some thing being finished,goes out of existence.-to annihilate- and its antonym is BAQIYA بَقِيَ in the QURAN.
Surat An-Naĥl (The Bee) - سورة النحل
16:96
مَا عِندَكُمْ يَنفَدُ ۖ وَمَا عِندَ اللَّهِ بَاقٍ ۗ وَلَنَجْزِيَنَّ الَّذِينَ صَبَرُوا أَجْرَهُم بِأَحْسَنِ مَا كَانُوا يَعْمَلُونَ
Whatever you have will end, but what Allah has is lasting. And We will surely give those who were patient their reward according to the best of what they used to do
3.2 KHATAMA  :To close and then sealed something after it's completion so that it cannot be varied excess or lessen.AAKHIR ALAMR آخر الامر and KHATAM AL3AML ختم العمل meaning to finish some deed and KHATAM ALKITAB ختم الكتاب meaning read entire book.ALLAH said
Surat Al-'Aĥzāb (The Combined Forces) - سورة الأحزاب
33:40
مَّا كَانَ مُحَمَّدٌ أَبَا أَحَدٍ مِّن رِّجَالِكُمْ وَلَٰكِن رَّسُولَ اللَّهِ وَخَاتَمَ النَّبِيِّينَ ۗ وَكَانَ اللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِيمًا
Muhammad is not the father of [any] one of your men, but [he is] the Messenger of Allah and last of the prophets. And ever is Allah , of all things, Knowing.
SUMMARY:
3.1 NAFADA:the actual thing goes out of existence.or gets out of hand.whereas in
3.2 KHATAMA:that thing remains existent yet nothing can be added or taken away from it.

5 KHARABIY [Fault/Mess]
SYNONYMS:KHABALAN(KH-BA-LA)(خَبَالاً (خبل MA3ARRATUN(3A-RA-RA) (مَعَرَّة (عررFASADUN فَسَادٌ
5.1 KHABALAN(KH-BA-LA)  خَبَلَ:KHABL,implies flaw of organs and   limbs.it   is said KHABAL ALHUZNU 3AQLAHU(خَبَلَ الحُزْنُ عَقْلَهُ ) grief has flawed his intellect. KHABALA ALHUBBU 3AQLAHU(خَبَلَ الْحُبُّ عَقَلَهُ) love destroyed his intellect.so KHIBAL is such a flaw which when happen to someone causes him to have unrest and discomfort. like madness or that disease which effects permanently.permanent grief.ALLAH said
Search Tips
Surat 'Āli `Imrān (Family of Imran) - سورة آل عمران
3:118
يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لَا تَتَّخِذُوا بِطَانَةً مِّن دُونِكُمْ لَا يَأْلُونَكُمْ خَبَالًا وَدُّوا مَا عَنِتُّمْ قَدْ بَدَتِ الْبَغْضَاءُ مِنْ أَفْوَاهِهِمْ وَمَا تُخْفِي صُدُورُهُمْ أَكْبَرُ ۚ قَدْ بَيَّنَّا لَكُمُ الْآيَاتِ ۖ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ
O you who have believed, do not take as intimates those other than yourselves, for they will not spare you [any] ruin. They wish you would have hardship. Hatred has already appeared from their mouths, and what their breasts conceal is greater. We have certainly made clear to you the signs, if you will use reason.
5.2 MA3ARRATUN  :said on every type of ailment.3AYYARA عَيَّرَ meaning to have itchines.and MA3ARRAH applies to every type of grief,pain,flaw,harship and insult.and as per ibn al faris MA3ARRAH is such a grief or pain which a human receives owing to some sin or inapt deed. In the QURAN
Search Tips
Surat Al-Fatĥ (The Victory) - سورة الفتح
48:25
هُمُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا وَصَدُّوكُمْ عَنِ الْمَسْجِدِ الْحَرَامِ وَالْهَدْيَ مَعْكُوفًا أَن يَبْلُغَ مَحِلَّهُ ۚ وَلَوْلَا رِجَالٌ مُّؤْمِنُونَ وَنِسَاءٌ مُّؤْمِنَاتٌ لَّمْ تَعْلَمُوهُمْ أَن تَطَئُوهُمْ فَتُصِيبَكُم مِّنْهُم مَّعَرَّةٌ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ ۖ لِّيُدْخِلَ اللَّهُ فِي رَحْمَتِهِ مَن يَشَاءُ ۚ لَوْ تَزَيَّلُوا لَعَذَّبْنَا الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا مِنْهُمْ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًا
They are the ones who disbelieved and obstructed you from al-Masjid al-Haram while the offering was prevented from reaching its place of sacrifice. And if not for believing men and believing women whom you did not know - that you might trample them and there would befall you because of them dishonor without [your] knowledge - [you would have been permitted to enter Makkah]. [This was so] that Allah might admit to His mercy whom He willed. If they had been apart [from them], We would have punished those who disbelieved among them with painful punishment
5.3 FASAD  :(Antonym ISLAH اصلاح)such a flaw which exhibits owing to the excess or shortage of something's limit of moderation.and it cause it to imbalance.In the QURAN
Surat Ar-Rūm (The Romans) - سورة الروم
30:41
ظَهَرَ الْفَسَادُ فِي الْبَرِّ وَالْبَحْرِ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ أَيْدِي النَّاسِ لِيُذِيقَهُم بَعْضَ الَّذِي عَمِلُوا لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ
Corruption has appeared throughout the land and sea by [reason of] what the hands of people have earned so He may let them taste part of [the consequence of] what they have done that perhaps they will return [to righteousness].
SUMMARY  :
5.1 KHABAL:such a flaw which effects organs and limbs-permanent grief
5.2 MA3ARRATUN:such a flaw which results because of happening of some inapt deed
5.3 FASAD:flaw resulting of imbalance in limit of moderation.corruption of society

KHABALA ALHUBBU 3AQLAHU(خَبَلَ الْحُبُّ عَقَلَهُ) love destroyed his intellect.so KHIBAL is such a flaw which when happen to someone causes him to have unrest and discomfort. like madness or that disease which effects permanently.permanent grief.ALLAH said

Surat 'Āli `Imrān (Family of Imran) - سورة آل عمران

3:118

يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لَا تَتَّخِذُوا بِطَانَةً مِّن دُونِكُمْ لَا يَأْلُونَكُمْ خَبَالًا وَدُّوا مَا عَنِتُّمْ قَدْ بَدَتِ الْبَغْضَاءُ مِنْ أَفْوَاهِهِمْ وَمَا تُخْفِي صُدُورُهُمْ أَكْبَرُ ۚ قَدْ بَيَّنَّا لَكُمُ الْآيَاتِ ۖ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ

O you who have believed, do not take as intimates those other than yourselves, for they will not spare you [any] ruin. They wish you would have hardship. Hatred has already appeared from their mouths, and what their breasts conceal is greater. We have certainly made clear to you the signs, if you will use reason.

5.2 MA3ARRATUN:said on every type of ailment.3AYYARA عَيَّرَ meaning to have itchines.and MA3ARRAH applies to every type of grief,pain,flaw,harship and insult.and as per ibn al faris MA3ARRAH is such a grief or pain which a human receives owing to some sin or inapt deed. In the QURAN

5.3 FASAD:(Antonym ISLAH اصلاح)such a flaw which exhibits owing to the excess or shortage of something's limit of moderation.and it cause it to imbalance.In the QURAN

6 KHARAB KARNA-HUWNA [To be messed up-To mess up]
SYNONYMS:KHARIBA خَرِبَAKHRABAاَخْرَبَ FASADA فَسَدَ AFSADA اَفْسَدَ ,i,3ABAعَابَ
AASANAاَسَنَ SANNAسَنَّ SANIHAسَنِهَ
6.1 KHARIBA AKHRABA  :KHARIBA meaning some harvest or building being inhabited,destroyed or unpopulated.ALLAH said
Surat Al-Baqarah (The Cow) - سورة البقرة
2:114
وَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّن مَّنَعَ مَسَاجِدَ اللَّهِ أَن يُذْكَرَ فِيهَا اسْمُهُ وَسَعَىٰ فِي خَرَابِهَا ۚ أُولَٰئِكَ مَا كَانَ لَهُمْ أَن يَدْخُلُوهَا إِلَّا خَائِفِينَ ۚ لَهُمْ فِي الدُّنْيَا خِزْيٌ وَلَهُمْ فِي الْآخِرَةِ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ
And who are more unjust than those who prevent the name of Allah from being mentioned in His mosques and strive toward their destruction. It is not for them to enter them except in fear. For them in this world is disgrace, and they will have in the Hereafter a great punishment.
and AKHRABA(antonym 3AMARA عَمَرَ)meaning to unpopulate some populated   place.to   demolish some   building.to   destroy some harvest.In the QURAN.
Search Tips
Surat Al-Ĥashr (The Exile) - سورة الحشر
59:2
هُوَ الَّذِي أَخْرَجَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا مِنْ أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ مِن دِيَارِهِمْ لِأَوَّلِ الْحَشْرِ ۚ مَا ظَنَنتُمْ أَن يَخْرُجُوا ۖ وَظَنُّوا أَنَّهُم مَّانِعَتُهُمْ حُصُونُهُم مِّنَ اللَّهِ فَأَتَاهُمُ اللَّهُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَمْ يَحْتَسِبُوا ۖ وَقَذَفَ فِي قُلُوبِهِمُ الرُّعْبَ ۚ يُخْرِبُونَ بُيُوتَهُم بِأَيْدِيهِمْ وَأَيْدِي الْمُؤْمِنِينَ فَاعْتَبِرُوا يَا أُولِي الْأَبْصَارِ
It is He who expelled the ones who disbelieved among the People of the Scripture from their homes at the first gathering. You did not think they would leave, and they thought that their fortresses would protect them from Allah ; but [the decree of] Allah came upon them from where they had not expected, and He cast terror into their hearts [so] they destroyed their houses by their [own] hands and the hands of the believers. So take warning, O people of vision.
6.2 FASADA AFSADA  :FASAD meaning corruption(antonym ISLAH)every that thing which is against Shariah whether it related to deeds or beliefs. and FASADA meaning initiation of corruption in something.and AFSADA meaning to mess up and to corrupt.ALLAH said
Surat Al-'A`rāf (The Heights) - سورة الأعراف
7:56
وَلَا تُفْسِدُوا فِي الْأَرْضِ بَعْدَ إِصْلَاحِهَا وَادْعُوهُ خَوْفًا وَطَمَعًا ۚ إِنَّ رَحْمَتَ اللَّهِ قَرِيبٌ مِّنَ الْمُحْسِنِينَ
And cause not corruption upon the earth after its reformation. And invoke Him in fear and aspiration. Indeed, the mercy of Allah is near to the doers of good.
6.3 3ABA  :3YB عيب some fault or flaw of something's shape or form or inside of it.and 3ABA meaning to flaw something or to fault it.whether living or non living. whether speech or action it applies in all aspects.ALLAH said
Surat Al-Kahf (The Cave) - سورة الكهف
18:79
أَمَّا السَّفِينَةُ فَكَانَتْ لِمَسَاكِينَ يَعْمَلُونَ فِي الْبَحْرِ فَأَرَدتُّ أَنْ أَعِيبَهَا وَكَانَ وَرَاءَهُم مَّلِكٌ يَأْخُذُ كُلَّ سَفِينَةٍ غَصْبًا
As for the ship, it belonged to poor people working at sea. So I intended to cause defect in it as there was after them a king who seized every [good] ship by force.
6.4 AASANA  :ASANA ALMA-U(اَسَنَ ألمَاءُ) meaning water smelling bad owing to variation.and ASIN ARRAJUL(اسِنَ الرُّجُل) meaning feeling dizzy or being unconscious owing to entering well of stale water.so word ASANA is used for water being stale,varied,foul smelled. ALLAH said
Surat Muĥammad (Muhammad) - سورة محمد
47:15
مَّثَلُ الْجَنَّةِ الَّتِي وُعِدَ الْمُتَّقُونَ ۖ فِيهَا أَنْهَارٌ مِّن مَّاءٍ غَيْرِ آسِنٍ وَأَنْهَارٌ مِّن لَّبَنٍ لَّمْ يَتَغَيَّرْ طَعْمُهُ وَأَنْهَارٌ مِّنْ خَمْرٍ لَّذَّةٍ لِّلشَّارِبِينَ وَأَنْهَارٌ مِّنْ عَسَلٍ مُّصَفًّى ۖ وَلَهُمْ فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ الثَّمَرَاتِ وَمَغْفِرَةٌ مِّن رَّبِّهِمْ ۖ كَمَنْ هُوَ خَالِدٌ فِي النَّارِ وَسُقُوا مَاءً حَمِيمًا فَقَطَّعَ أَمْعَاءَهُمْ
Is the description of Paradise, which the righteous are promised, wherein are rivers of water unaltered, rivers of milk the taste of which never changes, rivers of wine delicious to those who drink, and rivers of purified honey, in which they will have from all [kinds of] fruits and forgiveness from their Lord, like [that of] those who abide eternally in the Fire and are given to drink scalding water that will sever their intestines?
6.5 SANNA  :SINNسِنّ meaning teeth as well as age.and SUNNAHسُنَّة meaning method-tradition.and SANNA SUNNAHسَنَّ سُنَّة meaning he establish or enforce the method.so word SANNA contains the concept of period and perpetuity.and MASNUWN مَسْنُوْن is that thing which after passing of some time becomes flawed or foul smelled.yet this word is used commonly for mud etc. ALLAH said
Surat Al-Ĥijr (The Rocky Tract) - سورة الحجر
15:26
وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا الْإِنسَانَ مِن صَلْصَالٍ مِّنْ حَمَإٍ مَّسْنُونٍ
And We did certainly create man out of clay from an altered black mud.
6.6 SANIHA  :meaning of many years.SANIHA ATTA3AM WASHSHARAB( سَنِهَ الطَّعَام و الشَّرَاب) meaning staling of food   water.to   be abnormal.and TASANNAHA ALKHUBR(تَسَنَّهَ الْخُبزُ) meaning stale bread- to be foul smell.ALLAH said
Surat Al-Baqarah (The Cow) - سورة البقرة
2:259
أَوْ كَالَّذِي مَرَّ عَلَىٰ قَرْيَةٍ وَهِيَ خَاوِيَةٌ عَلَىٰ عُرُوشِهَا قَالَ أَنَّىٰ يُحْيِي هَٰذِهِ اللَّهُ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَا ۖ فَأَمَاتَهُ اللَّهُ مِائَةَ عَامٍ ثُمَّ بَعَثَهُ ۖ قَالَ كَمْ لَبِثْتَ ۖ قَالَ لَبِثْتُ يَوْمًا أَوْ بَعْضَ يَوْمٍ ۖ قَالَ بَل لَّبِثْتَ مِائَةَ عَامٍ فَانظُرْ إِلَىٰ طَعَامِكَ وَشَرَابِكَ لَمْ يَتَسَنَّهْ ۖ وَانظُرْ إِلَىٰ حِمَارِكَ وَلِنَجْعَلَكَ آيَةً لِّلنَّاسِ ۖ وَانظُرْ إِلَى الْعِظَامِ كَيْفَ نُنشِزُهَا ثُمَّ نَكْسُوهَا لَحْمًا ۚ فَلَمَّا تَبَيَّنَ لَهُ قَالَ أَعْلَمُ أَنَّ اللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
Or [consider such an example] as the one who passed by a township which had fallen into ruin. He said, "How will Allah bring this to life after its death?" So Allah caused him to die for a hundred years; then He revived him. He said, "How long have you remained?" The man said, "I have remained a day or part of a day." He said, "Rather, you have remained one hundred years. Look at your food and your drink; it has not changed with time. And look at your donkey; and We will make you a sign for the people. And look at the bones [of this donkey] - how We raise them and then We cover them with flesh." And when it became clear to him, he said, "I know that Allah is over all things competent."
SUMMARY:
6.1 KHARIB:house-place or harvest being unpopulated or messed up
6.2 FASAD:corruption in deeds or beliefs
6.3 3ABA:to corrupt something in its self/nature
6.4 AASANA:water smelling foul owing to being stale
6.5 SANNA:things that get bad after passing of long period.
6.6 SANIHA:for foul smelling of eatables and drinkables

7 KHARACH KARNA [To Spend]
SYNONYMS:ANFAQAاَنْفَقَ ASRAFAاَسْرَفَ BAZZARAبَذَّرَ BAKHILAبَخِلَ AQTARAاَقْتَرَ AHLAKAاَهْلَكَ
7.1 ANFAQA  :common word for spending.commonly used in the meaning for spending cash or wealth.yet it includes this concept that wealth comes from one side and get spend on the other.NAFQنفق is that tunnel whose both ends are open.and NYFQ ASSRAWYLنيفق السّراويل is the part where thread to tie goes around pajama.and NAFAQA ALYARBU3U WA NAFAQA(نَافَقَ الْيَرْبُوْعُ ونَفَقَ) meanign wild mice entered one end of its place and left from the other end.and in Shariah terminology NIFAQنفاق is that method in which a human enters islam from one path and leaves from the other.ALLAH said
Surat Al-Munāfiqūn (The Hypocrites) - سورة المنافقون
63:10
وَأَنفِقُوا مِن مَّا رَزَقْنَاكُم مِّن قَبْلِ أَن يَأْتِيَ أَحَدَكُمُ الْمَوْتُ فَيَقُولَ رَبِّ لَوْلَا أَخَّرْتَنِي إِلَىٰ أَجَلٍ قَرِيبٍ فَأَصَّدَّقَ وَأَكُن مِّنَ الصَّالِحِينَ
And spend [in the way of Allah ] from what We have provided you before death approaches one of you and he says, "My Lord, if only You would delay me for a brief term so I would give charity and be among the righteous."
7.2 BAKHILA 7.3 AQTARA   please see BUKHL KARNA [To Miser]
7.4 ASRAFA 7.5 BAZZARA   please see FAZOOL KHARCHI KARNA [To Spend Thrift]
7.6 AHLAKA  :its real meaning is to kill something-to destroy-or to annihilate.and when it refers to wealth then it means to spend all of wealth.and this implies spending wealth at bad/evil places. ALLAH said
Surat Al-Balad (The City) - سورة البلد
90:6
يَقُولُ أَهْلَكْتُ مَالًا لُّبَدًا
He says, "I have spent wealth in abundance."
SUMMARY:
7.1 ANFAQA:common word for spending.
7.2 BAKHILA:to not spend or spend less even on legit needs
7.3 AQTARA:to be stingy in providence of bread and butter of one's family
7.4 ASRAFA:to spend more than need
7.5 BAZZARA:to spend without need and without limit
7.6 AHLAKA:to spend lots of wealth for deplorable objectives

8 KHARYD WA FRWKHT KARNA [To Buy n Sell]
SYNONYMS:BA3Aبَاعَ TABAYA3Aتَبَايَعَ SHARAشَرَي ISHTARAاِشْتَرَي TIJARAHتِجَارة
8.1 BA3A TABAYA3A  :(BAY3 بيع)meaning buying as well as selling.meaning to transact.this word is from intrinsic antonym (for details please see appendix 3) and word ABTA3 ابتاع comes in the meaning of buying.but this word is not used in the QURAN. in normal usage BA-3بائع is the seller.and BAAYA3بَايَع meaning to contract-to pledge on hand and to also to transact among each other.and TABAYA3 meaning to buy n sell or transact among each other.ALLAH said

Surat Al-Baqarah (The Cow) - سورة البقرة
2:282
يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا إِذَا تَدَايَنتُم بِدَيْنٍ إِلَىٰ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى فَاكْتُبُوهُ ۚ وَلْيَكْتُب بَّيْنَكُمْ كَاتِبٌ بِالْعَدْلِ ۚ وَلَا يَأْبَ كَاتِبٌ أَن يَكْتُبَ كَمَا عَلَّمَهُ اللَّهُ ۚ فَلْيَكْتُبْ وَلْيُمْلِلِ الَّذِي عَلَيْهِ الْحَقُّ وَلْيَتَّقِ اللَّهَ رَبَّهُ وَلَا يَبْخَسْ مِنْهُ شَيْئًا ۚ فَإِن كَانَ الَّذِي عَلَيْهِ الْحَقُّ سَفِيهًا أَوْ ضَعِيفًا أَوْ لَا يَسْتَطِيعُ أَن يُمِلَّ هُوَ فَلْيُمْلِلْ وَلِيُّهُ بِالْعَدْلِ ۚ وَاسْتَشْهِدُوا شَهِيدَيْنِ مِن رِّجَالِكُمْ ۖ فَإِن لَّمْ يَكُونَا رَجُلَيْنِ فَرَجُلٌ وَامْرَأَتَانِ مِمَّن تَرْضَوْنَ مِنَ الشُّهَدَاءِ أَن تَضِلَّ إِحْدَاهُمَا فَتُذَكِّرَ إِحْدَاهُمَا الْأُخْرَىٰ ۚ وَلَا يَأْبَ الشُّهَدَاءُ إِذَا مَا دُعُوا ۚ وَلَا تَسْأَمُوا أَن تَكْتُبُوهُ صَغِيرًا أَوْ كَبِيرًا إِلَىٰ أَجَلِهِ ۚ ذَٰلِكُمْ أَقْسَطُ عِندَ اللَّهِ وَأَقْوَمُ لِلشَّهَادَةِ وَأَدْنَىٰ أَلَّا تَرْتَابُوا ۖ إِلَّا أَن تَكُونَ تِجَارَةً حَاضِرَةً تُدِيرُونَهَا بَيْنَكُمْ فَلَيْسَ عَلَيْكُمْ جُنَاحٌ أَلَّا تَكْتُبُوهَا ۗ   وَأَشْهِدُوا إِذَا تَبَايَعْتُمْ   ۚ وَلَا يُضَارَّ كَاتِبٌ وَلَا شَهِيدٌ ۚ وَإِن تَفْعَلُوا فَإِنَّهُ فُسُوقٌ بِكُمْ ۗ وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ ۖ وَيُعَلِّمُكُمُ اللَّهُ ۗ وَاللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِيمٌ
O you who have believed, when you contract a debt for a specified term, write it down. And let a scribe write [it] between you in justice. Let no scribe refuse to write as Allah has taught him. So let him write and let the one who has the obligation dictate. And let him fear Allah , his Lord, and not leave anything out of it. But if the one who has the obligation is of limited understanding or weak or unable to dictate himself, then let his guardian dictate in justice. And bring to witness two witnesses from among your men. And if there are not two men [available], then a man and two women from those whom you accept as witnesses - so that if one of the women errs, then the other can remind her. And let not the witnesses refuse when they are called upon. And do not be [too] weary to write it, whether it is small or large, for its [specified] term. That is more just in the sight of Allah and stronger as evidence and more likely to prevent doubt between you, except when it is an immediate transaction which you conduct among yourselves. For [then] there is no blame upon you if you do not write it.   And take witnesses when you conclude a contract  . Let no scribe be harmed or any witness. For if you do so, indeed, it is [grave] disobedience in you. And fear Allah . And Allah teaches you. And Allah is Knowing of all things.
8.2 SHARA  :like BY3 , SHRAشري is also from intrinsic antonym. and is used in both meaning of buying and selling.(please see appendix3).but ISHTARA is peculiar to buying.and MUSHTARAمشتري is the buyer.ALLAH said
Surat At-Tawbah (The Repentance) - سورة التوبة
9:111
إِنَّ اللَّهَ اشْتَرَىٰ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ أَنفُسَهُمْ وَأَمْوَالَهُم بِأَنَّ لَهُمُ الْجَنَّةَ ۚ يُقَاتِلُونَ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ فَيَقْتُلُونَ وَيُقْتَلُونَ ۖ وَعْدًا عَلَيْهِ حَقًّا فِي التَّوْرَاةِ وَالْإِنجِيلِ وَالْقُرْآنِ ۚ وَمَنْ أَوْفَىٰ بِعَهْدِهِ مِنَ اللَّهِ ۚ فَاسْتَبْشِرُوا بِبَيْعِكُمُ الَّذِي بَايَعْتُم بِهِ ۚ وَذَٰلِكَ هُوَ الْفَوْزُ الْعَظِيمُ
Indeed, Allah has purchased from the believers their lives and their properties [in exchange] for that they will have Paradise. They fight in the cause of Allah , so they kill and are killed. [It is] a true promise [binding] upon Him in the Torah and the Gospel and the Qur'an. And who is truer to his covenant than Allah ? So rejoice in your transaction which you have contracted. And it is that which is the great attainment.
8.3 TIJARAH  :word TAJARA(تَجَرَ) is used in both meaning of buying and selling but in it buying and selling, the actual intent is to make profit.whereas in BY3 and SHRA this implies obtaining some other intent .ALLAH said
Surat Al-Baqarah (The Cow) - سورة البقرة
2:16
أُولَٰئِكَ الَّذِينَ اشْتَرَوُا الضَّلَالَةَ بِالْهُدَىٰ فَمَا رَبِحَت تِّجَارَتُهُمْ وَمَا كَانُوا مُهْتَدِينَ
Those are the ones who have purchased error [in exchange] for guidance, so their transaction has brought no profit, nor were they guided.
SUMMARY  :
8.1 BA3A:to buy and sell.where intent is to fullfil personal need.and in common terms BA-3 is the seller
8.2 SHARA:to buy and sell where intent is to fullfil personal need.yet ISHTARA comes for buying.
8.3 TAJARA:to buy and sell where actual intent is profit making.

9 KHAZANA [Treasure]
SYNONYMS:QINTARقِنْطَار KANZكَنْز KHAZA-IN خَزَائِن
9.1 QINTAR  :huge quantity of gold,silver or cash(plural is قناطير QANATIYR).as per Sahib Fiqh Allugha this quantity is 4000 DIYNARدينار or more than than.or 12000 AWQIYAH اوقيه. In the QURAN.
Surat 'Āli `Imrān (Family of Imran) - سورة آل عمران
3:75
وَمِنْ أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ مَنْ إِن تَأْمَنْهُ بِقِنطَارٍ يُؤَدِّهِ إِلَيْكَ وَمِنْهُم مَّنْ إِن تَأْمَنْهُ بِدِينَارٍ لَّا يُؤَدِّهِ إِلَيْكَ إِلَّا مَا دُمْتَ عَلَيْهِ قَائِمًا ۗ ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ قَالُوا لَيْسَ عَلَيْنَا فِي الْأُمِّيِّينَ سَبِيلٌ وَيَقُولُونَ عَلَى اللَّهِ الْكَذِبَ وَهُمْ يَعْلَمُونَ
And among the People of the Scripture is he who, if you entrust him with a great amount [of wealth], he will return it to you. And among them is he who, if you entrust him with a [single] silver coin, he will not return it to you unless you are constantly standing over him [demanding it]. That is because they say, "There is no blame upon us concerning the unlearned." And they speak untruth about Allah while they know [it].
9.2 KANZ  :(plural KANWZ كنوز)such a gathered wealth which is hidden from people whether in the buried form or by some other  means.as   per ibn al faris every such wealth which is sealed.and KANZ ALMAL كَنْزَ المال meaning gathered wealth-buried. In the QURAN.
Surat Al-Kahf (The Cave) - سورة الكهف
18:82
وَأَمَّا الْجِدَارُ فَكَانَ لِغُلَامَيْنِ يَتِيمَيْنِ فِي الْمَدِينَةِ وَكَانَ تَحْتَهُ كَنزٌ لَّهُمَا وَكَانَ أَبُوهُمَا صَالِحًا فَأَرَادَ رَبُّكَ أَن يَبْلُغَا أَشُدَّهُمَا وَيَسْتَخْرِجَا كَنزَهُمَا رَحْمَةً مِّن رَّبِّكَ ۚ وَمَا فَعَلْتُهُ عَنْ أَمْرِي ۚ ذَٰلِكَ تَأْوِيلُ مَا لَمْ تَسْطِع عَّلَيْهِ صَبْرًا
And as for the wall, it belonged to two orphan boys in the city, and there was beneath it a treasure for them, and their father had been righteous. So your Lord intended that they reach maturity and extract their treasure, as a mercy from your Lord. And I did it not of my own accord. That is the interpretation of that about which you could not have patience."
9.3 KHAZA-IN  :(singular KHAZYNخزين)KHAZYNAخزينه being stored and gathered wealth.storage-store-cash or some other kind.whether hidden or apparent.and there are two basic things in KHAZANAخَزَنَ a) to gather b) to protect.KHAZANTULSIRR خَزَنْتُ الْسِرّ meaning i kept secret secret.and the guard of this gathered wealth is KHAZIN خازن.ALLAH said.
Surat Yūsuf (Joseph) - سورة يوسف
12:55
قَالَ اجْعَلْنِي عَلَىٰ خَزَائِنِ الْأَرْضِ ۖ إِنِّي حَفِيظٌ عَلِيمٌ
[Joseph] said, "Appoint me over the storehouses of the land. Indeed, I will be a knowing guardian."
SUMMARY:
9.1 QINTAR:huge quantity of wealth
9.2 KANZ:concealed gathered wealth
9.3 KHAZA-IN:storage or pile of some kind or cash whose protection is taken care of.

1 LAATHI
[Staff, stick]
Synonyms: A’SA(  عصا  )(A’SU)(   عصو  ), MINSA’TA(  منساءة   )(NISA’)(   نساء  )
1.1 a’sa(  عصا  )  : meaning the staff of a shepherd, a baton. It is stated in the Quran:
________________
Surat Al-Araf (The Heights) -   سُوۡرَةُ الاٴعرَاف
7:107
فَأَلۡقَىٰ عَصَاهُ فَإِذَا هِىَ ثُعۡبَانٌ۬ مُّبِينٌ۬
Then he flung down his staff and lo! it was a serpent manifest;
________________
1.2 minsa’ta (  منساءة  )  : the stick of a patient or elderly. It is stated in the Quran:
________________
Surat Saba  -   سُوۡرَةُ سَبَإ
34:14
مَا دَلَّهُمۡ عَلَىٰ مَوۡتِهِۦۤ إِلَّا دَآبَّةُ ٱلۡأَرۡضِ تَأۡڪُلُ مِنسَأَتَهُۖ ۥ
And when We decreed death for him, nothing showed his death to them save a creeping creature of the earth which gnawed away his staff.   And when he fell the jinn saw clearly how, if they had known the Unseen, they would not have continued in despised toil.
________________
And that type of stick, one end of which is twisted is called mihjan(  محجن  ). The ends of a’sa(  عصا  ) and minsa’ta(  منساءة  ) are not twisted. A’sa(  عصا  ) is a thick and strong stick and minsa’ta(  منساءة  ) is a relatively thin and fine looking stick.
For greed(lalach)(   لالچ  ), see ‘tama rakhna’(  طمع ركهنا)  .

10 KITAB [Book]
Synonyms:KITAB كِتَاب ASFAR اَسْفَار SIJIL سِجِل NUSKHA نُسخَة
ZUBUR زُبُر SUHUF صُحُف
10.1 KITAB  :every written thing.letter,book of deeds and in known meaning book( plural KUTUB). In the QURAN
Surat An-Naml (The Ant) - سورة النمل
27:28
اذْهَب بِّكِتَابِي هَٰذَا فَأَلْقِهْ إِلَيْهِمْ ثُمَّ تَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ فَانظُرْ مَاذَا يَرْجِعُونَ
Take this letter of mine and deliver it to them. Then leave them and see what [answer] they will return."
10.2 ASFAR  :(plural of SIFR سِفْر)SIFR meaning big book.a part from parts of Torah.and SUFR سُفْر meaning manifest or to unveil something.and SIFR meaning such a book which unveil the facts/truth. Huge Explanation and Exegesis of Torah.ALLAH said
Surat Al-Jumu`ah (The Congregation, Friday) - سورة الجمعة
62:5
مَثَلُ الَّذِينَ حُمِّلُوا التَّوْرَاةَ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَحْمِلُوهَا كَمَثَلِ الْحِمَارِ يَحْمِلُ أَسْفَارًا ۚ بِئْسَ مَثَلُ الْقَوْمِ الَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا بِآيَاتِ اللَّهِ ۚ وَاللَّهُ لَا يَهْدِي الْقَوْمَ الظَّالِمِينَ
The example of those who were entrusted with the Torah and then did not take it on is like that of a donkey who carries volumes [of books]. Wretched is the example of the people who deny the signs of Allah . And Allah does not guide the wrongdoing people.
10.3 SIJIL  : meaning register of contracts.register of order and recording of proceedings which a judge keeps safe in his possession.judicial record.ALLAH said
Surat Al-'Anbyā' (The Prophets) - سورة الأنبياء
21:104
يَوْمَ نَطْوِي السَّمَاءَ كَطَيِّ السِّجِلِّ لِلْكُتُبِ ۚ كَمَا بَدَأْنَا أَوَّلَ خَلْقٍ نُّعِيدُهُ ۚ وَعْدًا عَلَيْنَا ۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا فَاعِلِينَ
The Day when We will fold the heaven like the folding of a [written] sheet for the records. As We began the first creation, We will repeat it. [That is] a promise binding upon Us. Indeed, We will do it.
10.4 NUSKHA  :NASAKHA نَسَخَ meaning to erase-to cancel.and NASAKH ALKITAB نسخ الكتاب meaning to copy a book letter by letter.and NUSKHA is also said to that thing from which is copied.and also that which is copy.every NUSKHA is KITAB but not every KITAB is NUSKHA.
Surat Al-'A`rāf (The Heights) - سورة الأعراف
7:154
وَلَمَّا سَكَتَ عَن مُّوسَى الْغَضَبُ أَخَذَ الْأَلْوَاحَ ۖ وَفِي نُسْخَتِهَا هُدًى وَرَحْمَةٌ لِّلَّذِينَ هُمْ لِرَبِّهِمْ يَرْهَبُونَ
And when the anger subsided in Moses, he took up the tablets; and in their inscription was guidance and mercy for those who are fearful of their Lord.

11 KATRA JANA-BACH KAR NIKAL JANA [To Avoid-To Go Past by Dodge]
Synonyms:ZAWARA زَاوَرَ QARADA قَرَضَ HADA(HA-YA-DA)(حَادَ (حيد)
11.1 ZAWARA  : QAWL AZZWR قول الزور meaing twisted talk, and wrong discourse.AZWAR اَزْوَر such a person whose chest is uneven.and BI-RUN ZUWRA-A بَئْرٌ زَوْرََاءَ meaning such a well whose digging is uneven. and ZAWARA meaning to be uneven or to go past by being uneven.
11.2 QARADA  :meaning to avoid, and to go past by dodging.QARADA ALMAKAN قَرَضَ الْمَكَان meaning 'he went past that place by moving here and there(dodging). and QARADA FI ASSAYR(قَرَضَ فِي السَّيْر) meaning to incline here and there while walking. ALLAH said
Surat Al-Kahf (The Cave) - سورة الكهف
18:17
وَتَرَى الشَّمْسَ إِذَا طَلَعَت تَّزَاوَرُ عَن كَهْفِهِمْ ذَاتَ الْيَمِينِ وَإِذَا غَرَبَت تَّقْرِضُهُمْ ذَاتَ الشِّمَالِ وَهُمْ فِي فَجْوَةٍ مِّنْهُ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ مِنْ آيَاتِ اللَّهِ ۗ مَن يَهْدِ اللَّهُ فَهُوَ الْمُهْتَدِ ۖ وَمَن يُضْلِلْ فَلَن تَجِدَ لَهُ وَلِيًّا مُّرْشِدًا
And [had you been present], you would see the sun when it rose, inclining away from their cave on the right, and when it set, passing away from them on the left, while they were [laying] within an open space thereof. That was from the signs of Allah . He whom Allah guides is the [rightly] guided, but he whom He leaves astray - never will you find for him a protecting guide.
11.3 HADA  :meaning to incline away from straight path.and to run   away.to   change direction.ALLAH said
Surat Qāf (The Letter "Qaf") - سورة ق
50:19
وَجَاءَتْ سَكْرَةُ الْمَوْتِ بِالْحَقِّ ۖ ذَٰلِكَ مَا كُنتَ مِنْهُ تَحِيدُ
And the intoxication of death will bring the truth; that is what you were trying to avoid.
Summary:
11.1 ZAWARA:to go past by twisting
11.2 QARADA:to go past by avoidance and then to take the straight past
11.3 HADA:to avoid and run away and then to not take the straight path

12 KITNAY ? [How Many ?]
Synonyms: KAM كَمْ KAAYIN كَائٍ KAAYYAN كَائِن
12.1 KAM  :unclear count.this word is used to ask for (Time period)period or quantity. meaning how many,how much,how long . used as interrogative. In the QURAN
Search Tips
Surat Al-Baqarah (The Cow) - سورة البقرة
2:259
أَوْ كَالَّذِي مَرَّ عَلَىٰ قَرْيَةٍ وَهِيَ خَاوِيَةٌ عَلَىٰ عُرُوشِهَا قَالَ أَنَّىٰ يُحْيِي هَٰذِهِ اللَّهُ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَا ۖ فَأَمَاتَهُ اللَّهُ مِائَةَ عَامٍ ثُمَّ بَعَثَهُ ۖ   قَالَ كَمْ لَبِثْتَ   ۖ قَالَ لَبِثْتُ يَوْمًا أَوْ بَعْضَ يَوْمٍ ۖ قَالَ بَل لَّبِثْتَ مِائَةَ عَامٍ فَانظُرْ إِلَىٰ طَعَامِكَ وَشَرَابِكَ لَمْ يَتَسَنَّهْ ۖ وَانظُرْ إِلَىٰ حِمَارِكَ وَلِنَجْعَلَكَ آيَةً لِّلنَّاسِ ۖ وَانظُرْ إِلَى الْعِظَامِ كَيْفَ نُنشِزُهَا ثُمَّ نَكْسُوهَا لَحْمًا ۚ فَلَمَّا تَبَيَّنَ لَهُ قَالَ أَعْلَمُ أَنَّ اللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
Or [consider such an example] as the one who passed by a township which had fallen into ruin. He said, "How will Allah bring this to life after its death?" So Allah caused him to die for a hundred years; then He revived him.   He said, "How long have you remained?"   The man said, "I have remained a day or part of a day." He said, "Rather, you have remained one hundred years. Look at your food and your drink; it has not changed with time. And look at your donkey; and We will make you a sign for the people. And look at the bones [of this donkey] - how We raise them and then We cover them with flesh." And when it became clear to him, he said, "I know that Allah is over all things competent."
12.2 KAAYIN or KAAYAN  : KAM and KAAYIN are near in meaning,the only difference between them is that KAAYIN includes the concept of 'excess'.meaning How many more,How much more. meaning a lot of , and doesn't comes as interrogative. ALLAH said
Surat Yūsuf (Joseph) - سورة يوسف
12:105
وَكَأَيِّن مِّنْ آيَةٍ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ يَمُرُّونَ عَلَيْهَا وَهُمْ عَنْهَا مُعْرِضُونَ
And how many a sign within the heavens and earth do they pass over while they, therefrom, are turning away
for   KAJI[Nutation]   please see   TAYRH [Crookedness]   and   TAYRHA HUWNA[To be crooked]  -----For   KARWAT[Turn/Side]   please see   PEHLOW [Side]

raw_text:
Tawwwaba, “lawtna, lawtaana, rujoo` kurna”, P.768
{
synonyms: RAJAA,AABA(AUB),TABA(TUB),AANABA(NOB),BAAA(BU-)
FAAA(FA-),SADARA,SARA(SER),IRTADDA(RDD),INQALIB,
EFAD,HAAD
1 RAJAA(رَجَعَ):meaning something returning to its origin.whether this thing is living or non living,action or speech,whether voluntarily or involuntary.there is a famous proverb (كُلُّ شَيْءٍ يَرجِعُ اِلي اَصْلِهِ)meaning everything returns to its origin.use of this word is common in all aspect
Surat Al-Baqarah [2:210] - The Noble Qur'an
وَإِلَى اللَّهِ   تُرْجَعُ   الْأُمُورُ
And to Allah [all] matters are   returned
Surat Al-Baqarah [2:156] - The Noble Qur'an
الَّذِينَ إِذَا أَصَابَتْهُم مُّصِيبَةٌ قَالُوا إِنَّا لِلَّهِ وَإِنَّا إِلَيْهِ   رَاجِعُونَ
Who, when disaster strikes them, say, "Indeed we belong to Allah , and indeed to Him we will   return  ."
2 AABA(اَبَ):it is more specific than RAJAA.it is used only for living things and MAAB(ماَبَ)meaning place of return
and AYAB(اياب) meaning echo or return journey.and ZAHAB O AYAB(ذِهاب و اِياب) meaning to go and to return.
in AABA it is not necessary that return is voluntarily
Surat Al-Ghashiyah [88:25-26] - The Noble Qur'an
إِنَّ إِلَيْنَا   إِيَابَهُمْ   ثُمَّ إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا حِسَابَهُم
Indeed, to Us is   their return  .  Then indeed, upon Us is their account
when this verb goes beyond trilateral,for e.g (اَوَبَ اَوَّبَ )then it implies that return is voluntary AWAAB(اَوَّابَ) meaning the returner,the one always referring.
Surat Al-'Isra' [17:25] - The Noble Qur'an
فَإِنَّهُ كَانَ   لِلْأَوَّابِينَ   غَفُورًا
indeed He is ever, to the   often returning   [to Him], Forgiving.
3 TABA(تَابَ):meaning to give up sins,admitting sins,and vowing not to fall in sins again,to repent. If it refers to ALLAH then it means acceptance of repentence.forgive sins or to be merciful.
Surat Al-Baqarah [2:160] - The Noble Qur'an
إِلَّا الَّذِينَ تَابُوا وَأَصْلَحُوا وَبَيَّنُوا فَأُولَٰئِكَ   أَتُوبُ عَلَيْهِمْ   ۚ وَأَنَا   التَّوَّابُ   الرَّحِيمُ
