14. LAUH-E-MAHFOOZ [Al-Lauh Al-Mahfuz (The Preserved Tablet) and its names]
Synonyms: LAUH MAHFOOZ, KITAABUM MAKNOON, UMM-UL-KITAAB, IMAAMUM MUBEEN
14.1 LAUH MAHFOOZ (لَوْح مَحْفُوظ):   According to dictionary this word means ‘preserved tablet’. The complete comprehension to this tablet is beyond the bounds of human knowledge but according to legends this tablet or book contains all the matters related to the fate of the universe and it is not altered. Following is the knowledge of the names referred to it in the Quran
Surah Al-Burooj (The Mansions of the Stars): سورة البروج 85:21
بَلْ هُوَ قُرْآنٌ مَّجِيدٌ فِي لَوْحٍ مَّحْفُوظٍ
No indeed, (but) it is an Ever-Glorious Qur'an, in a preserved Tablet.
Thus the Quran is also derived from the LAUH MEHFOOZ (لَوْح مَحْفُوظ).
14.2 UMM-UL-KITAAB (اُمُّ ٱلۡكِتَـٰبِ):
Surah Az-Zukhruf (Ornaments of Gold): سورۃالزُّخرف 43:3-4
إِنَّا جَعَلۡنَـٰهُ قُرۡءَٲنًا عَرَبِيًّ۬ا لَّعَلَّڪُمۡ تَعۡقِلُونَ وَإِنَّهُ ۥ فِىٓ أُمِّ ٱلۡكِتَـٰبِ لَدَيۡنَا لَعَلِىٌّ حَكِيمٌ
We verily, have made it a Quran in Arabic, that you may be able to understand (its meanings and its admonitions). And Verily, it (this Quran) is in the Mother of the Book (i.e. Al-Lauh Al-Mahfuz), before Us, indeed Exalted, full of Wisdom.
It is said about the Quran that is a part or the UMM-UL-KITAAB (اُمُّ ٱلۡكِتَـٰبِ). An important fact is cleared here that Allah has revealed Holy books upon Prophets belonging to different era and nations. But they all advocated for the same doctrine. The standard of vice and virtues were the same, so were the laws of morality and civilization. Thus the religion always remained the same. Regarding the changes in laws and Shariah it is said in the Quran
Surah Al-Rad (The Thunder): سُوۡرَةُ الرّعد13:39
يَمۡحُواْ ٱللَّهُ مَا يَشَآءُ وَيُثۡبِتُ‌ۖ وَعِندَهُ ۥۤ أُمُّ ٱلۡڪِتَـٰبِ
Allah blots out what He wills and confirms (what He wills). And with Him is the Mother of the Book (Al-Lauh Al-Mahfuz)
According to this Ayah the changes in the Shariah Law and regulations were also recorded in this book.
PAGE - 772
14.3 IMAAMUM MUBEEN (إِمَامٌ مُّبِينٍ):   In another place in Quran
Surah As-Sajda (The prostration ): سُوۡرَةُ السَّجدَة 32:39
وَكُلَّ شَيْءٍ أَحْصَيْنَاهُ فِي إِمَامٍ مُّبِينٍ
We have recorded with numbers (as a record) in a Clear Book.
14.4 KITAABUM MAKNOON (كِتَابٌ مَّكْنُون):   Also in the Quran
Surah Al-Waqiah (The Inevitable): سُوۡرَةُ الواقِعَة 56:77
إِنَّهُ لَقُرْآنٌ كَرِيمٌ فِي كِتَابٍ مَّكْنُونٍ
It is a noble Quran. In a well-protected Book.
From this ayah we come to know that the contents of this book are not known by anyone except Allah not even Gabriel (Jibraeel) who used to take the divine revelations to Prophets.
Summary:
14.1 LAUH MAHFOOZ: The tablet that is protected from any alterations.
14.2 UMM-UL-KITAAB: Because it is the collection of all the Laws, rules and orders of Allah.
14.3 IMAAMUM MUBEEN: Because everything is already written in it.
14.4 KITAABUM MAKNOON: Because its contents are not known to anyone except Allah.

14.2 UMM-UL-KITAAB (اُمُّ ٱلۡكِتَـٰبِ):

Surah Az-Zukhruf (Ornaments of Gold): سورۃالزُّخرف 43:3-4

 إِنَّا جَعَلۡنَـٰهُ قُرۡءَٲنًا عَرَبِيًّ۬ا لَّعَلَّڪُمۡ تَعۡقِلُونَ وَإِنَّهُ ۥ فِىٓ أُمِّ ٱلۡكِتَـٰبِ لَدَيۡنَا لَعَلِىٌّ حَكِيمٌ

We verily, have made it a Quran in Arabic, that you may be able to understand (its meanings and its admonitions). And Verily, it (this Quran) is in the Mother of the Book (i.e. Al-Lauh Al-Mahfuz), before Us, indeed Exalted, full of Wisdom.

It is said about the Quran that is a part or the UMM-UL-KITAAB (اُمُّ ٱلۡكِتَـٰبِ). An important fact is cleared here that Allah has revealed Holy books upon Prophets belonging to different era and nations. But they all advocated for the same doctrine. The standard of vice and virtues were the same, so were the laws of morality and civilization. Thus the religion always remained the same. Regarding the changes in laws and Shariah it is said in the Quran

Surah Al-Rad (The Thunder): سُوۡرَةُ الرّعد13:39

 يَمۡحُواْ ٱللَّهُ مَا يَشَآءُ وَيُثۡبِتُ‌ۖ وَعِندَهُ ۥۤ أُمُّ ٱلۡڪِتَـٰبِ

Allah blots out what He wills and confirms (what He wills). And with Him is the Mother of the Book (Al-Lauh Al-Mahfuz)

According to this Ayah the changes in the Shariah Law and regulations were also recorded in this book.

PAGE - 772

 

14.3 IMAAMUM MUBEEN (إِمَامٌ مُّبِينٍ): In another place in Quran

Surah As-Sajda (The prostration ): سُوۡرَةُ السَّجدَة 32:39

 وَكُلَّ شَيْءٍ أَحْصَيْنَاهُ فِي إِمَامٍ مُّبِينٍ

We have recorded with numbers (as a record) in a Clear Book.

 

14.4 KITAABUM MAKNOON (كِتَابٌ مَّكْنُون): Also in the Quran

Surah Al-Waqiah (The Inevitable): سُوۡرَةُ الواقِعَة 56:77

إِنَّهُ لَقُرْآنٌ كَرِيمٌ فِي كِتَابٍ مَّكْنُونٍ

It is a noble Quran. In a well-protected Book.

 

From this ayah we come to know that the contents of this book are not known by anyone except Allah not even Gabriel (Jibraeel) who used to take the divine revelations to Prophets.

Summary:

14.1 LAUH MAHFOOZ: The tablet that is protected from any alterations.

14.2 UMM-UL-KITAAB: Because it is the collection of all the Laws, rules and orders of Allah.

14.3 IMAAMUM MUBEEN: Because everything is already written in it.

14.4 KITAABUM MAKNOON: Because its contents are not known to anyone except Allah.

raw_text:
15 LAUNDI – GHULAM [Salve girl, Slave]
Synonyms: A’BD, AMAH, RAQABAH, MILK YAMEEN
15.1 A’BD (عَبْد):   Means human being or salve, ABUDIYYAT (عبودیّت) means to show humility and abasement. The word IBADAH (عِبَادۃ) is more rhetoric than ABUDIYYAT (عبودیّت), IBADAH (عِبَادۃ) means to show utmost humility and abasement. And IBADAT (عبادت) is specifically done for a deity. Though all the creations of Allah are A’BD (عَبْد), but Allah refers to human being A’BD (عَبْد) who willfully submits himself completely to Allah. This ‘will’ is only given to man and sprites (jinn). Plural of ABD (عَبْد) is I’BAAD (عِبَاد) and also ABEED (عَبِیْد). The second meaning of A’BD (عَبْد) is to become a slave. This word can be used as either A’BD-AD-DIRHAM (عبد الدرہم) or A’BD-AD-DEENAAR (عبد الدّینار) means a slave of money, or its worshipper or A’BD-AT-TAGHUUT (عبد الطاغوت) or as salve of a person (Opposite HURR (حُرّ)) regardless if the slave is bought, inherited or caught in booty or spoils. And A’BBADA (عَبَّدَ) means to enslave someone. عَبَّدتَّ     (26:22) Allah says in the Quran
Surah Al-Baqarah (The cow): سورۃ البَقَرَۃ  2:178
الْحُرُّ بِالْحُرِّ وَالْعَبْدُ بِالْعَبْدِ وَالْأُنثَىٰ بِالْأُنثَىٰ ۚ
The free for the free, the slave for the slave, and the female for the female.
15.2 AMAH (اَمَة):   Female of A’BD (عَبْد), a female slave, this word is also used in all the ways as A’BD (عَبْد) is used and plural of AMAH (اَمَة) is IMMA’ (اَمَاء). Allah says in the Quran
Surah Al-Noor (The light): سورۃ النور 24:32
وَأَنكِحُوا الْأَيَامَىٰ مِنكُمْ وَالصَّالِحِينَ مِنْ عِبَادِكُمْ وَإِمَائِكُمْ
And marry the unmarried among you and the righteous among your male slaves and female slaves.
PAGE - 773
In another place in the Quran
Surah Al-Baqarah (The cow): سورۃ البَقَرَۃ  2:221
وَلَأَمَةٌ۬ مُّؤۡمِنَةٌ خَيۡرٌ۬ مِّن مُّشۡرِكَةٍ۬ وَلَوۡ أَعۡجَبَتۡكُمۡ‌ۗ
And a believing slave woman is better than a polytheist, even though she might please you.
15.3 RAQABAH (رَقَبَة):   Means the neck or the back of the neck. RAQABA (رَقَبَ) means to put a rope or a snare around the neck, Arabs use the word JAZA’ ASHRAF ‘جزء اشرف’ for everything. In this way RAQABAH (رَقَبَة) means a slave because he has a snare of slavery around his neck (dictionary al Manjad). (Plural RIQAAB (رقاب)) and RAQABAH (رَقَبَة) are used in the same manner for both the female and male slaves.
Surah Al-Baqarah (The cow): سورۃ البَقَرَۃ  2:177
آتَى الْمَالَ عَلَىٰ حُبِّهِ ذَوِي الْقُرْبَىٰ وَالْيَتَامَىٰ وَالْمَسَاكِينَ وَابْنَ السَّبِيلِ وَالسَّائِلِينَ وَفِي الرِّقَابِ
Brings wealth in spite of his love for it (Or: offers out of love for Him) to near kinsmen, and the orphans, and the indigent, and the wayfarer, and the beggars, and (to ransom) necks, (i.e. captives "slaves")
15.4 MILK YAMEEN (مِلْك یمین):   YAMEEN (یمین) means right hand or the right direction. And because of physical power and ability is done through hands and of the both hands right hand is more superior and better than the left hand. Thus YAMEEN (یمین) refers to a Human in the same manner as Arabs JAZA-ASHRAF (جزء اشرف). MILK (مِلك) is that thing that is under someone’s possession or ownership. MILK YAMEEN (مِلْك یمین) is anything under the ownership of a person but usually this word started to be used to refer to male or female salve that were captured as the spoils of war. Allah says in the Quran
Surah An-Nisa (The women): سورۃ النِّسا 4:24
وَالْمُحْصَنَاتُ مِنَ النِّسَاءِ إِلَّا مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَانُكُمْ ۖ
Also (forbidden are) women already married, except those (captives and slaves) whom your right hands possess.
Summary:
15.1 A’BD: Slave
15.2 AMAH: Female Slave
15.3 RAQABAH: Male or female salve regardless of how they are obtained
15.4 MILK YAMEEN: Male or female salve obtained through spoils or booty.

title: content/l/l16.html
raw_text:
16 LAINA [to take]
Synonyms: AKHAZA, TALAQQA, HAAUM
16.1 AKHAZA (اَخَذ):   To acquire something, to take under ownership, to hold in hands. And it is used both semantically and receptively. Allah says in the Quran
Surah Ale- Imran (The family of Imran): سورۃ آل عِمْرن 3:81
وَإِذْ أَخَذَ اللَّهُ مِيثَاقَ النَّبِيِّينَ
And [recall, O People of the Scripture], when Allah took the covenant of the prophets,
In another place in the Quran
Surah Al-Araf (The heights): سورۃ الأعرَاف 7:154
وَلَمَّا سَكَتَ عَن مُّوسَى الْغَضَبُ أَخَذَ الْأَلْوَاحَ
And when the anger subsided in Moses, he took up the tablets;
PAGE - 774
16.2 TALAQQA (تَلَقّٰی):   LAQIYA (لَقِیَ) means to meet, to gather, TALQQA-AS-SHAI (تلقی الشئ) means to greet someone, to meet (dictionary al Manjad). Thus TALQQA (تَلَقّٰی) means to take something by visiting or meeting.
Surah Al-Anbiya (the prophets): سورۃ الانَبیاء 21:103
لَا يَحْزُنُهُمُ الْفَزَعُ الْأَكْبَرُ وَتَتَلَقَّاهُمُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ
The greatest alarm will not grieve them, and the Angels will receive them:
16.3 HAAUM (ھَاءُمْ):   HAU’ (ھوء) is a verbal noun which means KHUZ (خُذْ) meaning ‘take’ or ‘hold’ and only the verbal side is used. And its conjugation is  ھَاءُمْ ھَاءُمَا ھَاءُمُوْا   . According to dictionary al Manjad the word HA (ھَا) means ‘take’ and HAL-KITAAB (ھَا الْکِتَاب) means ‘take the book’. HAA’ (ھَاءُ) (HAU’ (ھوء)) also means the same. HAA’ YA RAJUL (ھاء یا رجل) means ‘O man! Take this book’ (dictionary al Manjad). Thus this word refers to calling someone and telling him to take something. Allah says in the Quran
Surah Al-Haqqah (The reality): سورۃ الحَاقَّۃ 69:19
فَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِيَ كِتَابَهُ بِيَمِينِهِ فَيَقُولُ هَاؤُمُ اقْرَءُوا كِتَابِيَهْ
Then, as for him who is given his record in his right hand, he will say: Take, read my book!
Summary:
16.1 AKHAZA: To take something, to hold it. Commonly used.
16.2 TALAQQA: To go near to something and take it.
16.3 HAAUM: To call someone and ask him to take something.

title: content/l/l17.html
raw_text:
17 LAIN DAIN KARNA [to do a dealing, to do a transaction amongst]
Synonyms: TADAYAN, ADARA
17.1 TADAYAN (تَدَایَنَ):   DAIN (دَیْن) means a debt, loan (See UDHAAR [loan] for more details). TADAYAN (تَدَایَنَ) means to ask loan amongst each other. To deal with each other on loan (dictionary al Manjad). Allah says in the Quran
Surah Al-Baqarah (The cow): سورۃ البَقَرَۃ  2:282
يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا إِذَا تَدَايَنتُم بِدَيْنٍ إِلَىٰ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى فَاكْتُبُوهُ ۚ
O you who believe! When you contract a debt for a fixed period, write it down.
17.2 ADARA (اَدَار):    DARA (دَارَ) means to circulate, go around. ADAARAH (اَدَارہ) means to circularize or revolve something. ADAAR-ASH-SHAI (اَدَارَ الشَّئْ) means to deal in something, to give and take on something or to do a transaction.
Surah Al-Baqarah (The cow): سورۃ البَقَرَۃ  2:282
ا ۖ إِلَّا أَن تَكُونَ تِجَارَةً حَاضِرَةً تُدِيرُونَهَا بَيْنَكُمْ
Except when it is an immediate transaction which you conduct among yourselves.
Summary:
17.1 TADAYAN: To deal by loans.
17.2 ADARA: Immediate transactions.

Say: Come, bring your witnesses   who can bear witness that Allah forbade (all) this. And if they bear witness, do not thou bear witness with them. Follow thou not the whims of those who deny Our revelations, those who believe not in the Hereafter and deem (others) equal with their Lord.

And they say: None entereth paradise unless he be a Jew or a Christian. These are their own desires.   Say: Bring your proof (of what ye state) if ye are truthful.
________________
2.5 aja’aa (  اجاء  )  :to bring someone in a state helplessness and destitution, to bring someone impulsively or be the cause of it. Allah states that:
________________
Surat Maryam  -   سُوۡرَةُ مَریَم
19:23
أَجَآءَهَا ٱلۡمَخَاضُ إِلَىٰ جِذۡعِ ٱلنَّخۡلَةِ
And the pangs of childbirth drove her unto the trunk of the palm-tree  . She said: Oh, would that I had died ere this and had become a thing of naught, forgotten!
________________
2.6 ajlaba (  اجلب  )  : jalab(  جلب  ) means to make something move and ajlaba alaih(  اجلب عليه  ) means to make something move by force. It is stated in the Quran:
________________

وَأَجۡلِبۡ عَلَيۡہِم بِخَيۡلِكَ وَرَجِلِكَ
And excite any of them whom thou canst with thy voice  , and urge thy horse and foot against them  , and be a partner in their wealth and children, and promise them. Satan promiseth them only to deceive.
________________

1.JA’AB(  جآءب  ): its use is common.

3 LAAIQ HONA
[able, worthy]
Synonyms: YANBGHI(  ينبغي  ), AJDAR(  أجدر  ), AULA(  أولي  ), HUQQA(  حق  )
3.1 yanbghi(  ينبغي  )  : inbgha(  انبغي  ) meaning to be easy and simple. And yanbghi(  ينبغي  ) meaning to be worthy of something, be appropriate and this word is used for such kind of act for which it is achievable. It is said that:
النار ينبغي ان يحرق التواب   which means that burning clothes is the specialty of fire. This is used as a singular past perfect tense and is used for such acts which are close to nature. In literal sense, this word is used both in the positive and negative sense. There is no example of its positive use in the Quran but has been described above. An example of its negative use is given in the Quran as:
________________
Surat Ya-seen  -   سُوۡرَةُ یسٓ
36:40
لَا ٱلشَّمۡسُ يَنۢبَغِى لَهَآ أَن تُدۡرِكَ ٱلۡقَمَرَ
It is not for the sun to overtake the moon  , nor doth the night outstrip the day. They float each in an orbit.
________________
at another location it is stated:
________________
Surat Ya-seen  -   سُوۡرَةُ یسٓ
36:69
وَمَا عَلَّمۡنَـٰهُ ٱلشِّعۡرَ وَمَا يَنۢبَغِى لَهُ ۥۤ‌ۚ
And We have not taught him (Muhammad) poetry, nor is it meet for him.   This is naught else than a Reminder and a Lecture making plain.
________________
3.2 ajdar (  أجدر  )  : jadar(  جدر)   meaning to be appropriate and worthy of. And ajdaar(  أجدر  ) is used for authoritative tasks. Jader-u-zikr(  جدير الزكر  ) meaning worth mentioning. And jader-u-sana’(  جديرالتناء  ) meaning worth praising and it is used in such situations where something is according to one’s worth and circumstances. Allah states that:
________________
Surat At-Tawba (Repentance) -   سُوۡرَةُ التّوبَة
9:97
ٱلۡأَعۡرَابُ أَشَدُّ ڪُفۡرً۬ا وَنِفَاقً۬ا وَأَجۡدَرُ أَلَّا يَعۡلَمُواْ حُدُودَ مَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ
The wandering Arabs are more hard in disbelief and hypocrisy, and more likely to be ignorant of the limits which Allah hath revealed unto His messenger  . And Allah is Knower, Wise.
________________
3.3 aula (  أولي  )  : wali(  ولي  ) meaning companion, friend and one meaning of mawali(  موالي  ) is heir in the legacy. And wala(  ولاء  ) meaning the part of a freed slave and custodianship. Aula(  أولي  ) means more worthy, more appropriate, more deserving, used for authoritative tasks and only used in the positive sense. And just like yanbghi(  ينبغي  ), only one tense is used for this word as well. And when it ends in ‘  ب  ’, it will mean that he is entitled to it; that is more appropriate and deserving. It is stated in the Quran:
________________
Surat Maryam -   سُوۡرَةُ مَریَم
19:70
ثُمَّ لَنَحۡنُ أَعۡلَمُ بِٱلَّذِينَ هُمۡ أَوۡلَىٰ بِہَا صِلِيًّ۬ا
And surely We are best aware of those most worthy to be burned therein  .
________________
at another place, it is stated:
________________
Surat Al-Ahzab (The Clans) -   سُوۡرَةُ الاٴحزَاب
33:6
ٱلنَّبِىُّ أَوۡلَىٰ بِٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ مِنۡ أَنفُسِہِمۡ‌ۖ
The Prophet is closer to the believers than their selves  , and his wives are (as) their mothers. And the owners of kinship are closer one to another in the ordinance of Allah than (other) believers and the fugitives (who fled from Mecca), except that ye should do kindness to your friends. This is written in the Book (of nature).
________________
And when aula(  أولي  ) ends in ‘  ل  ’, then it becomes a negative verb meaning disaster, execution etc. it is stated in the Quran:
________________
Surat Al-Qiyama (Resurrection) -   سُوۡرَةُ القِیَامَة
75:35
أَوۡلَىٰ لَكَ فَأَوۡلَىٰٓ
Again nearer unto thee and nearer (is the doom).
________________
3.4 huqqa (  حق  )  : haq(  حق  ) meaning to become evident, to become apparent. And   حق ان يفعل كزا   meaning that doing like this is apparent and deserving of him i.e. he deserved this to do something like this. Its use is also only in the positive sense. Allah states that:
________________
Surat Al-Inshiqaq (The Sundering) -   سُوۡرَةُ الانشقاق
84:1-2
إِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ ٱنشَقَّتۡ وَأَذِنَتۡ لِرَبِّہَا وَحُقَّتۡ
When the heaven is split asunder And attentive to her Lord in fear,
________________
Summary:
1.YANBGHI(  ينبغي  ): only used for achievable tasks.
2. AJDAR(  أجدر  ): for authoritative tasks, according to someone’s circumstances and worth.
3. AULA(  أولي  ): this is used in vast meanings as compared to ajdar(  أجدر  ) and only used in the positive sense in authoritative tasks.
4. HUQQA(  حق  ): when the same thing is culpable for someone.

4 LAPAITNA, LIPATNA
[to fold, to get folded]
Synonyms: TAWA(  طوي  ), LAFFA(  لف  ), KAWWAR(  كور  )
4.1 tawa(  طوي  )  : meaning to fold and wrap, to end a game, to fold a tablecloth.   طويت التواب و الكتاب   meaning the way in which a cloth or book is folded or closed. It is said:   نشرت الكتاب تم طويته   meaning I opened a book and then closed it. Allah states that:
________________
Surat Al-Anbiya (The Prophets) -   سُوۡرَةُ الاٴنبیَاء
21:104
يَوۡمَ نَطۡوِى ٱلسَّمَآءَ ڪَطَىِّ ٱلسِّجِلِّ لِلۡڪُتُبِ‌ۚ
The Day when We shall roll up the heavens as a recorder rolleth up a written scroll  . As We began the first creation, We shall repeat it. (It is) a promise (binding) upon Us. Lo! We are to perform it.
________________
4.2 laffa (  لف  )  : meaning to join one thing with another, to merge. To fold one thing and then fold another thing and merge it with the first. And then similarly the third folded thing. Allah states that:
________________
Surat Al-Isra (Children of Israel) -   سُوۡرَةُ بنیٓ اسرآئیل / الإسرَاء
17:104
فَإِذَا جَآءَ وَعۡدُ ٱلۡأَخِرَةِ جِئۡنَا بِكُمۡ لَفِيفً۬ا
And We said unto the Children of Israel after him: Dwell in the land  ; but when the promise of the Hereafter cometh to pass We shall bring you as a crowd gathered out of various nations  .
________________
And for folded, the word iltaffa(  التف  ) is used which means one thing getting stuck on another thing. Allah states that:
________________
Surat Al-Qiyama (Resurrection) -   سُوۡرَةُ القِیَامَة
75:29-30
وَٱلۡتَفَّتِ ٱلسَّاقُ بِٱلسَّاقِ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ يَوۡمَٮِٕذٍ ٱلۡمَسَاقُ
And agony is heaped on agony; Unto thy Lord that day will be the driving.
________________
4.3 kawwar (  كور  )  : to fold something in the form of a turban and roll it in different ways. And   اكتارالفرس   means a horse wriggling its tail and laffa(  لف  ) is also used for rolling like a turban. It is said that    لففت عمامتى علي رأسي    meaning that I put on a turban on my head. This is in the sense that one layer gets fixed on the layer beneath but the world kawwar(  كور  ) is more appropriate for rolling a turban. Because kawwar(  كور  ) constitutes the aspects of fusion as well as roundness which are also seen in a turban. Allah states that:
________________
Surat Az-Zumar (The Troops) -   سُوۡرَةُ الزُّمَر
39:5
يُكَوِّرُ ٱلَّيۡلَ عَلَى ٱلنَّہَارِ وَيُكَوِّرُ ٱلنَّهَارَ عَلَى ٱلَّيۡلِ‌ۖ
He hath created the heavens and the earth with truth.   He maketh night to succeed day, and He maketh day to succeed night,   and He constraineth the sun and the moon to give service, each running on for an appointed term. Is not He the Mighty, the Forgiver?
________________
at another place, it is stated:
________________
Surat At-Takwir (The Overthrowing) -   سُوۡرَةُ التّکویر
81:1
إِذَا ٱلشَّمۡسُ كُوِّرَتۡ
When the sun is overthrown,
________________
Summary:
1.TAWA(  طوي  ): means to fold something such as a tablecloth.
2. LAFFA(  لف  ): to place one thing on another and merge them.
3. KAWWAR(  كور  ): to fold in a circling manner and joining them.

فَإِذَا جَآءَ وَعۡدُ ٱلۡأَخِرَةِ جِئۡنَا بِكُمۡ لَفِيفً۬ا

And We said unto the Children of Israel after him: Dwell in the land; but when the promise of the Hereafter cometh to pass We shall bring you as a crowd gathered out of various nations.

________________

And for folded, the word iltaffa(التف) is used which means one thing getting stuck on another thing. Allah states that:

________________

Surat Al-Qiyama (Resurrection) - سُوۡرَةُ القِیَامَة

75:29-30

وَٱلۡتَفَّتِ ٱلسَّاقُ بِٱلسَّاقِ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ يَوۡمَٮِٕذٍ ٱلۡمَسَاقُ

And agony is heaped on agony; Unto thy Lord that day will be the driving.

________________

4.3 kawwar (كور): to fold something in the form of a turban and roll it in different ways. And اكتارالفرس means a horse wriggling its tail and laffa(لف) is also used for rolling like a turban. It is said that  لففت عمامتى علي رأسي  meaning that I put on a turban on my head. This is in the sense that one layer gets fixed on the layer beneath but the world kawwar(كور) is more appropriate for rolling a turban. Because kawwar(كور) constitutes the aspects of fusion as well as roundness which are also seen in a turban. Allah states that:

________________

Surat Az-Zumar (The Troops) - سُوۡرَةُ الزُّمَر

39:5

يُكَوِّرُ ٱلَّيۡلَ عَلَى ٱلنَّہَارِ وَيُكَوِّرُ ٱلنَّهَارَ عَلَى ٱلَّيۡلِ‌ۖ

He hath created the heavens and the earth with truth. He maketh night to succeed day, and He maketh day to succeed night, and He constraineth the sun and the moon to give service, each running on for an appointed term. Is not He the Mighty, the Forgiver?

________________

at another place, it is stated:

________________

Surat At-Takwir (The Overthrowing) - سُوۡرَةُ التّکویر

81:1

إِذَا ٱلشَّمۡسُ كُوِّرَتۡ

When the sun is overthrown,

________________

Summary:

1.TAWA(طوي): means to fold something such as a tablecloth.

2. LAFFA(لف): to place one thing on another and merge them.

3. KAWWAR(كور): to fold in a circling manner and joining them.

6 KAAM -KAAM KARNA [Work-To Do Work]
Synonyms: FA3ALA فَعَلَ ,i,3AMILA عَمِلَ SANA3A صَنَعَ SADA3A صَدَعَ JARAHA جَرَحَ
IJTARAHA اِجْتَرَحَ TA3AMMADA تَعَمَّدَ AMR اَمْر SHAN شَاْن
6.1 FA3ALA  :FI3L فِعْل every such work which results of some agency of some agent.whether the doer intent or not.and whether it's material or not it applies to all.plural AF3AL افعال and FA3LTAN فَعْلَةً meaning to do something once.
Surat Ash-Shu`arā' (The Poets) - سورة الشعراء
26:19
وَفَعَلْتَ فَعْلَتَكَ الَّتِي فَعَلْتَ وَأَنتَ مِنَ الْكَافِرِينَ
And [then] you did your deed which you did, and you were of the ungrateful."
see in this Ayah which mentions   murder.it   happened by Moses unintentionally. for intentional work see the Ayah below
Surat Al-Baqarah (The Cow) - سورة البقرة
2:68
قَالُوا ادْعُ لَنَا رَبَّكَ يُبَيِّن لَّنَا مَا هِيَ ۚ قَالَ إِنَّهُ يَقُولُ إِنَّهَا بَقَرَةٌ لَّا فَارِضٌ وَلَا بِكْرٌ عَوَانٌ بَيْنَ ذَٰلِكَ ۖ فَافْعَلُوا مَا تُؤْمَرُونَ
They said, "Call upon your Lord to make clear to us what it is." [Moses] said, "[ Allah ] says, 'It is a cow which is neither old nor virgin, but median between that,' so do what you are commanded."
6.2 3AMILA  :3ML عَمْل every that work which happens by any living being intentionally. whether good or evil.(plural A3MAL اعمال) and word 3AMALA also comes for labour,hard work. as said
Surat Al-Kahf (The Cave) - سورة الكهف
18:79
أَمَّا السَّفِينَةُ فَكَانَتْ لِمَسَاكِينَ يَعْمَلُونَ فِي الْبَحْرِ فَأَرَدتُّ أَنْ أَعِيبَهَا وَكَانَ وَرَاءَهُم مَّلِكٌ يَأْخُذُ كُلَّ سَفِينَةٍ غَصْبًا
As for the ship, it belonged to poor people working at sea. So I intended to cause defect in it as there was after them a king who seized every [good] ship by force.
6.3 SANA3A  :to perform some work with skilled mastery.this is peculiar than 3AMALA, not used for animals. and SANNA3 صَنَّاع meaning skilledman/craftsman- one master of one's work.ALLAH said
Surat Hūd (Hud) - سورة هود
11:37
وَاصْنَعِ الْفُلْكَ بِأَعْيُنِنَا وَوَحْيِنَا وَلَا تُخَاطِبْنِي فِي الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا ۚ إِنَّهُم مُّغْرَقُونَ
And construct the ship under Our observation and Our inspiration and do not address Me concerning those who have wronged; indeed, they are [to be] drowned."
6.4 SADA3A  :meaning to just do   something.to   do something even after bearin difficulties.and SADA3A BILHAQQ صَدَعَ بِاحَقّ meaning to mention Truth openly.and SADA3A ASSHAY صَدَعَ الشَّئ meaning to tore something but not to detach it.ALLAH said
Surat Al-Ĥijr (The Rocky Tract) - سورة الحجر
15:94
فَاصْدَعْ بِمَا تُؤْمَرُ وَأَعْرِضْ عَنِ الْمُشْرِكِينَ
Then declare what you are commanded and turn away from the polytheists.
6.5 JARAHA  : JARH جرح meaning wound,(plural JARUWH جروح ) and JARAHA meaning to incur wound.JARAHA BILLISAN جَرَحَ بِالِلِّسَان meaning to wound someone with tongue.-to agonize by   tongue.to   describe someone's fault and flaws.and JARAHA ASHSHAHADAH جَرَحَ الشَّهَادة meaning falsify witness. when this verb is used in the meaning of work then it generally refers to bad context. ALLAH said
Surat Al-'An`ām (The Cattle) - سورة الأنعام
6:60
وَهُوَ الَّذِي يَتَوَفَّاكُم بِاللَّيْلِ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا جَرَحْتُم بِالنَّهَارِ ثُمَّ يَبْعَثُكُمْ فِيهِ لِيُقْضَىٰ أَجَلٌ مُّسَمًّى ۖ ثُمَّ إِلَيْهِ مَرْجِعُكُمْ ثُمَّ يُنَبِّئُكُم بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
And it is He who takes your souls by night and knows what you have committed by day. Then He revives you therein that a specified term may be fulfilled. Then to Him will be your return; then He will inform you about what you used to do.
and IJTARAH ,is peculiar to the meaning of commiting.IJTARAHA ALICM ( اِجْتَرَحَ الاِثْم) he committed sin.
Surat Al-Jāthiyah (The Crouching) - سورة الجاثية
45:21
أَمْ حَسِبَ الَّذِينَ اجْتَرَحُوا السَّيِّئَاتِ أَن نَّجْعَلَهُمْ كَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ سَوَاءً مَّحْيَاهُمْ وَمَمَاتُهُمْ ۚ سَاءَ مَا يَحْكُمُونَ
Or do those who commit evils think We will make them like those who have believed and done righteous deeds - [make them] equal in their life and their death? Evil is that which they judge.
6.6 TA3AMMADA  :3AMADA عَمَدَ meaning to intent for something and to support/lean against. and 3AMADA meaning pillar.(plural 3IMAD عِمَاد) and 3AMUWD عَمُوْد is that wood with which Tent is supported.and TA3AMMADA meaning to intentionally and openly does some work meaning to do something which is known to be evil and it's antonym is SAHW سَهْو. In the QURAN
Surat An-Nisā' (The Women) - سورة النساء
4:93
وَمَن يَقْتُلْ مُؤْمِنًا مُّتَعَمِّدًا فَجَزَاؤُهُ جَهَنَّمُ خَالِدًا فِيهَا وَغَضِبَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَلَعَنَهُ وَأَعَدَّ لَهُ عَذَابًا عَظِيمًا
But whoever kills a believer intentionally - his recompense is Hell, wherein he will abide eternally, and Allah has become angry with him and has cursed him and has prepared for him a great punishment.
6.7 AMR  :meaning work-state-matter-discourse whether verbal or physical (plural UMUWR امور) this word is more general than F3L because it applies to actions as well as   speech.in   addition such works and matters which relates to the divine will.In the QURAN
Surat An-Naml (The Ant) - سورة النمل
27:32
قَالَتْ يَا أَيُّهَا الْمَلَأُ أَفْتُونِي فِي أَمْرِي مَا كُنتُ قَاطِعَةً أَمْرًا حَتَّىٰ تَشْهَدُونِ
She said, "O eminent ones, advise me in my affair. I would not decide a matter until you witness [for] me."
in this AYAH , work AMR gives off three meanings of Work,discourse and matter. and also the work is nonexistent in speech and action.
and AMR also means command. and in this case it's plural is AWAMIR اَوَامِرْ (anotnym is NAWAHIY نواهي) and when AMR comes as verb then it doesn't mean to work but to order.
6.8 SHAN  :(plural SHU-WN شؤون) meaning huge huge matter-affairs-matter-state and MIN SHANIHI KAZA مِنْ شَانِهِ كَذَا meaning to do so is his natural and habitual to him.so SHAN refers to such work which is appropriate to someone's status or condition.ALLAH said about Himself.
Surat Ar-Raĥmān (The Beneficent) - سورة الرحمن
55:29
يَسْأَلُهُ مَن فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ ۚ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ هُوَ فِي شَأْنٍ
Whoever is within the heavens and earth asks Him; every day He is bringing about a matter.
at another place said.
Surat An-Nūr (The Light) - سورة النور
24:62
إِنَّمَا الْمُؤْمِنُونَ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا بِاللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ وَإِذَا كَانُوا مَعَهُ عَلَىٰ أَمْرٍ جَامِعٍ لَّمْ يَذْهَبُوا حَتَّىٰ يَسْتَأْذِنُوهُ ۚ إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَسْتَأْذِنُونَكَ أُولَٰئِكَ الَّذِينَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِاللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ ۚ   فَإِذَا اسْتَأْذَنُوكَ لِبَعْضِ شَأْنِهِمْ فَأْذَن لِّمَن شِئْتَ مِنْهُمْ   وَاسْتَغْفِرْ لَهُمُ اللَّهَ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
The believers are only those who believe in Allah and His Messenger and, when they are [meeting] with him for a matter of common interest, do not depart until they have asked his permission. Indeed, those who ask your permission, [O Muhammad] - those are the ones who believe in Allah and His Messenger.   So when they ask your permission for something of their affairs, then give permission to whom you will among them   and ask forgiveness for them of Allah . Indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful.
Summary:
6.1 FA3ALA:such thing which is done whether intentional or unintentional
6.2 3AMILA:such thing which is done intentionally to fullfill some demand.
6.3 SANA3A:to execute/do something skillfully
6.4 SADA3A:to do/finish something even when faced with difficulties
6.5 JARAHA:generally used for doing something evil
6.6 TA3AMMADA:intentionally doing anything evil
6.7 AMR:common than F3L -and includes all of speech,work,state
6.8 SHAN:work as per one's ability or status/worthiness

أَمْ حَسِبَ الَّذِينَ اجْتَرَحُوا السَّيِّئَاتِ أَن نَّجْعَلَهُمْ كَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ سَوَاءً مَّحْيَاهُمْ وَمَمَاتُهُمْ ۚ سَاءَ مَا يَحْكُمُونَ

Or do those who commit evils think We will make them like those who have believed and done righteous deeds - [make them] equal in their life and their death? Evil is that which they judge.

6.6 TA3AMMADA:3AMADA عَمَدَ meaning to intent for something and to support/lean against. and 3AMADA meaning pillar.(plural 3IMAD عِمَاد) and 3AMUWD عَمُوْد is that wood with which Tent is supported.and TA3AMMADA meaning to intentionally and openly does some work meaning to do something which is known to be evil and it's antonym is SAHW سَهْو. In the QURAN

Surat An-Nisā' (The Women) - سورة النساء

4:93

وَمَن يَقْتُلْ مُؤْمِنًا مُّتَعَمِّدًا فَجَزَاؤُهُ جَهَنَّمُ خَالِدًا فِيهَا وَغَضِبَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَلَعَنَهُ وَأَعَدَّ لَهُ عَذَابًا عَظِيمًا

But whoever kills a believer intentionally - his recompense is Hell, wherein he will abide eternally, and Allah has become angry with him and has cursed him and has prepared for him a great punishment.

6.7 AMR:meaning work-state-matter-discourse whether verbal or physical (plural UMUWR امور) this word is more general than F3L because it applies to actions as well as speech.in addition such works and matters which relates to the divine will.In the QURAN

Surat An-Naml (The Ant) - سورة النمل

27:32

قَالَتْ يَا أَيُّهَا الْمَلَأُ أَفْتُونِي فِي أَمْرِي مَا كُنتُ قَاطِعَةً أَمْرًا حَتَّىٰ تَشْهَدُونِ

She said, "O eminent ones, advise me in my affair. I would not decide a matter until you witness [for] me."

in this AYAH , work AMR gives off three meanings of Work,discourse and matter. and also the work is nonexistent in speech and action.

and AMR also means command. and in this case it's plural is AWAMIR اَوَامِرْ (anotnym is NAWAHIY نواهي) and when AMR comes as verb then it doesn't mean to work but to order.

6.8 SHAN:(plural SHU-WN شؤون) meaning huge huge matter-affairs-matter-state and MIN SHANIHI KAZA مِنْ شَانِهِ كَذَا meaning to do so is his natural and habitual to him.so SHAN refers to such work which is appropriate to someone's status or condition.ALLAH said about Himself.

Surat Ar-Raĥmān (The Beneficent) - سورة الرحمن

55:29

يَسْأَلُهُ مَن فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ ۚ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ هُوَ فِي شَأْنٍ

Whoever is within the heavens and earth asks Him; every day He is bringing about a matter.

at another place said.

Surat An-Nūr (The Light) - سورة النور

24:62

إِنَّمَا الْمُؤْمِنُونَ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا بِاللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ وَإِذَا كَانُوا مَعَهُ عَلَىٰ أَمْرٍ جَامِعٍ لَّمْ يَذْهَبُوا حَتَّىٰ يَسْتَأْذِنُوهُ ۚ إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَسْتَأْذِنُونَكَ أُولَٰئِكَ الَّذِينَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِاللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ ۚ فَإِذَا اسْتَأْذَنُوكَ لِبَعْضِ شَأْنِهِمْ فَأْذَن لِّمَن شِئْتَ مِنْهُمْ وَاسْتَغْفِرْ لَهُمُ اللَّهَ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ

The believers are only those who believe in Allah and His Messenger and, when they are [meeting] with him for a matter of common interest, do not depart until they have asked his permission. Indeed, those who ask your permission, [O Muhammad] - those are the ones who believe in Allah and His Messenger. So when they ask your permission for something of their affairs, then give permission to whom you will among them and ask forgiveness for them of Allah . Indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful.

Summary:

6.1 FA3ALA:such thing which is done whether intentional or unintentional

6.2 3AMILA:such thing which is done intentionally to fullfill some demand.

6.3 SANA3A:to execute/do something skillfully

6.4 SADA3A:to do/finish something even when faced with difficulties

6.5 JARAHA:generally used for doing something evil

6.6 TA3AMMADA:intentionally doing anything evil

6.7 AMR:common than F3L -and includes all of speech,work,state

6.8 SHAN:work as per one's ability or status/worthiness

l7 Army (Lashkar) pg 762   **INCOMPLETE**   needs translation of all entries under this subtopic
Fawj
Means a fastly moving group(of people), cavalry or infantry or Military troops.   (muff)  (Plural:Afwaaj).
A group larger that Tai'fah  (Full 205).   However in Qura'n, this word has mostly been used in the meaning of a group rather than the cavalry. We do not find in Qura'n , the word fawj being used in the meaning of military force a concept being associated with this word in the modern times.
Allah, Most Exhalted is He, says:
وَيَوْمَ نَحْشُرُ مِنْ كُلِّ أُمَّةٍ فَوْجًا مِمَّنْ يُكَذِّبُ بِآيَاتِنَا
"And (remember) the Day when We shall gather out of every nation a troop of those who denied Our Ayât (proofs, evidences, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.)."[27:83]
Afwaaja, “lashkar”,P.762     PLEASE REFER TO QATADA POST FOR PARTIAL ENTRY
FULL TOPIC :   LASHKAR p762
{
Synonyms: JUND,FAWJ,HIZB,NAFEER,FEAH,SABAT
1 JUND(جُند):is a famous and mutidimensional word for army,JUNDI(جُندي) meaning soldier,JANNADA(جنّد)meaning to recruit in to army.JAISH(جيش) [plural JYUSH جيوش] and 3SKAR(عسكر)[plural 3SAKAR عساكر] are two other words but they are not used in the Quran they refers to those forces which gathers from different aspect as there is call for JIHAD whether they have any weapons or not.
JUND is always equipped with means of warfare (combat capable)
Surat Al-Baqarah (The Cow)[2:249]
فَلَمَّا فَصَلَ طَالُوتُ   بِالْجُنُودِ
And when Saul went forth   with the soldiers
2 FAWJ(فوج):meaning group the moves swiftly,battle
group.(Taifa is comparatively a bigger
group).but in Quran it is used as aGroup
not in the sense of military group as used
today.
Surat An-Naml (The Ant)[27:83]
وَيَوْمَ نَحْشُرُ مِن كُلِّ أُمَّةٍ   فَوْجًا   مِّمَّن يُكَذِّبُ بِآيَاتِنَا
And [warn of] the Day when We will gather from every nation a   company   of those who deny Our signs
3 HIZB(حزب): group,party,gathering of likemined people and AHZAB( احزاب) meaning those people whose hearts and actions are similar even though may not be exact.HAZZABA(حزَّبَ) meaning nation, to gather by making groups.HIZB meaning such a group in which possess Intensity and Hardness.also it may refer to a political party.
As per Quran there exists only two HIZB
A)HIZB ULLAH(حزبِ الّله) and
B) HIZB US SHAYTAN(حزب إلشيطن)
both these groups are at war at all time. HIZB US SHAYTAN has many sub HIZB like at the occassion of battle of trench many AHZAB of disbelievers joined forces. also HIZB meaning people under one flag
Surat Al-'Aĥzāb (The Combined Forces)[33:20]
يَحْسَبُونَ     الْأَحْزَابَ   لَمْ يَذْهَبُوا ۖ وَإِن يَأْتِ   الْأَحْزَابُ   يَوَدُّوا لَوْ أَنَّهُم بَادُونَ فِي الْأَعْرَابِ يَسْأَلُونَ عَنْ أَنبَائِكُمْ ۖ
They think the   companies   have not [yet] withdrawn. And if the   companies   should come [again], they would wish they were in the desert among the bedouins, inquiring [from afar] about your news
4 FEAH(فئة)     :FAAYA ARRAAS FULAN(فاي الراس فلان) meaning to crack open one's head with the sword.FEAH meaning such a military group whose members are connected together for inter cooperation
Surat Al-Baqarah (The Cow)[2:249]
كَم مِّن     فِئَةٍ   قَلِيلَةٍ غَلَبَتْ فِئَةً كَثِيرَةً بِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ ۗ
How many a small   company   has overcome a large company by permission of Allah
5 NAFEER(نفير)     :NAFARA(نَفَرَ) meaning to go for war or mission.NAFEER meaning people going to the battle
and NAFEER also means group of less than 10
6 SABAT(ثبات):such valiant horse riders (cavaliers)whose attack won't miss(ineffective)
sidenote: as nowadays they say Legendary or Elite
Surat An-Nisā' (The Women)[4:71]
يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا خُذُوا حِذْرَكُمْ فَانفِرُوا     ثُبَاتٍ   أَوِ انفِرُوا جَمِيعًا
O you who have believed, take your precaution and [either] go forth in   companies   or go forth all together
Summary
1 JUND: command of recruited combat-capable units
2 FAWJ:swiftly moving group
3 HIZB:party,political school of thought
4 FEAH:A highly interwoven warrior group
5 NAFEER:People departing for war or mission
6 SABAT:small group of valiant horse riders

8 KANPNA [To Shiver]
Synonyms:ZALZAL زَلْزَل MARA(MA-WA-RA)(مَارَ (مور) RAJJA رَجَّ RAJAFA رَجَفَ
8.1 ZALZAL  :ZALLA زَلَّ meaning slipping off step.and ZALZAL contains recurrence of word.that recurrence which alludes to meaning(the physical action)[repetition in words implies repetition in action/meaning].meaning repetitively keep on slipping here and there.and ZALZALAH زَلْزَلَة meaning jolt-earth having impulses.moving here and there.and shivering.this word is specific for jolting (earthquake).ALLAH said
Surat Az-Zalzalah (The Earthquake) - سورة الزلزلة
99:1
إِذَا زُلْزِلَتِ الْأَرْضُ زِلْزَالَهَا
When the earth is shaken with its [final] earthquake
8.2 RAJJA  :to displace something   slightly.to   jolt.this is the inital stage of earth quake.ALLAH said
Surat Al-Wāqi`ah (The Inevitable) - سورة الواقعة
56:4
إِذَا رُجَّتِ الْأَرْضُ رَجًّا
When the earth is shaken with convulsion
8.3 RAJAFA  :basic meaning is intense restlessness.BAHRUN RAJJAFUN بَحْرٌ رَجَّافٌ meaning 'rough sea'.
Surat Al-'Aĥzāb (The Combined Forces) - سورة الأحزاب
33:60
لَّئِن لَّمْ يَنتَهِ الْمُنَافِقُونَ وَالَّذِينَ فِي قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌ   وَالْمُرْجِفُونَ فِي الْمَدِينَةِ   لَنُغْرِيَنَّكَ بِهِمْ ثُمَّ لَا يُجَاوِرُونَكَ فِيهَا إِلَّا قَلِيلًا
If the hypocrites and those in whose hearts is disease   and those who spread rumors in al-Madinah   do not cease, We will surely incite you against them; then they will not remain your neighbors therein except for a little.
meaning the one causing suspense,causing waves of unrest.and when it refers to earth then it means intense jolts.condition of intense earthquake
in the QURAN
Surat Al-Muzzammil (The Enshrouded One) - سورة المزمل
73:14
يَوْمَ تَرْجُفُ الْأَرْضُ وَالْجِبَالُ وَكَانَتِ الْجِبَالُ كَثِيبًا مَّهِيلًا
On the Day the earth and the mountains will convulse and the mountains will become a heap of sand pouring down.
8.4 MARA(MA-WA-RA)  :basic concept is of movement and swiftness.ANNAQATU TAMUWRU FI SAYRIHA اَلنَّاقَةُ تَمُوْرُ فِي سَيْرِهَا meaning she camel spreading dust by speeding swiftly.and MAWR مَوْر meaning fly in air by becoming dust.and MAR ASHSHAYEE مار الشئ meaning something moving to and fro owing to swift speed and to vibrate- to lose balance.
Surat Aţ-Ţūr (The Mount) - سورة الطور
52:9
يَوْمَ تَمُورُ السَّمَاءُ مَوْرًا
On the Day the heaven will sway with circular motion
Summary  :ZALZALA,RAJJA and RAJAFA all three of them are used commonly for EarthQuake.ZALZAL is common.RAJJA is initial condition and RAJF is intense condition. MARA is vibration and disorientation owing to swift speed in any thing.

9 KAB [When]
Synonyms: AYYAN اَيَّان MATA مَتَي
9.1 AYYAN  : to ask of time of something.ALLAH said
Surat An-Nāzi`āt (Those who drag forth) - سورة النازعات
79:42
يَسْأَلُونَكَ عَنِ السَّاعَةِ أَيَّانَ مُرْسَاهَا
They ask you, [O Muhammad], about the Hour: when is its arrival?
9.2 MATA  : in addition to time also give of the meaning of condition(If then) .In the QURAN
Surat As-Sajdah (The Prostration) - سورة السجدة
32:28
وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَٰذَا الْفَتْحُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَادِقِينَ
And they say, "When will be this conquest, if you should be truthful?"
Surat Yā-Sīn (Ya Sin) - سورة يس
36:48
وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَٰذَا الْوَعْدُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَادِقِينَ
And they say, "When is this promise, if you should be truthful?"

Synonyms: AYYAN اَيَّان MATA مَتَي

1. MAARNA [to hit, to strike]
Synonyms: DARABA, WAKAZA, SAKK, DAA’A’, DAMAGHA, RAJAMA, WAQAZA, NATAHA, JALADA
1.1 DARABA (ضَرَبَ):   This word is usually if followed by ‘ب’. DARABA (ضَرَبَ) means to hit or strike someone with hand or something and when it is followed by ‘ب’ then it refers the thing that is used for hitting; the tool or instrument used for hitting. This word is very commonly used to refer to striking. Allah says in the Quran
Surah Al-Baqarah (The cow): سورۃ البَقَرَۃ  2:60
فَقُلۡنَا ٱضۡرِب بِّعَصَاكَ ٱلۡحَجَرَ‌ۖ
“Strike the rock with your staff.”
1.2 WAKAZA (وَکَزَ):   To punch someone; to strike someone’s chest with palm or fist. In the Quran
Surah Al Qasas (The stories): سورۃ القَصَص 28:15
فَوَكَزَهُ مُوسَىٰ فَقَضَىٰ عَلَيْهِ ۖ
So Musa (Moses) struck him with his fist and killed him.
1.3 SAKKA (صَكَّ):   Means collision of two things with force and power causing sound. SAKK-AL-BAABA (صَكَّ الْبَابَ) means colliding of doors; also to hit on face, to slap or beat on face. In the Quran
Surah Adh-Dhariyaat (The Winnowing Winds): سورة الذاريات 51:29
فَصَكَّتْ وَجْهَهَا وَقَالَتْ عَجُوزٌ عَقِيمٌ
Then she beat her face, and said, "An old sterile woman!"
1.4 DAA’A’ (دَعَّ):   To push or repulse, to get someone out harshly. Allah says in the Quran
Surah Al-Maun (The Small Kindnesses):   سورة الماعون   107:2
فَذَٰلِكَ الَّذِي يَدُعُّ الْيَتِيمَ
That is he who repulses the orphan (harshly),
1.5 DAMAGHA (دَمَغَ):   Means to hit or injure someone on head or brains. Allah says in the Quran
Surah Al-Anbiya (the prophets): سورۃ الانَبیاء 21:18
بَلْ نَقْذِفُ بِالْحَقِّ عَلَى الْبَاطِلِ فَيَدْمَغُهُ
Nay! We cast the truth against the falsehood, so that it breaks its head,
1.6 RAJAMA (رَجَمَ):   1. To pelt stones at someone, or hit with stones from a distance. 2. To kill someone by hitting someone from a distance; to stone to death. Used in both the meanings. Both semantically and materially this word is used.   رَجۡمَۢا بِٱلۡغَيۡبِ‌ۖ (guessing at the unknown) (18:23) mean to throw stones without aiming and to talk on base of a guess or supposition. In the Quran
Surah Hud (Hud): سورۃ ھود 11:91
وَلَوۡلَا رَهۡطُكَ لَرَجَمۡنَـٰكَ‌ۖ
And if not for your family, we would have stoned you [to death];
PAGE - 776
1.7 WAQAZA (وَقَذَ):   Means to strike someone harshly with stone or stick that kills.  WAQZA (وَقْذَ) means a severe blow. WAQAZA (وَقَذَ) means to hit someone fatally (dictionary al Manjad).
1.8 NATAHA (نَطَحَ):   NATAH-AS-SAUR (نَطَحَ الثور) means a bull hitting with its horns. TANATA-HAL-KABSHAAN (تَنَاطَحَ الْکَبْشَان) means two sheeps banging against one another. NATEEH (نَطِیْح) means an animal killed by getting a blow from horns; or hit by horns (dictionary al Manjad). Allah says in the Quran
Surah Al-Maeda (The table spread): سورۃ المَائدہ 5:3
الْمُنْخَنِقَةُ وَالْمَوْقُوذَةُ وَالْمُتَرَدِّيَةُ وَالنَّطِيحَةُ
and [those animals] killed by strangling or by a violent blow or by a head-long fall or by the goring of horns,
1.9 JALADA (جَلَدَ):   JILD (جِلْد) (Plural JULOOD (جُلُوْد)) means skin on body, hide and JALADA (جَلَدَ) means to hit on skin. JALDATAN (جَلْدَۃً) means a whip whose effect remains till skin and causes no wound. To hit with a lash.
Surah Al-Noor (The light): سورۃ النور 24:2
الزَّانِيَةُ وَالزَّانِي فَاجْلِدُوا كُلَّ وَاحِدٍ مِّنْهُمَا مِائَةَ جَلْدَةٍ ۖ
The [unmarried] woman or [unmarried] man found guilty of sexual intercourse - lash each one of them with a hundred lashes,
Summary:
1.1 DARABA: Commonly used. To hit.
1.2 WAKAZA: To punch.
1.3 SAKK: To hit or beat face with hand.
1.4 DAA’A’: To push or shove.
1.5 DAMAGHA: To hit and injure head.
1.6 RAJAMA: To stone from distance, stone to death.
1.7 WAQAZA: To hit harshly with a stick or stone.
1.8 NATAHA: Hitting with horns by a four legged animal.
1.9 JALADA: To lash.

10 MAJLIS [Gathering, council]
Synonyms: MAJLIS, NAADI
10.1 MAJLIS (مجلس):   (Plural MAJALIS (مجالس)) Any place where people gather for some purpose. A gathering for some event at home. A famous word. Allah says in the Quran
Surah Al-Mujadila (The Pleading Women) سُوۡرَةُ المجَادلة 58:11
إِذَا قِيلَ لَكُمْ تَفَسَّحُوا فِي الْمَجَالِسِ فَافْسَحُوا
When you are told to make room in your gatherings, make room;
10.2 NAADI (نَادِی):   A gathering of people in which there is chatting and storytelling. Club, feast, places for recreation, or obscenity or lewdness. ANNADWAH (الندوۃ) means welfare. Gathering on National or religious matters. In the Quran
Surah Al-Ankaboot  (The Spider): سُوۡرَةُ العَنکبوت 29:29
وَتَأْتُونَ فِي نَادِيكُمُ الْمُنكَرَ
commit lewdness in your gatherings
Synonyms:
10.1 MAJLIS: Gathering of family and friends
10.2 NAADI: Specific places where obscene things happen during gatherings i.e. clubs feasts, recreational places.

11 MACHILI [Fish]
Synonyms: HOOT, NOON
11.1 HOOT (حُوْت):   Gender noun. Refers to all kind of fish (Plural HEETAN (حِیْتَان))  حِيتَانُهُمْ (7:163). A big fish is called SAMAK (سمك) but this word is not used in Quran. The largest of fish i.e. whale is called NOON (نون). In case of Jonah (Hazrat Yunus (A.S)) both the words HOOT (حوت) and NOON (نون). For instance in Quran
Surah Al-Qalam (The Pen):سورۃ القلم  68:48
وَلَا تَكُن كَصَاحِبِ الْحُوتِ إِذْ نَادَىٰ وَهُوَ مَكْظُومٌ
do not be like the Fellow of the Fish who cried out in despair.
In another place in Holy Quran
Surah Al-Anbiya (the prophets): سورۃ الانَبیاء 21:87
وَذَا النُّونِ إِذ ذَّهَبَ مُغَاضِبًا
And [mention] the man of the fish, when he went off in anger
Both the ayah refer to same meaning that he (Jonah (Hazrat Yunus (A.S))) went into the belly of a fish.

raw_text:
12 MOHABBAT – MOHABBAT KERNA [Love, to love]
Synonyms: HABBA, MAHABBATAH, WADDA WUDDA, ALLAFA, SHAGHAFA, URUBAN
12.1 HABBA (حَبَّ) and MAHABBATAH (مَحَبَّةً):   Means to aim for something by thinking of it as good. To desire for and use wisdom in order to get, regardless of it being woman or child, or wealth and gold. HABBA (حَبَّ) and HABBATHA (حَبَّة) means a grain (i.e. wheat grain or barley). And HABBAT-UL-QALB (حَبَّةُ القلب ) means pleasure of heart. In the Quran
Surah Saad (Saad): سورۃ ص 38:32
فَقَالَ إِنِّي أَحْبَبْتُ حُبَّ الْخَيْرِ عَن ذِكْرِ رَبِّي حَتَّىٰ تَوَارَتْ بِالْحِجَابِ
He said, “I have preferred the love of niceties to the remembrance of my Lord—until it disappeared behind the veil.
Another place in the Quran
Surah Ta-Ha (Ta-ha): سورۃ طٰھٰ  20:39
وَأَلْقَيْتُ عَلَيْكَ مَحَبَّةً مِّنِّي
And I have bestowed upon you love from Me,
12.2 WADDA (وَدَّ):   To wish for something, to be friend, to love (dictionary al Manjad). This word sometimes only refers to wishing and desiring. For instance in Quran
Surah Al-Hijr (The Rock): سورۃ الحِجر 15:6
رُّبَمَا يَوَدُّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا لَوْ كَانُوا مُسْلِمِينَ
Perhaps those who disbelieve will wish that they had been Muslims.
And when it is used for referring to love, then it means extreme love. MAUDAH (مؤدۃ) means mutual love and care. WADOOD (وَدُوْد) means someone who is loving, WUDD (وُدّ) refers to love and caring
PAGE - 790
Surah Maryam (Mary): سُوۡرَةُ مَریَم 19:96
إِنَّ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ سَيَجْعَلُ لَهُمُ الرَّحْمَٰنُ وُدًّا
On those who believe and work deeds of righteousness, will (Allah) Most Gracious bestow love.
In another place in Quran
Surah Hud (Hud): سورۃ ھود 11:90
ۚ إِنَّ رَبِّي رَحِيمٌ وَدُودٌ
My Lord is Merciful and Loving.
Thus the word WADDA (وَدَّ) when refers to love then it is prolific to HABB (حَبَّ)
12.3 ALLAFA (اَلَّفَ):   To combine separated parts of something, from this word comes the word TALEEF (تالیف) which means to develop bonds and attachment. ULFAT (اُلْفَت)means love that is due to attachment. Allah says in the Quran
Surah Al-Anfal (The Spoils of War): سُوۡرَةُ الاٴنفَال 8:63
لَوْ أَنفَقْتَ مَا فِي الْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًا مَّا أَلَّفْتَ بَيْنَ قُلُوبِهِمْ وَلَٰكِنَّ اللَّهَ أَلَّفَ بَيْنَهُمْ
If you had spent all that is in the earth, you could not have brought their hearts together;
12.4 SHAGHAFA (شَغَفَ):   SHAGHAFAT-UL-QALB (شَغَفَۃُ ٓالْقَلْْب) means the interior of heart. Meaning membrane of heart. SHAGHAFA (شَغَفَ) means to hurt the membrane of heart. SHAGHAFA HUBBAN (شَغَفَ حُبًّا) means love penetrating deep in heart. To be insanely or deeply in love. In the Quran
Surah Yusuf (Joseph): سورۃ یُوسُف 12:30
قَدْ شَغَفَهَا حُبًّا ۖ
She is deeply in love with him
12.5 URUBAN (عُرُبًا):   (singular AROOB (عَرُوب)) AROOB (عَرُوب) means a woman who loves her husband or a lively woman. In the Quran
Surah Al-Waqiah (The Inevitable): سُوۡرَةُ الواقِعَة 56:36
فَجَعَلْنَاهُنَّ أَبْكَارًا عُرُبًا أَتْرَابًا
Then We have made them virgins, Loving (their husbands only), equal in age.
Summary:
12.1 HABBA: Aim and desire for something
12.2 WADDA: To HABB to love dearly, to love.
12.3 ALLAFA: Love due to bonds and attachment,
12.4 SHAGHAFA HUBBA: Extreme love,
12.5 URUBAN: A loving wife, a woman who loves her husband
For MUHTAJ and MUHTAJI [Needy] see TANGDASTI [hardship]

إِنَّ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ سَيَجْعَلُ لَهُمُ الرَّحْمَٰنُ وُدًّا

On those who believe and work deeds of righteousness, will (Allah) Most Gracious bestow love.

In another place in Quran

Surah Hud (Hud): سورۃ ھود 11:90

ۚ إِنَّ رَبِّي رَحِيمٌ وَدُودٌ

My Lord is Merciful and Loving.

Thus the word WADDA (وَدَّ) when refers to love then it is prolific to HABB (حَبَّ)

12.3 ALLAFA (اَلَّفَ): To combine separated parts of something, from this word comes the word TALEEF (تالیف) which means to develop bonds and attachment. ULFAT (اُلْفَت)means love that is due to attachment. Allah says in the Quran

Surah Al-Anfal (The Spoils of War): سُوۡرَةُ الاٴنفَال 8:63

لَوْ أَنفَقْتَ مَا فِي الْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًا مَّا أَلَّفْتَ بَيْنَ قُلُوبِهِمْ وَلَٰكِنَّ اللَّهَ أَلَّفَ بَيْنَهُمْ

 If you had spent all that is in the earth, you could not have brought their hearts together;

12.4 SHAGHAFA (شَغَفَ): SHAGHAFAT-UL-QALB (شَغَفَۃُ ٓالْقَلْْب) means the interior of heart. Meaning membrane of heart. SHAGHAFA (شَغَفَ) means to hurt the membrane of heart. SHAGHAFA HUBBAN (شَغَفَ حُبًّا) means love penetrating deep in heart. To be insanely or deeply in love. In the Quran

Surah Yusuf (Joseph): سورۃ یُوسُف 12:30

قَدْ شَغَفَهَا حُبًّا ۖ

She is deeply in love with him

12.5 URUBAN (عُرُبًا): (singular AROOB (عَرُوب)) AROOB (عَرُوب) means a woman who loves her husband or a lively woman. In the Quran

Surah Al-Waqiah (The Inevitable): سُوۡرَةُ الواقِعَة 56:36

فَجَعَلْنَاهُنَّ أَبْكَارًا عُرُبًا أَتْرَابًا

Then We have made them virgins, Loving (their husbands only), equal in age.

Summary:

12.1 HABBA: Aim and desire for something

12.2 WADDA: To HABB to love dearly, to love.

12.3 ALLAFA: Love due to bonds and attachment,

12.4 SHAGHAFA HUBBA: Extreme love,

12.5 URUBAN: A loving wife, a woman who loves her husband

For MUHTAJ and MUHTAJI [Needy] see TANGDASTI [hardship]

13 MAHAL
[Palace]
Synonyms: QASAR(  قصر  ), SARAH(  صرح   )
13.1 qasar(  قصر  )  : The abodes of the rulers of Rome were called qasar(  قصر  ). Then this word started to be used for every tall and magnificent building (pl:qasoor   قصور )  . It is stated in the Quran:
________________
Surat Al-Hajj (The Pilgrimage) -   سُوۡرَةُ الحَجّ
22:45
فَهِىَ خَاوِيَةٌ عَلَىٰ عُرُوشِهَا وَبِئۡرٍ۬ مُّعَطَّلَةٍ۬ وَقَصۡرٍ۬ مَّشِيدٍ
How many a township have We destroyed while it was sinful, so that it lieth (to this day) in ruins, and (how many) a deserted well and lofty tower!
________________
13.2 sarah (  صرح   ):   saraha(  صرح  ) means to be pure and free from impurities. And sarah(  صرح  ) means such a decorated and high rise house that does not have any fault. It is stated in the Quran:
________________
Surat Al-Naml(The Ants) -   سُوۡرَةُ النَّمل
27:44
فَلَمَّا رَأَتۡهُ حَسِبَتۡهُ لُجَّةً۬ وَكَشَفَتۡ عَن سَاقَيۡهَا‌ۚ قَالَ إِنَّهُ ۥ صَرۡحٌ۬ مُّمَرَّدٌ۬ مِّن قَوَارِيرَ‌ۗ
It was said unto her: Enter the hall. And when she saw it she deemed it a pool and bared her legs. (Solomon) said: Lo! it is a hall, made smooth, of glass. She said: My Lord! Lo! I have wronged myself, and I surrender with Solomon unto Allah, the Lord of the Worlds.
________________
Summary:
1. QASAR(  قصر  ): any magnificent and high rising house.
2. SARAH(  صرح  ): any building that is decorated with carvings and artwork and is free from faults.

raw_text:
14 MEHNAT MUSHAQQAT KERNA, UTHAANA
[To work hard]
Synonyms: AMILA(  عمل  ), JAHADA(  جهد  ), NASABA(  نصب  ), KALLAFA(  كلف  ), KADAHA(  كدح  ), KURHUN(  كره  ), SHIQQA(  شق  ), SHUQQA(  شقه  )
14.1 amila(  عمل  )  : amal(  عمل  ) is all those acts which any living being does with its own will and consent although the act may be right or wrong. And the word amila(  عمل  ) has been used to depict some act done by hard work and labor or in other words, it is also used to depict earning of living. Allah states that:
________________
Surat Al-Kahf (The Cave) -   سُوۡرَةُ الکهف
18:79
أَمَّا ٱلسَّفِينَةُ فَكَانَتۡ لِمَسَـٰكِينَ يَعۡمَلُونَ فِى ٱلۡبَحۡرِ
As for the ship, it belonged to poor people working on the river, and I wished to mar it, for there was a king behind them who is taking every ship by force.
________________
14.2 jahada (  جهد  )  : meaning to utilize all your resources in getting something done, to make complete effort. Allah states that:
________________
Surat Al-Ankaboot (The Spider) -   سُوۡرَةُ العَنکبوت
29:6
وَمَن جَـٰهَدَ فَإِنَّمَا يُجَـٰهِدُ لِنَفۡسِهِۦۤ‌ۚ
And whosoever striveth, striveth only for himself, for lo! Allah is altogether Independent of (His) creatures.
________________
And juhd(  نصب  ) meaning that capable effort which a man can do. It is stated in the Quran:
________________
Surat Al-Tawba (Repentance) -   سُوۡرَةُ التّوبَة
9:79
وَٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَجِدُونَ إِلَّا جُهۡدَهُمۡ
Those who point at such of the believers as give the alms willingly and such as can find naught to give but their endeavours, and deride them - Allah (Himself) derideth them. Theirs will be a painful doom.
________________
14.3 nasaba(  نصب  )  : such hard work which tires a man (1) hard work (2) to feel tired. Then this word is also used for separate meanings. It is stated in the Quran:
________________
Surat Al-Kahf(The Cave)  -   سُوۡرَةُ الکهف
18:62
لَقَدۡ لَقِينَا مِن سَفَرِنَا هَـٰذَا نَصَبً۬ا
And when they had gone further, he said unto his servant: Bring us our breakfast. Verily we have found fatigue in this our journey.
________________
At another location it is stated:
________________
Surat Ash-Sharh (Solace) -   سُوۡرَةُ الشَّرح
94:7-8
وَإِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ فَٱرۡغَب فَإِذَا فَرَغۡتَ فَٱنصَبۡ
So when thou art relieved, still toil (7) And strive to please thy Lord.
________________
14.4 kallafa (  كلف  )  : meaning to hurt someone. To ask someone to work that much hard which is in his capability and not more than his capacity and strength. Allah states that:
________________
Surat Al-Baqarah (The Cow) -   سُوۡرَةُ البَقَرَة
2:286
لَا يُكَلِّفُ ٱللَّهُ نَفۡسًا إِلَّا وُسۡعَهَا‌ۚ
Allah tasketh not a soul beyond its scope. For it (is only) that which it hath earned, and against it (only) that which it hath deserved. Our Lord! Condemn us not if we forget, or miss the mark! Our Lord! Lay not on us such a burden as thou didst lay on those before us! Our Lord! Impose not on us that which we have not the strength to bear! Pardon us, absolve us and have mercy on us, Thou, our Protector, and give us victory over the disbelieving folk.
________________
14.5 kadaha (  كدح  )  : to work by enduring pain and keep on working laboriously. Allah states that:
________________
Surat Al-Inshiqaq (The Sundering) -   سُوۡرَةُ الانشقاق
84:6
يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلۡإِنسَـٰنُ إِنَّكَ كَادِحٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ كَدۡحً۬ا فَمُلَـٰقِيهِ
Thou, verily, O man, art working toward thy Lord a work which thou wilt meet (in His presence).
________________
14.6 kurah (  كره  )  : meaning forceful labor. That kind of laborious work in which the man’s will and consent is of no significance and he does not like that work. It is stated in the Quran:
________________
Surat Al-Ahqaf (The Dunes) -   سُوۡرَةُ الاٴحقاف
46:15
حَمَلَتۡهُ أُمُّهُ ۥ كُرۡهً۬ا وَوَضَعَتۡهُ كُرۡهً۬ا‌ۖ
And We have commended unto man kindness toward parents. His mother beareth him with reluctance, and bringeth him forth with reluctance, and the bearing of him and the weaning of him is thirty months, till, when he attaineth full strength and reacheth forty years, he saith: My Lord! Arouse me that I may give thanks for the favour wherewith Thou hast favoured me and my parents, and that I may do right acceptable unto Thee. And be gracious unto me in the matter of my seed. Lo! I have turned unto Thee repentant, and lo! I am of those who surrender (unto Thee).
________________
And akraha(  اكره  ) means to force someone to do that kind of work which he dislikes as is stated:
________________
Surat Al-Noor (The Light) -   سُوۡرَةُ النُّور
24:33
وَلَا تُكۡرِهُواْ فَتَيَـٰتِكُمۡ عَلَى ٱلۡبِغَآءِ
And let those who cannot find a match keep chaste till Allah give them independence by His grace. And such of your slaves as seek a writing (of emancipation), write it for them if ye are aware of aught of good in them, and bestow upon them of the wealth of Allah which He hath bestowed upon you. Force not your slave-girls to whoredom that ye may seek enjoyment of the life of the world, if they would preserve their chastity. And if one force them, then (unto them), after their compulsion, lo! Allah will be Forgiving, Merciful.
________________
14.7 shiqq (  شق  )  : such hard work and effort which affects the person’s body and soul. It is stated in the Quran:
________________
Surat An-Nahl (The Bee) -   سُوۡرَةُ النّحل
16:7
وَتَحۡمِلُ أَثۡقَالَڪُمۡ إِلَىٰ بَلَدٍ۬ لَّمۡ تَكُونُواْ بَـٰلِغِيهِ إِلَّا بِشِقِّ ٱلۡأَنفُسِ‌ۚ
And they bear your loads for you unto a land ye could not reach save with great trouble to yourselves. Lo! your Lord is Full of Pity, Merciful.
________________
14.8 shuqqah (  شقه  )  : The difference between shiq(  شق  ) and shuqqa(  شقه  )is the same as the difference between hamal(  حمل  ) and himal(  حمل  ) or waqar(  وقر  ) and wiqar(  وقر  ) (for details see ‘bojh’(  بوجه  )) meaning that destination which a person reaches through hard work. It is stated in the Quran:
________________
Surat Al-Tawba (Repentance) -   سُوۡرَةُ التّوبَة
9:42
لَوۡ كَانَ عَرَضً۬ا قَرِيبً۬ا وَسَفَرً۬ا قَاصِدً۬ا لَّٱتَّبَعُوكَ وَلَـٰكِنۢ بَعُدَتۡ عَلَيۡہِمُ ٱلشُّقَّةُ‌ۚ
Had it been a near adventure and an easy journey they had followed thee, but the distance seemed too far for them. Yet will they swear by Allah (saying): If we had been able we would surely have set out with you. They destroy their souls, and Allah knoweth that they verily are liars.
________________
Summary:
1.AMILA(  عمل  ): to work hard and do labor, common word with common use.
2. JAHADA(  جهد  ): to utilize all resources in getting something done.
3. NASABA(  نصب  ): that hard work which tires you or is the reason for tiring.
4.KALLAFA(  كلف  ): hard work according to one’s capacity and strength.
5. KADAHA(  كدح  ): to keep on working even while enduring pain.
6. KURAH(  كره  ): forced labor.
7.SHIQQ(  شق  ): the agony of hard work.
8. SHUQQA(  شقه  ): that destination which is achieved through hard work.

15 MUKHALAFAT, MUKHALAFAT KERNA
[Opposition, to oppose]
Synonyms: KHAALAFA(  خالف  ), ZADDA(  ضد  ), SHAAQQA(  شاق  ), HAADDA(  حاد  ), TA’ASARA(  تعاسر  ), A’NADA(  عند   )
15.1 khaalafa(  خالف  )  : meaning to oppose, to contest and meaning to oppose something and be against it, to do something other than what was told to be done. It is stated in the Quran:
________________
Surat Hud  -   سُوۡرَةُ هُود
11:88
وَمَآ أُرِيدُ أَنۡ أُخَالِفَكُمۡ إِلَىٰ مَآ أَsنۡهَٮٰڪُمۡ عَنۡهُ‌ۚ
He said: O my people! Bethink you: if I am (acting) on a clear proof from my Lord and He sustaineth me with fair sustenance from Him (how can I concede aught to you)? I desire not to do behind your backs that which I ask you not to do. I desire naught save reform so far as I am able. My welfare is only in Allah. In Him I trust and unto Him I turn (repentant).
________________
15.2 zadda (  جاس  )  : meaning to oppose and zidd(  ضد  ) meaning the one who opposes, competitor. Two things of competition are called ziddain(  ضدين  ). According to Imam Raghib, the definition of ziddain(  ضدين  ) is those two things which are each other’s competitors and of the same sex and can never be added together such as white and black (their sex is color or shade). According to Ibn al Faris, the definition of ziddain(  ضدين  ) is those two competitor things which cannot occur at the same time such as day and night. Thus it is derived from the word khalaaf(  خلاف  ). Meaning that every zidd(  ضد  ) is khalaaf(  خلاف  ) but not every khalaaf(  خلاف  ) is zidd(  ضد  ). It is stated in the Quran:
________________
Surat Maryam  -   سُوۡرَةُ مَریَم
19:82
كَلَّا‌ۚ سَيَكۡفُرُونَ بِعِبَادَتِہِمۡ وَيَكُونُونَ عَلَيۡہِمۡ ضِدًّا
Nay, but they will deny their worship of them, and become opponents unto them.
________________
And the word zidd(  ضد  ) itself is derived from izdaad(  اضداد  ). That is, zadd(  ضد  ) meaning opposition and competitor, and zidd(  ضد  ) meaning example and instance as well.
15.3 shaaqqa(  شاق  )  : meaning to oppose, to hold a grudge and shaqqa(  شاق  ) meaning rift and shiqaq(  شقاق  ) meaning hostility, conflict, opposition, such type of opposition in which each party adopts the point of opposition i.e. one adopts that trait which the other one dislikes. Allah states that:
________________
Surat Al-Hashr (Exile) -   سُوۡرَةُ الحَشر
59:4
ذَٲلِكَ بِأَنَّہُمۡ شَآقُّواْ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ ۥ‌ۖ وَمَن يُشَآقِّ ٱللَّهَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ شَدِيدُ ٱلۡعِقَابِ
That is because they were opposed to Allah and His messenger; and whoso is opposed to Allah, (for him) verily Allah is stern in reprisal.
________________
15.4 haadda(  حاد  )  : hadd-un-nazar(  حد النظر  ) meaning to stare strongly and had-us-saif(  حد السيف  ) meaning a sword’s edge. Hadd-as-sakeen(  حد السكين  ) meaning to sharpen a knife and haada(  حاد  ) means to keep enmity, to become furious. Thus haadda(  حاد  ) means such an opposition and enmity which makes a man furious enough to fight and take revenge. Allah states that:
________________
Surat Al-Tawba (Repentance) -   سُوۡرَةُ التّوبَة
9:63
أَلَمۡ يَعۡلَمُوٓاْ أَنَّهُ ۥ مَن يُحَادِدِ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ ۥ فَأَنَّ لَهُ ۥ نَارَ جَهَنَّمَ خَـٰلِدً۬ا فِيہَا‌ۚ
Know they not that whoso opposeth Allah and His messenger, his portion verily is hell, to abide therein? That is the extreme abasement
________________
15.5 ta’asara(  تعاسر  )  : usr(  عسر  ) meaning difficulty, assar-al-amar(  عسرالامر  ) meaning he made the task difficult for someone and made him suffer. And ta’asara(  تعاسر  ) meaning to oppose each other in such a way that the matter becomes difficult for the other. Ta’asara(  تعاسر  ) does not include the severity of opposition and enmity but one party adopts such a practice which becomes difficult for the other. Allah states that:
________________
Surat At-Talaq (Divorce) -   سُوۡرَةُ الطّلاَق
65:6
وَأۡتَمِرُواْ بَيۡنَكُم بِمَعۡرُوفٍ۬‌ۖ وَإِن تَعَاسَرۡتُمۡ فَسَتُرۡضِعُ لَهُ ۥۤ أُخۡرَىٰ
Lodge them where ye dwell, according to your wealth, and harass them not so as to straiten life for them. And if they are with child, then spend for them till they bring forth their burden. Then, if they give suck for you, give them their due payment and consult together in kindness; but if ye make difficulties for one another, then let some other woman give suck for him (the father of the child).
________________
15.6 a’nada(  عند  )  : meaning to purposely oppose truth and justice’s way. A’need(  عنيد  ) meaning that person who holds a resentment against the right path and opposes it. And a’nood(  عنود  ) meaning that person who deviates from the right path. Allah states that:
________________
Surat Al-Mudassir (The Cloaked One) -   سُوۡرَةُ المدَّثِّر
74:16
إِنَّهُ ۥ كَانَ لِأَيَـٰتِنَا عَنِيدً۬ا
Nay! For lo! he hath been stubborn to Our revelations
________________
Summary:
1. KHAALAF(  خالف  ): to oppose, to be against.
2. ZADDA(  ضد  ): derived from khaalaf(), to oppose and fight against.
3.  SHAAQQA(  شاق  ): to become a competitor and enemy.
4. HAADDA(  حاد  ): such an enmity in which someone comes down to fight.
5. TA’ASARA(  تعاسر  ): such a hostility in which one party makes things difficult for the other.
6. A’NADA(  عند  ): to oppose truth and the right path.

16 MUKHTALIF
[Different]
Synonyms: MUKHTALIF(  مختلف  ), SHATTA (  شتي  )(   شت)  , AZWAAJ(  ازواج  )
16.1 mukhtalif(  مختلف  )  : disagreement (antonym agreement), to keep things separately, to be of different forms and varieties, to be unusual. To have a difference of opinion in some matter. Allah states that:
________________
Surat An-Nahl (The Bee) -   سُوۡرَةُ النّحل
16:69
يَخۡرُجُ مِنۢ بُطُونِهَا شَرَابٌ۬ مُّخۡتَلِفٌ أَلۡوَٲنُهُ ۥ فِيهِ شِفَآءٌ۬ لِّلنَّاسِ‌ۗ
Then eat of all fruits, and follow the ways of thy Lord, made smooth (for thee). There cometh forth from their bellies a drink divers of hues, wherein is healing for mankind. Lo! herein is indeed a portent for people who reflect.
________________
At another point it is stated:
________________
Surat Al-Anaam(Cattle) -   سُوۡرَةُ الاٴنعَام
6:141
وَٱلنَّخۡلَ وَٱلزَّرۡعَ مُخۡتَلِفًا أُڪُلُهُ
He it is Who produceth gardens trellised and untrellised, and the date-palm, and crops of divers flavour, and the olive and the pomegranate, like and unlike. Eat ye of the fruit thereof when it fruiteth, and pay the due thereof upon the harvest day, and be not prodigal. Lo! Allah loveth not the prodigals.
________________
16.2 shatta (  شتي  )  : meaning to destroy something, to become disordered (antonym allaf(  ألف  ) meaning to bring together and join the separated pieces of something). Shateet(  شتيت  ) means dissimilative, deviant. It is stated in the Quran:
________________
Surat Al-Hashr (Exile) -   سُوۡرَةُ الحَشر
59:14
تَحۡسَبُهُمۡ جَمِيعً۬ا وَقُلُوبُهُمۡ شَتَّىٰ‌ۚ
They will not fight against you in a body save in fortified villages or from behind walls. Their adversity among themselves is very great. Ye think of them as a whole whereas their hearts are divers. That is because they are a folk who have no sense.
________________
At another point it is stated:
________________
Surat Al-Zalzala(The Earthquake) -   سُوۡرَةُ الزّلزَلة
99:6
يَوۡمَٮِٕذٍ۬ يَصۡدُرُ ٱلنَّاسُ أَشۡتَاتً۬ا لِّيُرَوۡاْ أَعۡمَـٰلَهُمۡ
That day mankind will issue forth in scattered groups to be shown their deeds.
________________
16.3 azwaaj(  ازواج  )  : zauj(  زوج  ) meaning couple and each member of a couple. For example, husband is the zauj(  زوج  ) of wife and wife is the zauj(  زوج  ) of husband. And husband and wife together are also one zauj(  زوج  ). Whichever creation has male and female members, it has the concept of zauj(  زوج  ). The concept of male and female has been evident to man in animals and plants but this aspect is also found in material things as well. Allah states that:
________________
Surat Az-Zariyat (The Scatterers) -   سُوۡرَةُ الذّاریَات
51:49
وَمِن ڪُلِّ شَىۡءٍ خَلَقۡنَا زَوۡجَيۡنِ
And all things We have created by pairs, that haply ye may reflect.
________________
Because zauj(  زوج  ) also includes in itself the aspect of companionship and friendship, hence zauj(  زوج  ) is also applicable for a collection of a few same sex living things. In this case, zauj(  زوج  ) means form, type, or variety. Allah states that:
________________
Surat Al-Waqia (The Event) -   سُوۡرَةُ الواقِعَة
56:7
وَكُنتُمۡ أَزۡوَٲجً۬ا ثَلَـٰثَةً۬
And ye will be three kinds:
________________
And the word azwaaj(  ازواج  ) is also used for different forms of same sex collections. Each of these collections will be  thought of as one entity and the meaning of azwaaj(  ازواج  ) would thus be different varieties of such collections. Allah states that:
________________
Surat Ta-Ha -   سُوۡرَةُ طٰه
20:131
وَلَا تَمُدَّنَّ عَيۡنَيۡكَ إِلَىٰ مَا مَتَّعۡنَا بِهِۦۤ أَزۡوَٲجً۬ا مِّنۡہُمۡ
And strain not thine eyes toward that which We cause some wedded pairs among them to enjoy, the flower of the life of the world, that We may try them thereby. The provision of thy Lord is better and more lasting.
________________
Summary:
1. MUKHTALIF(  مختلف  ): when things differ from one another, this word will be used.
2.When the collection of distributed pieces of the same thing is to be depicted, it would be SHATTA(  شتي  ) and
3. when different forms of same sex things have to be depicted, it would be AZWAAJ(  ازواج  ).

17 MUDDAT
[Time period]
Synonyms: MUDDAT(  مدت  ), AMAD(  امد  ), IDDAT(  عدت  ), UMMAH(  امه  )  , MALIYYAH(  مليا  ), MAHL(  مهل  ), UMUR(  عمر  )
(For ajjal(  اجل  ), heen(  حين  ) and meeqaat(  ميقات  ), see waqt(  وقت  ))
17.1 muddat(  مدت  )  : madda(  مد  ) meaning to pull and lengthen through pulling, muddat(  مدت  ) is derived from it, meaning the length of time. It’s a common word and its use is also common. Allah states that:
________________
Surat Al- Tawba (Repentance) -   سُوۡرَةُ التّوبَة
9:4
فَأَتِمُّوٓاْ إِلَيۡهِمۡ عَهۡدَهُمۡ إِلَىٰ مُدَّتِہِمۡ‌ۚ
Excepting those of the idolaters with whom ye (Muslims) have a treaty, and who have since abated nothing of your right nor have supported anyone against you. (As for these), fulfil their treaty to them till their term. Lo! Allah loveth those who keep their duty (unto Him).
________________
17.2 amada (  امد  )  : The word amada(  امد  ) is used to depict a long time period and used for showing the excess and commonality of time period. This word is used to measure time and place. If used in terms of place, it means distance. Allah states that:
________________
Surat Al-Kahf(The Cave) -   سُوۡرَةُ الکهف
18:12

73:11
وَذَرۡنِى وَٱلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ أُوْلِى ٱلنَّعۡمَةِ وَمَهِّلۡهُمۡ قَلِيلاً
Leave Me to deal with the deniers, lords of ease and comfort (in this life); and do thou respite them awhile.
________________

But We brought forth generations, and their lives dragged on for them. And thou wast not a dweller in Midian, reciting unto them Our revelations, but We kept sending (messengers to men).
________________

18 MADAD DENA, KERNA AUR CHAHNA
[To help, be helped and ask for help]
Synonyms: AA’ANA(  اعان  ), ISTA’AN(  استعان  ), NASARA(  نصر  ), ISTANSAR(  استنصر  ), AYYAD(  أيد  ), UZZAR(  عزر  ), AZZAZ(  عزز  ), ZAAHARA(  ظاهر  ), RAFADA(  رفد  ), RADA(  ردأ  ), AMADDA(  أمد  )
18.1 aa’ana(  اعان  )  : awn(  عون  ) meaning helper and aa’an(  اعان  ) meaning to help someone, to assist and ta’awun(  تعاون  ) meaning to help each other and assist each other. This word is common. It is stated in the Quran:
________________
Surat Al-Kahf (The Cave) -   سُوۡرَةُ الکهف
18:95
فَأَعِينُونِى بِقُوَّةٍ أَجۡعَلۡ بَيۡنَكُمۡ وَبَيۡنَہُمۡ رَدۡمًا
He said: That wherein my Lord hath established me is better (than your tribute). Do but help me with strength (of men), I will set between you and them a bank.
________________
And ista’an(  استعان  ) meaning to ask from someone’s help and assistance. It is stated in the Quran:
________________
Surat Al-Fatiha (The Opening) -   سُوۡرَةُ الفَاتِحَة
1:5
إِيَّاكَ نَعۡبُدُ وَإِيَّاكَ نَسۡتَعِينُ
Thee (alone) we worship; Thee (alone) we ask for help.
________________
18.2 nasara (  نصر  )  : meaning to help someone get out of misery and oppression. And it is derived from aa’nat(  اعانت  ). Allah states that:
________________
Surat Al-E-Imran(Family of Imran)  -   سُوۡرَةُ آل عِمرَان
3:123
وَلَقَدۡ نَصَرَكُمُ ٱللَّهُ بِبَدۡرٍ۬ وَأَنتُمۡ أَذِلَّةٌ۬‌ۖ
Allah had already given you the victory at Badr, when ye were contemptible. So observe your duty to Allah in order that ye may be thankful.
________________
And istansar(  استنصر  ) meaning to ask from someone’s help to take you out of oppression and cruelty. Allah states that:
________________
Surat Al-Anfal (The Spoils of War) -   سُوۡرَةُ الاٴنفَال
8:72
وَإِنِ ٱسۡتَنصَرُوكُمۡ فِى ٱلدِّينِ فَعَلَيۡڪُمُ ٱلنَّصۡرُ
Lo! those who believed and left their homes and strove with their wealth and their lives for the cause of Allah, and those who took them in and helped them: these are protecting friends one of another. And those who believed but did not leave their homes, ye have no duty to protect them till they leave their homes; but if they seek help from you in the matter of religion then it is your duty to help (them) except against a folk between whom and you there is a treaty. Allah is Seer of what ye do.
________________
18.3 ayyad(  أيد  )  : alayyad(  الأيد  ) meaning great strength and ayyad(  أيد  ) meaning to help someone to make him gain strength. Allah states that:
________________
Surat Al-Tawba (Repentence) -   سُوۡرَةُ التّوبَة
9:40
فَأَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ سَڪِينَتَهُ ۥ عَلَيۡهِ وَأَيَّدَهُ ۥ بِجُنُودٍ۬ لَّمۡ تَرَوۡهَا
If ye help him not, still Allah helped him when those who disbelieve drove him forth, the second of two; when they two were in the cave, when he said unto his comrade: Grieve not. Lo! Allah is with us. Then Allah caused His peace of reassurance to descend upon him and supported him with hosts ye cannot see, and made the word of those who disbelieved the nethermost, while Allah's Word it was that became the uppermost. Allah is Mighty, Wise.
________________
18.4 azzara(  عزر  )  : meaning to help someone out of act of reverence. Allah states that:
________________
Surat Al-Fath (Victory) -   سُوۡرَةُ الفَتْح
48:9
لِّتُؤۡمِنُواْ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ وَتُعَزِّرُوهُ وَتُوَقِّرُوهُ
That ye (mankind) may believe in Allah and His messenger, and may honour Him, and may revere Him, and may glorify Him at early dawn and at the close of day.
________________
18.5 azzaza(  عزز  )  : meaning to help someone to such an extent that his weakness is overcome (for details, see ‘izzat dena’). Allah states that:
________________
Surat Ya-Seen -   سُوۡرَةُ یسٓ
36:14
إِذۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَآ إِلَيۡہِمُ ٱثۡنَيۡنِ فَكَذَّبُوهُمَا فَعَزَّزۡنَا بِثَالِثٍ۬
When We sent unto them twain, and they denied them both, so We reinforced them with a third, and they said: Lo! we have been sent unto you.
________________
18.6 zaahara(  ظاهر  )  : two points are prominent in zahar(  زهر)   (1) to become evident, to come forward, to become prominent (2) back. Zaahara(  ظاهر  ) meaning to give such strength to someone to enable him to work, to be behind someone. Allah states that:
________________
Surat Al-Ahzab(The Clans) -   سُوۡرَةُ الاٴحزَاب
33:26
وَأَنزَلَ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَـٰهَرُوهُم مِّنۡ أَهۡلِ ٱلۡكِتَـٰبِ مِن صَيَاصِيهِمۡ
And He brought those of the People of the Scripture who supported them down from their strongholds, and cast panic into their hearts. Some ye slew, and ye made captive some.
________________
18.7 rafada(  رفد  )  : to help some poor or deprived person through charity and aids. (for details, see ‘daina’). Allah states that:
________________
Surat Hud -   سُوۡرَةُ هُود
11:99
وَأُتۡبِعُواْ فِى هَـٰذِهِۦ لَعۡنَةً۬ وَيَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَـٰمَةِ‌ۚ بِئۡسَ ٱلرِّفۡدُ ٱلۡمَرۡفُودُ
A curse is made to follow them in the world and on the Day of Resurrection. Hapless is the gift (that will be) given (them)
________________
18.8 rada’(  ردأ  )  : meaning to make a strong wall and rada arrajal(  ردا الرجال  ) meaning to be someone’s custodian, to be a helper and ridd(  رد  ) meaning custodian, helper meaning any such helper who always remains with you. It is stated in the Quran:
________________
Surat Al-Qasas(The Story) -   سُوۡرَةُ القَصَص
28:34
وَأَخِى هَـٰرُونُ هُوَ أَفۡصَحُ مِنِّى لِسَانً۬ا فَأَرۡسِلۡهُ مَعِىَ رِدۡءً۬ا يُصَدِّقُنِىٓ‌ۖ
My brother Aaron is more eloquent than me in speech. Therefor send him with me as a helper to confirm me. Lo! I fear that they will give the lie to me.
________________
18.9 amadda(  أمد  )  : madda(  مد  ) meaning to pull something, to spread, to increase in such a way so as to maintain proportions. Amadda(  أمد  ) means to help by increasing something’s quantity and amount. Allah states that:
________________
Surat Nooh(Noah) -   سُوۡرَةُ نُوح
71:12
وَيُمۡدِدۡكُم بِأَمۡوَٲلٍ۬ وَبَنِينَ
And will help you with wealth and sons, and will assign unto you Gardens and will assign unto you rivers.
________________
At another point it is stated:
________________
Surat Al-E-Imran(Family of Imran) -   سُوۡرَةُ آل عِمرَان
3:125
يُمۡدِدۡكُمۡ رَبُّكُم بِخَمۡسَةِ ءَالَـٰفٍ۬ مِّنَ ٱلۡمَلَـٰٓٮِٕكَةِ مُسَوِّمِينَ
Nay, but if ye persevere, and keep from evil, and (the enemy) attack you suddenly, your Lord will help you with five thousand angels sweeping on.
________________
Summary:
1.AA’AN(  اعان  ):to help someone, any kind of help, it is common.
2. NASAR(  نصر  ): to help someone out of his misery.
3. AYYAD(  أيد  ): to help someone and make him gain strength.
4. AZZAR(  عزر  ): to help someone out of act of reverence.
5. AZZAZ(  عزز  ): to help someone to such an extent such that his weakness is overcome.
6. ZAAHARA(  ظاهر  ): to be on someone’s back.
7. RAFADA(  رفد  ): to help some poor through charity and aid and continue to help them.
8. RADA(  ردأ  ): to provide help all the time.
9. AMADDA(  أمد  ): to reinforce.
