18.3 ayyad(أيد): alayyad(الأيد) meaning great strength and ayyad(أيد) meaning to help someone to make him gain strength. Allah states that:

________________

Surat Al-Tawba (Repentence) - سُوۡرَةُ التّوبَة

9:40

فَأَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ سَڪِينَتَهُ ۥ عَلَيۡهِ وَأَيَّدَهُ ۥ بِجُنُودٍ۬ لَّمۡ تَرَوۡهَا

If ye help him not, still Allah helped him when those who disbelieve drove him forth, the second of two; when they two were in the cave, when he said unto his comrade: Grieve not. Lo! Allah is with us. Then Allah caused His peace of reassurance to descend upon him and supported him with hosts ye cannot see, and made the word of those who disbelieved the nethermost, while Allah's Word it was that became the uppermost. Allah is Mighty, Wise.

________________

18.4 azzara(عزر): meaning to help someone out of act of reverence. Allah states that:

________________

Surat Al-Fath (Victory) - سُوۡرَةُ الفَتْح

48:9

لِّتُؤۡمِنُواْ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ وَتُعَزِّرُوهُ وَتُوَقِّرُوهُ

That ye (mankind) may believe in Allah and His messenger, and may honour Him, and may revere Him, and may glorify Him at early dawn and at the close of day.

________________

18.5 azzaza(عزز): meaning to help someone to such an extent that his weakness is overcome (for details, see ‘izzat dena’). Allah states that:

________________

Surat Ya-Seen - سُوۡرَةُ یسٓ

36:14

إِذۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَآ إِلَيۡہِمُ ٱثۡنَيۡنِ فَكَذَّبُوهُمَا فَعَزَّزۡنَا بِثَالِثٍ۬

When We sent unto them twain, and they denied them both, so We reinforced them with a third, and they said: Lo! we have been sent unto you.

________________

18.6 zaahara(ظاهر): two points are prominent in zahar(زهر) (1) to become evident, to come forward, to become prominent (2) back. Zaahara(ظاهر) meaning to give such strength to someone to enable him to work, to be behind someone. Allah states that:

________________

Surat Al-Ahzab(The Clans) - سُوۡرَةُ الاٴحزَاب

33:26

وَأَنزَلَ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَـٰهَرُوهُم مِّنۡ أَهۡلِ ٱلۡكِتَـٰبِ مِن صَيَاصِيهِمۡ

And He brought those of the People of the Scripture who supported them down from their strongholds, and cast panic into their hearts. Some ye slew, and ye made captive some.

________________

18.7 rafada(رفد): to help some poor or deprived person through charity and aids. (for details, see ‘daina’). Allah states that:

________________

Surat Hud - سُوۡرَةُ هُود

11:99

وَأُتۡبِعُواْ فِى هَـٰذِهِۦ لَعۡنَةً۬ وَيَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَـٰمَةِ‌ۚ بِئۡسَ ٱلرِّفۡدُ ٱلۡمَرۡفُودُ

A curse is made to follow them in the world and on the Day of Resurrection. Hapless is the gift (that will be) given (them)

________________

18.8 rada’(ردأ): meaning to make a strong wall and rada arrajal(ردا الرجال) meaning to be someone’s custodian, to be a helper and ridd(رد) meaning custodian, helper meaning any such helper who always remains with you. It is stated in the Quran:

________________

Surat Al-Qasas(The Story) - سُوۡرَةُ القَصَص         

28:34

وَأَخِى هَـٰرُونُ هُوَ أَفۡصَحُ مِنِّى لِسَانً۬ا فَأَرۡسِلۡهُ مَعِىَ رِدۡءً۬ا يُصَدِّقُنِىٓ‌ۖ

My brother Aaron is more eloquent than me in speech. Therefor send him with me as a helper to confirm me. Lo! I fear that they will give the lie to me.

________________

18.9 amadda(أمد): madda(مد) meaning to pull something, to spread, to increase in such a way so as to maintain proportions. Amadda(أمد) means to help by increasing something’s quantity and amount. Allah states that:

________________

Surat Nooh(Noah) - سُوۡرَةُ نُوح

71:12

وَيُمۡدِدۡكُم بِأَمۡوَٲلٍ۬ وَبَنِينَ

And will help you with wealth and sons, and will assign unto you Gardens and will assign unto you rivers.

________________

At another point it is stated:

________________

Surat Al-E-Imran(Family of Imran) - سُوۡرَةُ آل عِمرَان

3:125

يُمۡدِدۡكُمۡ رَبُّكُم بِخَمۡسَةِ ءَالَـٰفٍ۬ مِّنَ ٱلۡمَلَـٰٓٮِٕكَةِ مُسَوِّمِينَ

Nay, but if ye persevere, and keep from evil, and (the enemy) attack you suddenly, your Lord will help you with five thousand angels sweeping on.

________________

Summary:

1.AA’AN(اعان):to help someone, any kind of help, it is common.

2. NASAR(نصر): to help someone out of his misery.

3. AYYAD(أيد): to help someone and make him gain strength.

4. AZZAR(عزر): to help someone out of act of reverence.

5. AZZAZ(عزز): to help someone to such an extent such that his weakness is overcome.

6. ZAAHARA(ظاهر): to be on someone’s back.

7. RAFADA(رفد): to help some poor through charity and aid and continue to help them.

8. RADA(ردأ): to provide help all the time.

9. AMADDA(أمد): to reinforce.

19 MADADGAAR
[Helper]
Synonyms: NASIR(  ناصر  ), NASEER(  نصير  ), ANSAAR(  انصار  ), HAWARI (  حواري  ), WALI(  ولي  ), MAULA(  مولى  ), SHAHEED(  شهيد  ), ZAHEER(  ظهير  ), WAZEER(  وزير  ), A’DUD(  عضد  )
19.1 nasir and naseer(  ناصر, نصير  )  : nasar(  نصر  ) meaning to help someone out of his oppression and nasir(  ناصر  ) is such a helper who helps at such an occasion. Its plural is nasar(  نصر  ) and ansaar(  انصار  ). Allah states that:
________________
Surat Muhammad -   سُوۡرَةُ محَمَّد
47:13
أَهۡلَكۡنَـٰهُمۡ فَلَا نَاصِرَ لَهُمۡ
And how many a township stronger than thy township (O Muhammad) which hath cast thee out, have We destroyed, and they had no helper!
________________
and naseer(  نصير  ) is that person who always comes for help at such situations (pl: nasara(  نصر  ) and ansaar(  انصار  )) and this word is usually used for Allah SWT in the Quran. Naseer(  نصير  ) meaning helper who helps with strength. Allah states that:
________________
Surat An-Nisa (Women) -   سُوۡرَةُ النِّسَاء
4:45
وَكَفَىٰ بِٱللَّهِ نَصِيرً۬ا
Allah knoweth best (who are) your enemies. Allah is sufficient as a Friend, and Allah is sufficient as a Helper.
________________
19.2 hawari (  حواري  )  : huwari(  حواري  ) meaning white alkali which is used to clean clothes etc. and meaning a person who gives advices, relative, helper. Hawari(  حواري  ) basically refers to those companions of Prophet Essa(Jesus) who helped him in his difficult times. And Prophet Muhammad PBUH said that every prophet had one hawari(  حواري  ) and my hawari(  حواري  ) is Zubair RA. It is stated in the Quran:
________________
Surat As-Saff(The Ranks)  -   سُوۡرَةُ الصَّف
61:14
قَالَ عِيسَى ٱبۡنُ مَرۡيَمَ لِلۡحَوَارِيِّـۧنَ مَنۡ أَنصَارِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ‌ۖ قَالَ ٱلۡحَوَارِيُّونَ نَحۡنُ أَنصَارُ ٱللَّهِ‌ۖ
O ye who believe! Be Allah's helpers, even as Jesus son of Mary said unto the disciples: Who are my helpers for Allah? They said: We are Allah's helpers. And a party of the Children of Israel believed, while a party disbelieved. Then We strengthened those who believed against their foe, and they became the uppermost.
________________
19.3 wali and mawali(  ولي, موالى  )  : alwilaa(  الولاء  ) meaning love, friendship, nearness, relation, and closeness. And walayah(  ولاية  ) means inheritance and mawali(  موالى  ) meaning heir. Allah states that:
________________
Surat An-Nisa (Women) -   سُوۡرَةُ النِّسَاء
4:33
وَلِڪُلٍّ۬ جَعَلۡنَا مَوَٲلِىَ مِمَّا تَرَكَ ٱلۡوَٲلِدَانِ وَٱلۡأَقۡرَبُونَ‌ۚ
And unto each We have appointed heirs of that which parents and near kindred leave; and as for those with whom your right hands have made a covenant, give them their due. Lo! Allah is ever Witness over all things.
________________
The custom of inheritance was common in Arab i.e. people would make any of their friends heirs apart from their relatives. Then this heir would be entitled to his inheritance and superior to the relatives. At first, Islam kept this tradition. This was common among the ansaar and mahajreen. After the conquest of Makkah, when Allah specified shares of relatives in the inheritance, then this custom was abolished. Thus the words wali(  ولي  ) and mawali(  موالى  ) include much more wholeness in various aspects as compared to nasir(  ناصر  ) and naseer(  نصير  ). It also means the one who favors, helps and is a friend. Wali(  ولي  ) means someone who helps through love and affection and not just to show other people.
________________
Surat Al-Baqarah (The Cow) -   سُوۡرَةُ البَقَرَة
2:107
وَمَا لَڪُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مِن وَلِىٍّ۬ وَلَا نَصِيرٍ
Knowest thou not that it is Allah unto Whom belongeth the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth; and ye have not, beside Allah, any friend or helper?
________________
At another point, it is stated:
_______________
Surat Al-Anfal (The Spoils of War) -   سُوۡرَةُ الاٴنفَال
8:40
وَإِن تَوَلَّوۡاْ فَٱعۡلَمُوٓاْ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ مَوۡلَٮٰكُمۡ‌ۚ نِعۡمَ ٱلۡمَوۡلَىٰ وَنِعۡمَ ٱلنَّصِيرُ
And if they turn away, then know that Allah is your Befriender - a transcendent Patron, a transcendent Helper!
________________
19.4 shaheed (  شهيد  )  : shahida(  شهد  ) meaning to testify whether this testimony is by seeing or feeling i.e. whether it is by sight or wisdom and it also means to be present. And shaheed(  شهيد  ) is also used for such a witness who comes in front of a judge and testifies and becomes a means for his help and assistance.
________________
Surat Al-Baqarah (The Cow) -   سُوۡرَةُ البَقَرَة
2:23
وَٱدۡعُواْ شُهَدَآءَكُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَـٰدِقِينَ
And if ye are in doubt concerning that which We reveal unto Our slave (Muhammad), then produce a surah of the like thereof, and call your witness beside Allah if ye are truthful.
________________
19.5 zaheer (  ظهير  )  : zahar(  ظهر  ) meaning back, rear and meaning means of transport, helper, assister, and zaheer(  ظهير  ) also meaning helper; such a helper on which someone can rely on. Allah states that:
________________
Surat Al-Qasas (The Story) -   سُوۡرَةُ القَصَص
28:86
لَا تَكُونَنَّ ظَهِيرً۬ا لِّلۡكَـٰفِرِينَ
Thou hadst no hope that the Scripture would be inspired in thee; but it is a mercy from thy Lord, so never be a helper to the disbelievers.
________________
19.6 wazeer (  وزير  )  : wizr(  وزر  ) meaning burden (pl: auzaar(  أوزار  )). Wazeer(  وزير  ) is that kind of helper aide who can remove your burden in case of over work and difficulty. It is stated in the Quran:
________________
Surat Ta-Ha  -   سُوۡرَةُ طٰه
20:29
وَٱجۡعَل لِّى وَزِيرً۬ا مِّنۡ أَهۡلِى
Appoint for me a henchman from my folk,
________________
19.7 a’dud (  عضد  )  : meaning arm. The part from shoulders to elbows, and adad tuhu(  عضدته  ) meaning to hold someone’s arm and give support. Similarly, the word a’dud(  عضد  ) comes in the meaning of helper (pl: a’daad(  اعضاد  )). Allah states that:
________________
Surat Al-Kahf (The Cave) -   سُوۡرَةُ الکهف
18:51
وَمَا كُنتُ مُتَّخِذَ ٱلۡمُضِلِّينَ عَضُدً۬ا
I made them not to witness the creation of the heavens and the earth, nor their own creation; nor choose I misleaders for (My) helpers.
________________
Summary:
1.NASIR AND NASEER(  ناصر, نصير  ): helper in times of oppression and misery.
2.HAWARI(  حواري  ): group of companions of prophets.
3.WALI AND MAULA(  ولي,  موالى  ): companion and close friend and helper.
4.SHAHEED(  شهيد  ): to arrive at the right time and help someone by testifying in their favor.
5.ZAHEER(  ظهير  ): such a helper on which one can rely.
6.WAZEER(  وزير  ): to lend a hand in loads of work.
7. A’DUD(  عضد  ): helper who proves himself useful.

raw_text:
2 MAAR DALNA MARNA [to kill, to die]
Synonyms: MAATA, AMAATA, QATAL, QATTALA, SALABA, SALLABA, HALAKA, AHLAKA, ZABBAHA, RAJAMA, INKHANAQ, TAWAFA, SHAHADAT
2.1 MAATA (مَاتَ):   MAUT (مَوْت) (Opposite HAYYAT (حَیَات)) means a living being losing its soul and power, departing of soul from body. To die, regardless the condition which caused death. In the Quran
Surah Al-Baqarah (The cow): سورۃ البَقَرَۃ  2:161
إِنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا وَمَاتُوا وَهُمْ كُفَّارٌ
Those who reject Faith, and die rejecting,-
AMAATA (اَمَاتَ) means to kill someone, to put someone to death. Allah says in the Quran
Surah Al-Baqarah (The cow): سورۃ البَقَرَۃ  2:28
ثُمَّ يُمِيتُكُمْ ثُمَّ يُحْيِيكُمْ ثُمَّ إِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
And He gave you life; then will He cause you to die, and will again bring you to life; and again to Him will ye return.
PAGE - 777
2.2 QATAL (قَتَلَ):   A living being overpowering other living being and putting it to death. According to Ibn Al Faris to kill someone disgracefully. In the Quran
Surah Al-Kahf (The Cave): سورۃ الکھف 18:74
قَالَ أَقَتَلْتَ نَفْسًا زَكِيَّةً بِغَيْرِ نَفْسٍ
He said, “Did you kill a pure soul, who killed no one?
QATTALA (قَتَّلَ) means to kill someone by torturing or by putting in agony. In the Quran
Surah Al-Araf (The heights): سورۃ الأعرَاف 7:127

2.4 SALABA (صَلَبَ):   To hang someone, to execute someone on gallows or to crucify. SALEEB (صلیب) is that piece with which a criminal is executed on gallows. Allah says in the Quran

I will cut off your hands and your feet on alternate sides, and I will crucify you on the trunks of the palm-trees.
2.5 ZABBAHA (ذَبَّحَ):   ZABAHA (ذَبَحَ) to slaughter an animal according to shariah law by bleeding, ZABBAHA (ذَبَّحَ) means to painfully slaughter according to shariah law or overdo the slaughter (dictionary al Manjad). That which has been killed by strangling, or by a violent blow

20 MAZAK URANA
[To make fun of]
Synonyms: ISTAHZA’A(  استهزأ  ), SAKHARA(  سخر  ), FANNAD(  فند  )
20.1 istahza’a(  استهزأ  )  : alhaz(  الهز  ) meaning to make fun of someone internally and istahza(  استهزأ  ) meaning to make fun of someone on such an act which he did not even commit. It is stated in the Quran:
________________
Surat Al-Baqarah(The Cow) -   سُوۡرَةُ البَقَرَة
2:14
وَإِذَا خَلَوۡاْ إِلَىٰ شَيَـٰطِينِهِمۡ قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّا مَعَكُمۡ إِنَّمَا نَحۡنُ مُسۡتَہۡزِءُونَ
And when they fall in with those who believe, they say: We believe; but when they go apart to their devils they declare: Lo! we are with you; verily we did but mock.
________________
20.2 sakhara (  سخر  )  : maskhar(  مسخر  ) includes the aspect of ridicule and pity. Sakhara(  سخر  ) meaning to be against someone and sakkhara(  سخر  ) meaning to ridicule someone, to suppress someone. It also means to describe one’s faults and make fun of him in such a way so as to mock and insult. Allah states that:
________________
Surat Al-Hujraat (The Chambers) -   سُوۡرَةُ الحُجرَات
49:11
يَـٰٓأَيُّہَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ لَا يَسۡخَرۡ قَوۡمٌ۬ مِّن قَوۡمٍ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَكُونُواْ خَيۡرً۬ا مِّنۡہُمۡ
O ye who believe! Let not a folk deride a folk who may be better than they (are), not let women (deride) women who may be better than they are; neither defame one another, nor insult one another by nicknames. Bad is the name of lewdness after faith. And whoso turneth not in repentance, such are evil-doers.
________________
20.3 fannada (  فند  )  : fanad(  فند  ) meaning weakness in opinion and fannada(  فند  ) means to call someone as having weak opinion and of low intelligence. Fanida(  فند  ) means the decline of intelligence because of old age and to talk aimlessly. Fannada(  فند  ) means to rebuke an old man on his talk, to hold him responsible, to reprimand. It is stated in the Quran:
________________
Surat Yusuf -   سُوۡرَةُ یُوسُف
12:94
قَالَ أَبُوهُمۡ إِنِّى لَأَجِدُ رِيحَ يُوسُفَ‌ۖ لَوۡلَآ أَن تُفَنِّدُونِ
When the caravan departed their father had said: Truly I am conscious of the breath of Joseph, though ye call me dotard.
________________
Summary:
1.ISTAHZA(  استهزأ  ): to make fun of something by considering it to be against common sense.
2. SAKHARA(  سخر  ): to make fun of someone and ridicule someone by describing his faults.
3. FANNADA(  فند  ): to make fun of an old man’s talks.
(for ‘muraad pana’, see ‘kamyaab hona’)

21 MARD
[man]
Synonyms: RAJUL(  رجل  ), IMRA’U(  أمرء  ), MARU’(  مرء  ), ZAKAR(  ذكر  )
21.1 rajul(  رجل  )  : meaning man. This is used when you have to depict strength, bravery and chivalry. Rajuliyyah(  رجولية  ) means a man’s force (pl:rijal(  رجال  ))(feminine:nisa(  نسا  ) and niswa(  نسوه  )) Allah states that:
________________
Surat An-Nisa (Women) -   سُوۡرَةُ النِّسَاء
4:34
ٱلرِّجَالُ قَوَّٲمُونَ عَلَى ٱلنِّسَآءِ بِمَا فَضَّلَ ٱللَّهُ بَعۡضَهُمۡ عَلَىٰ بَعۡضٍ۬
Men are in charge of women, because Allah hath made the one of them to excel the other, and because they spend of their property (for the support of women). So good women are the obedient, guarding in secret that which Allah hath guarded. As for those from whom ye fear rebellion, admonish them and banish them to beds apart, and scourge them. Then if they obey you, seek not a way against them. Lo! Allah is ever High, Exalted, Great.
________________
21.2 imra’u or maru’ (  أمرء, مرء  )  : meaning man, person. This word is used when you have to point towards good behavior associated with humanity. Maruat(  مروعت  ) or mararrat(  مررت  ) meaning humanity, humanitarian sympathy (fm: imra’atu(  إمراة  ) or almara’tu(  المرءة  )). Its plural is also rijal(  رجال  ). It is stated in the Quran:
________________

22 MAZA
[taste]
Synonyms: ZAAIQA(  ذائقه  ), TA’M(  طعم  ), LAZZA(  لذة  ), HANA(  هنا  )
22.1 zaaiqa(  ذائقه  )  : zaaqa(  ذاق  ) meaning to taste but this word is usually used to depict the meaning of tasting with the tongue. Zaaiqa(  ذائقه  ) means power of tasting which is in the tongue. Maza(  مزة  ), zawaq(  ذواق  ) and mazaq(  مذاق  ) all come under the meaning of good taste. This word is used commonly. It is used in literal and semantic senses. Allah states that:
________________
Surat Al-E-Imran (Family of Imran) -   سُوۡرَةُ آل عِمرَان
2:185
كُلُّ نَفۡسٍ۬ ذَآٮِٕقَةُ ٱلۡمَوۡتِ‌ۗ
Every soul will taste of death. And ye will be paid on the Day of Resurrection only that which ye have fairly earned. Whoso is removed from the Fire and is made to enter paradise, he indeed is triumphant. The life of this world is but comfort of illusion.
________________
22.2 ta’m (  طعم  )  : ta’ma(  طعم  ) means food or to eat food and the taste of that food is called ta’m(  طعم  ). Allah states that:
________________
Surat Muhammad -   سُوۡرَةُ محَمَّد
47:15
وَأَنۡہَـٰرٌ۬ مِّن لَّبَنٍ۬ لَّمۡ يَتَغَيَّرۡ طَعۡمُهُ ۥ
A similitude of the Garden which those who keep their duty (to Allah) are promised: Therein are rivers of water unpolluted, and rivers of milk whereof the flavour changeth not, and rivers of wine delicious to the drinkers, and rivers of clear-run honey; therein for them is every kind of fruit, with pardon from their Lord. (Are those who enjoy all this) like those who are immortal in the Fire and are given boiling water to drink so that it teareth their bowels?
________________
22.3 lazza(  لذة  ):   lazza(  لذة  ) means for something to have a good taste and to be delicious. And lazza(  لذة  ) meaning the pleasure of good taste or that taste which is gratifying whether this taste is sweet or salty, sour or even bitter if it appeals to someone, that is delicious. And it is used in literal and semantic sense. Allah states that:
________________
Surat Muhammad -   سُوۡرَةُ محَمَّد
47:15
وَأَنۡہَـٰرٌ۬ مِّنۡ خَمۡرٍ۬ لَّذَّةٍ۬ لِّلشَّـٰرِبِينَ
A similitude of the Garden which those who keep their duty (to Allah) are promised: Therein are rivers of water unpolluted, and rivers of milk whereof the flavour changeth not, and rivers of wine delicious to the drinkers, and rivers of clear-run honey; therein for them is every kind of fruit, with pardon from their Lord. (Are those who enjoy all this) like those who are immortal in the Fire and are given boiling water to drink so that it teareth their bowels?
________________
At another point, it is stated:
________________
Surat Az.Zukhruf (Ornaments of Gold) -   سُوۡرَةُ الزّخرُف
43: 71
وَفِيهَا مَا تَشۡتَهِيهِ ٱلۡأَنفُسُ وَتَلَذُّ ٱلۡأَعۡيُنُ‌ۖ
Therein are brought round for them trays of gold and goblets, and therein is all that souls desire and eyes find sweet. And ye are immortal therein.
________________
22.4 hana(  هنا  ):   alhuni(  الهني  ) means that thing which is achieved without any effort and is favorable according to the results. This word is usually used to depict the good taste of food. Hana(  هنا  ) means to become happy and hanni alta’am(  هني الطعام  ) meaning to find the food delicious. Hanua’(  هنوء  ) means to achieve without grief or hard work. Hannaa’(  هنأ  ) means to congratulate. Haniu’(  هنيء  ) means a good thing which is achieved without effort and money and hani(  هني  ) means such a pleasing food in which there is no mist. Then this word started being used as merchandise which is achieved easily. Allah states that:
________________
Surat An-Nisa (Women) -   سُوۡرَةُ النِّسَاء
4:4
فَإِن طِبۡنَ لَكُمۡ عَن شَىۡءٍ۬ مِّنۡهُ نَفۡسً۬ا فَكُلُوهُ هَنِيٓـًٔ۬ا مَّرِيٓـًٔ۬ا
And give unto the women (whom ye marry) free gift of their marriage portions; but if they of their own accord remit unto you a part thereof, then ye are welcome to absorb it (in your wealth).
________________
Summary:
1. ZAAIQA(  ذائقه  ): its use is common, meaning to taste.
2. TA’M(  طعم  ): The taste of human food.
3. LAZZAT(  لذة  ): pleasure, deliciousness.
4. HANA(  هنأ  ): the pleasure of achieving something without effort, something having a good presentation and taste.

23 MUZAYYAN KERNA
[to decorate]
Synonyms: ZAYYAN(  زين  ), ZUKHRUF(  زخرف  ), SAWWAL(  سول  )
23.1 zayyan(  زين  )  : meaning to beautify something, to decorate, ornamentation, to smarten. This word is used commonly. Used both in literal and semantic sense. It is stated in the Quran:
________________
Surat Al-Mulk (The Kingdom) -   سُوۡرَةُ المُلک
67:5
وَلَقَدۡ زَيَّنَّا ٱلسَّمَآءَ ٱلدُّنۡيَا بِمَصَـٰبِيحَ
And verily We have beautified the world's heaven with lamps, and We have made them missiles for the devils, and for them We have prepared the doom of flame.
________________
At another point, it is stated:
________________
Surat Al-Anaam (Cattle) -   سُوۡرَةُ الاٴنعَام
6:43
وَزَيَّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلشَّيۡطَـٰنُ مَا ڪَانُواْ يَعۡمَلُونَ
If only, when Our disaster came on them, they had been humble! But their hearts were hardened and the devil made all that they used to do seem fair unto them!
________________
23.2 zukhruf (  زخرف  )  : zukhruf(  زخرف  ) means gold and that beautification which is achieved through enameling and zukhruf al qaul(  زخرف القول  ) meaning enameled talk and zukhruf al kalaam(  زخرف الكلام  ) meaning the talk decorated with lies. Zakhraf(  زخرف  ) and tazakhraf(  تزخرف  ) meaning to beautify something by enameling. Allah states that:
________________
Surat Al-Anaam (Cattle) -   سُوۡرَةُ الاٴنعَام
6:112
وَكَذَٲلِكَ جَعَلۡنَا لِكُلِّ نَبِىٍّ عَدُوًّ۬ا شَيَـٰطِينَ ٱلۡإِنسِ وَٱلۡجِنِّ يُوحِى بَعۡضُهُمۡ إِلَىٰ بَعۡضٍ۬ زُخۡرُفَ ٱلۡقَوۡلِ غُرُورً۬ا‌ۚ
Thus have We appointed unto every prophet an adversary - devils of humankind and jinn who inspire in one another plausible discourse through guile. If thy Lord willed, they would not do so; so leave them alone with their devising;
________________
23.3 sawwala(  سول  ):   sawal(  سول  ) meaning a loose stomach beneath the navel. Sawwala(  سول  ) means the showing of some sin to the person by the Satan weakly and loosely so that the person does not remain aware of the sin or to present some wrong thing in a beautiful and decorative way so that the person agrees to do that thing instead of keeping away from it. As-saweel(  السويل  ) meaning the decoration of something by the soul in such a way so that he feels greedy and also to present it in a pleasing way. Allah states that:
________________
Surat Yusuf -   سُوۡرَةُ یُوسُف
12:18
وَجَآءُو عَلَىٰ قَمِيصِهِۦ بِدَمٍ۬ كَذِبٍ۬‌ۚ قَالَ بَلۡ سَوَّلَتۡ لَكُمۡ أَنفُسُكُمۡ أَمۡرً۬ا‌ۖ
And they came with false blood on his shirt. He said: Nay, but your minds have beguiled you into something. (My course is) comely patience. And Allah it is Whose help is to be sought in that (predicament) which ye describe.
________________
Summary:
1. ZAYYAN(  زين  ): to beautify, to decorate, common use.
2. ZUKHRUF(  زخرف  ): to beautify by gold plating and decorate it. To make something appealing through lies.
3. SAWWAL(  سول  ): the presentation of some wrong thing in a beautiful way by Satan and the soul for which the man holds greed.

Sawwala(سول) means the showing of some sin to the person by the Satan weakly and loosely so that the person does not remain aware of the sin or to present some wrong thing in a beautiful and decorative way so that the person agrees to do that thing instead of keeping away from it. As-saweel(السويل) meaning the decoration of something by the soul in such a way so that he feels greedy and also to present it in a pleasing way. Allah states that:

________________

Surat Yusuf - سُوۡرَةُ یُوسُف

12:18

وَجَآءُو عَلَىٰ قَمِيصِهِۦ بِدَمٍ۬ كَذِبٍ۬‌ۚ قَالَ بَلۡ سَوَّلَتۡ لَكُمۡ أَنفُسُكُمۡ أَمۡرً۬ا‌ۖ

And they came with false blood on his shirt. He said: Nay, but your minds have beguiled you into something. (My course is) comely patience. And Allah it is Whose help is to be sought in that (predicament) which ye describe.

________________

Summary:

1. ZAYYAN(زين): to beautify, to decorate, common use.

2. ZUKHRUF(زخرف): to beautify by gold plating and decorate it. To make something appealing through lies.

3. SAWWAL(سول): the presentation of some wrong thing in a beautiful way by Satan and the soul for which the man holds greed.

24 MUSAFIR
[traveler]
Synonyms: although, the word safar(  سفر  ) is from the Arabic language and it is used in the Quran, but there have not been words like saafara(  سافر  ) and musafir(  مسافر  ). Instead the following words have been used: IBN-AS-SABEEL(  ابن السبيل  ), A’BARI SABEEL(  عابري سبيل  ), MUQWEEN(  مقوين  ), SAYYARA(  سيارة  )
24.1 ibn-as-sabeel(  ابن السبيل  )  : son of the path, this is the alias of a traveler. Until the time the traveler reaches his home, he is ibn as sabeel(  ابن السبيل  ) irrespective of whether he might be travelling or staying temporarily at some place during his journey. It is stated in the Quran:
________________
Surat Al-Baqarah (The Cow) -   سُوۡرَةُ البَقَرَة
2:177

It is not righteousness that ye turn your faces to the East and the West; but righteous is he who believeth in Allah and the Last Day and the angels and the Scripture and the prophets; and giveth wealth, for love of Him, to kinsfolk and to orphans and the needy and the wayfarer and to those who ask, and to set slaves free; and observeth proper worship and payeth the poor-due. And those who keep their treaty when they make one, and the patient in tribulation and adversity and time of stress. Such are they who are sincere. Such are the God-fearing.
________________
24.2 a’bar sabeel(  عابري سبيل  ):   A’bir(  عابر  ) meaning the one who crosses, the one who covers and a’bari as sabeel(  عابري سبيل  ) meaning travelling travelers whose journey is continuing. It is stated in the Quran:
________________
Surat An-Nisa (Women) -   سُوۡرَةُ النِّسَاء
4:43
وَلَا جُنُبًا إِلَّا عَابِرِى سَبِيلٍ حَتَّىٰ تَغۡتَسِلُواْ‌ۚ
O ye who believe! Draw not near unto prayer when ye are drunken, till ye know that which ye utter, nor when ye are polluted, save when journeying upon the road, till ye have bathed. And if ye be ill, or on a journey, or one of you cometh from the closet, or ye have touched women, and ye find not water, then go to high clean soil and rub your faces and your hands (therewith). Lo! Allah is Benign, Forgiving.
________________
24.3 muqween (  مقوين  )  : alqawa(  القوى  ) means hunger and baat al qawa(  بات القوى  ) meaning he spent the night hungry and alqawiyah(  ألقاوية  ) meaning the year of less rains. Taqawi(  تقاوى  ) meaning scarcity or abundance of rains which ruin the crops and results in famine. Taqawi(  تقاوى  ) loans are those which the government gives to proprietors in such a year on condition of installments. Taqawa(  تقاوى  ) means to spend night in hunger and quwat la yamoot(  قوت لايموت  ) means such a less amount of food on which a person can remain alive. Muqween(  مقوين  ) meaning those gypsies who settle from one place to another in search of food. Allah states that:
________________
Surat Al-Waqia (The Event) -   سُوۡرَةُ الواقِعَة
56:73
نَحۡنُ جَعَلۡنَـٰهَا تَذۡكِرَةً۬ وَمَتَـٰعً۬ا لِّلۡمُقۡوِينَ
We, even We, appointed it a memorial and a comfort for the dwellers in the wilderness.
________________
24.4 sayyarah(  سيارة  ):   sara(  سار  ) meaning to travel, to move and sayyar(  سيار  ) is the intensive noun which means the one who moves a lot. Sayyarah(  سيارة  ) means (i) a caravan of people travelling together (ii) things that revolve all the time, planets, heavenly bodies, vehicle etc. This word has been used in the first meaning in the Quran:
________________
Surat Yusuf -   سُوۡرَةُ یُوسُف
12:19
وَجَآءَتۡ سَيَّارَةٌ۬ فَأَرۡسَلُواْ وَارِدَهُمۡ
And there came a caravan, and they sent their waterdrawer. He let down his pail (into the pit). He said: Good luck! Here is a youth. And they hid him as a treasure, and Allah was Aware of what they did.
________________
Summary:
1. IBN-AS-SABEEL(  ابن السبيل  ): alias of a traveler until he reaches his home.
2. A’BARI SABEEL(  عابري سبيل  ): pedestrian, travelling people who are in the state of journey.
3. MUQWEEN(  مقوين  ): people who travel from one place to another in search of food and living.
4. SAYYARAH(  سيارة  ): caravan of people travelling together.

title: content/m/m25.html
raw_text:
25 MUSAKHAR KERNA
[to conquer, to control]
Synonyms: SAKHARA(  سخر  ), ZALLALA(  ذلل  ), ZALOOL(  ذلول  )
25.1 sakhara(  سخر  )  : this is used for impulsive submission i.e. something doing the task for which it has been designed. It does not include the will, resolve or plan of the one submitting (whether it is living or non-living). For more details, see ‘zabardasti kerna’. Allah states that:
________________
Surat Az-Zukhruf (Ornaments of Gold) -   سُوۡرَةُ الزّخرُف
43:13
وَتَقُولُواْ سُبۡحَـٰنَ ٱلَّذِى سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَـٰذَا وَمَا ڪُنَّا لَهُ ۥ مُقۡرِنِينَ
That ye may mount upon their backs, and may remember your Lord's favour when ye mount thereon, and may say: Glorified be He Who hath subdued these unto us, and we were not capable (of subduing them)
________________
25.2 zallala(  ذلل  ):   zalla(  ذل  ) meaning to be weak and submissive. And zallala(  ذلل  ) means to make someone humble and weak. That type of submission which includes the aspect of degradation and humility. Allah states that:
________________
Surat Ya-Seen -   سُوۡرَةُ یسٓ
36:72
وَذَلَّلۡنَـٰهَا لَهُمۡ فَمِنۡہَا رَكُوبُہُمۡ وَمِنۡہَا يَأۡكُلُونَ
And have subdued them unto them, so that some of them they have for riding, some for food?
________________
25.3 zalool (  ذلول  )  : means to willingly leave its stubbornness by something and become submissive and obedient. Allah states that:
________________
Surat Al-Mulk (the Kingdom) -   سُوۡرَةُ المُلک
67:15
هُوَ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ ذَلُولاً۬
He it is Who hath made the earth subservient unto you, so Walk in the paths thereof and eat of His providence. And unto Him will be the resurrection (of the dead).
________________
At another point it is stated:
________________
Surat Al-Baqarah (the Cow) -   سُوۡرَةُ البَقَرَة
2:71
إِنَّہَا بَقَرَةٌ۬ لَّا ذَلُولٌ۬ تُثِيرُ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَلَا تَسۡقِى ٱلۡحَرۡثَ
(Moses) answered: Lo! He saith: Verily she is a cow unyoked; she plougheth not the soil nor watereth the tilth; whole and without mark. They said: Now thou bringest the truth. So they sacrificed her, though almost they did not.
________________
Summary:
The word sakhara(  سخر  ) highlights just the impulsive aspect of something whereas zalool(  ذلول  ) highlights the aspect in which a person makes something submissive and obedient through his effort.

title: content/m/m26.html
raw_text:
26 MUSALLAT KERNA
[To impose]
Synonyms: SALLATA(  سلط  ), QAYYAZA(  قيض  )
26.1 sallata(  سلط  )  : salita(  سلط  ) meaning to be long-tongued and sallata(  سلط  ) includes two points: (i)nature (ii)wrath. Meaning domination as well as pressure. Sultan(  سلطان  ) meaning king, power and open argument. Allah states that:
________________
Surat Al-Hashr (Exile) -   سُوۡرَةُ الحَشر
59:6
وَلَـٰكِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُسَلِّطُ رُسُلَهُ ۥ عَلَىٰ مَن يَشَآءُ‌ۚ
And that which Allah gave as spoil unto His messenger from them, ye urged not any horse or riding-camel for the sake thereof, but Allah giveth His messenger lordship over whom He will. Allah is Able to do all things.
________________
26.2 qayyaza(  قيض  ):   qaiz(  قيض  ) is used to call the shell of an egg. And qayyaza(  قيض  ) means to dominate and impose on something in the way that a shell covers the insides of an egg, to dominate someone and make him helpless. Allah states that:
________________
Surat Az-Zukhruf (Ornaments of Gold) -   سُوۡرَةُ الزّخرُف
43:36
وَمَن يَعۡشُ عَن ذِكۡرِ ٱلرَّحۡمَـٰنِ نُقَيِّضۡ لَهُ ۥ شَيۡطَـٰنً۬ا
And he whose sight is dim to the remembrance of the Beneficent, We assign unto him a devil who becometh his comrade;
________________
Summary:
Qayyaza(  قيض  ) includes the aspect of pressure more as compared to sallata(  سلط  ).

title: content/m/m27.html
raw_text:
27 MASHGHOOL HONA
[to become absorbed, engaged]
Synonyms: SHAGHALA(  شغل  ), KHAAZA(  خاض  ), AFAAZ(  أفاض  ), SABAHA(  سبح  )
27.1 shaghala(  شغل  )  : that kind of engagement due to which a person is not able to give attention to other tasks. It is stated in the Quran:
________________
Surat Al-Fath (Victory) -   سُوۡرَةُ الفَتْح
48:11
سَيَقُولُ لَكَ ٱلۡمُخَلَّفُونَ مِنَ ٱلۡأَعۡرَابِ شَغَلَتۡنَآ أَمۡوَٲلُنَا وَأَهۡلُونَا
Those of the wandering Arabs who were left behind will tell thee: Our possessions and our households occupied us, so ask forgiveness for us! They speak with their tongues that which is not in their hearts. Say: Who can avail you aught against Allah, if He intend you hurt or intend you profit? Nay, but Allah is ever Aware of what ye do.
________________
27.2 khaaza(  خاض  ):   means to penetrate and enter till the middle of something. Khaaz fil maa(  خاض فى ألما  ) meaning to penetrate in water and khaaz fil hadees(  خاض فى حديث  ) meaning to be engaged in talk. It means to be absorbed in some work or thing with full concentration. It is usually used in the Quran in the negative sense i.e. to be absorbed in rubbish talk and tasks. Allah states that:
________________
Surat At-Tawba (Repentance) -   سُوۡرَةُ التّوبَة
9:69
وَخُضۡتُمۡ كَٱلَّذِى خَاضُوٓاْ‌ۚ أُوْلَـٰٓٮِٕكَ حَبِطَتۡ أَعۡمَـٰلُهُمۡ فِى ٱلدُّنۡيَا وَٱلۡأَخِرَةِ‌ۖ
Even as those before you who were mightier than you in strength, and more affluent than you in wealth and children. They enjoyed their lot awhile, so ye enjoy your lot awhile even as those before you did enjoy their lot awhile. And ye prate even as they prated. Such are they whose works have perished in the world and the Hereafter. Such are they who are the losers.
________________
At another point it is stated:
________________
Surat Al-Anaam (Cattle) -   سُوۡرَةُ الاٴنعَام
6:68
وَإِذَا رَأَيۡتَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَخُوضُونَ فِىٓ ءَايَـٰتِنَا فَأَعۡرِضۡ عَنۡہُمۡ
And when thou seest those who meddle with Our revelations, withdraw from them until they meddle with another topic. And if the devil cause thee to forget, sit not, after the remembrance, with the congregation of wrong-doers.
________________
27.3 afaaza(  أفاض  ):   faaz(  فاض  ), faiz(  فيض  ) meaning to continue something easily or the flow of water after rising from some place, to have something in abundance. It is said that faaz as-sail(  فاض السيل  ) i.e. to have abundant water and having it flow from the banks of canals and rivers . faazat a’ainah(  فاضت عينه  ) means that tears started dropping from his eyes. Afaaza ina-a’(  أفاض اناءه  ) meaning that he poured his vessel to such an extent that water started to flow through the edges. It is stated in the Quran:
________________
Surat Al-Baqarah (The Cow) -   سُوۡرَةُ البَقَرَة
2:199
ثُمَّ أَفِيضُواْ مِنۡ حَيۡثُ أَفَاضَ ٱلنَّاسُ
Then hasten onward from the place whence the multitude hasteneth onward, and ask forgiveness of Allah. Lo! Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.
________________
It also means to come with the flow and gush of a crowd i.e. you also flow with the flow of this crowd. And accordingly, afaaz alqaum min makaan(  أفاض القوم من مكان  ) means to disperse and scatter. And afaaza fil hadees(  أفاض في الحديث  ) meaning to be absorbed in talk with full concentration for a long time. It is stated in the Quran:
________________

28 MSHAQQAT MEI DAALNA
[to become absorbed, engaged]
Synonyms: AA’NATA(), IQTAHAMA(  اقتحم  )
28.1 aa’nata(  اعنت  )  : a’nta(  عنت  ) meaning a person getting stuck in something in which there is a chance of his destruction and aa’nta(  اعنت  ) means to put someone else into such position and difficulty. Allah states that:
________________
Surat Al-Baqarah (The Cow) -   سُوۡرَةُ البَقَرَة
2:220
وَلَوۡ شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ لَأَعۡنَتَكُمۡ‌ۚ
Upon the world and the Hereafter. And they question thee concerning orphans. Say: To improve their lot is best. And if ye mingle your affairs with theirs, then (they are) your brothers. Allah knoweth him who spoileth from him who improveth. Had Allah willed He could have overburdened you. Allah is Mighty, Wise.
________________
28.2 iqtahama (  اقتحم  ):   qahama fil amar(  قحم فى الامر  ) means to proceed on some matter without having thought over it. Iqtahama alamar(  اقتحم الامر  ) means to get oneself stuck in something through some effort and iqtahama(  اقتحم  ) means to enter some dangerous place. Allah states that:
________________
Surat Sad -   سُوۡرَةُ صٓ
38:59
هَـٰذَا فَوۡجٌ۬ مُّقۡتَحِمٌ۬ مَّعَكُمۡ‌ۖ
Here is an army rushing blindly with you. (Those who are already in the Fire say): No word of welcome for them. Lo! they will roast at the Fire.
________________
Summary:
aa’nata(  اعنت  ) is used for someone else and iqtahama(  اقتحم  ) is used for one’s own self to put in some difficult and dangerous task.
(for ‘mushkil’, see ‘bojhal kerna’)

29 MASHWARA KERNA
[to consult]
Synonyms: SHAWARA(  شاور  ), BAYYAT(  بيت  ), TANAAJA(  تناجي  )(NAJW(  نجو  )), I’TAMAR(  اءتمر  )
29.1 shawara(  شاور  )  : meaning to consult and with respect to some matter, some people getting together and going through its various aspects and taking each other’s opinion. This word’s use is common. Allah states that:
________________
Surat Al-E-Imran (Family of Imran) -   سُوۡرَةُ آل عِمرَان
3:159
وَشَاوِرۡهُمۡ فِى ٱلۡأَمۡرِ‌ۖ فَإِذَا عَزَمۡتَ فَتَوَكَّلۡ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ‌ۚ
It was by the mercy of Allah that thou wast lenient with them (O Muhammad), for if thou hadst been stern and fierce of heart they would have dispersed from round about thee. So pardon them and ask forgiveness for them and consult with them upon the conduct of affairs. And when thou art resolved, then put thy trust in Allah. Lo! Allah loveth those who put their trust (in Him).
________________
29.2 bayyat(  بيت  ):   baata(  بات  ) meaning to spend night and bayyat(  بيت  ) means to get together at home and after some night has passed, to consult on some matter. Its other meaning is to become discouraged. Allah states that:
________________
Surat An-Nisa (Women) -   سُوۡرَةُ النِّسَاء
4:81
فَإِذَا بَرَزُواْ مِنۡ عِندِكَ بَيَّتَ طَآٮِٕفَةٌ۬ مِّنۡہُمۡ غَيۡرَ ٱلَّذِى تَقُولُ‌ۖ
And they say: (It is) obedience; but when they have gone forth from thee a party of them spend the night in planning other than what thou sayest. Allah recordeth what they plan by night. So oppose them and put thy trust in Allah. Allah is sufficient as Trustee.
________________
bayyat(  بيت  ) has also come in the meaning of discourage as in 27:49, but here, that meaning is not under discussion.
________________
29.3 tanaaja(  تناجي  ):   najw(  نجو  ) meaning the secret between two people and najwa(  نجوى  ) means confidential information, secret, confidant and tanaaja(  تناجي  ) meaning to whisper, to especially whisper, to make someone your confidant in secret and najiyyah(  نجيا  ) means to consult about secrecy. It is stated in the Quran:
________________
Surat Al-Mujadila (The Pleading Woman) -   سُوۡرَةُ المجَادلة
58:8
وَيَتَنَـٰجَوۡنَ بِٱلۡإِثۡمِ وَٱلۡعُدۡوَٲنِ وَمَعۡصِيَتِ ٱلرَّسُولِ
Hast thou not observed those who were forbidden conspiracy and afterward returned to that which they had been forbidden, and (now) conspire together for crime and wrongdoing and disobedience toward the messenger? And when they come unto thee they greet thee with a greeting wherewith Allah greeteth thee not, and say within themselves: Why should Allah punish us for what we say? Hell will suffice them; they will feel the heat thereof - a hapless journey's end!
________________
29.4 I’tamara(  اءتمر  ):   amar(  امر  ) meaning to order and I’tamara(  اءتمر  ) means to reach on some decision after mutual consultation and fulfill the order. I’tamara biflan(  اءتمر بفلان  ) to conspire for someone’s murder. It is stated in the Quran:
________________
Surat Al-Qasas (The Story) -   سُوۡرَةُ القَصَص
28:20
قَالَ يَـٰمُوسَىٰٓ إِنَّ ٱلۡمَلَأَ يَأۡتَمِرُونَ بِكَ لِيَقۡتُلُوكَ
And a man came from the uttermost part of the city, running. He said: O Moses! Lo! the chiefs take counsel against thee to slay thee; therefor escape. Lo! I am of those who give thee good advice.
________________
Summary:
1. SHAWARA(  شاور  ): it is common, to consult.
2. BAYYAT(  بيت  ): secret consultation at night.
3. TANAAJA(  تناجي  ): secret whispering among two or less persons.
4. I’TAMARA(  اءتمر  ): to be in agreement over some consultation or to conspire for murder.

3 MAAL O DOLAT, ATTA KERNA [wealth and money, to bestow or distribute wealth and money]
Synonyms: MAALA, DAULAH, RIZQ, RAZAQA, KHAIRA, AFAA’, MAGHANIMA, ANFAAL
3.1 MAALA (مَال):   (MAUL مول) some refer to it as livestock, because to them it is their biggest possession. ‘خَرَجَ اِلٰی مَالِهِ’ he went to his treasures or livestock camels. RAJULUM-MALUN (رَجُلٌ مَالٌ) means a wealthy man. MAALA-YAMOOLU (مَالَ یَمُوْلُ) means to be wealthy. TAMAWWUL (تَمَوُّل) means to collect wealth, to get it, to be very rich or wealthy. MAYYIL (مَیِّل) means very wealthy, MUWAEL (مُوَیْل) means less wealth or riches (dictionary al Manjad). In common word it is refer to as money, or liquid assets or wealth that can be used in transactions. Allah says in the Quran
Surah Al-Hadeed (The Iron): سورة الحديد 57:20
أَنَّمَا الْحَيَاةُ الدُّنْيَا لَعِبٌ وَلَهْوٌ وَزِينَةٌ وَتَفَاخُرٌ بَيْنَكُمْ وَتَكَاثُرٌ فِي الْأَمْوَالِ وَالْأَوْلَادِ
Know that the worldly life is only play, and distraction, and glitter, and boasting among you, and rivalry in wealth and children.
3.2 DAULAH (دَوْلَة):   (DAUL (دول)) the opposite of DALA (دَوَلَ) is DARA (دَارَ) (DAUR (دَوْر)), DAUR (دَوْر) and DAIRAH (دائرہ) are used for poverty, deprivation and difficult times. DAULAH (دَوْلَة) and DULAH (دُوْلَة) refer to changing of hard times into prosperous times. DAWAL (دَاوَل) is the coming of fortune to people from time to time. DAULAH (دَوْلَة) is something that circulates among people. One day it is with one person and next with someone else or for someone else (dictionary al Manjad) just like the idiom ‘Money is round and is meant to roll’. For politicians DAULAH (دَوْلَة) is kingdom, realm or government (dictionary al Manjad). Allah says in the Quran
Surah Al Hashr (The exile): سورۃ الحَشر 59:7
كَيْ لَا يَكُونَ دُولَةً بَيْنَ الْأَغْنِيَاءِ مِنكُمْ
In order that it may not become a fortune used by the rich among you.
PAGE - 780
3.3 RIZQ (رِزْق):   Actually means livelihood or anything that is causative for the disciplining and improvement of body or soul. Materially it is anything for eating or feeding stomach. RIZQ (رِزْق) also refers to destiny, MARZUQ (مَرْزُوْق) means a lucky or fortunate (dictionary al Manjad). RUZIQTU-ILMAN (رُزِقْتُ عِلْماً) means ‘I was bestowed with knowledge’. RIZQ (رِزْق) is anything that is a source of nourishment for body or soul. In this way rain is also a kind of RIZQ (رِزْق). As Allah says in the Quran
Surah Adh-Dhariyaat (The Winnowing Winds): سورة الذاريات 51:22
وَفِي السَّمَاءِ رِزْقُكُمْ
And in the heaven is your livelihood
And RAZAQA (رَزَقَ) means to provide RIZQ (رِزْق) or wage, to give away food or wealth. RAZZAQ (رَزَّاق) though is only Allah but for providing food and nourishment, it can be used to refer to some other too. Allah says in the Quran
Surah An-Nisa (The women): سورۃ النِّسا 4:8
وَإِذَا حَضَرَ الْقِسْمَةَ أُولُو الْقُرْبَىٰ وَالْيَتَامَىٰ وَالْمَسَاكِينُ فَارْزُقُوهُم مِّنْهُ وَقُولُوا لَهُمْ قَوْلًا مَّعْرُوفًا
And when the relatives and the orphans and Al-Masakin (the poor) are present at the time of division, give them out of the property, and speak to them words of kindness and justice.
3.4   KHAIRA (خَیْر):   Is goodness or anything that seems better. Wealth is also goodness and bestowing of wealth upon someone is also a blessing of Allah because by spending wealth correctly and according to the guidance given by Shariah one can earn a lot of virtue and goodness. Allah says in the Quran
Surah Al-Baqarah (The cow): سورۃ البَقَرَۃ  2:215
قُلْ مَا أَنفَقْتُم مِّنْ خَيْرٍ فَلِلْوَالِدَيْنِ وَالْأَقْرَبِينَ وَالْيَتَامَىٰ وَالْمَسَاكِينِ وَابْنِ السَّبِيلِ
Say, "Whatever you spend of good is [to be] for parents and relatives and orphans and the needy and the traveler.
But the love for money is in the nature of human. As Allah says in the Quran
Surah Al-Adiyat (The Chargers): سُوۡرَةُ العَادیَات 100:8
وَإِنَّهُ لِحُبِّ الْخَيْرِ لَشَدِيدٌ
And he is fierce in his love of wealth.
When a person starts to obtain money illegally and does not differentiate between forbidden ways and legitimate ways to earn money, then this money which is a source of goodness and benefit becomes a calamity and a tribulation. Allah says in the Quran
Surah Al-Anfal (The Spoils of War): سُوۡرَةُ الاٴنفَال 8:28
أَنَّمَا أَمْوَالُكُمْ وَأَوْلَادُكُمْ فِتْنَةٌ
And know that your properties and your children are but a trial
3.5 AFAA’ (  اَفَاء  ):   FA’ (فئ) Is that wealth or riches that comes to Mujahedeen without engaging in a fight or battle, for instance if an infidel runs away from battle field before the start of battle then anything from their belongings will be called MAAL-E-FAY (مالِ فَے). And AFAA’ (اَفَاء) means to give someone the wealth of FAY (فَے). Allah says in Quran
Surah Al Hashr (The exile): سورۃ الحَشر 59:7
مَّا أَفَاءَ اللَّهُ عَلَىٰ رَسُولِهِ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْقُرَىٰ فَلِلَّهِ وَلِلرَّسُولِ وَلِذِي الْقُرْبَىٰ وَالْيَتَامَىٰ وَالْمَسَاكِينِ وَابْنِ السَّبِيلِ
What Allah gave as booty (Fai') to His Messenger (Muhammad SAW) from the people of the townships, - it is for Allah, His Messenger (Muhammad SAW), the kindred (of Messenger Muhammad SAW), the orphans, Al-Masakin (the poor), and the wayfarer,
PAGE - 781
3.6 MAGHANIMA     (  مَغَانِم  ):   GHANAMA (غَنَم) means a herd of goats; ALGHANAMA (اَلْغَنَمُ) means to get hold of goats from somewhere, to obtain them. This word is also used for wealth and treasure looted from an enemy and MAGHNAM (مَغْنَم) (plural MAGHANAM (مغانم)) is spoils of war. By Sharia law it is the wealth and booty obtained from enemy after victory. For the earlier religious sects this wealth was forbidden but for Muslims this wealth has been permitted by Allah. Allah says in the Quran
Surah Al-Anfal (The Spoils of War): سُوۡرَةُ الاٴنفَال 8:69
فَكُلُوا مِمَّا غَنِمْتُمْ حَلَالًا طَيِّبًا
So consume what you have taken of war booty [as being] lawful and good,
In another place in Quran
Surah An-Nisa (The women): سورۃ النِّسا 4:94
تَبْتَغُونَ عَرَضَ الْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا فَعِندَ اللَّهِ مَغَانِمُ كَثِيرَةٌ
Coveting the perishable goods of this life: with Allah are profits and spoils abundant
3.7 ANFAAL (اَنْفَال):   NAFAL (نَفَل) means spoils of war, gift of deed, remittance, or something in excess. (Plural ANFAAL (اَنْفَال)). And NAFL (نَفْل) means something additional to dues and necessary things (dictionary al Manjad). ANFAAL (اَنْفَال) refers to both MAAL-E-GHNAEEMANT (مالِ غنیمت) (spoils of war in case of victory) and MAAL-E-FAY (مالِ فَے) (spoils of war in case enemy retreats without fighting). This word denotes to that subject under which this wealth was only allowed to followers of Prophet Muhammad (S.A.A.W) as an extra contribution or donation, which was forbidden for earlier orders of religion.  Allah says in the Quran
Surah Al-Anfal (The Spoils of War): سُوۡرَةُ الاٴنفَال 8:1
يَسْأَلُونَكَ عَنِ الْأَنفَالِ ۖ قُلِ الْأَنفَالُ لِلَّهِ وَالرَّسُولِ
They ask you (O Muhammad SAW) about the spoils of war. Say: "The spoils are for Allah and the Messenger.
Summary:
3.1 MAALA: Liquid assets, or things that can turn into liquid assets.
3.2 DAULAH: Return of prosperous time.
3.3 RIZQ: Anything that is a source for nourishing body or soul.
3.4 KHAIRA: Goodness in wealth, to earn and spend money according to Sharia guidance or in virtuous actions.
3.5 FAA’: The wealth and spoils that comes to mujahedeen if the enemy leaves the battle field without fighting,
3.6 MAGHANIMA: Spoils of war in result of victory over enemy in battle.
3.7 ANFAAL: MAAL-E- GHANEEMAT (مالِ غنیمت) or FAY (فَے). This word refers to this kind of wealth being an extra donation from Allah.

30 MASHHUWR KARNA [Disseminate/Promulgate]
Synonyms SHA3A شَاعَfrom SH-YA-3A (شيع)  AZAA’ (اَذَاعَ) from ZA-YA-3A (ذيع)ARJAFA (اَرْجَفَ)AHALLA (اَھَلَّ)
30.1 SHA3A (شَاعَ)  :SHA3A ALKHABR(شَاعَ الْخَبْر) meaning news spread out and in force. SHA3A ALQAWM شاع القوم meaning nation dispersed and increased.and ASHSHIYA3 الشياع meaning to be dispersed and to strengthen. so word SHA3 is used for spreading of some discourse whether good or bad among the people and also along with that to become common.from this is derived famous word ASHA3AT اشاعت(Circulation of print news/media/publication) .ALLAH said
Surah Al-Noor (The light): سورۃ النور 24:19
إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يُحِبُّونَ أَن تَشِيعَ الْفَاحِشَةُ فِي الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
Those who love to see immorality spread among the believers—for them is a painful punishment, in this life and in the Hereafter.
30.2 AZAA’ (اَذَاعَ):    ZAA’ (ذَاعَ) means to appear and spread. ZAA’-AL-KHABAR (ذاع الخبر) means news appeared and spread. RAJULUN-AZAUN (رَجُلٌ یذَاعٌ) is a person who cannot keep secret. Thus AZAA’ (اَذَاعَ) means surfacing of such news that was not supposed to come to lime light. And IZAA’H (اِذَاعَة) means a radio. Because radio telecasts news of countries who are not pleased by telecasting of it. Means spreading of news. Allah says in the Quran
Surah An-Nisa (The women): سورۃ النِّسا 4:83
وَإِذَا جَاءَهُمْ أَمْرٌ مِّنَ الْأَمْنِ أَوِ الْخَوْفِ أَذَاعُوا بِهِ
And when there comes to them information about [public] security or fear, they spread it around.
30.3 ARJAFA (اَرْجَفَ):   RAJF (رَجْف) means extreme agitation. RAJAFAH (رَجْفَة) means the climax of earthquake. Violent tremors and BAHRUN-RIJAFUN (بَحْرٌ رِجافٌ) means violent sea (dictionary al Manjad). ARJAFA (اَرْجَفَ) means causing perturbation and thrill amongst people by spreading a rumor, ARAJEEF (اَرَاجِیف) means baseless news, rumors. Allah says in the Quran
Surah Al-Ahzaab (The clans): سورۃ الأحزَاب 33:60
لَّئِن لَّمْ يَنتَهِ الْمُنَافِقُونَ وَالَّذِينَ فِي قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌ وَالْمُرْجِفُونَ فِي الْمَدِينَةِ لَنُغْرِيَنَّكَ بِهِمْ ثُمَّ لَا يُجَاوِرُونَكَ فِيهَا إِلَّا قَلِيلًا
If the hypocrites and those in whose hearts is disease and those who spread rumors in al-Madinah do not cease, We will surely incite you against them; then they will not remain your neighbors therein except for a little.
30.4 AHALLA (اَھَلَّ):   Means to raise voices by taking name of something. HILAL (ھِلاَل) means a new moon, upon seeing it people call each other and raise voices. TEHLEEL means to say LA-ILAHA-ILLALAH (لَاالٰهَ اِلَّا اللہُ) loudly. In the Quran
Surah Al-Baqarah (The cow): سورۃ البَقَرَۃ  2:173
إِنَّمَا حَرَّمَ عَلَيْكُمُ الْمَيْتَةَ وَالدَّمَ وَلَحْمَ الْخِنزِيرِ وَمَا أُهِلَّ بِهِ لِغَيْرِ اللَّهِ
Surely He has prohibited for you only carrion (i.e. dead meat) and blood and the flesh of swine, and whatever has been acclaimed to other than Allah
Summary:
30.1 ASHAA’: To spread good news. To publish.
30.2 AZAA’: To spread news.  To spread out secrets or things related to secrets.
30.3 ARJAFA: To spread something that causes perturbation and restlessness.
30.4 AHALLA: To raise voice by taking name of something and make it popular.

31 MAZBOOT [firm, strong]
Synonyms: THABIT, RASIKH, MATEEN, MUHKAM, QAYYIMAH, WUTHQA
31.1 THABIT (ثَابِت):   THABAT (ثَبَتَ) means to withstand, THABT-ALA-AMR (ثبت علی الامر) means to be perpetual in some matter (dictionary al Manjad). Opposite ZALL (زَلّ) meaning to not stand form on one’s base. To slip. Allah says on the Quran
Surah Ibraheem (Abraham): سورۃ ابراھیم 14:24
مَثَلًا كَلِمَةً طَيِّبَةً كَشَجَرَةٍ طَيِّبَةٍ أَصْلُهَا ثَابِتٌ وَفَرْعُهَا فِي السَّمَاءِ
A good word is like a good tree—its root is firm, and its branches are in the sky.
31.2 RASIKH (راسِخ):   To hold to one place (dictionary al Manjad), means something tough and robust. RASAKH-AL-HIBR-FIS-SAHEEFAH (رَسَخَ الْحِبْر فی الصحیفة) means the ink solidified in book. And RASAKH-AL-ILM-FIL-QALB (رَسَخَ الْعِلْمُ فِی القَلْبِ) means the knowledge settling into heart (dictionary al Manjad). Thus RASKH (رسخ) has substantiation as well as affirmation in it. And also to know something with reasons or according to need which cannot be redressed. Allah says in the Quran
Surah Ale- Imran (The family of Imran): سورۃ آل عِمْرن 3:7
ۗ وَمَا يَعْلَمُ تَأْوِيلَهُ إِلَّا اللَّهُ ۗ وَالرَّاسِخُونَ فِي الْعِلْمِ يَقُولُونَ آمَنَّا بِهِ
But none knows its interpretation except God and those firmly rooted in knowledge say, “We believe in it; all is from our Lord.”
31.3 MATEEN (مَتَیْن):   MATN (متن) means something has been firm individually, solid, and the strength spreading in it. HABLUM-MATEENUN (حَبْلٌ مَّتَیْن) means a strong rope; RAYA-MATEENUN (رَاْیَ مَتَیْن) means a strong opinion. Allah says in the Quran
Surah Al-Qalam (The Pen):سورۃ القلم  68:45
وَأُمْلِي لَهُمْ ۚ إِنَّ كَيْدِي مَتِينٌ
And I will give them respite. My plan is firm.
31.4 MUHKAM (مُحْکم):   AHKAMA (احْکَمَ) means something getting sturdy due to experience and wisdom (dictionary al Manjad). According to Imam Raghib AYAT-E-MAHKAMAAT (ایا ت محکمات) are those Ayahs that contain no ambiguity in meaning and wording. Allah says in the Quran
Surah Ale- Imran (The family of Imran): سورۃ آل عِمْرن 3:7
هُوَ الَّذِي أَنزَلَ عَلَيْكَ الْكِتَابَ مِنْهُ آيَاتٌ مُّحْكَمَاتٌ هُنَّ أُمُّ الْكِتَابِ وَأُخَرُ مُتَشَابِهَاتٌ
It is He who revealed to you the Book. Some of its verses are definitive; they are the foundation of the Book, and others are unspecific.

A Messenger from Allah, reciting Scrolls purified, Therein are ever-upright Books.
31.6 WUTHQA (وُثْقٰی):   WATHIQA YATHIQU THIQATAN (وَثِقَ یَثِقُ ثِقَةً) means to trust or rely on something. WATHUQA YUTHAQU WATHAQATAN (وَثُقَ یُوْثَقُ وَثَاقَةً) means to be firm and powerful, to be strong. And AWTHAQA (اَوْثَقَ) means to tie up a rope firmly.  THIQATUN (ثِقَةٌ) trustworthy, reliable and AWTHAQUN (اَوْثَقَ) (Feminine WUTHQA (وُثْقٰی)) means tough and reliable thing. Allah says in the Quran.

Whoever renounces evil and believes in God has grasped the most trustworthy handle; which does not break.
Summary:
31.1 THABIT: To stand firm on your base.
31.2 RASIKH: Firm and sturdy. Unshakeable.
31.3 MATEEN: Something being robust individually.
31.4 MUHKAM: Strong, or affirm due to wisdom and experience.
31.5 QAYYIMAH: A strong object which can support other things, or be used as a standard.
31.6 WUTHQA: A strength that is reliable.

31 MAZBOOT [firm, strong]

Synonyms: THABIT, RASIKH, MATEEN, MUHKAM, QAYYIMAH, WUTHQA

31.1 THABIT (ثَابِت): THABAT (ثَبَتَ) means to withstand, THABT-ALA-AMR (ثبت علی الامر) means to be perpetual in some matter (dictionary al Manjad). Opposite ZALL (زَلّ) meaning to not stand form on one’s base. To slip. Allah says on the Quran

Surah Ibraheem (Abraham): سورۃ ابراھیم 14:24

مَثَلًا كَلِمَةً طَيِّبَةً كَشَجَرَةٍ طَيِّبَةٍ أَصْلُهَا ثَابِتٌ وَفَرْعُهَا فِي السَّمَاءِ

 A good word is like a good tree—its root is firm, and its branches are in the sky.

31.2 RASIKH (راسِخ): To hold to one place (dictionary al Manjad), means something tough and robust. RASAKH-AL-HIBR-FIS-SAHEEFAH (رَسَخَ الْحِبْر فی الصحیفة) means the ink solidified in book. And RASAKH-AL-ILM-FIL-QALB (رَسَخَ الْعِلْمُ فِی القَلْبِ) means the knowledge settling into heart (dictionary al Manjad). Thus RASKH (رسخ) has substantiation as well as affirmation in it. And also to know something with reasons or according to need which cannot be redressed. Allah says in the Quran

Surah Ale- Imran (The family of Imran): سورۃ آل عِمْرن 3:7

31.3 MATEEN (مَتَیْن): MATN (متن) means something has been firm individually, solid, and the strength spreading in it. HABLUM-MATEENUN (حَبْلٌ مَّتَیْن) means a strong rope; RAYA-MATEENUN (رَاْیَ مَتَیْن) means a strong opinion. Allah says in the Quran

32 MAZBOOT BANANA – KARNA [to strengthen, to make firm]
SYNONYMS: THABBATA, AHKAMA, AWTHAQA, SHADD, ATHQANA, RABATA, AZARA, AQQDA, WAKKADA, SANNADA, RASSA, SHAYYAD
32.1 THABBATA (ثَبَّتَ):   Means to solidify something in its place, to strengthen, to make it stand firm. Allah says in the Quran
Surah Ibraheem (Abraham): سورۃ ابراھیم 14:27
يُثَبِّتُ اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا بِالْقَوْلِ الثَّابِتِ فِي الْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ
Allah will establish in strength those who believe, with the word that stands firm, in this world and in the Hereafter;
32.2 AHKAMA (اَحْکم):   Wisdom, to strengthen something with experience and profundity. And HAKEEM (حکیم) means a scholar of Laws and affairs. Allah says in the Quran
Surah Al-Hajj (The Pilgrimage): سُوۡرَةُ الحَجّ 22:52
ثُمَّ يُحْكِمُ اللَّهُ آيَاتِهِ
God affirms His revelations.
AYAT-E-MUHKMAAT (ایا ت محکمٰت) are those that have no ambiguity in meaning and words.
Page 814
32.3 AWTHAQA (اَوْثَقَ):   Means to make an oath strong and reliable. Or bind someone firmly with ropes. Allah says in the Quran
Surah Al-Fajr (The Dawn): سُوۡرَةُ الفَجر 89:26
وَلَا يُوثِقُ وَثَاقَهُ أَحَدٌ
And none will bind [as severely] as His binding [of the evildoers].
In another place in the Quran
Surah Al-Maeda (The table spread): سورۃ المَائدہ 5:7
وَاذْكُرُوا نِعْمَةَ اللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ وَمِيثَاقَهُ الَّذِي وَاثَقَكُم بِهِ
And remember the favor of Allah on you and His covenant with which He bound you firmly,
32.4 SHADD (شدّ):   Something being strong and robust individually. Used as both transitive and intransitive. And SHADEED (شدید) means extreme, ASHUDD (اشُدّ) means that part of youth when strength is at its peak. Allah says in the Quran
Surah Al-Insan (The Man) - سورة الانسان 76:28
نَّحْنُ خَلَقْنَاهُمْ وَشَدَدْنَا أَسْرَهُمْ
We have created them and strengthened their forms,
32.5 ATHQAN-AL-AMR (اَثْقَنَ الْاَمْر):   Means to make a task firmly. And THAQQAN-AL-ARD (ثَقَّنَ الْاَرْضَ) means to strengthen and enriching earth by irrigating it with muddy and rich water. RAJULUN-THAQINUN (رَجُلٌ ثَقِنٌ) means someone who performs a task reliably. Expert in a task (dictionary al Manjad). Intelligent in work, and someone who performs a task correctly. This ATHQAN (اَثْقَنَ) means to strengthen something with expertise. Allah says in the Quran
Surah An-Naml (The ant): سورۃ النَّمل 27:88
صُنْعَ اللَّهِ الَّذِي أَتْقَنَ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ
The Work of Allah, Who perfected all things,
32.6 RABATA (رَبَطَ):   Means to tie up firmly, an idiom. RABT ALLAHU ALA QALBHI (ربط اللہُ علٰی قلبه) means Allah bestowed his heart with strength and patience. And RIBAAT (رِبَاط) means something which other things are tied to. RABITA (رَابِطہ) means bonds and attachments (dictionary al Manjad). Allah says in the Quran
Surah Al Qasas (The stories): سورۃ القَصَص 28:10
وَأَصْبَحَ فُؤَادُ أُمِّ مُوسَىٰ فَارِغًا ۖ إِن كَادَتْ لَتُبْدِي بِهِ لَوْلَا أَن رَّبَطْنَا عَلَىٰ قَلْبِهَا
And the heart of the mother of Musa (Moses) became empty [from every thought, except the thought of Musa (Moses)]. She was very near to disclose his (case, i.e. the child is her son), had We not strengthened her heart (with Faith)
32.7 AZARA (اٰزَرَ):   AL-IZR (اَلْاِزْر) means root or TEHBAND (a cloth around the waist and passing between the legs); AL-AZAAR (الازار) means a sheet of cloth, TEHBAND, curtains, support or a wall. AAZAR-AN-NABATAT (اٰزَرَ النبات) means entwining of plants. AZZARAH (اَزَّرَہ) means to give strength, to empower (dictionary al Manjad). Thus AAZARA (اٰزَرَ) means to strengthen someone gradually by giving it power. Allah says in the Quran
Surah Al-Fath (The victory): سورۃ الفَتْح  48:29
كَزَرْعٍ أَخْرَجَ شَطْأَهُ فَآزَرَهُ
Like a plant that sprouts, becomes strong, grows thick, and rests on its stem,
Page 815
32.8 WAKKADA (وَکَّدَ):   WIKAAD (وکاد) is that rope with which the legs of cows and other animals are tied together while milking them. WAKKAD (وَکَّد) or AKKAD (اَکَّدَ), or AWKAD-AS-SARJ-AWIL-AHAD (اَوْکَدَ السَّرج اَوِالْعَھْد) means to tie up firmly or strengthen an accord.
Surah An-Nahl (The Bee): سورۃ النّحل16:91
وَلَا تَنقُضُوا الْأَيْمَانَ بَعْدَ تَوْكِيدِهَا
And do not break oaths after their confirmation
32.9 AQQDA (عَقَّدَ):   AQADA (عَقَدَ) means to tie a knot; AQDAH (عقدۃ) means a knot, tangle, or a difficult matter. AQQAD-AL-BAE’-WAL-YAMEEN (عَقَّد البیع و الیمین) to an oath or (dictionary al Manjad). AQD (عَقْد) means an oath or a covenant; Declaration. (Plural AQOOD (عقود)) Allah says in the Quran
Surah Al-Maeda (The table spread): سورۃ المَائدہ 5:89
لَا يُؤَاخِذُكُمُ اللَّهُ بِاللَّغْوِ فِي أَيْمَانِكُمْ وَلَٰكِن يُؤَاخِذُكُم بِمَا عَقَّدتُّمُ الْأَيْمَانَ
Allah will not call you to account for what is futile in your oaths, but He will call you to account for your deliberate oaths:
32.10 SANNADA (سَنَّدَ):   SANADA (سَنَدَ) to trust, to rely, to get support from, SANNADA (سَنَّدَ) means to give support and strengthen (dictionary al Manjad). For instance when the wood supporting the roof gets weak, then another wood log is place under them to support and strengthen the roof. Allah says in the Quran
Surah Al-Munafiqoon (The Hypocrites) - سورة المنافقون 63:4
كَأَنَّهُمْ خُشُبٌ مُّسَنَّدَةٌ ۖ يَحْسَبُونَ كُلَّ صَيْحَةٍ عَلَيْهِمْ
[They are] as if they were pieces of wood propped up - they think that every shout is against them.
32.11 RASSA (رَصَّ):   Means to connect something, to join, to sinter RASAS (رصاص) also means lead. Thus RASSAH (رَصَّ) means to strengthen something by adding molten lead to it. Allah says in the Quran
Surah As-Saf (The Ranks) - سورة الصف 61:4
إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الَّذِينَ يُقَاتِلُونَ فِي سَبِيلِهِ صَفًّا كَأَنَّهُم بُنْيَانٌ مَّرْصُوصٌ
Indeed, Allah loves those who fight in His cause in a row as though they are a [single] structure joined firmly.
32.12 SHAYYAD (شَیَّدَ):   SHAAD-AL-HAIT (شَادَ الحَائِط) means to plaster a wall with lime (dictionary al Manjad). And SHAYYAD (شَیَّدَ) is to plaster over a wall with lime or other cement in order to fortify a building. Allah says in the Quran
Surah An-Nisa (The women): سورۃ النِّسا 4:78
أَيْنَمَا تَكُونُوا يُدْرِككُّمُ الْمَوْتُ وَلَوْ كُنتُمْ فِي بُرُوجٍ مُّشَيَّدَةٍ
Wherever you may be, death will catch up with you, even if you were in fortified towers.
Summary:
32.1 THABBATA: To keep something firm and strong in its place.
32.2 AHKAMA: To remove ambiguity in words using wisdom and experience.
32.3 AWTHAQA:to make something strong and reliable with some other thing
32.4 SHADDA:to strengthen something in it of itself by reinforcing it.
32.5 ATHQANA:to strengthen something by means of mastery of skill
32.6 RABATA ALLAH 3LA ALQALB(ربط اللّه علي القلب):ALLAH strengthening heart by bestowing patience upon it.
32.7 AZARA:to strengthen gradually by reinforcing
32.8 AKKAD:to strengthen vows,pledges and oaths
32.9 AQQDA:for strengthening transactions/trade,nuptial contract,and every other type of vows and promises.and is general/common than AKKAD
32.10 SANNADA:to strengthen by giving support
32.11 RASSA: to strengthen something by means of 'moltenlead'[figurative usage:implies intensely firm]
32.12 SHAYYAD:to strengthen building by plastering with lime etc.
for MAZBUWTIY SAY PAKARNA [To Hold Strongly/firmly] please see PAKARNA[To Hold]

{
Synonyms:AFFA(AFFU),ASFAHA,GHAFARA,TASADDAQA,
TAJAWAZA,(3N),KAFFARA(3N),HITTATUN
1 AFFA(عَفَا):to pardon punishment or    avenge.to    let go some person deservng punishment. to not avenge him whether its minor or severe
Surat At-Tawbah [9:43] - The Noble Qur'an
عَفَا   اللَّهُ عَنكَ لِمَ أَذِنتَ لَهُمْ
May Allah   pardon   you, [O Muhammad]; why did you give them permission [to remain behind]?
2 ASFAHA(اَصْفَحَ):to forgive to let go.not even letting someone aware of one's    wrong.to    not put one to trial,this is more difficult than pardon. and ASFAHA is superior to AFFA.AFFA is pardon of punishment and ASFAHA is pardon of rebuke
Surat Al-Baqarah [2:109] - The Noble Qur'an
فَاعْفُوا وَاصْفَحُوا     حَتَّىٰ يَأْتِيَ اللَّهُ بِأَمْرِهِ ۗ
So   pardon   and   overlook   until Allah delivers His command
3 GHAFARA(غَفَرَ):meaning to cover up something with such a thing that will protect it against dirt and other    hazards.it    is said GHAFAR ALSHABAB BIL KHIZAB(غفر الشباب بالخضاب) i.e he hide whiteness of hair with haircolour and MIGHFAR(مِغْفَر) meaning Armor Helmet that soldiers wear during war it's also called ALGHAFARA(الغفارة) and ALGHAFARA is also the cloth which women put under their head scarf to protect it from oil.It is the cloth that is used to cover bow. and GHUFRAN(غفران) from ALLAH meaning that HE cover up man from punishment of man sins. and GHAFARA (connnecting with ل) meaning ALLAH protecting man from the punishment of man's sin. and GHUFRAN requires curse to be void and this is what makes reward mandatory
Surat 'Ali `Imran [3:135] - The Noble Qur'an
وَمَن   يَغْفِرُ   الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ
and who can   forgive   sins except Allah ?
ISTAGHFAR(اِستغفر) is used to seek forgiveness of sin from ALLAH.and it always refer to ALLAH whether ALLAH's name is mentioned or not
Surat Al-Munafiqun [63:6] - The Noble Qur'an
سَوَاءٌ عَلَيْهِمْ   أَسْتَغْفَرْتَ   لَهُمْ أَمْ لَمْ   تَسْتَغْفِرْ   لَهُمْ
It is all the same for them whether you   ask forgiveness   for them or do not   ask forgiveness   for them;
4 TASADDAQA( تَصَدَّقَ):meaning to give up one's right and to forgive one's right to other
Surat Al-Baqarah [2:280] - The Noble Qur'an
وَإِن كَانَ ذُو عُسْرَةٍ فَنَظِرَةٌ إِلَىٰ مَيْسَرَةٍ ۚ وَأَن   تَصَدَّقُوا   خَيْرٌ لَّكُمْ
And if someone is in hardship, then [let there be] postponement until [a time of] ease. But if you   give [from your right as] charity  , then it is better for you,
5 TAJAWAZA(تَجَاوَزَ):used with (عن) JAZA(جَازَ)meaning something legit. not forbidden.JAWAZ ALMAKAN(جَاوزَ المكان) meaning to move ahead of some place.TAJAWA 3NHU(تجَاوزَ عنه) meaning to cover up,to forgive. TAJAWAZ ALAMR(تجَاوزَ في الامر) meaning to be reckless in some action.and meaning increase in weakness but as favour to be not put to trial
Surat Al-'Ahqaf [46:16] - The Noble Qur'an

35 MAQDUWR - HAYCIYAT [Affordability/Capacity-Status]
Synonyms: WUJD وُجْد SA3AH سَعَة QADR   قدر these three words exhibits the state of economic condition or subsistance of some person
35.1 WUJD  : WAJADA وَجَدَ  meaning to find, and WUJD meaning present,exist.exists meaning whatever one has of the necessities of life.ALLAH said
Surat Aţ-Ţalāq (The Divorce) - سورة الطلاق
65:6
أَسْكِنُوهُنَّ مِنْ حَيْثُ سَكَنتُم مِّن وُجْدِكُمْ وَلَا تُضَارُّوهُنَّ لِتُضَيِّقُوا عَلَيْهِنَّ ۚ وَإِن كُنَّ أُولَاتِ حَمْلٍ فَأَنفِقُوا عَلَيْهِنَّ حَتَّىٰ يَضَعْنَ حَمْلَهُنَّ ۚ فَإِنْ أَرْضَعْنَ لَكُمْ فَآتُوهُنَّ أُجُورَهُنَّ ۖ وَأْتَمِرُوا بَيْنَكُم بِمَعْرُوفٍ ۖ وَإِن تَعَاسَرْتُمْ فَسَتُرْضِعُ لَهُ أُخْرَىٰ
Lodge them [in a section] of where you dwell out of your means and do not harm them in order to oppress them. And if they should be pregnant, then spend on them until they give birth. And if they breastfeed for you, then give them their payment and confer among yourselves in the acceptable way; but if you are in discord, then there may breastfeed for the father another woman.
35.2 SA3AH  : meaning wideness,capacity-state of relief-this word is used to signify the level of relief of a   human.it  doesn't contain the context of difficulty.ALLAH said
Surat Aţ-Ţalāq (The Divorce) - سورة الطلاق
65:7
لِيُنفِقْ ذُو سَعَةٍ مِّن سَعَتِهِ ۖ وَمَن قُدِرَ عَلَيْهِ رِزْقُهُ فَلْيُنفِقْ مِمَّا آتَاهُ اللَّهُ ۚ لَا يُكَلِّفُ اللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا مَا آتَاهَا ۚ سَيَجْعَلُ اللَّهُ بَعْدَ عُسْرٍ يُسْرًا
Let a man of wealth spend from his wealth, and he whose provision is restricted - let him spend from what Allah has given him. Allah does not charge a soul except [according to] what He has given it. Allah will bring about, after hardship, ease.
35.3 QADAR  :this word relative to it's reality is used for  the state of difficulty and to specifying it level.ALLAH said
Surat Ar-Ra`d (The Thunder) - سورة الرعد
13:26
اللَّهُ يَبْسُطُ الرِّزْقَ لِمَن يَشَاءُ وَيَقْدِرُ ۚ وَفَرِحُوا بِالْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا وَمَا الْحَيَاةُ الدُّنْيَا فِي الْآخِرَةِ إِلَّا مَتَاعٌ
Allah extends provision for whom He wills and restricts [it]. And they rejoice in the worldly life, while the worldly life is not, compared to the Hereafter, except [brief] enjoyment.
but this word is also used by QURAN for specifying both the levels of difficulty and comfort as well
Page 820
Allah says in the Quran.
Surah Al-Baqarah (The cow): سورۃ البَقَرَۃ  2:236
عَلَى الْمُوسِعِ قَدَرُهُ وَعَلَى الْمُقْتِرِ قَدَرُهُ
But bestow on them (a suitable gift), the rich according to his means, and the poor according to his means,
Summary  :
35.1: WUJD: A common word for existing items/provisions.
35.2: SA3AH: for Comfort and to signify its level.
35.3 QADAR: commonly used for Difficulty and to signify its level.

36 MUQARAR KARNA [to appoint, to set]
Synonyms: FARADA, WAKKALA, AJJAL
36.1 FARADA (فَرَضَ):   Means to cut something hard, to puncture. To put a mark on a hard object. FARRAD-AL-KHASHBAH (فَرَّضَ الْخَشْبَةَ) means to make a hole in wood. FARD-AL-AMAR (فَرَضَ الْاَمر) is some task that is a must and compulsory. ALFARD (الفَرْض) refers to the laws set for humans by Allah or something that is made compulsory on oneself   (dictionary al Manjad)  . FAREEDATAN (فَرَضَةً) means something that is compulsory, appointed or set. Mahr of a woman (Mahr is a mandatory gift given by the groom to the bride)   (dictionary al Manjad)  .
Surah Al-Baqarah (The cow): سورۃ البَقَرَۃ  2:236
لَّا جُنَاحَ عَلَيْكُمْ إِن طَلَّقْتُمُ النِّسَاءَ مَا لَمْ تَمَسُّوهُنَّ أَوْ تَفْرِضُوا لَهُنَّ فَرِيضَةً
There is no sin on you, if you divorce women while yet you have not touched (had sexual relation with) them, nor appointed unto them their Mahr (bridal money given by the husband to his wife at the time of marriage)
36.2 WAKKALA (وَکَّلَ):   WAKALA (وَکَلَ) means to trust somebody else in one’s own matter. WAKKAL (وَکَّلَ) means to trust somebody and leave one’s matters to him. To appoint a representative or delegate   (dictionary al Manjad)  . Allah says in the Quran
Surah Al-Ana’am (The Cattle): سورۃ الانعام 6:89
فَإِن يَكْفُرْ بِهَا هَٰؤُلَاءِ فَقَدْ وَكَّلْنَا بِهَا قَوْمًا لَّيْسُوا بِهَا بِكَافِرِينَ
But if the disbelievers deny it, then We have entrusted it to a people who are not therein disbelievers.
36.3 AJJAL (اَجَّلَ):   AJAL (اَجَل) means s fixed time period of something. The time period of a man’s life is also called AJAL (اَجَل). The idiom ‘ دَنَااَجَلُهُ’ means the time of his passing is near. AJJAL (اَجَّلَ) means to set time period for something. In the Quran
Surah Al-Ana’am (The Cattle): سورۃ الانعام 6:128
وَبَلَغْنَا أَجَلَنَا الَّذِي أَجَّلْتَ لَنَا
but now we have reached our appointed term which You did appoint for us.
Summary:
36.1 FARADA: To make a task compulsory and must, to set it.
36.2 WAKKALA: To put someone in charge, to appoint a representative.
36.3 AJJAL: Means to set a time period.

Synonyms: DUBAB, NAHL
37.1 DUBAB (ذُبَاب):   Means a small fly, DABB ANHU (ذَبَّ عَنْهُ) means to remove flies from someone. To disperse flies or exempt from blame.  MADIBBAH (مَذِبَّة) means a fly whisk or a fan made from feather. (Plural DUBBUN (ذُبٌّ), ADIBBAH (اَذِبَّة)). Allah says in the Quran
Surah Al-Hajj  (The Pilgrimage): سُوۡرَةُ الحَجّ 22:73
وَإِن يَسْلُبْهُمُ الذُّبَابُ شَيْئًا لَّا يَسْتَنقِذُوهُ مِنْهُ
And if the fly steals anything from them, they cannot recover it from it.
37.2 NAHL (نَحْل):   Means a honey bee. For both male and female honey bee. (Singular NAHLAH (نَحْلَةٌ)) Allah says in the Quran

And your Lord inspired to the bee, "Take for yourself among the mountains, houses,

38 MILNA [meet, mix]
Synonyms: LAQIA, LAHAQA, WALIA, ASNA, IKHTALATA, TAJAWAR, RATAQA, TAHYYAZ, ISHTAMMALA
38.1 LAQIA (لَقَیَ):   Two things meeting each other from front. To visit. To meet coming from front. Allah says in the Quran
Surah Al-Baqarah (The cow): سورۃ البَقَرَۃ  2:14
وَإِذَا لَقُوا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا قَالُوا آمَنَّا
And when they meet those who believe, they say, "We believe";
38.2  LAHAQA (لَحَقَ):   Something meeting a similar thing, LAHIQA (لَاحِقَ) a thing that meets the one before. The fruit that comes after the first time   (dictionary al Manjad)  . Allah says in the Quran
Surah Ale- Imran (The family of Imran): سورۃ آل عِمْرن 3:170
وَيَسْتَبْشِرُونَ بِالَّذِينَ لَمْ يَلْحَقُوا بِهِم مِّنْ خَلْفِهِمْ
they receive good tidings about those [to be martyred] after them who have not yet joined them -
Surah Al-Jumah (The Congregation, Friday) - سورة الجمعة 62:3
وَآخَرِينَ مِنْهُمْ لَمَّا يَلْحَقُوا بِهِمْ
And [to] others of them who have not yet joined them. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
Page 822
38.3  WALIA (وَلِیَ):    WALIA (وَلِیَ) and WALA-YAL-WALIAN (وَلَی یَلی وَلْیاً)means to be near or close, contiguous; to follow someone without distance   (dictionary al Manjad)  . To seem like meeting because of closeness. This word is both used for place and time. To be close due to blood. Closeness due to friendship or religion. Following is the example with respect to place
Surah Al Tawbah (The repentance): سورۃ التوبھ 9:123
يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا قَاتِلُوا الَّذِينَ يَلُونَكُم مِّنَ الْكُفَّارِ
O you who have believed, fight those adjacent to you of the disbelievers
It means to fight those infidels who live near to you first and if they turn to Muslim and accept the religion then fight those who live next to them and further on. In case of time this word is perhaps not used in Quran. But according to the hadith of Prophet Muhammad (S.A.A.W)
خَیْرُ الْقُرُوْنِ قَرْنِیْ ثُمَّ الَّذِیْنَ یَلُوْنَھُمْ ثُمَّ الَّذِیْنَ یَلُوْنَھُمْ۔
The best of mankind is my generation, then those that follow them and then those that follow them.
And it means the best time are that of Prophet Muhammad (S.A.A.W) and then of his companions (R.A.A) and then his followers.
38.4 ASNA (اَصْنٰی):   ASNA-AN-NAKHAL (اَصْنٰی النخل) means sprouting of two date palms from one root. SINW (صِنْو) is the depth between two mountains and where the water flows. And if two date palms sprout from a single root then each of them is the SINW (صِنْو) of other. In the same way real brothers are also SINW (صِنْو) of one another. Allah says in the Quran
Surah Al-Rad (The Thunder): سُوۡرَةُ الرّعد13:4
وَنَخِيلٌ صِنْوَانٌ وَغَيْرُ صِنْوَانٍ يُسْقَىٰ بِمَاءٍ وَاحِدٍ
and date-palms, growing out two or three from a single stem root,
38.5 IKHTALATA (اِخْتَلَطَ):   Means mixing together of two things, (opposite KHALAS (خَلَصَ)) intermixed or intermingled. Allah says in the Quran
Surah Al-Kahf (The Cave): سورۃ الکھف 18:45
كَمَاءٍ أَنزَلْنَاهُ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ فَاخْتَلَطَ بِهِ نَبَاتُ الْأَرْضِ
We send down from the sky, and the vegetation of the earth mingles with it
38.6 TAJAWAR (تَجَاوَرَ):   JAR (جار) means neighbor, JAWARA (جَاوَرَ) and TAJAWARA (تَجَاوَرَ) something being contiguous due to the small distance between. To live next to each other. To live in the same neighborhood   (dictionary al Manjad)  . To be together, to live in the neighborhood. In the Quran
Surah Al-Rad (The Thunder): سُوۡرَةُ الرّعد13:4
وَفِي الْأَرْضِ قِطَعٌ مُّتَجَاوِرَاتٌ
And within the land are neighboring plots
38.7 RATAQA (رَتَقَ):   Means joining together of two or more things, to be glued together   (dictionary al Manjad)  . RATQA’ (رَتقَاء) is that woman, the edge of whose private parts are joined together so that she cannot be copulated. Allah says in the Quran
Surah Al-Anbiya (the prophets): سورۃ الانَبیاء 21:30
أَوَلَمْ يَرَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا أَنَّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ كَانَتَا رَتْقًا فَفَتَقْنَاهُمَا
Have those who disbelieved not considered that the heavens and the earth were a joined entity, and We separated them
Page 823
38.8 TAHYYAZ (تَحَیَّزَ):   From the dictionary of opposites, Means to get separated and meet again.
38.9 ISHTAMALA (اِشْتَمَلَ):   ASH-SHAML (اَلشَّمْل) means a combined task. Contingent matter. JAMAA’-ALLAHU-SHAMLAHUM ( جَمَعَ اللہُ شَمْلَھُمْ) means Allah merged their dispersed tasks. FARRAQA-ALLAHU-SHAMLAHUM (فَرَّقَ اللہُ شَمْلَھُمْ) means Allah broke up their assemblage. SHAMILA (شَمِلَ) means to cover with a sheet. SHAMALA (شَمَلَ) and SHAMILA (شَمِلَ) to include everyone. To be usual   (dictionary al Manjad)  . ISHTAMALA (اِشْتَمَلَ) means to combine the dispersed and separated ingredients to the real thing. To combine. In the Quran
Surah Al-Ana’am (The Cattle): سورۃ الانعام 6:143
أَمَّا اشْتَمَلَتْ عَلَيْهِ أَرْحَامُ الْأُنثَيَيْنِ
or (the young) which the wombs of the two females enclose?
Summary:
38.1 LAQIA: Two things meeting together from front.
38.2 LAHAQA: Something meeting a similar older thing.
38.3 WALIA: Two living things meeting each other with respect to time or place.
38.4 ASNA: Those combined things whose roots are same.
38.5 IKHTALATA: To mix up, to intermix.
38.6 TAJAWAR: Two things meeting each other being near.
38.7 RATAQA: Meet and get joined. Sealed opening.
38.8 TAHYYAZ: To get separated and meet again.
38.9 ISHTAMMALA: Dispersed items of something combining in assemblage. To get included.
