39 MILANA [to mix, to arrange to meet]
Synonyms: KHALATA, ALHAQA, WASALA, ALLAFA, LABASA, RAKKABA, DAMMA, MASHAJA, MARAJA, SHABA, DAGHATHA
39.1 KHALATA (خَلَطَ):   (Opposite KHALASA (خَلَصَ)) to mix two or more things. To intermix or intermingle. Allah says in the Quran
Surah Al Tawbah (The repentance): سورۃ التوبھ 9:102
وَآخَرُونَ اعْتَرَفُوا بِذُنُوبِهِمْ خَلَطُوا عَمَلًا صَالِحًا وَآخَرَ سَيِّئًا
Others have confessed their sins, having mixed good deeds with bad deeds
Page 824
39.2   ALHAQA (اَلْحَقَ):   Means to mix from back. In the Quran
Surah Yusuf (Joseph): سورۃ یُوسُف 12:101
تَوَفَّنِي مُسْلِمًا وَأَلْحِقْنِي بِالصَّالِحِينَ
Receive my soul in submission, and unite me with the righteous.”
39.3 WASALA (وَصَلَ):   Means mixing of two things so that they become one, WASAAL (وصال) (Opposite HIJRAAN (ھجران)) and ATSAAL (اتصال) (Opposite ANFSAAL(انفصال)) to bring together, to join two things. This word is used both semantically and materially. Materially it means to reach something. And semantically to make up connections and to bound up with. Allah says in the Quran
Surah Al-Baqarah (The cow): سورۃ البَقَرَۃ  2:27
وَيَقْطَعُونَ مَا أَمَرَ اللَّهُ بِهِ أَن يُوصَلَ
and sever that which Allah ordered to be joined,
39.4 ALLAFA (اَلَّفَ):   Means to mix together the dispersed elements of a single thing, to recollect some dispersed things systematically. TALEEF-E-QULOOB (تالیفِ قلوب) means to remove the differences from heart and bring them together and inculcate love. ULFAT (اُلْفَت) means loving from heart. TALEEF (تألیف) is that idiom whose parts are put together by taking care their priorities and delays. Allah says in the Quran
Surah Al-Anfal (The Spoils of War): سُوۡرَةُ الاٴنفَال 8:63
وَأَلَّفَ بَيْنَ قُلُوبِهِمْ ۚ لَوْ أَنفَقْتَ مَا فِي الْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًا مَّا أَلَّفْتَ بَيْنَ قُلُوبِهِمْ
And He has brought their hearts together (Literally: joined "between" their hearts). If you had expended whatever is in the earth altogether, in no way could you have brought their hearts together;
39.5 LABASA (لَبَسَ):   YALBASU (یَلْبَسُ) means to wear clothes, to cover the body, LABSA-YALBISU (لَبَسَ یَلْبِسُ) means to mix one thing in another making the original thing suspicious and doubtful. TALBEES (تلبیس) means to hide the truth by displaying false and untrue things   (dictionary al Manjad), and LABS   (لبس)   comes in the meaning of suspicion (see SHAKK O SHUBA [suspicion]).  LABASA   (لَبَسَ)   is only used in negation and only in talks. Like mixing up truth and lies, virtue and vice. Allah says in the Quran
Surah Al-Baqarah (The cow): سورۃ البَقَرَۃ  2:42
وَلَا تَلْبِسُوا الْحَقَّ بِالْبَاطِلِ
And do not mix truth with falsehood
39.6 RAKKABA (رَکَّبَ):   RAKABA (رَکَبَ) means to mount, something mounting another thing. TARAKABA (تَرَاکَبَ) means to put one thing on another and mix them. RAKKABA (رَکَّبَ) means to mix together one thing with other, then mix in the third thing, then the fourth and similarly mixing them together and making them one. TARKEEB (ترکیب) is a famous word. Allah says in the Quran
Surah Al-Infitaar (The Cleaving) - سورة الإنفطار 82:7 - 8
الَّذِي خَلَقَكَ فَسَوَّاكَ فَعَدَلَكَ فِي أَيِّ صُورَةٍ مَّا شَاءَ رَكَّبَكَ
Who created you, fashioned you perfectly, and gave you due proportion; In whatever form He willed, He put you together.
Page 825
39.7 DAMMA (ضَمَّ):   Joining one part of a thing to its other part. To include; DAMEEMAH-AL-KITAB (ضمیمۃ الکتاب) is a famous word. In the Quran
Surah Ta-Ha (Ta-ha): سورۃ طٰھٰ  20:22
وَاضْمُمْ يَدَكَ إِلَىٰ جَنَاحِكَ تَخْرُجْ بَيْضَاءَ
And press your hand to your side, it shall come out white
39.8 MASHAJA (مَشَجَ):   To mix together, to intermix, MASHAJ (مشج) and MASHEEJ (مشیج) means mixed, (plural AMSHAAJ (امشاج))   (dictionary al Manjad). To mix together  things of the same gender and making them one.
Surah Al-Insan (The Man) - سورة الانسان 76:2
إِنَّا خَلَقْنَا الْإِنسَانَ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ أَمْشَاجٍ نَّبْتَلِيهِ
Verily, We have created man from Nutfah drops of mixed semen (discharge of man and woman),
39.9 MAZAJA (مَزَجَ):   MAZAJA-ASH-SHARAAB (مَزَجَ الشراب) to mix something in a drink, the thing that is mixed into the liquid is MIZJ (مِزْج) and MIZAAJ (مِزَاج)   (dictionary al Manjad)  . Medically when the different parts of a body are mixed together this condition is known as MIZAAJ (مِزَاج), condition or state. In the Quran
Surah Al-Insan (The Man) - سورة الانسان 76:17
وَيُسْقَوْنَ فِيهَا كَأْسًا كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا زَنجَبِيلًا
And they will be given to drink there a cup (of wine) mixed with Zanjabil (ginger, etc.),
39.10 MARAJA (مَرَجَ):   To things mixing together so that their individual properties remain in contact. GHUSNUN-MAREEJ (غَصْنٌ مَرِیْجٌ) means an intertwined branch of tree. AMAR-MAREEJ (امرمریج)means a complicated and difficult matter in which two or more opinions mix. Allah says in the Quran
Surah Ar-Rahman (The Beneficent): سُوۡرَةُ الرَّحمٰن 55:19
مَرَجَ الْبَحْرَيْنِ يَلْتَقِيَانِ
He has let loosed the two seas (the salt water and the sweet) meeting together.
39.11 SHABA (شَابَ):   Means to mix, to trick someone, defalcation   (dictionary al Manjad). (SHOUB   (شوب)  ) or honey or any eatable that is mixed into other things. Surah As-Saaffat (The Aligners): سُوۡرَةُ الصَّافات37:67

Mixed dreams which cannot be interpreted   (dictionary al Manjad)  . In the Quran
Surah Yusuf (Joseph): سورۃ یُوسُف 12:44
قَالُوا أَضْغَاثُ أَحْلَامٍ ۖ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِتَأْوِيلِ الْأَحْلَامِ بِعَالِمِينَ

Page 826
Summary:
39.1 KHALATA: To intermix different things.
39.2 ALHAQA: To mix from the back.
39.3 WASALA: To mix together and join.
39.4 ALLAFA: To unite dispersed elements.
39.5 LABASA: To mix one thing with another in order to cheat.
39.6 RAKKABA: To mix one thing in another, then mix another.
39.7 DAMMA: To join together to parts of a same thing.
39.8 MASHAJA: Mixing together to similar things,
39.9 MADAJA: To mix something in a drink.
39.10 MARAJA: To mix two similar things so that their individual properties remain intact.
39.11 SHAUB: To mix an eatable into other and consume them.
39.12 DAGHATHA: To mix a conversation, mixed conversation.

For MANGHARAT [Fiction] see ATKAL PACHU [Aimless, Random]

39 MILANA [to mix, to arrange to meet]

Synonyms: KHALATA, ALHAQA, WASALA, ALLAFA, LABASA, RAKKABA, DAMMA, MASHAJA, MARAJA, SHABA, DAGHATHA

39.1 KHALATA (خَلَطَ): (Opposite KHALASA (خَلَصَ)) to mix two or more things. To intermix or intermingle. Allah says in the Quran

Surah Al Tawbah (The repentance): سورۃ التوبھ 9:102

وَآخَرُونَ اعْتَرَفُوا بِذُنُوبِهِمْ خَلَطُوا عَمَلًا صَالِحًا وَآخَرَ سَيِّئًا

Others have confessed their sins, having mixed good deeds with bad deeds

Page 824

39.2 ALHAQA (اَلْحَقَ): Means to mix from back. In the Quran

Surah Yusuf (Joseph): سورۃ یُوسُف 12:101

تَوَفَّنِي مُسْلِمًا وَأَلْحِقْنِي بِالصَّالِحِينَ

Receive my soul in submission, and unite me with the righteous.”

39.3 WASALA (وَصَلَ): Means mixing of two things so that they become one, WASAAL (وصال) (Opposite HIJRAAN (ھجران)) and ATSAAL (اتصال) (Opposite ANFSAAL(انفصال)) to bring together, to join two things. This word is used both semantically and materially. Materially it means to reach something. And semantically to make up connections and to bound up with. Allah says in the Quran

Surah Al-Baqarah (The cow): سورۃ البَقَرَۃ  2:27

وَيَقْطَعُونَ مَا أَمَرَ اللَّهُ بِهِ أَن يُوصَلَ

and sever that which Allah ordered to be joined,

39.4 ALLAFA (اَلَّفَ): Means to mix together the dispersed elements of a single thing, to recollect some dispersed things systematically. TALEEF-E-QULOOB (تالیفِ قلوب) means to remove the differences from heart and bring them together and inculcate love. ULFAT (اُلْفَت) means loving from heart. TALEEF (تألیف) is that idiom whose parts are put together by taking care their priorities and delays. Allah says in the Quran

Surah Al-Anfal (The Spoils of War): سُوۡرَةُ الاٴنفَال 8:63

وَأَلَّفَ بَيْنَ قُلُوبِهِمْ ۚ لَوْ أَنفَقْتَ مَا فِي الْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًا مَّا أَلَّفْتَ بَيْنَ قُلُوبِهِمْ

And He has brought their hearts together (Literally: joined "between" their hearts). If you had expended whatever is in the earth altogether, in no way could you have brought their hearts together;

39.5 LABASA (لَبَسَ): YALBASU (یَلْبَسُ) means to wear clothes, to cover the body, LABSA-YALBISU (لَبَسَ یَلْبِسُ) means to mix one thing in another making the original thing suspicious and doubtful. TALBEES (تلبیس) means to hide the truth by displaying false and untrue things (dictionary al Manjad), and LABS (لبس) comes in the meaning of suspicion (see SHAKK O SHUBA [suspicion]).  LABASA (لَبَسَ) is only used in negation and only in talks. Like mixing up truth and lies, virtue and vice. Allah says in the Quran

Surah Al-Baqarah (The cow): سورۃ البَقَرَۃ  2:42

وَلَا تَلْبِسُوا الْحَقَّ بِالْبَاطِلِ

 And do not mix truth with falsehood

39.6 RAKKABA (رَکَّبَ): RAKABA (رَکَبَ) means to mount, something mounting another thing. TARAKABA (تَرَاکَبَ) means to put one thing on another and mix them. RAKKABA (رَکَّبَ) means to mix together one thing with other, then mix in the third thing, then the fourth and similarly mixing them together and making them one. TARKEEB (ترکیب) is a famous word. Who created you, fashioned you perfectly, and gave you due proportion; In whatever form He willed, He put you together.

Page 825

And press your hand to your side, it shall come out white

39.8 MASHAJA (مَشَجَ): To mix together, to intermix, MASHAJ (مشج) and MASHEEJ (مشیج) means mixed, (plural AMSHAAJ (امشاج)) (dictionary al Manjad). To mix together  things of the same gender and making them one.

Verily, We have created man from Nutfah drops of mixed semen (discharge of man and woman),

4. MAALIK [Master]
Synonyms: MAALIK, RABB, AHL
4.1 MAALIK (مَالِك):   MILK (مِلْك) is anything under the possession of someone, and nobody other than him is allowed to use it. MAALIK (مَالِك) means an owner of something; master. Allah says in the Quran
Surah Fatiha (The Opening): سُوۡرَةُ الفَاتِحَة 1:4
مَالِكِ يَوْمِ الدِّينِ
Master of the Day of Judgment,
4.2 RABB (  رَبّ  ):   Means a lord or master. Mostly this word is used as a verbal noun, but actually a gerund which means to nurture someone to its excellence and take care of its necessities. Though RABB (رَبّ) is only Allah but it can be used to refer to a person who is an owner and also the nurturer. Allah says in the Quran
PAGE - 782
Surah Yusuf (Joseph): سورۃ یُوسُف 12:41
يَا صَاحِبَيِ السِّجْنِ أَمَّا أَحَدُكُمَا فَيَسْقِي رَبَّهُ خَمْرًا
O two companions of prison, as for one of you, he will give drink to his master of wine;
4.3 AHL (اَھْل):   Means kinsmen, and family, relative, wife and kids.  AHL-AR-RUJAL (اَھْلَ الرَّجُل) means wife, and AHAL-AR-RUJAL (اَھَلَ الرَّجُل) means to marry. AHL also means people of same lineage or same religion and AHL (اَھْل) also means people of same household, and house (see GHAR [home]). In the following ayah in Quran the word AHL (اَھْل) is used for referring the Master of house. Allah says in the Quran
Surah An-Nisa (The women): سورۃ النِّسا 4:25
فَانكِحُوهُنَّ بِإِذْنِ أَهْلِهِنَّ
So marry them with the permission of their masters,
Summary:
4.1 MAALIK: Owner and master,
4.2 RABB: Who is also the master and nurturer,
4.3 AHL: People of household, house and its master

40 MUNH PHAIRNA [to turn away]
Synonyms: AE’RADA (A’N), TAWALLA (A’N), SADAFA
40.1 AE’RADA (A’N) ((عن) اَعْرَضَ):   A’RADA (عَرَضَ) means to present someone with something. A’RD (عَرْض) means a supplication; A request   (dictionary al Manjad)  . AE’RADA-AN ((عن) اَعْرَضَ) means to get away from something, to turn away from. Allah says in the Quran
Surah Ta-Ha (Ta-ha): سورۃ طٰھٰ  20:124
وَمَنْ أَعْرَضَ عَن ذِكْرِي فَإِنَّ لَهُ مَعِيشَةً ضَنكًا
But whoever turns away from My Reminder, for him is a confined life.
40.2 TAWALLA (A’N) ((عن) تَوَلّٰی):   TAWALLA (تَوَلّٰی) means to befriend, TAWALLA-AN ((عن) تَوَلّٰی) means to renounce from friendship, turn away, avert or reject   (dictionary al Manjad). Allah says in the Quran
Surah As-Saaffat (The Aligners): سُوۡرَةُ الصَّافات37:178
وَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ
So turn (O Muhammad SAW) away from them for a while,
Page 827
40.3   SADAFA (صَدَفَ):   Means AE’RADA-ANHU-WASADD ( اَعْرَضَ عَنْهُ وصَدّ) to refuse vehemently, to turn down vehemently. SADAF (صَدَف) means a shell, edge of a mountain,  the bend in the camels’ leg. All of these three have toughness and curvature in them. Sometimes it is followed by A’N (عن) but it also gives its meaning without it. Allah says in the Quran
Surah Al-Ana’am (The Cattle): سورۃ الانعام 6:157
سَنَجْزِي الَّذِينَ يَصْدِفُونَ عَنْ آيَاتِنَا سُوءَ الْعَذَابِ بِمَا كَانُوا يَصْدِفُونَ
We will repay those who turn away from Our messages with the worst kind of punishment, because of their turning away.
In another place in the Quran
Surah Al-Ana’am (The Cattle): سورۃ الانعام 6:46
انظُرْ كَيْفَ نُصَرِّفُ الْآيَاتِ ثُمَّ هُمْ يَصْدِفُونَ
Note how We explain the revelations in various ways, yet they still turn away.
Summary:
40.1 AE’RADA: Turn away or get away from front.
40.2 TAWALLA: To renounce from friendship.
40.3 SADAFA: To turn away vehemently.
For MUNH KAY BAL [on face] see AWNDAH HONA [to turn upside down]

41 MUWAFQAT KARNA [compatibility, to adjust accordingly]
Synonyms: WAFFAQA, WATAA’
41.1 WAFFAQA (وَفَّقَ):   ALWAFQ (اَلْوَفْق) means harmony and compatibility between two things. WAFFAQA (وَفَّقَ) (TAWFEEQA (توفیقا)) means Allah setting conditions in favor of some task. This word is never used for negative meanings. Allah says in the Quran
Surah An-Nisa (The women): سورۃ النِّسا 4:35
إِن يُرِيدَا إِصْلَاحًا يُوَفِّقِ اللَّهُ بَيْنَهُمَا
If they both desire reconciliation, Allah will cause it between them
41.2 WATAA’ (وَطَأ):   Means to crush something under one’s feet, to trample or tread down. WATAA’-A’LAL-AMAR (وَطَأ عَلَی الْاَمْر) means to make some task’s compatibility easy for oneself   (dictionary al Manjad)  . And this word is used with reference to human, and usually taken in a negative meaning. Allah says in Quran
Surah Al Tawbah (The repentance): سورۃ التوبھ 9:49

raw_text:
43 MEHRBAAN [Kind, Compassionate]
Synonyms: REHMAN, RAHEEM, RAU’OOF, LATEEF, HANAN
43.1 REHMAN (رحمٰن), 43.2 RAHEEM (رَاحِیْم):   are exaggerated nouns of kindness.  Means extremely kind. REHM (رحم) has compassion, kindness and softness in it. The word RAHMAN (رحمان) is more amplified. Apart from all the other qualities it has a greater portion of kindness in it. REHMAN (رحمٰن) means someone who bestows his favors equally upon all the creation. And by favors we mean the things from which all the creations can equally get benefit from like sun, moon, stars, air, water, light and earth. These all favor can only be from Allah that is why Allah can only be referred as REHMAN (رحمان) no other being can be REHMAN (رحمان) but RAHEEM (رَاحِیْم) can be another human. This word is used for Prophet Muhammad (S.A.A.W) and also for his companions. When Allah is referred as RAHEEM (رَاحِیْم) then it means ‘the one who is kind to his virtuous people’. But this quality does not possess much because Allah listens to the call of all the poor and needy, and bestows his kindness upon them and lessens their tribulations irrespective of them being believers or infidels. Allah says in the Quran
Surah Fatiha (The Opening): سُوۡرَةُ الفَاتِحَة 1:1
بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
In the Name of Allah, the Most Beneficent, the Most Merciful.
Page 829
43.3 RAU’OOF (رءوف):   RAA’FAH (رَأفَة) means to feel compassion to see someone in agony. To fill pity for and touched by it. Allah says in the Quran
Surah Al-Noor (The light): سورۃ النور 24:2
الزَّانِيَةُ وَالزَّانِي فَاجْلِدُوا كُلَّ وَاحِدٍ مِّنْهُمَا مِائَةَ جَلْدَةٍ ۖ وَلَا تَأْخُذْكُم بِهِمَا رَأْفَةٌ فِي دِينِ
The adulteress and the adulterer—whip each one of them a hundred lashes, and let no pity towards them overcome you regarding God’s Law,
And RAU’OOF (رءوف) means soft hearted, who feels compassion seeing the agony of someone and buries himself in the worries of getting him out of agony. Allah says in the Quran
Surah Al Tawbah (The repentance): سورۃ التوبھ 9:128
لَقَدْ جَاءَكُمْ رَسُولٌ مِّنْ أَنفُسِكُمْ عَزِيزٌ عَلَيْهِ مَا عَنِتُّمْ حَرِيصٌ عَلَيْكُم بِالْمُؤْمِنِينَ رَءُوفٌ رَّحِيمٌ
There has come to you a messenger from among yourselves, concerned over your suffering, anxious over you. Towards the believers, he is compassionate and merciful.
43.4 LATEEF (لطیف):   LUTF (لُطْف) consists of two main things 1. Subtlety, 2. Softness. And being fine and soft, or tiny, and LATEEF (لطیف) also refers to only a single thing, either subtlety or refinement, or knowledge of secret or tiny detail in a matter. For instance in the Quran
Surah Al-Ana’am (The Cattle): سورۃ الانعام 6:103
لَّا تُدْرِكُهُ الْأَبْصَارُ وَهُوَ يُدْرِكُ الْأَبْصَارَ ۖ وَهُوَ اللَّطِيفُ الْخَبِيرُ
No vision can grasp Him, but His grasp is over all vision. He is the Subtle, the Expert.
Or sometimes both the meaning are found in it, for instance to have knowledge of small and tinniest needs of a creature and out of kindness taking care of these needs. In this case LATEEF (لطیف) refers to ‘Kind’. Allah says in the Quran
Surah Ash-Shuraa (The Consultation) - سورة الشورى 42:19
اللَّهُ لَطِيفٌ بِعِبَادِهِ يَرْزُقُ مَن يَشَاءُ
Allah is Ever-Kind to His bondmen; He provides whomever He decides;
43.5 HANAN (حَنَان):   ALHANEEN (اَلْحَنِیْن) to get attracted towards something due to affection. ‘حَنَتِ المَرْاَۃ اَوِ النَّاقَةُ لِوَلَدِھَا’ means a woman or she-camel was attracted towards her baby or being eager for it. HANNA (حَنَّ) means kind and compassionate, HANAN (حَنَان) means kindness and graciousness. HANNAN (حَنَّان)means a one who is compassionate. Also one of the beautiful names of Allah   (dictionary al Manjad)  . Allah says in the Quran
Page 830
Surah Maryam (Mary): سُوۡرَةُ مَریَم 19:13
وَحَنَانًا مِّن لَّدُنَّا وَزَكَاةً ۖ وَكَانَ تَقِيًّا
And (made him) sympathetic to men as a mercy (or a grant) from Us, and pure from sins [i.e. Yahya (John)]
Summary:
43.1   REHMAN: Very compassionate only Allah can be REHMAN.
43.2 RAHEEM: Very kind, this quality is second to REHMAN
43.3 RAU’OOF: One who feels compassion when seeing someone in agony.
43.4 LATEEF: Someone who knows and takes care of small things.
43.5 HANAN: The compassion and affection like that of a mother for her child.

44 MUHAR LAGANA [to seal]
Synonyms: TABAA’, KHATAMA
44.1 TABAA’ (طَبَعَ):   To reach the extreme of something and fill up. TATABBA-AN-NAHAR (تَطَبَّعَ النَّھْر) means the stream filled up. And also TABAA’ (طَبَعَ) means to seal. TABAA’-AD-DARAHIM (طَبَعَ الدَّرَاھِم) means mint with lead. MATBAA’ (مطْبَع) means a sealing machine. MATBUAA’ (مَطْبُوع) means a sealed item   (dictionary al Manjad)  . TAWABAE’ (طَوَابَعَ) means a postal stamp. Thus the sealing or stamping of something after its completion is called TABAA’ (طَبَعَ) and it is related to some influence or staying firm on something.
Surah An-Nisa (The women): سورۃ النِّسا 4:155
بَلْ طَبَعَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهَا بِكُفْرِهِمْ فَلَا يُؤْمِنُونَ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا
In fact, God has sealed them for their disbelief, so they do not believe, except for a few.
44.2 KHATAMA (خَتَمَ):   Means to seal. To close and seal so that nothing can enter it (regardless if there is space to enter or not) and nothing can leave it. KHATAM-AL-ANAA’ (خَتَمَ الْاَناء) means to close a pot with earth or anything else. KHATAAM (خَتَمَ) is the equipment used for sealing; sealing wax   (dictionary al Manjad). KHATAM-AL-QURAN   (خَتَمَ القراٰن)   means he completed the Quran. Thus KHATAM   (خَتَمَ)   is related to completion of something or cessation of an action or matter. Allah says in the Quran
Surah Al-Baqarah (The cow): سورۃ البَقَرَۃ  2:7
خَتَمَ اللَّهُ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمْ وَعَلَىٰ سَمْعِهِمْ
God has set a seal on their hearts and on their hearing, and over their vision is a veil.
Summary:
44.1 TABAA’: To seal in order to show some influence or withstanding.
44.2 KHATAMA:   Completion of something or cessation of an action or matter. To seal its opening.

45 MUHLAT DAINA [to give time, give grace]
Synonyms: MAHHAL, AMLAA, NAZRAH
Page 831
45.1 MAHHAL (مَھَّلَ):   MAHHAL (مَھَّلَ) and AMHAL (اَمْھَلَ) are synonyms, MAHHAL (مَھَّلَ) means to give enough rope or to perform a task slowly. SAARA-ALAA-MAHLIN (سَارَ عَلٰی مَھْلٍ) means to amble (dictionary al Manjad). MAHHAL (مَھَّلَ) means to increase time for someone slowly without haste and this time is a vague. Allah says in the Quran
Surah At-Tariq (The Nightcommer) - سورة الطارق 86:17
فَمَهِّلِ الْكَافِرِينَ أَمْهِلْهُمْ رُوَيْدًا
So allow time for the disbelievers. Leave them awhile.
In this Ayah MAHHAL (مَھَّلَ) and AMHAL (اَمْھَلَ) both are synonyms.
45.2 AMLAA (اَمْلٰی):   MALAA (مَلَا) means to increase the age. MALAK-ALLAH (مَلَاكَ اللہ) means may Allah lengthen your life and MALA (مَلَا) is a wide desert and also to take benefit for a long time. MALIYUM-MIN-AD-DHAR (مَلِیٌّ مِنَ الدَّھْر) means a long time (dictionary al Manjad). MALIYYAN مَلِيًّا  (19:46) also means a ‘long while’. Thus MALEE (ملی) contains both length and expanse and AMLA (اَمْلٰی) means to give grace period to someone for a long time. To give time for an extended period.  To give enough rope. Allah says in the Quran
Surah Al-Araf (The heights): سورۃ الأعرَاف 7:183
وَأُمْلِي لَهُمْ ۚ إِنَّ كَيْدِي مَتِينٌ
And I will give them time. Indeed, my plan is firm.
45.3 NAZRAH (نَظَرَۃٌ):   NAZARA (نَظَرَ) means to see, to glance. NAZARA-FULANA-AL-MADEEN (نَظَرَ فُلَانَا المَدِیْن  ) means to keep an eye on someone whom money is lend to without being harsh to him (dictionary al Manjad). ANZAAR (انظار) means wait for the right time to get something. This period is conditional. Allah says in the Quran
Surah Al-Baqarah (The cow): سورۃ البَقَرَۃ  2:280

And if the debtor is in a hard time (has no money), then grant him time till it is easy for him to repay,

45 MUHLAT DAINA [to give time, give grace]

Synonyms: MAHHAL, AMLAA, NAZRAH

Page 831

45.1 MAHHAL (مَھَّلَ): MAHHAL (مَھَّلَ) and AMHAL (اَمْھَلَ) are synonyms, MAHHAL (مَھَّلَ) means to give enough rope or to perform a task slowly. SAARA-ALAA-MAHLIN (سَارَ عَلٰی مَھْلٍ) means to amble (dictionary al Manjad). MAHHAL (مَھَّلَ) means to increase time for someone slowly without haste and this time is a vague. Allah says in the Quran

Surah At-Tariq (The Nightcommer) - سورة الطارق 86:17

فَمَهِّلِ الْكَافِرِينَ أَمْهِلْهُمْ رُوَيْدًا

So allow time for the disbelievers. Leave them awhile.

In this Ayah MAHHAL (مَھَّلَ) and AMHAL (اَمْھَلَ) both are synonyms.

45.2 AMLAA (اَمْلٰی): MALAA (مَلَا) means to increase the age. MALAK-ALLAH (مَلَاكَ اللہ) means may Allah lengthen your life and MALA (مَلَا) is a wide desert and also to take benefit for a long time. MALIYUM-MIN-AD-DHAR (مَلِیٌّ مِنَ الدَّھْر) means a long time (dictionary al Manjad). MALIYYAN مَلِيًّا  (19:46) also means a ‘long while’. Thus MALEE (ملی) contains both length and expanse and AMLA (اَمْلٰی) means to give grace period to someone for a long time. To give time for an extended period.  To give enough rope. Allah says in the Quran

Surah Al-Araf (The heights): سورۃ الأعرَاف 7:183

وَأُمْلِي لَهُمْ ۚ إِنَّ كَيْدِي مَتِينٌ

And I will give them time. Indeed, my plan is firm.

And if the debtor is in a hard time (has no money), then grant him time till it is easy for him to repay,

47 MAHEENAY [months]
Synonyms: SHAHOOR, ASHHAR
47.1 SHAHOOR (شُھُوْر):   Means total months. Maximum amount of months. Allah says in the Quran
Surah Al Tawbah (The repentance): سورۃ التوبھ 9:36
إِنَّ عِدَّةَ الشُّهُورِ عِندَ اللَّهِ اثْنَا عَشَرَ شَهْرًا فِي كِتَابِ اللَّهِ يَوْمَ خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ
The number of months, according to God, is twelve months—in the decree of God—since the Day He created the heavens and the earth,
47.2 ASHURU (اَشْھُرُ):   Means months in a given time period. But its total sum would always be less then twelve. When a simple count is stated then the word ASHAR (اشھر) is used. ASHUR (اَشْھُر) is the small sum which can be from 3 to 10. Allah says in the Quran
Surah Al-Baqarah (The cow): سورۃ البَقَرَۃ  2:226
لِّلَّذِينَ يُؤْلُونَ مِن نِّسَائِهِمْ تَرَبُّصُ أَرْبَعَةِ أَشْهُرٍ
Those who vow abstinence from their wives must wait for four months.

title: content/m/m48.html
raw_text:
48 MAIKH [nail, peg]
Synonyms: DUSUR, AWTAAD
48.1 DUSUR (دُسُر):   (Singular DISAAR (دِسَار)) DASARA (دَسَر) means to stab with a spear or drive a nail. DISAAR (دِسَار) is the old rope used to close the cracks in a plane. A nail (dictionary al Manjad). Allah says in the Quran
Surah Al-Qamar (The moon): سورۃ القَمَر 54:13
وَحَمَلْنَاهُ عَلَىٰ ذَاتِ أَلْوَاحٍ وَدُسُرٍ
And We carried him on a [construction of] planks and nails,
48.2 AWTAAD (اَوْتَاد):   (singular WATAD (وَتد)) WATAD (وتد) means a peg or a big nail. Can be either  wood or metal. WATDAAN (وتدان) are the bulged portions of shoulders. Thus WATD (وْتد) is anything that has some of the portion protruding out. WATADA (وَتَدَ) means he drove in a strong peg. WATD (وَتد) means a wooden nail. AWTAAD-UL-ARD (اَوْتَادُ الاَرْضِ) means a mountain. Allah says in the Quran
Surah An-Naba (The Tidings) : سورۃ النّبَإ 78:6
أَلَمْ نَجْعَلِ الْأَرْضَ مِهَادًا وَالْجِبَالَ أَوْتَادًا
Have We not made the earth as a bed, And the mountains as pegs?
Page 833
Summary:
48.1 DUSUR: DISAAR is a small nail that is driven to close a fissure or firmly close an opening.
48.2 AWTAAD: WATD is a large nail or peg, a portion of which is outside, and a greater area is in earth.
For MAIDAN [field] see ZAMEEN [Earth and its types]
For MAIWAY [fruits] see PHAL [fruits]

title: content/m/m5.html
raw_text:
5 MAAN [Mother]
Synonyms: WALIDAH, UMM
5.1 WALIDAH (وَالِدَۃ):   The woman who gives birth to a child, this word is popular and has a specific use. When both the mother and father are mentioned then word WALDAIN (والدین) is used. (Plural WALIDAAT (والدات)). Allah says in the Quran
Surah Al-Baqarah (The cow): سورۃ البَقَرَۃ  2:233
وَالْوَالِدَاتُ يُرْضِعْنَ أَوْلَادَهُنَّ حَوْلَيْنِ كَامِلَيْنِ
Mothers may nurse their infants for two whole years,
5.2 UMM (اُمّ):   This word refers to a larger set of meanings. UMM (اُمّ) is the real mother and also anything that is cause of birthing, or tutoring and nurturing of another thing. This word is used in the following meanings
1. As the real mother, Allah says in the Quran
Surah Al Qasas (The stories): سورۃ القَصَص 28:7
وَأَوْحَيْنَا إِلَىٰ أُمِّ مُوسَىٰ أَنْ أَرْضِعِيهِ
And We inspired the mother of Moses, saying: Suckle him
2. The way AB (اَبْ) is used for real father as well as grandfather, great father and ancestry, in the same way UMM (اُمّ) is also used. The way Hazrat Adam (Adam) is father of human race in the same way Hwwa (Eve) is the mother of human race.
PAGE - 783
3. As source or root. Like أُمُّ الْكِتَابِ (13:39) as Al-Lauh Al Mahfooz, أُمَّ الْقُرَىٰ (6:92). Means central village and metaphorically the city of Makkah (Mecca). Also UMM-UL-KHABAIS (اُمّ) (Mother of all evil) is alcohol, and UMM-UL-AMRAD (اُمّ) (Mother of ailments) is constipation. UMM-AT-TAREEQ (اُمّ) (Mother of ways) is the most traveled road, and UMM-UN-NUJOOM (اُمّ) (Mother of stars) is galaxy.
4. For respect and reverence. Allah says in the Quran
Suran Al-Ahzaab (The clans): سورۃ الأحزَاب 33:6
النَّبِيُّ أَوْلَىٰ بِالْمُؤْمِنِينَ مِنْ أَنفُسِهِمْ ۖ وَأَزْوَاجُهُ أُمَّهَاتُهُمْ
The Prophet is more worthy of the believers than themselves, and his wives are [in the position of] their mothers
5. As a patronymic. Sometimes there is connection in the patronym for instance UMM-UR-RUBAA’ WA-ARBAIEAN (ام اربع واربعین) which means a myriapoda, and while other times there is no connection in it for instance naming an infant girl UMME KULTHOOM (ام کلثوم) (Mother of kulthoom). But there is no such patronym in the Quran

title: content/m/m6.html
raw_text:
6 MANGNA [to ask]
Synonyms: TALABA, SA’ALA, IDDAA’, HAFA, AE’TARRA
6.1 TALABA (طَلَبَ):   TALAB-ASH-SHAI (طَلَبَ الشَّیْ) means to ask for something, to make efforts for something. TILB (طِلْب) and TILBAH (طِلْبَۃ), a thing that is lent from someone or to make efforts in order to get something. This word is used for asking, wanting or finding. And is the initial state in case of asking for something. In the Quran
Surah Al-Hajj  (The Pilgrimage): سُوۡرَةُ الحَجّ 22:73
ضَعُفَ الطَّالِبُ وَالْمَطْلُوبُ
Weak (indeed) are the seeker and the sought!
6.2 SA’ALA (سَاَلَ):   Refers to two things 1. To inquire about something in order to get an answer for it. 2. To ask for something necessary, to plead for wealth or anything necessary and SUA’L (سُؤْل) is that necessity which the superego covets and one also declares it.
Surah Al-Baqarah (The cow): سورۃ البَقَرَۃ  2:61
ۚ اهْبِطُوا مِصْرًا فَإِنَّ لَكُم مَّا سَأَلْتُمْ
Go down to Egypt, where you will have what you asked for.
6.3 IDDAA’ (اِدَّعَ):   DAA’ (دَعَا) means to ask for, to call for, to pray for. And IDDAA’ (اِدَّعَ) has exaggeration in it. To call loudly while asking for something. Allah says in the Quran
Surah Yaseen (Yaseen): سورۃ ٰیٰس 36:57
لَهُمْ فِيهَا فَاكِهَةٌ وَلَهُم مَّا يَدَّعُونَ
They will have therein fruits (of all kinds) and all that they ask for.
6.4 HAFA (  حَفَا  ):   To exaggerate while asking for something, to put in extreme efforts. Allah says in the Quran
Surah Muhammad (Muhammad): سُوۡرَةُ محَمَّد 47:37
إِن يَسْأَلْكُمُوهَا فَيُحْفِكُمْ تَبْخَلُوا
Were He to ask you for it, and press you, you would become tightfisted
PAGE - 784
In Another place in Holy Quran
Surah Al-Araf (The heights): سورۃ الأعرَاف 7:187
يَسْأَلُونَكَ كَأَنَّكَ حَفِيٌّ عَنْهَا
They ask you as if you are responsible for it.
6.5 AE’TARRA (اِعْتَرَّ):   ARR (عَرّ) and AETARR (اِعْتَرّ) both refer to the same meaning i.e. to ask for forgiveness and to confront someone for that. Allah says in the Quran
Surah Al-Hajj (The Pilgrimage): سُوۡرَةُ الحَجّ 22:36
وَأَطْعِمُوا الْقَانِعَ وَالْمُعْتَرَّ
Eat thereof, and feed the beggar who does not ask (men), and the beggar who asks (men).
Summary:
6.1 TALABA: A necessity which the human superego covets and make efforts for it.
6.2 SA’ALA: A necessity which the superego covets and tell it to someone.
6.3 IDDAA’: A necessity which the superego covets and to ask for it loudly.
6.4 HAFA: A necessity which the superego covets and insists on it.
6.5 AE’TARRA: To face people for forgiveness.
For MAEL HONA [proclivity] see JHUKNA [to lean]
For MAYOOS HONA [disappointed] see NA UMEED HONA [to become hopeless]

6.5 AE’TARRA (اِعْتَرَّ): ARR (عَرّ) and AETARR (اِعْتَرّ) both refer to the same meaning i.e. to ask for forgiveness and to confront someone for that. Allah says in the Quran

Surah Al-Hajj (The Pilgrimage): سُوۡرَةُ الحَجّ 22:36

وَأَطْعِمُوا الْقَانِعَ وَالْمُعْتَرَّ

Eat thereof, and feed the beggar who does not ask (men), and the beggar who asks (men).

Summary:

6.1 TALABA: A necessity which the human superego covets and make efforts for it.

6.2 SA’ALA: A necessity which the superego covets and tell it to someone.

6.3 IDDAA’: A necessity which the superego covets and to ask for it loudly.

6.4 HAFA: A necessity which the superego covets and insists on it.

6.5 AE’TARRA: To face people for forgiveness.

For MAEL HONA [proclivity] see JHUKNA [to lean]

For MAYOOS HONA [disappointed] see NA UMEED HONA [to become hopeless]

7 MITANA [to erase, to remove]
Synonyms: TAMASA, MAHAQA, MAHA, NASAKHA
7.1 TAMASA (طَمَسَ):   To erase something by rubbing or scraping leaving some effects; to obliterate. TAMASA (طَمَسَ) word is mostly used for eyes, stars and face. For eyes it refers to losing sight, for stars it refers to losing their light or dimming. And for face it means it gets mutilated and gets ugly. Allah says in the Quran
Surah An-Nisa (The women): سورۃ النِّسا 4:47
آمِنُوا بِمَا نَزَّلْنَا مُصَدِّقًا لِّمَا مَعَكُم مِّن قَبْلِ أَن نَّطْمِسَ وُجُوهًا
Believe in what We have sent down [to Muhammad], confirming that which is with you, before We obliterate faces and turn them toward their backs or curse them
In another place in Holy Quran:
Surah Al-Mursalat (The Emissaries): سُوۡرَةُ المُرسَلات 77:8
فَإِذَا النُّجُومُ طُمِسَتْ
Then when the stars become dim;
PAGE - 785
7.2 MAHAQA (مَحَقَ):   To weaken someone or impair him, invalidate, or making him helpless or destroy. And MAHAQ (محق) means to lessen or reduce and its opposite is RABU (ربو) or RABI (ربی) which means to nourish and raise. To nurture and bring up. Allah says in the Quran
Surah Al-Baqarah (The cow): سورۃ البَقَرَۃ  2:276
يَمْحَقُ اللَّهُ الرِّبَا وَيُرْبِي الصَّدَقَاتِ
Allah destroys interest and gives increase for charities.
7.3 MAHA (محو):   To erase something leaving no trace; to abolish. ‘مَحَتِ الرّیْحُ السَّحَابَ’ wind blew away the clouds or obliterated the clouds. And its opposite is ATHBATA (اَثْبَتَ) means to uphold. Allah says in the Quran
Surah Al-Rad (The Thunder): سُوۡرَةُ الرّعد13:39
يَمْحُو اللَّهُ مَا يَشَاءُ وَيُثْبِتُ
God abolishes whatever He wills, and He affirms.
7.4 NASAKHA (نَسَخَ):   Means to nullify, to invalidate, to mutilate or erase (dictionary al Manjad). To remove one thing and putting another instead. The thing that was removed or erased before is MANSUKH (منسوخ) and one that is brought in is NASIKH (ناسخ). Sometimes this word is used for only erasing and nullifying. Allah says in the Quran
Surah Al-Hajj (The Pilgrimage): سُوۡرَةُ الحَجّ 22:52
فَيَنسَخُ اللَّهُ مَا يُلْقِي الشَّيْطَانُ ثُمَّ يُحْكِمُ اللَّهُ آيَاتِهِ
But God nullifies what Satan interjects, and God affirms His revelations.
And sometimes it is used for abrogating something and replacing it. Allah says in the Quran
Surah Al-Baqarah (The cow): سورۃ البَقَرَۃ  2:106
مَا نَنسَخْ مِنْ آيَةٍ أَوْ نُنسِهَا نَأْتِ بِخَيْرٍ مِّنْهَا أَوْ مِثْلِهَا
We do not abrogate a verse or cause it to be forgotten except that We bring forth [one] better than it or similar to it
Synonyms:
7.1 TAMASA: To erase so as to leave behind a trace.
7.2 MAHAQA: To weaken someone or making him helpless.
7.3 MAHA: Erase something leaving no trace.
7.4 NASAKHA: To remove one thing and putting another instead.

8 MATTI [Earth, Soil and its different conditions]
Synonyms: TURAB, TEEN, LAZIB, HAMA, SALSAAL, FAKH-KHAAR, SAEED, SULA-LAH, THARA,
8.1 TURAB (تُرَاب):   Means dust or dirt, dry soil that contains no moisture. Which is easily blown away with wind. A common word for soil. In the Quran
Surah An-Naba (The Tidings) : سورۃ النّبَإ 78:40
وَيَقُولُ الْكَافِرُ يَا لَيْتَنِي كُنتُ تُرَابًا
And the faithless will say, “O, I wish I were dust.”
PAGE - 786
8.2 TEEN (طِیْن):   A water soaked soil that contains no husk or straw; clay. Even if the moisture in the mud ends, even then this dry mud will be called TEEN (طِیْن). Allah says in the Quran
Surah As-Sajda (The prostration): سُوۡرَةُ السَّجدَة 32:8
وَبَدَأَ خَلْقَ الْإِنسَانِ مِن طِينٍ
And originated the creation of man from clay.
8.3 LAZIB (لَازِب):   Soil the sticks to hand (dictionary al Manjad). Sticky and viscous clay. Allah says in the Quran
Surah As-Saaffat (The Aligners): سُوۡرَةُ الصَّافات37:11
إِنَّا خَلَقْنَاهُم مِّن طِينٍ لَّازِبٍ
We created them from sticky clay.
In the above ayah LAZIB (لَازِب) is not used as a property of TEEN (طِیْن) but LAZIB (لَازِب) itself is sticky and viscous mud.
8.4 HAMA (حَمَا):   Means a smelly mud, when a mud turns black and starts to stink. HAM-AL-BIRR (حَمَا الْبِئْرَ) ‘he took out stinking black mud from the well’. HAM-AL-MAA’ (حَمَا الْمَاء) means water mixed with black soil.
8.5 SALSAAL (صَلْصَال):   When the black stinking mud turns dry, and creates noise on a light blow this is called SALSAAL (صَلْصَال).
Surah Al-Hijr (The Rock): سورۃ الحِجر 15:26
وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا الْإِنسَانَ مِن صَلْصَالٍ مِّنْ حَمَإٍ مَّسْنُونٍ
And We did certainly create man out of clay from an altered black mud.
In another place in the Quran
Surah Ar-Rahman (The Beneficent): سُوۡرَةُ الرَّحمٰن 55:14
خَلَقَ الْإِنسَانَ مِن صَلْصَالٍ كَالْفَخَّارِ
He created man (Adam) from sounding clay like the clay of pottery.
8.6 FAKH-KHAAR (فَخَّار):   Means an earthen shard, or crock, a fire hardened or cooked earth (dictionary al Manjad). That cooked earth or earthen crock that produces sound when it is clanked or tapped. And FAKHARI (فخاری) is a potter who makes clay pots and sells them after cooking them in fire (dictionary al Manjad). Man was also made from this kind of clay or mud as said in the ayah above.
8.7 SAEED (صَعِیْد):   SAA’DA (صَعَدَ) means to rise or get covered. SAEED (صَعِیْد) is the top layer of earth which gets covered with dirt and grime. All flat land is SAEED (صَعِیْد) and refers to the top layer of soil and grime and dirt. Allah says in the Holy Quran
Surah Al-Maeda (The table spread): سورۃ المَائدہ 5:6
فَلَمْ تَجِدُوا مَاءً فَتَيَمَّمُوا صَعِيدًا طَيِّبًا
Then seek clean earth and wipe over your faces and hands with it
8.8 SULA-LAH (سُلَالَۃ):   Means the summary or overview, important area, an extracted thing. Allah says in the Quran
Surah Al-Mumenoon (The believers): سُوۡرَةُ المؤمنون 23:12
وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا الْإِنسَانَ مِن سُلَالَةٍ مِّن طِينٍ
We created man from an extract of clay.
PAGE - 787
8.9 THARA (ثَرٰی):   The water soaked soil from the deeper parts of earth. Moist earth. Allah says in the Quran
Surah Ta-Ha (Ta-ha): سورۃ طٰھٰ  20:6
لَهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَمَا تَحْتَ الثَّرَىٰ
To Him belongs everything in the heavens and the earth, and everything between them, and everything beneath the soil.
Synonyms:
8.1 TURAB: Dry earth or soil, common word for all kind of earth.
8.2 TEEN: Water soaked soil without husk.
8.3 LAZIB: Viscous, sticky clay.
8.4 HAMA: Black, stinking mud.
8.5 SALSAAL: Dried black, stinking mud which clanks.
8.6 FAKH-KHAAR: Clinking and sounding cooked earth.
8.7 SAEED: The grime and dirt on the topmost layer of earth.
8.8 SULA-LAH: Extract
8.9 THARA: The moist soil from the deeper layer of earth

raw_text:
9 MAJAMA’T KERNA [coition]
Synonyms: BAASHAR, QADAA, WATRAN, TAGHASHAA, RAFATHA, MASSA, LAMASA, TAMATHA, QURB
All the words that are used in Quran for coition are metaphors. Not a single word is used that literary means coition due to modesty.
9.1 BAASHAR (بَاشَر):   BASHARA (بَشَر) means to peel of skin. BASHARAH (بَشَرَۃ) means upper side of skin, BAASHARA (بَاشَر) means touching of a body’s skin to another body. BASHAR-AL-MARAH (باشر المرۃ) means coition (dictionary al Manjad). Allah says in the Quran
Surah Al-Baqarah (The cow): سورۃ البَقَرَۃ  2:187
تُبَاشِرُوهُنَّ وَأَنتُمْ عَاكِفُونَ فِي الْمَسَاجِدِ
And have no contact with them while you keep to the mosques;
9.2 QADAA (قَضٰی) WATARAN (وَطَرًا):   WATR (وطر) means a necessity, or a need and QADAA WATRAN (قَضٰی وَطَرًا) means to fulfill a need. In the Quran
Surah Al-Ahzaab (The clans): سورۃ الأحزَاب 33:37
فَلَمَّا قَضَىٰ زَيْدٌ مِّنْهَا وَطَرًا
So when Zaid had accomplished his desire from her (i.e. divorced her)
9.3 TAGHASHAA (تَغَشّیٰ):   One thing covering another. In the Quran
Surah Al-Araf (The heights): سورۃ الأعرَاف 7:189
فَلَمَّا تَغَشَّاهَا حَمَلَتْ حَمْلًا خَفِيفًا
Then, when he has covered her, she conceives a light load,
PAGE - 788
9.4 RAFATHA (رَفَثَ):   Any talk that causes absement. To unveil. To talk about coition and things related to it. Allah says in the Quran
Surah Al-Baqarah (The cow): سورۃ البَقَرَۃ  2:187
أُحِلَّ لَكُمْ لَيْلَةَ الصِّيَامِ الرَّفَثُ إِلَىٰ نِسَائِكُمْ
It has been made permissible for you the night preceding fasting to go to your wives [for sexual relations]
9.5 MASSA (مَسَّ):   To touch something. Something coming in contact with body. In the Quran
Surah Ale- Imran (The family of Imran): سورۃ آل عِمْرن 3:47
قَالَتْ رَبِّ أَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ لِي وَلَدٌ وَلَمْ يَمْسَسْنِي بَشَرٌ
She said, “My Lord, how can I have a child, when no man has touched me?”
9.6 LAAMASA (لَامَسَ):   LAMASA (لَمَسَ) To examine something using fingers. To find something using finger or any other part of body. In the Quran
Surah An-Nisa (The women): سورۃ النِّسا 4:43
أَوْ لَامَسْتُمُ النِّسَاءَ
or you have had contact with women,
9.7 TAMATHA (طَمَثَ):   TAMATHA (طَمَثَ) means menstrual blood. TAMTHA YATMITHU (طَمَثَ یَطْمِثُ) means a woman during her menstruation period (dictionary al Manjad) and also a man deflowering a woman. Thus this word also refers to having sex for the first time. In the Quran
Surah Ar-Rahman (The Beneficent): سُوۡرَةُ الرَّحمٰن 55:74
لَمْ يَطْمِثْهُنَّ إِنسٌ قَبْلَهُمْ وَلَا جَانٌّ
Whom neither humankind nor the jinn (race) have deflowered before them.
9.8 QARUB (قَرُبَ):   Means to be intimate, to approach someone. Allah says in the Quran
Surah Al-Baqarah (The cow): سورۃ البَقَرَۃ  2:222
وَلَا تَقْرَبُوهُنَّ حَتَّىٰ يَطْهُرْنَ
And do not approach them until they have become pure.
For MAJBOOR KARNA [to compel] see ZABARDASTI KERNA [to coerce]
For MAJBOOR HONA [compelled] see BE-QARAR HONA [to be restless]

Surah Al-Baqarah (The cow): سورۃ البَقَرَۃ  2:187

 

تُبَاشِرُوهُنَّ وَأَنتُمْ عَاكِفُونَ فِي الْمَسَاجِدِ

And have no contact with them while you keep to the mosques;

9.2 QADAA (قَضٰی) WATARAN (وَطَرًا): WATR (وطر) means a necessity, or a need and QADAA WATRAN (قَضٰی وَطَرًا) means to fulfill a need. In the Quran

Surah Al-Ahzaab (The clans): سورۃ الأحزَاب 33:37

 

فَلَمَّا قَضَىٰ زَيْدٌ مِّنْهَا وَطَرًا

 So when Zaid had accomplished his desire from her (i.e. divorced her)

9.3 TAGHASHAA (تَغَشّیٰ): One thing covering another. In the Quran

Surah Al-Araf (The heights): سورۃ الأعرَاف 7:189

 

فَلَمَّا تَغَشَّاهَا حَمَلَتْ حَمْلًا خَفِيفًا

 Then, when he has covered her, she conceives a light load,

PAGE - 788

 

9.4 RAFATHA (رَفَثَ): Any talk that causes absement. To unveil. To talk about coition and things related to it. Allah says in the Quran

Surah Al-Baqarah (The cow): سورۃ البَقَرَۃ  2:187

أُحِلَّ لَكُمْ لَيْلَةَ الصِّيَامِ الرَّفَثُ إِلَىٰ نِسَائِكُمْ

It has been made permissible for you the night preceding fasting to go to your wives [for sexual relations]

9.5 MASSA (مَسَّ): To touch something. Something coming in contact with body. In the Quran

Surah Ale- Imran (The family of Imran): سورۃ آل عِمْرن 3:47

قَالَتْ رَبِّ أَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ لِي وَلَدٌ وَلَمْ يَمْسَسْنِي بَشَرٌ

She said, “My Lord, how can I have a child, when no man has touched me?”

9.6 LAAMASA (لَامَسَ): LAMASA (لَمَسَ) To examine something using fingers. To find something using finger or any other part of body. In the Quran

Surah An-Nisa (The women): سورۃ النِّسا 4:43

 

أَوْ لَامَسْتُمُ النِّسَاءَ

 or you have had contact with women,

9.7 TAMATHA (طَمَثَ): TAMATHA (طَمَثَ) means menstrual blood. TAMTHA YATMITHU (طَمَثَ یَطْمِثُ) means a woman during her menstruation period (dictionary al Manjad) and also a man deflowering a woman. Thus this word also refers to having sex for the first time. In the Quran

Surah Ar-Rahman (The Beneficent): سُوۡرَةُ الرَّحمٰن 55:74

لَمْ يَطْمِثْهُنَّ إِنسٌ قَبْلَهُمْ وَلَا جَانٌّ

Whom neither humankind nor the jinn (race) have deflowered before them.

9.8 QARUB (قَرُبَ): Means to be intimate, to approach someone. Allah says in the Quran

Surah Al-Baqarah (The cow): سورۃ البَقَرَۃ  2:222

وَلَا تَقْرَبُوهُنَّ حَتَّىٰ يَطْهُرْنَ

 And do not approach them until they have become pure.

 

For MAJBOOR KARNA [to compel] see ZABARDASTI KERNA [to coerce]

For MAJBOOR HONA [compelled] see BE-QARAR HONA [to be restless]

Page 834
ن
1 NA UMEED HONA [become hopeless, despair]
Synonyms: YAA’SA, ISTAA’ASA, QANATA, ABLASA
1.1 YAA’SA (یَأَسَ):   Means withdrawing of hope and trust, to lose hope regarding some matter. To despair. This can be before a hope or after it.  Allah says in the Quran
Surah Yusuf (Joseph): سورۃ یُوسُف 12:87
إِنَّهُ لَا يَيْأَسُ مِن رَّوْحِ اللَّهِ إِلَّا الْقَوْمُ الْكَافِرُونَ
Indeed, no one despairs of relief from Allah except the disbelieving people."
And ISTAA’ASA (اِسْتَیْئَسَ) means gradually lose expectations in a matter. To give up after a lot of experimentation. Allah says in the Quran
Surah Yusuf (Joseph): سورۃ یُوسُف 12:110
حَتَّىٰ إِذَا اسْتَيْأَسَ الرُّسُلُ وَظَنُّوا أَنَّهُمْ قَدْ كُذِبُوا جَاءَهُمْ نَصْرُنَا
[They continued] until, when the messengers despaired and were certain that they had been denied, there came to them Our victory,
1.2 QANATA (قَنَطَ):   Means to lose hope in goodness, to lose hope. QANOOT (قنوط) means extreme hopelessness. QANOOT (قنوط) in terms of quality or QANOOTI (قنوطی) is a person who only sees the dark sides of a matter or looks only at the risks and problems of a matter and is habitual of these things and neglects the positive aspects of the matter. Allah says in the Quran
Surah Fussilat (Explained in Detail): سورۃ فُصّلَت 41:49
لَّا يَسْأَمُ الْإِنسَانُ مِن دُعَاءِ الْخَيْرِ وَإِن مَّسَّهُ الشَّرُّ فَيَئُوسٌ قَنُوطٌ
The human being never tires of praying for good things; but when adversity afflicts him, he despairs and loses hope.
1.3 ABLASA (اَبْلَسَ):   Means to be in grief due to extreme hopelessness. To be in ignorance. To be in grief and broken hearted (dictionary al Manjad). When lose of hope causes grief then this word is used. The Satan is also called IBLEESS (ابلیس) because he has lost hope in Allah’s compassion. Allah says in the Quran
Surah Ar-Rom (The Romans) - سورة الروم 30:49
وَإِن كَانُوا مِن قَبْلِ أَن يُنَزَّلَ عَلَيْهِم مِّن قَبْلِهِ لَمُبْلِسِينَ
Although they were before this—before it was sent down upon them—in despair.
Page 835
Summary:
1.1 YAA’SA: To despair, to lose hope ISTAA’ASA: Means gradually lose hope.
1.2 QANATA: To lose hope in goodness, extreme hopelessness.
1.3 ABLASA: To lose hope and become gloomy.
For NA-INSAAFI [Injustice] see BE-INSAAFI KERNA [to do injustice]

raw_text:
Page 842
10 NA-MUBARAK [Sinister, menace]
Synonyms: MASHAMAH, NAHS, HUSOOM
10.1 MASHAMAH (مَشْئَمَة):   SHAE’MA (شئم) means sinister or menacing. SHA’MA (شَاءَمَ) means the left side (dictionary al Manjad). The opposite of SHA’AMA (شَئَم) is YAMANA (یَمَنَ) means the right hand or right side. The gerund of SHA’AMA (شَأمَ) is SHAMAT (شامت). SHAMAT-E-AMAL (شامتِ اعمال) (misfortune of actions) is a popular word. And MASHA’MAH (مَشْئَمَة) means sinister or someone on the left side. Thus SHA’MA is that menace that comes in result of one’s own actions.  Allah says in the Quran
Surah Al-Balad (The City): سورة البلد 90:19
وَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا بِآيَاتِنَا هُمْ أَصْحَابُ الْمَشْأَمَةِ
And the ones who disbelieve in Our signs, they are the companions of the position of sinister (befalling); (Or: the Hand)
10.2 NAHS (نحس):   (Opposite SA’AD (سعد)) SA’ADA (سَعَد) means good luck, or fortune. Good tidings from the deity in order to help him in getting good things. NAHS (نحس) is that sinister that comes by the will of God.  NAHASA (نَحَسَ) means unlucky or unfortunate. According to astrology NAHSAAN (نَحْسَان) is Saturn and Mars and SA’DAAN (سَعْدَان) is Jupiter and Pluto (dictionary al Manjad). Allah says in the Quran
Surah Al-Qamar (The moon): سورۃ القَمَر 54:19
إِنَّا أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ رِيحًا صَرْصَرًا فِي يَوْمِ نَحْسٍ مُّسْتَمِرٍّ
Indeed, We sent upon them a screaming wind on a day of continuous misfortune,
10.3 HUSOOM (حُسُوْم):   A continuous menace that does not come to an end. For detail see LAGA TAR [continuous]. Allah says in the Quran
Surah Al-Haqqah (The reality): سورۃ الحَاقَّۃ 69:7
سَخَّرَهَا عَلَيْهِمْ سَبْعَ لَيَالٍ وَثَمَانِيَةَ أَيَّامٍ حُسُومًا فَتَرَى الْقَوْمَ فِيهَا صَرْعَىٰ
Which Allah imposed on them for seven nights and eight days in succession, so that you could see men lying overthrown (destroyed),
Summary:
10.1 MASHAMAH: SHAMAT is that menace that comes in result of one’s actions.
10.2 NAHS: The menace from God.
10.3 HUSOOM: A continuous menace.
Also see BAD-BAKHTI [misfortune]

raw_text:
11 NIJAAT PANA [salvation, to be free]
Synonyms: NAJAA, FAAZA
Page 843
11.1 NAJAA (نَجٰی):   Means to be free from a trouble, to get freedom of any sort. A very common word. Allah says in the Quran
Surah Yusuf (Joseph): سورۃ یُوسُف 12:45
وَقَالَ الَّذِي نَجَا مِنْهُمَا وَادَّكَرَ بَعْدَ أُمَّةٍ
But the one who was freed and remembered after a time
11.2 FAAZA (فاز):   Means to be free from trouble and reach a beloved thing. To get goodluck with saftey. Allah says in the Quran
Surah Ale- Imran (The family of Imran): سورۃ آل عِمْرن 3:185
ۖ فَمَن زُحْزِحَ عَنِ النَّارِ وَأُدْخِلَ الْجَنَّةَ فَقَدْ فَازَ
Whoso is removed from the Fire and is made to enter paradise, he indeed is triumphant.
FAAZA (فاز) is from dictionary of antonyms. FAWZ (فوز) means to get salvation and also get perished. FAWWAZ-AR-RUJL (فَوَّزَ الرَّجُل) means the man died. And MAFAZA (مفازة) means the reason for salvation or place of salvation and also the reason and place of damnation. Allah says in the Quran
Surah Ale- Imran (The family of Imran): سورۃ آل عِمْرن 3:188
فَلَا تَحْسَبَنَّهُم بِمَفَازَةٍ مِّنَ الْعَذَابِ ۖ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
think escape the penalty. For them is a penalty Grievous indeed.
In this ayah the word MAFAZAH (مفازة) means the place or reason of damnation.
Summary:
11.1 NAJAA:  To get free from trouble.
11.2 FAAZA: To get free from trouble and reach and objective.

raw_text:
12 NAZAR-O-NIYAZ [votive, fulfill a vow, offering]
Synonyms: NAZAR, QURBAN
12.1 NAZAR (نَذَر):   (Plural NAZOOR (نذور)) means to make some nonobligatory thing an obligation upon oneself. NAZARA (نَذَرَ) means to make a votive, to fulfill a vow. Usually it is based on some conditional event but the offering of such votive is an obligation. Allah says in the Quran
Surah Al-Hajj  (The Pilgrimage): سُوۡرَةُ الحَجّ 22:29
ثُمَّ لْيَقْضُوا تَفَثَهُمْ وَلْيُوفُوا نُذُورَهُمْ
Then let them end their untidiness and fulfill their vows
12.2 QURBAN (قُرْبَان):   QURBAN-AL-MALK (قربان الملك) means friend of a king. QURBAN (قُرْبَان) refers to anything through which nearness of Allah is attained that can be sacrifice or anything (dictionary al Manjad). All these kind of offerings for anyone other than Allah is forbidden because it is type of worship but infidels offers votives to other things which they might consider as   honorable. In the Quran
Surah Al-Maeda (The table spread): سورۃ المَائدہ 5:27
إِذْ قَرَّبَا قُرْبَانًا فَتُقُبِّلَ مِنْ أَحَدِهِمَا وَلَمْ يُتَقَبَّلْ مِنَ الْآخَرِ
when they both offered a sacrifice [to Allah ], and it was accepted from one of them but was not accepted from the other.
Page 844
Summary:
12.1 NAZAR: A votive that is made obligatory by oneself.
12.2 QURBAN: A votive that is offered for pleasing Allah.

13 NARAM HONA – KERNA [soften]
Synonyms: LAANA and ALAANA, ADHANA, AAHA, TALATAF
13.1 LAANA (لاَنَ):   Means softening. Opposite of LEEN (لِیْن) is KHASHOONAT (خشونت) (crustiness) means something being flexible. QAWLAL-LEENA قَوْلًا لَّيِّنًا  (20:44) means to talk softly.  Thus this word is used both materially and semantically. In the Quran
Surah Az-Zumar (The Troops) - سورة الزمر 39:23
ثُمَّ تَلِينُ جُلُودُهُمْ وَقُلُوبُهُمْ إِلَىٰ ذِكْرِ اللَّهِ
then their skins and their hearts soften up to the remembrance of God.
And ALAANA (اَلاَنَ) means to soften, Allah says in the Quran
Surah Saba' (Sheba) - سورة سبإ 34:10-11
وَأَلَنَّا لَهُ الْحَدِيدَ أَنِ اعْمَلْ سَابِغَاتٍ وَقَدِّرْ فِي السَّرْدِ
And We made the iron soft for him. Saying: "Make you perfect coats of mail, balancing well the rings of chain armour,
13.2 ADHANA (اَدْھَنَ):   DUHN (دُھْن) means oil, and extract or fat. ADHANA (اَدْھَنَ) means to soften something by applying oil to it. When used figurative then this means to deceive someone by using sweet talking but having something else in heart. To get loose. To do flattery; hypocrisy. Allah says in the Quran
Surah Al-Qalam (The Pen):سورۃ القلم  68:9
وَدُّوا لَوْ تُدْهِنُ فَيُدْهِنُونَ
They wish that you would soften [in your position], so they would soften [toward you].
13.3 AAHA (اٰہَ):   Means to sigh or groan (in pain) in order to express sadness. AWWAHUN (اَوَّاہٌ) means a softhearted person. To lament while a supplication. Allah says in the Quran
Surah Al Tawbah (The repentance): سورۃ التوبھ 9:114
إِنَّ إِبْرَاهِيمَ لَأَوَّاهٌ حَلِيمٌ
most surely Ibrahim was very tender-hearted forbearing.
13.4 TALATAF (تَلَطَّفَ):   LATF (لَطْفَ) means to have knowledge about small things and take care of them. And to compensate for the negative factors (See MEHRBAN [Kind]). TALATAF (تَلطَفَ) means to take in to account care and soft handedness while performing a task. In the Quran
Surah Al-Kahf (The Cave): سورۃ الکھف 18:19
فَلْيَأْتِكُم بِرِزْقٍ مِّنْهُ وَلْيَتَلَطَّفْ وَلَا يُشْعِرَنَّ بِكُمْ أَحَدًا
so let him bring you provision from it, and let him behave with gentleness, and by no means make your case known to any one:
Summary:
13.1 LAANA: Soft and flexible.
13.2 ADHANA: Flattery; to flatter despite a foul feeling heart.
13.3 AAHA: Soft hearted.
13.4 TALATAF: To take in account care and soft handedness while performing a task.

raw_text:
14. NAZDIYK HUWNA-KARNA [TO BE NEAR -TO BRING NEAR]    PAGE 845
Synonyms: KADA (KA-WA-DA)(كَادَ (كود)  QARUBA  قَرُبَ DANA دَنَي AZIFA اَزِفَ ZALAFA زَلَفَ QAB  قاب IQTARNA اِقْتَرَنَ
14.1 KADA  :meaning to be near of doing some deed.and meaning to agree to do something but to not do it.this is from verb of nearness (افعال مقاربه)and it takes another verb with it. only used in past or present/future
Surat Al-Baqarah (The Cow) - سورة البقرة
2:20
يَكَادُ الْبَرْقُ يَخْطَفُ أَبْصَارَهُمْ ۖ كُلَّمَا أَضَاءَ لَهُم مَّشَوْا فِيهِ وَإِذَا أَظْلَمَ عَلَيْهِمْ قَامُوا ۚ وَلَوْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ لَذَهَبَ بِسَمْعِهِمْ وَأَبْصَارِهِمْ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
The lightning almost snatches away their sight. Every time it lights [the way] for them, they walk therein; but when darkness comes over them, they stand [still]. And if Allah had willed, He could have taken away their hearing and their sight. Indeed, Allah is over all things competent.
14.2 QARUBA  :to be near (Antonym BA3UDA بَعُدَ) this word is of common usage.meaning used for nearness of distance,period,lineage,status,for all things.now let's see some examples
a)for nearness of distance
Surat Ar-Ra`d (The Thunder) - سورة الرعد
13:31
وَلَوْ أَنَّ قُرْآنًا سُيِّرَتْ بِهِ الْجِبَالُ أَوْ قُطِّعَتْ بِهِ الْأَرْضُ أَوْ كُلِّمَ بِهِ الْمَوْتَىٰ ۗ بَل لِّلَّهِ الْأَمْرُ جَمِيعًا ۗ أَفَلَمْ يَيْأَسِ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا أَن لَّوْ يَشَاءُ اللَّهُ لَهَدَى النَّاسَ جَمِيعًا ۗ وَلَا يَزَالُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا تُصِيبُهُم بِمَا صَنَعُوا قَارِعَةٌ أَوْ تَحُلُّ قَرِيبًا مِّن دَارِهِمْ حَتَّىٰ يَأْتِيَ وَعْدُ اللَّهِ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يُخْلِفُ الْمِيعَادَ
And if there was any qur'an by which the mountains would be removed or the earth would be broken apart or the dead would be made to speak, [it would be this Qur'an], but to Allah belongs the affair entirely. Then have those who believed not accepted that had Allah willed, He would have guided the people, all of them? And those who disbelieve do not cease to be struck, for what they have done, by calamity - or it will descend near their home - until there comes the promise of Allah . Indeed, Allah does not fail in [His] promise.
b)for nearness of distance
Surat Al-Baqarah (The Cow) - سورة البقرة
2:222
وَيَسْأَلُونَكَ عَنِ الْمَحِيضِ ۖ قُلْ هُوَ أَذًى فَاعْتَزِلُوا النِّسَاءَ فِي الْمَحِيضِ ۖ وَلَا تَقْرَبُوهُنَّ حَتَّىٰ يَطْهُرْنَ ۖ فَإِذَا تَطَهَّرْنَ فَأْتُوهُنَّ مِنْ حَيْثُ أَمَرَكُمُ اللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ التَّوَّابِينَ وَيُحِبُّ الْمُتَطَهِّرِينَ
And they ask you about menstruation. Say, "It is harm, so keep away from wives during menstruation. And do not approach them until they are pure. And when they have purified themselves, then come to them from where Allah has ordained for you. Indeed, Allah loves those who are constantly repentant and loves those who purify themselves."
c) for nearness of lineage
Surat Al-Mā'idah (The Table Spread) - سورة المائدة
5:106
يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا شَهَادَةُ بَيْنِكُمْ إِذَا حَضَرَ أَحَدَكُمُ الْمَوْتُ حِينَ الْوَصِيَّةِ اثْنَانِ ذَوَا عَدْلٍ مِّنكُمْ أَوْ آخَرَانِ مِنْ غَيْرِكُمْ إِنْ أَنتُمْ ضَرَبْتُمْ فِي الْأَرْضِ فَأَصَابَتْكُم مُّصِيبَةُ الْمَوْتِ ۚ تَحْبِسُونَهُمَا مِن بَعْدِ الصَّلَاةِ فَيُقْسِمَانِ بِاللَّهِ إِنِ ارْتَبْتُمْ لَا نَشْتَرِي بِهِ ثَمَنًا وَلَوْ كَانَ ذَا قُرْبَىٰ ۙ وَلَا نَكْتُمُ شَهَادَةَ اللَّهِ إِنَّا إِذًا لَّمِنَ الْآثِمِينَ
O you who have believed, testimony [should be taken] among you when death approaches one of you at the time of bequest - [that of] two just men from among you or two others from outside if you are traveling through the land and the disaster of death should strike you. Detain them after the prayer and let them both swear by Allah if you doubt [their testimony, saying], "We will not exchange our oath for a price, even if he should be a near relative, and we will not withhold the testimony of Allah . Indeed, we would then be of the sinful."
d) for nearness of status
Surat Al-Baqarah (The Cow) - سورة البقرة
2:237
وَإِن طَلَّقْتُمُوهُنَّ مِن قَبْلِ أَن تَمَسُّوهُنَّ وَقَدْ فَرَضْتُمْ لَهُنَّ فَرِيضَةً فَنِصْفُ مَا فَرَضْتُمْ إِلَّا أَن يَعْفُونَ أَوْ يَعْفُوَ الَّذِي بِيَدِهِ عُقْدَةُ النِّكَاحِ ۚ وَأَن تَعْفُوا أَقْرَبُ لِلتَّقْوَىٰ ۚ وَلَا تَنسَوُا الْفَضْلَ بَيْنَكُمْ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ
And if you divorce them before you have touched them and you have already specified for them an obligation, then [give] half of what you specified - unless they forego the right or the one in whose hand is the marriage contract foregoes it. And to forego it is nearer to righteousness. And do not forget graciousness between you. Indeed Allah , of whatever you do, is Seeing.
for nearness of status and time , word IQTARABA اِقْتَرَبَ is used more as said
Surat Al-`Alaq (The Clot) - سورة العلق
96:19
كَلَّا لَا تُطِعْهُ وَاسْجُدْ وَاقْتَرِب ۩
No! Do not obey him. But prostrate and draw near [to Allah ].
at another place said:
Surat Al-Qamar (The Moon) - سورة القمر
54:1
اقْتَرَبَتِ السَّاعَةُ وَانشَقَّ الْقَمَرُ
The Hour has come near, and the moon has split [in two].
and for nearness of status , word QARRABA قَرَّبَ is specially used. and this comes in the meaning of bring someone near.ALLAH said
Surat 'Āli `Imrān (Family of Imran) - سورة آل عمران
3:45
إِذْ قَالَتِ الْمَلَائِكَةُ يَا مَرْيَمُ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُبَشِّرُكِ بِكَلِمَةٍ مِّنْهُ اسْمُهُ الْمَسِيحُ عِيسَى ابْنُ مَرْيَمَ وَجِيهًا فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ وَمِنَ الْمُقَرَّبِينَ
[And mention] when the angels said, "O Mary, indeed Allah gives you good tidings of a word from Him, whose name will be the Messiah, Jesus, the son of Mary - distinguished in this world and the Hereafter and among those brought near [to Allah ].
14.3 DANA  :generally used for nearness of distance.and DUNIYA دنيا meaning the world of near(which is near)-existing universe (antonym AKHIRAT آخرت) in the QURAN
Surat An-Najm (The Star) - سورة النجم
53:8
ثُمَّ دَنَا فَتَدَلَّىٰ
Then he approached and descended
and sometimes also used for lowering of status and/or value.ADNA اَدْنَي meaning lower,vile,despicable (antonym is A3LA اعلَي). ALLAH said
Surat Al-Baqarah (The Cow) - سورة البقرة
2:61
وَإِذْ قُلْتُمْ يَا مُوسَىٰ لَن نَّصْبِرَ عَلَىٰ طَعَامٍ وَاحِدٍ فَادْعُ لَنَا رَبَّكَ يُخْرِجْ لَنَا مِمَّا تُنبِتُ الْأَرْضُ مِن بَقْلِهَا وَقِثَّائِهَا وَفُومِهَا وَعَدَسِهَا وَبَصَلِهَا ۖ قَالَ أَتَسْتَبْدِلُونَ الَّذِي هُوَ أَدْنَىٰ بِالَّذِي هُوَ خَيْرٌ ۚ اهْبِطُوا مِصْرًا فَإِنَّ لَكُم مَّا سَأَلْتُمْ ۗ وَضُرِبَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ الذِّلَّةُ وَالْمَسْكَنَةُ وَبَاءُوا بِغَضَبٍ مِّنَ اللَّهِ ۗ ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ كَانُوا يَكْفُرُونَ بِآيَاتِ اللَّهِ وَيَقْتُلُونَ النَّبِيِّينَ بِغَيْرِ الْحَقِّ ۗ ذَٰلِكَ بِمَا عَصَوا وَّكَانُوا يَعْتَدُونَ
And [recall] when you said, "O Moses, we can never endure one [kind of] food. So call upon your Lord to bring forth for us from the earth its green herbs and its cucumbers and its garlic and its lentils and its onions." [Moses] said, "Would you exchange what is better for what is less? Go into [any] settlement and indeed, you will have what you have asked." And they were covered with humiliation and poverty and returned with anger from Allah [upon them]. That was because they [repeatedly] disbelieved in the signs of Allah and killed the prophets without right. That was because they disobeyed and were [habitually] transgressing.
and for nearness of time ,usage of ADNA is in the meaning of 'nearly nearly' or   approximately.as   said
Surat Al-Muzzammil (The Enshrouded One) - سورة المزمل
73:20
إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَعْلَمُ أَنَّكَ تَقُومُ أَدْنَىٰ مِن ثُلُثَيِ اللَّيْلِ وَنِصْفَهُ وَثُلُثَهُ وَطَائِفَةٌ مِّنَ الَّذِينَ مَعَكَ ۚ وَاللَّهُ يُقَدِّرُ اللَّيْلَ وَالنَّهَارَ ۚ عَلِمَ أَن لَّن تُحْصُوهُ فَتَابَ عَلَيْكُمْ ۖ فَاقْرَءُوا مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنَ الْقُرْآنِ ۚ عَلِمَ أَن سَيَكُونُ مِنكُم مَّرْضَىٰ ۙ وَآخَرُونَ يَضْرِبُونَ فِي الْأَرْضِ يَبْتَغُونَ مِن فَضْلِ اللَّهِ ۙ وَآخَرُونَ يُقَاتِلُونَ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ ۖ فَاقْرَءُوا مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنْهُ ۚ وَأَقِيمُوا الصَّلَاةَ وَآتُوا الزَّكَاةَ وَأَقْرِضُوا اللَّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًا ۚ وَمَا تُقَدِّمُوا لِأَنفُسِكُم مِّنْ خَيْرٍ تَجِدُوهُ عِندَ اللَّهِ هُوَ خَيْرًا وَأَعْظَمَ أَجْرًا ۚ وَاسْتَغْفِرُوا اللَّهَ ۖ إِنَّ اللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
Indeed, your Lord knows, [O Muhammad], that you stand [in prayer] almost two thirds of the night or half of it or a third of it, and [so do] a group of those with you. And Allah determines [the extent of] the night and the day. He has known that you [Muslims] will not be able to do it and has turned to you in forgiveness, so recite what is easy [for you] of the Qur'an. He has known that there will be among you those who are ill and others traveling throughout the land seeking [something] of the bounty of Allah and others fighting for the cause of Allah . So recite what is easy from it and establish prayer and give zakah and loan Allah a goodly loan. And whatever good you put forward for yourselves - you will find it with Allah . It is better and greater in reward. And seek forgiveness of Allah . Indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful.
14.4 AZIFA  :used for nearness of time and it contains the meaning of shortage of time. as said AAZIFATI ASHSHUKHUWSU(اَزِفَتِ الشُّخُوْصُ) meaning 'time to depart has approached'.and Judgement Day is given the name of AAZIFAH اَزِفَة because there is little time left in it's arrival.ALLAH said
Surat Ghāfir (The Forgiver) - سورة غافر
40:18
وَأَنذِرْهُمْ يَوْمَ الْآزِفَةِ إِذِ الْقُلُوبُ لَدَى الْحَنَاجِرِ كَاظِمِينَ ۚ مَا لِلظَّالِمِينَ مِنْ حَمِيمٍ وَلَا شَفِيعٍ يُطَاعُ
And warn them, [O Muhammad], of the Approaching Day, when hearts are at the throats, filled [with distress]. For the wrongdoers there will be no devoted friend and no intercessor [who is] obeyed.
14.5 ZALAFA  :for nearness in status and level.ALLAH said
Surat Şād (The Letter "Saad") - سورة ص
38:40
وَإِنَّ لَهُ عِندَنَا لَزُلْفَىٰ وَحُسْنَ مَآبٍ
And indeed, for him is nearness to Us and a good place of return.
and AZLAFA is used to bring near, to be brought near-to make approach near .and in it the connotation of status or value is not necessary. as said
Surat At-Takwīr (The Overthrowing) - سورة التكوير
81:13
وَإِذَا الْجَنَّةُ أُزْلِفَتْ
And when Paradise is brought near,
14.6 QABA(قَابَ)  :(ALARD الارض)meaning circular digging of earth. and QABA meaning quantity-approximation-distance between the end of bow to it's handle- is an idiom HUWA 3LA QABA QUWSIYN (هو علي قاب قوسين) meaning he is very near.ALLAH said
Surat An-Najm (The Star) - سورة النجم
53:9
فَكَانَ قَابَ قَوْسَيْنِ أَوْ أَدْنَىٰ
And was at a distance of two bow lengths or nearer.
14.7 IQTARNA  :QARAN قَرَن is that rope with which two camels are tied.and QARIYN قرين meaning companion and QARANA meaning one thing place near another. and QARANA ASSAWRAYN(قَرَنَ الثَّوْرَيْن) meaning two oxes joined togther in one oxbow/yoke. and IQTARANA contains exaggeration, meaning bring absolutely near. and IQTARAN contains the connotation of one then immediately second then third then fourth like wise continual and consecutive, because of this nearness.In the QURAN
Surat Az-Zukhruf (The Ornaments of Gold) - سورة الزخرف
43:53
فَلَوْلَا أُلْقِيَ عَلَيْهِ أَسْوِرَةٌ مِّن ذَهَبٍ أَوْ جَاءَ مَعَهُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ مُقْتَرِنِينَ
Then why have there not been placed upon him bracelets of gold or come with him the angels in conjunction?"
Summary  :
14.1 KADA:to be near of doing it,but to not do it
14.2 QARUBA:is a comprehensive word in all aspect. is of common usage
14.3 DANA:for nearness of distance and lowliness in value and status
14.4 AZIFA:for expression of shortness of time
14.5 ZALAFA:for nearness in value and status
14.6 QAB:extremely near in distance.like distance between one corner of bow to it's handle.QAB QWSIYN is of idiomatic usage
14.7 IQTARN:such nearness in time or distance like both things have met each other.

15 NISHAN-NISHANIY [SIGN-MARKING]   page 847
Synonyms: ACAR 3ALAMAT AYAT MUBSIRAH SHART NUSUB SEEMA SHA3A-IR
15.1 ACAR(اَثر)  :(plural AACAR اَثار) meaning to obtain such things which refers to the existence of actual thing.and meaning signs left over by something with which that thing is reminded.antiquities(ACAR-E-QAIYMAH اثار قديمه) and  archaeology (3LM UL ACAR علم الاثار) are famous words.meaning knowledge of such things which refresh the memories of those elders to whom these things belong. and word AACAR is sometimes used for footprint or the signs of feet of some passer   by. as   said
Surat Al-Kahf (The Cave) - سورة الكهف
18:64
قَالَ ذَٰلِكَ مَا كُنَّا نَبْغِ ۚ فَارْتَدَّا عَلَىٰ آثَارِهِمَا قَصَصًا
[Moses] said, "That is what we were seeking." So they returned, following their footprints.
15.2 3LAMAT(علامت)  :(plural 3LAMAAT علامات) every such sign which itself is not clear but with it knowledge of something else is obtained. for e.g to find the time and direction by star gazing at night, or with sunlight and shadow ,approximation of time and direction. or diagnosing disease by symptomps of patient.3LAMAT comes before the thing desired. like cloud is 3LAMAT of rain. whereas ACAR refers to after something. In the QURAN
Surat An-Naĥl (The Bee) - سورة النحل
16:16
وَعَلَامَاتٍ ۚ وَبِالنَّجْمِ هُمْ يَهْتَدُونَ
And landmarks. And by the stars they are [also] guided.
15.3 aayah(أية)  : All those signs through which you can get information about them through contemplation as well as the things they symbolize for example, if a person knows that there are so and so markings on a certain track, and if he finds them, he can be sure that he has found his way and is going on the right path. In the Quran, the word ayat(آيت) has been used in three meanings: (i)any sentence of the Quran (ii) meaning any sign or memento, the definition of which has been described above, (iii) miracle which is given to prophets. Each sentence of the Holy Quran, because of its eloquence and expressiveness, is evident of the fact that this is the works of a higher being. Based on this, each sentence is a sign and in the other meanings, these ayats come in the definitions described above. Allah states that:
________________
Surat Al-Fussilat (Revelations well expounded) - سُوۡرَةُ حٰمٓ السجدة / فُصّلَت
41:53
سَنُرِيهِمۡ ءَايَـٰتِنَا فِى ٱلۡأَفَاقِ وَفِىٓ أَنفُسِہِمۡ حَتَّىٰ يَتَبَيَّنَ لَهُمۡ أَنَّهُ ٱلۡحَقُّ‌ۗ
We shall show them Our portents on the horizons and within themselves until it will be manifest unto them that it is the Truth. Doth not thy Lord suffice, since He is Witness over all things? (53) How! Are they still in doubt about the meeting with their Lord? Lo! Is not He surrounding all things?
________________
15.4 mubsirah (مبصرة)  : meaning a clear and obvious reminder through which a person awakens and this word is usually used to depict a miracle. Allah states that:
________________
Surat Al-Naml(The Ants) - سُوۡرَةُ النَّمل
27:13
فَلَمَّا جَآءَتۡہُمۡ ءَايَـٰتُنَا مُبۡصِرَةً۬ قَالُواْ هَـٰذَا سِحۡرٌ۬ مُّبِينٌ۬
But when Our tokens came unto them, plain to see, they said: This is mere magic,
________________
At another point, it is stated:
________________
Surat Al-Isra(Children of Israel) - سُوۡرَةُ بنیٓ اسرآئیل / الإسرَاء
17:59
وَءَاتَيۡنَا ثَمُودَ ٱلنَّاقَةَ مُبۡصِرَةً۬
Naught hindereth Us from sending portents save that the folk of old denied them. And We gave Thamud the she-camel - a clear portent--but they did wrong in respect of her. We send not portents save to warn.
________________
And when the disagreement of disbelievers is proved whether it is mentioned in the Quran or hadees, then at that time, the meaning of ayat is also miracle. As is stated:
________________
Surat Al-Qamar(The Moon) - سُوۡرَةُ القَمَر
54:2
وَإِن يَرَوۡاْ ءَايَةً۬ يُعۡرِضُواْ وَيَقُولُواْ سِحۡرٌ۬ مُّسۡتَمِرٌّ۬
And if they behold a portent they turn away and say: Prolonged illusion.
________________
15.5 shart (شرط)  : ashrat-al-ibl(اشراط الابل) meaning to mark a camel and separate it to sell it off and shart(شرط) (pl: ashrat(اشراط)) meaning reminder, sign, beginning of everything meaning that ordained order whose occurrence is dependent on some other task. That second task is like a reminder for it. Ashrat as-sa’a(اشراط الساعة) means signs of the day of judgement. It is stated in the Quran:
________________
Surat Muhammad - سُوۡرَةُ محَمَّد
47:18
فَهَلۡ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا ٱلسَّاعَةَ أَن تَأۡتِيَہُم بَغۡتَةً۬‌ۖ فَقَدۡ جَآءَ أَشۡرَاطُهَا‌ۚ
Await they aught save the Hour, that it should come upon them unawares? And the beginnings thereof have already come. But how, when it hath come upon them, can they take their warning?
________________
15.6 nusub (نصب)  : nasab ashaei(نصب الشيء) meaning to make something stand upright, to erect and an-nasab(النصب) meaning an erect flag. Nusub(نصب) meaning an erected sign, a milestone. Allah states that:
________________
Surat Al-Maarij(The Ladders) - سُوۡرَةُ المعَارج
70:43
يَوۡمَ يَخۡرُجُونَ مِنَ ٱلۡأَجۡدَاثِ سِرَاعً۬ا كَأَنَّہُمۡ إِلَىٰ نُصُبٍ۬ يُوفِضُونَ
The day when they come forth from the graves in haste, as racing to a goal.
________________
15.7 seema (سيما)  : soum(سوم) meaning a sign, reminder and sawwam(سوم) means to mark something in such a way to distinguish it from others. Thus seema(سيما) means symbolic sign or representative sign. Allah states that:
________________
Surat Al-Fath(The Victory) - سُوۡرَةُ الفَتْح
48:29
سِيمَاهُمۡ فِى وُجُوهِهِم مِّنۡ أَثَرِ ٱلسُّجُودِ‌ۚ
Muhammad is the messenger of Allah. And those with him are hard against the disbelievers and merciful among themselves. Thou (O Muhammad) seest them bowing and falling prostrate (in worship), seeking bounty from Allah and (His) acceptance. The mark of them is on their foreheads from the traces of prostration. Such is their likeness in the Torah and their likeness in the Gospel - like as sown corn that sendeth forth its shoot and strengtheneth it and riseth firm upon its stalk, delighting the sowers - that He may enrage the disbelievers with (the sight of) them. Allah hath promised, unto such of them as believe and do good works, forgiveness and immense reward.
________________
15.8 sha3a-ir (شعائر)  : (sg: sha’eera(شعيرة)) meaning religious symbols i.e. those symbols which are considered sacred according to the religion; things, places and signs of respect. sha3a-ir-e-hajj(شعائرحج) meaning the procedures of hajj and places. sha3a-ir Allah(شعائر الله) meaning those symbols which Allah has held sacred and it also means those animals of sacrifice which are sent towards the house of Allah. Allah states that:
________________
Surat Al-Baqarah(The Cow) - سُوۡرَةُ البَقَرَة
2:158
إِنَّ ٱلصَّفَا وَٱلۡمَرۡوَةَ مِن شَعَآٮِٕرِ ٱللَّهِ‌ۖ
Lo! (the mountains) As-Safa and Al-Marwah are among the indications of Allah. It is therefore no sin for him who is on pilgrimage to the House (of Allah) or visiteth it, to go around them (as the pagan custom is). And he who doeth good of his own accord, (for him) lo! Allah is Responsive, Aware.
________________
At another point it is stated:
________________
Surat Al-Maeda(The Table) - سُوۡرَةُ المَائدة
5:2
يَـٰٓأَيُّہَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ لَا تُحِلُّواْ شَعَـٰٓٮِٕرَ ٱللَّهِ وَلَا ٱلشَّہۡرَ ٱلۡحَرَامَ وَلَا ٱلۡهَدۡىَ وَلَا ٱلۡقَلَـٰٓٮِٕدَ
O ye who believe! Profane not Allah's monuments nor the Sacred Month nor the offerings nor those garlands, nor those repairing to the Sacred House, seeking the grace and pleasure of their Lord. But when ye have left the sacred territory, then go hunting (if ye will). And let not your hatred of a folk who (once) stopped your going to the inviolable place of worship seduce you to transgress; but help ye one another unto righteousness and pious duty. Help not one another unto sin and transgression, but keep your duty to Allah. Lo! Allah is severe in punishment. ________________
Summary  :
15.1. ACAR(أثر): that left over thing through which you can find the reality of something, something after the real.
15.2. ALAMA(علامة): that sign which is not evident itself but clarifies something else and is in place before.
15.3.  AYAH(أية): that thing on which after pondering you gain knowledge about it as well as the thing that it symbolizes.
15.4. MUBSIRAH(مبصرة): clear and obvious sign which awakens, miracle.
15.5. SHART(شرط): that sign which is associated with something else.
15.6. NUSUB(نصب): milestones on a way or rocks etc.
15.7. SEEMA(سيما): symbolic sign.
15.8. SHA3A-IR(شعائر): religious symbols, those symbols that are associated with religion.

16 NISHAN LAGANA
[To mark]
Synonyms: SAWWAM(  سوم  ), WASAM(  وسم  )
16.1 sawwam(  سوم  )  : seema(  سيما  ) meaning a sign, symbolic mark and sawwam(  سوم  ) means to mark a symbol. To mark something to distinguish it from others. Allah states that:
________________
Surat Hud -   سُوۡرَةُ هُود
11:82-83
وَأَمۡطَرۡنَا عَلَيۡهَا حِجَارَةً۬ مِّن سِجِّيلٍ۬ مَّنضُودٍ۬ مُّسَوَّمَةً عِندَ رَبِّكَ‌ۖ
So when Our commandment came to pass We overthrew (that township) and rained upon it stones of clay, one after another, Marked with fire in the providence of thy Lord (for the destruction of the wicked). And they are never far from the wrong-doers.
________________
16.2 wasam (  وسم  )  : meaning to mark, to stain, to engrave on the body and make tattoos. Wassam(  وسم  ) means to dye. Wisam(  وسام  ) and wasma(  وسمه  ) are those things which are used to stain or dye. Waseem(  وسيم  ) means beautiful. It is stated in the Quran:
________________
Surat Al-Qalam (The Pen) -   سُوۡرَةُ القَلَم
68:16
سَنَسِمُهُ ۥ عَلَى ٱلۡخُرۡطُومِ
We shall brand him on the nose
________________
Summary:
1.SAWWAM(  سوم  ): used to mark a symbol.
2. WASAM(  وسم  ): to engrave or to mark or dye for beautification.

16.2 wasam (وسم): meaning to mark, to stain, to engrave on the body and make tattoos. Wassam(وسم) means to dye. Wisam(وسام) and wasma(وسمه) are those things which are used to stain or dye. Waseem(وسيم) means beautiful. It is stated in the Quran:

________________

Surat Al-Qalam (The Pen) - سُوۡرَةُ القَلَم

68:16

سَنَسِمُهُ ۥ عَلَى ٱلۡخُرۡطُومِ

We shall brand him on the nose

________________

Summary:

1.SAWWAM(سوم): used to mark a symbol.

2. WASAM(وسم): to engrave or to mark or dye for beautification.
