4.8 aslihah(أَسۡلِحَ) (sg: salaah): this word is associated with war or fight which means equipment of war and destruction, weapons of fighting and everything that is used for fighting or for defense.  Allah states that:

________________

Surat An-Nisa (Women) - سُوۡرَةُ النِّسَاء

4:102

فَلۡتَقُمۡ طَآٮِٕفَةٌ۬ مِّنۡہُم مَّعَكَ وَلۡيَأۡخُذُوٓاْ أَسۡلِحَتَہُمۡ

And when thou (O Muhammad) art among them and arrangest (their) worship for them, let only a party of them stand with thee (to worship) and let them take their arms. Then when they have performed their prostrations let them fall to the rear and let another party come that hath not worshipped and let them worship with thee, and let them take their precaution and their arms. Those who disbelieve long for you to neglect your arms and your baggage that they may attack you once for all. It is no sin for you to lay aside your arms, if rain impedeth you or ye are sick. But take your precaution. Lo! Allah prepareth for the disbelievers shameful punishment.

________________

4.9 uddah(عُدَّةً۬) (sg: udad): A’dd(عد) meaning to prepare. And a’adda(أعد) and a’atadd(أعتد) meaning to keep prepared and uddah(عدة) meaning provision related to preparation. Since this word has been used related to war preparation in the Quran, this word will include the meanings of all kinds of preparations and equipment. Allah states that:

________________

Surat Al-Tawba (Repentance) - سُوۡرَةُ التّوبَة

9:46

وَلَوۡ أَرَادُواْ ٱلۡخُرُوجَ لَأَعَدُّواْ لَهُ ۥ عُدَّةً۬

And if they had wished to go forth they would assuredly have made ready some equipment, but Allah was averse to their being sent forth and held them back and it was said (unto them): Sit ye with the sedentary!

________________

4.10 na’ma(نَعۡمَ): na’am meaning prosperity and favorite dwellings. And na’ma(نعمة) meaning things of luxury and delight. It is stated in the Quran:

________________

Surat Ad-Dukhan (Smoke) - سُوۡرَةُ الدّخان

44:27

وَنَعۡمَةٍ۬ كَانُواْ فِيہَا فَـٰكِهِينَ

And pleasant things wherein they took delight!

________________

4.11 reeshan(رِيشً۬ا): reesh-ut-taair(ريش الطائر) meaning the feathers and arms of a bird. And rayyaash(رياش) means a person who attaches a bird’s feathers to arrows. Because a bird’s feathers are like its clothes, consequently, the word reeshan(رِيشً۬ا) is used to depict a man’s luxurious clothing and its adornment and ornamentation. Allah states that:

________________

Surat Al-A’raf (The Heights) - سُوۡرَةُ الاٴعرَاف

7:26

يَـٰبَنِىٓ ءَادَمَ قَدۡ أَنزَلۡنَا عَلَيۡكُمۡ لِبَاسً۬ا يُوَٲرِى سَوۡءَٲتِكُمۡ وَرِيشً۬ا‌ۖ

O Children of Adam! We have revealed unto you raiment to conceal your shame, and splendid vesture, but the raiment of restraint from evil, that is best. This is of the revelations of Allah, that they may remember.

________________

4.12 bidaa’ah(بِضَـٰعَةً۬): meaning a greater portion  of wealth that has been placed aside for trade, meaning merchandise for sale, and those assets that have been designated for trade purposes. It is stated in the Quran:

________________

Surat Yusuf (Joseph) - سُوۡرَةُ یُوسُف

12:19

قَالَ يَـٰبُشۡرَىٰ هَـٰذَا غُلَـٰمٌ۬‌ۚ وَأَسَرُّوهُ بِضَـٰعَةً۬‌ۚ

And there came a caravan, and they sent their waterdrawer. He let down his pail (into the pit). He said: Good luck! Here is a youth. And they hid him as a treasure, and Allah was Aware of what they did.

________________

4.13 ma’oun(مَاعُونَ): alma’an(المعن) meaning a beneficial thing. And ma’oun(مَاعُونَ) is used for all those things of utility that are of use for ordinary people such as axe, saucepan and other household items. Allah states that:

________________

Surat Al-Ma’un (Small Kindness) - سُوۡرَةُ المَاعون

107:6-7

 ٱلَّذِينَ هُمۡ يُرَآءُونَ وَيَمۡنَعُونَ ٱلۡمَاعُونَ

Who would be seen (at worship) - Yet refuse small kindnesses!

________________

4.14 hizr(حِذۡرَ): hazar(حذر) meaning to remain alert and cautious. And hizr are all those things which can be used for defense and protection. Thus, all those things which are used for defense during war are called hizr. Allah states that:

________________

Surat An-Nisa (Women) - سُوۡرَةُ النِّسَاء

4:102

وَلَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيۡڪُمۡ إِن كَانَ بِكُمۡ أَذً۬ى مِّن مَّطَرٍ أَوۡ كُنتُم مَّرۡضَىٰٓ أَن تَضَعُوٓاْ أَسۡلِحَتَكُمۡ‌ۖ وَخُذُواْ حِذۡرَكُمۡ‌ۗ

And when thou (O Muhammad) art among them and arrangest (their) worship for them, let only a party of them stand with thee (to worship) and let them take their arms. Then when they have performed their prostrations let them fall to the rear and let another party come that hath not worshipped and let them worship with thee, and let them take their precaution and their arms. Those who disbelieve long for you to neglect your arms and your baggage that they may attack you once for all. It is no sin for you to lay aside your arms, if rain impedeth you or ye are sick. But take your precaution. Lo! Allah prepareth for the disbelievers shameful punishment.

________________

 

PAGE 576

4.15 MA’AISH (مَعَائِش): (singular MAEESHAH مَعِیْشَۃ) Means articles of sustenance. AASH (عاش) means to live or exist. And any items which can be used as a source of nourishment like food, grains, water etc. will be known as MA’AISH(مَعَائِش). Allah says in the Holy Quran

Surah Al-Araf (The heights): سورۃ الأعرَاف 7:10

وَلَقَدۡ مَكَّنَّـٰڪُمۡ فِى ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَجَعَلۡنَا لَكُمۡ فِيہَا مَعَـٰيِشَ‌ۗ

We have established you firmly on earth, and made for you in it livelihood—

 

Summary:

4.1 ARD: Ephemerality of the world and worldly goods.

4.2 MATA’: Every item/good that can be benefitted from.

4.3 ASSAS: Household Goods.

4.4 RAHL: Luggage/Baggage for travelling

4.5 WIAA’: Luggage/Baggage that is enclosed or locked.

4.6 JAHAZ: Luggage that is packed together for travelling it can be RAHL or ZAAD

4.7 ZAAD: Food and perishable items for travel.

4.8 ASLIHAH: Weapons and arms.

4.9 UDDAH: Preparations for war, and all the items related to the preparation.

4.10 NI’MAH: Luxury items.

4.11 REESH: Haughty attire or related items.

4.12 BIDAA’AH: Merchantable goods, capital.

4.13 MA’OON: Items of daily use.

4.14 HIZR: Articles for self conservation.

4.15 MA’AISH: Articles of sustenance.



<<Alternate Translation>>

Luggage, Belongings

For this the words عَرَضَ, مَتَاع, اَثَاث, رَحَلَ, وِعَأ(وعِي), جَهَاز, زَاد (زود), اَسلِحة, عُدَّة , نَعمَة, رِيش, مَاعوُن (معن), مَعَا يشhave been used.

1- عَرَضَ

عَرَضَis everything which is not constant and everything in this world, with reference to this is عَرَضَ. When it is necessary to highlight inconstancy and fickleness of worldly things or possessions then عَرَضَis used. It also means that worldly gains and possession are flimsy and short lived.

وَلَا تَقُولُواْ لِمَنۡ أَلۡقَىٰٓ إِلَيۡڪُمُ ٱلسَّلَـٰمَ لَسۡتَ مُؤۡمِنً۬ا تَبۡتَغُونَ عَرَضَ ٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنۡيَا فَعِندَ ٱللَّهِ مَغَانِمُ ڪَثِيرَةٌ۬*ۚ

“Say not unto one who offereth you peace: "Thou art not a believer," seeking the chance profits of this life. With Allah are plenteous spoils” 4/94

2- مَتَاع(Pl: اَمتِعَة)

مَتَعَmeans to benefit from something in the long run. Any useful commodity or any part of it which is useful and to enjoy worldly gains a possessions. When its necessary to highlight worldly possessions and gains they bring, this word is used.

وَلَكُمۡ فِى ٱلۡأَرۡضِ مُسۡتَقَرٌّ۬ وَمَتَـٰعٌ إِلَىٰ حِينٍ۬

“There shall be for you on earth a habitation and provision for a time” 2/36

3- اَثَاث

اَثَاثةis the plural and is most commonly used. اثَاث البَيتis a famous phrase meaning household items or property. Household essentials like clothing, furniture, culinary items, beds etc. are all classed as اثَاث البَيت. This phrase, afterwards, was also used for all kinds of other things which were not so useful and has also been used for scrapyards and shops which sell this kind of items. Also, a slave or an animal that belongs to someone and is in direct use of that person is also referred to as اثَاث البَيت. For example, horse, cow, camel etc.

وَكَمۡ أَهۡلَكۡنَا قَبۡلَهُم مِّن قَرۡنٍ هُمۡ أَحۡسَنُ أَثَـٰثً۬ا وَرِءۡيً۬ا

“How many a generation have We destroyed before them, who were more imposing in respect of gear and outward seeming” 19/74

4- رَحل

رَحَلَmeans to put a saddle on a camel, to set off, to ride and the personal luggage that one takes on a journey is also رَحَلَ. In a Hadith, the Prophet Muhammad (saw) says:

لاَ تَشَدَّ و ا اَلَرِّحََالَ إِلاَّ لِثَلاَثة

which can be roughly translated as, 'don't put a saddle on your camel for pilgrimage of anywhere apart from 3 mosques(Masjid Al-Haraam, Masjid An-Nabawi, Masjid Al-Aqsa)'

In the Quran it says:

جَعَلَ ٱلسِّقَايَةَ فِى رَحۡلِ أَخِيهِ

“He put the drinking-cup in his brother's saddlebag” 12/70

5- وِعَأ(sing: اوعِيَة)

وَعَيmeans to put something a bag and tie a knot on it for safe keeping. اَوعِيَةis that item which is put inside a container and locked.

ثُمَّ ٱسۡتَخۡرَجَهَا مِن وِعَآءِ أَخِيهِ*ۚ

“Then he produced it from his brother's bag ” 12/76

6- جَهَاز

جَهَّزَmeans to make ready, to load and to send. جَهَازis that luggage which a passenger makes ready before setting off. تَجهِيزis that which is prepared before burying a person and جَهِيزis that which parents give to their daughter, at the time of her wedding, to take with.

فَلَمَّا جَهَّزَهُم بِجَهَازِهِمۡ

“And when he provided them with their provision” 12/70

7- زََاد

It means extra, something spare and زََادis normally used in text to journeys. زَادرَاهmeans 'spending money' and food for the journey andالمزاد هmeaning a water skin which is used during travelling and المِزوَدmeans a food container and تَزَوَّدَmeans to take provisions for a journey.

وَتَزَوَّدُواْ فَإِنَّ خَيۡرَ ٱلزَّادِ ٱلتَّقۡوَىٰ*ۚ

“So make provision for yourselves (Hereafter); for the best provision is to ward off evil“ 2/197

8- اَسلِحَة(sing: سَلاَح)

This word is commonly associated with war and fighting and gives the meaning of arms, weapons and everything else that is used to fight with or to resist with.

فَلۡتَقُمۡ طَآٮِٕفَةٌ۬ مِّنۡہُم مَّعَكَ وَلۡيَأۡخُذُوٓاْ أَسۡلِحَتَہُمۡ

“Let only a party of them stand with thee (to worship) and let them take their arms” 4/102

9- عُدَّة(sing: عُدَد)

عَدَّmeans to make preparations or to make ready.اَعَدَّand اَعتَدَmean to keep ready for actions and عُدَّةmeans equipment with regards to readiness. In Quran this word has been used in context of readiness and preparedness for war. Hence, the meaning more broadly encompasses any sort of preparation and equipment.

وَلَوۡ أَرَادُواْ ٱلۡخُرُوجَ لَأَعَدُّواْ لَهُۥ عُدَّةً۬

“And if they had wished to go forth they would assuredly have made ready some equipment” 9/46

10- نَعمَة

نَعَمmeans prosperity and good fortune. نَعمَةmeans items that constitute luxury.

وَنَعۡمَةٍ۬ كَانُواْ فِيہَا فَـٰكِهِينَ

“And pleasant things wherein they took delight!“ 44/27

11- رِيشاً

رِيش الطَّأرmeans the wings and feathers of a bird. رَيََّاشis a person who puts bird feathers on arrows. Because bird feathers are like regalia so similarly the word رِيشاًis used for raiment worn by people.

يَـٰبَنِىٓ ءَادَمَ قَدۡ أَنزَلۡنَا عَلَيۡكُمۡ لِبَاسً۬ا يُوَٲرِى سَوۡءَٲتِكُمۡ وَرِيشً۬ا*ۖ

“Children of Adam! We have revealed unto you raiment to conceal your shame, and splendid vesture” 7/26

It is also used in the meaning of decoration and ornamentation.

12- بِضَاعَةً

Means a generous part of wealth that is put aside for business or commodities that are for sale. It is also used for the capitol that is set aside for trade.

قَالَ يَـٰبُشۡرَىٰ هَـٰذَا غُلَـٰمٌ۬*ۚ وَأَسَرُّوهُ بِضَـٰعَةً۬*ۚ

“He said: Good luck! Here is a youth. And they hid him as a treasure” 12/19

13- مَاعُون

اَلمَعَنَmeans useful belongings. مَاعُونis everything of use that is commonly used by everyone. For example, everyday used things like axe, pots, household items etc.

وَيَمۡنَعُونَ ٱلۡمَاعُونَ

“Yet refuse small kindnesses” 107/7

14- حِذر

حَذَرَmeans to stay vigilant and sharp and حِذرis all the equipment that is used for defence. So, every instrument used in defence during a war is حِذر.

وَلَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيۡڪُمۡ إِن كَانَ بِكُمۡ أَذً۬ى مِّن مَّطَرٍ أَوۡ كُنتُم مَّرۡضَىٰٓ أَن تَضَعُوٓاْ أَسۡلِحَتَكُمۡ*ۖ وَخُذُواْ حِذۡرَكُمۡ*ۗ

“It is no sin for you to lay aside your arms, if rain impedeth you or ye are sick. But take your precaution” 4/102

15- مَعَائِش(sing: مَعِيشَة)

عَاشmeans to stay alive and everything that is needed to stay alive for example, good, water etc. isمَعَائِش.

وَلَقَدۡ مَكَّنَّـٰڪُمۡ فِى ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَجَعَلۡنَا لَكُمۡ فِيہَا مَعَـٰيِشَ*ۗ

“And We have given you (mankind) power in the earth, and appointed for you therein livelihood” 7/10

Inference

1- عَرض: Points towards fickleness of the world and the worldly wealth

2- مَتَاع: Everything that is useful in some way

3- اَثَاث: Household items and property

4- رَحل: Luggage that stays with the traveller throughout the journey

5- وِعَأ: Everything that is kept locked

6- جَهَاز: Whatever is prepared for the journey and it can be زَادand/or رَحل

7- زَاد: Food material for the journey

8- اَسلِحَة: Arms and weapons

9- عُدَّةَ: Preparation for war and fighting equipment

10- نَعمَة: Items that constitute luxury

11- رِِيش: Raiment and adornments

12- بِضَاعَة: Commodities or wealth for investment

13- مَاعُون: Everyday use household items

14- حِذر: Defensive equipment or gear

15- مَعَائِش: Necessities of life

5. SAMANE ANA [to come forth, to appear]
Synonyms: AQBALA, BARAZA
5.1 AQBALA (اَقْبَلَ):   QABAL-AL-MAKAAN (قَبَلَ المَکَان) means to head for a place and QABAL (قْابَل) means two things coming face to face, competing. QABBALA (قْبَّلَ) means to embrace and AQBALA (اَقْبَلَ) means to stand/come in front of someone facing it. Or face something. To come from the front (dictionary Al   Manjad  ). In the Quran
Surah Yusuf (Joseph): سورۃ یُوسُف 12:71
قَالُواْ وَأَقۡبَلُواْ عَلَيۡهِم مَّاذَا تَفۡقِدُونَ
They said, as they came towards them, “What are you missing?”
PAGE 577
5.2 BARAZA (بَرَزَ):   BARZ (بَرْزَ) means an open field, atmosphere. BARAZA (بَرَزَ) means to go out into an open area. Or emerge in open after isolation or anonymity (dictionary Al   Manjad  ). Allah says in the Holy Quran
Surah Ibraheem (Abraham): سورۃ ابراھیم 14:21
وَبَرَزُواْ لِلَّهِ جَمِيعً۬ا
They will emerge before God, altogether.
Summary:
5.1 AQBALA: To come towards, to face.
5.2 BARAZA: To emerge
To come out
For this the words بَرَزَand اَقبَلَhave been used.
1- اَقبَلَ
قَبَلَ المَكَانmeans to face in the direction and قَابَلَis used to denote when 2 entities confront each other. قَبَّلَmeans to kiss and اَقبَلَmeans to turn one's face in someone's direction to face them or appear in front of them.
قَالُواْ وَأَقۡبَلُواْ عَلَيۡهِم مَّاذَا تَفۡقِدُونَ
“They cried, coming toward them: What is it ye have lost?” 12/71
2- بَرَزَ
بَرزmeans outdoors and open plane and بَرَزَmeans to come into the open plane. At the same time it means to appear or to manifest after a period of hiding.
وَبَرَزُواْ لِلَّهِ جَمِيعً۬ا
“They all come forth unto their Lord” 14/21

6. SAANP [snake, serpent]
Synonyms: HAYYAH, JAAN, THAUBAAN
6.1 HAYYAH (حَیَّۃٌ):   It’s a gender noun representing every kind of snake, and used for both the genders of snakes. A convoluted snake according to dictionary Al   Manjad. HAWAYA (حَوَایَا) means intestines convoluted like a snake. TAHWI-AL-HAYYA (تحوی الحیّۃ) refers to convolution or coiling of a snake. HAAWI (حَاوِی) means a snake charmer   (dictionary Al   Manjad  ). Both the meanings seem appropriate because every snake convolutes. This is possibly why it’s called HAYYAH (حَیَّۃٌ). In the Quran
Surah Ta-Ha (Ta-ha): سورۃ طٰھٰ  20:19
قَالَ أَلۡقِهَا يَـٰمُوسَىٰ  فَأَلۡقَٮٰهَا فَإِذَا هِىَ حَيَّةٌ۬ تَسۡعَىٰ
He said, “Throw it, O Moses.”  So he threw it—thereupon it became a moving serpent.
6.2 JAANN (جَآنٌ):   means Jinn, demon or a fairy, Gigantic and every jinn that is in form of a snake as mentioned in hadith. Moulana Shabbir Ahmed Usmani translates it as a thin white snake or stick serpent. Allah says in the Holy Quran
Surah An-Naml (The ant): سورۃ النَّمل 27:10
فَلَمَّا رَءَاهَا تَہۡتَزُّ كَأَنَّہَا جَآنٌّ۬ وَلَّىٰ مُدۡبِرً۬ا وَلَمۡ يُعَقِّبۡ‌ۚ
But when he saw it quivering, as though it were a demon, he turned around not looking back.
6.3 THAUBAAN (ثَعْبَانٌ):   means a huge snake, anaconda or boa. Allah says in the Holy Quran
Surah Al-Araf (The heights): سورۃ الأعرَاف 7:107
فَأَلۡقَىٰ عَصَاهُ فَإِذَا هِىَ ثُعۡبَانٌ۬ مُّبِينٌ۬
So he threw his staff, and it was an apparent serpent.

7. SAB, SARAY [Everyone, All]
Synonyms: KULL, KAAFFAH, AJMA’UN
7.1 KULL (کّل):   means everyone, all (opposite JUZ جزء). This word is used when KULL (کّل) is a collection of units, and it is also used to represent each portion for instance every person, everyone, everything. In the Quran
Surah Al-Israa (The Night Journey): سورۃ الٕاسرَاء  17:84
قُلۡ ڪُلٌّ۬ يَعۡمَلُ عَلَىٰ شَاكِلَتِهِ
Say: Everyone acts according to his own disposition:
When using this word as a collection of units, the word still means all, everyone. In the Quran
Surah Al-Baqarah (The cow): سورۃ البَقَرَۃ  2:31
وَعَلَّمَ ءَادَمَ ٱلۡأَسۡمَآءَ كُلَّهَا
And He taught Adam the names, all of them;
7.2 KAAFFAH (کَافَّۃ):   AL-KAFAF (الکفاف) means completely, total girth of anything. KAFF (کََافّ) is an agent noun and KAAFFAH (کَافَّۃ) is the feminine of this noun. It is used in two ways.
1. When KULL (کّل) is a collection of units then it will also represent this complete collection. In this respect it is prolific to KULL (کّل). Allah says in the Quran
Surah Saba (Sheba): سورۃ سَبَإ 34:28
وَمَآ أَرۡسَلۡنَـٰكَ إِلَّا ڪَآفَّةً۬ لِّلنَّاسِ بَشِيرً۬ا وَنَذِيرً۬ا
We sent you only universally to all people, a herald and warner,
2. When KULL (کّل) represents a complete unit then KAAFFAH (کَافَّۃ) represents the enclosure of all its constituents. In this respect it is prolific to KAMIL (کامل). Allah says in the Quran
Surah Al-Baqarah (The cow): سورۃ البَقَرَۃ  2:208
يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ ٱدۡخُلُواْ فِى ٱلسِّلۡمِ ڪَآفَّةً۬
O you who believe! Enter into submission, wholeheartedly
In this Ayah KAAFFAH (کَافَّۃ) means both all and completely.
7.3 AJMA’UN (اَجْمَعُوْن):   JAMA (جمع) means to gather or collect. AJMA’ (اَجْمَعَ) means to do something collectively. AJAMA’-ALAL-AMAR (اَجْمَعَ عَلَی الْاَمْر) means everyone  agreeing to an opinion. In the Quran
Surah Yusuf (Joseph): سورۃ یُوسُف 12:15
فَلَمَّا ذَهَبُواْ بِهِۦ وَأَجۡمَعُوٓاْ أَن يَجۡعَلُوهُ فِى غَيَـٰبَتِ ٱلۡجُبِّ‌ۚ
So they went away with him, and agreed to put him at the bottom of the well.
And AJMA’UN (اَجْمَعُوْن) means to perform a task together at one time. Allah says in the Holy Quran
Surah Al-Hijr (The Rock): سورۃ الحِجر 15:30
فَسَجَدَ ٱلۡمَلَـٰٓٮِٕكَةُ ڪُلُّهُمۡ أَجۡمَعُونَ
So the angels prostrated themselves, all together.
Summary:
7.1 KULL: Everyone, all
7.2 KAFFAH: Completely, all, everyone. Prolific to both KULL and KAMIL
7.3 AJMA’UN: Together, collectively.
All, Everyone
The words, كُلّ، كَافّة، and اجمَعُونhave been used in the Quran.
1- كُلّ
كُلّ     means everyone, all (ant:جُزء) and is used when the addressees comprise of numerous denominations. This particular word is also used for every single entity or being, being addressed. For example, every single thing, every single person.
قُلۡ ڪُلٌّ۬ يَعۡمَلُ عَلَىٰ شَاكِلَتِهِ
“Say: Each one doth according to his rule of conduct” 17:84
For the assembly as a whole it is used as:
“     وَعَلَّمَ ءَادَمَ ٱلۡأَسۡمَآءَ كُلَّهَا
“And He taught Adam all the names” 2/31
2- كَافّة
الكفَاف     means to encompass completely. كَافّcan be loosely generalised, in English, as a noun that performs an action but its the performer in question that is being addressed and not the action. So, كَافّis the noun and كَافّةis the feminine gender. It can be used in 2 ways.
a- When كُلّis a collection of several types of units then it is used for the whole collection of units and carries a more concise meaning than كُلّ
وَمَآ أَرۡسَلۡنَـٰكَ إِلَّا ڪَآفَّةً۬ لِّلنَّاسِ بَشِيرً۬ا وَنَذِيرً۬
“And We have not sent thee (O Muhammad) save as a bringer of good tidings and a warner unto all” 34/28
b- When كُلّconsists of only a single unit then it is used to cover all aspects of that unit.
يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ ٱدۡخُلُواْ فِى ٱلسِّلۡمِ ڪَآفَّةً۬
“O ye who believe! Come, all of you, into   submission  ” 2/  208
In the above ayah, كَافّةis giving both the meanings as in 'all of you' and 'everything of you'.
3- اجمَعُون
جَمع     means to gather and اَجمَعَmeans to make a collective effort. اَجمَعَعلَيالاَمرmeans to reach unanimity.
فَلَمَّا ذَهَبُواْ بِهِۦ وَأَجۡمَعُوٓاْ أَن يَجۡعَلُوهُ فِى غَيَـٰبَتِ ٱلۡجُبِّ*ۚ
“Then, when they led him off, and were of one mind that they should place him in the depth of the pit” 12/15
اَجمَعُون     means to make a collective effort in unison.
فَسَجَدَ ٱلۡمَلَـٰٓٮِٕكَةُ ڪُلُّهُمۡ أَجۡمَعُونَ
“So the angels fell prostrate, all of them together” 15/30
Inference
1- كُلّ: Means each of you and also means everyone of you.
2- كَافّة: Means all of you and everyone of you. It is more concise than كُلّand كَامل
3- اَجمَعُون: Means everyone in unison

8- SUPURD KERNA, HAWALAY KERNA [to devolve, to commend]
Synonyms: AKFALA, KAFFALA, WAKKALA, DAFA’ (ILA), SALLAMA, FAWWADA, ISTAWDA’
8.1 AKFALA (اَکْفَلَ) and KAFFALA (کْفَّلَ):   KAFALA (کْفَلَ) means liable to someone’s livelihood and protection. Guarantor. AKFALA (اَکْفَلَ) and KAFFALA (کْفَّلَ) means to commend the responsibilities of protection and grooming to someone, to assign a guarantor, Entrust someone else in charge   (dictionary Al   Manjad  )  . In the Quran
Surah Saad (Saad): سورۃ ص 38:23
إِنَّ هَـٰذَآ أَخِى لَهُ ۥ تِسۡعٌ۬ وَتِسۡعُونَ نَعۡجَةً۬ وَلِىَ نَعۡجَةٌ۬ وَٲحِدَةٌ۬ فَقَالَ أَكۡفِلۡنِيہَا وَعَزَّنِى فِى ٱلۡخِطَابِ
“This brother of mine has ninety nine ewes, and I have one ewe, and he said, ‘Entrust it to me,’ and he pressured me with words.”
In Another reference:
Surah Al-e-Imran (The family of Imran): سورۃ آل عِمْرن 3:37
فَتَقَبَّلَهَا رَبُّهَا بِقَبُولٍ حَسَنٍ۬ وَأَنۢبَتَهَا نَبَاتًا حَسَنً۬ا وَكَفَّلَهَا زَكَرِيَّا‌ۖ
Her Lord accepted her with a gracious reception, and brought her a beautiful upbringing, and entrusted her to the care of Zechariah.

9 SACH [Truth]
Synonyms: SIDQ, HAQQ
9.1 SIDQ (صِدْق):   SADAQA (صَدَقَ) means to speak the truth (opposite KAZAB کذب), And not tell anything that deviates from or perverts the actual incident. A well-known word. Allah says in the Holy Quran
Surah Az-Zumar (The groups): سورۃ الزُّمَر 39:32
فَمَنۡ أَظۡلَمُ مِمَّن ڪَذَبَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ وَكَذَّبَ بِٱلصِّدۡقِ إِذۡ جَآءَهُ ۥۤ‌ۚ
Who is more evil than he who lies about God, and denies the truth when it has come to him?
PAGE 581
9.2 HAQQ (حَقّ):   (opposite BATAL باطل) HAQQ (حَقّ) is a fact that has been verified and proven through experiments and contemplation, truth. Allah says in the Quran
Surah Fussilat (Explained in Detail): سورۃ فُصّلَت 41:53
سَنُرِيهِمۡ ءَايَـٰتِنَا فِى ٱلۡأَفَاقِ وَفِىٓ أَنفُسِہِمۡ حَتَّىٰ يَتَبَيَّنَ لَهُمۡ أَنَّهُ ٱلۡحَقُّ‌ۗ
We will show them Our proofs on the horizons, and in their very souls, until it becomes clear to them that it is the truth.

title: Allah says in the Quran: 77:30 : Surat Al-Mursalāt   (The Emissaries)   -     سورة المرسلات
raw_text:
Page 604 onwards
1.            Branch
Faraa   فَرَعَ    , Shaa’ab   شَعَبَ   , & afnan     اَفنَان    are the words used in the Quran
1.            Faraa    فَرَعَ   :This word means branch & its plural is faroo’o    فروع   .( meaning branches) According to Imaam Raghib, that the upper part of anything that comes from the root is called faraa as shajar    فرع الشجر  .
Allah says in the Quran : 14:24 : Surat 'Ibrāhīm (Abrahim) -   سورة ابراهيم
أَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ ضَرَبَ اللَّهُ مَثَلًا كَلِمَةً طَيِّبَةً كَشَجَرَةٍ طَيِّبَةٍ أَصْلُهَا ثَابِتٌ وَفَرْعُهَا فِي السَّمَاءِ
Have you not considered how Allah presents an example, [making] a good word like a good tree, whose root is firmly fixed and its branches [high] in the sky?
This word is used for both matter & meaning. Faroaaee masaael    فروعى مساءل   are those masaael (issues) that are based on some other facts & are assumed on those. There are no examples of this in the Quran.
2.            Shoab     شَعَبَ  : Its the plural of Shoaba    شُعبة   . There are two basic things in the meaning of this word. A) Iftaraq    افتراق    or to be separate/to alienate. & b) Ijmaa    اجماع  . But this word does not come from dictionary of opposites. It applies to all those things that divide into many branches. For e.g.tashsha’ab un nahar     تَشَعَّبُ النَّهر   meaning branches of river or fingers from palm. Shoab    شَعَبَ   is also used for a big tribe.
Allah says in the Quran: 77:30 : Surat Al-Mursalāt   (The Emissaries)   -     سورة المرسلات
انطَلِقُوا إِلَىٰ ظِلٍّ ذِي ثَلَاثِ شُعَبٍ
Proceed to a shadow [of smoke] having three columns
3.            Afnaan    اَفنَان  : (plural of fanan    فنن    ). Fanan     فنن    means a very thick & long branch of a tree. Shajaratunn fannanunn    شَجَرَةٌ فَنَّان   means a tree with thick & long branches.
Quran says: 55:48: Surat Ar-Raĥmān   (The Beneficent)   -     سورة الرحمن
ذَوَاتَا أَفْنَانٍ
Having [spreading] branches.
Summary:
1.             Faraa    فَرَعَ   : Whatever  comes out of something, other than its original, it called it faraa
2.            Shoaba   شَعَبَ   :When something divides into parts & is still connected to its origin.
3.            Fanan   اَفنَان   : This refers to a thick & long branch of a tree.

10. Doubt/uncertainity:
Shakk   شَكّ   , shubah   شُبه   ,mareej    مَرِيج    ,miryah   مِرية    ,labs   لَبَس   & raib    رَيب   are the words used.
1.            Shakk   شَكّ   : two views having the same strength in the mind when there is not enough evidence to support one. The basis of shakk    شَكّ   (doubt /confusion)is lack of knowledge.
In the Quran: 14:10: Surat 'Ibrāhīm (Abrahim) -   سورة ابراهيم
قَالَتْ رُسُلُهُمْ أَفِي اللَّهِ شَكٌّ فَاطِرِ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ ۖ يَدْعُوكُمْ لِيَغْفِرَ لَكُم مِّن ذُنُوبِكُمْ وَيُؤَخِّرَكُمْ إِلَىٰ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى ۚ قَالُوا إِنْ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُنَا تُرِيدُونَ أَن تَصُدُّونَا عَمَّا كَانَ يَعْبُدُ آبَاؤُنَا فَأْتُونَا بِسُلْطَانٍ مُّبِينٍ
Their messengers said, "Can there be doubt about Allah , Creator of the heavens and earth? He invites you that He may forgive you of your sins, and He delays your death for a specified term." They said, "You are not but men like us who wish to avert us from what our fathers were worshipping. So bring us a clear authority."
2.            Shubah   شُبه   : It means when two things are so similar that it becomes difficult to differentiate between them.
This confusion/doubt is generally in colours or characteristics/qualities.
Allah says in the Quran: 4:157: Surat An-Nisā' (The Women) -   سورة النساء
وَقَوْلِهِمْ إِنَّا قَتَلْنَا الْمَسِيحَ عِيسَى ابْنَ مَرْيَمَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ وَمَا قَتَلُوهُ وَمَا صَلَبُوهُ وَلَٰكِن شُبِّهَ لَهُمْ ۚ وَإِنَّ الَّذِينَ اخْتَلَفُوا فِيهِ لَفِي شَكٍّ مِّنْهُ ۚ مَا لَهُم بِهِ مِنْ عِلْمٍ إِلَّا اتِّبَاعَ الظَّنِّ ۚ وَمَا قَتَلُوهُ يَقِينًا
And [for] their saying, "Indeed, we have killed the Messiah, Jesus, the son of Mary, the messenger of Allah ." And they did not kill him, nor did they crucify him; but [another] was made to resemble him to them. And indeed, those who differ over it are in doubt about it. They have no knowledge of it except the following of assumption. And they did not kill him, for certain.
In another verse : 2:70 :Surat Al-Baqarah (The Cow) -   سورة البقرة
قَالُوا ادْعُ لَنَا رَبَّكَ يُبَيِّن لَّنَا مَا هِيَ إِنَّ الْبَقَرَ تَشَابَهَ عَلَيْنَا وَإِنَّا إِن شَاءَ اللَّهُ لَمُهْتَدُونَ
They said, "Call upon your Lord to make clear to us what it is. Indeed, [all] cows look alike to us. And indeed we, if Allah wills, will be guided."
3.            Mirya   مِرية    : Maree    مرى    has two basic meanings. a) some idea or belief or some reality to be solid. B)to make this reality doubtful with doubtful things. Therefore this word is used for arguments/verbal fights. & the basis of arguments is generally doubts.
Allah says in the Quran :53:55: Surat An-Najm (The Star) -   سورة النجم
فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكَ تَتَمَارَىٰ
Then which of the favors of your Lord do you doubt?
Miryaa is a doubt created about a reality /fact  & this doubt is created /made up by people.
As Allah says in the Quran:32:23: Surat As-Sajdah (The Prostration) -   سورة السجدة
وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنَا مُوسَى الْكِتَابَ فَلَا تَكُن فِي مِرْيَةٍ مِّن لِّقَائِهِ   ۖ   وَجَعَلْنَاهُ هُدًى لِّبَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ
And We certainly gave Moses the Scripture, so do not be in doubt over his meeting. And we made the Torah guidance for the Children of Israel.
4.            Mareej   مَرِيج   : maraj    مَرَجَ    means mix up of two things or views. Ghusnum mareej    غُصنٌ مَّرِيجٌ  means a curled up twig/branch. Messed up/disorderly are other meanings. Some situation to be confused or muddled up. Maraj    مَرَجَ   means coming & going of a thought or to be confused or disturbed. Therefore this word is a combination of the meanings of confusion & reluctance.
Allah says in the Quran:50:5 : Surat Qāf (The Letter "Qaf") -   سورة ق
بَلْ كَذَّبُوا بِالْحَقِّ لَمَّا جَاءَهُمْ فَهُمْ فِي أَمْرٍ مَّرِيجٍ
But they denied the truth when it came to them, so they are in a confused condition.
5.            Lubs     لَبس    : labas    لَبَسَ   means confusion or doubt. i.e to mix up two things.or to put one thing in another.(corrupt it) for example, mix up truth with falsehood or add a little bit of lie to the truth/fact. Similarly make the reality so doubtful that it is difficult to differentiate between the two. This word is used in conversation & arguments.
As per the Quran:50:15: Surat Qāf (The Letter "Qaf") -   سورة ق
أَفَعَيِينَا بِالْخَلْقِ الْأَوَّلِ ۚ بَلْ هُمْ فِي لَبْسٍ مِّنْ خَلْقٍ جَدِيدٍ
Did We fail in the first creation? But they are in confusion over a new creation.
In another verse. 2:42: Surat Al-Baqarah (The Cow) -   سورة البقرة
وَلَا تَلْبِسُوا الْحَقَّ بِالْبَاطِلِ وَتَكْتُمُوا الْحَقَّ وَأَن  تُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
And do not mix the truth with falsehood or conceal the truth while you know [it].
6.            Raib   رَيب   : A doubt which has an element of compulsion in it. Raibud dahr    رَيبُ الدَّهر   means cycle of life(the way it moves) hawaadis se zamana & raib ul manoon    رَيبُ المَنٌون   meaning the dangers of life. Raib   رَيب   is such a doubt which creates confusion. They say,   دَع مَا يُريبَكَ اَلى مَا لاَ يُريبَكَ          leave that thing that creates confusion in mind.That control or authority that has no confusion/restlessness. Reeba   رِيبَة   means anxiety.
Allah says in the Quran: 41:35: Surat Fuşşilat (Explained in Detail) -   سورة فصلت
وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنَا مُوسَى الْكِتَابَ فَاخْتُلِفَ فِيهِ ۗ وَلَوْلَا كَلِمَةٌ سَبَقَتْ مِن رَّبِّكَ لَقُضِيَ بَيْنَهُمْ ۚ وَإِنَّهُمْ لَفِي شَكٍّ مِّنْهُ مُرِيبٍ
And We had already given Moses the Scripture, but it came under disagreement. And if not for a word that preceded from your Lord, it would have been concluded between them. And indeed they are, concerning the Qur'an, in disquieting doubt.
In another verse: 2:2 : Surat Al-Baqarah (The Cow) -   سورة البقرة
ذَٰلِكَ الْكِتَابُ لَا رَيْبَ ۛ فِيهِ ۛ هُدًى لِّلْمُتَّقِينَ
This is the Book about which there is no doubt, a guidance for those conscious of Allah –
Summary:
1.            Shakk    شَكّ  : inability to give preference to one view because of lack of knowledge
2.            Shubah       شُبه    : confusion between some things because of the similarity in qualities/characteristics.
3.            Mirya   مِرية    : to make a truth /fact doubtful by saying/spreading doubtful things.
4.            Lubs   لَبس   : To mix up two things in such a way that it becomes difficult to differentiate between them.
5.            Mareej   مَرِيج   : to be confused because of the fact that views /thoughts keep on changing in priority.one thought looks important initially, then the other thought seems important, & then again the initial thought becomes important. Hence the confusion.
6.            Raib   رَيب   : A doubt with the element of both anxiety & in quietude.

And We certainly gave Moses the Scripture, so do not be in doubt over his meeting. And we made the Torah guidance for the Children of Israel.

4.        Mareej مَرِيج : maraj  مَرَجَ  means mix up of two things or views. Ghusnum mareej  غُصنٌ مَّرِيجٌmeans a curled up twig/branch. Messed up/disorderly are other meanings. Some situation to be confused or muddled up. Maraj  مَرَجَ means coming & going of a thought or to be confused or disturbed. Therefore this word is a combination of the meanings of confusion & reluctance.

Allah says in the Quran:50:5 : Surat Qāf (The Letter "Qaf") - سورة ق

بَلْ كَذَّبُوا بِالْحَقِّ لَمَّا جَاءَهُمْ فَهُمْ فِي أَمْرٍ مَّرِيجٍ

But they denied the truth when it came to them, so they are in a confused condition.

5.        Lubs   لَبس  : labas  لَبَسَ means confusion or doubt. i.e to mix up two things.or to put one thing in another.(corrupt it) for example, mix up truth with falsehood or add a little bit of lie to the truth/fact. Similarly make the reality so doubtful that it is difficult to differentiate between the two. This word is used in conversation & arguments.

As per the Quran:50:15: Surat Qāf (The Letter "Qaf") - سورة ق

أَفَعَيِينَا بِالْخَلْقِ الْأَوَّلِ ۚ بَلْ هُمْ فِي لَبْسٍ مِّنْ خَلْقٍ جَدِيدٍ

Did We fail in the first creation? But they are in confusion over a new creation.

In another verse. 2:42: Surat Al-Baqarah (The Cow) - سورة البقرة

وَلَا تَلْبِسُوا الْحَقَّ بِالْبَاطِلِ وَتَكْتُمُوا الْحَقَّ وَأَن  تُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ

And do not mix the truth with falsehood or conceal the truth while you know [it].

6.        Raib رَيب : A doubt which has an element of compulsion in it. Raibud dahr  رَيبُ الدَّهر means cycle of life(the way it moves) hawaadis se zamana & raib ul manoon  رَيبُ المَنٌون meaning the dangers of life. Raib رَيب is such a doubt which creates confusion. They say, دَع مَا يُريبَكَ اَلى مَا لاَ يُريبَكَ        leave that thing that creates confusion in mind.That control or authority that has no confusion/restlessness. Reeba رِيبَة means anxiety.

Allah says in the Quran: 41:35: Surat Fuşşilat (Explained in Detail) - سورة فصلت

وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنَا مُوسَى الْكِتَابَ فَاخْتُلِفَ فِيهِ ۗ وَلَوْلَا كَلِمَةٌ سَبَقَتْ مِن رَّبِّكَ لَقُضِيَ بَيْنَهُمْ ۚ وَإِنَّهُمْ لَفِي شَكٍّ مِّنْهُ مُرِيبٍ

And We had already given Moses the Scripture, but it came under disagreement. And if not for a word that preceded from your Lord, it would have been concluded between them. And indeed they are, concerning the Qur'an, in disquieting doubt.

In another verse: 2:2 : Surat Al-Baqarah (The Cow) - سورة البقرة

ذَٰلِكَ الْكِتَابُ لَا رَيْبَ ۛ فِيهِ ۛ هُدًى لِّلْمُتَّقِينَ

This is the Book about which there is no doubt, a guidance for those conscious of Allah –

 

Summary:

1.        Shakk  شَكّ: inability to give preference to one view because of lack of knowledge

2.        Shubah   شُبه  : confusion between some things because of the similarity in qualities/characteristics.

3.        Mirya مِرية  : to make a truth /fact doubtful by saying/spreading doubtful things.

4.        Lubs لَبس : To mix up two things in such a way that it becomes difficult to differentiate between them.

5.        Mareej مَرِيج : to be confused because of the fact that views /thoughts keep on changing in priority.one thought looks important initially, then the other thought seems important, & then again the initial thought becomes important. Hence the confusion.

6.        Raib رَيب : A doubt with the element of both anxiety & in quietude.

11. Face & features:
Haeya    هَية  ,shakal   شَكل   , soorat   صُورت  , tamaseel    تماثيل   are the words used in the Quran.
1.            Haeya    هَية  : the first sketch of something. May it be in the mind or on paper/real/in substance.hiya   هِية   & haeya   هَية  means the situation,feeling or face or features.
In the Quran:3:49: Surat 'Āli `Imrān (Family of Imran) -   سورة آل عمران
وَرَسُولًا إِلَىٰ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ أَنِّي قَدْ جِئْتُكُم بِآيَةٍ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ   ۖ   أَنِّي أَخْلُقُ لَكُم مِّنَ الطِّينِ كَهَيْئَةِ الطَّيْرِ فَأَنفُخُ فِيهِ فَيَكُونُ طَيْرًا بِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ   ۖ   وَأُبْرِئُ الْأَكْمَهَ وَالْأَبْرَصَ وَأُحْيِي الْمَوْتَىٰ بِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ   ۖ   وَأُنَبِّئُكُم بِمَا تَأْكُلُونَ وَمَا تَدَّخِرُونَ فِي بُيُوتِكُمْ   ۚ   إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَةً لَّكُمْ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
And [make him] a messenger to the Children of Israel, [who will say], 'Indeed I have come to you with a sign from your Lord in that I design for you from clay [that which is] like the form of a bird, then I breathe into it and it becomes a bird by permission of Allah . And I cure the blind and the leper, and I give life to the dead - by permission of Allah . And I inform you of what you eat and what you store in your houses. Indeed in that is a sign for you, if you are believers.
2.            Shakal    شَكل   : mushakila   مُشاكِلَة    means resembling someone. Ishkaal   اشكال   means complications arising in a matter in such a way that many similar looking views emerge. Mushkil   مُشكل   is one such complicated issue. Shakal al amar    شَكَلَ الامر   means to  resemble & shakl    شَكل   maeans resemblance,example & ashkaal   اشكال   means gold/silver ornaments/jewels that look like one another.
Allah says in the Quran: 38:58: Surat Şād (The Letter "Saad") -   سورة ص
وَآخَرُ مِن شَكْلِهِ أَزْوَاجٌ
And other [punishments] of its type [in various] kinds.
3.            Soorat   صُورت   : It means the external features of something with which it can be recognised & differentiated from others.
Allah says in the Quran :82:8 : Surat Al-'Infiţār (The Cleaving) -   سورة الإنفطار
فِي أَيِّ صُورَةٍ مَّا شَاءَ رَكَّبَكَ
In whatever form He willed has He assembled you.
4.            Tamsaal    تَمثال   : (plural –tamaseel    تماثيل  ) masul   مَثُل   means to copy the looks/features of someone else & pretend to be someone else(someone copied) . Mumassal   مُمَثَّل   means such a thing that can be made as per the model. Tamassal   تَمَثَّل   means to copy someone,pretend to be someone. Tamsaal    تَمثال   means picture,face, or statue of someone.
Allah says in the Quran: 21:52: Surat Al-'Anbyā' (The Prophets) -   سورة الأنبياء
إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِ مَا هَٰذِهِ التَّمَاثِيلُ الَّتِي أَنتُمْ لَهَا عَاكِفُونَ
When he said to his father and his people, "What are these statues to which you are devoted?"
Summary:
1.            Haiyat   هَية   : rough sketch of something. May it be in mind or on paper.(physical)
2.            Shakal: things that resemble one another/look like one another
3.            Soorat:external/prominent features of something/someone
4.            Tamsaal    تَمثال  : copy of something original.(picture,photo,statute etc)

12. To make/draw /paint face:
Sawwara   صَوَّرَ   ,khalaqa   خَلَقَ   ,tamassal   تَمَثَّل    are the words used in the Quran
1.            Sawwara    صَوَّرَ   : Means to draw/paint face. This word is specifically used for making face of living things which is a characteristic of Allah.
Allah says in the Quran: 3:6: Surat 'Āli `Imrān (Family of Imran) -   سورة آل عمران
هُوَ الَّذِي يُصَوِّرُكُمْ فِي الْأَرْحَامِ كَيْفَ يَشَاءُ ۚ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ
It is He who forms you in the wombs however He wills. There is no deity except Him, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
2.            Khalaqa   خَلَقَ   : To make initial marks of features on clay/material before finalising/completing the model.
Allah says in the Quran : 22:5: Surat Al-Ĥaj (The Pilgrimage) -   سورة الحج
يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ إِن كُنتُمْ فِي رَيْبٍ مِّنَ الْبَعْثِ فَإِنَّا خَلَقْنَاكُم مِّن تُرَابٍ ثُمَّ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ ثُمَّ مِنْ عَلَقَةٍ ثُمَّ مِن مُّضْغَةٍ مُّخَلَّقَةٍ وَغَيْرِ مُخَلَّقَةٍ لِّنُبَيِّنَ لَكُمْ ۚ وَنُقِرُّ فِي الْأَرْحَامِ مَا نَشَاءُ إِلَىٰ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى ثُمَّ نُخْرِجُكُمْ طِفْلًا ثُمَّ لِتَبْلُغُوا أَشُدَّكُمْ ۖ وَمِنكُم مَّن يُتَوَفَّىٰ وَمِنكُم مَّن يُرَدُّ إِلَىٰ أَرْذَلِ الْعُمُرِ لِكَيْلَا يَعْلَمَ مِن بَعْدِ عِلْمٍ شَيْئًا ۚ وَتَرَى الْأَرْضَ هَامِدَةً فَإِذَا أَنزَلْنَا عَلَيْهَا الْمَاءَ اهْتَزَّتْ وَرَبَتْ وَأَنبَتَتْ مِن كُلِّ زَوْجٍ بَهِيجٍ
O People, if you should be in doubt about the Resurrection, then [consider that] indeed, We created you from dust, then from a sperm-drop, then from a clinging clot, and then from a lump of flesh, formed and unformed - that We may show you. And We settle in the wombs whom We will for a specified term, then We bring you out as a child, and then [We develop you] that you may reach your [time of] maturity. And among you is he who is taken in [early] death, and among you is he who is returned to the most decrepit [old] age so that he knows, after [once having] knowledge, nothing. And you see the earth barren, but when We send down upon it rain, it quivers and swells and grows [something] of every beautiful kind.
3.            Tamassal   تَمَثَّل    : To change ones own features & pretend to be someone.
Allah says in the Quran:19:17: Surat Maryam (Mary) -   سورة مريم
فَاتَّخَذَتْ مِن دُونِهِمْ حِجَابًا فَأَرْسَلْنَا إِلَيْهَا رُوحَنَا فَتَمَثَّلَ لَهَا بَشَرًا سَوِيًّا
And she took, in seclusion from them, a screen. Then We sent to her Our Angel, and he represented himself to her as a well-proportioned man.

raw_text:
13. Gap/break/rift:
Futoor    فُطُور   & furooj    فُرُوج   are the words used.
1.           Futoor فُطُور : fatara  فَطَرَ to tear or rip something length-wise (longitudinally) . Inafatar  اِنفَطَر  means rip apart.(usmani) So, Futoor  فُطُور is such a gap whose breadth is quite less as compared to its length.(crack,break)
Allah says in the Quran: 67:3 : Surat Al-Mulk (The Sovereignty) -   سورة الملك
الَّذِي خَلَقَ سَبْعَ سَمَاوَاتٍ طِبَاقًا ۖ مَّا تَرَىٰ فِي خَلْقِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ مِن تَفَاوُتٍ ۖ فَارْجِعِ الْبَصَرَ هَلْ تَرَىٰ مِن فُطُورٍ
[And] who created seven heavens in layers. You do not see in the creation of the Most Merciful any inconsistency. So return [your] vision [to the sky]; do you see any breaks?
2.            Furooj    فُرُوج   : faraj    فَرج    means expansion,wider area. It does not mean tearing or ripping of something. Faraja   فَرَجَ   means to expand, to open or to make loose. i.e expanding amongst two things or between two parts of one thing. Faraj ul tareeq    فَرج الطريق    means the middle of a path, a hole, or a gap which is there in its structure originally or happened afterwards.
Allah says in the Quran: 50:6 : Surat Qāf (The Letter "Qaf") -   سورة ق

الَّذِي خَلَقَ سَبْعَ سَمَاوَاتٍ طِبَاقًا ۖ مَّا تَرَىٰ فِي خَلْقِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ مِن تَفَاوُتٍ ۖ فَارْجِعِ الْبَصَرَ هَلْ تَرَىٰ مِن فُطُورٍ

1.             مدينة   –   مدن   –   to stay, to reside in a town and   تمدن   (  tamaddana)   means to be civilised, well behaved (MJD) and   مدينة     means a town where people stay collectively under some rules and regulations. (plural    مدائن  )
In Surah Yaseen: (36:20):
وَجَاءَ     مِنْ     أَقْصَى     الْمَدِينَةِ     رَجُلٌ     يَسْعَىٰ
And there came from the farthest end of the city a man, running.
2.                بلد  -   a place which has a boundary  and people stay there   (MF) plural   بلاد
In Surah al-Balad: (90:1):
لَا     أُقْسِمُ     بِهَٰذَا     الْبَلَدِ
I swear by this city, Makkah -
3.                 مصر  - means boundary   (plural   مصور     ) It is said   اشتري     فلان     الدار     بمصورها    - that man has bought the house within these boundaries and      مصر  means headquarters (which has a boundary) and according to some      مصر  means town/city where the wealth of war booty and  charity is distributed (ML), and according to some it means a walled city, also in the Quran it is a name of a country.
In Surah Baqarah: (2:61):
اهْبِطُوا     مِصْرًا     فَإِنَّ     لَكُم     مَّا     سَأَلْتُمْ
Go into [any] settlement and indeed, you will have what you have asked."
4.                ديار  -  ( singular   دار   and plural   دور   )   دور     means something been surrounded by all four sides, and   دار   means   house, dwelling and   دير    means   house of a worshipper and   دار   is   directly related to residence , the connotations are quite wide, it can be used for village, settlement, town, city and country.   دارالحرب   means the country of the enemy.   دارالقرار   means hereafter,   دارالدنيا   house of this world, all world. So when the [time of] promise came for the first of them, We sent against you servants of Ours - those of great military might, and they probed [even] into the homes,

وَتِلْكَ     الْقُرَىٰ     أَهْلَكْنَاهُمْ     لَمَّا     ظَلَمُوا

وَتِلْكَ الْقُرَىٰ أَهْلَكْنَاهُمْ لَمَّا ظَلَمُوا وَجَعَلْنَا لِمَهْلِكِهِم مَّوْعِدًا

Zujaaja    زُجَاجَة  ,qawareer     قَوارير   are the words used.
1.            Zujaaja    زُجَاجَة   :means glass,(piece of glass) . It can be used for both piece of glass or for a container made of glass.  Az zujaaji    الزُّجَاجى   means glass seller. Zijaajah     زِجاجة   means glass making skill/art. (glass making or making something from glass) zujaajah    زُجَاجَة   means that glass which is clear & one can see through it.
As per the Quran: 24:35 : Surat An-Nūr (The Light) -   سورة النور
اللَّهُ نُورُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ   ۚ   مَثَلُ نُورِهِ كَمِشْكَاةٍ فِيهَا مِصْبَاحٌ   ۖ   الْمِصْبَاحُ فِي زُجَاجَةٍ   ۖ   الزُّجَاجَةُ كَأَنَّهَا كَوْكَبٌ دُرِّيٌّ يُوقَدُ مِن شَجَرَةٍ مُّبَارَكَةٍ زَيْتُونَةٍ لَّا شَرْقِيَّةٍ وَلَا غَرْبِيَّةٍ يَكَادُ زَيْتُهَا يُضِيءُ وَلَوْ لَمْ تَمْسَسْهُ نَارٌ   ۚ   نُّورٌ عَلَىٰ نُورٍ   ۗ   يَهْدِي اللَّهُ لِنُورِهِ مَن يَشَاءُ   ۚ   وَيَضْرِبُ اللَّهُ الْأَمْثَالَ لِلنَّاسِ   ۗ   وَاللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِيمٌ
Allah is the Light of the heavens and the earth. The example of His light is like a niche within which is a lamp, the lamp is within glass, the glass as if it were a pearly [white] star lit from [the oil of] a blessed olive tree, neither of the east nor of the west, whose oil would almost glow even if untouched by fire. Light upon light. Allah guides to His light whom He wills. And Allah presents examples for the people, and Allah is Knowing of all things.
2.            Qawaareer    قَوارير   : means a drink.or a bowl/container where one keeps dates/dried dates. In medical terminology, it also means a bottle/container which is used for taking urine sample. Qaroora    قاروره    means all the glass which is made for any use. Allah says in the Quran: 76:16: Surat Al-'Insān (The Man) -   سورة الانسان
قَوَارِيرَ مِن فِضَّةٍ قَدَّرُوهَا تَقْدِيرًا
Clear glasses [made] from silver of which they have determined the measure.
Summary:
1.            Zujaaja     زُجَاجَة   :glass which is see through
2.            Qawareer     قَوارير  : All the glass made for any use. May it be clear or coloured.(with or without design)

2.            Evening times  :
Rawaah     رَوَاح  , aseel    اَصِيل   ,Asheeya   عَشِيَّا   ,amsaa     اَمسى   are the words used.
1.                        Rawaah     رَوَاح   : This time starts after zuhr namaz. Its opposite Ghudduwa   غُدُوّ   ,ghuddwa     غُدوة   &  alghuduu wa alrawah   الغدو والرواح    means first & last (earlier & last time)time –means starting of the time & its end.
As per the Quran: 34:12 : Surat Saba' (Sheba) -   سورة سبإ
وَلِسُلَيْمَانَ الرِّيحَ غُدُوُّهَا شَهْرٌ وَرَوَاحُهَا شَهْرٌ ۖ وَأَسَلْنَا لَهُ عَيْنَ الْقِطْرِ ۖ وَمِنَ الْجِنِّ مَن يَعْمَلُ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِ ۖ وَمَن يَزِغْ مِنْهُمْ عَنْ أَمْرِنَا نُذِقْهُ مِنْ عَذَابِ السَّعِيرِ
And to Solomon [We subjected] the wind - its morning [journey was that of] a month - and its afternoon [journey was that of] a month, and We made flow for him a spring of [liquid] copper. And among the jinn were those who worked for him by the permission of his Lord. And whoever deviated among them from Our command - We will make him taste of the punishment of the Blaze.
2.                        Aseela   اَصِيل   : (Asaal    اصال   -plural) :Time starting after Asr prayers.Its oppositre is Bukra     بُكرَة
Allah says in the Quran: 76:25: Surat Al-'Insān (The Man) -   سورة الانسان
وَاذْكُرِ اسْمَ رَبِّكَ بُكْرَةً وَأَصِيلًا
And mention the name of your Lord [in prayer] morning and evening
3.                        Asheeya     عَشِيَّا   : The time of Ashee    عشى   starts before sunset. Its opposite is ishraaq    اشراق    & ghudoo   غُدُوّ    & sometimes even bukraa   بُكرَة   . Look at the examples below:
a )  Surat Ghāfir (The Forgiver) -   سورة غافر   (40:46)
النَّارُ يُعْرَضُونَ عَلَيْهَا غُدُوًّا وَعَشِيًّا ۖ وَيَوْمَ تَقُومُ السَّاعَةُ أَدْخِلُوا آلَ فِرْعَوْنَ أَشَدَّ الْعَذَابِ
The Fire, they are exposed to it morning and evening. And the Day the Hour appears [it will be said], "Make the people of Pharaoh enter the severest punishment."
b) Surat Al-'An`ām (The Cattle) -   سورة الأنعام   (6:52)
وَلَا تَطْرُدِ الَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ رَبَّهُم بِالْغَدَاةِ وَالْعَشِيِّ يُرِيدُونَ وَجْهَهُ ۖ مَا عَلَيْكَ مِنْ حِسَابِهِم مِّن شَيْءٍ وَمَا مِنْ حِسَابِكَ عَلَيْهِم مِّن شَيْءٍ فَتَطْرُدَهُمْ فَتَكُونَ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ
And do not send away those who call upon their Lord morning and afternoon, seeking His countenance. Not upon you is anything of their account and not upon them is anything of your account. So were you to send them away, you would [then] be of the wrongdoers.
c) Surat 'Āli `Imrān (Family of Imran) -   سورة آل عمران   (3:41)
قَالَ رَبِّ اجْعَل لِّي آيَةً ۖ قَالَ آيَتُكَ أَلَّا تُكَلِّمَ النَّاسَ ثَلَاثَةَ أَيَّامٍ إِلَّا رَمْزًا ۗ وَاذْكُر رَّبَّكَ كَثِيرًا وَسَبِّحْ بِالْعَشِيِّ وَالْإِبْكَارِ
He said, "My Lord, make for me a sign." He Said, "Your sign is that you will not [be able to] speak to the people for three days except by gesture. And remember your Lord much and exalt [Him with praise] in the evening and the morning."
The time for Isha starts from night(when the sky is dark) to mid night.
Allah says in the Quran: 24:58: Surat An-Nūr   (The Light)   -     سورة النور
يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لِيَسْتَأْذِنكُمُ الَّذِينَ مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَانُكُمْ وَالَّذِينَ لَمْ يَبْلُغُوا الْحُلُمَ مِنكُمْ ثَلَاثَ مَرَّاتٍ ۚ مِّن قَبْلِ صَلَاةِ الْفَجْرِ وَحِينَ تَضَعُونَ ثِيَابَكُم مِّنَ الظَّهِيرَةِ وَمِن بَعْدِ صَلَاةِ الْعِشَاءِ ۚ ثَلَاثُ عَوْرَاتٍ لَّكُمْ ۚ لَيْسَ عَلَيْكُمْ وَلَا عَلَيْهِمْ جُنَاحٌ بَعْدَهُنَّ ۚ طَوَّافُونَ عَلَيْكُم بَعْضُكُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُبَيِّنُ اللَّهُ لَكُمُ الْآيَاتِ ۗ وَاللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌ
O you who have believed, let those whom your right hands possess and those who have not [yet] reached puberty among you ask permission of you [before entering] at three times: before the dawn prayer and when you put aside your clothing [for rest] at noon and after the night prayer. [These are] three times of privacy for you. There is no blame upon you nor upon them beyond these [periods], for they continually circulate among you - some of you, among others. Thus does Allah make clear to you the verses; and Allah is Knowing and Wise.
The word amsaa    اَمسى    if is used for evening times.
4.                        Amsaa    اَمسى    : masaa    مسا   meaning evening. Amsaa     اَمسى   means reach evening or do something in the evening & its opposite is asbaah   اَصبَح   . Meaning to reach morning or do something in the morning.
Allah says in the Quran: 30:17: Surat Ar-Rūm   (The Romans)   -     سورة الروم
فَسُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ حِينَ تُمْسُونَ وَحِينَ تُصْبِحُونَ
So exalted is Allah when you reach the evening and when you reach the morning.

raw_text:
3.Probable/May be:
Asa   عَسى    & la ‘alla   لَعَلَّ    are the words used.
1.Asa   عَسى   : it is from af’aal muqarba   أفعال المقاربة   (verb of approach & hope) & it is indeclinable/frozen. It is only used with Madi (   ماضي   past) & not used with mudari (  مضارع   present/future)
It is used for ‘Hope’ amongst desired things & for ‘fear’ amongst hated/disliked things. For example, amongst desired/favourable things, it is used for dominating hope.
As per the Quran: 28:22: Surat Al-Qaşaş (The Stories) -   سورة القصص
وَلَمَّا تَوَجَّهَ تِلْقَاءَ مَدْيَنَ قَالَ عَسَىٰ رَبِّي أَن يَهْدِيَنِي سَوَاءَ السَّبِيلِ
And when he directed himself toward Madyan, he said, "Perhaps my Lord will guide me to the sound way."
& ‘fear’  amongst the prohibited/disliked things.
Allah says in the Quran: 47:22 : Surat Muĥammad (Muhammad) -   سورة محمد
فَهَلْ عَسَيْتُمْ إِن تَوَلَّيْتُمْ أَن تُفْسِدُوا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَتُقَطِّعُوا أَرْحَامَكُمْ
So would you perhaps, if you turned away, cause corruption on earth and sever your [ties of] relationship?

4.Alcohol/Intoxicants:
Khamr   خَمر   ,maeen   مَعِين   ,raheeq   رَحيق    are the words used for alcohol in the Quran:
1.            Khamr    خَمر   : Its a noun for Alcohol. Khamara    خَمَرَ   means to cover. & khimaar    خِمار   means some fabric used for covering (scarf/dupatta)-used to cover face etc. Alcohol is called khamar    خَمر   because it covers the wisdom or mind /thinking of a person.
Allah says in the Quran: 5:90 : Surat Al-Mā'idah (The Table Spread) -   سورة المائدة
يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا إِنَّمَا الْخَمْرُ وَالْمَيْسِرُ وَالْأَنصَابُ وَالْأَزْلَامُ رِجْسٌ مِّنْ عَمَلِ الشَّيْطَانِ فَاجْتَنِبُوهُ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ
O you who have believed, indeed, intoxicants, gambling, [sacrificing on] stone alters [to other than Allah ], and divining arrows are but defilement from the work of Satan, so avoid it that you may be successful.
2.            Maeen    مَعِين   : ma’anal maa    مَعَنَ الماء   means water flowing slowly on the ground. Maanan nazar fel amar    مَعَنَ النَّظر فى الامر    means think deeply on some matter. Maeen    مَعِين   is such a water that is sweet,delicious & clean & clear.
Allah says in the Quran: 67:30: Surat Al-Mulk (The Sovereignty) -   سورة الملك
قُلْ أَرَأَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَصْبَحَ مَاؤُكُمْ غَوْرًا فَمَن يَأْتِيكُم بِمَاءٍ مَّعِينٍ
Say, "Have you considered: if your water was to become sunken [into the earth], then who could bring you flowing water?"
But the word kaas   كَاس   , when used in the above aayat makes the meaning of maeen    مَعِين   as pleasant alcohol. Such alcohol which is devoid of unpleasant effects of khamr    خَمر    . Because kaas   كَاس    is used generally used for a glass /container filled with alcohol & even for alcohol.
As Allah says in the Quran:56:18: Surat Al-Wāqi`ah (The Inevitable) -   سورة الواقعة
بِأَكْوَابٍ وَأَبَارِيقَ وَكَأْسٍ مِّن مَّعِينٍ
With vessels, pitchers and a cup [of wine] from a flowing spring
2.            Raheeq   رَحيق   : Means pure,clear &  pleasant smelling alcohol.(which is clear of any particles)
Allah says in the Quran:83:25: Surat Al-Muţaffifīn (The Defrauding) -   سورة المطففين
يُسْقَوْنَ مِن رَّحِيقٍ مَّخْتُومٍ
They will be given to drink [pure] wine [which was] sealed.
Summary:
1. Khamar   خَمر   : alcohol that makes one lose his control/mind.It is used for all kinds of alcohol.
2. Maeen   مَعِين   : Pleasant tasting & smelling drink which is devoid of all impurities & which will be given in heaven .
3. Raheeq   رَحيق    : the best quality/type of drink ,fragrant & delicious available in heaven.

5: To be shy:
Istahyaa    اِستِحيا   , istankaf    اِستَنكَف   are the words used in the Quran.
1.            Istahyaa   اِستِحيا   :hiya   حَيِى   , yahyaa   يحي   ,hayaat    حيوةً   means to be alove. He   حي   ,yahyee   يحى   ,haya   حياء   means to be embarrassed or ashamed or be shy.baab istafaal istahya    باب استفعال استحيا   is derived from both the words & means to leave someone alive or to be shy of someone.Both these meanings are used in the Quran.istahya    استحيا   means to be shy or be reluctant.It is both used for meaning & material.
The example of the material use of this word  is:
As per the Quran:28:25: Surat Al-Qaşaş (The Stories) -   سورة القصص
فَجَاءَتْهُ إِحْدَاهُمَا تَمْشِي عَلَى اسْتِحْيَاءٍ قَالَتْ إِنَّ أَبِي يَدْعُوكَ لِيَجْزِيَكَ أَجْرَ مَا سَقَيْتَ لَنَا ۚ فَلَمَّا جَاءَهُ وَقَصَّ عَلَيْهِ الْقَصَصَ قَالَ لَا تَخَفْ ۖ نَجَوْتَ مِنَ الْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ
Then one of the two women came to him walking with shyness. She said, "Indeed, my father invites you that he may reward you for having watered for us." So when he came to him and related to him the story, he said, "Fear not. You have escaped from the wrongdoing people."
When this word is used for its meaning,then the following is a good example:
As per the Quran:6:26: Surat Al-Baqarah (The Cow) -   سورة البقرة
إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يَسْتَحْيِي أَن يَضْرِبَ مَثَلًا مَّا بَعُوضَةً فَمَا فَوْقَهَا ۚ فَأَمَّا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا فَيَعْلَمُونَ أَنَّهُ الْحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّهِمْ ۖ وَأَمَّا الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا فَيَقُولُونَ مَاذَا أَرَادَ اللَّهُ بِهَٰذَا مَثَلًا ۘ يُضِلُّ بِهِ كَثِيرًا وَيَهْدِي بِهِ كَثِيرًا ۚ وَمَا يُضِلُّ بِهِ إِلَّا الْفَاسِقِينَ
Indeed, Allah is not timid to present an example - that of a mosquito or what is smaller than it. And those who have believed know that it is the truth from their Lord. But as for those who disbelieve, they say, "What did Allah intend by this as an example?" He misleads many thereby and guides many thereby. And He misleads not except the defiantly disobedient,
2.            Istinkaf   اِستَنكَف   : Nakif    نَكِف   means show attitude. And istankaf    اِستَنكَف   means to think of something as having little value because one is proud or thinks very high of himself.
Allah says in the Quran: 4:172: Surat An-Nisā' (The Women) -   سورة النساء
لَّن يَسْتَنكِفَ الْمَسِيحُ أَن يَكُونَ عَبْدًا لِّلَّهِ وَلَا الْمَلَائِكَةُ الْمُقَرَّبُونَ ۚ وَمَن يَسْتَنكِفْ عَنْ عِبَادَتِهِ وَيَسْتَكْبِرْ فَسَيَحْشُرُهُمْ إِلَيْهِ جَمِيعًا
Never would the Messiah disdain to be a servant of Allah , nor would the angels near [to Him]. And whoever disdains His worship and is arrogant - He will gather them to Himself all together.
Summary
Istahya    اِستِحيا   means someone being shy because of shame & istankaf    اِستَنكَف   is a disliked verb which means to be reluctant,to think of something as having less value because of undue pride.

6.To start/initiate:
Bada’a   بَدَاَ    & tafiqa    طَفِقَ    are the words used.
1.            Bada’a    بَدَاَ   : It has two meanings. a ) to start something. To initiate/inaugurate. B) to do something first.(give something priority. If this is associated to Allah, then it means to do it first time.
Allah says in the Quran: 12:76 Surat Yūsuf (Joseph) -   سورة يوسف
فَبَدَأَ بِأَوْعِيَتِهِمْ قَبْلَ وِعَاءِ أَخِيهِ ثُمَّ اسْتَخْرَجَهَا مِن وِعَاءِ أَخِيهِ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ كِدْنَا لِيُوسُفَ ۖ مَا كَانَ لِيَأْخُذَ أَخَاهُ فِي دِينِ الْمَلِكِ إِلَّا أَن يَشَاءَ اللَّهُ ۚ نَرْفَعُ دَرَجَاتٍ مَّن نَّشَاءُ ۗ وَفَوْقَ كُلِّ ذِي عِلْمٍ عَلِيمٌ
So he began [the search] with their bags before the bag of his brother; then he extracted it from the bag of his brother. Thus did We plan for Joseph. He could not have taken his brother within the religion of the king except that Allah willed. We raise in degrees whom We will, but over every possessor of knowledge is one [more] knowing.

7.Private parts:
Farj    فَرج  ,sau’a     سَوءَة   are the words used.
1.            Farj    فَرج   (plural farooj   فُرُوج   ).farj      فَرج   has the idea of expansion in it. Faraja    فَرَجَ   means to open,expand,to loosen. & farj   فَرج   means the width/expansion between two things or two parts of one thing. Farj ul tareeq     فرج الطريق    means the middle part of a path. The gap in a wall is also called farj    فَرج  . The space when one expands legs. This word is used for private parts as well & since it was used so often, it started to be thought as its real & only meaning.
Allah says in the Quran: 23:5: Surat Al-Mu'minūn (The Believers) -   سورة المؤمنون
وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ لِفُرُوجِهِمْ حَافِظُونَ
And they who guard their private parts
2.            Sau’a    سَوءَة   : everything which is bad or looks bad as per wisdom or shariah.. For this reason, if  private parts  or satr(body parts which are to covered as per shariah) are exposed, then it is called sau’a   سَوءَة  . & sau’a    سَوءَة   does not only apply to private parts but also to the other body parts that are supposed to be covered. (body of a female,her breasts) when they are exposed.
As Allah says in the Quran: 7:26: Surat Al-'A`rāf (The Heights) -   سورة الأعراف
يَا بَنِي آدَمَ قَدْ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَيْكُمْ لِبَاسًا يُوَارِي سَوْآتِكُمْ وَرِيشًا ۖ وَلِبَاسُ التَّقْوَىٰ ذَٰلِكَ خَيْرٌ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ مِنْ آيَاتِ اللَّهِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَذَّكَّرُونَ
O children of Adam, We have bestowed upon you clothing to conceal your private parts     and as adornment. But the clothing of righteousness - that is best. That is from the signs of Allah that perhaps they will remember.

So he made them fall, through deception. And when they tasted of the tree, their private parts became apparent to them, and they began to fasten together over themselves from the leaves of Paradise. And their Lord called to them, "Did I not forbid you from that tree and tell you that Satan is to you a clear enemy?"
Similarly, sau’a    سَوءَة   is also used for a human dead body if it is not buried for sometime after death. (as it becomes sore to the eyes because it gets mutilated/rotten.)
Allah says in the Quran: 5:31: Surat Al-Mā'idah (The Table Spread) -   سورة المائدة
فَبَعَثَ اللَّهُ غُرَابًا يَبْحَثُ فِي الْأَرْضِ لِيُرِيَهُ كَيْفَ يُوَارِي سَوْءَةَ أَخِيهِ ۚ قَالَ يَا وَيْلَتَا أَعَجَزْتُ أَنْ أَكُونَ مِثْلَ هَٰذَا الْغُرَابِ فَأُوَارِيَ سَوْءَةَ أَخِي ۖ فَأَصْبَحَ مِنَ النَّادِمِينَ
Then Allah sent a crow searching in the ground to show him how to hide the disgrace of his brother. He said, "O woe to me! Have I failed to be like this crow and hide the body of my brother?" And he became of the regretful.
Summary:
1.            Farj   فَرج   : the gap between two things. Or private parts of the body
2.            Sau’a   سَوءَة   : if private parts are exposed or any thing that does not look nice to the eys or is not allowed/appropriate when exposed is called sau’a   سَوءَة   .

8. Partner:
Khaleet   خَليط    , shareeq     شَريك    & andaadan    اَندادً   are the words used.
1.            Khaleet   خَليط    . This means to mix/combine one thing with another. (opposite khalas    خلص  ) Al-khalt    اَلخَلط   means a social person. Al –khult    اَلخُلط    means partnership. Khaleet   خَليط    are those people who have same interests. Meaning the participants that have some individual interests & some common interests. An example would be that X & Y own one flock of sheep each but have rented one place to keep them (combined rental) or have kept one shepherd to take care of both the flocks & pay him together. So such partners like X & Y are called khaleet   خَليط    . As per hadeeth, zakat is to be calculated & deducted from the combined wealth of khaleet   خَليط    .
As per Quran: 38:24: Surat Şād (The Letter "Saad") -   سورة ص
قَالَ لَقَدْ ظَلَمَكَ بِسُؤَالِ نَعْجَتِكَ إِلَىٰ نِعَاجِهِ   ۖ   وَإِنَّ كَثِيرًا مِّنَ الْخُلَطَاءِ لَيَبْغِي بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ إِلَّا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ وَقَلِيلٌ مَّا هُمْ   ۗ   وَظَنَّ دَاوُودُ أَنَّمَا فَتَنَّاهُ فَاسْتَغْفَرَ رَبَّهُ وَخَرَّ رَاكِعًا وَأَنَابَ
[David] said, "He has certainly wronged you in demanding your ewe [in addition] to his ewes. And indeed, many associates oppress one another, except for those who believe and do righteous deeds - and few are they." And David became certain that We had tried him, and he asked forgiveness of his Lord and fell down bowing [in prostration] and turned in repentance [to Allah ]
2.            Shareeq   شَريك   : Meaning partners that cannot be separated from each other. Partnership could be material or meaningful. Material in the situation when two persons are partners in a business & the absence of causes disruption in the business. In other words business cannot be carried on if one partner is absent.
In this context, Allah says: 17:111: Surat Al-'Isrā' (The Night Journey) -   سورة الإسراء
وَقُلِ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي لَمْ يَتَّخِذْ وَلَدًا وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُ شَرِيكٌ فِي الْمُلْكِ وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُ وَلِيٌّ مِّنَ الذُّلِّ ۖ وَكَبِّرْهُ تَكْبِيرًا
And say, "Praise to Allah , who has not taken a son and has had no partner in [His] dominion and has no [need of a] protector out of weakness; and glorify Him with [great] glorification."
& the example of  meaningful partnership would be between horses & humans. They both share the characteristic of  beastliness.(     حيوانيت  ). Allah is devoid of these characteristics. As has been proved by many aayats.
3.            Andaadan   اَندادً   : (its the plural of nidd    نِدّ   ) . It means to detest/hate  & run away. Naadah    نَدّ   means he opposed..It also means to be a partner in someones quality or personality. So Nidd    نِدّ    does not mean partner, but actually means opponent. Meaning , some or all qualities of one are present in the other/others.(Nazeer   نظير   -means example/misaal    مثال  ). Means opponent as well as competitor.
Allah says in the Quran : (2:22) : Surat Al-Baqarah (The Cow) -   سورة البقرة
الَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الْأَرْضَ فِرَاشًا وَالسَّمَاءَ بِنَاءً وَأَنزَلَ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً فَأَخْرَجَ بِهِ مِنَ الثَّمَرَاتِ رِزْقًا لَّكُمْ ۖ فَلَا تَجْعَلُوا لِلَّهِ أَندَادًا وَأَنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
[He] who made for you the earth a bed [spread out] and the sky a ceiling and sent down from the sky, rain and brought forth thereby fruits as provision for you. So do not attribute to Allah equals while you know [that there is nothing similar to Him].
Summary:
1.            Khaleet    خَليط    :temporary partner.
2.            Shareeq   شَريك   : Have complete partnership in something
3.            Nadd    نَدّ   : partner in personality or characteristics. Opponent or competitor.

3.        Andaadan اَندادً : (its the plural of nidd  نِدّ ) . It means to detest/hate  & run away. Naadah  نَدّ means he opposed..It also means to be a partner in someones quality or personality. So Nidd  نِدّ  does not mean partner, but actually means opponent. Meaning , some or all qualities of one are present in the other/others.(Nazeer نظير -means example/misaal  مثال). Means opponent as well as competitor.

 

Allah says in the Quran : (2:22) : Surat Al-Baqarah (The Cow) - سورة البقرة

الَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الْأَرْضَ فِرَاشًا وَالسَّمَاءَ بِنَاءً وَأَنزَلَ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً فَأَخْرَجَ بِهِ مِنَ الثَّمَرَاتِ رِزْقًا لَّكُمْ ۖ فَلَا تَجْعَلُوا لِلَّهِ أَندَادًا وَأَنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ

[He] who made for you the earth a bed [spread out] and the sky a ceiling and sent down from the sky, rain and brought forth thereby fruits as provision for you. So do not attribute to Allah equals while you know [that there is nothing similar to Him].

Summary:

 

1.        Khaleet  خَليط  :temporary partner.

2.        Shareeq شَريك : Have complete partnership in something

3.        Nadd  نَدّ : partner in personality or characteristics. Opponent or competitor.

9. Flame:
Lahab    لَهَب  ,shawaaz   شَواظ   ,nuhhaas   نُحَّاس   ,maarij    مَارِّج   & sharar    شَرَر   are the words used in the Quran.
1.            Lahab   لَهَب  : This means movement of the flame/fire & get higher.in other words,high flame. It is a commonly used word for flame.
Allah says in the Quran: (111:3) : Surat Al-Masad (The Palm Fiber, Flame) -   سورة المسد
سَيَصْلَىٰ نَارًا ذَاتَ لَهَبٍ
He will [enter to] burn in a Fire of [blazing] flame
2.            Shawaaz   شَواظ  /Nuhhaas   نُحَّاس   : Shawaaz    شَواظ   is such a flame that does not have smoke with it. & when some smoke accompanies that flame, then it is termed as Nuhhaas    نُحَّاس  .(provided smoke is less than fire/fire is higher & has some smoke with it). It is called Nuhhaas   نُحَّاس   because the colour of the flame is more like copper.(Nuhhaas   نُحَّاس   means copper)
Allah says in the Quran:55:35: Surat Ar-Raĥmān (The Beneficent) -   سورة الرحمن
يُرْسَلُ عَلَيْكُمَا شُوَاظٌ مِّن نَّارٍ وَنُحَاسٌ فَلَا تَنتَصِرَانِ
There will be sent upon you a flame of fire and smoke, and you will not defend yourselves.
3.            Maarij   مَارِّج   : The highest point of flame ,which is extremely hot & is without any smoke. Or engulfed/surrounded by fire.
Allah says in the Quran: 55:15: Surat Ar-Raĥmān (The Beneficent) -   سورة الرحمن
وَخَلَقَ الْجَانَّ مِن مَّارِجٍ مِّن نَّارٍ
And He created the jinn from a smokeless flame of fire.
4.            Sharar    شَرَر   : small particles of fire coming off a bigger/higher fire/flame. Sparks.(tiny bright material that flies up of something that is burning)
Allah says in the Quran: 77:32: Surat Al-Mursalāt (The Emissaries) -   سورة المرسلات
إِنَّهَا تَرْمِي بِشَرَرٍ كَالْقَصْرِ
Indeed, it throws sparks [as huge] as a fortress,
Summary
1.            Lahab    لَهَب  : Commonly used word for flame.
2.            Shuwaaz   شَواظ   : smokeless flame
3.            Nuhhaas   نُحَّاس   : fire with smoke(provided smoke is less than fire)
4.            Maarij   مَارِّج   : the highest & hottest part of flame.
5.            Sharar    شَرَر   : tiny particles flying from something burning/spark.

81:15-16 (surah 81 at takweer,verse 15-16)

10. Taraashnaa تراشنا (To Trim/Cut/Carve)
Also known as ‘nahata’   نَحَتَ   and ‘jaaba’   جَابَ   (jwb   جوب  ) in the Holy Quran.
1.          Nahata   نَحَتَ  : It refers to the peeling, abrading or carving of hard and solid objects such as wood, stone or metal etc. ‘Nuhataah’   نُحَاتَه   refers to the clippings or the trimmed pieces.
Allah Taa’la says:
Surah As Saffat (Those who set the Ranks)   سُوۡرَةُ الصَّافات
(37:95)
أَتَعۡبُدُونَ مَا تَنۡحِتُونَ
“He said,   "Do you worship that which you [yourselves] carve,”
It is evident that these idols were made out of stone, wood or metal. In another location, Allah Taa’la says:
Surah Al Araf (The Heights)   سُوۡرَةُ الاٴعرَاف
(7:75)
وَتَنۡحِتُونَ ٱلۡجِبَالَ بُيُوتً۬ا‌ۖ
“And remember when He made you successors after the 'Aad and settled you in the land, [and]   you take for yourselves palaces from its plains and carve from the mountains, homes.   Then remember the favors of Allah and do not commit abuse on the earth, spreading corruption."
2.          Jaaba   جَابَs  : To cut or crop. It also refers to making a hole or a slit/fissure and then carving and peeling it to accuracy. In addition, for a delicate and meticulous job, the word ‘nahata’   نَحَتَ   is more appropriate, whereas for a heavy duty job, the word ‘jaaba’   جَابَ   is suitable.
Allah Taa’la says:
Surah Al Fajr (The Dawn)   سُوۡرَةُ الفَجر
(89:9)
وَثَمُودَ ٱلَّذِينَ جَابُواْ ٱلصَّخۡرَ بِٱلۡوَادِ
“And [with] Thamud, who carved out the rocks in the valley?”
Conclusion:
(1)       Nahata   نَحَتَ  : To carve and peel; commonly used for delicate tasks.
(2)     Jaaba   جَابَ  : To cut, drill into, and peel. It is associated with heavy duty tasks.
For ‘targheeb dena’   ترغیب     دینا   (To Encourage/Persuade), see ‘ubhaarna’   ابھارنا   (Boost/instigate/stimulate)

11. Tarkaari ترکاری (Vegetables)
Also known as ‘Qadab’   قَضَب   and ‘Baqal’   بَقَل   in the Holy Quran.
1.          Qadab   قَضَب  : It refers to the vegetable that is consumed when it is freshly picked. According to Sahb Mufardaat and Muntahi-Al-Arab, it also includes the fresh grass. (one that is the diet of cattle) In addition, Sahb tafseer Muhammadi in reference to Mu’aalim Al-tanzeel, has described ‘Qadab’   قَضَب   as any such green vegetable that has its green leaves, the herbage (food for cattle) grown outwardly on the ground and the useful and valuable part (food for human) is grown under the ground. For example, carrots, radishes, turnips, beetroots etc.
Allah Taa’la says:
Surah Abasa (He Frowned)   سُوۡرَةُ عَبَسَ
(80:27-29)
فَأَنۢبَتۡنَا فِيہَا حَبًّ۬ا (  ﻿  ٢٧  ﻿  ) وَعِنَبً۬ا وَقَضۡبً۬ا (  ﻿  ٢٨  ﻿  ) وَزَيۡتُونً۬ا وَنَخۡلاً۬
“And caused to grow within it grain; And grapes and herbage; And olive and palm trees”
2.          Baqal   بَقَل  : According to Imam Raaghib, it refers to those vegetables whose roots and shoots do not survive in the winters. According to Sahb Muntahi-al-Arab, it refers to all the vegetables that neither grows from a seed, nor a root. For example, sugarcane etc. But the most reasonable and sensible meaning of ‘baqal’   بَقَل   is one that refers to any kind of vegetable. ‘Baqaal’   بَقَال   is referred to the vegetable vendor that sells all kinds of vegetables.
In the Holy Quran,
Surah Al Baqarah (The Cow)   سُوۡرَةُ البَقَرَة
(2:61)
فَٱدۡعُ لَنَا رَبَّكَ يُخۡرِجۡ لَنَا مِمَّا تُنۢبِتُ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ مِنۢ بَقۡلِهَا
“And [recall] when you said, "O Moses, we can never endure one [kind of] food. So   call upon your Lord to bring forth for us from the earth its green herbs and its cucumbers and its garlic and its lentils and its onions."   [Moses] said, "Would you exchange what is better for what is less? Go into [any] settlement and indeed, you will have what you have asked." And they were covered with humiliation and poverty and returned with anger from Allah [upon them]. That was because they [repeatedly] disbelieved in the signs of Allah and killed the prophets without right. That was because they disobeyed and were [habitually] transgressing.”

12. Tasbeeh-o-Taqdees (Pakeezgi Byan Kerna) تسبیح و تقدیس - پاکیزگی بیان کرنا [To Praise and to Sanctify] (To Glorify the Purity/Holiness)
Also known as ‘Sabbah’   سَبَّحَ  , ‘Qaddasa’   قَدَّسَ   and ‘Haasha’   حَاشَ   in the Holy Quran.
1.          Sabbah   سَبَّحَ  : To praise. To recite Subhan Allah or to mention Subhan Allah. It refers to describe the qualities in the language of the being that is free and clean from all defects, faults and weaknesses. In addition, it means to praise the features and the qualities of this being in a positive manner. (For details, see ‘Paak’   پاک   (Pure)).
2.         Qaddasa   قَدَّسَ  : Quddus   قُدُّوس   is a name of Allah Taa’la. It refers to the being that is free from the dependencies and reliance of others. 13. Taskeen (Tasalli) تسکین - تسلّی [Satisfaction – Assurance]
Also known as ‘Sakinah’   سَكِينَةٌ   and ‘Itma-inna’   اِطمَئِنَّ  .
1.          Sakinah   سَكِينَةٌ  : Peace and tranquility. The calmness after an activity or a movement. This kind of calmness could be manifested physically, mentally or spiritually. If it is manifested mentally or spiritually, then it is referred to as ‘sakinah’   سَكِينَةٌ  ; which implies the heart finds salvation from worries, sorrows and grief and acquires composure.
Allah Taa’la says:
Surah At Tawbah (The Repentance)   سُوۡرَةُ التّوبَة
(9:40)
إِذۡ يَقُولُ لِصَـٰحِبِهِۦ لَا تَحۡزَنۡ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مَعَنَا‌ۖ فَأَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ سَڪِينَتَهُ ۥ عَلَيۡهِ
“If you do not aid the Prophet - Allah has already aided him when those who disbelieved had driven him out [of Makkah] as one of two  , when they were in the cave and he said to his companion, "Do not grieve; indeed Allah is with us." And Allah sent down his tranquility upon him   and supported him with angels you did not see and made the word of those who disbelieved the lowest, while the word of Allah - that is the highest. And Allah is Exalted in Might and Wise.”
2. Itma-inna   اِطمَئِنَّ  : To gain satisfaction and contentment. In addition it means to gain composure, equanimity and tranquility after quite a lot of uncertainty, confusion, doubts and suspicions.
Allah Taa’la says:
Surah Al Baqarah (The Cow)   سُوۡرَةُ البَقَرَة
(2:260)
قَالَ أَوَلَمۡ تُؤۡمِن‌ۖ قَالَ بَلَىٰ وَلَـٰكِن لِّيَطۡمَٮِٕنَّ قَلۡبِى‌ۖ
“And [mention] when Abraham said, "My Lord, show me how You give life to the dead."   [ Allah ] said, "Have you not believed?" He said, "Yes, but [I ask] only that my heart may be satisfied."   [ Allah ] said, "Take four birds and commit them to yourself. Then [after slaughtering them] put on each hill a portion of them; then call them - they will come [flying] to you in haste. And know that Allah is Exalted in Might and Wise."
Conclusion:
(1)       Sakinah   سَكِينَةٌ  : To find salvation and peace from grief and sorrows.
(2)     Itma-inna   اِطمَئِنَّ  : To find composure after uncertainty and doubts.

14. Taa’beer batlana تعبیر بتلانا (To Interpret/Decipher)
Also known as ‘Abara’   عَبَرَ  , ‘Awwala’   اَوَّلَ   and ‘Afta’   اَفتَى   in the Holy Quran.
1.          Abara   عَبَرَ  : It means to cross a valley or a canal. ‘Ibarata ar-ru’ya’   عِبَرَةَ     ارُّؤيَا   and ‘abbara-ru’ya’   عَبَّرَالرُّؤيَا   mean to interpret a dream. ‘Abbaar’   عَبَّار   means the person who interprets the dream. ‘Al-ibrah wal i’tibaar’   اَلعِبرَة     وَالاِعتِبَار   means to reach an unseen conclusion by means of seen things. By ‘  Tabeer’تعبیر   ‘interpretation’, the reference is towards telling the outcome of a dream.
In the Holy Quran,
Surah Yusuf (Joseph)   سُوۡرَةُ یُوسُف
(12:43)
إِن كُنتُمۡ لِلرُّءۡيَا تَعۡبُرُونَ
“And [subsequently] the king said, "Indeed, I have seen [in a dream] seven fat cows being eaten by seven [that were] lean, and seven green spikes [of grain] and others [that were] dry. O eminent ones, explain to me my vision,   if you should interpret visions.  "
2.          Awwala   اَوَّلَ  : (Taweel)   تاویل   It means to return something to its ending or final limit. This word comes in range with interpretation since the meaning of ‘Taweel’   تاویل   absolutely, is declaring the consequence or outcome of something; whether it is a dream or something else. However, the word ‘Tabeer’   تعبیر  , (interpretation) is exclusive for interpreting the outcomes of dreams. According to Sahb Fruq Al-laghwiyah, ‘Taweel’   تاویل   can only be done with analogous and homologous entities.
Allah Taa’la says:
Surah Yusuf (Joseph)   سُوۡرَةُ یُوسُف
(12:36)
وَقَالَ ٱلۡأَخَرُ إِنِّىٓ أَرَٮٰنِىٓ أَحۡمِلُ فَوۡقَ رَأۡسِى خُبۡزً۬ا تَأۡكُلُ ٱلطَّيۡرُ مِنۡهُ‌ۖ نَبِّئۡنَا بِتَأۡوِيلِهِۦۤ‌ۖ
“And there entered the prison with him two young men. One of them said, "Indeed, I have seen myself [in a dream] pressing wine."   The other said, "Indeed, I have seen myself carrying upon my head [some] bread, from which the birds were eating. Inform us of its interpretation;   indeed, we see you to be of those who do good."
3.          Afta   اَفتَى  : It means to explain a solution or an answer to a very difficult and complex problem. ‘Fatuwaa’   فَتُوَى   is a Shari’ah (Islamic) terminology, which refers to offering a solution to a complex problem abiding by the laws of Islam (Shari’ah). ‘Istaftaa’   استفتاء   means to ask a scholar regarding a problem of a complex nature. In the Holy Quran, the word ‘Aftaa’   اَفتَى   has appeared only in the context where the dream that required interpretation, was itself a complicated and a complex one.
In the Holy Quran,
Surah Yusuf (Joseph)   سُوۡرَةُ یُوسُف
(12:43)
يَـٰٓأَيُّہَا ٱلۡمَلَأُ أَفۡتُونِى فِى رُءۡيَـٰىَ
“And [subsequently] the king said, "Indeed, I have seen [in a dream] seven fat cows being eaten by seven [that were] lean, and seven green spikes [of grain] and others [that were] dry.   O eminent ones, explain to me my vision,   if you should interpret visions."
It was this complex dream that these interpreters put off and labeled as ‘Idghaathu Ahlaam’   اضغاثُ     احلام  . It was then that the freed partner of Yusuf (Aleh Assalam) (Joseph) said,
Surah Yusuf (Joseph)   سُوۡرَةُ یُوسُف
(12:46)
يُوسُفُ أَيُّہَا ٱلصِّدِّيقُ أَفۡتِنَا فِى سَبۡعِ بَقَرَٲتٍ۬ سِمَانٍ۬
“[He said], "  Joseph, O man of truth, explain to us about seven fat cows   eaten by seven [that were] lean, and seven green spikes [of grain] and others [that were] dry - that I may return to the people; perhaps they will know [about you]."
Conclusion:
(1)       Abara   عَبَرَ   and Tabeer   تعبیر  : These words are specifically used to explain the outcome and consequence of a dream.
(2)     Taweel   تاویل  : To tell the end result of an event that can also include a dream.
(3)      Afta   اَفتَى  : To offer an explanation of a solution of a complex problem that can also include the interpretation of a dream.
