{
Synonyms: HAMD,SHUKR
1 HAMD(حَمد):to describe someone's those good qualities and virtues which are voluntary actions.for example if someone does charity so it is a voluntary action. If one is praised for this then it will be called HAMD and if it's involuntary for example if a person is of good height or handsome or belongs to a noble family then it has no effort or contribution from that person.so if someone praised him for these qualities then it will be called MADH(مدح).The antonym is ZIMM(ذمّ) meaning to describe flaws in some person whether voluntary or involuntary. so HAMD is specific than MADH.MADH can be for voluntary or involuntary quality but HAMD is only applicable to voluntary actions.
Surat 'Ali `Imran [3:188] - The Noble Qur'an
وَّيُحِبُّونَ أَن   يُحْمَدُوا   بِمَا لَمْ يَفْعَلُوا
and like to be   praised   for what they did not do
and for ALLAH,MADH is not suitable because all the actions of ALLAH are voluntary as well as favourite
Surat Al-Fatihah [1:1] - The Noble Qur'an
الْحَمْدُ   لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ

16. To respect/honour:
Azzam     عَظَّم  & waqqar    وَقَّر   are the words used.
1.            Azzam   عَظَّم   : Azm   عَظم   means grow as well as bone. i.e Azm   عَظم   has the meaning of  being grown up/big as well as strength and hardness. Azzam    عَظَّم   means to think of someone as respectful & respect/honour the by heart. It is used for both living as well as non-living things.
Allah says in the Quran:22:32: Surat Al-Ĥaj (The Pilgrimage) -   سورة الحج
ذَٰلِكَ وَمَن يُعَظِّمْ شَعَائِرَ اللَّهِ فَإِنَّهَا مِن تَقْوَى الْقُلُوبِ
That [is so]. And whoever honors the symbols of Allah - indeed, it is from the piety of hearts.
2.            Waqqar    وَقَّر    : Waqaar    وقار   means glory/grandeur and seriousness. According to people of vocabulary,it eans seriousness as well as knowledge. Ibn e Faaris also writes its meaning as al hilm war razanat    الحلم والرّزانة  . Waqqar     وَقَّر   means to give respect /honour someone with a status/knowledge & do not do anything against his will. This word is only used for people.
As per Quran: 48:9: Surat Al-Fatĥ (The Victory) -   سورة الفتح

That you [people] may believe in Allah and His Messenger and honor him and respect the Prophet and exalt Allah morning and afternoon.
Summary:
Azzam    عَظَّم   is a common word whereas Waqqar     وَقَّر   is only used for people/humans.

raw_text:
17: To/until:
Ilaa    اِلى   & hatta   حتَّى   are the words used.
Both these words describe the limit/peak of something.& are both used for time & space. Following is the difference between them.
1.            Ilaa   اِلى   : It enters /or is used with attached pronoun. Like for example ilaikum.   اِليكُم   & in this way, it would give the meaning of ‘towards’. But hatta  is used only with assumed/visible noun & becomes possessed noun & cannot be used with attached pronoun. It enters with noun or verb.
Like in the Quran: 2:55: Surat Al-Baqarah (The Cow) -   سورة البقرة
وَإِذْ قُلْتُمْ يَا مُوسَىٰ لَن نُّؤْمِنَ لَكَ حَتَّىٰ نَرَى اللَّهَ جَهْرَةً فَأَخَذَتْكُمُ الصَّاعِقَةُ وَأَنتُمْ تَنظُرُونَ
And [recall] when you said, "O Moses, we will never believe you until we see Allah outright"; so the thunderbolt took you while you were looking on.
2.            Hatta  حتَّى   : To describe gate & end of something, hatta   حتَّى   is more widely used/told than ilaa    اِلى  . Hatta al aan   حتَّى الان   can be said/used but ilaal aan    اِلى الان   cannot be said. Ilaa    اِلى   describes ‘to’ whereas hatta    حتَّى  means ‘to’ and ‘until’ as explained in the  example above.

19 = having or giving Trouble/Difficulty    تكليف اتهانا
اَذًى , اذى , يُوْذِي ,and ضَرّ , ضُرّ , يَضُرّ and from كُرْهاً  to اَكْرَهَ , يُكْرِهُ have been     used to give the meaning of trouble and inconvenience in Quran. اذي , يوذي are narrated previously now rest of the examples are as follows;
1-  وَلَا تكون كَالذين اذو مُوسى
Like those who abused Moses         (33:69)
2- و إِن تَصبِرو و تّتقو لَا يَضروكم كيدوهم شيَا
If you are patient and fear Allah, their plot will not harm you at all.         (3:120)
And ضَار (يضَار) means to hurt one another trouble or harm each other, Quran says;
لَا تضَار وَالدة بِوَالدِهَا وَلَامولودله بوَالده
No mother should be harmed through her child, and no father through his child. And upon the [father's] heir is [a duty] like that [of the father].          (2:233)
3- كُرهُ Means forced drudgery and اكرة   means involving some one in some kind of hardship/exertion which is against his will /nature.
Forcing some one to do something which he is not willing to do. Allah SWT says;
وَلَاتُكرِهُو فَتَىتِكُمٌ عَلَى الْبِغاءِ
And do not compel your slave girls to prostitution.  (24:33)
Other than this, كَلفَ   شق  عَنَتَ  and سَام  are used in the similar way.
4-Kallafa كَلفَ : means utilizing something beyond its capacity, or obliging on  something harder to follow, Allah SWT says;
لآيُكلِفُ اللهُ نفْساً اِلآ وُسْعَها
Allah does not charge a soul except [with that within] its capacity.  (2:286)
And trouble is both liked and imposed/disgraceful. Liked trouble is, doing a thing in such a way that it becomes easier for him and also becomes one of the loved tasks, and this very thing is illegal botheration. Disgraceful trouble is called fakery, meaning pretence/dramatizing of trouble.
5- شق means tearing apart شق, شقَّmeaning utilizing some one more then he could put his efforts into ,or involving some one in hard labour.Quran says;
وَ مآ اُرِيدُ انْ اشقَّ عَليكَ
And I do not wish to put you in difficulty.  (28:27)
6- عَنَتَ being in such a trouble which could lead to assassination, meaning extreme harm or great difficulty. Allah talah says;
ياايُهاَالْذِيْنَ امَنُوْ لآ تَتَّخِذُوْا بِطَانَةً مِنْ دُوْنِكُمْ لآ يَاْلُوْنَكُمْ خُباَلاً وَدُّوْا ماَ عَنِتُمْ
O you who have believed, do not take as intimates those other than yourselves, for they will not spare you [any] ruin. They wish you would have hardship. (3:118)
And اعُنَتَ means imposing some one trouble. Allah SWT says;
وَلو شآءَاللهُ
لَاَعْنَتِكُم
And if Allah had willed, He could have put you in difficulty  .   (2:220)
7- سَامَ means harming some one and سَامَخَسُفأ is an idiom which means demoralizing some one, سَامَ means such a trouble which is also embarrassing and undermining the morale, سَامَ depicts a trouble which involves dishonoring and discomposure. Quran says;
يَسومُونَكُمْ سُوْءالعذابِ يذبِحونَ اَبْناءَكُمْ وَ يَسْتَحْيُونَ نِسآءَكُمْ
People of Pharaoh, who afflicted you with the worst torment, slaughtering your [newborn] sons and keeping your females alive.  (2:49)
Summary:
1-          اذي     Azza           For minor suffering, mental or physical.
2-          ضَرَ    Zarra         Major trouble and mishap.
3-          اكرة    Akra           Forced suffering, torture.
4-          تَكليف    Taklef       Utilizing according to capacity.
5-          مشقَ         mashaq     Utilizing beyond capacity
6-          عَنَتَ     Aanata      a kind of trouble which leads to killings.
7-          سَامَ          Samaa       A kind of trouble which is demoralizing to one’s character.

raw_text:
20= To be/Make healthy   تندرست كرنا/ هونا
For this  شفاء   and اَبْرَءَ have been used,
1-               شفاء means getting rid of an illness, being composed, and means getting cured from a disease ,making some one healthy, Quran says;
وَاِذَا مَرِضتُ فَهُوَ يَشفِين
And when I fall sick, You are one who cure me .
and the way شَفى   is used for bodily diseases, it also been used for illnesses of soul and its relief, Allah SWT says;
وَ يَشْفِ صُدُورَ قَوْمٍ مُومِنِينْ
and satisfy the breasts of a believing people        (9:14 )
2-   اَبْرَءَ        means discontented/dissatisfied and بُرَءُ  means getting rid of something detestable and  رَجُلُ بَرِىُ  means pious and righteous man, and بَرَءَ مِنَ الْمَرضْ   means getting healed, getting cured from an illness and  اَبْرَءَ الْمَرِيْض        means giving sufferer/patient relief from his illness.Quran says;
وَ اُبرِىءٌ الْاَكْمَهَ وَالْاَبْرَصَ وَاُخِي الْمَوْتى بِاِذنِ الله
And I cure the blind and the leper, and I give life to the dead - by permission of Allah. (3:49)
3- اَفَاقَ   means coming back to conscious state after being in an state of unconscious/doped OR regaining strength from a feeble condition of health and according to lexicographers, اَفَاقَ   word is used only for becoming conscious from an unconscious state, Allah SWT says;
فَلَمَّا تَجَلّى رَبُّه ُلِلْجَبَلِ جَعَلُهُ دَكَّا وَ خَرَّ مُوسى صَعِقاً -فَلَمآ اَفَاقَ قَالَ سُبحنَكَ
And when Moses arrived at Our appointed time and his Lord spoke to him, he said, "My Lord, show me [Yourself] that I may look at You." [ Allah ] said, "You will not see Me, but look at the mountain; if it should remain in place, then you will see Me." But when his Lord appeared to the mountain, He rendered it level, and Moses fell unconscious. And when he awoke, he said, "Exalted are You! I have repented to You   (7:143)
Summary  :
Shafaa     شَفى     Getting cured from an ailment.
Abraaa     اَبْرَءَ        Becoming conscious from an unconscious state
Aafaqa     اَفَاقَ   Getting rid from an extreme illness

raw_text:
Miskeen – Poverty
Quran has used the words Faqr, Maskana, A'elah, Imlaaq, Qatr, Ba'saa and Matrabah.
1- Faqr
It means poverty and Fiqrah means vertebra from the backbone and its plural is Fiqaar. Fiqrah is also used for severity that is back breaking. 'Faqrat hud-dahiyah' means that such a severe situation befall him that it left him back broken. So, Faqr means back breaking poverty.
“  If they should be poor, Allah will enrich them from His bounty   ” 24:32
2- Maskana
Miskeen is a person who barely has means for everyday survival.. According to another opinion, Miskeen is a person who is living in poverty but he doesn't own anything, meaning he doesn't even have a place to live. Linguists have always differed in their opinion over who is financially weaker, Faqir or Miskeen but in the opinion of the Quran, a Faqir is more deserving.
“  Zakah expenditures are only for the poor and for the needy “ 9:60
In the above aayah, the occurance of the word Faqir before Miskeen is an argument in favour of this opinion and the following aayah shows that Miskeen can own.
“  The boat belonged to the poor people who used to work at the river” 18:80
3- A'elah
A'elah or A'ol is everything that is a burden on a person. Ayal mean those people for whom one is responsible to spend on and A'elah is the poverty resulting from such responsibility. Allah says:
“  And if you fear poverty than if Allah willed, He will make you rich with his bounty” 9:38
4- Imlaaq
Imlaaq doesn't mean poverty itself but it means the fear of loosing everything by spending all of it. It is said that 'Amla qadahru ma lahu' meaning the time made his riches slip away from him and Amlaq means the slipping away of the riches.
Allah says:
“  And do not kill your offspring for fear of poverty” 17:31
The same meaning is implied in another aayah using 'Khashyata infaaq'.
5- Qatr
It has been used in the Quran in the meaning of stinginess. For example,
“  But give them [a gift of] compensation - the wealthy according to his capability and the poor according to his capability - a provision according to what is acceptable“ 2:236
But the linguists say that it means spending on ones family with miserliness and it has been ussed so in Quran too.
“  And [they are] those who, when they spend, do so not excessively or sparingly but are ever, between that, [justly] moderate” 25:67
6- Ba'saa
Bi'sa and Yaba'sa mean dire neediness and Ba'saa means war, calamity and hunger. Ba'saa is commonly used to depict adversity and its antonym is Sara'a which means prosperity and favour. Ba'saa also means a calamity that also brings along fear.
“  And feed the miserable and the poor” 22:28
Similarly in 2:214, Ba'saa means advesity and Daraa means other afflictions.
7- Matrabah
Turab means dry soil. 'Tarib ar-rajul' (Tarban, Matraba) means a person who is so poor and worthless as dirt. It says in the Quran:
“  Or feeding on a day of severe hunger or a needy person in misery” 90:14-16
Inference
1- Faqr:   Severe and extreme poverty
2- Maskanat:   Hardly making ends meet
3- A'elah:   Buried under the burden of responsibility
4- Imlaaq:   Fear of poverty
5- Qatr:   Stinginess in spending on family
6- Ba'saa:   Times of adversity
7- Matrabah:   Being miserable because of poverty

raw_text:
22- Indigence   تنگي
For this عُسر حَرَج ضَنْكَ ضَيْق حَاجَة have been used,
1-                عُسر Usrun : means time of need, needy, destitution, and extreme difficulties be it economical or other wise. This word is commonly used and its antonym is  يُسر means ease, prosperity, contentment. Allah SWT says;
اِنِّ مَعَ الْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا
Indeed, with hardship [will be] ease. (94:6)
2- حَرَج Haraj : Congestion in the heart, suffocation because of undue restrictions
وَمَا جَعَلَ عَلَيْكُمْ فِي الْدِيْنِ مِنْ حَرَج
and has not placed upon you in the religion any difficulty  (22:78)
3- ضَنْكَ Zanka : means difficulties in day to day lives, discontentment of the heart, stressed, ضناكة   means suffocated life.
وَمَنْ اَعْرَضَ عَنْ ذِكْرِي فَاِنَ لَهُ مَعِيشَة ًضَنْكاً
And whoever turns away from My remembrance - indeed, he will have a depressed life, (20:124)
4- ضَيْق Zayq : is used for the shortage of the place of living, and its antonym is distention ,spacious. Almighty Allah says in the Quran;
اِذآ اُلْقُوا مِنْهاَمَكَاناً ضَيِقاً
And when they are thrown into a narrow place (25:13)
Some times its opposite comes as رَحُب   as well like;
حَتى اِذَا ضَاقَتْ عَلَيهَمُ الْاَرْضُ بِماَ رَحُبَت
that the earth closed in on them in spite of its vastness, ( 9:118)
Then on other times   ضَيْق   is used for حَرَج , that is, suffocation of the heart, this also imply the meaning for ضَيْق   , such as,
وَلاَ تَكُ فِي ضَيْقٍ مِّمَّا يَمْكُرُونْ
And do not grieve over them and do not be in distress over what they conspire.  (16:127)
5-                   حَاجَة Hajja : الحوج  means dependency, starvation ,poverty, and حاج  means to be dependent ,need, needy –Such hopeless feeling which is produced because of unfulfilled wishes or need, Allah SWT says;
وَلاَ يَجِدُونَ فِى صُدُورِهِمْ حَاجَةً مِمآ اُوتُو
They love those who emigrated to them and find not any want in their breasts. (59:9)
Summary:
1-   Usra   عسر: For the time of need
2-   Haraja   حَرَج Discontentment of the heart
3-  Zanka   ضَنْكَ Problems and stresses of life
4-  Zayq   ضَيْق Shortage of space
5-Hajja حَاجَة  Unsatisfied because of not getting what is desired or needed.

raw_text:
23  -   Irritated / Annoyed / Bugging   تنگ كرنا /هونا
For this ضَاَقَ  قَدَرَ  قَبِضَ   حَصِرَ  حَفاَ are used in the Quran ;
1-                 ضَاَقَ is used for the little space
2- قَدَرَ   Basically weighing the pros and cons of a situation or a matter, taking care of it and doing something about it. But when this word is related to provision رزق then it is interpreted as shortage of it. Its opposite/antonym is abundance. Allah SWT says;
اَللهُ يَبْسُطُ الرِّزْقُ لِمَنْ يَّشآءُ مِنْ عِباَدِهِ وَ يَقْدِرُه لَه
Allah extends provision for whom He wills of His servants and restricts for him. (29:62)
3- قَبِضَ   means holding something with your entire palm, holding tightly within the fist, and squeezing it. And قبضة means fist and something held inside it. Antonym is it is بسط as well. And قَبِضَ    is used when minimizing or limiting a thing which was in abundance once, whether its provision or something else of a sort. Allah talah says;
مَن ذَالْذِيْ يَقرِضُ اللهُ قَرضَاً حَسَناً فَيُضعِفَهُ لَهُ اَضْعَافاً كَثِيرَةً وَاللهُ يَقِبضُ وَ َيْبسُطُ
Who is it that would loan Allah a goodly loan so He may multiply it for him many times over? And it is Allah who withholds and grants abundance (2:245)
4- حَصِرَ means shortage of resources, and حصرارجال means ,to talk hesitantly, splutter, anxiety, angst ,inarticulate.
اِلَّا الَّذِيْنَ يَصِلُونَ اِلَى قَومٍ بَيْنَكُمْ وَ بَيْنَهُمْ مِيثاَقُ اَوْ جَآوُكُمْ حَصِرَت صُدُورَهُم اَنْ يُقاَتُلُوكُمْ اَوْ يُقاَتُلُوكُم قَومَهُم
Except for those who take refuge with a people between yourselves and whom is a treaty or those who come to you, their hearts strained at [the prospect of] fighting you or fighting their own people.  (4:90)
5- حَفاَ meaning of حَفاَ is to exaggerating and repeating in asking something, and حَفِيُّ means knowing about something thoroughly inside out, Exaggeration in expressing gratitude, respect and joy.
And this constant habit of continually asking with exaggeration and repetition, it becomes bothersome and this is what it is meant by this word.
اِنْ يَسْءَلْكُمُوهَافَيُحْفِكُم تَبْخَلُو
If He should ask you for them and press you, you would withhold. (47:37)
Summary  :
Zaaqa   ضَاَقَ Shortage/congestion of the place
Qadara   قَدَرَ Shortage of provision رزق if it is related with this.
Qabaza   قَبِضَ  if related to provision then   to shrink .
Hasira   حَصِرَ Anxiety, suffocation of the heart (feeling)
Haffa   حَفاَ Bothering/irritating some one by constantly asking about something.

24-Breaking   تورنا
For this نَكَثَ, نَقَضَ, انْقَضَ, فَقَرَ, جَدَّ are used in the Quran.
1- نَكَثَ means tearing something made of weave, and نَكَثَ
Means unknotting a blanket or a camp cloth to weave/knit it again and is a person who disjoint something joint already, or something which is woven, it is often used for breaking promises, commitments, means breaking a promise, disobeying an obligation.
اَلاَ تُقَاتِلُونَ قَوْماً نَكَثُوآ اَيماَنَهُم
Would you not fight a people who broke their oaths (9:12)
2- نَقَضَ means falling apart, and its antonym is ابرم  meaning strengthening some issue/matter and this word is more common then نكث  like نقضت البنا   means demolishing some building, الْعَظمُ   breaking bone  , العقد untying a Knott,
Similarly نقضت الحبل        means straightening the curves of a rope then    نَقَضَis above then نكث  and this is used for breaking a firmly determined promise or commitment .Allah SWT says;
وَاَوفُو بِعَهدِاللهِ اِذاَ عَاهَدّْتُمْ وَلاَ تَنقُضُوا الْاَيْمَانَ بَعدَ تَوكِيدِهاَ
And fulfill the covenant of Allah when you have taken it, [O believers], and do not break oaths after their confirmation (16:91)
And at another place it is written as
اَلذِينَ يَنقُضُونَ عَهدِاللهَ مِن بَعدِ مِيثاَقِه
Who break the covenant of Allah after contracting it (2:27)
3- انْقَضَ means breaking something in a way that it would produce a loud sound, then it was started applying on different occasions, for example  اَنقَضَتِ الْدُجاَجَه   meaning a chicken producing sound while laying eggs   اَلاَدِيم leather squishing sound   اَنقَضَ اَصَابِعَهُ   means cracking the knuckles, اَنقَضَ اَلْحَمَلُ اَلْظُهَر        means having so much weight on the shoulders that it would start to hurt. Almighty Says;
وَوَضَعناَ عَنكَ وِزرَك الَّذِي اَنقَضَ ظَهرَك
And We removed from you your burden,   Which had weighed upon your back (94:3)
4- فَقَرَ this word is taken from انْقَضَ which is only used as breaking the back bone, however انْقَضَ
is very common, الفقرةُ  and الفِقرةُ  are used to call the base of the spinal cord which has whole in it, and its plural is فقار  and   فقرات .and  فقرالخرز means  to have a whole for sewing the beads through it.and فاقرةُ means such a misery which in turn would break the back bone/spinal cord.
وَوُجُوهُ يَومَءِذٍ ابَاسِرَةُ تَظُنُ اَنْ يُفعَلَ بِهاَ فَاقِرَه
And [some] faces, that Day, will be contorted,   Expecting that there will be done to them [something] backbreaking. (75:25)
5- جَدَّ breaking a hard thing into pieces.
Summary:
1-  Nakas  a  نَكَثَ :  Breaking or disobeying a promise or commitment etc, OR disjointing a thing which is   already joint .
2- Naqaza  نَقَضَ: Tearing something, falling apart, and breaking a firm decision or promise or spoiling it.
3-Anqaza  انْقَضَ: Breaking something in such a manner that it would produce a sound.
4-Faqara  فَقَرَ: Breaking the back bone
5-Jadda  جَدَّ: Breaking a hard thing into pieces.

raw_text:
25- Giving strength/ability   توفيق دينا /هونا
For this وَفَقَ   and اَوزَعَ        have been used in the Quran.
1- وَفَقَ means   harmony and compatibility between two things and        means to make suitable. And وَفَقَ الله   means   making a thing suitable for some one by Almighty Allah .He says;
اِن يُرِيدَآاِصلاَحاًيُوَفِّقِ اللهُ بَينَهُمَا
If they both desire reconciliation, Allah will cause it  between them. (4:35)
1-                 اَوزَعَ  وَزَعَ means to restrict, and وَزَعَ الجيش  means keeping the army in their line and length and وزَّعَ and اَوزَعَ  means to divide, derange and اَوزَعَ الشَّي  means to get revelation, and استوزع الله شكره  asking Allah for the ability of gratitude, thankfulness. And اوزع الله فلانا means Allah has given that some one the ability to be thankful for what he has, Allah Says;
قَاَلَ رَبِي اَوزِعنِي اَن اَشكُرَنِعمَتِكَ الَّتِي اَنعَمتَ عَليَّ وَ عَلى وَالِدَىَّ
My Lord, enable me to be grateful for Your favor which You have bestowed upon me and upon my parents. (46:15)
Summary  :
1-Wafaqa Allah وَ فَّقَ الله :  Allah making suitable/ favorable circumstances for some one .
2-Aao’za Allah  اَوزَعَ الله : Allah making some one’s heart to be convinced /inclined for some task.

title: content/t/t26.html
raw_text:
26-Layers /Over lapped   ته بر ته
For this طِباَق (طَبَق ) مركوم رُكَام  رُكَم  مُتَرَاكِبَاً  رَكَب نَضِيْد مَنضُودْ and كِسَف have been used.
1-               طَبَق Placing one thing over or besides another thing, so that they would fit together, making it looking equal in size. Allah SWT says;
اَلَّذِي خَلَقَ سَبْعَ سَمَواتٍ طِباَقاً
[And] who created seven heavens in layers. (67:3)
2-               رَكَمَ  means accumulation of something, heap, without any order, putting things together with out any manner or specific order, placing them left right centre and رُكام and مركوم  means layers of clouds. Allah SWT says ;
اَلَم تَرَاَنَّ اللهَ يُزجِيْ سَحاَباً ثُمَ يُوءَلِّفُ بَيْنَهُ ثُمَّ يَجْعَلُهُ رُكاَماً
Do you not see that Allah drives clouds? Then He brings them together, then He makes them into a mass. (24:43)
At other place it is Said;
وَ يَجْعَلَ الْخَبِيثَ بَعْضَهُ عَلي بَعْضٍ فَيَرْكُمَهُ جَمِيعاً
and place the wicked some of them upon others and heap them all together. (8:37)
3-               تراكب  : ركب means to take a ride, and ركييب means the back rider amongst the two .Or something which is conjoined like  pearls in the ring and تراكب means over lapping in such a way that there is some order or arrangement. And متراكب  means associated, adjoined, linked .Allah says;
فَاَخْرَجْناَ مِنْهُ خَضِراً نَخْرِجُ مِنْهُ حَباً مُتَرَاكِباً
We produce from it greenery from which We produce grains arranged in layers. (6:99)
4-               نَّضِيْد : نَضَدَ means gradually collecting a mass, or picking a quantity of something house hold stuff etc. and تنضدت اللنسان means arrangement of the teeth, meaning accumulating in such a way that it has some nice distinct arrangement. Allah SWT says;
وَانَّخْلُ يسِقتٍ لَهاَ طَلْعُ نَّضِيْد
And lofty palm trees having fruit arranged in layers – (59:10)
5-               كِسَف كِسْفَةُ means something feathery , like a cloud or cotton bud  ,whose plural is كِسْفُ  and كِسَفاً  are those feather like  pieces folded on top of each other, big or small.Allah SWT says;
اَللهُ اَّلذِي يُرسِلُ الِّريحَ فَتُثِيرُ سَحَاباً فَيَبسُطُهُ ِفي َالَّسمآءِ كَيْفَ يَشآءُ وَ يَجْعَلُهُ كِسَفاً
It is Allah who sends the winds, and they stir the clouds and spread them in the sky however He wills, and He makes them fragments.  (30:48)
Summary:
1-Tabaaq    طِباَق : Placing something above something, of same size.
2-Rakam    ركم : Accumulating things left right centre up down without any specific order.
3-Tarakib   تراكب : Placing things in a proper arrangement and in such a manner that they would join together.
4-Nazad   نَضَد :  Arranging things in a nice decorative manner.
5-Kisafa   كِسَف : Placing feathery matter .such as clouds, cotton buds
in layers.

اَللهُ اَّلذِي يُرسِلُ الِّريحَ فَتُثِيرُ سَحَاباً فَيَبسُطُهُ ِفي َالَّسمآءِ كَيْفَ يَشآءُ وَ يَجْعَلُهُ كِسَفاً

It is Allah who sends the winds, and they stir the clouds and spread them in the sky however He wills, and He makes them fragments.  (30:48)

 

 

 

 

Summary:

 

1-Tabaaq  طِباَق : Placing something above something, of same size.

 

2-Rakam  ركم : Accumulating things left right centre up down without any specific order.

 

3-Tarakib تراكب : Placing things in a proper arrangement and in such a manner that they would join together.

 

4-Nazad نَضَد :  Arranging things in a nice decorative manner.

 

5-Kisafa كِسَف : Placing feathery matter .such as clouds, cotton buds

 in layers.

27-Tired   تهكنا
سَءَمَ  ,نَصِبَ,  ,عَيَّ  لَغَبَ  ,حَسَرَ ادَ (اود) have been used for this ;
1-                سَءَمَ  Being disheartened or fed up of bearing a thing for a very long time, Fed up/annoyed/bored of doing a thing repeatedly, this would be initial phase of tiredness. Allah says;
لَا يَسءَمُ الْاِنساَنُ مِن دُعآءِ الْخَيرْ
Man is not weary of supplication for good [things]. (41:49)
2-                نَصَبَ means to bury, and if it is  علم يعلم then it would produce a reverse meaning, that is, a man cant keep his balance due to tiredness .To work really hard and tiredness, exhaustion, because of hard work. Quran says;
فَلَمّاَ جَاوَزَا قَالَ لِفَتهُ اتِنَا غَدَآءَناَ لَقَد لَقِيناَ مِن سَفَرِناَهَذاَ نَصَباً
So when they had passed beyond it, [Moses] said to his boy, "Bring us our morning meal. We have certainly suffered in this, our journey, [much] fatigue."  (18:62)
3-                 Getting weak and tired because of excessive hard work. Allah talah says;
وَ لَقَد خَلَقْناَالْسَموَاتِ وَالْاَرْضَ وَماَ بَيْنَهُماَ فِي سِتَّةِ اَيَّامٍ وَّماَ مَسَّناَ مِنْ لُغُوبٍ
And We did certainly create the heavens and earth and what is between them in six days, and there touched Us no weariness. (50:38)
4- عَيَّ Not being able to work more due to tiredness/ fatigue. اَلْعَيُّ  And اَلْعَيَّان   is called tired and دَاءُ عَياَءُ   , untreatable illness .Allah SWT says;
اَوَلَم يَرَوْا اَنَّ اللهَ الْذِيْ خَلَقَ الْسَموَاتِ وَالْاَرضَ وَلَم يَعْىَ بِخَلْقِهَنَّ
Do they not see that Allah , who created the heavens and earth and did not fail in their creation. (46:33)
5-   حَسَرَ is the next level to اَلْعَيَّ  that is, feeling so restricted to move because of tiredness/fatigue.
ثُمَّ اَرْجِعِ الْبَصَرَ خَاسِءًا وَّهُوَ حَسِيرْ
Then return [your] vision twice again. [Your] vision will return to you humbled while it is fatigued. (67:4)
1-               ادَ يَءُود  Real meaning is burden and being burdened, and due to which deviating from its path. And in common words, its meaning are getting tired because of burden. Allah SWT says;
وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ الْسَموَاتِ الْاَرْضَ وَلاَ يَءُدُهُ حِفضُهُماَ
His Kursi extends over the heavens and the earth, and their preservation tires Him not. (2:255)
Summary:
1-Sa’aa maa   سَءَمَ Getting bored of some task.
2-Nasaba   نَصِبَ   disorientation because of fatigue in the body.
3-Laghaba   لَغَبَ  Getting weak because of tiredness.
4-Aayaa   عَيَّ Not being able to work any more because of tiredness.
5-Hasara   حَسَرَ  Next level of tiredness and fatigue to عَيَّ
7-                Aadaa   ادَ  Getting tired because of burdens

28- Stop
Sakan   سَكَنَ   ,sakat, & rahwann are the words used.
1.            Sakan   سَكَنَ   : stopping after a movement is called sakoon   سكون   . Used for both obvious & for its meaning. Its opposite is harkat          حركت  & iztarab   اضطراب    .
Allah says in the Quran: ( 42:33): Surat Ash-Shūraá (The Consultation) -   سورة الشورى
إِن يَشَأْ يُسْكِنِ الرِّيحَ فَيَظْلَلْنَ رَوَاكِدَ عَلَىٰ ظَهْرِهِ   ۚ   إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَاتٍ لِّكُلِّ صَبَّارٍ شَكُورٍ
If He willed, He could still the wind, and they would remain motionless on its surface. Indeed in that are signs for everyone patient and grateful.
2.            Sakat    سَكَتَ   : to be quiet. To stop talking/be quiet while talking. Sakeet   سَكيت   & saakoot    سَاكُوت   is such a person who is stays quiet for most of his time. Sakat al ghazab    سَكَتَ الغَضَب   means subsiding of anger.
Allah says in the Quran:7:154 : Surat Al-'A`rāf (The Heights) -   سورة الأعراف
وَلَمَّا سَكَتَ عَن مُّوسَى الْغَضَبُ أَخَذَ الْأَلْوَاحَ ۖ وَفِي نُسْخَتِهَا هُدًى وَرَحْمَةٌ لِّلَّذِينَ هُمْ لِرَبِّهِمْ يَرْهَبُونَ
And when the anger subsided in Moses, he took up the tablets; and in their inscription was guidance and mercy for those who are fearful of their Lord.
3.            Rahwann    رَهوًا   : raha yarhoo     رها يرهو   means walk slowly. Raha al bahr     رَهَا البَحر   means quietness/calmness/stillness of the sea. In other words the waves stop moving fast in the sea.(the sea becomes calm/still) . It also means water puddle/water collection on a flat ground.
Quran says: (44:24) Surat Ad-Dukhān (The Smoke) -   سورة الدخان
وَاتْرُكِ الْبَحْرَ رَهْوًا ۖ إِنَّهُمْ جُندٌ مُّغْرَقُونَ
And leave the sea in stillness. Indeed, they are an army to be drowned."
Summary:
1.            Sakan    سَكَنَ  : commonly used word. Whenever soething stops after moving then it is called sukoon.
2.            Sakat     سَكَتَ  : to stop talking in the middle of conversation/talking
3.            Rahwann    رَهوًا   : stillness of sea. When the waves stop moving.

29: Less:
Qaleel    قَليل   ,fateel     فتيل   ,naqeer   نَقير   ,qatmeer    قطمير  ,fawaaq     فواق   are the words used.
1.            Qaleel    قَليل   : Opposite is qaseer. Meaning less as compared to more. Its a commonly used word. May it be quantity,weight,distance,duration  etc.It is used for all.
Allah says in the Quran: 2:41 : Surat Al-Baqarah (The Cow) -   سورة البقرة
وَآمِنُوا بِمَا أَنزَلْتُ مُصَدِّقًا لِّمَا مَعَكُمْ وَلَا تَكُونُوا أَوَّلَ كَافِرٍ بِهِ ۖ وَلَا تَشْتَرُوا بِآيَاتِي ثَمَنًا قَلِيلًا وَإِيَّايَ فَاتَّقُونِ
And believe in what I have sent down confirming that which is [already] with you, and be not the first to disbelieve in it. And do not exchange My signs for a small price, and fear [only] Me.
2.            Fateel     فتيل  : fatal means dividing/twisted rope etc. Fateel     فتيل   is divided/twisted rope. Its feminine is fateela   فتيله   .( it is that small twisted rope used in a oil lamp. Fateela  فتيله     is also used for that very thin thread which is in the middle of the seed of the date(fruit). This word is basically used for very small quantity/amount etc.
In the Quran: 4:49: Surat An-Nisā' (The Women) -   سورة النساء
أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَى الَّذِينَ يُزَكُّونَ أَنفُسَهُم ۚ بَلِ اللَّهُ يُزَكِّي مَن يَشَاءُ وَلَا يُظْلَمُونَ فَتِيلًا
Have you not seen those who claim themselves to be pure? Rather, Allah purifies whom He wills, and injustice is not done to them, [even] as much as a thread [inside a date seed].
3.            Naqeer    نَقير   : Naqar al teer    نقر الطير   means the bird touched/pecked with its beak. & naqar alteayr alhab    نقر الطير الحب   means bird picked seeds with its beak. Mankaar    منقار   means beak & naqeer    نَقير    is the small mark on the seed of the date fruit. (because it looks like a bird touched/pecked it with its beak) & naqeer    نَقير   also signifies very small amount of something.
Allah says in the Quran:4:53: Surat An-Nisā' (The Women) -   سورة النساء
أَمْ لَهُمْ نَصِيبٌ مِّنَ الْمُلْكِ فَإِذًا لَّا يُؤْتُونَ النَّاسَ نَقِيرًا
Or have they a share of dominion? Then [if that were so], they would not give the people [even as much as] the speck on a date seed.
4.            Qitmeer     قطمير  : That very fine/thin membrane on date seed which is very thin & almost like nothing. There is a proverb,   مَا اَصَبتُ عَنهُ قِطميرًا   meaning i didn’t get anything out of him.
Allah says in the Quran:35:13 : Surat Fāţir (Originator) -   سورة فاطر
يُولِجُ اللَّيْلَ فِي النَّهَارِ وَيُولِجُ النَّهَارَ فِي اللَّيْلِ وَسَخَّرَ الشَّمْسَ وَالْقَمَرَ كُلٌّ يَجْرِي لِأَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى ۚ ذَٰلِكُمُ اللَّهُ رَبُّكُمْ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ ۚ وَالَّذِينَ تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِهِ مَا يَمْلِكُونَ مِن قِطْمِيرٍ
He causes the night to enter the day, and He causes the day to enter the night and has subjected the sun and the moon - each running [its course] for a specified term. That is Allah , your Lord; to Him belongs sovereignty. And those whom you invoke other than Him do not possess [as much as] the membrane of a date seed.
5.            Fawaaq   فواق   :The duration between milking of a cow /other animal. Meaning the duration between the opening & closing/pressing of hands of the milk man on the udders. This describes very less duration.
Allah says in the Quran: 38:15 : Surat Şād (The Letter "Saad") -   سورة ص
وَمَا يَنظُرُ هَٰؤُلَاءِ إِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَاحِدَةً مَّا لَهَا مِن فَوَاقٍ
And these [disbelievers] await not but one blast [of the Horn]; for it there will be no delay.
Summary:
1.            Qaleel    قَليل  : Less quantity in comparison of more (of anything).COmonly used word
2.            Fateel   فتيل   : for a small quantity/amount
3.            Naqeer    نَقير   . For a very small amount/quantity
4.            Qitmeer     قطمير  : That small quantity which is almost like none.
5.            Fawaaq   فواق   : Used for a small duration.
Note: Similarly, khar dill (seed of rai) & zarra are also used to describe small quantities.

That is Allah , your Lord; to Him belongs sovereignty. And those whom you invoke other than Him do not possess [as much as] the membrane of a date seed.

5.        Fawaaq فواق :The duration between milking of a cow /other animal. Meaning the duration between the opening & closing/pressing of hands of the milk man on the udders. This describes very less duration.

Allah says in the Quran: 38:15 : Surat Şād (The Letter "Saad") - سورة ص

وَمَا يَنظُرُ هَٰؤُلَاءِ إِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَاحِدَةً مَّا لَهَا مِن فَوَاقٍ

And these [disbelievers] await not but one blast [of the Horn]; for it there will be no delay.

 

 

Summary:

1.        Qaleel  قَليل: Less quantity in comparison of more (of anything).COmonly used word

2.        Fateel فتيل : for a small quantity/amount

3.        Naqeer  نَقير . For a very small amount/quantity

4.        Qitmeer   قطمير: That small quantity which is almost like none.

5.        Fawaaq فواق : Used for a small duration.

 

Note: Similarly, khar dill (seed of rai) & zarra are also used to describe small quantities.

30. To prepare:
Hayya   هَيَّا    ,Aa’atad   اَعتَد     , Aa’adda   اعَدَّ   ,jaahhaz     جَهَّزَ  are the words used.
1.            Hayya   هَيَّا  :  hayatan   هيءةً   means the perceptible state of some object . hayya    هَيَّا  means to arrange something. Correct/improve it, prepare it. In other words, to prepare grounds to complete/do something.
Allah says in the Quran: 18:16: Surat Al-Kahf (The Cave) -   سورة الكهف
وَإِذِ اعْتَزَلْتُمُوهُمْ وَمَا يَعْبُدُونَ إِلَّا اللَّهَ فَأْوُوا إِلَى الْكَهْفِ يَنشُرْ لَكُمْ رَبُّكُم مِّن رَّحْمَتِهِ وَيُهَيِّئْ لَكُم مِّنْ أَمْرِكُم مِّرْفَقًا
[The youths said to one another], "And when you have withdrawn from them and that which they worship other than Allah , retreat to the cave. Your Lord will spread out for you of His mercy and will prepare for you from your affair facility."
2.            Aa’atad    اَعتَد    :  Al-itaad    العتاد   refers to such stuff  which is prepared for some mission/objective. & atudd    عَتُد  means to agree,to be ready. Aa’atad   اَعتَد     means to prepare.
Allah says in the Quran:18:102: Surat Al-Kahf (The Cave) -   سورة الكهف
أَفَحَسِبَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا أَن يَتَّخِذُوا عِبَادِي مِن دُونِي أَوْلِيَاءَ ۚ إِنَّا أَعْتَدْنَا جَهَنَّمَ لِلْكَافِرِينَ نُزُلًا
Then do those who disbelieve think that they can take My servants instead of Me as allies? Indeed, We have prepared Hell for the disbelievers as a lodging.
3.            Aa’adda  اعَدَّ   : means to prepare or to present. Meaning to present after preparing. Adda   عَدَّ   means to count & aa’adda    اعَدَّ  means to present something after preparing each & everything required for its preparation.
Allah says in the Quran: 2:24: Surat Al-Baqarah (The Cow) -   سورة البقرة
فَإِن لَّمْ تَفْعَلُوا وَلَن تَفْعَلُوا فَاتَّقُوا النَّارَ الَّتِي وَقُودُهَا النَّاسُ وَالْحِجَارَةُ ۖ أُعِدَّتْ لِلْكَافِرِينَ
But if you do not - and you will never be able to - then fear the Fire, whose fuel is men and stones, prepared for the disbelievers.
Many people of dictionary take aa’tadd    اَعتَد     as adad   اعدد  . According to Imam Raaghib,Aa’tadna    اعتدنا   was actually aa’dadna     اعددنا  . When first ‘daal’ was replaced by ‘teh’,then it became aatadna    اعتدنا   .In other words, according to most people of dictionary,both, aa’adda   اعَدَّ    & aatad   اَعتَد     have the same meaning.
4.            Jahazza    جَهَّزَ   :Jihaaz    جِهاز    is that luggage of passengers which is ready/prepared. & jahazza      جَهَّزَ  means to load already prepared luggage & send it to its destination. Generally this word is used for preparing dead bodies & sending them to their final destination ( tajheezo takfeen    تجهيزوتكفين   ) or for preparing luggage of passengers.
Allah says in the Quran: 12:70: Surat Yūsuf (Joseph) -   سورة يوسف
فَلَمَّا جَهَّزَهُم بِجَهَازِهِمْ جَعَلَ السِّقَايَةَ فِي رَحْلِ أَخِيهِ ثُمَّ أَذَّنَ مُؤَذِّنٌ أَيَّتُهَا الْعِيرُ إِنَّكُمْ لَسَارِقُونَ
So when he had furnished them with their supplies, he put the [gold measuring] bowl into the bag of his brother. Then an announcer called out, "O caravan, indeed you are thieves."
Summary:
1.            Hayya   هَيَّا   : to arrange or prepare something to make something
2.            Atada   اَعتَد     :To prepare things required to make something
3.            Aa’adda  اعَدَّ   : Prepare completely everything required for an objective
4.            Jahazza    جَهَّزَ   : to prepare luggae for passengers Or to prepare  a dead body for their destination

31. Arrow:
Sahmunn    سَهمٌ   and zalam   زَلَم    are the words used.
1.            Sahmunn     سَهمٌ  : it means a common arrow as well as an arrow used in gambling (arrow used to draw /cast)  & saham   سَاهَم   means to draw/cast lots. Or sortition. Tasaham    تَسَاهَم    means to distribute things amongst each other. Sahm   سَهم    means the distributed share, fate,luck .
As per the Quran: 37:141 Surat Aş-Şāffāt (Those who set the Ranks) -   سورة الصافات
فَسَاهَمَ فَكَانَ مِنَ الْمُدْحَضِينَ
And he drew lots and was among the losers.
2.            Zalam   زَلَم     :  Arrow without feather. The method of drawing cards for fortune telling/future telling.It also means divining arrows.
Allah says in the Quran: 5:90) Surat Al-Mā'idah (The Table Spread) -   سورة المائدة
يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا إِنَّمَا الْخَمْرُ وَالْمَيْسِرُ وَالْأَنصَابُ وَالْأَزْلَامُ رِجْسٌ مِّنْ عَمَلِ الشَّيْطَانِ فَاجْتَنِبُوهُ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ
O you who have believed, indeed, intoxicants, gambling, [sacrificing on] stone alters [to other than Allah ], and divining arrows are but defilement from the work of Satan, so avoid it that you may be successful.

32. Fast/sharp:
Hadeed   حديد    ,hadad   حداد    ,salaq   سلق   are the words used.
1.            Hadeed    حديد   & hadad   حداد    : hadd   حد   means the border of something that separates it from other things.    حدَّ السَّيف والسِّكين    Means to sharpen the edge of knife or sword. Hadeed    حديد  means iron or fast/sharp. hadeed ul fahm   حديد الفهم   means sharp in thinking/logic & hadeed ul nazar   حديدالنظر  , means person with sharp sight.
As per Quran: 50:22: Surat Qāf (The Letter "Qaf") -   سورة ق
لَّقَدْ كُنتَ فِي غَفْلَةٍ مِّنْ هَٰذَا فَكَشَفْنَا عَنكَ غِطَاءَكَ فَبَصَرُكَ الْيَوْمَ حَدِيدٌ
[It will be said], "You were certainly in unmindfulness of this, and We have removed from you your cover, so your sight, this Day, is sharp."
2.            Salaq  سلق    : Means to use hands in fight or tongue with anger. Salaq al lisaan    سلق اللسان    measn use tongue fast.
Allah says in the Quran:33:19: Surat Al-'Aĥzāb (The Combined Forces) -   سورة الأحزاب
أَشِحَّةً عَلَيْكُمْ ۖ فَإِذَا جَاءَ الْخَوْفُ رَأَيْتَهُمْ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَيْكَ تَدُورُ أَعْيُنُهُمْ كَالَّذِي يُغْشَىٰ عَلَيْهِ مِنَ الْمَوْتِ ۖ فَإِذَا ذَهَبَ الْخَوْفُ سَلَقُوكُم بِأَلْسِنَةٍ حِدَادٍ أَشِحَّةً عَلَى الْخَيْرِ ۚ أُولَٰئِكَ لَمْ يُؤْمِنُوا فَأَحْبَطَ اللَّهُ أَعْمَالَهُمْ ۚ وَكَانَ ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى اللَّهِ يَسِيرًا
Indisposed toward you. And when fear comes, you see them looking at you, their eyes     revolving like one being overcome by death. But when fear departs, they lash you with sharp tongues, indisposed toward [any] good. Those have not believed, so Allah has rendered their deeds worthless, and ever is that, for Allah , easy.

لَّقَدْ كُنتَ فِي غَفْلَةٍ مِّنْ هَٰذَا فَكَشَفْنَا عَنكَ غِطَاءَكَ فَبَصَرُكَ الْيَوْمَ حَدِيدٌ

[It will be said], "You were certainly in unmindfulness of this, and We have removed from you your cover, so your sight, this Day, is sharp."

 

2.        Salaqسلق  : Means to use hands in fight or tongue with anger. Salaq al lisaan  سلق اللسان  measn use tongue fast.

 

Allah says in the Quran:33:19: Surat Al-'Aĥzāb (The Combined Forces) - سورة الأحزاب

 

أَشِحَّةً عَلَيْكُمْ ۖ فَإِذَا جَاءَ الْخَوْفُ رَأَيْتَهُمْ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَيْكَ تَدُورُ أَعْيُنُهُمْ كَالَّذِي يُغْشَىٰ عَلَيْهِ مِنَ الْمَوْتِ ۖ فَإِذَا ذَهَبَ الْخَوْفُ سَلَقُوكُم بِأَلْسِنَةٍ حِدَادٍ أَشِحَّةً عَلَى الْخَيْرِ ۚ أُولَٰئِكَ لَمْ يُؤْمِنُوا فَأَحْبَطَ اللَّهُ أَعْمَالَهُمْ ۚ وَكَانَ ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى اللَّهِ يَسِيرًا

 

Indisposed toward you. And when fear comes, you see them looking at you, their eyes revolving like one being overcome by death. But when fear departs, they lash you with sharp tongues, indisposed toward [any] good. Those have not believed, so Allah has rendered their deeds worthless, and ever is that, for Allah , easy.

33. Oil :
Zait   زيت   , duhan   دُهن  , & dihaan   دِهان   are the words used.
1.            Zait   زيت   : fruit from the olive tree tree is called zaitoona   زيتونة   & the oil from the fruit is called zait   زيت   . Zaat al taa’am   زات الطعام   means putting olive oil in food or brush olive oil on food. This oil ,for the purpose of burning is best in quality.
Allah says in the Quran: 24:35 : Surat An-Nūr (The Light) -   سورة النور
اللَّهُ نُورُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ ۚ مَثَلُ نُورِهِ كَمِشْكَاةٍ فِيهَا مِصْبَاحٌ ۖ الْمِصْبَاحُ فِي زُجَاجَةٍ ۖ الزُّجَاجَةُ كَأَنَّهَا كَوْكَبٌ دُرِّيٌّ يُوقَدُ مِن شَجَرَةٍ مُّبَارَكَةٍ زَيْتُونَةٍ لَّا شَرْقِيَّةٍ وَلَا غَرْبِيَّةٍ يَكَادُ زَيْتُهَا يُضِيءُ وَلَوْ لَمْ تَمْسَسْهُ نَارٌ ۚ نُّورٌ عَلَىٰ نُورٍ ۗ يَهْدِي اللَّهُ لِنُورِهِ مَن يَشَاءُ ۚ وَيَضْرِبُ اللَّهُ الْأَمْثَالَ لِلنَّاسِ ۗ وَاللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِيمٌ
Allah is the Light of the heavens and the earth. The example of His light is like a niche within which is a lamp, the lamp is within glass, the glass as if it were a pearly [white] star lit from [the oil of] a blessed olive tree, neither of the east nor of the west, whose oil would almost glow even if untouched by fire. Light upon light. Allah guides to His light whom He wills. And Allah presents examples for the people, and Allah is Knowing of all things.
2.            Duhn   دُهن   : It means oil,fat. This is a common word. May this oil/fat be of any kind like ,plant based, animal based. & dahan   دَهَنَ   & adhan   اَدهَنَ   means to fool someone,cheat someone. Taddahan   تَدَهَّنَ   means to make something slippery/oily with oil/fat.
Allah says in the Quran: 23:20 : Surat Al-Mu'minūn (The Believers) -   سورة المؤمنون
وَشَجَرَةً تَخْرُجُ مِن طُورِ سَيْنَاءَ تَنبُتُ بِالدُّهْنِ وَصِبْغٍ لِّلْآكِلِينَ
And [We brought forth] a tree issuing from Mount Sinai which produces oil and food for those who eat.
3.            Dihaan   دِهان   : This means lees/scum of oil. slippery place, paint,warmish etc.
Allah says in the Quran: 55:37: Surat Ar-Raĥmān (The Beneficent) -   سورة الرحمن
فَإِذَا انشَقَّتِ السَّمَاءُ فَكَانَتْ وَرْدَةً كَالدِّهَانِ
And when the heaven is split open and becomes rose-colored like oil –
Summary:
Zait    زيت   means oil derived from olive. & duhn means every oil including olive oil. & may the oil be of any type, its lees/scum is dihaan   دِهان  .

raw_text:
34. To frown/scowl:
Abasa   عَبَسَ    ,kalaha   كَلَحَ   ,basara   بَسَرَ   are the words used.
1.            Abasa   عَبَسَ   : Means to knit the brows/eye brows,to have wrinkles on the forehead between both eyes. This is the first stage/degree
As per the Quran:80:1: Surat `Abasa (He Frowned) -   سورة عبس
عَبَسَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ
The Prophet frowned and turned away
2.            Kalaha   كَلَحَ   : This is the second/next degree of abasa   عَبَسَ   . Have wrinkles on the face that it doesn’t look nice. According to some,it means moving lips up & down in such a manner that teeth starts showing & face doesn’t look nice.
As per Quran: 23:104: Surat Al-Mu'minūn (The Believers) -   سورة المؤمنون
تَلْفَحُ وُجُوهَهُمُ النَّارُ وَهُمْ فِيهَا كَالِحُونَ
The Fire will sear their faces, and they therein will have taut smiles.
3.            Basara   بَسَرَ  : This is the last degree of abasa   عَبَسَ   . When frowning reaches its maximum limit,then it is called basara   بَسَرَ  . To frown/scowl.
As per the Quran: 74:21-22: Surat Al-Muddaththir (The Cloaked One) -   سورة المدثر
ثُمَّ نَظَرَ   ثُمَّ عَبَسَ وَبَسَرَ
Then he considered [again]; Then he frowned and scowled;

reasoning in it. First
three among them give a positive impression. لِ lii, كَى kaii are used

the addition of laa are compound  together

تَقَرَّ عَيْنُهَا وَلَا تَحْزَنَ

بَيْنَ الْأَغْنِيَاءِ مِنْكُمْ

distribution among the rich from among you

يَكُونَ لِلنَّاسِ عَلَيْكُمْ حُجَّةٌ
2:150 (surah 2 al baqarah
verse 150)

people shall have no accusation against you

he raised his parents upon the throne.

عَرَش الْبَيْت arsh albeit  Means

roof of house. عَرَشَ يَعْرِشُ  aarsh yaresh to build a wooden house

so عرش البيت aarsh albeit  means a roof that is made up of log(beam)

and

hair.

2)ارآ ئكّ

aarayik:plural of اريكه arikha

it means tent bed or canopy bed or throne . Fiqhul

lughat - فقه اللغة comfortable

chair or a throne where one can recline .A decorated and adorned

throne. Munjid – منجد.

Allah says:

مُّتَّكِئِينَ فِيهَا عَلَى الْأَرَائِكِ

76:13 (surah 76

insaan verse 13)

Translation: They

will be] reclining therein on adorned couches

4)سُرُر

suror singular is  سرير sareer it means a bed without

canopy

or tent Fiqhul lughat - فقه اللغة 30  sareer almaiit سَريرُالْمَيِّت means bed

on which corpse are carried. And as per the author of munjid سرير

sareer word is also mostly used

for royal throne. And according to imam Raghib it means a throne (seat) which

well established people make for sitting on in a grand manner

Mufraddat – مفردات

Allah says :

  عَلَىٰ سُرُرٍ مَّوْضُونَةٍ مُّتَّكِئِينَ عَلَيْهَا مُتَقَابِلِينَ

56:15 (surah 56 al waqiyaah

15 verse)

On thrones woven [with ornament], Reclining on them, facing each other.

وَضَنَ means gold-lace work means to weave with gold and silver

wires Mufraddat – مفردات . so the above

verse translation can also be: on thrones woven with gold and silver wires.

To plan-8
Synonyms are:
1)    دَبَّرَ
2)    كاد
(كيد)
3)    مَكَرَ
4)    حيلَة
1)dabara دَبَّرَ:
dubr دُبَر means back or the
backside of anything. And dabara دَبَّرَ
means to focus on the result of a task to ponder over it and to sort out way
for it Mufraddat – مفردات .
Allah says:
وَمَن يُدَبِّرُ الْأَمْرَ ۚ
فَسَيَقُولُونَ اللَّـهُ
10:31 (surah 10 yoonas verse
31)
Translation:
And Who plans all matters?” So they will now say, “Allah.
2)keed
كَيْد: plan secretly to  accomplish a
task .to play or to trick Mufraddat – مفردات ..and keedo
sahiriin كَيْدُسَاحِرٍ means trick of sorcerer. If the aim of such plan is
right and virtues than this kind of plan is correct and allowed.
كَذَٰلِكَ كِدْنَا لِيُوسُفَ
12:76 (surah 12
yousaf verse 76)
Translation: Thus did We plan for Joseph.
And if the aim is wrong than it is forbidden.
Allah says:
فَإِن
كَانَ لَكُمْ كَيْدٌ فَكِيدُونِ
77:39 (surah 77
al mursallat  verse 39)
Translation: So if you have a plan, then plan against Me.
3)makara مَكَرَ:  deceive and lie(artful) to accomplish a task
Maqaayeesul-lughat .and it also means to secretly
introduce sumthing abhorrent to sumone Alfurooqul-lughwiyyah
214. This word  usually gives a negative meaning(interpretation).makar
مكر  means cheat and makaar مَكّار means
cheater(deciver) and ill natured(one with bad reputation)
Maqaayeesul-lughat.and imam Raghib tells the
meaning of this word as to turn a person away from his/her aim through
pretext and excuse. And if it is attributed
to Allah than it means to take an action against deceitful people.
like Allah says اللَّـهُ
يَسْتَهْزِئُ بِهِمْ “Allah mocks them” 2:15 (surah baqarah verse
15).and in case of competing/opposing this is permitted.
Allah says:
وَمَكَرُوا وَمَكَرَ اللَّـهُ ۖ وَاللَّـهُ خَيْرُ الْمَاكِرِينَ
3:54 (surah 3 al
e imraan verse 54)
Translation: And
the disbelievers planned, but Allah planned. And Allah is the best of planners
4)heelah حيلَة :from hool حول means cleverness, far sightedness. The
ability to Seek to
obtain (something, typically food or money) at the expense or through the
generosity of others or by stealth.its plural is heial حِيَل or hiwal
حِوَل and it means cheat and deceive Miraatul Quraan. Heelaa حيله
actually is a task perform
in such a way to derive benefit or to repel harm so that one can escape from
the grip of law and people.
For example before
the start of New Year to gift ones asset to wife so that he don’t have to pay
zakat. and then after some time ask wife to gift it back to him.
This is cleverness
and is cheating and also planning but not like maker مكر or kaiid كَيْد  it’s
not a hidden plan.
Allah says:
وَالنِّسَاءِ وَالْوِلْدَانِ لَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ
حِيلَةً وَلَا يَهْتَدُونَ سَبِيلًا
4:98 (surah 4 an nisa verse  98)
Translation: women
and children who cannot devise a plan nor are they directed to a way
Summary  :
1)dabra:to keep the
result of some task in front and ponder over it.
2)keeidd:a hidden plan
to introduce something condemn to some one.And if cheat is on low scale than it
is called makaar and if on large scale than it is kaeeid.
3)maker:if it is
for a good aim then it is correct and if the aim is wrong then it is forbidden
and usually maker word is taken in negative senses.
4)heela:
through  cleverness and in cunning way steal something.

raw_text:
9. Tarazu ترازو – physical balance, weighing scale
Also known as ‘meezaan’   مِيزَان   and ‘qistaas’   قِسطَاس  .
1.          Meezaan   مِيزَان  : An instrument to measure weight. This is a commonly used word for an instrument that balances the weight of one object with another. ‘Meezan’   مِيزَان   is referred to either of the two objects placed in the physical balance that is to be weighed. It refers to the idea of weighing.
Allah Taa’la says:
Surah Ar Rahman (The Beneficent)   سُوۡرَةُ الرَّحمٰن
(55:8-9)
أَلَّا تَطۡغَوۡاْ فِى ٱلۡمِيزَانِ (  ﻿  ٨  ﻿  ) وَأَقِيمُواْ ٱلۡوَزۡنَ بِٱلۡقِسۡطِ وَلَا تُخۡسِرُواْ ٱلۡمِيزَانَ
“That you not transgress within the balance. And establish weight in justice and do not make deficient the balance.”
2.          Qistaas   قِسطَاس  : It is a word from the Roman dictionary, which later started being used in the Arabic language. It is referred to such a balance/scale, one that is very sensitive. Direct and veracious. This is the type of a scale in which there is a needle/pointer (lisaan-ul-meezaan)   لِسَانُ     المِيزَان   to indicate the unit of measurement.
Allah Taa’la says:
Surah Al Isra (The Night Journey)   سُوۡرَةُ الإسرَاء
(17:35)
وَزِنُواْ بِٱلۡقِسۡطَاسِ ٱلۡمُسۡتَقِيمِ‌ۚ
“And give full measure when you measure,   and weigh with an even balance.   That is the best [way] and best in result.”

1 CABIT HUWNA [To be Proven]
SYNONYMS:HAQQA(حَقَّ) ,HAS HASA(حَصّْحَصَ )
1.1 HAQQA(حَقَّ)  :meaning    proven.to    be legit. and it's antonym is BATALA(بَطَلَ). and HAQQUN(حَقٌّ) meaning proven discourse,truth,uprightness/probity(anotnym BATIL باطل) .ALLAH said
Surat Al-'Isrā' (The Night Journey) - سورة الإسراء
17:16
وَإِذَا أَرَدْنَا أَن نُّهْلِكَ قَرْيَةً أَمَرْنَا مُتْرَفِيهَا   فَفَسَقُوا فِيهَا فَحَقَّ عَلَيْهَا الْقَوْلُ فَدَمَّرْنَاهَا تَدْمِيرًا
And when We intend to destroy a city, We command its affluent   but they defiantly disobey therein; so the word comes into effect upon it, and We destroy it with [complete] destruction  .
1.2 HASHASA(حَصّْحَصَ)  :true discourse that remains hidden owing to some pressure but once pressure lifts off ,it manifests clearly.manifestation of truth after concealment.In the QURAN
Surat Yūsuf (Joseph) - سورة يوسف
12:51
قَالَ مَا خَطْبُكُنَّ إِذْ رَاوَدتُّنَّ يُوسُفَ عَن نَّفْسِهِ ۚ قُلْنَ حَاشَ لِلَّهِ مَا عَلِمْنَا عَلَيْهِ مِن سُوءٍ ۚ   قَالَتِ امْرَأَتُ الْعَزِيزِ الْآنَ حَصْحَصَ الْحَقُّ أَنَا رَاوَدتُّهُ عَن نَّفْسِهِ   وَإِنَّهُ لَمِنَ الصَّادِقِينَ
Said [the king to the women], "What was your condition when you sought to seduce Joseph?" They said, "Perfect is Allah ! We know about him no evil."   The wife of al-'Azeez said, "Now the truth has become evident. It was I who sought to seduce him,   and indeed, he is of the truthful.

title: content/th/th2.html
raw_text:
2 CABIT QADAM REHNA-RAKHNA [To Stay Firm-Keep Firm]
SYNONYMS:CABATA(ثَبَتَ),ISTIQAMA(اِسْتَقَام)[QWM(قوم)],ISTABARA(اِصْطَبَرَ )[SBR(صبر)],RABATA( رَابَطَ)
2.1 CABATA(ثَبَتَ)  :meaning to be firm on some    discourse.to    stay firm at one's place, to be firm.(antonym ZALL زلّ ).ALLAH said
Surat Al-'Anfāl (The Spoils of War) - سورة الأنفال
8:45
يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا إِذَا لَقِيتُمْ فِئَةً فَاثْبُتُوا   وَاذْكُرُوا اللَّهَ كَثِيرًا لَّعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ
O you who have believed, when you encounter a company [from the enemy forces], stand firm   and remember Allah much that you may be successful.
2.2 ISTIQAMA(اِسْتَقَام)  :QAM 3LA ALAMR(قام علي الامر)meaning to be resolute on some matter or discourse. and AQAM ASSHAYEE(اقام الشئ)meanign to make some one stand ,to straighten and ISTIQAM (استقام) meaning to establish and continue    something.to    be perpetual.also ISTIQAM means to walk on straight path and to be steadfast on it. ALLAH said
Surat Al-'Aĥqāf (The Wind-Curved Sandhills) - سورة الأحقاف
46:13
إِنَّ الَّذِينَ قَالُوا رَبُّنَا اللَّهُ ثُمَّ اسْتَقَامُوا فَلَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ
Indeed, those who have said, "Our Lord is Allah ," and then remained on a right course - there will be no fear concerning them, nor will they grieve.
2.3 ISTABARA(اِصْطَبَرَ)  :SAABARA(صَابَر) and SABARA(صَبَرَ) meaning to hold oneself back from unlawful actions at the time of pivation or trouble.(antonym JZ3 جزع) and SABARA meaning to bear with bravery.and SABAR ADDAYAH(صَبَرَ الدَّايَة) meaning tie some animal(cattle) without fodder.SABIR(صابر) meaning to preach each other of steadfastness and patience. and ASTABR(اصطبر) meaning having habit of standing in wake of troubles and complexity. and to perpetuate on    it.to    remain steadfast.ALLAH said
Surat Ţāhā (Ta-Ha) - سورة طه
20:132
وَأْمُرْ أَهْلَكَ بِالصَّلَاةِ وَاصْطَبِرْ عَلَيْهَا ۖ   لَا نَسْأَلُكَ رِزْقًا ۖ نَّحْنُ نَرْزُقُكَ ۗ وَالْعَاقِبَةُ لِلتَّقْوَىٰ
And enjoin prayer upon your family [and people] and be steadfast therein  . We ask you not for provision; We provide for you, and the [best] outcome is for [those of] righteousness.
2.4 RABATA( رَابَطَ)  :RABAT ALFARS(ربط الفرس) meaning to securely tie horses at some place.and RIBAT(رباط) is that place where defense forces are kept deployed.cantonment,fort and RABAT ALJAYSH(رباط الجيش) meaning permanent deployment of armed forces near enemy front/border. and RABAT ALAMR(رَابَطَ الاَمْرَ) meaning to always follow some command. so RABATA will imply the permanency on such a command which relates to the protection and strength of that command.ALLAH said
Surat 'Āli `Imrān (Family of Imran) - سورة آل عمران
3:200
يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اصْبِرُوا وَصَابِرُوا وَرَابِطُوا   وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ
O you who have believed, persevere and endure and remain stationed   and fear Allah that you may be successful.
SUMMARY:
2.1 CABATA:to be steadfast on some discourse
2.2 ISTIQAMA:to follow the right discourse and to stay firm and to perpertuate it
2.3 ISTABARA:to brave  in the face of trial and tribulation.and to take it as a habit
2.4 RABATA:to stay firm on such a matter whose establishment and protection is mandatory
and to keep steadfast (others)   CABBATA(ثَبَّتَ)   comes.ALLAH said
Surat Hūd (Hud) - سورة هود
11:120
وَكُلًّا نَّقُصُّ عَلَيْكَ مِنْ أَنبَاءِ الرُّسُلِ مَا نُثَبِّتُ بِهِ فُؤَادَكَ   ۚ وَجَاءَكَ فِي هَٰذِهِ الْحَقُّ وَمَوْعِظَةٌ وَذِكْرَىٰ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
And each [story] We relate to you from the news of the messengers is that by which We make firm your heart  . And there has come to you, in this, the truth and an instruction and a reminder for the believers.

title: content/tt/tt1.html
raw_text:
START OF TA ٹ         (page 367)
1- TUKDRA [Piece/ section]
Synonyms:- JUZ-, QITA3, BUKAH, KISFA, ZUBAR, ANKAC, 3IDIYIN(3A-DA-WA), JUZAZ(JUZZ), FIRQ, BAAD.
1.1  JUZ (جُزء  ): means piece or a seperated portion of a thing. Its antonym is كُلّ'whole'. It means those parts of a thing whose summing up can compile an entire thing. JAZA-ASHAYE (جَزَءَ الشئ) means to divide a thing in different units. To take one portion .
Allah states in Qur'an:-
Surat Al-Baqarah (The Cow) - سورة البقرة
[2:260]
ثُمَّ اجْعَلْ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ جَبَلٍ مِّنْهُنَّ جُزْءًا
Then [after slaughtering them] put on each hill a portion of them.
1.2 QITA3UN(قِطَعٌ)  : is a plural of QIT3ATUN(قِطَعَةٌ), it means a seperated portion or piece of a thing.QIT3AH(قِطعَه) refers to an anthology of poems in which a poem has four or less then four verses.It is also used for divided land e.g. plot etc.
Allah SWT states in Qur'an:-
Surat Ar-Ra`d (The Thunder) - سورة الرعد
[13:4]
وَفِي الْأَرْضِ قِطَعٌ مُّتَجَاوِرَاتٌ
And within the land are neighboring plots.
If the word QIT3UN(قِطعٌ) is related to night, then it means a portion of night, but most translators descibe it as a last portion of night.
Allah SWT states in Qur'an:-
Surat Hūd (Hud) - سورة هود
[11:81]
فَأَسْرِ بِأَهْلِكَ بِقِطْعٍ مِّنَ اللَّيْلِ
So set out with your family during a portion of the night.
1.3 BUQ3AH (بُقعَة)   According to Author of Miqyas-ul-Lugha (arabic lexicon) (in referenece to KHALIL[most probably a lexiconologist]) BUQAHT(بقعة) is a section of land which is prominent as compared to other sections.
It is stated in Qur'an:-
Surat Al-Qaşaş (The Stories) - سورة القصص
[28:30]
فَلَمَّا أَتَاهَا نُودِيَ مِن شَاطِئِ الْوَادِ الْأَيْمَنِ فِي الْبُقْعَةِ الْمُبَارَكَةِ مِنَ الشَّجَرَةِ
But when he came to it, he was called from the right side of the valley in a blessed spot - from the tree.
1.4 KISAF(كِسَف)  :is plural of KISFAH كِسْفَة. meaning porous bodies like clouds or piece of cotton. which can be separated easily and can be joined easily.In the QURAN.
Surat Ash-Shu`arā' (The Poets) - سورة الشعراء
26:187
فَأَسْقِطْ عَلَيْنَا كِسَفًا مِّنَ السَّمَاءِ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ الصَّادِقِينَ
So cause to fall upon us fragments of the sky, if you should be of the truthful."
1.5 ZUBR(زُبر)  :is plural of ZUBRAH  زُبْرة.meaning big piece of iron.sheets of iron, slabs,then it applies to every spread out thing whose thickness is less but spread is more for e.g slabs of paper-leafs/pages of book,scrolls etc. In the QURAN.
Surat Al-Kahf (The Cave) - سورة الكهف
18:96
آتُونِي زُبَرَ الْحَدِيدِ ۖ حَتَّىٰ إِذَا سَاوَىٰ بَيْنَ الصَّدَفَيْنِ قَالَ انفُخُوا ۖ حَتَّىٰ إِذَا جَعَلَهُ نَارًا قَالَ آتُونِي أُفْرِغْ عَلَيْهِ قِطْرًا
Bring me sheets of iron" - until, when he had leveled [them] between the two mountain walls, he said, "Blow [with bellows]," until when he had made it [like] fire, he said, "Bring me, that I may pour over it molten copper."
Surat Ash-Shu`arā' (The Poets) - سورة الشعراء
26:196
وَإِنَّهُ لَفِي زُبُرِ الْأَوَّلِينَ
And indeed, it is [mentioned] in the scriptures of former peoples.
there is also literal/abstract usage of ZUBR as well.ALLAH said
Surat Al-Mu'minūn (The Believers) - سورة المؤمنون
23:53
فَتَقَطَّعُوا أَمْرَهُم بَيْنَهُمْ زُبُرًا ۖ كُلُّ حِزْبٍ بِمَا لَدَيْهِمْ فَرِحُونَ
But the people divided their religion among them into sects - each faction, in what it has, rejoicing.
1.6 ANKAC(انكاث)  :is plural of NUKC(نُكْث). meaning to tore blanket or tent for respinning.and NIKKAC(نكّاث) is toring of something which is made up or wrapped up.then because in the process of tearing up such things can also become bad or broken in to pieces.so ANKAC comes in the meaning of such pieces.ALLAH said
Surat An-Naĥl (The Bee) - سورة النحل
16:92
وَلَا تَكُونُوا كَالَّتِي نَقَضَتْ غَزْلَهَا مِن بَعْدِ قُوَّةٍ أَنكَاثًا تَتَّخِذُونَ أَيْمَانَكُمْ دَخَلًا بَيْنَكُمْ أَن تَكُونَ أُمَّةٌ هِيَ أَرْبَىٰ مِنْ أُمَّةٍ ۚ إِنَّمَا يَبْلُوكُمُ اللَّهُ بِهِ ۚ وَلَيُبَيِّنَنَّ لَكُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ مَا كُنتُمْ فِيهِ تَخْتَلِفُونَ
And do not be like she who untwisted her spun thread after it was strong [by] taking your oaths as [means of] deceit between you because one community is more plentiful [in number or wealth] than another community. Allah only tries you thereby. And He will surely make clear to you on the Day of Resurrection that over which you used to differ.
1.7 3ADIYN(عَضِيْن)  : AL3UDW اَلْعُضْو and AL3IDWاَلْعِضْو meaning part of body,and it's plural is A3DA-.اَعْضاء and 3ADA YA3DUW(عَضَا يَعْضُموا) meaning to make pieces.and AL3IDATU(العِضَةُ) means   piece-faction.it  's plural is 3IDIYN (عِضِين)and 3IDUWN(عضون). and as per author of MUQYAS ALLUGHA , 3ADANA means to make pieces of something.and from it's derived 3UDW عُضْو and 3IDW عِضْو. pieces of meat-bits/morsels.ALLAH said
Surat Al-Ĥijr (The Rocky Tract) - سورة الحجر
15:91
الَّذِينَ جَعَلُوا الْقُرْآنَ عِضِينَ
Who have made the Qur'an into portions.
1.8 JUZAZ(جُذاذ)  :JAZZA(جَذّ) meaning cutting,breaking. and JIZZ(جِذّ) is small pieces of thing being cut.its plural is JUZAZ and JAZAZATجذاذات.meaning fine bits or pieces of something being cut.JAZAZAT MIN ALFIDDAH جذاذات من الفضّة meaning particles of silver.and JAZAZ is also said for lump/piece of Gold. so JAZAZ is used for fine pieces or particles of precious metals.ALLAH said
Surat Al-'Anbyā' (The Prophets) - سورة الأنبياء
21:58
فَجَعَلَهُمْ جُذَاذًا إِلَّا كَبِيرًا لَّهُمْ لَعَلَّهُمْ إِلَيْهِ يَرْجِعُونَ
So he made them into fragments, except a large one among them, that they might return to it [and question].
1.9 FIRQ(فِرْق)  :meaning broken off or cutt of part of   something.it   includes the connotation of two pieces in general.one cut of detached piece.second that which remains after cutting.and FARQ  فَرْق is also said to the middle path between hair of head or hairdo/coiffure. and FARAQ  فَرَق is also the distane between two frontal teeth.ALLAH said
Surat Ash-Shu`arā' (The Poets) - سورة الشعراء
26:63
فَأَوْحَيْنَا إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰ أَنِ اضْرِب بِّعَصَاكَ الْبَحْرَ ۖ فَانفَلَقَ فَكَانَ كُلُّ فِرْقٍ كَالطَّوْدِ الْعَظِيمِ
Then We inspired to Moses, "Strike with your staff the sea," and it parted, and each portion was like a great towering mountain.
(for difference between FIRQ فِرق and FILQ فِلق please see PHARNA [To Tore Apart])
1.10 BA3D(بَعْض)  :is of common   usage.it   also means 'part' of some 'whole'. as ALLAH said
Surat Al-Baqarah (The Cow) - سورة البقرة
2:73
فَقُلْنَا اضْرِبُوهُ بِبَعْضِهَا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُحْيِي اللَّهُ الْمَوْتَىٰ وَيُرِيكُمْ آيَاتِهِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ
So, We said, "Strike the slain man with part of it." Thus does Allah bring the dead to life, and He shows you His signs that you might reason.
and if 'whole' is collection of many permanent things then for single entity as well. for e.g BA3D ALLIYALY meaning a night from among nights. or BA3D ANNAS -some man.In the QURAN
Surat Al-Qalam (The Pen) - سورة القلم
68:30
فَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ يَتَلَاوَمُونَ
Then they approached one another, blaming each other.
in addition BA3D is also used in literal context .in the QURAN
Surat Az-Zukhruf (The Ornaments of Gold) - سورة الزخرف
43:63
وَلَمَّا جَاءَ عِيسَىٰ بِالْبَيِّنَاتِ قَالَ قَدْ جِئْتُكُم بِالْحِكْمَةِ وَلِأُبَيِّنَ لَكُم بَعْضَ الَّذِي تَخْتَلِفُونَ فِيهِ ۖ فَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
And when Jesus brought clear proofs, he said, "I have come to you with wisdom and to make clear to you some of that over which you differ, so fear Allah and obey me.
Summary:
1.1 JUZ-:those parts of something which completes it.
1.2 QIT3AH:piece of part of land,poetry or night
1.3 BUQ3AH:that portion of land which is prominent from others
1.4 KISAF:porous bodies for e.g cloud,cotton or piece of sky
1.5 ZUBUR:sheet or slabs of iron or paper etc.
1.6 ANKAC:spinned cotton or pieces of wool
1.7 3IDIYN:pieces or morsel/chop of meat
1.8 JUZAZ:pieces or particles of precious metals
1.9 FIRQ: generally any one part of the two
1.10 BA3D: for 'part' in comparison with 'whole' and for 'member'or 'some member'in comparison with collection.
please see "  HISSA" [Part/Portion]

title: content/tt/tt2.html
raw_text:
2 TUTNA[To Break]
SYNONYMS:TABBA(تَبَّ),INFASAMA(اِنْفَصَمَ),INQADDA(انْقَضَّ),TAQATTA3A(تَقَطَّعَ)
2.1 TABBA(تَبَّ)  :lexical meaning is to approach destruction owing to continual loss and damadge.and in the QURAN word TABAB(تباب) is used in this meaning. and TABBA is a curse word as    well.it    is said TABBAN LAKA( تَبّاًلَكَ) meaning god decimate or destroy you.like wise TABBAT YADAHU(تَبَّتْ يَدَاهُ) means May his both hands be broken. ALLAH said
Surat Al-Masad (The Palm Fiber, Flame) - سورة المسد
111:1
تَبَّتْ يَدَا أَبِي لَهَبٍ وَتَبَّ
May the hands of Abu Lahab be ruined, and ruined is he.
2.2 INFASAMA(اِنْفَصَمَ)  :Some thing breaks such that it both parts doesn't separate but remain connected.having crack or hair(like in a glass/mirror) . ALLAH said
Surat Al-Baqarah (The Cow) - سورة البقرة
2:256
لَا إِكْرَاهَ فِي الدِّينِ ۖ قَد تَّبَيَّنَ الرُّشْدُ مِنَ الْغَيِّ   ۚ فَمَن يَكْفُرْ بِالطَّاغُوتِ وَيُؤْمِن بِاللَّهِ فَقَدِ اسْتَمْسَكَ بِالْعُرْوَةِ الْوُثْقَىٰ لَا انفِصَامَ لَهَا ۗ   وَاللَّهُ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ
There shall be no compulsion in [acceptance of] the religion. The right course has become clear from the wrong.   So whoever disbelieves in Taghut and believes in Allah has grasped the most trustworthy handhold with no break in it  . And Allah is Hearing and Knowing.
2.3 INQADDA(انْقَضَّ)  :NAQADA(نَقَضَ) meaning to break and INQADDA meaning building or wall being cracked up.and ANNAQD(النَّقْض) meaning broken part of the building.wall etc being cracked up and break up to incline to one side. ALLAH said
Surat Al-Kahf (The Cave) - سورة الكهف
18:77
فَانطَلَقَا حَتَّىٰ إِذَا أَتَيَا أَهْلَ قَرْيَةٍ اسْتَطْعَمَا أَهْلَهَا فَأَبَوْا أَن يُضَيِّفُوهُمَا   فَوَجَدَا فِيهَا جِدَارًا يُرِيدُ أَن يَنقَضَّ فَأَقَامَهُ   ۖ قَالَ لَوْ شِئْتَ لَاتَّخَذْتَ عَلَيْهِ أَجْرًا
So they set out, until when they came to the people of a town, they asked its people for food, but they refused to offer them hospitality.   And they found therein a wall about to collapse, so (al-Khidh r) restored it  . [Moses] said, "If you wished, you could have taken for it a payment."
2.4 TAQATTA3A(تَقَطَّعَ)  :something being break up or cut up to separate .used in both apparent and literal meaning. ALLAH said
Surat Al-Baqarah (The Cow) - سورة البقرة
2:166
إِذْ تَبَرَّأَ الَّذِينَ اتُّبِعُوا مِنَ الَّذِينَ اتَّبَعُوا   وَرَأَوُا الْعَذَابَ وَتَقَطَّعَتْ بِهِمُ الْأَسْبَابُ
[And they should consider that] when those who have been followed disassociate themselves from those who followed [them],   and they [all] see the punishment, and cut off from them are the ties [of relationship],
SUMMARY:
2.1 TABBA: curse word- used in bad meaning-meaning to curse for someone's destruction and annihilation
2.2 INFASAMA:to break such that both parts doesn't separate
2.3 INQADDA:cracking of building or wall
2.4 TAQATTA3A:to break such that its parts gets separated
for   THATHA KARNA-[To Laugh off]   please see   MAZAQ URANA[To Make Fun of]

title: content/tt/tt3.html
raw_text:
3 THANDA HUWNA-KARNA [To be Cool,To Cool]
SYNONYMS:BARADA(بَرَدَ),QARRA(قَرَّ)
3.1 BARADA(بَرَدَ)  :meaning to be cooled,and BARD(بَرْد)-BURUDAT(بُرُوْدَت)meaning cold or winter. and BARAD meaning hail.BURIDATI ALARD(بُرِدَتِ الارض) meaning hail shower on earth.and BARID(بارد) meaning any cool thing.ALLAH said
Surat Şād (The Letter "Saad") - سورة ص
38:42
ارْكُضْ بِرِجْلِكَ ۖ هَٰذَا مُغْتَسَلٌ بَارِدٌ وَشَرَابٌ
[So he was told], "Strike [the ground] with your foot; this is a [spring for] a cool bath and drink."
3.2 QARRA(قَرَّ )  :QARRA ALYAUWM(قَرَّ الْيَوْم)meaning cooling of day.YAUWMUN QARRUN(يَوْمٌ قَرٌّ)meaning cold day. LAYLATUN QIRRATUN(لَيْلَةٌ قرَّةٌ)meaning cold night. then it is also used as literal/abstract.for e.g QARRAT(قَرَّتْ )[QURATUN QURRATUN (قُرَةٌ و قُرَّةٌ )]i,3AYNUHU(عَيْنُهُ) meaning someone eyes getting cooled.happiness of heart and getting one's desire.so such a coolness which is also pleasant then it's QARRA. ALLAH said
Surat Maryam (Mary) - سورة مريم
19:26
فَكُلِي وَاشْرَبِي وَقَرِّي عَيْنًا   ۖ فَإِمَّا تَرَيِنَّ مِنَ الْبَشَرِ أَحَدًا فَقُولِي إِنِّي نَذَرْتُ لِلرَّحْمَٰنِ صَوْمًا فَلَنْ أُكَلِّمَ الْيَوْمَ إِنسِيًّا
So eat and drink and be contented  . And if you see from among humanity anyone, say, 'Indeed, I have vowed to the Most Merciful abstention, so I will not speak today to [any] man.' "
SUMMARY:
3.1 BARADA is common for coolness
3.2 QARRA is such coolness which is pleasant and a means of peace and tranquility

3.1 BARADA(بَرَدَ):meaning to be cooled,and BARD(بَرْد)-BURUDAT(بُرُوْدَت)meaning cold or winter. and BARAD meaning hail.BURIDATI ALARD(بُرِدَتِ الارض) meaning hail shower on earth.and BARID(بارد) meaning any cool thing.ALLAH said

Surat Şād (The Letter "Saad") - سورة ص

38:42

ارْكُضْ بِرِجْلِكَ ۖ هَٰذَا مُغْتَسَلٌ بَارِدٌ وَشَرَابٌ

[So he was told], "Strike [the ground] with your foot; this is a [spring for] a cool bath and drink."

3.2 QARRA(قَرَّ ):QARRA ALYAUWM(قَرَّ الْيَوْم)meaning cooling of day.YAUWMUN QARRUN(يَوْمٌ قَرٌّ)meaning cold day. LAYLATUN QIRRATUN(لَيْلَةٌ قرَّةٌ)meaning cold night. then it is also used as literal/abstract.for e.g QARRAT(قَرَّتْ )[QURATUN QURRATUN (قُرَةٌ و قُرَّةٌ )]i,3AYNUHU(عَيْنُهُ) meaning someone eyes getting cooled.happiness of heart and getting one's desire.so such a coolness which is also pleasant then it's QARRA. ALLAH said

Surat Maryam (Mary) - سورة مريم

19:26

فَكُلِي وَاشْرَبِي وَقَرِّي عَيْنًا ۖ فَإِمَّا تَرَيِنَّ مِنَ الْبَشَرِ أَحَدًا فَقُولِي إِنِّي نَذَرْتُ لِلرَّحْمَٰنِ صَوْمًا فَلَنْ أُكَلِّمَ الْيَوْمَ إِنسِيًّا

So eat and drink and be contented. And if you see from among humanity anyone, say, 'Indeed, I have vowed to the Most Merciful abstention, so I will not speak today to [any] man.' "

SUMMARY:

3.1 BARADA is common for coolness

3.2 QARRA is such coolness which is pleasant and a means of peace and tranquility

4 THERNA (BA MA3NY RUKNA) [To Wait (Meaning To Stop)]
SYNONYMS:SAKANA(سَكَنَ),RAKADA(رَكَدَ),JAMADA(جَمَدَ),RAHWAN(رَهْواً),QARRA(قَرَّ),WAQAFA(وَقَفَ)
4.1 SAKANA(سَكَنَ)  :used for idle after motion
4.2 RAKADA(رَكَدَ):after lack of something, some other thing being established and firm(side note:the agent of change is removed).RAKAD ALMIYZAN(ركد الميزان) meaning weighing balance(N.B.old ones not the new digital one) being idle after being balanced.and RAKADA ASSHAMS(رَكَدَ الشّمس) meaning to know sun as idle above one's head. ALLAH said
Surat Ash-Shūraá (The Consultation) - سورة الشورى
42:33
إِن يَشَأْ يُسْكِنِ الرِّيحَ فَيَظْلَلْنَ رَوَاكِدَ عَلَىٰ ظَهْرِهِ ۚ   إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَآيَاتٍ لِّكُلِّ صَبَّارٍ شَكُورٍ
If He willed, He could still the wind, and they would remain motionless on its surface  . Indeed in that are signs for everyone patient and grateful.
4.3 JAMADA(جَمَدَ)  :nonliving things being absolutely motionless.JAMAD ALMA-(جمد الماء) meanign water being frozen. and JAMAD ALDAM(جمد الدم) meaning blood being dry. and JAMD(جَمْد) is said for frozen water.ALLAH said
Surat An-Naml (The Ant) - سورة النمل
27:88
وَتَرَى الْجِبَالَ تَحْسَبُهَا جَامِدَةً وَهِيَ تَمُرُّ مَرَّ السَّحَابِ   ۚ صُنْعَ اللَّهِ الَّذِي أَتْقَنَ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ ۚ إِنَّهُ خَبِيرٌ بِمَا تَفْعَلُونَ
And you see the mountains, thinking them rigid, while they will pass as the passing of clouds  . [It is] the work of Allah , who perfected all things. Indeed, He is Acquainted with that which you do.
4.4 RAHWAN(رَهْواً)  :idling of waves or currents or tides on sea or water surface.second lexical meaning is that of open place or path between two heights
In the HOLY QURAN this word is used only once and give both the meanings. ALLAH said
Surat Ad-Dukhān (The Smoke) - سورة الدخان
44:24
وَاتْرُكِ الْبَحْرَ رَهْوًا ۖ   إِنَّهُمْ جُندٌ مُّغْرَقُونَ
And leave the sea in stillness.   Indeed, they are an army to be drowned."
4.5 QARRA(قَرَّ)  :To root in at some place, to stay firmly.ALLAH said
Surat Al-Ĥaj (The Pilgrimage) - سورة الحج
22:5
يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ إِن كُنتُمْ فِي رَيْبٍ مِّنَ الْبَعْثِ فَإِنَّا خَلَقْنَاكُم مِّن تُرَابٍ ثُمَّ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ ثُمَّ مِنْ عَلَقَةٍ ثُمَّ مِن مُّضْغَةٍ مُّخَلَّقَةٍ وَغَيْرِ مُخَلَّقَةٍ لِّنُبَيِّنَ لَكُمْ   ۚ وَنُقِرُّ فِي الْأَرْحَامِ مَا نَشَاءُ إِلَىٰ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى   ثُمَّ نُخْرِجُكُمْ طِفْلًا ثُمَّ لِتَبْلُغُوا أَشُدَّكُمْ ۖ وَمِنكُم مَّن يُتَوَفَّىٰ وَمِنكُم مَّن يُرَدُّ إِلَىٰ أَرْذَلِ الْعُمُرِ لِكَيْلَا يَعْلَمَ مِن بَعْدِ عِلْمٍ شَيْئًا ۚ وَتَرَى الْأَرْضَ هَامِدَةً فَإِذَا أَنزَلْنَا عَلَيْهَا الْمَاءَ اهْتَزَّتْ وَرَبَتْ وَأَنبَتَتْ مِن كُلِّ زَوْجٍ بَهِيجٍ
O People, if you should be in doubt about the Resurrection, then [consider that] indeed, We created you from dust, then from a sperm-drop, then from a clinging clot, and then from a lump of flesh, formed and unformed - that We may show you.   And We settle in the wombs whom We will for a specified term  , then We bring you out as a child, and then [We develop you] that you may reach your [time of] maturity. And among you is he who is taken in [early] death, and among you is he who is returned to the most decrepit [old] age so that he knows, after [once having] knowledge, nothing. And you see the earth barren, but when We send down upon it rain, it quivers and swells and grows [something] of every beautiful kind.
4.6 WAQAFA(وَقَفَ)  :To stand motionless,   senseless.to    stop for a short time while continuously doing work.[SAYYARAT(سيّارات) is bus stand].or such an idleness after which is expected motion or work as before. and usage of this word is both intransitive and transitive.ALLAH said
a) as intransitive
Surat Al-'An`ām (The Cattle) - سورة الأنعام
6:30
وَلَوْ تَرَىٰ إِذْ وُقِفُوا عَلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ   ۚ قَالَ أَلَيْسَ هَٰذَا بِالْحَقِّ ۚ قَالُوا بَلَىٰ وَرَبِّنَا ۚ قَالَ فَذُوقُوا الْعَذَابَ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَكْفُرُونَ
If you could but see when they will be made to stand before their Lord  . He will say, "Is this not the truth?" They will say, "Yes, by our Lord." He will [then] say, "So taste the punishment because you used to disbelieve."
b) as transitive
Surat Aş-Şāffāt (Those who set the Ranks) - سورة الصافات
37:24
وَقِفُوهُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُم مَّسْئُولُونَ
And stop them; indeed, they are to be questioned."
SUMMARY:
4.1 SAKANA:idle after movement
4.2 RAKADA:idling of something in motion after being established and balanced on its own
4.3 JAMADA:to freeze,permanent settlement of nonliving thing
4.4 RAHWAN:calmness of water surface, or open space between two established things.
4.5 QARRA:something getting established at some place. to stay for some time
4.6 WAQAFA:pause,work break

raw_text:
5 THERNA(AABAD HUWNA) [TO Stay(To Populate)]
SYNONYMS:LABICA(لَبِثَ),MAKACA(مَكَثَ)i,3AKAFA(عَكَفَ), also see AABAD HUWNA[To Populate]
5.1 LABICA(لَبِثَ)  :meaning to stay firmly at some place and to stay permanently.ALLAH said
Surat Al-Kahf (The Cave) - سورة الكهف
18:25
وَلَبِثُوا فِي كَهْفِهِمْ ثَلَاثَ مِائَةٍ سِنِينَ وَازْدَادُوا تِسْعًا
And they remained in their cave for three hundred years and exceeded by nine.
5.2 MAKACA(مَكَثَ)  :to stay in wait of something.In the QURAN
Surat Ţāhā (Ta-Ha) - سورة طه
20:10
إِذْ رَأَىٰ نَارًا   فَقَالَ لِأَهْلِهِ امْكُثُوا إِنِّي آنَسْتُ نَارًا   لَّعَلِّي آتِيكُم مِّنْهَا بِقَبَسٍ أَوْ أَجِدُ عَلَى النَّارِ هُدًى
When he saw a fire   and said to his family, "Stay here; indeed, I have perceived a fire;   perhaps I can bring you a torch or find at the fire some guidance."
on a second place
Surat An-Naml (The Ant) - سورة النمل
27:22
فَمَكَثَ غَيْرَ بَعِيدٍ   فَقَالَ أَحَطتُ بِمَا لَمْ تُحِطْ بِهِ وَجِئْتُكَ مِن سَبَإٍ بِنَبَإٍ يَقِينٍ
But the hoopoe stayed not long   and said, "I have encompassed [in knowledge] that which you have not encompassed, and I have come to you from Sheba with certain news.
on a third place
Surat Al-'Isrā' (The Night Journey) - سورة الإسراء
17:106
وَقُرْآنًا فَرَقْنَاهُ لِتَقْرَأَهُ عَلَى النَّاسِ عَلَىٰ مُكْثٍ   وَنَزَّلْنَاهُ تَنزِيلًا
And [it is] a Qur'an which We have separated [by intervals] that you might recite it to the people over a prolonged period  . And We have sent it down progressively.
but later on this word left it's original meaing to become synonymous to LABICA(لَبِثَ).as in the QURAN
5.3 3AKAFA(عَكَفَ)  :means to be attentive towards something out of respect.and to remain joined.and meaning to be secluded , to reform oneself and to restrain oneself. meaning at some blessed place to stay for the sake of worship and to remain.ALLAH said
Surat Al-Baqarah (The Cow) - سورة البقرة
2:187
أُحِلَّ لَكُمْ لَيْلَةَ الصِّيَامِ الرَّفَثُ إِلَىٰ نِسَائِكُمْ ۚ هُنَّ لِبَاسٌ لَّكُمْ وَأَنتُمْ لِبَاسٌ لَّهُنَّ ۗ عَلِمَ اللَّهُ أَنَّكُمْ كُنتُمْ تَخْتَانُونَ أَنفُسَكُمْ فَتَابَ عَلَيْكُمْ وَعَفَا عَنكُمْ ۖ فَالْآنَ بَاشِرُوهُنَّ وَابْتَغُوا مَا كَتَبَ اللَّهُ لَكُمْ ۚ وَكُلُوا وَاشْرَبُوا حَتَّىٰ يَتَبَيَّنَ لَكُمُ الْخَيْطُ الْأَبْيَضُ مِنَ الْخَيْطِ الْأَسْوَدِ مِنَ الْفَجْرِ ۖ ثُمَّ أَتِمُّوا الصِّيَامَ إِلَى اللَّيْلِ ۚ   وَلَا تُبَاشِرُوهُنَّ وَأَنتُمْ عَاكِفُونَ فِي الْمَسَاجِدِ ۗ تِ  لْكَ حُدُودُ اللَّهِ فَلَا تَقْرَبُوهَا ۗ كَذَٰلِكَ يُبَيِّنُ اللَّهُ آيَاتِهِ لِلنَّاسِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَّقُونَ
It has been made permissible for you the night preceding fasting to go to your wives [for sexual relations]. They are clothing for you and you are clothing for them. Allah knows that you used to deceive yourselves, so He accepted your repentance and forgave you. So now, have relations with them and seek that which Allah has decreed for you. And eat and drink until the white thread of dawn becomes distinct to you from the black thread [of night]. Then complete the fast until the sunset.   And do not have relations with them as long as you are staying for worship in the mosques  . These are the limits [set by] Allah , so do not approach them. Thus does Allah make clear His ordinances to the people that they may become righteous.
SUMMARY:
5.1 LABICA:to stay for a very long period
5.2 MAKACA:to stay in wait for something
5.3 3AKAFA:to stay at some holy place for sake o worship
NOTE: for   SAKANA   and   KHALADA(خَلَدَ)   etc please see   AABAD HUWNA[To Populate]
