فَمَكَثَ غَيْرَ بَعِيدٍ فَقَالَ أَحَطتُ بِمَا لَمْ تُحِطْ بِهِ وَجِئْتُكَ مِن سَبَإٍ بِنَبَإٍ يَقِينٍ

But the hoopoe stayed not long and said, "I have encompassed [in knowledge] that which you have not encompassed, and I have come to you from Sheba with certain news.

on a third place

Surat Al-'Isrā' (The Night Journey) - سورة الإسراء

17:106

وَقُرْآنًا فَرَقْنَاهُ لِتَقْرَأَهُ عَلَى النَّاسِ عَلَىٰ مُكْثٍ وَنَزَّلْنَاهُ تَنزِيلًا

And [it is] a Qur'an which We have separated [by intervals] that you might recite it to the people over a prolonged period. And We have sent it down progressively.

but later on this word left it's original meaing to become synonymous to LABICA(لَبِثَ).as in the QURAN

5.3 3AKAFA(عَكَفَ):means to be attentive towards something out of respect.and to remain joined.and meaning to be secluded , to reform oneself and to restrain oneself. meaning at some blessed place to stay for the sake of worship and to remain.ALLAH said

Surat Al-Baqarah (The Cow) - سورة البقرة

2:187

أُحِلَّ لَكُمْ لَيْلَةَ الصِّيَامِ الرَّفَثُ إِلَىٰ نِسَائِكُمْ ۚ هُنَّ لِبَاسٌ لَّكُمْ وَأَنتُمْ لِبَاسٌ لَّهُنَّ ۗ عَلِمَ اللَّهُ أَنَّكُمْ كُنتُمْ تَخْتَانُونَ أَنفُسَكُمْ فَتَابَ عَلَيْكُمْ وَعَفَا عَنكُمْ ۖ فَالْآنَ بَاشِرُوهُنَّ وَابْتَغُوا مَا كَتَبَ اللَّهُ لَكُمْ ۚ وَكُلُوا وَاشْرَبُوا حَتَّىٰ يَتَبَيَّنَ لَكُمُ الْخَيْطُ الْأَبْيَضُ مِنَ الْخَيْطِ الْأَسْوَدِ مِنَ الْفَجْرِ ۖ ثُمَّ أَتِمُّوا الصِّيَامَ إِلَى اللَّيْلِ ۚ وَلَا تُبَاشِرُوهُنَّ وَأَنتُمْ عَاكِفُونَ فِي الْمَسَاجِدِ ۗ تِلْكَ حُدُودُ اللَّهِ فَلَا تَقْرَبُوهَا ۗ كَذَٰلِكَ يُبَيِّنُ اللَّهُ آيَاتِهِ لِلنَّاسِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَّقُونَ

It has been made permissible for you the night preceding fasting to go to your wives [for sexual relations]. They are clothing for you and you are clothing for them. Allah knows that you used to deceive yourselves, so He accepted your repentance and forgave you. So now, have relations with them and seek that which Allah has decreed for you. And eat and drink until the white thread of dawn becomes distinct to you from the black thread [of night]. Then complete the fast until the sunset. And do not have relations with them as long as you are staying for worship in the mosques. These are the limits [set by] Allah , so do not approach them. Thus does Allah make clear His ordinances to the people that they may become righteous.

SUMMARY:

5.1 LABICA:to stay for a very long period

5.2 MAKACA:to stay in wait for something

5.3 3AKAFA:to stay at some holy place for sake o worship

NOTE: for SAKANA and KHALADA(خَلَدَ) etc please see AABAD HUWNA[To Populate]

title: content/tt/tt6.html
raw_text:
6 TIYLA AUR US KI IQSAAM [Hillock And Its Types]
SYNONYMS:RABWAH(رَبْوَة),AMTAN(اَمْتاً),HADAB(حَدَب),RAY3A(رَيْع),AHQAF(اَحْقَاف),NAJD(نَجْد)
6.1 RABWAH(رَبْوَة)  :meaning high place with crest and trough.RABA YARBUW(ربا يربوا)meaning to grow and flourish. and RABWAH is such a sandy earth, whose surface is quite high. this is commonly lush green and verdure.In the QURAN
Surat Al-Baqarah (The Cow) - سورة البقرة
2:265
وَمَثَلُ الَّذِينَ يُنفِقُونَ أَمْوَالَهُمُ ابْتِغَاءَ مَرْضَاتِ اللَّهِ وَتَثْبِيتًا مِّنْ أَنفُسِهِمْ   كَمَثَلِ جَنَّةٍ بِرَبْوَةٍ أَصَابَهَا وَابِلٌ فَآتَتْ أُكُلَهَا ضِعْفَيْنِ   فَإِن لَّمْ يُصِبْهَا وَابِلٌ فَطَلٌّ ۗ وَاللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ
And the example of those who spend their wealth seeking means to the approval of Allah and assuring [reward for] themselves is   like a garden on high ground which is hit by a downpour - so it yields its fruits in double.   And [even] if it is not hit by a downpour, then a drizzle [is sufficient]. And Allah , of what you do, is Seeing.
6.2 AMTAN(اَمْتاً)  :Height,small hillock,high place.ALLAH said
Surat Ţāhā (Ta-Ha) - سورة طه
20:107
لَّا تَرَىٰ فِيهَا عِوَجًا وَلَا أَمْتًا
You will not see therein a depression or an elevation."
6.3 HADAB(حَدَب)  :lexical meaning is protrusion and hunched back. and virtually said for high and hard ground which is of this shape.meaning such a hillock which is more in area and less in height.MUHADDAB antonym MUJAWWAF(محدّب ضد مجوّف) glass  which is used for far and short sight weakness. and magnifying glass is also called 3ADASA(عَدَسَه) as it's shape is protruded from both side like lentil pulse    grain.in    the QURAN
Surat Al-'Anbyā' (The Prophets) - سورة الأنبياء
21:96
حَتَّىٰ إِذَا فُتِحَتْ يَأْجُوجُ وَمَأْجُوجُ وَهُم مِّن كُلِّ حَدَبٍ يَنسِلُونَ
Until when [the dam of] Gog and Magog has been opened and they, from every elevation, descend
6.4 RAY3A(رَيْع)  :is plural of RAY3AT(ريعة) meaning high valley.livable valleys between mountains. and RAY3AH(ريعة) meaning high hillock.place of flowing water from high of valley.wide mountainous path.ALLAH said
Surat Ash-Shu`arā' (The Poets) - سورة الشعراء
26:128
أَتَبْنُونَ بِكُلِّ رِيعٍ آيَةً تَعْبَثُونَ
Do you construct on every elevation a sign, amusing yourselves,
6.5 AHQAF(اَحْقَاف)  :is plural of HAQF(حقف) meaning rough hillock of sand.long and complicated patch of sand.and AHQAF meaning hills of    sand-desert.name    of a desert.ALLAH said
Surat Al-'Aĥqāf (The Wind-Curved Sandhills) - سورة الأحقاف
46:21
وَاذْكُرْ أَخَا عَادٍ إِذْ أَنذَرَ قَوْمَهُ بِالْأَحْقَافِ   وَقَدْ خَلَتِ النُّذُرُ مِن بَيْنِ يَدَيْهِ وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِ أَلَّا تَعْبُدُوا إِلَّا اللَّهَ إِنِّي أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
And mention, [O Muhammad], the brother of 'Aad, when he warned his people in the [region of] al-Ahqaf -   and warners had already passed on before him and after him - [saying], "Do not worship except Allah . Indeed, I fear for you the punishment of a terrible day."
6.6 NAJD(نَجْد)  :High and Hard Earth, also said for hillock, and also breast, and meaning small mountain. then NAJD is also trough/low and also the high path which leads to vale. and also the one descending.ALLAH said
Surat Al-Balad (The City) - سورة البلد
90:10
وَهَدَيْنَاهُ النَّجْدَيْنِ
And have shown him the two ways?
Surat Al-Balad (The City) - سورة البلد
90:11
فَلَا اقْتَحَمَ الْعَقَبَةَ
But he has not broken through the difficult pass.
SUMMARY:
6.1 RABWAH:high and soft sandy land
6.2 AMTAN:small rough hillock
6.3 HADAB:such a hillock whose area is more and heigh is less
6.4 RAY3A:livable valleys between mountains
6.5 AHQAF:desert.long and complicated sandy hillock
6.6 NAJD:vale and the path to ascend to and descend from it

title: content/tt/tt7.html
raw_text:
7 TAYRH(KAJIY)TAYRHA HUWNA [crooked(Crotchetness)To be awry]
SYNONYMS:3IWAJ(عوج),ZAYGH(زيغ),ILHAD(اِلحاد),JAWR(جَوْر),NAKAB(نَكب)
7.1 3IWAJ(عوج)  :meaning some standing thing being crooked for e.g wall or tree's upper part being crooked and A3WAJ(اَعْوَج) meaning man with crooked walk.and AL3AWJ(العَوْج) is that crookedness which can be seen with eyes and AL3IWAJ(العِوَج) is that crookedness which can be seen with intellect and widsom.but from the Ayah below this doesn't seem to be correct.and ALLAH knows best.
Surat Ţāhā (Ta-Ha) - سورة طه
20:107
لَّا تَرَىٰ فِيهَا عِوَجًا وَلَا أَمْتًا
You will not see therein a depression or an elevation."
3WJ(عوج) and AMT(امت) are antonyms.meaning 'up and down' and as per KHALYL these both words are synonyms or having same meaning which can be used in place of one    another.in    any case 3WJ has vast    meaning.in    apparent things it means up down and turn. and in literal meaning it means complication,problem or doubts. ALLAH said
Surat Al-Kahf (The Cave) - سورة الكهف
18:1
الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَنزَلَ عَلَىٰ عَبْدِهِ الْكِتَابَ وَلَمْ يَجْعَل لَّهُ عِوَجًا ۜ
[All] praise is [due] to Allah , who has sent down upon His Servant the Book and has not made therein any deviance.
7.2 ZAYGH(زيغ)  :ZAGH(زاغ)meaning to deviate from right path.ZAGH ALBASR(زاغ البصر) meaning tiring of sight. and as per Imam Raghib ,sight make a mistake and move to one side.this word is commonly used in literal meaning. and its meaning is variation,crookedness and deviation in angle of view or point of view. ALLAH said
Surat 'Āli `Imrān (Family of Imran) - سورة آل عمران
3:7
هُوَ الَّذِي أَنزَلَ عَلَيْكَ الْكِتَابَ مِنْهُ آيَاتٌ مُّحْكَمَاتٌ هُنَّ أُمُّ الْكِتَابِ وَأُخَرُ مُتَشَابِهَاتٌ ۖ   فَأَمَّا الَّذِينَ فِي قُلُوبِهِمْ زَيْغٌ فَيَتَّبِعُونَ مَا تَشَابَهَ مِنْهُ   ابْتِغَاءَ الْفِتْنَةِ وَابْتِغَاءَ تَأْوِيلِهِ ۗ وَمَا يَعْلَمُ تَأْوِيلَهُ إِلَّا اللَّهُ ۗ وَالرَّاسِخُونَ فِي الْعِلْمِ يَقُولُونَ آمَنَّا بِهِ كُلٌّ مِّنْ عِندِ رَبِّنَا ۗ وَمَا يَذَّكَّرُ إِلَّا أُولُو الْأَلْبَابِ
It is He who has sent down to you, [O Muhammad], the Book; in it are verses [that are] precise - they are the foundation of the Book - and others unspecific.   As for those in whose hearts is deviation [from truth], they will follow that of it which is unspecific,  seeking discord and seeking an interpretation [suitable to them]. And no one knows its [true] interpretation except Allah . But those firm in knowledge say, "We believe in it. All [of it] is from our Lord." And no one will be reminded except those of understanding.
another place it is said:
Surat Aş-Şaf (The Ranks) - سورة الصف
61:5
وَإِذْ قَالَ مُوسَىٰ لِقَوْمِهِ يَا قَوْمِ لِمَ تُؤْذُونَنِي وَقَد تَّعْلَمُونَ أَنِّي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ إِلَيْكُمْ ۖ   فَلَمَّا زَاغُوا أَزَاغَ اللَّهُ قُلُوبَهُمْ   ۚ وَاللَّهُ لَا يَهْدِي الْقَوْمَ الْفَاسِقِينَ
And [mention, O Muhammad], when Moses said to his people, "O my people, why do you harm me while you certainly know that I am the messenger of Allah to you?"   And when they deviated, Allah caused their hearts to deviate.   And Allah does not guide the defiantly disobedient people.
7.3 ILHAD(الْحَدَ)  :LAHD(لَحْد) meaning grave and its back side. and ALHADA(الْحَدَ) meaning to stay on any one side from the right path. and ALHADA ASSAHMI ALHADAF(الْحَدَ السَّهْمُ الْهَدَفَ) meaning arrow hitting any one side of the target. and ALHADA 3ANI ADDIYN(الْحَدَ عَنِ الدِّيْن) meaning to be sarcastic in religion. and this acuteness relates to beliefs. like doub in the existence and attribute of god, or to deny miracles.yet this doesn't makes a human disbeliever. ALLAH said
Surat Al-Ĥaj (The Pilgrimage) - سورة الحج
22:25
إِنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا وَيَصُدُّونَ عَن سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ وَالْمَسْجِدِ الْحَرَامِ الَّذِي جَعَلْنَاهُ لِلنَّاسِ سَوَاءً الْعَاكِفُ فِيهِ وَالْبَادِ ۚ   وَمَن يُرِدْ فِيهِ بِإِلْحَادٍ بِظُلْمٍ نُّذِقْهُ مِنْ عَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ
Indeed, those who have disbelieved and avert [people] from the way of Allah and [from] al-Masjid al-Haram, which We made for the people - equal are the resident therein and one from outside;   and [also] whoever intends [a deed] therein of deviation [in religion] or wrongdoing - We will make him taste of a painful punishment.
another place it is said:
Surat Al-'A`rāf (The Heights) - سورة الأعراف
7:180
وَلِلَّهِ الْأَسْمَاءُ الْحُسْنَىٰ فَادْعُوهُ بِهَا ۖ وَذَرُوا الَّذِينَ يُلْحِدُونَ فِي أَسْمَائِهِ   ۚ سَيُجْزَوْنَ مَا كَانُوا يَعْمَلُونَ
And to Allah belong the best names, so invoke Him by them. And leave [the company of] those who practice deviation concerning His names  . They will be recompensed for what they have been doing.
7.4 JAWR(جَوْر)  :JARA(جَارَ) meaning MAYL 3N ALTRYQ(مَيْل عن الطريق) meaning to incline towards one side of the path and meaning to stop from obeying law of shariah(Islamic jurisprudence). and this crotchetness relates to renounce shariah orders. and JA-R(جائر) meaning to lean towards onse    side.to    incline towards excess.ALLAH said
Surat An-Naĥl (The Bee) - سورة النحل
16:9
وَعَلَى اللَّهِ قَصْدُ السَّبِيلِ وَمِنْهَا جَائِرٌ   ۚ وَلَوْ شَاءَ لَهَدَاكُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
And upon Allah is the direction of the [right] way, and among the various paths are those deviating  . And if He willed, He could have guided you all.
7.5 NAKAB(نَكَبَ)  : NAKAB ALINA-A(نَكَبَ الاِنَاءَ) meaning whatever is in the vessel ,chuck it away by lowering it. and NAKABATI ARRIYH(نَكَبَتِ الرِّيْح) meaning crosswinds. and ALANKAB() a)meaning one having crooked shoulder b) that camel which walk down(not upright). and ALANKAB(الانْكَبْ) meaning one keeping one shoulder higher than other,tyrant,one who misbehave. and NAKUB (plural NUKUWB and NAKBAT)[نَكُب ج نُكُوْب نكبات]meaning troubles. so NAKABA is such an inclination and crookedness which results in flaw,tyranny,or trouble. ALLAH said.
Surat Al-Mu'minūn (The Believers) - سورة المؤمنون
23:74
وَإِنَّ الَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِالْآخِرَةِ عَنِ الصِّرَاطِ لَنَاكِبُونَ
But indeed, those who do not believe in the Hereafter are deviating from the path.
SUMMARY:

7 TAYRH(KAJIY)TAYRHA HUWNA [crooked(Crotchetness)To be awry]

SYNONYMS:3IWAJ(عوج),ZAYGH(زيغ),ILHAD(اِلحاد),JAWR(جَوْر),NAKAB(نَكب)

7.1 3IWAJ(عوج):meaning some standing thing being crooked for e.g wall or tree's upper part being crooked and A3WAJ(اَعْوَج) meaning man with crooked walk.and AL3AWJ(العَوْج) is that crookedness which can be seen with eyes and AL3IWAJ(العِوَج) is that crookedness which can be seen with intellect and widsom.but from the Ayah below this doesn't seem to be correct.and ALLAH knows best.

Surat Ţāhā (Ta-Ha) - سورة طه

20:107

لَّا تَرَىٰ فِيهَا عِوَجًا وَلَا أَمْتًا

You will not see therein a depression or an elevation."

3WJ(عوج) and AMT(امت) are antonyms.meaning 'up and down' and as per KHALYL these both words are synonyms or having same meaning which can be used in place of one another.in any case 3WJ has vast meaning.in apparent things it means up down and turn. and in literal meaning it means complication,problem or doubts. ALLAH said

Surat Al-Kahf (The Cave) - سورة الكهف

18:1

الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَنزَلَ عَلَىٰ عَبْدِهِ الْكِتَابَ وَلَمْ يَجْعَل لَّهُ عِوَجًا ۜ

[All] praise is [due] to Allah , who has sent down upon His Servant the Book and has not made therein any deviance.

7.2 ZAYGH(زيغ):ZAGH(زاغ)meaning to deviate from right path.ZAGH ALBASR(زاغ البصر) meaning tiring of sight. and as per Imam Raghib ,sight make a mistake and move to one side.this word is commonly used in literal meaning. and its meaning is variation,crookedness and deviation in angle of view or point of view. ALLAH said

Surat 'Āli `Imrān (Family of Imran) - سورة آل عمران

3:7

هُوَ الَّذِي أَنزَلَ عَلَيْكَ الْكِتَابَ مِنْهُ آيَاتٌ مُّحْكَمَاتٌ هُنَّ أُمُّ الْكِتَابِ وَأُخَرُ مُتَشَابِهَاتٌ ۖ فَأَمَّا الَّذِينَ فِي قُلُوبِهِمْ زَيْغٌ فَيَتَّبِعُونَ مَا تَشَابَهَ مِنْهُ ابْتِغَاءَ الْفِتْنَةِ وَابْتِغَاءَ تَأْوِيلِهِ ۗ وَمَا يَعْلَمُ تَأْوِيلَهُ إِلَّا اللَّهُ ۗ وَالرَّاسِخُونَ فِي الْعِلْمِ يَقُولُونَ آمَنَّا بِهِ كُلٌّ مِّنْ عِندِ رَبِّنَا ۗ وَمَا يَذَّكَّرُ إِلَّا أُولُو الْأَلْبَابِ

It is He who has sent down to you, [O Muhammad], the Book; in it are verses [that are] precise - they are the foundation of the Book - and others unspecific. As for those in whose hearts is deviation [from truth], they will follow that of it which is unspecific,seeking discord and seeking an interpretation [suitable to them]. And no one knows its [true] interpretation except Allah . But those firm in knowledge say, "We believe in it. All [of it] is from our Lord." And no one will be reminded except those of understanding.

another place it is said:

Surat Aş-Şaf (The Ranks) - سورة الصف

61:5

وَإِذْ قَالَ مُوسَىٰ لِقَوْمِهِ يَا قَوْمِ لِمَ تُؤْذُونَنِي وَقَد تَّعْلَمُونَ أَنِّي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ إِلَيْكُمْ ۖ فَلَمَّا زَاغُوا أَزَاغَ اللَّهُ قُلُوبَهُمْ ۚ وَاللَّهُ لَا يَهْدِي الْقَوْمَ الْفَاسِقِينَ

And [mention, O Muhammad], when Moses said to his people, "O my people, why do you harm me while you certainly know that I am the messenger of Allah to you?" And when they deviated, Allah caused their hearts to deviate. And Allah does not guide the defiantly disobedient people.

7.3 ILHAD(الْحَدَ):LAHD(لَحْد) meaning grave and its back side. and ALHADA(الْحَدَ) meaning to stay on any one side from the right path. and ALHADA ASSAHMI ALHADAF(الْحَدَ السَّهْمُ الْهَدَفَ) meaning arrow hitting any one side of the target. and ALHADA 3ANI ADDIYN(الْحَدَ عَنِ الدِّيْن) meaning to be sarcastic in religion. and this acuteness relates to beliefs. like doub in the existence and attribute of god, or to deny miracles.yet this doesn't makes a human disbeliever. ALLAH said

Surat Al-Ĥaj (The Pilgrimage) - سورة الحج

22:25

إِنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا وَيَصُدُّونَ عَن سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ وَالْمَسْجِدِ الْحَرَامِ الَّذِي جَعَلْنَاهُ لِلنَّاسِ سَوَاءً الْعَاكِفُ فِيهِ وَالْبَادِ ۚ وَمَن يُرِدْ فِيهِ بِإِلْحَادٍ بِظُلْمٍ نُّذِقْهُ مِنْ عَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ

Indeed, those who have disbelieved and avert [people] from the way of Allah and [from] al-Masjid al-Haram, which We made for the people - equal are the resident therein and one from outside; and [also] whoever intends [a deed] therein of deviation [in religion] or wrongdoing - We will make him taste of a painful punishment.

another place it is said:

Surat Al-'A`rāf (The Heights) - سورة الأعراف

7:180

وَلِلَّهِ الْأَسْمَاءُ الْحُسْنَىٰ فَادْعُوهُ بِهَا ۖ وَذَرُوا الَّذِينَ يُلْحِدُونَ فِي أَسْمَائِهِ ۚ سَيُجْزَوْنَ مَا كَانُوا يَعْمَلُونَ

And to Allah belong the best names, so invoke Him by them. And leave [the company of] those who practice deviation concerning His names. They will be recompensed for what they have been doing.

7.4 JAWR(جَوْر):JARA(جَارَ) meaning MAYL 3N ALTRYQ(مَيْل عن الطريق) meaning to incline towards one side of the path and meaning to stop from obeying law of shariah(Islamic jurisprudence). and this crotchetness relates to renounce shariah orders. and JA-R(جائر) meaning to lean towards onse side.to incline towards excess.ALLAH said

Surat An-Naĥl (The Bee) - سورة النحل

16:9

وَعَلَى اللَّهِ قَصْدُ السَّبِيلِ وَمِنْهَا جَائِرٌ ۚ وَلَوْ شَاءَ لَهَدَاكُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ

And upon Allah is the direction of the [right] way, and among the various paths are those deviating. And if He willed, He could have guided you all.

7.5 NAKAB(نَكَبَ): NAKAB ALINA-A(نَكَبَ الاِنَاءَ) meaning whatever is in the vessel ,chuck it away by lowering it. and NAKABATI ARRIYH(نَكَبَتِ الرِّيْح) meaning crosswinds. and ALANKAB() a)meaning one having crooked shoulder b) that camel which walk down(not upright). and ALANKAB(الانْكَبْ) meaning one keeping one shoulder higher than other,tyrant,one who misbehave. and NAKUB (plural NUKUWB and NAKBAT)[نَكُب ج نُكُوْب نكبات]meaning troubles. so NAKABA is such an inclination and crookedness which results in flaw,tyranny,or trouble. ALLAH said.

Surat Al-Mu'minūn (The Believers) - سورة المؤمنون

23:74

وَإِنَّ الَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِالْآخِرَةِ عَنِ الصِّرَاطِ لَنَاكِبُونَ

But indeed, those who do not believe in the Hereafter are deviating from the path.

SUMMARY:

7.1 3IWAJ:in bodies,height,lowness,turn,crookedness,inclination. and in literal meaning then it means complexity,complication and doubt

7.2 ZAYGH:crookedness in view point and beliefs

7.3 ILHAD:crookedness in the existence and attributes of god  and beliefs

7.4 JAWR:recklessness in the fulfillment of shariah law

7.5 NAKAB:such crookedness and inclination which causes flaw,oppression and disobedience

8 TAYK LAGANA [To Prop up]
SYNONYMS:ITTAKA(اِتَّكَاَ),IRTAFAQA(اِرْتَفَقَ)
8.1 ITTAKA(اِتَّكَاَ)  :ATKAA(اَتْكَاَ) meaning to setup cushion for some one.and ATKA 3ALA ASSHAYEE(اَتْكَاَ عَلَي الشَّيْ) meaning to take support, to prop up.TAWAKKAA 3ALA AL3ASA(تَوَكَّاَ عَلَي الْعَصَا) meaning he prop up on the staff/wand. and TAKATUN(تَكَاةٌ) meanign the thing on which one props up. for e.g staff,sword,bow etc and ITTAKAA(اِتَّكَاَ) meanign to sit by proping up.ALLAH said
Surat Al-'Insān (The Man) - سورة الانسان
76:13
مُّتَّكِئِينَ فِيهَا عَلَى الْأَرَائِكِ   ۖ لَا يَرَوْنَ فِيهَا شَمْسًا وَلَا زَمْهَرِيرًا
[They will be] reclining therein on adorned couches.   They will not see therein any [burning] sun or [freezing] cold.
8.2 IRTAFAQA(اِرْتَفَقَ)  :MARFAQ(مرفق) meaning elbow and every that thing from which support can be taken. and MIRFIQAH(مِرفَقَة) meaning small cushion.and IRTAFAQA meaning to prop up on elbow or cushion.and MURTAFAQ(مُرْتَفَق) is such a place where cushions are setup and every type of comfort is available.ALLAH said
Surat Al-Kahf (The Cave) - سورة الكهف
18:31
أُولَٰئِكَ لَهُمْ جَنَّاتُ عَدْنٍ تَجْرِي مِن تَحْتِهِمُ الْأَنْهَارُ يُحَلَّوْنَ فِيهَا مِنْ أَسَاوِرَ مِن ذَهَبٍ وَيَلْبَسُونَ ثِيَابًا خُضْرًا مِّن سُندُسٍ وَإِسْتَبْرَقٍ مُّتَّكِئِينَ فِيهَا عَلَى الْأَرَائِكِ ۚ   نِعْمَ الثَّوَابُ وَحَسُنَتْ مُرْتَفَقًا
Those will have gardens of perpetual residence; beneath them rivers will flow. They will be adorned therein with bracelets of gold and will wear green garments of fine silk and brocade, reclining therein on adorned couches.   Excellent is the reward, and good is the resting place  .
SUMMARY:
ITTAKAA:to prop up with any thing and IRTAFAQA only to prop up with comfortable things
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
End of TA(ٹ)
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Translation: pages 871,872 and part of 873.
و
1.  كثير   (katheer)  :  opposite:  قليل   (  qaleel  ).  meaning:a  bundant.
It is used for quantity as well as volume,and in both physical/material
as well as literal sense.Allah SWT says:
and whoever has been given wisdom has certainly been given much good.(2:269)
In the verse quoted above  كثير   (  katheer)   has been used for volume. In the segment of the verse quoted below it has been used in terms of quantity:
So We gave the ones who believed among them their reward, but many of them are defiantly disobedient.57:27
Whereas in   كوثر     (kauthar) there is a lot of exaggeration.   تکاثر الشئی   means   abundance of some  thing   and   رَجُلُن كَاثِرُن   means   a rich man   and also خِير كَثِير (much goodness).  كوثر   is  also the name of a stream in Jannah (Mf).Allah SWT says:
Indeed, We have granted you, [O Muhammad], al-Kawthar.:108:1
2.  جمّ  :   meaning:  collection of something in one place in a large quantity   (M-L)  جمّ البِثَر   means   A well with abundant water.  And   جمَّ المِكيَال  meaning   to fill the measuring cup to the brim   (Mnjd).This is used in both physical/material and literal senses.Allah SWT says:
And you love wealth with immense love.:89:20
3.  مَركُوم :   is from  رَكَمَ   meaning   to  fold something on itself.  Then to fold it a third time is also considered the same.Similarly when something is collected in a huge quantity or is in a pile then it is   رُكَام   and   مَركُوم   and   رَكَمَ السّحَاب   means   the cloud has thickened   (M-Q) and  سحَابُ مَركُوم   means   thick cloud.  Allah SWT says:
Page 872
[This is] so that Allah may distinguish the wicked from the good and place the wicked some of them upon others and heap them all together:8:37
4.  لُبِدَ  :  and  لِبد   and   لبده   mean neatly folded hair or wool.Woolen felt rug.
مَالٌ لُبدٌ:  meaning   abundant wealth.  And   لَبَّدَ شعرُهُ   means
gluing together hair to make like a woolen felt rug.
لبد الشَىء:  means   something like a woolen felt rug.  (Mnjd)
That is, to gather something that is scattered and make it compact.Allah SWT says:
He says, "I have spent wealth in abundance.":90:6
And when it is referred to popular opinion,it would mean:
To be over crowded.  Allah Swt says:
And that when the Servant of Allah stood up supplicating Him, they almost became about him a compacted mass."72:19
5.   رَغَدَ:   is only used for   Provision   or   Food.  To eat freely/sufficiently or to get sufficient provisions/livelihood.(M-L) Allah SWT says:
and eat therefrom in [ease and] abundance from wherever you will. 2:35
6.   غَدَقَ :  meaning   to rain great quantity and as a blessing  .
(M-L)Allah SWT says:
And [ Allah revealed] that if they had remained straight on the way, We would have given them abundant provision:72:1
7.   ثَجّاج
: ثَجَّ   meaning   heavy downpour and flowing of water.  (Mf) and
ثَجّاج   meaning   surge of water.(  M-Q).Allah SWT says:
And sent down, from the rain clouds, pouring water.78:14
8.   موفُور
:  وَفَر :  is used for completion or abundance of something.(M-L)and
وَفَّر   means   to complete,to increase   (Mnjd) and   وَفَرَ جَزَاءُهُ
meaning   paid him back in full measure and gave
even more  . (Mf).Allah SWT says:
[ Allah ] said, "Go, for whoever of them follows you, indeed Hell will be the recompense of you - an ample recompense.17:63.
Summary:
1.   كثير   :   it is used quite commonly.The abundance in terms of
volume or quantity in anything.
2.   جمّ   :   collection of something in a large quantity in one place.
3.   مَركُوم   :   folded up into a pile.
4.   لُبِدَ   :   the gathering of scattered pieces of something into a pile in
one place.
5.   رَغَدَ   :   only for abundance of food and provisions.
6.   غَدَقَ   :   for abundance of water,when it is also beneficial.
7.   ثَجّاج     :   continous and abundant downpour and flowing of water.
8.     موفُور     :   is used for completion with some addition.
For incidences see "Stories".

اَصحاب:
(singular (صاحب refers to someone or something
that lives with you for a long time or is there to support you for an
extended period of time. This companionship can be with another human
being, with an animal, with a place or of a time period. However this word

3 WARACAT [Inheritance]
Synonyms: WALAYAT ولايت , WARACAT وراثت
3.1 WALAYAH(ولاية)  :ALWALA-اَلْوَلاَء meaning legacy obtained of freed   slave.as   Prophetic Narration (PBUH) ALWALA- LIMAN A3TAQA اَلْوَلاَء لِمَنْ اَعْتَقَ (Bukhari) meaning legacy of slave is of the one who frees him. so WALA- actual meaning is only legacy or    residue.as   per people of arabia there exist different traditions of inheritance.for e.g they only consider the heir to their inheritance of that male offspring who is able to hold their sword after them (being deceased).and there is no male offspring then some male near relative would be declared the heir or guardian and it's order would be as such. after offspring(if there isn't any male offspring) ,father (of the deceased).if there is no father(alive) then brother and if there is no brother then paternal uncle etc. then  in them exist the tradition of WALA-.which means that one person affirms vow with other that they will be helping each other and will be heir to each other.
Islam also give rights to females as well along with males.and initially accepted this right of Vowing and WALA-.but declared its basis to be ISLAM and HIJRAH (migration). ALLAH said
Surah Al-Anfal (The Spoils of War): سُوۡرَةُ الاٴنفَال 8:72
إِنَّ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَهَاجَرُوا وَجَاهَدُوا بِأَمْوَالِهِمْ وَأَنفُسِهِمْ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ وَالَّذِينَ آوَوا وَّنَصَرُوا أُولَٰئِكَ بَعْضُهُمْ أَوْلِيَاءُ بَعْضٍ ۚ وَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَلَمْ يُهَاجِرُوا مَا لَكُم مِّن وَلَايَتِهِم مِّن شَيْءٍ حَتَّىٰ يُهَاجِرُوا
Surely those who believed and fled (their homes) and struggled hard in Allah's way with their property and their souls, and those who gave shelter and helped-- these are guardians of each other; and (as for) those who believed and did not fly, not yours is their guardianship until they fly; and if they seek aid from you in the matter of religion, aid is incumbent on you except against a people between whom and you there is a treaty, and Allah sees what you do.
And MAULA (مَوْلٰی) (Plural MAWALI (مَوَالی)) means an heir. Allah says in the Quran
Surah An-Nisa (The women): سورۃ النِّسا 4:33
وَلِكُلٍّ جَعَلْنَا مَوَالِيَ مِمَّا تَرَكَ الْوَالِدَانِ وَالْأَقْرَبُونَ
And for all, We have made heirs to what is left by parents and relatives.
This law of inheritance was a part of series of fraternization. But when the living conditions of Muhajreen (Migrators i.e. the people who left Makkah and migrated to Medina) improved then this law of inheritance was abolished and only the relatives became the lawful heirs. Nonetheless it was advised to give something to friends as a gesture of good will. Allah says in the Quran
Surah Al-Ahzaab (The clans): سورۃ الأحزَاب 33:6
فِي كِتَابِ اللَّهِ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُهَاجِرِينَ إِلَّا أَن تَفْعَلُوا إِلَىٰ أَوْلِيَائِكُم مَّعْرُوفًا
and the possessors of relationship have the better claim in the ordinance of Allah to inheritance, one with respect to another, than (other) believers, and (than) those who have fled (their homes), except that you do some good to your friends;
3.2 WIRATHA (وِرَاثَۃ)  : Those Shariah laws and divine decrees, according to which the possession of a dead goes to other people. This inheritance is not only related to property and money but also about habits and qualities. Prophet Muhammad (S.A.A.W) said “الْعُلَمَآءُ وَرَثَۃُ الأَنْبِیَاءِ” ‘The Scholars are the Inheritors of the Prophets’ and here the WARATHA (وَرَاثَۃ) mentioned is not wealth and money but knowledge and preaching. And WARITH (وَرِثَ) means to become the inheritor of a dead. AWRATHA (اَوْرَثَ) means to appoint an heir. And WARITHA (وَرَاثَۃ) and TURATH (تُرَاث) means legacy and inheritance. Allah says in the Quran
Surah An-Naml (The ant): سورۃ النَّمل 27:16
وَوَرِثَ سُلَيْمَانُ دَاوُودَ
And Solomon was David's heir.
Summary  :
3.1 WALAYAT:  Law of inheritance as a part of series of fraternization which was later abolished.
3.2 WARATHAT: The portion of inheritance of relatives according to the Shariah Law.

4 WAQT [Time]
Synonyms: WAQT, MEEQAAT, HEEN, HEENAIZN, AAN, AANAFA, AJL
4.1 WAQT (وقت):   Famous word for time. ALWAQT (الوقت) means ZAMANUM-MALUM (زَمَانٌ مَّعْلُوْمٌ) (known time), (plural AUKAAT (اوقات)) According to Imam Raghib The word refers to the last limit of the appointed time for a task. Allah says in the Quran
Page 876
Surah Al-Araf (The heights): سورۃ الأعرَاف 7:187
قُلْ إِنَّمَا عِلْمُهَا عِندَ اللَّهِ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
Say, "Its knowledge is only with my Lord. None will reveal its time except Him.
And MEEQAAT (میقات) is the noun of place or time, Used both for time and place. (plural AWAQIYAT (وقت)). In the ayah below this word is used for time.
Surah Al-Araf (The heights): سورۃ الأعرَاف 7:142
وَوَاعَدْنَا مُوسَىٰ ثَلَاثِينَ لَيْلَةً وَأَتْمَمْنَاهَا بِعَشْرٍ فَتَمَّ مِيقَاتُ رَبِّهِ أَرْبَعِينَ لَيْلَةً
And We made an appointment with Moses for thirty nights and perfected them by [the addition of] ten; so the term of his Lord was completed as forty nights.
And in the Following ayah the word MEEQAAT (میقات) is used for both place and time, meaning the time and place is specified.
Surah Al-Araf (The heights): سورۃ الأعرَاف 7:143
وَلَمَّا جَاءَ مُوسَىٰ لِمِيقَاتِنَا وَكَلَّمَهُ رَبُّهُ
And when Moses arrived at Our appointed time and his Lord spoke to him,
4.2 HEEN (حِیْن):   Is that time at which some news reaches or one gets something. It’s a hidden time or place, an unspecified time (Plural AHYAN (احیان)). And AHYANAN (اَحْیَانًا) means time to time; sometimes. In the Quran
Surah Al-Baqarah (The cow): سورۃ البَقَرَۃ  2:36
وَلَكُمْ فِي الْأَرْضِ مُسْتَقَرٌّ وَمَتَاعٌ إِلَىٰ حِينٍ
you will have upon the earth a place of settlement and provision for a time."
When HEEN (حین) is followed by IZ (اذ) it becomes HEENAIZN (حین), then it refers to a certain time, or ‘this time’. Allah says in the Quran
Surah Al-Waqiah (The Inevitable): سُوۡرَةُ الواقِعَة 56:84
وَأَنتُمْ حِينَئِذٍ تَنظُرُونَ
And you are at that time looking on –
4.3 AAN (اٰن):   AAN-YAANI (اٰن یانی) means the time is here. Something reaching its peak or its maximum strength.  Allah says in the Quran
Surah Al-Hadeed (The Iron): سورة الحديد 57:16
أَلَمْ يَأْنِ لِلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا أَن تَخْشَعَ قُلُوبُهُمْ لِذِكْرِ اللَّهِ
Has the time not come for those who have believed that their hearts should become humbly submissive at the remembrance of Allah
And AAN (اٰن) means Time (Plural AANAA’ (اٰناء) means times). This word is accompanied by an AL (ال). ALAAN (الئٰن) means current time, this time, now. Allah says in the Quran
Surah Al-Anfal (The Spoils of War): سُوۡرَةُ الاٴنفَال 8:66
الْآنَ خَفَّفَ اللَّهُ عَنكُمْ وَعَلِمَ أَنَّ فِيكُمْ ضَعْفًا
Now, Allah has lightened [the hardship] for you, and He knows that among you is weakness.
4.3 AANAFA (انِفًا):   ANF (اَنْف) means a nose, the highest part of something or its start. ANF-AL-JABL (انف الجبل) means the peak of mountain. And ANF-AL-HAYAH (انف الحیۃ) means edge of beard. ASTANF-ASHAI (استانف الشئ) means to hold the edge of start of something or begin it. ASTANF-AL-AMR (اسانف الامر) means to restart a task anew   (dictionary al Manjad)  . And ANIFA (اٰنِفا) means right now. At the start of this matter or task; A few moments ago   (dictionary al Manjad)  . Allah says in the Quran
Surah Muhammad (Muhammad): سُوۡرَةُ محَمَّد 47:16
قَالُوا لِلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا الْعِلْمَ مَاذَا قَالَ آنِفًا
they say to those who have received knowledge: "What has he said just now?
Page 877
4.5 AJL (اجل):   AJILA (اَجِلَ) means to delay. AAJL (اٰجل) and AAJLAH (اٰجلہ) happening with delay, Hereafter   (dictionary al Manjad)  . Opposite of AAJL (اٰجل) is AA’JL (عاجل) both of these words are famous words used in the payment of HAQ-MAHR.  AA’JL (عاجل) means something paid immediately and AAJL (اٰجل) means a debt or credit. AJAL (اَجَل) means a term or time period, death   (dictionary al Manjad)  . Thus the AJAL (اجل) refers to the mid time from the current time to the specified time or sometimes till the death. Its use is quite elaborate.  Allah says in the Quran
Surah Al-Isra (The Night Journey): سُوۡرَةُ الإسرَاء 17:99
وَجَعَلَ لَهُمْ أَجَلًا لَّا رَيْبَ فِيهِ
And He has appointed for them a term, about which there is no doubt.
In this Ayah the word AJAL (اجل) can be translated as time, or term or specific time period even death, all of these words fit into it.
Summary:
4.1 WAQT, MEEQAAT: The decided time or place.
4.2 HEEN: An unspecified time.
4.3 AAN and ALAAN: Now, current time.
4.4 AANAFA: Right now, a few moments back, at start of conversation.
4.5 AJL: The mid of the time between specified time and current time.

4.2 HEEN (حِیْن): Is that time at which some news reaches or one gets something. It’s a hidden time or place, an unspecified time (Plural AHYAN (احیان)). And AHYANAN (اَحْیَانًا) means time to time; sometimes. In the Quran

Surah Al-Baqarah (The cow): سورۃ البَقَرَۃ  2:36

وَلَكُمْ فِي الْأَرْضِ مُسْتَقَرٌّ وَمَتَاعٌ إِلَىٰ حِينٍ

you will have upon the earth a place of settlement and provision for a time."

 

When HEEN (حین) is followed by IZ (اذ) it becomes HEENAIZN (حین), then it refers to a certain time, or ‘this time’. Allah says in the Quran

Surah Al-Waqiah (The Inevitable): سُوۡرَةُ الواقِعَة 56:84

وَأَنتُمْ حِينَئِذٍ تَنظُرُونَ

And you are at that time looking on –

 

4.3 AAN (اٰن): AAN-YAANI (اٰن یانی) means the time is here. Something reaching its peak or its maximum strength.  Allah says in the Quran

Surah Al-Hadeed (The Iron): سورة الحديد 57:16

أَلَمْ يَأْنِ لِلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا أَن تَخْشَعَ قُلُوبُهُمْ لِذِكْرِ اللَّهِ

Has the time not come for those who have believed that their hearts should become humbly submissive at the remembrance of Allah

 

And AAN (اٰن) means Time (Plural AANAA’ (اٰناء) means times). This word is accompanied by an AL (ال). ALAAN (الئٰن) means current time, this time, now. Allah says in the Quran

Surah Al-Anfal (The Spoils of War): سُوۡرَةُ الاٴنفَال 8:66

الْآنَ خَفَّفَ اللَّهُ عَنكُمْ وَعَلِمَ أَنَّ فِيكُمْ ضَعْفًا

Now, Allah has lightened [the hardship] for you, and He knows that among you is weakness.

 

4.3 AANAFA (انِفًا): ANF (اَنْف) means a nose, the highest part of something or its start. ANF-AL-JABL (انف الجبل) means the peak of mountain. And ANF-AL-HAYAH (انف الحیۃ) means edge of beard. ASTANF-ASHAI (استانف الشئ) means to hold the edge of start of something or begin it. ASTANF-AL-AMR (اسانف الامر) means to restart a task anew (dictionary al Manjad). And ANIFA (اٰنِفا) means right now. At the start of this matter or task; A few moments ago (dictionary al Manjad). Allah says in the Quran      

Surah Muhammad (Muhammad): سُوۡرَةُ محَمَّد 47:16

قَالُوا لِلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا الْعِلْمَ مَاذَا قَالَ آنِفًا

 

they say to those who have received knowledge: "What has he said just now?

 

Page 877

 

4.5 AJL (اجل): AJILA (اَجِلَ) means to delay. AAJL (اٰجل) and AAJLAH (اٰجلہ) happening with delay, Hereafter (dictionary al Manjad). Opposite of AAJL (اٰجل) is AA’JL (عاجل) both of these words are famous words used in the payment of HAQ-MAHR.  AA’JL (عاجل) means something paid immediately and AAJL (اٰجل) means a debt or credit. AJAL (اَجَل) means a term or time period, death (dictionary al Manjad). Thus the AJAL (اجل) refers to the mid time from the current time to the specified time or sometimes till the death. Its use is quite elaborate.  Allah says in the Quran

Surah Al-Isra (The Night Journey): سُوۡرَةُ الإسرَاء 17:99

وَجَعَلَ لَهُمْ أَجَلًا لَّا رَيْبَ فِيهِ

And He has appointed for them a term, about which there is no doubt.

 

In this Ayah the word AJAL (اجل) can be translated as time, or term or specific time period even death, all of these words fit into it.

Summary:

4.1 WAQT, MEEQAAT: The decided time or place.

4.2 HEEN: An unspecified time.

4.3 AAN and ALAAN: Now, current time.

4.4 AANAFA: Right now, a few moments back, at start of conversation.

4.5 AJL: The mid of the time between specified time and current time.

1-- YA [Or]
Synonyms: AW اوْ AM امْ IMMA اِمَّا OR AMMA اَمَّا
1.1 AW  : to tell of two or more than two things. In the QURAN
Surat Al-Baqarah (The Cow) - سورة البقرة
2:259
أَوْ كَالَّذِي مَرَّ عَلَىٰ قَرْيَةٍ   وَهِيَ خَاوِيَةٌ عَلَىٰ عُرُوشِهَا قَالَ أَنَّىٰ يُحْيِي هَٰذِهِ اللَّهُ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَا ۖ فَأَمَاتَهُ اللَّهُ مِائَةَ عَامٍ ثُمَّ بَعَثَهُ ۖ قَالَ كَمْ لَبِثْتَ ۖ قَالَ لَبِثْتُ يَوْمًا أَوْ بَعْضَ يَوْمٍ ۖ قَالَ بَل لَّبِثْتَ مِائَةَ عَامٍ فَانظُرْ إِلَىٰ طَعَامِكَ وَشَرَابِكَ لَمْ يَتَسَنَّهْ ۖ وَانظُرْ إِلَىٰ حِمَارِكَ وَلِنَجْعَلَكَ آيَةً لِّلنَّاسِ ۖ وَانظُرْ إِلَى الْعِظَامِ كَيْفَ نُنشِزُهَا ثُمَّ نَكْسُوهَا لَحْمًا ۚ فَلَمَّا تَبَيَّنَ لَهُ قَالَ أَعْلَمُ أَنَّ اللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
Or [consider such an example] as the one who passed by a township   which had fallen into ruin. He said, "How will Allah bring this to life after its death?" So Allah caused him to die for a hundred years; then He revived him. He said, "How long have you remained?" The man said, "I have remained a day or part of a day." He said, "Rather, you have remained one hundred years. Look at your food and your drink; it has not changed with time. And look at your donkey; and We will make you a sign for the people. And look at the bones [of this donkey] - how We raise them and then We cover them with flesh." And when it became clear to him, he said, "I know that Allah is over all things competent."
1.2 AM  :حرف عطف(connective/conjunction)-it comes after Alif of interrogation to mean "equality".in the Quran
Surat An-Nāzi`āt (Those who drag forth) - سورة النازعات
79:27
أَأَنتُمْ أَشَدُّ خَلْقًا أَمِ السَّمَاءُ ۚ بَنَاهَا
Are you a more difficult creation or is the heaven? Allah constructed it.
1.3 IMMA  :to tell of every one of the things of two things and comes with recurrence.ALLAH said
Surat Al-'Insān (The Man) - سورة الانسان
76:3
إِنَّا هَدَيْنَاهُ السَّبِيلَ إِمَّا شَاكِرًا وَإِمَّا كَفُورًا
Indeed, We guided him to the way, be he grateful or be he ungrateful.

2- YAAD KARNA-AANA-RAKHNA [To Remember,Remind,To Remember(retain) ]
Synonyms: ZAKARA ذَكَرَ IDDAKARA اِدَّكَرَ HAFIZA حَفِظَ WA3A وَعَي
2.1 ZAKARA  :meaning some matter manifesting on tongue or heart whether any thing remain remembered or get recalled after being   forgotten.it  's usage is common.ALLAH said
Surat Maryam (Mary) - سورة مريم
19:67
أَوَلَا يَذْكُرُ الْإِنسَانُ أَنَّا خَلَقْنَاهُ مِن قَبْلُ وَلَمْ يَكُ شَيْئًا
Does man not remember that We created him before, while he was nothing?
and IDDAKARA meaning getting rememberance of some forgotten thing.In the QURAN
Surat Yūsuf (Joseph) - سورة يوسف
12:45
وَقَالَ الَّذِي نَجَا مِنْهُمَا وَادَّكَرَ بَعْدَ أُمَّةٍ أَنَا أُنَبِّئُكُم بِتَأْوِيلِهِ فَأَرْسِلُونِ
But the one who was freed and remembered after a time said, "I will inform you of its interpretation, so send me forth."
2.2 HAFIZA  :to remember something and then to be mindful of   it.to   prevent something from being wasted ad   destroyed.to   protect from being flawed. ALLAH said
Surat Al-Baqarah (The Cow) - سورة البقرة
2:238
حَافِظُوا عَلَى الصَّلَوَاتِ وَالصَّلَاةِ الْوُسْطَىٰ وَقُومُوا لِلَّهِ قَانِتِينَ
Maintain with care the [obligatory] prayers and [in particular] the middle prayer and stand before Allah , devoutly obedient.
2.3 WA3A  :meaning to tie up the mouth of some container after putting something inside   it. to   protect it and to not let anything comes out of it.and WI3A- meaning tied up goods.ALLAH said
Surat Al-Ĥāqqah (The Reality) - سورة الحاقة
69:12
لِنَجْعَلَهَا لَكُمْ تَذْكِرَةً وَتَعِيَهَا أُذُنٌ وَاعِيَةٌ
That We might make it for you a reminder and [that] a conscious ear would be conscious of it.
SUMMARY  :
2.1 ZAKARA:to remember-to retain-remind-to remember by tongue(speech) or heart.use in all places.and is of common usage
2.2 HAFIZA:to remember something by tongue-and preserve it in the heart and then to be mindful of it.and not to let it be forgotten
2.3 WA3A:meaning to remember and not to let it vary.

raw_text:
3 YAQEEN KARNA [To Believe-To be sure of]
Synonyms: AYQANA اَيْقَنَ ISTAYQANA اِسْتَيْقَنَ ZANNA ظَنَّ
3.1 AYQANA  :YA-QA-NA يقن meaning to leave no doubt or uncertainity. and as per Imam Raghib YA-QA-NA means to comprehend some affair/matter completely as well as reaching conclusive evidence/proof.and it's leve is above 'acquaintance' and 'tact'.and as per Abu Hilal 3skari,YAQIYN's يقين level is more than Knowledge.he writes ALYAQIYN SAKUWN ANNAFS WA NAHJ ASSADR BIMA 3ILM(اليقين سكون النفس و نهج الصدر بما علم) meaning 'YAQIYN is the rest/peace of heart and coolness of chest on known thing.ALLAH said
Surat Al-Baqarah (The Cow) - سورة البقرة
2:4
وَالَّذِينَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِمَا أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكَ وَمَا أُنزِلَ مِن قَبْلِكَ وَبِالْآخِرَةِ هُمْ يُوقِنُونَ
And who believe in what has been revealed to you, [O Muhammad], and what was revealed before you, and of the Hereafter they are certain [in faith].
and ISTAYQANA means 'to be certain of something gradually slowly after experiencing it'.ALLAH said
Surat An-Naml (The Ant) - سورة النمل
27:14
وَجَحَدُوا بِهَا وَاسْتَيْقَنَتْهَا أَنفُسُهُمْ ظُلْمًا وَعُلُوًّا ۚ فَانظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الْمُفْسِدِينَ
And they rejected them, while their [inner] selves were convinced thereof, out of injustice and haughtiness. So see how was the end of the corrupters
3.2 ZANNA  :it comes in the meaning of approximating with evidence and observation and to assume.now this assumption would be as weak as the signs and observations are.and similarly as strong as the signs and observations are. in this case of strong ZANN gives off the meaning of YAQIYN and its sign is that after ZANNA comes of normally word of ANNA اَنَّ or AN اَنْ.(for details please see GUMAN KARNA [To Assume]).ALLAH said
Surat Al-Baqarah (The Cow) - سورة البقرة
2:46
الَّذِينَ يَظُنُّونَ أَنَّهُم مُّلَاقُو رَبِّهِمْ وَأَنَّهُمْ إِلَيْهِ رَاجِعُونَ
Who are certain that they will meet their Lord and that they will return to Him.
Summary  :
3.1 AYQANA:to fully comprehend some affair and to reach its conclusive proof.
3.2 ZANNA ANNA ظَنَّ اَنَّ:to achieve certainity by assuming from signs and evidence

title: content/y/y4.html
raw_text:
4 YAKSUW HUWNA [To Concentrate,To be Wholly Devoted]
Synonyms: HANAFA حَنَفَ, TABATTALA تَبَتَّلَ
4.1 HANIYF   حَنِيْف:HANAFA (antonym JANAFA جَنَفَ) to incline toward perseverance by leaving all false paths. and HANIYF means the one who comes towards only straight path, leaving all wrong paths.ALLAH said
Surat Yūnus (Jonah) - سورة يونس
10:105
وَأَنْ أَقِمْ وَجْهَكَ لِلدِّينِ حَنِيفًا وَلَا تَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ
And [commanded], 'Direct your face toward the religion, inclining to truth, and never be of those who associate others with Allah ;
4.2 TABTIYL   تَبْتِيْل:BATALA(بَتَلَ) meaning to cut of something to detach it from some other. and BATTALA بَتَّلَ and TABATTALA meaning to free to turn to GOD by turning/diverting away one's attention from every type of business and    fuss.to    be involved in GOD's worship with sincere intention.ALLAH said
Surat Al-Muzzammil (The Enshrouded One) - سورة المزمل
73:8
وَاذْكُرِ اسْمَ رَبِّكَ وَتَبَتَّلْ إِلَيْهِ تَبْتِيلًا
And remember the name of your Lord and devote yourself to Him with [complete] devotion.
Summary  :

1 – Zaida [excess,extra]
Synonyms: AAFU, NAFILAH, DI’IF
1.1 AAFU (عَفْو):   AFA has two important aspects: 1. To leave something, 2. To exceed. AFA-ASH-SHA’R (عَفََاالشَّعْر) means to leave hair and let it grow. The Prophet ﷺ said “قَصُّواالشَّوَارِبَ واعفوالحٰی ” translation: Clip then moustache and grow the beard. AFA-ASH-SHA (عَفَاالشَّیْ) means to exceed. AAFU (عَفْو) means excess or a superior thing. AAFU-MINAL-MAAL (عَفْومِنَ الْمَال) means wealth that is in excess and is easily dispensable. In the Quran
Surah Al-Baqarah (The cow): سورۃ البَقَرَۃ 2:219
وَيَسۡـَٔلُونَكَ مَاذَا يُنفِقُونَ قُلِ ٱلۡعَفۡوَ*ۗ
And they ask you about what they should give: say, “The surplus.”
1.2 NAFILAH (نَافِلَۃ):   NAFALA(نَفَلَ) means to donate. ANFAAL (اَنْفَالْ) means giving away spoils of war. NAFL (نَفْل) refers to anything that is in excess to requirement or dues. Similarly nawafil worship is what is intentionally performed apart from the fard or sunnah. It may be salah, charity, fasting or pilgrimage. In the Quran
Surah    Al-Israa (The Night Journey   ): سورۃ الٕاسرَاء 17-79
وَمِنَ ٱلَّيۡلِ فَتَهَجَّدۡ بِهِۦ نَافِلَةً۬ لَّكَ
And keep vigil with it during parts of the night, as an extra prayer.
Another reference in Quran
Surah Al-Anbiya (the prophets): سورۃ الانَبیاء 21:72
وَوَهَبۡنَا لَهُ ۥۤ إِسۡحَـٰقَ وَيَعۡقُوبَ نَافِلَةً۬*ۖ
And We granted him Isaac and Jacob as a gift;
1.3 DI’IF (**ضِعْف):   double the original amount. In the Quran
Surah    Al-Israa (The Night Journey   ): سورۃ الٕاسرَاء 17-75
إِذً۬ا لَّأَذَقۡنَـٰكَ ضِعۡفَ ٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ وَضِعۡفَ ٱلۡمَمَاتِ
Then We would have made you taste double in life, and double at death;
The double of DI’IF(ضِعْف) is DI’IFAIN(ضِعْفِیْن) which means to increase. In the Quran
Surah Al-Baqarah (The cow): سورۃ البَقَرَۃ 2:265
كَمَثَلِ جَنَّةِۭ بِرَبۡوَةٍ أَصَابَهَا وَابِلٌ۬ فَـَٔاتَتۡ أُڪُلَهَا ضِعۡفَيۡنِ
Example is that of a garden on a hillside. If heavy rain falls on it, its produce is doubled
DA’AFA (ضَاعَفَ) means to exceed manifold. In the Quran
Surah Al-Baqarah (The cow): سورۃ البَقَرَۃ 2:261
وَٱللَّهُ يُضَـٰعِفُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ*ۗ
God multiplies for whom He wills
Page 557
Summary:
1.1 AAFU: To exceed.
1.2 NAFILAH: anything that is in excess to requirement or dues.
1.3 DI’IF: double the original amount.

raw_text:
10 – Adornment
The words زِينَة, زُخرُف, رِيش, زُهرَة and جَمَال have been used in the holy Quran
10.1 ZEENAH (زِينَة): means to decorate, embellish, ornament; is commonly used.  Used with both tangible and intangible things as well as with reference to physical and external adornment.
An example of external adornment:
Surat Al-Qaşaş (The Stories) - القصص سورة
28:79
فَخَرَجَ عَلَىٰ قَوۡمِهِۦ فِى زِينَتِهِۦ‌ۖ (﻿٧٩﻿)
So he came out before his people in his adornment (79)
An example of physical adornment:
Surat Al-'A`rāf (The Heights) - لأعرافا سورة
7:32
قُلۡ مَنۡ حَرَّمَ زِينَةَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّتِىٓ أَخۡرَجَ لِعِبَادِهِۦ (﻿٣٢﻿)
Say, "Who has forbidden the adornment of Allah which He has produced for His servants (32)
An example of intangible adornment:
Surat Al-'An`ām (The Cattle) - الأنعام سورة
6:43
وَزَيَّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلشَّيۡطَـٰنُ مَا ڪَانُواْ يَعۡمَلُونَ (﻿٤٣﻿)
And Satan made attractive to them that which they were doing (43)
10.2 ZUKHRUF (زُخرُف): can mean (1) apparent ornamentation; beautification that is attained through fabrication/coating.  The phrase الكلام رخرف refers to adorning a statement with lies. For example, Allah (the exalted) states in the holy Quran:
Surat Al-'An`ām (The Cattle) - الأنعام سورة
6:112
يُوحِى بَعۡضُهُمۡ إِلَىٰ بَعۡضٍ۬ زُخۡرُفَ ٱلۡقَوۡلِ غُرُورً۬ا‌ۚ (﻿١١٢﻿)
Inspiring to one another decorative speech in delusion (112)
(2) The term can also refer to the different forms and colors of plants.
Surat Yūnus (Jonah) - يونس سورة
10:24
حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَآ أَخَذَتِ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ زُخۡرُفَهَا (﻿٢٤﻿)
Until, when the earth has taken on its adornment (24)
10.3 REESHA (رِيش): الطاءر ريش refers to the feathers of birds, especially those of eagles.  رَيَّاش is one who decorates arrows with the feathers of birds.  Because the feathers of a bird are its clothing, this term began to be used metaphorically for luxurious attire – beautiful clothing.
Surat Al-'A`rāf (The Heights) - الأعراف سورة
7:26
يَـٰبَنِىٓ ءَادَمَ قَدۡ أَنزَلۡنَا عَلَيۡكُمۡ لِبَاسً۬ا يُوَٲرِى سَوۡءَٲتِكُمۡ وَرِيشً۬ا‌ۖ (﻿٢٦﻿)
O children of Adam, We have bestowed upon you clothing to conceal your private parts and as adornment (26)
10.4 ZAHRAH (زُهرَة): apparent attractiveness, eye candy, gloss and glitter, something lustrous.  The phrase الدنيا زهرة refers to the apparent luster and splendor of the worldly life.  The term is usually used in the context of this unsubstantial world, its attractiveness and sparkle.
Surat Ţāhā (Ta-Ha) - طه سورة
20:131
وَلَا تَمُدَّنَّ عَيۡنَيۡكَ إِلَىٰ مَا مَتَّعۡنَا بِهِۦۤ أَزۡوَٲجً۬ا مِّنۡہُمۡ زَهۡرَةَ ٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنۡيَا (﻿١٣١﻿)
And do not extend your eyes toward that by which We have given enjoyment to [some] categories of them, [its being but] the splendor of worldly life (131)
10.5 JAMAL (جَمَال): can refer to (1) the apparent/outer beauty of something, (2) qualities related to one’s character or (3) well decorated surroundings/environment.  In the Quran, the term has been used to describe goodness of deeds, character and apparent actions as well as observable beauty.  Originally the term referred only to internal beauty.
Surat An-Naĥl (The Bee) - النحل سورة
16:6
وَلَكُمۡ فِيهَا جَمَالٌ حِينَ تُرِيحُونَ وَحِينَ تَسۡرَحُونَ (﻿٦﻿)
And for you in them is [the enjoyment of] beauty when you bring them in [for the evening] and when you send them out [to pasture] (6)
Summary:
1.          زِينَة: common term for adornment and decoration
2.          زُخرُف: adornment attained through coating
3.          رِيش: adornment attained through luxurious attire and beautification
4.          زُهرَة: used for the luster and charm of the worldly life
5.          جَمَال: used for apparent beauty, beauty of character and beautification of the environment

title: content/z/z2.html
raw_text:
2. ZABARDASTI KERNA [to force, to coerce]
Synonyms: AKRAHA , JABARA, QAHARA, SAKH-KHARA, RAHIQA
2.1 AKRAHA (اَکْرَہَ):   KARIHA (  کَرِہَ  ) means to abhor, detest or loathe something. AKRAHA (  اَکْرَہَ  ) means to coerce or compel someone. It basically refers to two things: loathing and coercing. In the Quran
Surah Al-Baqarah (The cow): سورۃ البَقَرَۃ 2:256
لَآ إِكۡرَاهَ فِى ٱلدِّينِ*ۖ
Let there be no compulsion in religion
Another reference in Quran:
Surah Al-Noor (The light): سورۃ النور 24:33
وَلَا تُكۡرِهُواْ فَتَيَـٰتِكُمۡ عَلَى ٱلۡبِغَآءِ إِنۡ أَرَدۡنَ تَحَصُّنً۬ا لِّتَبۡتَغُواْ عَرَضَ ٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنۡيَا*ۚ
And do not compel your girls to prostitution, seeking the materials of this life, if they desire to remain chaste
2.2 JABARA (جَبَرَ):   the meaning also consists of two parts: 1. Coercion, 2. Rectification. Essentially to rectify by force. JABAR-AL-ADHM (جَبَرَالْعَظْم) means to cure (rectify) a broken bone. JABAR-AL- ‘AMR (جَبَرَالاَمْر) means to compel someone to perform a task. Allah mentions His Attributes in the Quran
Surah Al Hashr (The exile): سورۃ الحَشر 59:23
ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡجَبَّارُ ٱلۡمُتَڪَبِّرُ*ۚ
the Almighty, the Omnipotent, the Overwhelming
This word is also used to indicate coercion. For instance in Quran
Surah Ash-Shura’ (The Poets): صورۃ الشُّعْراء 26:130
وَإِذَا بَطَشۡتُم بَطَشۡتُمۡ جَبَّارِينَ
And when you strike, you strike mercilessly?
2.3 QAHARA (قَھَرَ):   also consists of two parts: 1. Dominate, 2. Humiliate - to dominate over someone and to humiliate those under influence. To signify strong oppressing a weak. In the Quran
Surah Ad-Duha (The morning hours): سورۃ الضُّحیٰ 93:9
فَأَمَّا ٱلۡيَتِيمَ فَلَا تَقۡهَرۡ وَأَمَّا ٱلسَّآٮِٕلَ فَلَا تَنۡہَرۡ
Therefore, do not mistreat the orphan. Nor rebuff the seeker.
Page 558
2.4 SAKH-KHARA (سَخَّرَ):   SAKHARA (سَخَرَ) means to ridicule, and SAKH-KHARA (  سَخَّرَ  ) comprises of two things: 1. Coercion, 2. Self regard. To force someone to your bidding. To coerce someone to work against their will. This word is commonly used when the conquest of universe is deliberated. In the Quran
Surah Ibraheem (Abraham): سورۃ ابراھیم 14:33
وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمُ ٱلشَّمۡسَ وَٱلۡقَمَرَ دَآٮِٕبَيۡنِ*ۖ وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمُ ٱلَّيۡلَ وَٱلنَّہَارَ
And He committed the sun and the moon to your service, both continuously pursuing their courses, and He committed the night and the day to your service
Another reference:
Surah Az-Zukhruf (Ornaments of Gold): سورۃالزُّخرف 43:32
وَرَفَعۡنَا بَعۡضَہُمۡ فَوۡقَ بَعۡضٍ۬ دَرَجَـٰتٍ۬ لِّيَتَّخِذَ بَعۡضُہُم بَعۡضً۬ا سُخۡرِيًّ۬ا*ۗ
We elevated some of them in rank above others, that some of them would take others in service
2.5 RAHIQA (رَھِقَ):   to hide, to cover something. RAHIQA-UL-AMR (رَھِقََہُ الْاَمْر) means something forcefully detained him. Thus RAHIQA refers to: 1. Coercion/Force, 2. Hide or cover.
Surah Al-Qalam (The Pen):سورۃ القلم 68:43
خَـٰشِعَةً أَبۡصَـٰرُهُمۡ تَرۡهَقُهُمۡ ذِلَّةٌ۬*ۖ
Their eyes subdued, shame will cover them.
Summary:

2. ZABARDASTI KERNA [to force, to coerce]

Synonyms: AKRAHA , JABARA, QAHARA, SAKH-KHARA, RAHIQA

2.1 AKRAHA (اَکْرَہَ): KARIHA (کَرِہَ) means to abhor, detest or loathe something. AKRAHA (اَکْرَہَ) means to coerce or compel someone. It basically refers to two things: loathing and coercing. In the Quran

Surah Al-Baqarah (The cow): سورۃ البَقَرَۃ 2:256

لَآ إِكۡرَاهَ فِى ٱلدِّينِ*ۖ

Let there be no compulsion in religion

Another reference in Quran:

Surah Al-Noor (The light): سورۃ النور 24:33

وَلَا تُكۡرِهُواْ فَتَيَـٰتِكُمۡ عَلَى ٱلۡبِغَآءِ إِنۡ أَرَدۡنَ تَحَصُّنً۬ا لِّتَبۡتَغُواْ عَرَضَ ٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنۡيَا*ۚ

And do not compel your girls to prostitution, seeking the materials of this life, if they desire to remain chaste

2.2 JABARA (جَبَرَ): the meaning also consists of two parts: 1. Coercion, 2. Rectification. Essentially to rectify by force. JABAR-AL-ADHM (جَبَرَالْعَظْم) means to cure (rectify) a broken bone. JABAR-AL- ‘AMR (جَبَرَالاَمْر) means to compel someone to perform a task. Allah mentions His Attributes in the Quran

Surah Al Hashr (The exile): سورۃ الحَشر 59:23

ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡجَبَّارُ ٱلۡمُتَڪَبِّرُ*ۚ

the Almighty, the Omnipotent, the Overwhelming

This word is also used to indicate coercion. For instance in Quran

Surah Ash-Shura’ (The Poets): صورۃ الشُّعْراء 26:130

وَإِذَا بَطَشۡتُم بَطَشۡتُمۡ جَبَّارِينَ

And when you strike, you strike mercilessly?

2.3 QAHARA (قَھَرَ): also consists of two parts: 1. Dominate, 2. Humiliate - to dominate over someone and to humiliate those under influence. To signify strong oppressing a weak. In the Quran

Surah Ad-Duha (The morning hours): سورۃ الضُّحیٰ 93:9

فَأَمَّا ٱلۡيَتِيمَ فَلَا تَقۡهَرۡ وَأَمَّا ٱلسَّآٮِٕلَ فَلَا تَنۡہَرۡ

Therefore, do not mistreat the orphan. Nor rebuff the seeker.

Page 558

2.4 SAKH-KHARA (سَخَّرَ): SAKHARA (سَخَرَ) means to ridicule, and SAKH-KHARA (سَخَّرَ) comprises of two things: 1. Coercion, 2. Self regard. To force someone to your bidding. To coerce someone to work against their will. This word is commonly used when the conquest of universe is deliberated. In the Quran

Surah Ibraheem (Abraham): سورۃ ابراھیم 14:33

وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمُ ٱلشَّمۡسَ وَٱلۡقَمَرَ دَآٮِٕبَيۡنِ*ۖ وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمُ ٱلَّيۡلَ وَٱلنَّہَارَ

And He committed the sun and the moon to your service, both continuously pursuing their courses, and He committed the night and the day to your service

Another reference:

Surah Az-Zukhruf (Ornaments of Gold): سورۃالزُّخرف 43:32

وَرَفَعۡنَا بَعۡضَہُمۡ فَوۡقَ بَعۡضٍ۬ دَرَجَـٰتٍ۬ لِّيَتَّخِذَ بَعۡضُہُم بَعۡضً۬ا سُخۡرِيًّ۬ا*ۗ

We elevated some of them in rank above others, that some of them would take others in service

2.5 RAHIQA (رَھِقَ): to hide, to cover something. RAHIQA-UL-AMR (رَھِقََہُ الْاَمْر) means something forcefully detained him. Thus RAHIQA refers to: 1. Coercion/Force, 2. Hide or cover.

Surah Al-Qalam (The Pen):سورۃ القلم 68:43

خَـٰشِعَةً أَبۡصَـٰرُهُمۡ تَرۡهَقُهُمۡ ذِلَّةٌ۬*ۖ

Their eyes subdued, shame will cover them.

Summary:

2.1 IKRAHA: loathe and coercion.

2.2 JABARA: coerce to rectify.

2.3 QAHARA: coercion and oppression.

2.4 SAKH-KHARA: coercion and self regard

2.5 RAHIQA: coercion and enshroud.

Synonym: QARH, JURUH
3.1 QARH (قَرْح):   means abscess, abrasion or wound (plural QAROOHقروح ). Its cause can be internal or external; for instance an abscess causing an pus-filled wound and later causing pain. إِن يَمۡسَسۡكُمۡ قَرۡحٌ۬ فَقَدۡ مَسَّ ٱلۡقَوۡمَ قَرۡحٌ۬ مِّثۡلُهُ ۥ*ۚ
If a wound afflicts you, a similar wound has afflicted the others
Page 559

وَٱلسِّنَّ بِٱلسِّنِّ وَٱلۡجُرُوحَ قِصَاصٌ۬*ۚ
a tooth for a tooth, and an equal wound for a wound;
Summary:
3.1 QARH: injury limited to skin
3.2 JUROOH: deep wound

title: content/z/z4.html
raw_text:
4 ZAMANA [time period, epoch]
Synonyms: DAHR, ASR, QARN, HUQBA, RAIB-AL-MANOON
4.1 DAHR (دَھْر): The time period since the creation of the universe till the end of it. According to Ibn-Al-Faris, DAHARA(دَھَرَ) has the essence of domination, and DAHR (دَھْر) is used to for time because it is faced (experienced) by everyone and dominates them. The Prophet said “لَا تَسُبُّواالدَّھْرَفَاِنَّ اﷲَ ھُوَالدَّھْر” translation: Do not revile time for Allah is time. DAHIR (دھری) means an atheist. Allah says in Quran
Surah Al-Insan (The Man): سورۃ الانْسان 76:1
هَلۡ أَتَىٰ عَلَى ٱلۡإِنسَـٰنِ حِينٌ۬ مِّنَ ٱلدَّهۡرِ لَمۡ يَكُن شَيۡـًٔ۬ا مَّذۡكُورًا
Has there come upon man a period of time when he was nothing to be mentioned?
4.2 ‘ASR (عَصْر): Last part of the day, Afternoon or Time. The time-period of days and nights until they last. Rather it should be the time when man came into being till the day of resurrection because Allah takes ‘Asr as a witness. And if the man did not exist then how could this be a witness? Allah Knows best. In Quran
Surah Al Asr (The Time): سورۃ العصر 103:1
وَٱلۡعَصۡرِ إِنَّ ٱلۡإِنسَـٰنَ لَفِى خُسۡرٍ
By time. The human being is in loss.
Certainly days and nights were made long before the creation of man. According to the above mentioned definition the plural of ‘ASR(عَصْر) and DAHR(دَھْر) do not exist, but according to dictionary, the plural of DAHR(دَھْر) is DUHOOR(دُھُوْر), and of ‘ASR (عَصْر) is USOOR(عُصُوْر). This is because the common meaning of DHAR (دَھْر) and ASR (عَصْر) is taken as an extended time period.
4.3 QARN (قَرْنْ): a century, people belonging to a same era, people of same historic period. Therefore QARN (قَرْنْ) can relate to a certain age or time period and also to the people of that age. Like QARYAH (قَرْیَۃ) (plural QAROON (قرون)) means a village and the people belonging to it. In Quran this word is mostly used for people of an age. For instance
Surah Ta-Ha (Ta-ha): سورۃ طٰھٰ 20:51
قَالَ فَمَا بَالُ ٱلۡقُرُونِ ٱلۡأُولَىٰ
(Pharaoh) said: "What then is the condition of previous generations?"
4.4 HUQBAH (حُقْبَۃ): period of eighty (80) years or more, long period of time, unspecified time period. Its plural is both HUQUB (حُقْبَ) and AHQAB (احْقَابَ) meaning centuries. The natives say that the word is taken from HAQEEBAH(حقیبۃ) which means the leather tote for carrying luggage that a rider fastens to his saddle - thus it’s not a part of time rather adverb of time and place. Allah says in the Quran
Surah Al-Kahf (The Cave): سورۃ الکھف 18:60
حَتَّىٰٓ أَبۡلُغَ مَجۡمَعَ ٱلۡبَحۡرَيۡنِ أَوۡ أَمۡضِىَ حُقُبً۬ا
until I reach the junction of the two rivers, even if it takes me years.”
4.5 RAIB-AL-MANOON(رَیْبَ اْلمَنُوْن) : an idiom which means the alterations of time, Usually refers to accidents or calamity of time in a negative way; e.g. when someone goes through a difficult phase for a time or longer. In the Quran:
Surah At-Tur (The Mount): سورۃ الطُّور 52:30
أَمۡ يَقُولُونَ شَاعِرٌ۬ نَّتَرَبَّصُ بِهِۦ رَيۡبَ ٱلۡمَنُونِ
Or do they say, “A poet—we await for him a calamity of time”?
Summary:
4.1 DAHR: time from the creation of universe to the end of it.
4.2 ASR: time from creation of mankind till the day of resurrection.
4.3 QARN: Era or People of that era
4.4 HUQBAH: A long time period. Eighty years or more
4.5 RAIB-AL-MANOON : accidents of time. (see GARDISH-E-AYYAM)

title: content/z/z6.html
raw_text:
6 – To Level the Earth, To Destroy
The words دَكَّ and دَمدَمَ have been used in the holy Quran
6.1 DAKKA (دَكَّ): this term includes two things – to crush and to level, make plane and smooth.  So this term means to crush something into small bits so that it is leveled with the earth.
Surat Al-'A`rāf (The Heights) - الأعراف سورة
7: 143
فَلَمَّا تَجَلَّىٰ رَبُّهُ ۥ لِلۡجَبَلِ جَعَلَهُ ۥ دَڪًّ۬ا (﻿١٤٣﻿)
But when his Lord appeared to the mountain, He rendered it level (143)
And in another place the Almighty states:
Surat Al-Fajr (The Dawn) - لفجرا سورة
89:21
كَلَّآ إِذَا دُكَّتِ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ دَكًّ۬ا دَكًّ۬ا (﻿٢١﻿)
No! When the earth has been leveled - pounded and crushed (21)
6.2 DAMDAMA (دَمدَمَ): the phrase الشّئ دَمدَمُ refers to making something stick to the ground. The phrase عَلَيهِم اللّٰهُ دَمدَمَ means Allah destroyed them.  A dessert is also called a دَيمُومَة.
Surat Ash-Shams (The Sun) - الشمس سورة
91: 14
فَدَمۡدَمَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ رَبُّهُم بِذَنۢبِهِمۡ فَسَوَّٮٰهَا (﻿١٤﻿)
So their Lord brought down upon them destruction for their sin and made it equal [upon all of them] (14)
Summary:
1.          دَكَّ: to demolish some lifeless object and level the earth
2.          دَمدَمَ: to punish through destruction and complete annihilation

title: content/z/z7.html
raw_text:
7 – Chains
The words سَلَاسِل (سَلَّ), اَصفَاد, اَنكَالَ and اَغلَال have been used in the holy Quran
7.1 SALAASIL (سَلَاسِل): [singular – سلسله] سَلَّ means to pull one thing from another like pulling a sword from its sheath.  سلسله refers to a chain, whose each link is linked with another.  تسلسل refers for one thing to be linked to another.
Surat Al-Ĥāqqah (The Reality) - الحاقة سورة
69:32
ثُمَّ فِى سِلۡسِلَةٍ۬ ذَرۡعُهَا سَبۡعُونَ ذِرَاعً۬ا فَٱسۡلُكُوهُ (﻿٣٢﻿)
Then into a chain whose length is seventy cubits insert him (32)
7.2 ASFAAD (اَصفَاد): [singular – صَفَد and صِفَاد] refers to iron shackles or fetters which are used to tie captives.   صَفَدَ means to tie or make captive while اَصفَدَ means to hold captive.
Surat Şād (The Letter "Saad") - ص سورة
38:38
وَءَاخَرِينَ مُقَرَّنِينَ فِى ٱلۡأَصۡفَادِ (﻿٣٨﻿)
And others bound together in shackles (38)
7.3 ANKAALA (اَنكَالَ): [singular – نكل] نكل refers to an iron bridle or fetters that are used to control an animal.  نكَال also refers to an exemplary punishment which serves as a deterrent for others.  نَكَّلَ means to give someone an exemplary punishment or chain them with fetters or bridle them.
Surat Al-Muzzammil (The Enshrouded One) - المزمل سورة
73:12-13

7 – Chains

 

The words سَلَاسِل (سَلَّ), اَصفَاد, اَنكَالَ and اَغلَال have been used in the holy Quran

 

7.1 SALAASIL (سَلَاسِل): [singular – سلسله] سَلَّ means to pull one thing from another like pulling a sword from its sheath.  سلسله refers to a chain, whose each link is linked with another.  تسلسل refers for one thing to be linked to another.

 

Surat Al-Ĥāqqah (The Reality) - الحاقة سورة

69:32

 ثُمَّ فِى سِلۡسِلَةٍ۬ ذَرۡعُهَا سَبۡعُونَ ذِرَاعً۬ا فَٱسۡلُكُوهُ (﻿٣٢﻿)

Then into a chain whose length is seventy cubits insert him (32)

 

7.2 ASFAAD (اَصفَاد): [singular – صَفَد and صِفَاد] refers to iron shackles or fetters which are used to tie captives.   صَفَدَ means to tie or make captive while اَصفَدَ means to hold captive.

 

Surat Şād (The Letter "Saad") - ص سورة

38:38

 وَءَاخَرِينَ مُقَرَّنِينَ فِى ٱلۡأَصۡفَادِ (﻿٣٨﻿)

And others bound together in shackles (38)

 

7.3 ANKAALA (اَنكَالَ): [singular – نكل] نكل refers to an iron bridle or fetters that are used to control an animal.  نكَال also refers to an exemplary punishment which serves as a deterrent for others.  نَكَّلَ means to give someone an exemplary punishment or chain them with fetters or bridle them.

 

Surat Al-Muzzammil (The Enshrouded One) - المزمل سورة

73:12-13

 إِنَّ لَدَيۡنَآ أَنكَالاً۬ وَجَحِيمً۬ا (﻿١٢﻿) وَطَعَامً۬ا ذَا غُصَّةٍ۬ وَعَذَابًا أَلِيمً۬ا (﻿١٣﻿)

Indeed, with Us [for them] are shackles and burning fire (12).  And food that chokes and a painful   punishment (13).

Surat Al-'Insān (The Man) - الانسان سورة

Indeed, We have prepared for the disbelievers chains and shackles and a blaze (4)

1.      سَلَاسِل: common term for chains

2.      اَصفَاد: shackles or chain

3.      اَنكَالَ: bridle, fetters and chains

4.      اَغلَالَ: used in a variety of contexts, can refer to handcuffs, fetters, shackles, etc.

8 – To Give Life
The words اَحيَا, بَعَثَ and اَنشَرَ have been used in the holy Quran
8.1 AHYAA (اَحيَا): حَيِيَ means to be alive or to stay alive.  اَحيَا (opposite – اَمَاتَ) refers to make something dead alive.  This term is commonly used.
Surat Al-Baqarah (The Cow) - البقرة سورة
2:73
كَذَٲلِكَ يُحۡىِ ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡمَوۡتَىٰ وَيُرِيڪُمۡ ءَايَـٰتِهِۦ (﻿٧٣﻿)
Thus does Allah bring the dead to life, and He shows you His signs (73)
8.2 BA’AATHA (بَعَثَ): contains two essential meanings – to raise and to send alone.  If the term is being used in the context of the dead laying in their graves than it means to give them life, raise them and make them go toward the ground of Mehshar (the gathering ground on the Day of Judgment).
Surat Al-Ĥaj (The Pilgrimage) - الحج سورة
22:7
وَأَنَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ ءَاتِيَةٌ۬ لَّا رَيۡبَ فِيہَا وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَبۡعَثُ مَن فِى ٱلۡقُبُورِ (﻿٧﻿)
And [that they may know] that the Hour is coming - no doubt about it - and that Allah will resurrect those in the graves.
8.3 ANSHARA (اَنشَرَ): originally means to spread (opposite – طوي).  The phrase نشورا الميّت نشر refers to the dead being given life again.  النُّشُور اِلَيهِ includes the meanings of becoming alive, rising and spreading; it refers to being given life, spreading and going towards Allah.  اَنشَرَ means to give life and to spread in the ground of Mehshar (the gathering ground on the Day of Judgment).
Surat `Abasa (He Frowned) - عبس سورة
80:21-22
ثُمَّ أَمَاتَهُ ۥ فَأَقۡبَرَهُ ۥ (﻿٢١﻿) ثُمَّ إِذَا شَآءَ أَنشَرَهُ ۥ (﻿٢٢﻿)
Then He causes his death and provides a grave for him (21).     Then when He wills, He will resurrect him (22).
Summary:
1.          اَحيَا: commonly used term, to give life to anything dead
2.          بَعَثَ: to give life to the dead laying in the graves and to raise them
3.          اَنشَرَ: to give life, to raise and spread

title: content/z/z9.html
raw_text:
9 – To be Alive, stay Alive, keep Alive
The words حَيِيَ (حَيَّ), عَاشَ and اِستِحيَاءَ have been used in the holy Quran
9.1 HAIYA (حَيِيَ): means to be alive, to stay alive.  The term حَيٰوة means life, it is used in a wide variety of contexts, it is well established that animals have life but even inanimate objects show traces of life.  Allah (the All Mighty), His angels and the jinn are all alive.  This term is commonly used.  حَيٌّ refers to anything that is alive.
Surat Al-Mu'minūn (The Believers) - المؤمنون سورة
23:37
إِنۡ هِىَ إِلَّا حَيَاتُنَا ٱلدُّنۡيَا نَمُوتُ وَنَحۡيَا وَمَا نَحۡنُ بِمَبۡعُوثِينَ (﻿٣٧﻿)
Life is not but our worldly life - we die and live, but we will not be resurrected (37)
9.2 A’AASHA (عَاشَ): means to stay alive.  عَيش refers to the kind of life that is found in animals, in other words beings that subsist because of food and drink.  This term is thus more specific than حَيِيَ.  مَعِيشَت (plural – مَعَائِش) refers to the things necessary for existence.
Surat Al-'A`rāf (The Heights) - الأعراف سورة
7:10
وَلَقَدۡ مَكَّنَّـٰڪُمۡ فِى ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَجَعَلۡنَا لَكُمۡ فِيہَا مَعَـٰيِشَ‌ (﻿١٠﻿)
And We have certainly established you upon the earth and made for you therein ways of livelihood (10).
9.3 ISTIHYAA (اِستِحيَاءَ): حَيِيَ has the infinitives: حيوة – life and حَيَاء – modesty.  اِستِحيَاءَ means to be/seek modesty, to keep alive or to let something live.  The meaning of ‘letting something live’ is implied when in comparison something else is being made to die.
Surat Al-Baqarah (The Cow) - البقرة سورة
2:49
يُذَبِّحُونَ أَبۡنَآءَكُمۡ وَيَسۡتَحۡيُونَ نِسَآءَكُمۡ‌ۚ (﻿٤٩﻿)
Slaughtering your [newborn] sons and keeping your females alive (49).
Summary:
1.          حَيِيَ: the life of every living thing
2.          عَاشَ: the life of every such living being which is dependent upon food and drink for life
3.          اِستِحيَاءَ: to let someone else live

title: Aakhirah
raw_text:
Aakhirah
Aakhirah

"Arabic words used for this meaning in Quran"
آخرة - دار الآخرة - دار القرار

"Synonyms in English"
Hereafter, Next world, Life after death, Eternal abode

Aakhirah is the Arabic word for the Hereafter. It is derived from the root letters "ءخر" which means "to be last" or "to be behind".

The word Aakhirah, which is actually short for الحياة الآخرة,  is used in the Quran to refer to the life after death, the life in the Hereafter, the life in the next world, the life in the world to come, the life in the world of the unseen! The eternal life one will get after death in this world. When the bodies and the souls will reunite again. The life that will be full of rewards or punishments based on the deeds done in this world.

The opposite of Aakhirah is "Dunya" (الحياة الدنيا) which means "this world" or "this life". The word Dunya is the comparative word derived from the root letters "دنو" which means "to be near" or "to be close". So الحياة الدنيا actually means the closer life. Interestingly, when we refer to this world as dunya or the closer world, we are accepting the existence of aakhirah - the further world. Other words which are used in Quran as antonyms of Aakhirah are عاجلة, أولى, and أدنى.

"Surah Al-Baqarah - 4"

وَالَّذِينَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِمَا أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكَ وَمَا أُنزِلَ مِن قَبْلِكَ وَبِالْآخِرَةِ هُمْ يُوقِنُونَ
(1)

And who believe in (the Qur’ân and the Sunnah ) which has been sent down (revealed) to you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) and in that which was sent down before you [the Taurât (Torah) and the Injeel (Gospel), etc.] and they believe with certainty in the Hereafter. (Resurrection, recompense of their good and bad deeds, Paradise and Hell).

دار الآخرة

This eternal life is also referred to as "دار الآخرة" (Daar al-Aakhirah) in the Quran. The word "دار" can be translated as "home" or "abode". But this word is very comprehensive in its meaning. It can be used for a house, or town, area, country, even Earth as a home for humans. So this world is دار الدنيا and Aakhirah or دار الآخرة is the home in the Hereafter.

But in this furthest life, everyone will be rewarded an abode depending on their deeds in this world.

"Surah An-Nahl - 30"

وَقِيلَ لِلَّذِينَ اتَّقَوْا مَاذَا أَنزَلَ رَبُّكُمْ ۚ قَالُوا خَيْرًا ۗ لِّلَّذِينَ أَحْسَنُوا فِي هَٰذِهِ الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةٌ ۚ وَلَدَارُ الْآخِرَةِ خَيْرٌ ۚ وَلَنِعْمَ دَارُ الْمُتَّقِينَ
(1)

And (when) it is said to those who are the Muttaqûn (the pious - See V.2:2) "What is it that your Lord has sent down?" They say: "That which is good." For those who do good in this world, there is good, and the home of the Hereafter will be better. And excellent indeed will be the home (i.e. Paradise) of the Muttaqûn.

"Surah Ar-Ra'd - 25"

وَالَّذِينَ يَنقُضُونَ عَهْدَ اللَّهِ مِن بَعْدِ مِيثَاقِهِ وَيَقْطَعُونَ مَا أَمَرَ اللَّهُ بِهِ أَن يُوصَلَ وَيُفْسِدُونَ فِي الْأَرْضِ ۙ أُولَٰئِكَ لَهُمُ اللَّعْنَةُ وَلَهُمْ سُوءُ الدَّارِ
(1)

And those who break the Covenant of Allâh, after its ratification, and sever that which Allâh has commanded to be joined (i.e. they sever the bond of kinship and are not good to their relatives), and work mischief in the land, on them is the curse (i.e. they will be far away from Allâh’s Mercy), and for them is the unhappy (evil) home (i.e. Hell).

"Surah Ibrahim - 28"

أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَى الَّذِينَ بَدَّلُوا نِعْمَتَ اللَّهِ كُفْرًا وَأَحَلُّوا قَوْمَهُمْ دَارَ الْبَوَارِ
(1)

Have you not seen those who have changed the Blessings of Allâh into disbelief (by denying Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه و سلم and his Message of Islâm), and caused their people to dwell in the house of destruction?

دار القرار

Another word used in the Quran for the Hereafter is "دار القرار" (Daar al-Qarar). The word "قرار" means "to settle" or "to stay". So this word is used to refer to the eternal abode where one will settle down forever. This word as used in the Quran has a positive association, as it is used to refer to the final abode of the righteous people.

For the disbelievers the word used is بئس القرار which means "evil abode" or "evil settlement".

"Surah Ghafir - 39"

يَا قَوْمِ إِنَّمَا هَٰذِهِ الْحَيَاةُ الدُّنْيَا مَتَاعٌ وَإِنَّ الْآخِرَةَ هِيَ دَارُ الْقَرَارِ
(1)

"O my people! Truly, this life of the world is nothing but a (quick passing) enjoyment, and verily, the Hereafter that is the home that will remain forever."

"Surah Sad - 60"

قَالُوا بَلْ أَنتُمْ لَا مَرْحَبًا بِكُمْ ۖ أَنتُمْ قَدَّمْتُمُوهُ لَنَا ۖ فَبِئْسَ الْقَرَارُ
(1)

(The followers of the misleaders will say): "Nay, you (too)! No welcome for you! It is you (misleaders) who brought this upon us (because you misled us in the world), so evil is this place to stay in!"

وَقِيلَ لِلَّذِينَ اتَّقَوْا مَاذَا أَنزَلَ رَبُّكُمْ ۚ قَالُوا خَيْرًا ۗ لِّلَّذِينَ أَحْسَنُوا فِي هَٰذِهِ الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةٌ ۚ وَلَدَارُ الْآخِرَةِ خَيْرٌ ۚ وَلَنِعْمَ دَارُ الْمُتَّقِينَ
(1)
1. And (when) it is said to those who are the Muttaqûn (the pious - See V.2:2) "What is it that your Lord has sent down?" They say: "That which is good." For those who do good in this world, there is good, and the home of the Hereafter will be better. And excellent indeed will be the home (i.e. Paradise) of the Muttaqûn. !!! quote "Surah Ar-Ra'd - 25"
وَالَّذِينَ يَنقُضُونَ عَهْدَ اللَّهِ مِن بَعْدِ مِيثَاقِهِ وَيَقْطَعُونَ مَا أَمَرَ اللَّهُ بِهِ أَن يُوصَلَ وَيُفْسِدُونَ فِي الْأَرْضِ ۙ أُولَٰئِكَ لَهُمُ اللَّعْنَةُ وَلَهُمْ سُوءُ الدَّارِ
(1)
1. And those who break the Covenant of Allâh, after its ratification, and sever that which Allâh has commanded to be joined (i.e. they sever the bond of kinship and are not good to their relatives), and work mischief in the land, on them is the curse (i.e. they will be far away from Allâh’s Mercy), and for them is the unhappy (evil) home (i.e. Hell). !!! quote "Surah Ibrahim - 28"
أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَى الَّذِينَ بَدَّلُوا نِعْمَتَ اللَّهِ كُفْرًا وَأَحَلُّوا قَوْمَهُمْ دَارَ الْبَوَارِ
(1)
1. Have you not seen those who have changed the Blessings of Allâh into disbelief (by denying Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه و سلم and his Message of Islâm), and caused their people to dwell in the house of destruction? ## دار القرار Another word used in the Quran for the Hereafter is "دار القرار" (Daar al-Qarar). The word "قرار" means "to settle" or "to stay". So this word is used to refer to the eternal abode where one will settle down forever. This word as used in the Quran has a positive association, as it is used to refer to the final abode of the righteous people. For the disbelievers the word used is بئس القرار which means "evil abode" or "evil settlement". !!! quote "Surah Ghafir - 39"
يَا قَوْمِ إِنَّمَا هَٰذِهِ الْحَيَاةُ الدُّنْيَا مَتَاعٌ وَإِنَّ الْآخِرَةَ هِيَ دَارُ الْقَرَارِ
(1)
1. "O my people! Truly, this life of the world is nothing but a (quick passing) enjoyment, and verily, the Hereafter that is the home that will remain forever." !!! quote "Surah Sad - 60"
قَالُوا بَلْ أَنتُمْ لَا مَرْحَبًا بِكُمْ ۖ أَنتُمْ قَدَّمْتُمُوهُ لَنَا ۖ فَبِئْسَ الْقَرَارُ
(1)
1. (The followers of the misleaders will say): "Nay, you (too)! No welcome for you! It is you (misleaders) who brought this upon us (because you misled us in the world), so evil is this place to stay in!"
